tei:div.tei:p: hā:bye ni gu/ 1 bca 'ab 3777ne bya 8330lung0606ba 'ang 5055'bya 17 bci kho migaXng khukhu po khor

/ tsho sne 37 4ma ri thupa 7 rto༄ ༄ lha'i dzo cu nga laX sku 'i rngo64rke ༄1 rnye sa khu ba (( shākya ‘nga gi go ga /ri 5)rjo 3 — zlo 3 —— 5 44 ri 1 rngo7 80thu /ji tshun ༷ 77 ——— ————————— — — — —— sgo spra rke7 ———— 44 4 sdo du ༷ mi rdoX4 ༷ wa po 4 rdoX(dzeX snal4 ba la skol gde nge ( 8༄mi rten bye shes sgyu dol sgo sde — ngapo ༷ snang (snyedang ge ge ge ro ༷ ༷ hu ༷༄4shiXsnaX zod sna rngi r+sharme snyed
la — — — ——— 4la ༷/ 1 411 7 — —— — 1/ ḍā // mo // pha ga sa / wabyubyung —— —

dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib la jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib la jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so se'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams nga/ sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ngas dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum // zhes pa sde/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mjad pa ta cang rgya chen ngo/ gnang med pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i ming gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du la jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal sad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad dar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//krung go'i bod rig pa dpe sgrun khang nas/sngi nge — 2009lo'i zla 8par/

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su /khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyen kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib la jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ga tshoganang bstan dpe rnying 'chos bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba pa'i tshes 7la/

ba//sgrig gab55 nga pond/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 200ldanas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum ming gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb nyanas 4bar pod rtags (kan 6) (gnakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā 'a chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6༄ 6) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja/ (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags 6) ste rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)sde dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags smyon)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i ze

pas chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags ( ba)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (pa) (she (chen ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (jen ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)sde rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin 'al lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma khong)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ta cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lha'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/()

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'brul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad dar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ga khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tsho thabs phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gachan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i ste'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sbrul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad 'bas drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khrag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon mkhag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gnyis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mjad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab 31ga brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'phos bsdu phyog sgrig khang nas////

dkar chagale'u bdun brgyud 'debs/ (1)bla ma ga me gu ru'i brgyud 'debs/ (2)bla ma ga rma gu ru'i gyer sgom 'phrin las gzi 'od stong 'bar/ (5)bla ma ga me gu ru'i 'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad byin rlabs sprin phung / (13)bla ma ga me gu ru'i bsnyen yig sbar bcangs ma (18)da rma gu ru yang gsang drag po dang 'brel ba'i zangs mdog dpal rir skye ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam gyi rim pa/ 420)bla ma dmi gu ru'i gtor nag gi las mtha' gnam lcags spu gri/ (22)ma dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed me mchod kyi cho ga rigs 'dzin srog mthud rtsi sman ljon pa/ (29)phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba (38)rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi rtsa tshig rdo rje'i mdud 'grol/ (42)rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying tig gi 'khrid yig mchan gsal 'bum phrag snang bzhi'i 'od zer/ (46)g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / (57)thug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston/ (71)tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi sgo nas gzim chung brtan bzhugs kyi chog sgrigs dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la dgos pa'i lhan thabs bcas pa (85)'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun gyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i zla snang / (91)

:sna brag gter byon nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dbang chog dang bcas pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ 599)byang gter lcags sdong ma'i dbang chog gi lhan thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang (109)khra brag gter byon ma'i dregs 'dul bsnyen thabs rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzi byin/ (117)rdo rje gtum pa'i las byang rgyun 'khyer mthong bas rnam grol/ (121)rjes gnang rig gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las chu rgyun/ (125)lha brag gter byon las khyung gi 'phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog mda'/ (137)skad cig nyid la bde chen du bgrod par byed pa'i zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa/ (140)lcags 'dra'i 'khor lo'i sngags byang / (142)btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ (145)mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog gi bcas bshoms ci 'dod rtse dga' gsar glu/ (160)bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ (164)phyi nas mkha' 'gro bsun ma'i zhu ba/ 5183)tshogs mchod 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin/ (186)bsun bzlog gi zor byang / (190)brtan bzhugs kyi chog sgrigs rab brtan rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/ (192)rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti hrīḥgacig ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa (204)mchod rten gyi stod smad bar gsum bsgrig pa'i ngag 'don/ ci (222)rje btsun seng snyeXng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ (226)2

changs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum thor bu las dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo la bstod pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i do shal/ (248)dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i mnga' gsol bsam don lhun grub ma/ (254)lha mo'i gsang mdos bsngo tshig (258)sgo dbyer zor srin mo'i za lam ma rnams/ (261)'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdos kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ (267)gter srung dpal mgon stag zhen gyi gsol mchod bklags chog khyer bde/ (287)gtsang rong gter gsar bla ma zhi drag gnyis kyi gter srung mchod pa'i 'phrin las/ (293)sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po'i mdos kyi gyer gzhung bsam don lhun grub/ (295)byes chas ke tu'i las byang ngag bsgrigs dgra srog gcod pa'i spu gri (297)gnod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi mdos chog dbang drag grub pa'i dga' ston/ (304)dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin las yid bzhin gter mdzod/ (310)bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (333)drang srong khyab 'jug rā hu la'i las byang dug mda' nag po/ (368)khyab 'jug rten mdos kyi 'phrin las drang srong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ (374)drang srong log tri pā la'i las byang chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs/ (384)drang srong log tri pa la'i srung bzlog thun mong ba nyams su len tshul btsan mkhar bsrung ba'i 'dzaḥl skyogs/ (406)sngags rgod log tri'i tam gyi lag len nyi ma'i snying po/ (424)smu

drang srong log tri'i gtang rag (426)sngags rgod log tri pā la'i bzlog pa dang bsad pa'i las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang smyon sna rtser bkod pa'i mtshon 'khor/ (427)gnyan chen thang lha'i 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ (444)stag zhen/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/ bka' srung brgyad mchod/ thang lha/ khyab mjug /rgyal btsan/rdor legs/ zhing skyong / mthu chen sde bzhi/ phur srung rnams kyi gsol mchod/ gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bcas pa (451)nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog sgrigs mi mthun smag rum sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ (478)

le'u bdun brgyud 'debs/ nang ma (pe༄༅༅/ /le'u bdun brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/ /bde chen chos sku'i ngo bo 'od dpag med/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam rol pad dkar can/ /grangs med sprul pa'i zlos gar pad+ma 'byung / /nam mkha'i snying po 'tsho rgyal khri srong lde/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms mu khri btsan po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje can gyis gzigs/ /tshul 'di'i sgo 'byed gter ston bzang po grags/ /bka' babs dngos grub rgyal mtshan rdo rje dpal/ /byams pa bshes gnyen burnya shrī'i zhabs/ /mes ston nam mkha'i mtshan can shākya bzang / /bdud sde dpung bcoms rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje can gyis gzigs/ /snga 'gyur srog shing che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /theg mchog chos kyi rgyal po rig sngags 'chang / /kun bzang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar can/ /'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje can gyis gzigs/ /ru lag grum pa rgyang dang yon po lung / /gting zab sgrom bu mi mngon phyag rgya yis/ /rgyas bcings gsang ba zab mo'i gter gyi chos/ /dpal ldan lha mo dge bsnyen nor bu bzang / /gter gnas srung mar bcas pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba tre/ mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /tshig don yang zab gsol 'debs tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ khri shes ldan g.yel ba med par nyams len na/ /thugs rje nus pa'i mthu dpung bskyed du gsol/ /le'u bdun brgyud 'debs khyer bder shing sprel lo za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //sarba maṅga le/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebla ma ga rma gu ru'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/ /phul byung bde chen klong du g.yo med las/ /nag phyogs bdud sde 'joms phyir khros pa'i gar/ /ston mdzad bcom ldan ga rma he ru gar/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /log par 'khu ba'i 'byung po'i rgyal mtshan kun/ /cig car stol ba'i 'phrin las lha'i 'khor lo'i/ /drag sngags grub pa'i mthu ldan pra ha sti/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /bgrang yas sprul pa'i gar gyis rnam rol pa/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin pad+ma ka ra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /ljongs 'dir theg mchog bka' mi bsdu ba por/ /bde ba'i dpal ster ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /mi yi srid pa'i zol brten 'tsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i thugs rje'i rnam rol las/ /bod yul rgyal po'i tshul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan/ /rgyas mdzad tshangs pa lha yi me tog la/ /gsol ba (2na tsher de bas so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /gang gi skye sprul zlos gar grangs med las/ /ma rungs log 'dren kun 'dul zab mo'i gter/ /lung bstan dus bzhin sgo 'byed dbang po'i ster/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /mtha' klas nges gsang rgya mtsho'i tshogs spyi dang / /khyad par tshul 'di'i bka' babs dpral ba'i ngos/ /skye ba'i rtags kyis ngo mtshar rigs 'dzin cher/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /mi bzad gsang ba drag po'i gzhal med du/ /zab mo'i chos kyi bka' babs rig sngags 'chang / /mthu stobs rgya mtsho'i dpal gyur rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /mtha' yas theg pa mchog gi chos tshul kun/ /rjen par ston mdzad dpal ldan kun tu bzang / /bshes gnyen gzugs can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /g.yas ru gtsang rong kham bu lung —2

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheba'i gter/ /gnas chos bka' skyong srung ma'i tsho gos bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi mthar byed shog /srog gtad dbang gis rang rgyud yongs su smin/ /gang snang lha skur shar bas bskyed rim gsal/ /chos kun rig ngor 'phrod pas rang sar grol/ /phugs med tshul bzhin nyams su longs par shar/ nang du rang rgyud dug lnga bdud bzhi'i dpung / /ka dag dbyings su ye shes lngar dag pas/ /phyi rol 'khrul ngor shar ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /tshar gcod rten 'brel lhun gyis grub par shog /snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten par shog /grags pa thams cad grag stong sngagasakyi sgra/ /(3bskong sems brjod bral chos sku'i rang rtsal du/ /legs shar don gnyis tsā ba pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di'ang sngar brgyud 'debs shig brtsams de mang skyon nas phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i chog grwa ba rnams kyis 'khyer bde ba'i slad du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// //sarba maṅga lo/

bla ma ku me gu ru'i gyer sgom 'phrin las gzi 'od stong 'bar/ nang ma rtogebla ma ga rma gu ru'i gyer sgom 'phrin las gzi 'od stong 'bar bzhugs so/ /na maḥrkarma gu ra wa/ rnga yab gling dbus laṅka'i pho brang na/ /'bod grogs rgyal po'i rnam par 'phruldopo che/ 'phrin las rigs 'dzin dme gu ru'i gzis/ /bdud bzhi'i smag rum srid zhi'i pha mthar sgrod//khri srong lde btsan zab gter bstan pa'i sgo/ /'byed la sku gsung thugs sprul rim byon ltar/ /yon tan sgyu 'phrul bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal/ /mkha' 'gro 'phrin las yongs grub rtsal de bsngags/ /chosabadag bka' babs lung zan dpral rme can/ /mi lhag byang pa rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang / /rgyal kun ngo bo zur chen thams cad mkhyen/ /zhabs rdul byang chub bar du gtsug na bsten/ /au ḍi ya na'i slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rigs lnga'i rnam par 'byams su klas pa las/ /bya grub ye shes rang mdangs don grub tu/ /yongs shar 'byung po'i don snying 'bigs pa'i mda'/ /de phyir rkarma ma hā gu ru yi/ /gyer sgom 'phrin las gzi 'od stong 'bar ba/ /tshig gi srad bur legs brgyus mar gad 'phreng / /sngagasa'achang yongs kyis mgul ba'i rgyan du long / /skyabs sems tshogs (2na tsā kho mtshams gcod dang / /byin dbab mchod rlabs sngon 'gro'i 'khrigs/ /dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ /snyigs dus nyen mongs dug lnga drag /phung byed 'dre srin 'byung po langs/ /de phyir bar gcod rkyen rnam mang / /bar gcod rkyen las skyob pa'i phyir/ /bdud 'dul pad+ma ra bdag skyabs mchi/ /mtha' yi dgra bzhi mang ba dang / khyad par rang rgyud nyan mongs bdud/ /nang du zhakhrugs pa'i phyi rol bdud/ /rlung ltar langs tshe bsgrub par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/gnyis pa bsod nams tshogs gsog pa/ hūṃ/ ga me drag rtsal lha tshogs gshegs/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'abu la/ /nyams chags sdig sgrib thams cad bshags/ /gsang sngags bsgrub la rjes yi rang / /smin gro la gsang sngags chos 'khor skor/ /mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs/ /snying po sems can don du bsngo/ /yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /gsum pa mtshams (2ba)gcod rim pa ni/ hūṃ/ rang nyid dmi gu rur gsal ba yi/ /thugs las khro mtshon me dpung rab tu 'phros/ /gnod byed bdud dpung ma lus rdul du rlog /lhag ma phyir bskrad me mtshon khro bos gtams/ /rtsa sngags sham bu can gyi mjug tu/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha tsakra dz+wa la raṃ rak+ta rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ bzhi pa byin chen dbab pa ni/ hūṃ/ a la la ho bha ga wa na ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya ho sam ya sto/ hūṃ/ rnga yab gling phran srin po'i yul/ /zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal yas nas/ /ga me ma hā gu ru rtsal/ /lha tsho gos 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor rten dang sgrub rdzas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob/ /dbang chen bskur la byin gyis rlomes/ /gzi mdangs bkrag phyung bdud rtsir spel/ /bdud dang log 'dren tshar gcod pa'i/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /rtsa sngags mjug tu sam ya a be sha ya a āḥ lnga pa mchod gtor brlab pa ni/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las re yaṃ kho 'phros pas/ mchod pa'i tsho gos kyi nyes skyon bsregs gtore bkrus/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ /zegs mar 'dod yon lha mo dpag med spros/ /ā+oṃ ā ཿ PROB badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ badz+ra puspro hūṃ/ badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/ badz+ra — hūṃ/ badz+ra ni wi bye hūṃ/ badz+ra shasta hūṃ/badz+ra sarba pū dza megha hūṃ/ ā+oṃ āḥ& sarba pañtsa a khra ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ mahā ba li ta te dz+wa ba smra ta ba la ba te gu phya sa ma ya swā hā/ ā+oṃ āḥ& mahā rak+ta sa man+ta maṇ+ḍal hūṃ phaṭa/ rten bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugasagaso pa phyag /mchod bstod 'dzab (3na)bzla dngos gzhi'i khrigs/ /dang po rten dang brten pa ni/ /rang bi rig pa hūṃ du bsam/ khri khye las skyes pa'i sngags brjod pas/ /drag po'i gzhal yas lhun gyisagrub/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nang / /gdan du sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /chu skyes steng du nyon mongs bdud/ /dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng / /stang stabs khros pa'i tshul du ni/ /hūṃ pas karma drag po'i sku/ /ljang nag du ba'i mdog lta bu/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar/ /phyag —6

bla ma kurma gu ru'i gyer sgom tshon las gzi 'od stong 'bar/ nang ma 'dagayon seng ldeng phur bu bsgril/ /mthing nag ber dang chos gos bsnams/ /sna tsho gos rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang / /bdud kyi mgo 'phreng do shal 'chang / /stang stabs khros pa drag po'i sku/ /dam tshig sems dpa' nyid du gsal/ /gnyis pa ye shes spyan drang pa/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ laṅka pu ra srin po'i yul/ /gtum drag rngams pa'i dur khrod nas/ /srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can/ /gu ru ga rma drag po rtsal/ /log 'dren ma rungs bsgral slad du/ /gnas 'dir myur ba nyid du spyon/ /mahā gu ru ga rma drag po rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ gsum pa stan la bzhugs gsol ba/ 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng / /pad+ma'i gdan la nyon mongs bdud/ /dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng / /stang stabs khros pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /mahā gu ru ga me drag po rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ bzhi pa gus pasaphyag 'tshal ba/ (3ba)dpal chen thugs kyi sprul pa ma hā gu mā /drag po'i 'phrin las mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /ma rungs dus mtha'i dmag dpung 'joms pa'i lha/ /khro rgyal 'phrin las rdzogs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ma hā gu ru a ti pu sngo pra byu sngo lja pa mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ sgo lnga'i longs spyod phyi yi mchod pa dang / /dug lnga rnam dag rang byung dag pa'i rdzas/ /bde chen yongs grol gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams/ /bdud 'dul pad+ma'i sku la mchod par 'bul/ /dgyes pa chen bo bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol/ /badze mahā gu ru rma sa rak+ta ke snu ti a mṛ ta ba smra ta mahā sarba pā dza khā hi/ drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje 'dus pa dpal/ /ma rungs 'dul mdzad podze drag po rtsal/ /'gro ba snyigs ma'i sdug bsngal skyob pa'i lha/ /drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdun pa 'dzab kyi rim pa ni/ thugs kar mthing nag rdo rje'i dbus/ /hūṃ yig mtha' ru sngags kyis bskor/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i khang sgrom dbus/ /gsal bar bsgoms la drag sngags bzlas/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ ga me mahā gu ru ga me sirnyi hūṃ/ rtsa sgrub las/ rtsa ba'i snying po 'bum phrag gsum/ /bzlas pasabadud bzhi'i bar chad sel/ /zhes pa ltar bsnyen pa bya/ brlab drangs thog par tha ma lhag /mtho skyong bro gtang bsdu smon shis/ /dang po tshogs mchod byin rlabs ni/ tshogs mchoge ljags sgrigs las/—7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesgrub pa'i las rim kha skong phyir/ /'dod yon tshogs (4na)kyi yo byad rnams/ /zhing lpags dngos sam gcan gzan gyi/ /g.yang gzhi'i gdan la legs bshams te/ /a las thod pa'i nang du ni/ /'dod yon dpag med legs bshams la/ /'byung ba'i sa bon gsum gyis sbyangs/ /zhes pa ltar/ raṃ yaṃ kho/'bru gsum sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& saḥ yis 'dod yon sna tsho gis spel/ /gnyisapa tshogs la spyan drang ba/ dus gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dam tshig can/ /chos stong srung ma gter bdag rnams/ /ma lus yud kyis gnas 'dir spyon/ /laṅka pu ra srin po'i yul/ /zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog nas/ /srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can/ /'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /dag pa'i zhing khams so so nas/ /sprul skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /thugs rjes dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs/ /chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing mchog nas/ /mkha' 'gro 'phrin las yongs grub rtsal/ /chos bdag bu mchog nyer gcig rnams/ /tsho gos la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rkarma mahā gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni sarba ṅga ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ gsum pa thog mar mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ thugs rje 'phrin las gcig bsdus mahā gu sa /longs spyod rdzogs sku khrag 'thung zhi khro'i lha/ /dpa' bo ḍā ki chos srung gter bdag dang / /rigs 'dzin (4ba)brgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog thun dngos grub bu mchog bdag la stsol/ /ga ṇa tsakra pā dza khā hi/ bzhi pa bar du nyams chags bshags/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa'i dbang gyur te/ /tshor dang ma tshor ma rig mun pas bsgribs/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags kun/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas mthol zhing bshags/ /khrag 'thung lha tshogasarnams kyis bzod par bzhes/ /rkarma mahā gu ru sarba sa ma ya hūṃ/ lnga pa tha mar bsgral zhing stob/ //tsho tri dzaḥdzaḥ mchog gsum sku gsum byin rlabs bden pa dang / /dbang phyug 'jig rten dregs pa'i nus mthu yis/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan byas pas/ /dkon mchog spyi dgra rigs 'dzin sku dgra dang / /skye 'gror 'tshe byed zhing bcu ru dra dang / /bod khams phung byed mtha' dmag gdug pa'i —8—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebargyad dam btags tshe/ /so so'i gzugs bstan =/ mchod gtor 'di bzhes ཿ / lnga brgya tha ma zangasamadog dpal ri sa /gter ston rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro yongs grub kyis/ /'phrin las drag po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /dam can rgya mtsho dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /so so'i gzugs bstan ཿ /mchodagator 'dibazhes=/ hūṃ/ ma nyesadapang du dpon mchog bzhugs/ /dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku gzur zhig /khrag 'thung drag po'i dmag dpung bkye/ /dgra bo'i steng du gtor zor rgyob/ /mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad mā ra ya sod/ rtsa ba'i sngags dang las kyi sngags mang du bzla zhing gnod phyogs su 'phang / brgyad pa bod skyong bstan ma brngan zhes pa spyi ltar byed/ dgu pa dam sri'i steng du bro/bdud 'dul game drag po'i bro/ /dam sri'i snying la chems se chem/ khro bo khro mo rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegasasnying la chems sechem/ khro bo rnamasakyisabro brdungasal/ khro mo rnamasakyis rgyas 'debs so/ /shar du zhi ba'i bro brdungs pas/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar shog /lho ru rgyas pa'i bro brdungs pas/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyasapar shog /(6na)ba tu dbang gi bro brdungasapas/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang sdud shog /byang du drag po'i bro brdungs pa sa/ /dgra bgegs dam sri zhi bar shog /sngags mjugatu/ shan+ti/ 〈me pa shaṃ /mā ra ya phaṭa/ dgu pa bshagasashing btang rag gtong / yig brgya'i mjug tu/ lha mchog garma drag po gshegs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod 'bul/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul mthol lo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las bstod / /mchog dang thun mong dngosagrub stsol/ /mahā pas mahā rak+ta/ mahā ba kla ta khā hi/ hūṃ/ dpal chen thugasakyi sprul pa 'phrin las bdag /log 'dren gdug pa kun 'dul mahā gu sa /bdud sde'adul mdzad garma drag po'i sku/ /byin rlabasamathustobs nusapa'i rtsal ldan pa/ /ma rungs log 'dren 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcu pa dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu ba/ gnam lcags khang sgrom gdan bcas sku la thim/ /sku yang rdo rje de nyid sngags 'khor dang / /sngags 'phreng hūṃ la de yang zhabs kyu nas/ /nā da'i bar bsdus ka nas dbyings su dag /bcu gcig smon lam legs gdab pa/ /dge 'di'i mthu yis sde brgyad zil gnon — 10

bla ma dme gu ru'i gyer sgom 'phrin las gzi 'od stong 'bar/ nang ma 6)cing / /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal nas/ /rang rig don gyi dme drag po rtsal/ /mngon sum rang zhal tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig /bcu gnyis shis pa brjod pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun/ /skyabs gnas ma lus (6ba tshe sus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bla ma rigs 'dzin ga rma gu ru yis/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs shis brjod kyi rim pa ci rigs bya'o/ /gdul dka'i 'gro la tshangs pa lha'i me tog /slar byon byang pa rigs ldan chos rgyal che/ /sngags 'chang yongs kyi 'khor sgyur dbang po'i sdes/ /bka' gter bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs/ /snyigs dus 'byung po'i gnyen por cher khros pa/ /ga rma gu ru'i gtum drag tsha ba'i dpal/ /dus kyi me dpung khengs pa thung ngu sa /byed pa'i ngad de sde brgyad su yis bzod/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyag mtshan nyer gdengs pas/ /las bzhi thogs med bsgrub la dkar phyogs rnams/ /'dzum dang chabs cig phur bus bdud bzhi'i snying / /phug par nag po'i dpung rnams gdong pa dmad/ /gang gi rnam 'phrul srid me chu spungs nas/ /bskal pa'i me lce tshangs ris yul sa che/ /brgal bas nyes brgya gzhil dang cig car du/ /bkra shis mi nor yongs 'phel de med byung / /de phyir 'phrin las gang dkrugs 'thor pa rnams/ /brgyud ldan dam pa'i dgongs don 'khrul med du/ / rab bsdebs dge bas dus gsum rgyal kun gyi/ /bdag nyid rnga yab gling pas rjes 'dzin shog / ces bla ma ga me gu ru'i gyer sgom 'phrin las gzi 'od stong 'bar zhes pa 'di ni dkon mchog 'byung gnas thog chen mda' ltar 'phen pa sogs lang 'gro'i sngags 'chang rim par byon pa'i gdung las rta (7na 〉 na ga sgrol ma phug nas chen mos gsung gis bskul zhing chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas kyang legs so'i rgyu mtshan mdzad pa rnam g.yeng gis ring zhig 'gyangs pa nye char pho brang gnang byung ba sngags btsun ngag dbang mkhyen rtses bskul bas mtshams sbyor gyi rkyen byas gter gzhud ljags sgrigs gnyis dang bla ma'i gsung rgyun gyis legs par brgyan te za hor gyi sngags spyon zil gnon — 11 —
gu zla ba'i sbyosarba maṅga le

bla ma ga rma gu ru'i 'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad byin rlabs sbyin phung / nang ma (pebla ma ga me gu ru'i 'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so/ / na mo dharma dh+wa sna (2 ya/ /'phrin las drag por bsgrub pa srog gi dbang / /sbyin mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /chos dbyings rang grol zhabs pad la gas nas/ /kurma gu ru'i byin rlabs lag len 'dri/ /'dir rkarma mahā gu ru'i srog gtad pa'i sgo nas snod ldan gyi slob bu rjes su 'dzin pa la stegs bu'am cog tshe'i khar lcags sogs kyi snod du zan gyi chos 'byung nag po'i steng bdud bzhi'i gzugs phyag len ltar bkod pa'i dbus su seng ldeng gi phur pa dar gyi cod pan can btab/ de'i steng malji'i khar dbang gtor nag po zur gsum pa zhi drag gi rgyan spros phun sum tshogs pa sku rten tsakli dar nag gi gtor gdugs can g.yas g.yon du sna tshogs rdo rje/ seng phur/ dbang phyug gi zor gtor/sman raka /mdun du nyer spyod lnga tshar/ rgyab tu gter srung gi gtor ma/ mdun du tshogs mchod rnams bkod pas mdzes par bsham/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ thod rnga/ 'thor nas/gzhan yang rol chen bgegs gtor gu gul yungs dar sogs yo byad thams cad tshags su chud par (2na)byas/ las byang gzhung bzhin gyer ba'i bdag bskyed gsal 'debs pa dang lhan du me long la gzugs brnyan ltar dbang gtor kyang gsal btab ste/ bstod pa dang bsnyen pa dkyus bawo byas rjes dbang phyug gi zor sgrub bya/ tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum gter srung mchod pa rnams song rjes/ /de nas slob ma rnams yi ge brgya pa'i bum chus khrus nas phyung ste gral la 'khod/ /bgegs gtor btang / maṇ+ḍal phul/ spyi dang bye brag gi chos bshad dang / khyad par chos 'di'i lo rgyus kyi che ba bshad nas spro ba bskyed/ thog mar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ snyigs dus nyon mongs dug lnga drag /ces tshig rkang bzhi/ las byang ji lta ba'i gsham du/ bdud 'dul pad+ma'i srog gtad zhu/ /zhes lan gsum — 13—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegyis gsol ba gdab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar lam log pa las ldog pa skyabs 'gro dang / dman pa las ldog pa sems bskyed tsha/'i phyir du las byang ltar skyabs sems so sor tshar gsum re'i rjes zlos byed/ rtsa sgrub (2ba)las/ bu nyid lhar bskyed sgom lung phob/ /rdzas kun lag tu gtad par bya/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i bu la sbyin/ /mang du mi spel sam ya/ /zhes dang / drag po'i srog gtad las/ 'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad pa/ gzhung bzhin lha ru bskyed nas kyang / /tshil chen gu gul dud pa btang / /mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis/ /srin yul lo ka pu ra nas/ /spyan drangs bstim pa nyer gcig bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ dbang gi che ba byin dbab pa la rag las pa jo mo'i zhu lan las byung ba ltar gal che bas/ a mṛ ta'i sngags kyis bgegs bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ skad cig stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /gdan du sna tsho gos rdo rje dang / /chu skyes steng du nyon mongs bdud/ /dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng / /stangs stab khros pa'i tshul du ni/ /hūṃ las rdo rje'i slob bu rnams/ skad gcig po dze drag po'i sku/ /zhes pa nas/ zhesapa'i bar brjod cing gsal btab/ spos sbyor bsreg cing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/lo ka pu ra srin po'i yul/ /zhes sogs lan gsum dang / rtsa sngags nyer gcig brjod pas nub phyogs bde ba can/ /phyon mkha' 'gro'i gling / rnga yab gling phran/ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo sogs nas bdud 'dul ga rma gu ru la rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin byon pa bstim/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mi 'bral (3na tha'i ched du spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya/ de nas slob ma lhar gsal ba la mdun bskyed kyi phyag mtshan gnyis mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du gtad par brda sprad/ /nyon mongs bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i rdo rje 'di/ /skal ldan bu la thabs kyi phyag rgyar sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra sto bha ya nan zhes sna tshogs rdo rje lag g.yas su gtad/ 'phrin las yongs sgrol seng ldeng phur ba 'di/ khres rab snying rjes bsgral ba'i rjes su gtad/ /hūṃ badz+ra ki li ki lwa ya mā ra ya rbad ces lag g.yon du gtad/ gzhung las/— /4

bla ma ga me gu ru'i 'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad byin rlabs sprin phung / nang ma rtogeb smra lhar gsal spyi bor bzhag /ces pa'i don bzhin/ mdun gyi gtor ma ga me gu rur gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor gdan drangs la/ gdung shugs drag pos mos gus byed du bcug ste/ hūṃ/ dpal chen thugs kyi sprul pa 'phrin las bdag /log 'dren gdug pa kun 'dul mahā gu sa /ga me drag po rtsal gyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las byin rlabs nus pa'i rtsal/ /rigs kyi bu la da lta nyid du byin/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ da rma mahā ku ru rkarma sid+dhi hūṃ zhes brjod cing mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim par brda sprad/ gzhung las/ de nas srog gi snying po byin zhesapa'i don thugs gar mthing nag rdo rje'i dbus/ hūṃ yig mtha' ru sngags kyis bskor zhes pa'i don dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i thugs dar rdo rje mthing nag lte bar hūṃ bcas gsal btab/ /(3ba〉bdag dang gtor ma ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba grangs med pa chad sku'i dbyibs brgyud zhal nas thon slob ma'i khar zhugs sngags 'phreng la sib sib thim pas sngags kyi me lces nad gdon sdig sgrib bar gcod sogs gzhob thul gyi bsregs par bsams la/ slob dpon gyi ru ra glu'i 'phreng ba la slob ma rnams bzung du bcug la/ rtsa sngags brgya rtsa dang las sngags tshar gsum gyi rjes zlos byas nas 'phreng ba mgo bor 'jog /rtsa sgrub las/ bag zan dung dang khrag gis sprus/ /bkug bstim mdun du bzhag nas kyang / /zhes pa'i don ltar gtor ma'i 'og gi bdud bzhi slob ma'i mdun du bkod/tshogs mchod ltar bskyed dgug gi rjes slob dpon gyis sgrol sngags brjod cing seng ldeng phur pa gdeng ba'i stang ga byas nas slob mar gtad de phar 'debs dang mtshon chas gtub tu bcug /slob ma lhar gsal ba la ling ro sbyin te/ hūṃ/ srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can/ /zhes sogs kyi stob pa bya ba ni sgral dbang de nas slob ma kurma gu ru che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba de nyid gnas 'gyur te/ rang nyid dbang phyug chen po'i sku/ /zhes pa nas gnod byed thams cad tshig par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar brjod de don dran bzhin dang 'od zer me lte las sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog par bsams te/ zor sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ zor lag tu gtad —/5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shede zor bskul dang bcas 'phen du 'jug /sngags pa sogs nyams len mkhan po rnams la dbang yongs rdzogs dang / rkyen sel (4na7ma la sgrol dbang dang zor dbang dor bas chog cing / lugs gnyis gang ltar yang mthar gtor ma mgor bzhag nas bka' bsgo bas/ zor dbang bskur tshe ba kla lhar gsal spyi bor bzhag ces pa'i don bzhin/ dbang phyug gnas 'gyur nas lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ dpal chen dme he ru daḥ/ 'phrin las grub pa'i rigs 'dzin pra wa hasti/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ mi nyag byang pa chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ thugs sras ngag dbang rigs 'dzin rdo rje/ rigs kun khyab bdag zur chos dbyings rang grol sogs rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / /bdud 'dul ga rma drag po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i slob ma 'di la byin gyis rlobs shig /lus kyi na tsha/ sems kyi sdug bsngal/ bsam pa'i bar chad/ chags che nyam nga / steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon bgegs 'byung po/ /mtha'i dmag dpung sogs gzugs can dgra'i gnod pas mtshon te bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung skyob sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal 'byor mnga' thang / lung rtogs kyi yon tan sogs 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs skabs su gang bab kyi bka' bsgo/ sku rten tsakli ra lha nam mkhar bteg /gtor ma'i lha dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bstim/ /(4ba)bltas pa tsam gyis srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /bsdigs pa tsam gyis sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /bsams pa tsam gyis dngos grub char du 'bebs/ /skyon brgyud par bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pas mtshon te bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad brjod de me tog sil ma'i char 'bebs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/tshogs la rol ba nas rta bro'i bar dkyus bzhin dang / gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/sku rten gyi lha la brtan bzhugs/ rten mang rnams gshegs su gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod/las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /cher snyigs gdul dkar dgra gdon mthar byed pa'i/ /'phrin las — 16

bla ma rkarma gu ru'i 'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad byin rlabs sprin phung / nang ma rtogedrag po'i sgrub pa nyams bstar bar/ /mang du mi rung srog gtad byin rlabs kyi/ /sprin gyi phung pos phan bde'i lo tog bskyed/ /la la yig nag thug phrad rang sor 'jog /'ga' zhig sprad tsam bzhin du gang rnyed bsre/ /zol zog 'phrul gyis gzhan snang brid mthong nas/ /brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes mthong bas don gsal bkod/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad rnga yab gling dbus snying / /dpal ri'i rtse mor rang rig pad+ma 'byung / /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod rgyur 'dir 'bad ba'i/ /ston zla lta bur dkar ba'i dge tshogs bsngo/ /zhes bla ma ga me gu ru'i 'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad byin rlabs sprin phung 'di ni rta nag sgrol phug chos rjes ring mo nas bskul ma mdzad par mthar rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas khrigs chags shig byung na gsung pa dang las dang (ldan)po ba mang por phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas blangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma zur kun mkhyen chen po'i phyag bzhes dang zin bris gnang ba gzhir bzhag ste za hor gyi sngags btsun zil gnon ba yid pa rtsal gyis dmar ser can gyi lo dbyu gu zla ba'i gral tshes la rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal med khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /dmi gu ru'i sman mchod kyi lhan thabs ni/ 'phrin las khrag 'thung ga rma he ru gaḥ/ /pra chen ha sdi pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /ye shes 'tsho rgyal khri srong lde btsan la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /sngags sbyor/ 'phrin las yongs grub rtsal dang ngag gi dbang / /rgyal kun ngo bo chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/— /ga me gu ru yang gsang drag po'i skur/ /rnam rol lus dang srung ba go cha'i lha/ /ma hā de wa gnas chos srung ma la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /ces pa'ang za hor gyi brnyes sbyar// //sarba maṅga lo/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebla ma rkarma gu ru'i bsnyen yig sbar bcangs ma bzhugs rber+sha/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal/ /dpal ldan bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal po dang/ /dbyer med chos dbyings rang grol zhabs pad rdul/ /gtsug tu bsten nas bsnyen pa'i dmigs rim 'dri/ /rkarma gu ru'i bsnyen pa'i tshe thugasakar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ mthing kha'i mthar bsnyen sngags kha dog ljang nag mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du gyen du langs nas 'khod pa gsal zhing 'tsher ba nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od bkra ba lta bu zhig la sems yang yang bstad nas bsgom zhing /de'i 'od kyis mun nang du sgron me 'bar ba ltar dar ljang gu'i phru ma phus btab pa lta bu rang snang ba'i lus kyi nang thams cad shin tu gsal bar bsam pa thun gcig la cha gnyis su bgos pa'i cha dang po la nyams su len/ cha gnyis par bsnyen pa zhes pa ni nye ba'i don de 'jig rten na mi la zas gos sogs kyi ster sbyin byas nas nye 'brel 'dogs pa dang 'dra bas/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i 'od zer gyi sne la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs spros nas (2na)rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mchod pa phul/ thugs mnyes shing tshim par bsams nas 'od zer tshur bsdu de 'dra ba'i spro bsdu thun de ma rdzogs bar byed/ de nas bdun gnyisapa la thun re'i stod kyi cha gong ltar la 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas zhi khro rab 'byams kyi skyabs yul thamasacad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku'i byin rlabs rnams darma gu ru'i rnam pa gsung bsnyen sngags dang ā li kā li/ thugs sna tshogs rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa char bzhin du babs nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam pa ni sgrub pa ste/dper na 'jig rten la khas drag can zhig la gnyen grogs bcol ba'i 'bras bu rang 'dod pa'i stobs 'byor sogs des ster ba dang 'dra/ sgrub pa chen po zhes pa'i do li 'dir mi mdzad/ bdun phrag — /8 —

bla ma /me gu ru'i bsnyen yig sbarangs ma/ nang ma 'ad ge wa wagasum pa'i tshe thun gyi cha dang po sngar ltar la cha gnyis par thugs ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng las 'od zer me lce lta bu tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad gzhob thul gyis (2ba〉sregs/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs pa ltar bsam/ tshul 'di bdun phrag gsum la dpes mtsho ni pa yin/ de las mang ba byed na de rtsis kyi gsum bgos byed/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig tsam song nas thun thams cad kyi zhabs su rang nyid dbang phyug chen por gsal ba'i thugs dzir kurma gu ru ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du gsal btab/ chu bug nas me 'bar ba sogs kyi dmigs pa dang bcas sngags ring brgya'am nyer gcig gang rigs bzla/ las bzhi'i bsnyen pa sogs spros bcas 'dod na bsnyen yig gzhan nas kha bkang bar 'gal ba med rdo/ /zhes bla ma ga rma gu ru'i bsnyen yig sbar bcangs ma 'di ni blo bzang thabs mkhas kyi nyams len du za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dge legs so// //sarba mcho le/— 1()

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheg me gu ru yang gsang drag po dang 'brel ba'i zangs mdog dpal rir skye ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam gyi rim pa bzhus/sa/phung khams skye mched laṅka'i grong khyer dbus/ /rang snying zangs rma dog dpal ri'i pho brang cher/ /ma 'gags rig gdangs rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med mtsho skyes rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rnga yab gling phran srin pos yongs bkur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po che/ /ga rma gu ru khro chags rol ba'i gar/ /legs mdzad brtul zhugs grub par gsol ba 'debs/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs dug lnga 'byug pa'i gzugs/ /phyi rol bdud bzhir shar ba'i gnyen po mā /ljang nag rigs 'dzin 'phrin las drag po'i lha/ /yid srubs g.yul las rgyal der gsol ba 'debs/ /ban sngags lam log dam sri ru tra sogs/ /mi bsrun gdon bgegs 'byung po brtsegs pa'i brag /mthu stobs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog gi mdas/ /phyer 'thag yang gsang drag por gsol ba 'debs/ /snang stong 'gog med chu nang zla ltar gsal/ /brtul zhugs brtan pos gang la'ang nyam mi nga / /lha sngags ye shesarol pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bskyod pa'i rim pa (2na tham du longs par shog /'dzab bsnyen grangs thengs rtags dang drod tshad rnyed/ /man ngag phra rags kun la nang byan chud/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las sbyor ba kun/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gsal/ /gang snang ma lus rang byung rang las shar/ /sems nyid blo 'das ka dag rig pa'i dbyings/ /lhun grub 'od lnga 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam bkra 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa pad+ma 'od/ /rin cen gzhal yas mdzes pa mkha' 'gro'i gling / /skam rlon thod pa brtsegs pa'i srin po'i mkhar/ /gcig las du mar 'char ba dag pa'i zhing / /dran pas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal skyob/ /thos —20

dme gu ru yang gsang drag po dang 'brel ba'i ngas mdog dpal rir skye ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam/ nang ma 'dapas mngon mtho'i bde skyid dpal la sbyor/ /mthong bas srid pa'i mtsho las rnam sgrol ba/ /'di bas lhag pa mkha' spyod dmigs su med/ /de phyir tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags ma thag /'chi ba 'od gsal don gyi thod phreng rtsal/ /rang ngo 'phrod nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ /rigs 'dzin 'dus pa'i gral der skye bar (2ba〉gag /rtsa gsum byin rlabs lus phra'i 'gram pa'i chang / /mngar por 'thul ba bdag rgyud ba klu la'i/ /'dab ma yongs phye 'di phyi'i mdun ma yi/ /ze'u 'bru ba 'ad pa'i phun tshogs dga' ston shog /ces bla ma ga rma gu ru dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs zangs mdog dpal rir skye ba'i smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes dngul maṇ+ḍal dang bcas gnang byung ba ngag dbang mkhyen brtses bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /sarba maṅga lo// //—21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebla ma ga me gu ru'i gtor nag gi las mtha' gnam lcags spu gri bsdo kyigs rbesna/ /'phrin las rigs 'dzin ga me drag po rtsal/ /ches cher khros pa sku smad phur bu'i rtse/ /btab pa'i mod la dgra bgegs phye ma leb/ /byin za'i phung por mchong par byed de rgyal/ /mig sman khu bas byugs pa zor gyi mda'/ /mi bsrun dgra bgegs don snying thal phyung du/ /'bigs byed gnam lcags spu gri bar ma'i dbal/ /gdengs tshe dga' rab dbang phyug byin sha 'dar/ /tshul de'i zab mo'i gnad gsang 'khrul med par/ /mngon sum gzigs pa zur chen thams cad mkhyen/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i phyag bzhes gsung rgyun bzhin/ /yi ger 'dri la gter srung gnang ba stsol/ /de yang sbas yul kham bu lung nas mi nyag byang pa rigs 'dzin chen pos gdan drangs pa'i bla ma dmi gu ru'i gtor nag gi rim pa nyams su len pa la/ gtor nag las mtha' las/ /phyi nang bar gcod sel ba'i phyir/ /gtor nag las kyi mde thung bstan/ /lcags sam thod pa'i tshal bu ru /'bru nag phye la dug khrag gis/ /sbrus pa'i chos 'byung (2na〉spya gsum steng / /zhes pa ltar gcan gzan nam glang lpags lta bu'i steng du lcags sogs drag por 'os pa'i snod du 'bru nag ngar btags kyi phye la khrag chang dang btsan dug sogs kyis sprus pa'i chos 'byung gru gsum nag po'i khar/ gtor nag ljags sgrigs las/ de ni rgya dang dpangs mnyam pa'i/ /steng du bdud bzhi byi chings su/ /lha bu gan rkyal dkar po la/ kha sbub ser po phung po'i bdud/ /de steng nyon mongs bdud gan rgyal/ /'chi bdag nag po kha sbub steng / /rkang bzhi sa la 'bebs pa'i tshul/ /lag gnyis bgrad nas brkyang ba'o/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin bdud bzhi'i ba'i la bla' snying gar dgra bgegs dmigs bsal yod na so so'i ming byang spel tshig can 'jug pa dngos bstan bdud bzhi'i gzugs bzos kyang don gang dgos la sbyar chog pa ma tho la —22

bla ma dme gu ru'i gtor nag gi las mtha' gnam lcags spu gri/ nang ma (nge)ru tra'i dbyibs bzo yang dgra bgegs gang dgos 'gugs pa dang dbyibs mtshungs shing seng ldeng phur pa ri rab ma sor brgyad pa rked par dar gyi sprul mgo'i cod pan can btsugs pa/ de'i (2bskong malji'i khar lcags snod du gong gi rgyu las grub pa'i gtor nag zur gsum pa me ris dmar ser nge ba sogs drag po'i rgyan dang mthar zer kong mtheb skyu rtsang dmar nyer gcig /srin mo 'gros su btsugs par rgyu ma'i lda ldi dang sha dum gyi spras shing g.yin yang mtshe dang yungs dar gangs bzang sogs kyis brgyan par sku rten tsaka li dar nag gi gtor gdugs mda' bcas btsugs/ mdun du sgrub gtor/ g.yas su sman mchod dang / g.yon du rak+ta/ rgyab tu gter srung / chad mtho gzhan yang chosaskyong gang dgos kyi gtor ma phyi nang gi nyer spyod thad sgrigs/ mdun nam g.yas g.yon gang 'os su gsang ba mu stegs gtor nag las/ khyad par pha rol byad ltas dang / /bkra ngan rmis ltas ngan pa na/ khung thum drag po'i bzlog pa bya/ /dur khrod sa dang sa nag bsres/ /dug khrag chus sprus dbang phyug gi /mtshan ma khong stong mtho gang dang / /sor bzhi la sogs ci 'grub bya/ /re ba'i gdan la 'bru nag steng / /bkod la rang 'drar bskyed cing bstim/ /yungs gar thun la sngags shing bsgrub/ /dug shog sngags bris thun yungs bcas/ /nang bcug la chas zhabs bsdams la/ /gnod byed sogs la zor du 'phang / /zhes pa ltar che ba gcig la chung ba brgyad kyis bskor ba'i zor bcas/ tshogs 'khor/bgegs gtor/ ḍā dril/ phur pa/ sgrol gri/ rnga rol/ zhwa phod sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams legasapar bsham/ bdag bskyed kyi las byang gzhung bsrangs/ /(3na tshe snga dro'i bar rtsa ba'i 'dzab gang 'gro bzla/ gtor nag las mtha' las/ rang nyid lha yi ting nge 'dzin gyis/ /gtor ma sha khrag phung por bsam/ /ma la ya yi ri bo dang / /srin yul gnas nas gu ru'i tshogs/ /spyan drangs 'kha du gsol bar bsam/ /zhes pa ltar zor gtor la gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams tshogs tha ma ji lta ba'i sgo nas dgug gzhug nyer gcig gam bdun gyi mthar phur pa sgril zhing gdengs ga'i steng ka dang bcas bsgral ba'i tshig dmigs bya/ /gtor ma ngo bo bdud rtsi la rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegi rgya mtsho chen por bsam/ hūṃ/ lang ka pu ra srin po'i yul zhes sogs las byang ltar spyan drangs/rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ ji hi/ zhes bdun nam gsum gyis phul bas lhag ma ma lus par gsol bar bsam/ /mdun du spyan drangs pa'i lha dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ bdag dang drag po'i gtor ma ni/ /bdud 'dul pad+ma drag po'i sku/ /ljang nag du ba'i mdog lta bu/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar/ /'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa'i rtags/ /nyon mongs bdud bzhi zil gyis sa non/ /g.yon pa seng ldeng phur pa gdengs/ shes rab snying rjes sgrol ba'i phyir/ /zhing bcu ru dra sgrol ba'i rtags/ /sku smad phur pa dpal dang ldan/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog ltar bsam/ /zhes bdag mdun gnyis ka gsal btab/ /spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i (3bsgo jug tu dgra dgegs ru dra sgrol pa'i las mdzod cig /ces pa 'dogs/ thugs dar mthing nag rdo rje'i dbus/ /hūṃ yig mtha' ru las sngags ni/ /rtags dang sbyar te ci 'grub bzlas/ /mgar gyi zhun me lta bu 'phro/ /'bar ba drag po'i sku ru gsal/ /zhesating nge 'dzin gsal bas sngags dang las sngags sbrel pas ci nus su bzla/ zor bsgrub pa ni/gsang ba mu stegs gtor nag las/ rang nyid dbang phyug chen po'i sku/ zhan tu che ba gyen du bsgrengs/ /'bras bu klu yi yul du zug /skyed pa mi yi yul du ldem/ /mgo bo lha yi yul du 'khyog /chu sbugs bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar/ /sku yi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /zhun gyi me stag khro bo 'phro/ /sngags bzlas me yi 'od zer gyis/ /gnod byed thams cad tshig par bsam/ /zhes man ngag ltar gsal btab ste zor sngags ci 'grub tu bzla/ tsho gos tha ma dang bar ma song nas/ /tsho gos tha ma la brten nas bzlog pa'i 'phrin las 'chol ba/ gtor nag las mtha' las/ ltas dang mtshan ma rtsub pa na/ /gtor ma drag po'i phur bur bsgom/ /liṅga bsgral la gtor mar btab/ /zhes pa ltar bdud bzhi liṅga zur pa zhig bshams la/ bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ gnam lcags gzhal yas me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad dmi drag po rtsal/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhedas/ /—24

bla ma da rma gu ru'i gtor nag gi las mtha' gnam lcags spu gri/ nang ma 6)bgegs tshogs bdud dpung ma lus dgra la sgyur/ /mahā de ba srid pa'i mes po che/ /bskal pa'i me rlung bar snang khams 'byug pas/ /nad gdon bar gcod rkyen ngan ma (4na)lus pa/ /gnam lcags zor gyis dgra bo'i steng du sgyur/ /bdud 'dul dme drag po'i lha tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan bshig dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod/ /bla ma'i sku dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe/ khyad par bdag sogs rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /gnod byed gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs/ /yang sgos dam sri gdon bgegs 'byung po'i dpung / /rbad 'dre rbod gtong byad ma mkhan po sogs/ /rnam par shes pa bla srog tshe gsum sogs/ /mthar med 'brub khung nag po'i nang khrid de/ /bdud bzhi'i gzugs brnyan dmigs bya'i khog pa sa /ming byang yi ger btab pa 'di nyid la/ /da lta nyid la 'gugs bstim 'phrin las mdzod/ /gser skyems btang / gdab las dngos gzhi tshogs tha ma ltar la/ stob pa ni/ hūṃ/ srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can/ /gu ru ga rma drag po rtsal/ /gnam sa tsam du zhal phye zhig /gangs ri tsam gyi mche gtsigs la/ /glog dmar tsam gyi ljags khyongs shig /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /dug gsum sha khrag mchod par bzhes/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& ga me mahā gu ru ga rma sirnyi hūṃ/ gnod byed kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ 'a hi zhes 'bul/ /lhag ma btson du bzung /bzlog sgyur ni/ hūṃ/ bdud 'dul ga me gu ru khro zhing gtum/ /g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rjes las bzhi bsgrub/ /g.yon pa phur bu dgra bgegs snying la gzir/ /sprul pa yang sprul pho nya'i tsho gos bcasarnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag mchod pa bzhes/ /mi mthun (4ba thar gcod bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /lha chen dbang phyug srid gsum dbang sgyur ba/ /lha klu mi yi gnas khyab srid mesacan/ /chu sbubs bskal me ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /mgar gyi tsha tsha ltar 'phro'i drag shul can/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag mchod par bzhes/ /mi mthun bar gcod bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces ling ro'i lhag ma rnams dang sman raka bcas stob pa'i tshul du byed/ phur pa lcags khang ma'i bzlog gzhung chung ba las/ hūṃ/ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni/ bzlog sgyur las la khyed —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherang mkhas/ /lci yang ri bo pang du long / /dka' yang bdud la rgyu zhags thob/ /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa bzlog /mas kyi sri ru langs pa bzlog /nye ba'i byol zor gtong ba bzlog /ltag pa'i bdud du babs pa bzlog /dpral ba'i gshed du 'khor ba bzlog /pho sri mo sri langs pa bzlog /che sri chung sri langs pa bzlog /dam sri dbul sri god sri bzlog /pha mes dur sri 'phung sri bzlog /bdud kyi than nag phyag brnyan bzlog /btsan gyi gzer bab gtong ba bzlog /sa bdag byad du bcings pa bzlog /rgyal po'i smyo 'dre 'bog pa bzlog /gza' yi zhing kai dug rlangs bzlog /mu stegs ༅ sngags thams cad bzlog /the'u rang sris la rku ba bzlog /sngags pa'i phur pa 'debs pa bzlog /bon gyi btso zor 'phen pa bzlog /sum pa'i glang chen sna bsgyur bzlog /mi nyag bon gyi 'bo le bzlog /lo geg ki dang gshed bzhi bzlog /sa la zhag rtsis 'debs pa bzlog /gnam la zla grangs (ldan/sna debs pa bzlog /gza' dang skar ma ngan pa bzlog /lo keg zla keg zhag keg bzlog /za geg bdun zur thams cad bzlog /dus tshod brtsis nas 'debs pa bzlog /gnam gyi dal kha babs pa bzlog /sa la dug nad langs pa bzlog /thog bab dal babs thams cad bzlog /byas nyes nyams grab thams cad bzlog /yul mi khyim mtshes dmod mo bzlog /g.yas nas pho brgyas mda' brdar bzlog /g.yon nas mo brgyas dug sbyor bzlog /mi nag skye bo'i ya ga bzlog /bran khol ngan pa'i dmod chu bzlog /mdun nas langs shing sdod pa bzlog /rgyab nas khyi bzhin 'brang ba bzlog /mo ngan log par sdigs pa bzlog /rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog /srod la bya pho 'tsher ba bzlog /tho rengs sgo khyi ngu ba bzlog /'ug pa ha ha rgod pa bzlog /srin bya thog khar 'tsher ba bzlog /logs la wa spyang brgyal ba bzlog /ltas ngan brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi bzlog /pha tshan nang gi brgya 'dre bzlog /ma bu de ni byung 'dre bzlog /dar tshan nang gi stong 'dre bzlog /pho bdud dal kha g.yas su bzlog /mo bdud dal kha g.yon du bzlog /spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la bzlog /phas kyi 'phung 'dre bod 'dre bzlog /tshur gyi sna 'dren byed pa bzlog /lus la na tsha gtong ba bzlog /tshe la bar chad byed —26

bla ma da rma gu ru'i gtor nag gi las mtha' gnam lcags spu gri/ nang ma (ri)pa bzlog /rkub nas 'bu bzhin g.yeng ba bzlog /mgo la til brdung byed pa bzlog /kha nas dar bzhin 'jam pa bzlog /gting nas tsher bzhin rtsub pa bzlog /lus la sprul ltar 'khril ba zlog /ngos la sprel ltar 'dzeg pa bzlog /mi kha bram mchu thams cad bzlog /(5ba〉gra ru chags che thamasacad bzlog /sgos su nyam nga yod pa bzlog /rbod gtong rbad 'dre thams cad bzlog /rmi lam ban pa thams cad bzlog /pho byol de ni g.yas su byol/ /mo byol de ni g.yon du byol/ khyim mtshes gzhan gyi sa ru byol/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs de la bh+yo/ /za bar byed pa'i 'dre la bh+yo/ /'phung bar byed pa'i sri la bh+yo/ /sbyor ngan gtong ba'i ltag tu bh+yo/ /cho 'phrul ngan pa dgra la sgyur/ /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /chad mtho dang / ma nyes dpang du sogs kyis thun gtor 'phang / /bstan skyong bro brdung chad lhag bkang nas bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod bya/ nyin rjes ma rnams la dngos gzhi gong ltar la bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa grub rjes/ bdag dang drag po'i gtor ma ni zhes sogs man ma gtogs gtor mar dgug gzhug dang / lha spyan drangs nas 'bul ba dor/ nyin tha ma ling ga zur pa mi dgos shing thun gtor 'phang rjes/ gser skyems/ sgo dbye tshe bdag ltar dang gtor ma spags/tshogs lhag dang chad mtho dmag lto'i tshul du gtong / gtor ma 'phen par gser skyems kyi rjes su/hūṃ/ dbang phyug mahā de ba'i sku/ /chu sbubs bskal ba'i me rlung 'khrug /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i zor gtor 'di/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du 'phen/ /byad kha bzlog la phur kha sgyur/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /zor sngags bzla zhing 'phen/ rtsa ba'i sngags dang las kyi sngags/ /mang du bzlas shing gnod phyogs 'phang zhes pa ltar/ /hūṃ/ ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs/ /dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku gzur cig /khrag 'thung drag po'i dmag dpung (6na〉skyed/ /dgra bgegs steng du gtor zor rgyob/ /mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad mā ra ya sod/ /rtsa sngags gsham du bzlog sngags dang zor sngags btags te gtor ma brgyag /me chu'i rgyas 'debs/ nang du log nas bstan skyong / bro brdung / tshe 'gugs gtang rag /rten la brtan bzhugs/ mgron la gshegs pa/—27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebazod gsol/ smon lam shis brjod rnams dkyus ltar phyed do/ /rta ljang dbang po'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis char/ /brdar la bi shwa ga me'i khengs dregs khur/ /'dor byed rim pa bdun yang thal byung du/ /'bigs nus gnam lcags zor gyi las 'di mtshar/ /gdon bgegs mtha' dmag glang gdong bsnyems pa'i mche/ /phyungs te mthu stobs me bya la chen nas/ /bde skyid khang bzang mdun sar gar rtse ba/ /rigs 'dzin gdong drug de ko cis mi rgyal/ /'dir 'bad 'bras bu rang rgyud dug lnga'i dpung / /rnam par bcom pas phyi rol dgra gdon bgegs/ /nyin phyed 'char ga'i mun pa ltar bsangs nas/ /gangs ljongs rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /ces bla ma ga me gu ru'i gtor nag gi las mtha' gnam lcags spu gri 'di ni lang 'gro'i sngags 'chang rta nag sgrol ma phug nas dang slad mar rigs 'dzin chen po gter bdag gling pa'i gsung gis bskul ba ring zhig 'gyangs pa nye char pho brang gnang byung pa sngags btsun ngag dbang mkhyen brtses mtshams sbyar bas rkyen byas gter gzhung gi dgongs don bka' drin mnyam med chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung las ji ltar thos pa bzhin ljags sgrigs dang zin bris la zhib tu (6ba po pyad nas za hor gyi sngags spyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis me sbrul hor zla dgu pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcur sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so// //sarba maṅga lo/—28

ma dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed me mchod kyi cho ga rigs 'dzin thog mthud rtsi sman ljon pa/ nang ma rtogem dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed me mchod kyi cho ga rigs 'dzin srog mthud rtsi sman ljon pa bzhugs rbesna/ /na mo badz+ra wa ra khyi/ rgyal kun 'dus pa rnga yab gling pa yi/ /ring lugs spel la bi mā la mi tre'i/ /rnam sprul myang ston blo mchog rdo rje'i zhabs/ /byang chub bar du gtsug gi nor bur bsten/ /rnal 'byor rtsing spyod dam sel grib rkyen mthus/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad mun pa'i smag /mthar byed me mchod snang ba 'od po ches/ /bde skyid gzugs brnyan ma lus mngon sum gsal/ /de tshul zab gter rnam grangs mang ba las/ /mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs gter chen nyang ral gyi/ /ḍā zhi'i snying khrag khros nag dgongs don bzhin/ /rigs 'dzin srog mthud rtsi sman ljon 'di spel/ /de la 'dir mkha' 'gro'i me mchod bya ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/lha lnga'i gzhung las/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang / /dus gnyan dus su mi med pa'i/ /sa phyogs dben pa'i gnas nyid du/ /dkyil 'khor lnga ni bzhengs byas la/ /zhes pa ltar/ gnas dben cing gzugs can gzugs (2na〉ped kyi 'tshe ba med pa'am/ yang na mtsho gling bas mtha' dur khrod nags khrod sogs ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs su yar ngo'i tshes bcu'am dus gzhan gyi srod la bya bar ma zad nyin mo lta bu'ang mi rung ba min pas gang du bya bar phyag bdar dang skyang nul legs par byas la gtsang ma'i sa la stegs bu zlum po rgya dang dbangs tshad ji ltar rigs pa byas na gzhung dang mthun zhing / deng sang lag len du gru bzhi byed pa ltar byas kyang mi 'gal zhing khod bsnyoms pas bdud rtsi lngas chag chag gdab/ de nyid las/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi dkar po bri/ /zhes pa ltar rdul tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab bzhi mu ram kha khyer dang bcas pa bris pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lte ba dkar po'i dbus —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesu phyag mtshan nam yig 'bru'i mtshon spungs gang rung 'god/ de nyid las/ glang ma bal bu'i shing rnams la/ /zlum por brtsigs te sreg rdzas 'bul/ /zhes pa ltar byas pas khyab kyang srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam po 'jug pa bde phyir zlum por brtsigs te sa dkar sogs kyis kha dog bsgyur/ /(2bskyon rag gtor gsum chu gnyis nyer spyod/ rdo rje/ dgang blugs/ dril bu/ thod rnga/ rkang gling /rol chen/ 'thor nas/ bsang chu sogs mkho ba'i yo byad mtha' dag dang khyad par sreg rdzas ni/ de nyid las/ rdzas ni phye mar rat+na dang / /'bru sna dar zab gos la sogs/ /zas sna thams cad bsreg par bya/ /gser dngul zangs lcags g.yu dang ni/ /dung dang mgron bu la sogs pa/ /rang rang phyogs su bsreg par bya/ /zhes las ba chikhi thab khung so sor yod pa'i dbang du byas nas gsungs kyang / de nyid las/ dbus su thams cad bsreg par bya/ /zhes rdzas thams cad gcig tu bsgril nas 'bul rung zhing phyag len du'ang mdzad pas dngos bstan gyi rdzas rnams dang der mi gsal ba'i rdzas rnams kyang rigs pas dpyad nas thams cad phyi mar byas bag zan dang bsres nas ril bur dril te 'bul pa legs shing mar khu dang yam shing ni med du mi rung / de'ang rdzas gang 'dzom gyi steng du/ gzi brjid nyams pa zhi ba la tsan+dan dkar po dang 'o ma can dri bzang po'i shing rigs mang ba bsre/ de bzhin du/mdangs nyams pa zhi bar me tog sna tshogs/ kha dog nyams pa zhi bar dar sna tshogs/ 'byor pa nyams pa zhi bar mar/ sdig pa zhi bar til/ nyams rtogs mi 'phel ba zhi bar chang / dam sdom nyams pa zhi bar spos/ /tshe nyams pa zhi bar du rba/ bsod nams nyams pa zhi bar 'bras/ 'bru nor nyams pa zhi bar so ba/ bde ba nyams pa zhi bar zas mchog /mi gtsang ba zhi bar ku sha /bgegs zhi bar yungs dar dang sha khrag tshil gsum/ 'og (3na gi don gyi 'tshe ba zhi bar rma bya'i mdongs/ sbyor ngan zhi bar lan tsha/ shugs nyams pa zhi bar nas/ longs spyod nyams pa zhi bar 'o ma/ stobs nyams pa zhi bar sran ma dang rin chen sna tshogs/ /rims zhi bar gro /mi mos pa zhi bar dngar gsum/ nad zhi bar sman sna tshogs/ rigs brgyud mi 'phel ba zhi bar shing tog sna tshogs/ /sa lam gyi yon tan mi 'phel —3(3—

ma dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed me mchod kyi cho ga rigs 'dzin srog mthud rtsi sman ljon pa/ nang ma khonganab zhi bar 'bru mar rnams skabs su gang bab gtso ches sbyor ba gnad du che/ de ltar yo byad rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag nyid kyi rnal 'byor dang /me mchod dngos las/ dang po ni rgyas par spro na gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga bde chen rab rgyas bya bar rigs na'ang / mdor bsdus khyer bde tsam la skyabs 'gro ni/ brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rin po che/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha yi tshogs/ /legs kha par byin rlab ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /kun nas gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ bdag gzhan gnyis med don kun bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro kun bsgrubs nas/ /snying po bla med byang chub 'thob bya'i phyir/ /gzhan don byed par bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum brjod/ bdag bskyed ni/ de nas stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di ni/ /mkha' 'gro chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /pad+ma 'dab bzhi nyi ma ro/ /de steng rang nyid hrīḥ(3bskog las/ /'od 'phros bskul don rnam gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pa las/ /bdag nyid rdo rje phag mor bsgom/ /mdog nag phag zhal gyen du gzigs//phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum gru mor brten/ /rus pa'i rgyan dang dar gyis brgyan/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum bde bar bzhugs/ /zhal nas pho peṃ hring hring brjod/ /spyan bgrad ljags ni slog ltar 'gyu/ /gcer bu pad+ma rak+ta 'dzag /sku las bskal pa'i me 'od 'phro/ /de lta bu yi sku rba sdu spyar/ /ces sogs yo ga gsum las mahā ltar sa bon las bskyed kyang a ti yo ga ltar rang rig gdod nas khros ma nag mo'i skur lhun gyis grub pa gsal snang dang nga rgyal las spyan 'dren mchod bstod spros pa rnams dor bas chad lhag tu mi 'gyur ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ spro na spyan 'dren sogs gzhung bzhin bya/ /snying gar chos 'byung g.yung drung steng / /hrīḥnag sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /thugs ga'i sngags las 'od 'phros pas/ /'gro drug sgrib sbyangs phag mor gyur/ /gzugs su snang ba mkha' 'gro'i sku/ /sgra rnams yi ge bzhi yi sgra/ /dran rtog chos nyid ngang du gnas/ /de ltar gsal ba'i dkyil —31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'akhor de/ /dbyibs la brtags shing sems la bsgom/ /dbyibs dang goms par gyur ba dang / /sngags kyi sgra la bslab par bya/ /ha ri ni sa zhes pa ni/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i sngags su bshad/ /sngagasakyi rgyal po 'di bzlas so/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra bha ra hi/ khyoḥha ri ni sa/ ra tsa hri ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa 'di la 'bum phrag drug
