/(4nangs ni lus ngag yid gsum la/ /'bar ba gsum gyi dngos grub 'byung //de ni bsnyen pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bsnyen pa dngos bstan la dgongs kyi me mchod la 'dzab ci 'grub bzlas pas chog go /gnyis pa me mchod kyi rim pa ni/ rdor dril bzung nas ma da rdzas dang sreg rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūṃ/ dur khrod zhing mchog 'og min gnas su gsal/ /mchod rdzasasman raka gtor ma ye shes lnga/ /'dod yon drug ldan tshogs kyis 'jig rten dang / /thabs shes gnyis med bde chen 'du 'bral med/ /phyi nang gsang gsum snod bcud bde ba che/ /oṃ āḥ& hoḥ sarba pū dza sa ma ya hūṃ zhes lan mang du bzlas nas byin gyis brlabs/ du ba med pa'i mes thab tu spar la oṃ a gli dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod cing mar khu'i thigs pas kyang gso/ de nas mdun gyi thab dang lha gsal 'debs pa ni/ / bha sogs hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod cing bsang chu gtor nas bgegs bskrad/su bha'i sngags kyis stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng / /hūṃ las zhi ba'i thab khung zlum zhing dkar/ /rgyar ni khru gang dpangs su khru phyed la/ /nang du lha rdzas las byung bud shing gang / /rang bzhin me 'bar me dbus pad+ma dang / /nyi zla ro steng a yig 'phro 'du las/ /me lha 'jig rten ye shes gnyis med pa/ /rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag mo'i sku/ /sku mdog nag mo sku dang yan lag rags/ /phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar stabs mdzad/ /g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang (4ba)thugs kur 'dzin/ kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan 'chang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /g.yas bskum zhabs kyi rting pa bha gar bstad/ /g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis mi ro'i snying ga mnan/ /bde gshegs phar phyin drug ldan rus rgyan gsol/ /ral pa dmar nag gyen 'khyil thur du grol/ /spyi gtsug phag zhal nag mo ngur sgra sgrog /khams gsum dbang sdud phag ze me dpung 'bar/ /spyan gsum dmar zhabrug za byed zhal —32

ma dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed me mchod kyi cho ga rigs 'dzin srog mthud rtsi sman ljon pa/ nang ma rtonganagadangs 'jigs/ /mche ba bzhi gtsigs ljags 'dril rkan sgra sgrog /phe sgra ha ha'i gad brgyangs zhabs gnyis brdeg /bdud dpung sreg mdzad sku las me dpung 'bar/ /'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs du mas bskor/ khams gsum yongs rdzogs sku yis stong gsum khengs/ /stong nyid ye shes rig rtsal sku ru gsal/ /phyogs bzhin pad+ma nyi ma ro steng du/ /ha yig dkar po'i 'phro 'du lasaskyes pa'i/ /bde chen dkar mo me long ye shes sku/ /ri yig ser po'i 'phro 'du las skyes pa'i/ /ser mo don grub mnyam nyid ye shes rgyas/ /ni yig dmar po'i 'phro 'du las skyes pa'i/ /dmar mo sgra sgrog sor rtog ye shes gsung / /sa yig ljang gu'i 'phro 'du las skyes pa'i/ /sna tshogs mthar phyin bya grub ye shes las/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin/ kha ṭ+wāṃ dar dpyangs rin chen rus pa'i rgyan/ /gcer bu gar stabs phyogs bzhi'i ro steng bzhugs/ /de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āḥdamar thugs mar hūṃ sngon mtshan/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros skyon (ldan)gnas mchog nas/ /ye shes lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ/ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /sku dang ye shes gzhal yas nas/ /yi dam lha tshogasagashegs su gsol/ /stong nyid chos dbyings pho brang nas/ khros ma nag mo gshegs su gsol/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ khyod kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra bha ra nyi/ kro ta kā li ha ri ni sa/ a be sha ya/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs bstim/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes bzhugs su gsol/mchod pa ni/ hūṃ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis dbu brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi/ kro ta kā li/ ha ri ni sa sa pā ri wā ra a lha/ pā ṭ+wāṃ/ pur+sha/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /ga rnye/ ni wi du/ sha sto pā dza hoḥ mahā pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ ji nyi/ mahā rak+ta kha raṃ ji hi/ mahā ba kla ta kha raṃ ji lha/ zhes mchod gtor —33—

ma dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed me mchod kyi cho ga rigs 'dzin sgrog mthud rtsi sman ljon pa/ nang ma (pelegs par sems/ brgya stong khri 'bum sogs grangs nges par bsag dgos yod na grogs shig gis ma nor bar byed/ 'di gtso bor zhi ba'i las bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ bde chen rab rgyasalas/ gang 'dod las sam las bzhi dril la bzlas/ bsreg cing zhal du bdud rtsis mchode par bsam/ /sngags tsam gyis mchode bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ /zhes pa'i khungs la brten nas chosargyal gter bdag gling pas las bzhi ga'i spel tshig sbyar ba'i srol yod ces gsung pa gsang sngagasagasar ma'i lugs kyi las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg dang cha mtshungs pa byed par spro na zhi ba'i grangs thengs pa'i mjug tu rdzas de ga 'bul zhing / spel tshig /che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang thang lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad pusti ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du khams gsum gyi skye dgu'i stobs 'byor thams cad wa she ku ru swā hā/ che ge la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad (6bsgo ra ya phaṭa/ ces ji ltar 'os pa bya rung ba rdzas rnams 'bul tshe rnam pa rdzas la ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi zhal du gsol bas bsgrub bya rnams kyi 'phrin las rnam bzhi thams cad 'bad med du 'grub cing / khyad par dam tshig nyams chags kyi mthus ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad la brten pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzad par bsam pa sogs gang 'tsham rig pas snyul shes par bya/ thun mtshams su gong ltar sngags kyis mchode/ bstod pa ni/ 〉 skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul cir yang ston mdzad ma/ /'gro ba kun skyob ye shes mkha' 'gro yum/ /dug gsum 'joms mdzad phag mo khyod la bstod/ /las gang bsgrub kyi 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa rjes ni/ slar yang gtang rag gi mchod bstod byas la/ bzod gsol ni/ gang dag nyes pa byas dang byed 'gyur ba/ /rje btsun mgon khyod 'od gsal chen po'i ngang / /bzod par mdzod la las kyi dngos grub dang / /thogs med 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes dang yig brgya bzla/ se gol gtog cing badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ smon lam ni/ skye 'chi bar do sku gsum lam 'byer gyis/ /—35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shernam rtog dag nas skad cig gcig nyid la/ /ma spangs gnas dag mkha' spyod zhing khams su/ /mngon sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba'i don byed shog mas brjod ni/ phun tshogs yon (7na)tan rin chen 'phrin las ldan/ /rab dkar thub bstan rab rgyas 'dzin ma'i dpal/ /bstan 'dzin dpyod ldan theg gsum lhun gyis grub/ /rtag tu dpal gnas bkra shis bde legs sgo/ga /ces sogs bsngo smon bkra shis rgya cher bya zhing me tog sil ma phyogs kun tu dgram par bya/ me rang shir song na dang /long med na chu gtsang dang 'o ma sogs kyis gzhil lo/ /thal ba phan byed kyi rdzas su 'jog pa'am/ yang na chu klung chen por dor ro/ /de nyid las/ zhi rgyas dbang drag so so yi/ /gang byed shing ni 'tshog par bya/ /zhi ba la ni zlum por brtsig /rgyas pa la ni gru bzhin brtsig /dbang la zla gam drag po la/ /zur gsum dag tu brtsig par bya/ /me lhag phag mo lha lnga bskyed/ /ces pa ltar lhag ma gsum gyi stegs bu'ang las so so'i dbyibs dang mthun pa'i steng du/ rgyas pa la pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte ba ser po'i steng du/ thab kyi rgyu rgya shug gi shing / lha rnams sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ dbang la pad+ma'i lte ba dmar po/ tsan dan dang mdzo mo shing / /sku mdog dmar po g.yas lcags kyu/ drag po la pad+ma'i lte ba ljang / seb dang tsher ma dug shing / sku mdog ljang nag gri gug 'dzin pa sreg rdzas kyang bsdu na sngar bshad pa tsam gyis rung zhing / rgyas par spro na/ rgyas pa dang dbang gi sbyin sreg gi gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar dang / drag po la/ gtso bor liṅga la dgug gzhug thun brdeg pa (7ba〉sogs bshad pas mtshon/ zhib cha mtha' dag gzhung dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bya ba las rgyun du mkho chung bas 'dir rgyas par ma spros/ de nyid las/ dkar chas thams cad shar du bsreg /ser chas thams cad lho ru bsreg /dmar chas thams cad nub tu bsreg /drag chas thams cad byang du bsreg /ces pa sgrub mchod kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag pa'i phyogs bzhir las so so'i sbyin sreg byed pa'i don yin pas ma 'dres par shes par bya'o/ /bar chad kun sel ḍā ka ḍā rki ni'i/ /zab don man ngag gter byon mtha' yas pa'i/ /rtser son mnga' bdag nyi ma 'od zer —36

ma dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed me mchod kyi cho ga rigs 'dzin srog mthud rtsi sman ljon pa/ nang ma khonganal/ /bka' babs khros nag yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /sna tsho gis las sgrub thabs tshul grangs med nas/ /dam tshig nyams chags skong thabs me mchod kyi/ /lag len rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bzhed srol la/ /blo gros rtsal gyis zhib mor dpyad nas bkod/ /dge des dam gtsang ma la ya klung nas/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i tsan dan dris/ /sdig sgrib des bskyed bar gcod tsha gdung tshogs/ /rab gzhil sgo gsum bde chen la sbyor shog /ma dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed me mchod kyi cho ga rigs 'dzin srog mthud rtsi sman ljon pa 'di ni gtsang rong nges gsang rdo rje gling gi gdan sa pa chos rje sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs rab rgyas kyis nan chen pos bskul ba la brten/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag khra tshang ba blo mchog rdo (8na)rje'i bka' drin las gter kha gong ma'i khros nag gi skor legs par thob cing / me mchod kyi phyag bzhes chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi yid kyi za ma tog tu 'khyil ba za hor gyi sngags smyon che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis gter gzhung gi dgongs don gzhir bzhag /paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bde chen rab rgyas nas kha 'geng dgos pa bskang zhing / zor yang ba'i ched du tshig sbyor la ston 'brid cung zad bgyis te lcags bya hor zla drug pa'i nyer dgu mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog gis bgyis pa sarba sirnyi bri ya nā na /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shephyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba sogs bzhugs so/ /gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ srid gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog shākya'i tog /'dul ba'i 'khor tshogs rigs 'dzin byang chub sems/ /rdo rje'i sku brnyes pad+ma kā ra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod bzlog /chos kyi rgyal po lha sras mu khri btsan/ /zab gter mnga' brnyes bzang po grags pa dang / /mgon des rjes bzung dngos grub rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ཿ/ kun spang chen po ri pa sangs rgyas dang / /'dul ba 'dzin pa nam mkha' mchog bzang po/ grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la/ /gsol ཿ/ sngags 'chang chen po 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan dang / /mthu stobs mnga' bdag rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rje/ /thugs sras sngags 'chang dbang po'i gnyid la/ /gsol — /ma lus rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gang 'dul sprul pa'i rol par yongs shar ba/ /rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po la/ /gsol cha/ rigs 'dzin mchog des rjes bzung thugs kyi sras/ /zab chos gdams pa kun gyi mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan zur chen bla ma rjer/ /gsol — / tshe rabs du mar pad+mā kā ra yis/ /rjes su bzung ba'i bzang po'i las lo can/ /gang shar rang sar (2na)grol ba'i rigs 'dzin la/ /gsol —/ zhes pa 'di yang chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes rwa lung gang ba bzang po'i 'dabs su mdzad pa'o/ /su bhā was sbyangs/ chos kun ka dag spros dang bral ba'i ngang / /hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / /rdo rje'i ra ba dra ba gur bla bre/ /rtse mor rdo rje'i tog gis legs mtshan par/ phra rab rdul gyi rdo rjes yongs su gtams/ /phyi rol kha dog lnga ldan me dpung 'bar/ /gur khang nang du gser 'khor bcu gsum rtsibs/ /rtsibs log rtsa rtse rgya gram lte bar zug /de nang bcu gsum rtsibs rtse phyir bstan pa/ /g.yas 'khor rtsibs la sngags rnams gyen bsgreng ba/ /sngags kyi sgra rnams 'brug stong lta bur —38

phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba sogs/ nang ma (peldir/ /'od zer 'phro zhing lte bar : yig las/ /gser sbyangs las grub byang chub mchod rten che/ /lte bar seng khri pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /hūṃ las sprul sku shākya seng ge'i sku/ /sa gnon mnyam gzhag bdud 'dul phyag rgya can/ /rigs 'dzin byang sems nyan rang 'khor gyis bskor/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa yi/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros rten dang brten par bcas/ /thogs pa med par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ sngo dam ye dbyer med pa/ /rig pa'i rang rtsal ngang du ro gcig gyur/ /me tog dam pa 'phreng pa dam pa dang / /zhes sogs blo ka gnyis kyis mchod/ mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ /zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis bstod/ rang nyid thub par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ /lag na rdo rje stobs po che la sogs/ /pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /dril bu thogs pa stong gsum khyab spros nas/ /lo zla zhag dus za ma'i skeg rigs dang / /che sri chung sri dar sri pho (2bski sri/ /mo sri na sri dur sri sgos sri dgra /phung sri rgyal sri gdon sri rgan gzhen sri/ /lo zla zhag dang dus kyi sri ngan kun/ so so'i gzugs dang byad dbyibs ji bzhin pa/ /phyi nang rtsibs bar bsgoms pa'i gzugs byang la/ khu gcig badz+ra aṅga sha ya dzaḥ/ rked nas chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ /yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra sgro ṭa baṃ/ /myos par gyis shig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi sngo /dbyer med stims shig a be sha ya a/ /phyi nang rtsibs gnyis drag tu 'khor ba'i bar/ /gnod byed gdon bgegs phyi ma dum bur gtungs/ /sngags 'phreng las 'phros me yis ga chob thul bsregs/ /thal ba'i rdul phran lta bur brlag par gyur/ /zhes 'khor lo 'bar ba'i dmigs pa'i zab gnad rigs 'dzin yol mo ba chen po'i zhal gdams kyi ston gu ru tshe brtan gyi gsung rgyun bzhin/ /za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lha sab ngag dbang dkon cog go /rgya gar skad du tsakra no bi ka nā maḥ bod skad du: 'khor lo 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs:sangs rgyas dang byang chu sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo 'di skad bdag gis thos —39
rang ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /zhes pa 'di ni sprul sku bzang po grags pas rgyang yon lung nas ga kho nas ba 'a te/ rigs 'dzin rgod ldem la gnang ba'o// //maṅga lo/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherdo rje drag po rtsal gyi rtsa tshig rdo rje'i mdud 'grol zhe tha bya ba bzhuga'//gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ thog mar sngon 'gro gzer lnga zangs thal dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par skyang gnas kyi bla ma drag po rtsal du bsgom/ skyabs sems grub nas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros skyabs yul gzhan rnams 'od du zhu thugs gar thim 'gro ba rnams kyang de lta bur 'od du zhu nas thugs kur thim rang yang de lta bur thugs kur thim/ maṇ+ḍal kyang 'bul mkhan dang 'bul yul thams cad skyabs 'gro dang 'dra phyi nang gsang gsum chos longs sprul gsum so sor 'bul yang gnas mi 'gyur rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas gsum du rdor sems dkar dmar mthing ga bskyed thugs dar zla gdan la oṃ āḥ/ gi mthar yig brgya dkar dmar mthing gis bskor ba/ spyi bo'i rdor sems las bdud rtsi byung smin mtshams yan gang de bzhin du mgrin pas mgrin pa thugs kas thugs ka yan gang gsum gnas byung bas sku thams cad gang de nas mtheb mo nas bdud rtsi byung rang gi spyi bor thugs nas sdig sgrib dag pa mthar 'gro drug gi sgrib pa sbyangs mthar thams cad rdor sems su gyur nas dbang bzhi len bla ma mtho brtsegs gsol ba gdang dbang bzhi bya'o/ /dmigs rim bcad/ bla ma rang thim lus 'di lha ru gyur/ snang stong 'dzin med lha la sems 'dzin pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi mthar bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang drag po rtsal du bsgom pa'i sems 'dzin byas mthar thugs ka nas bla ma mtheb sor tsam pa mdun du chad de la sems 'dzin/ de las bla ma grangs med 'jig rten gang bar spro la ma pho bar bsgom slar 'dus mdun gyi der thim de'ang rang la thim par bsam mo/ /rags dang phra ba cha shas kun la 'dzin/ /de nas ngag nyid (2na)sngags la sems 'dzin hūṃ ngag na brjod pa'i sgra dang bcas snying gar nyi gdan la hūṃ bsgom de las hūṃ gnyis ro rkyang rgyud sna bug gi sgor thon de las/ 'jig rten gang bar spro zhing lan brdzus te hūṃ gnyis la thim de'ang thugs kar bsdu/ thugs kar rdo rje rtse dgu pa sngon po la/ pa/ /yi ge hūṃ sngon snod bcud khyab pa ni/kha dog sgra dbyibs kun la ci gnas bya/ /sems nyid phyag mtshan gnam lcags de la rdo rje gnyis ro rkyang nas sna sgo 'thon 'jig rten thams cad rdo rjes gang yang tshur bsdus rdo rje gnyis la bsdu de gnyis kyang thugs kar thim mo/ rdo rje —42

rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi rtsa tshig rdo rje'i mdud 'grol/ nang ma (gel/ /'dzin tshul snying dbus gnam lcags rtse dgur gyur/ /de las spro bsdu gong bzhin 'dzin par bya/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas rdo rje dkar po lus tshan mdun gyi khru bdun tsam bar spros te g.yas bskor bar tshur snying gar bsdu/ ka dag sngon 'gro rdo rje dkar po dang / hūṃ yang rdo rje dkar po ltar mdun du spros de las sems la dzin yang de las/ grang med spros snod gan phar thal tshur thal tshur bsdu ba gong ltar ro/ /hūṃ sngon thig le dkar dmar dmigs rim skyong / /lus gnad chos bdun srin lag gi rtsa mthe bos mnan nas sta zur du bzhug /rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum spyi bor baṃ las byung ba'i thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gsum mdor a las byung ba'i thig le dmar po snying ga lta bur rlung cung zad bzung bas thig le dmar po snying gar yong dkar por zhu nas 'dres par dmigs pa gtod yang dkar dmar so so'i gnas su 'jog go/ /(2ba〉yus gnad rlung gnad rtsa gnad thig le'i gnad/ /bzhi la brten nas sems kyi gnad cha btsal/ brten ༅ rde'u shing bu lha sku sogs lha skur bsgoms pa yin/ /bar bar ngo bor bltas te rang grol btang /brten med ma bcos pa'i ngang du bzhag /de rjes khrid de nas lus rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad sngar bzhin la steng rlung cung zad mnan pas ro rkyang nas mar song ba dbu ma nas yar zhugs pas a shad la thig le dmar po nas tsam gcig snying gar song spyi bo'i dkar po mar babs snying gar steng dkar 'og dmar la dmigs pa gtad do/ /de nas spyi bor bla ma drag po rtsal bsgoms de la hūṃ lnga brtsegs kyi gnas kyi gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od zhu thig le sngon por song nas snying ga'i thig le la thim pas bla ma phyin med rang sems nang du med par gnyis ka dbyer med du cig nas 'jog go /gzhud dngos gzhi la zhugs te/ /mnyam gzhag gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngo bo skyong / /de la bying ba gti mug gegs byung na/ /gu ru dmar smug nam mkha'i mthongs su bsgoms/ /'od zhu rang la thim sogs gzhud bzhin bskyangs/ /rgod pa zhe sdang gti mug gegs sel gu ru dmar smug la dmigs pa gtad de nas 'od du zhu thig le dmar smug tu gyur nas snying ga'i thig le la thim pas rang sogs thams cad mi dmigs par 'jog go /gegs sel gu 〈co dkar/ nyams len dngos gzhi sngar ltar la zhe sdang gi bgegs sel gu ru dkar po yin de las gu ru dkar pos 'jig rten khyab par spros sems can gyi don byas las sems can thams cad gu rur gyur pas zhe sdang bul dag nas med par song snying gar thim pa sngar ltar ro/ /smin mtshams thad kyi nam mkhar ba lha/ma pa dang / dngos gzhi sngar ltar la bgegs sel gu ru mthing ga snying gar thim pa'i bar dmar sngag dang 'dra de nas thig —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shele dkar dmar gyi spyi bo dang steng 'og so sor song / rlung ro rkyang nas mar byung dbu ma rgyud a shad bskul bas me 'bar rtsa 'khor rnams rim par bsregs lus thams cad mes gang / /phro dang shes pa de nas phyir 'phros 'jig rten mes gang bsregs rang lusakyang lcags gong me 'bar ba ltar bsgoms pas chags(3na〉lcal zhi bar 'gyur ro/ rdzing 'khor gegs byung na/ /lte ba'i gnas nas me 'bar snod bcud dang / /phung khams bsregs nas stong nyid ngang la 'jog /yang dngosagazhi sngar ltar la dug lnga cha mnyam gyi bgegs ces la gu ru mthing ma dag snying gar sgom yang thig ler bzhu lte bar thim/ phro na gu ru mthing ga snying thad bsgoms/ /de yang 'od zhu rang la thim par bsam/ /skabs 'gar bde sdug re dogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /snang ba gang gu ru mthing gar bsgoms pa des dug lnga'i bgegs ma sel na 'di ltar sgoms/ shar chu yi ri mo bar/ /sbrul mdud bzhin du rang grol ngang la btang / /de la ma gnas yang dug lnga'i gegs: rim sogs kyi ma sel na gu ru la mtshon lta bur bsgom pa dang lte bar thim/ gu ru 'od lnga yi/ /rnam par sems gtad 'od zhu rang la thim/ /'dzin med ngang la zhag gcig mnyam par bzhag /de nas lus sems snang sems brtag par bya/ lus sems so so yin na spyi dang bye brag gi khyad mang bas lus sems kyang min sems lus kyang min te lus sems ltar mi mthong dgos pa la mthong sems lus ltar mthong reg dgos pa la med des mtshon sems phyi snang ba snod bcud min la tshur yang min pas lus sems dang snang sems zhus sa cad dbyer med tu bya'o/ khyung gnas 'gro gsum brtags la phu thag bcad/ dang rdzogang nas byung bar du gang du sa mthar gang du 'gro lta tshe ngos ba spyang rgyu ṣ+ka de/ /de nas semasanyid stong gsal 'dzin med de/ /ye nas sku gsum yin par ngo sprad de/ /ngo bo stong pa chos sku de yi mdangs/ gnas dag pa/ /rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod 'ja' 'a ltar lhun grub/ rdzogs sku dang / /thugs rjes cir nyi ma nam mkha' la shar kyang 'od la 'gyur po ltar/ yang ma 'gags sprul sku de/ /don la rang rig ma bcos rjen pa 'di/ gas 4 na stong stong 4 na gsal/ gsal stong dbyer med snang stong dbyer med ngang /snang tsam na stong stong tsam na snang ba la/ /rig stong rig rig wal wal khyug khyug de la blta pas kyang rig tsam na stong stong tsam na (3ba jig /dbyer med gsal le sing nge ba gsal le ming nga yi re ba gsal stong 'dzin med rang babs su shig go rang grol du lhod nge 'jog /ye re spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba 'di/ /ye nas sku gsum bla ma rang sem thig —44

rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi rtsa tshig rdo rje'i khod 'grol/ nang ma (gele dang de la bram chum pas/ rang bcas yin/ /de las logs su zhi dang khro bo sogs/ /sangs rgyas yar la 'tshol ba'i re ba dang / /mar la ga song 'khor bar lhung dogs pa'i/ /re dogs dang bral bar rda rnam gsum gcod/ /'khor 'das shan byed bem rig mgo rtags byed/ /gzung 'dzin rang grol 'od gsal ma bu sprod/ /rang rig rang ngo ma bcos thod phreng rtsal/ /zhes pa'i dgongs don mthar thug khrid yig gi /zin bris yang thig gces sgron gsal byed 'di/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun ma nyams pa/ kun tu bzang / rigs lnga/ phyag rdor smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro ma/ tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ 'jog po/ rgyal po dza/shākya pra bha/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /bka' gter snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i ldum bu pa/bi mā la/shī la mtha mkhar chen bza'/sna nam pa/ gter sten yab sras/ sangs rgyas byams bzang / se nyi ma bzang po/ se mgar pa rgyal mtshan/ se rin chen rgyal mtshan/ zla ba mgon pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhan byams pa bzang po/ bya btang kun bzang nyi ma/ rdzogs chen 'brug sgra bzang po/ dar sdings pa 'phrin las lhun grub ste/ /'phrin las rab rtsa tshig mchan bu gsal ba'i rdo rje'i tshig /rje btsun bla ma'i gsung rgyun ma nyams pa/ brjed nges 'jigs pa spang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /gang shar rang sar grol des bkod pa dge/ /gnyags dzñā na kumā ra'i skye sprul zur chen ma dbyangs bla ma/ rgya ba mugang des bris pa la/ /nongs pa dpal sngags kyi srung mas ka dzā thi/ mchis na chos srung kun la bshags/ /dge 'dis kun bzang gdod ma'i sa thob shog / / /sarba maṅga lo/—45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sherdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying tig gi 'khrid yig mchan gsal 'bum phrag snang bzhi'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs/rdzogs pa chen po sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum gyi nang nas/man ngag gi sde'i yang snying mkha' 'gro snying tig gi skor dpon slong kyi 'grel pa brtag pa nas bzung dbang khrid lung gsum spel mar mdzad pa'i shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs yod kyang deng sang 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas nas mi mdzad pa shas che/la ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang /smin zin grol bar byed pa khrid kyi rim pa gnyis/phyi ma la grol lam gtso bor ston pa dang /chags lam gtso bor ston pa gnyis/dang po la/rgya che ba paṇ+ḍita'i chos skor dang /shin tu zab pa kū swa li'i 'di la spyir bshad na mang du yod kyang bye brag pad gling pa'i brgyud kun bzang dgongs 'dus/ma rgyud klong gsal/rgyud bu chung gsum la ngos 'dzin/mkha' 'gro snying tig dang de'i gsal byed yang tig yid bzhin nor bu gnyis yin/snar+shas skor gnyis/phyi ma la brtson khrus rab tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya/'bring bar do/tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du 'tshang rgya ba dang gsum/dang po la/sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshig nas rang bzhin ma bcos par snal du dbab pa/dngos gzhi nas lugs kyi don gtan la dbab ste 'od gsal chos sku gcer mthong du ngo sprod pa/rjes snang nyams kyi 'char tshul bstan nas nyams 2na)su len tshul bshad pa dang gsum/dang po la/'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba thun mong gi sngon yang tig khrid yig nyi zla gza' skar gyi sa bcad la brten khrid yig nor bu lugs dang /dge ba gsum gyi khrid yig byang chub lam bzang nas kha bkang pasar dzi'i klong gsal sogs rdzogs chen spyi 'gro'i 'chad lugs dang mthun/mkha' 'gro snying tig gi btags grol snying po'i don khrid las/mi rtag snyang rje byang sems bsgom/zhes pa'i rtsa ba la brten bkra bzang ba phyogs kyis 'chad tshul sa bcad gnyis su byas nas/ma rtag ces par/dal 'byor rnyed dka'/mi rtag pa' tshul la 4༷sams nas las 'dus kyi ngang tshul/mi dge bas 'phangs pas

rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying tig gi 'khrid yig mchan gsal 'bum phrag snang bzhi'i 'od zer/ nang ma rtongad༅ song gi sdug bsngal/ kun dkris kyi dge bas mtho ris thob kyang sdug bsngal myong tshul/ rnam dag gi dge pal brten nas thar pa thob tshul/ tshul de la bsams nas rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len/ sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i phyir du skyabs 'gro dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa byams snying rje byang sems bsgom pa'i tshul la/ kun rdzob smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dang / don dam sems bskyed gnyis/ de'i mjug tu yig brgya/ maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams ston pa ltar mdzad kyang cho ge go /'gro/ gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dang gnyis/ dang po la/ snang srid bla ma'i lam khyer ba po r+sāng phe lugs de she pan nas rje rang byung bar brgyud pa'i ga kho g.yi sor gnas kyi khrid tshul yin pa don la khyad par med na'ang (2bskor rgyas chos sdings phyogs kyi rgyun phyag len bde ba'i gshis yang tig gi khrid yig gser 'phreng gi sa bcad sor bzhag pa yin/sgrib sbyong tshogs gsog maṇ+ḍal gyi lam khyer/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras kyi lam khyer/ tshe mi rtag pa'i lam khyer/ byams snying rje byang sems kyi lam khyer dang lnga/ dang po la/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po la/ skyabs 'gro dang 'brel ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor gser phreng gzhung bzhin dngos/ rjes thob bla ma rang la bstim zin rjes slar yang stod gzhal yas khang bcud bla ma sgrar grags pa sngags kyi gdang su blta/ kyi nyams len/ nyal ba'i rnal snying gar bla ma yab yum sor gang pa zhig la dmigs pa gtod/ 'byor dang gsum/gnyis pa la/ kun rdzob sems༅ gyi don du lam 'di nyams su len snyam pa/ sems bskyed/ don dam sems༅ rnams me nas sang rgya yin pa shes par bya ba'i phyir du/ sems bskyed gnyis/ gnyis pa sgrib sbyong tshogs gsog maṇ+ḍal gyi lam khyer la/ rdor sems gser phreng na mi gsal gnyi zla gza' skar gyi rtsa tho bzhin dge ba gsum khrid nasakha bkang / sgom bzlas dang maṇ+ḍal gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos gzhi/ rjes snod gzhal yas khang/ gan rdor sems/sgra yig brgya'i gdangs/ thob/ nyal ba'i rnal snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sor gang tsam la sems gto/ 'byor dang gsum/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi dang rjes gang snang thams cad mchod rdzas su shes pa/ thob gnyis/ dang po la/sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ cho me sku'i maṇ+ḍal dang gsum/ gsum ga la gang la 'bul bar bya ba'i yul/ gci 7snyo/ gang 'bul bar bya ba'i dngos po sprul sku lam dag pa srid pa'i 'dod yon/ longs sku la dag pa sgos pa rnga sgra'i zhing kun bzang mchod sprin gyi gang ba/ chos sku la 'od zer rdo rje snying po'i zhing khams rang bsto gyis rnam —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepar dag cing lhun gyis grub pas mchod bya mchod byed mar yul thams cad (3na)ngo bo stong pa rnam pa ye shes lnga'i gdangs ma 'gags i du 'od lnga'i thig le'i maṇ+ḍal/ 'bul ba po'i mkhan po dang gsum/ gsum pa 'khor ba rgyu 'brasakyi lam khyer la/ dngos 'bras bu las rgyu dpog pa'i tshul gyis las dkar nag gi 'bras bu bde sdug de la 'dor len de yang dal rten la sgrub pa/ gzhi dang / rjes thob dge ga la spro zhing mi dge spul rte pa log pa/ gnyis/ bzhi pa tshe mi rtag pa'i lam khyer la/ nges par sngar byung ba mtha' dag pha rol tu song tshul sogs 'chi nges par the tshom med pa/ 'chi ba/myur du 'chi ba/ ltag chu ho pa'i rdzing bu zhabs brdol lta bu/ de ring yang mi 'chi 7lus kyi spyod lam/ ngag gi smra brjod/ yid kyi rtog dpyod byed bzhin pa'i ngang nas gza' gdong thug lta bus skad cig la 'chi bas lus nam mkha'i gzha' tshon/ snyan grags brag cha/ nor jos sbrang rtsi/ 'khor g.yog tshong 'dus kyi mgron po lta bu ste/ mkhar rdzong brtsigs pa zhig pa/ nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur tshul/bas kyi sems can gyi ngang tshul bsams pa'i 'chi ba mi rtag pa rab skyes pa la chos pa rab sogs 'byung ba/ ba'i nges pa med pa/ rjes thob gang snang thams cad la mi rtag pa'i 'du shes/ dang bzhi/ lnga pa byams snying gser 'phreng du byams pa sngon la gsungs kyang kun mkhyen pa'i gzhung gzhan tshor snying rje sngon la mdzad pa nam mkha' ltar sems can la mtha' med pa thams cad pha ma yin pa/ tshe 'di'i ma dper mtshon nas bsams pas de la byams pa skye bas mar gyur dus grang ba'i du gos dang / tsha ba'i reg bya la phu btab pas mtha' brten pa'i phan btags na/ la la dmyal ba tsha grang gis nyen bzhin pa la'ang phan thabs ga la yod cing /ma yul du byas nas las bsags te dug gsum gyi sdug bsngal la spyad na mi rung snyam pasang ga nas kyang bde ba thob cing sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i gsal gang mang 'debs/ byang sems kyi skabs gto me len yang yang byed rje byang sems bsgom tshul la/ snying rje bsgom pa/ byams pa bsgom pa/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ rjes thob dang bzhi/ gomasapa'i shugs kyis ga ༅ nga gis(3ba〉khyung ba dgos/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro lnga po'i dgos pa la'ang gnyis te/ gnas skabs su bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis byin rlabs kyi sgo 'byed/ yig brgyas sgrib pa 'dag /maṇ+ḍal gyis tshogs gsog /rgyu 'bras bsams pas dge sdig gi mtshang shes/ mi rtag pas nges 'byung dang skyo shas skye/ snying rje byang sems kyis theg chen lam du 'gyur ba dang / mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro —48

rdzog chen mkha' 'gro snying rtag gi 'khrid yig mchan gsal 'bum phrag snang bzhi'i 'od zer/ nang ma (pe la/'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba/sgrib pa sbyang ba/sngon 'gro dngos/snal du dbab pa dang bzhi/dang po la gzhi bdag gtor ma/'ad rjes la lus kyi sngon 'gro bya ba'i phyir/rig drug spyod pa sna tsho gos bya//dkon cog gsum gyi spyod pa dang spyad zhes gsung pas/rang gi gan khang ma yin pa'i dur khrod lta bu gnyan sa yin na dgos/rdo rje rtse lnga'i steng du bla ma bsgom pa/ sems bskyed nas kun bzang yab yum bsgoms pas bar ho sel zhing byin tsos 'jug/rigs drug gi spyod pa/sngon ho rig drug gi spyod pa sna tshogs byas par grogs kyi skyon mtshang rig pawo nang slong ba'i zasal zhen ga log pa ltar de'i gnyen po theg pa thun mong bar/byams pa dang /mi sdug pa/gsang sngags phyi ma la rnam pa gzhan du gyur kyang yodag pa'i snang ba 'di nyid kyi spyod pas bsgyur ba/dri mas dri ma bkru gdang /dug gi dug ni 'joms par byed/cesangaltar/yang sos so gos dmyal ba'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur/a na a tshas so gosang ga gi brjod pa/'jigs sgrog dang sdug bsngal bsamapa mtshon rig drug so so'i dga' sdug sna tsho gos byang dgos pa ni sgo gsum gyi sdig pa'i dag/bar gcod zhi/mngon chen ldog/mthar a sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du la'i sto//dkon mchog gsum gyi spyod tshul dang bzhi/rgyal bzhi khro'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod la bslab/gnyis pa la/sbyang gzhi las nyon gyis spags ba lus(4na 'di mi gtsang ba'i snod dang 'dra bas/klad rgya'i steng na lha'i sa 'a a dkar po/mgrin par lha min gyi su ser nag/kho gar mi'i yi sngo nag/ltebar dud 'gro'i tri ljang ser/gsang gan su yi dwags kyi pre dmar nag/rkang mthil g.yon du dmyal ba'i du nag po/thams cad kyang las nyen gyis nag tshuge nge mi gsal ba'o//de ltar yang thal 'gyur las/lus ni ma rin rgyus bskyed phyir//rig drug sa bo ne nyid du gnas//zhesapa'o//sbyong byed gnyis/gan gsum du sku gsum gyi ngo bo yig 'bru gsum las me yang dkar dmar mthing gsum 'bar bsarigs drug gi sa bon rnams mes mar bsregs pa ltar rje med du song bar bsam/thal 'gyur las/rig pa sku gsum dngos yin phyir//ye shes yi ge 'bru gsum shar//zhes pa'o//dgos pa ni/gsum thun mong du sdig pa'i sa bon 'dag/man go zhi/ma' nga ldog/phyis 'khor bar mi ldog sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su la'i rgya/gsum pa sngon 'gro la/za lus kyi sngon 'gro/thal 'gyur las/rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas pas//lus sbyangs sems la phan pa'o//zhes pas/rkang mthil gnyis sprad pa'i/rtse sar btsugs/lag mthil gnyis spyi gtsug tu sbyar ba'i dbyibs rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i rnam pa de rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum pa me 'bar ba zhig tu btso/las/ pa'i thal mo phyi nang klog pa kong po rdzogs wo ༷༷mdzad pa de mas che gsung //ngag gi ston 'gro/yid

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she kyi sngon 'gro dang gsum/gnyis pa la/thal 'gyur las/pag ni hūṃ zhes gan pa la/rgyas gdang pa dang rtsal sbyang ba/gnyen tsam la mo du zhugs po yis//ngag sbyangs sems la phan dzo yin/ces gsungs pas/rgya btagadab pa/rtsal sbyang ba/gnyen btsal ba/hūṃ gcig lagacig 'byar ba khanang nas sngo byur gyis sang /mdun gyi dmigs rten la sgrul ltar 'gril/rtsemor hūṃ sleb pa de la sems 'dzin/bang rim gyis grol brtsabar glebs pa la sems 'dzin/mthar dmigs pa gang la yang gtad chog/lam du zhugs pa dang bzhi/mdun du hūṃ khru gang tsam (4bto zhig sgo skas/rdo skas sogs la mi 'gro bltar phyin nasal klungs mang po bgol/mtshams mtshams su hūṃ la sems 'dzin/mthar mi mngon pa lta bur phyin na slar yang tshur ldog go/dang po la/phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab pa/mchu dang sgom reg tsam gyi tswa nasa3 dal bus mnyam par brjod kha nang nas/ rong rong phyir thon/snod bas khengs6 gyis gdos bams thams rang 7zha med pa'i stong par rtogs/de'i mdangs/ gi snang ba mer gyis gang snyam pa chad pa/des ji gzhan la 'gro/hūṃ yig rlung gsum gcig tu bsres nas bsgoms pas myur du sems 'dzin nusapa yang btag pa'i man ngag yin gsungs/nang phung po la rgyas gdab pa/phyi nang gi khyad ma gtags gong dang 'dra/gnyis pa la/phyi snang ba la rtsal sbyang ba/hūṃ 'a po ri rang sogs po rnams lu khung brtol bar ltar phug gnasabazung yungs hrū tsam pa rdul phran tsam gyis phug ste mthar phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral du 'gro/gong dang 'dra nang phung po la rtsal sbyang ba/gsum pa yid kyi sngon 'gro la/rtsad bcad pa/lus la nad drag po thong po ga i la song ba'i dus mi mngon pa don sems kyi thog tu byung ba'i rtags yin/shi nas lus mes bsregs pa sogs rdul phran du 'gro la/sem kyi thog tu rigs drug gi bde sdug myong brkun ma rkan thog tu ngos zin pa lta bu ste lusang ga las sems gtso bar ngesapa'o//mtshang btsal ba lusang ga yid gsum gcig gam tha dad/gcig na lusang ga ltar sems mthong thos su rung zhing semaspoltar lus ngag mthong thos su ma rung bas de gsum mi gcig pa lta bu/ tha dad na lus rdul phran cha med/ ngag rjes med gtad yal/sems bya lam rjes med du song tshe so so'i gzhi ma rnyed par gcig bya gcig byed dang bral/tha dad bya byed dang bral bas de'i tshe yul mang rten 'brel gcig tu rtogs pas/gzung 'dzan gyi rtsa ba chad/gnyis 'dzan gyi mkhar pa 'gyel/gnas lugs brtag pa dang gsum/gsum pa la 'byung gnas/thal 'gyur las/sems ni dang ba byungs dang /bar du gnas dang tha mar 'gro//de ltar gsum la brtags (ldan)//da na//sems sbyangs sems kyi gnas lugs shes//zhes

rdzogs 'a mkha' 'gro snying tig gi 'khrid yig mas gsal 'bum phrag snang bzhi'i 'od zer/ nang ma (pegasungs/'gro gsum/sems 'di snod bas spyi dang khyad par rang gi po be+e nas rkang mthil bar gyi cha shas phra mo re re'i steng nas byung tshom rnyed/de bzhin du gnas sa dang 'gro sa yang ma rnyed pas/skye 'gag gan gsum dang bral la/bzhi pa snal du dbab pa la/klong gsal las/na dag don gnyi rtogs bya'i phyir//snal du pha ponas gsang yang gzhug khes pas/lus lus mi 'gul bas gdon bgegs mi 'jug/de la brten nas rtsa mi 'gul/de ma 'gul bas rlung mi 'gul/de ma 'gulabs thig le mi 'gul/de mo 'gul bas sems rang babs su gnas pas bsam gto nga gis skye ba'i dgos pa yod/so ma ma bcos pa bskul bskyod dang bral ba/ngag so ma ma bcos pa smra brjod dang bral ba/yid som ma bcos pa dgag sgrub dang bral ba dang gsum mo//gnyis pa gnas lugs kyi don gtan la dbab pa 'od gsal chos sku gcer mthong du ngo sprod pa la/gzhi ka dag cho ge zad dul zla ba khreg chod kyi gdams pa/lam lhun grub 'od gsal du 'gag bsdam pa thod brgal gyi gdams pa dang gnyis/dang po la/ngo sprod pa/thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'tsho dus zag med kyi bsgo gto skyes kyang ngos ma zin pas rang rig rang gnas kyi bas gagatan ngo sprod pa la yi dam/mkha' 'gro lnga/bka' srung bzhi'i gtor ma/mchod pa/gegs gtor/tshogs 'khor rnams nyam/mkha 'tsho las sbyang /ga 'a srung gi ga sto bsngo/4nga tshom nas sa 'khor rnams song rjes ngo sprod dpe steng nas lan gsum gsung /de yang mig sna rtser phab/rig ༅ ngo bo la pos pas ngo bo chos sku skye med stong pa/rang bsto longs sku gnas pa med pa gsal sing nge ba/thug rje sprul sku gdangs 'gag med sna gas su 'char ba/de'i ngang nas byung 4 gyi rtag pa dang /(5ba)dran 'dzin gyi gnyen pos ma bslad pyogs la le cig ge gnas pa bsam gtan dug bral/gnas sgo snyam pa so gos dug can/rtog pa dang bral ba'i gsal sing nge ba mnyam bzhag/mthar bsam gtan las langs tshe spros bral gyi be shes las mi g.yo po rjes thob/de'i mjug rtog pa sna tshogs lo brjes shes zer/ phyag rgya btso rnam rtog la bya ra byed cing de 'gog pas 'di dang mi mthun/rang lugs rnam rtog dgag sgrub med po bya tshor yang nam mkha las ma 'das pa lta bu/rtsal sbyang ba/bogs dbyung ba dang gsum/ga/nyis pa la/rang gnas bsam gto gyi ngang du sbyang ba dang /rang gdangs ye shesakyi rol pas sbyang ba gnyis/dang po la/ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang /sngar gyi gas sing nge ba'i ngang nas mig gyen du ba kho pa sngar gyi bsam gto de zhig pa'i nga tshor gyi rtog pa dang dran 'dzin ga 'a po med pa'i shes pa rang gsal rgya yan 'chal ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shezhig 'char gdon stong gsal de ga rgya cher song g.yin/de la rtog pa ci 'phros kyang sgrul mdud ltar rang sar smo 'gro/'di med nga tsho 'od gas la sogs mi zin/'di kho na ma byas lhun grub kyi sgom pa chu ba lta bu yin no//mnyam rjes bsre ba/sngar ngos zin pa'i bsam gto lagato pa cung zad thong nas khro bo'i lta stangs/rgyad kyi dor stabs/seng ge'i mchod stangs gsum gyis spyod lam zhi ba/ca zad rtsung pa/shin tu rtsub pa gsum gyi sngar gyi ba4 gto gyi nga ma shor bar rkyen dang tso bar bya'o//gnyis pa rang gdangs ye shes kyi rol bar rtsal sbyang ba la/gnas pa sems kyi rgyan/tso mas ji 'gan kyang chu las ma 'das pa ltar rtog pa gang los pa de ga rang babs su bzhag pas/mthar de ga'i ngang du yal lo//'gro mkhan gyi shesapa dang 'phro bya'i yul gnyis su mgrub par gzhi med rtsa bral duganas pa'o//khro ba sems kyi ral ba/dgag sgrub re dogs sogs gang shar gyi rtog pa lan du bzhi pa chu rlabs byung k+ṣe nyid na chu nang du zhig 'gro (6na)ba ltar/rnam rtog 'phros tsam stong gsal gyi 4 du yal lo//gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du gnas pa dang gsum/'gro gnas gnyis rtsa med pa stong gsal rjen yi ba de ga'i ngang nas lusang ga yid gsum gyi spyod pa ci byas kyang bsam gtan las mi g.yo ba'o//gsum pa bogs dbyung ba la/dug lnga rang grol/byar ba sog kyi tshe de'i ngo bo la bltas pas shel la nyi zhur phog pa ltar dwangs sing nge dag 'gro bas sto mongs gas la'ang 'gre/dper na 'dod chags mi bzod pa zhig skyes pa'i tshe de'i ngo bo la cher gyis bltas nasachas gyis bzhag pas pad stong gnyis med du grol0ste slong dpon chen pos/'di ltar yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi//zhes sogs lta bu'o//sgo lnga rang grol/mig lta bu la rtog dpyod thol gyis mi pon de ga'i nga la pos pas zhig 'gro bas mtshon/tshogasadrug rang grol dang gsum mo//lus kyi mdzegs gi rtog pa lta bu shar ba de ga'i 4 du 'ag pas ma' sgra dri sogasala'ang 'gre'o//gnyis pa lhun grub 'od gsal du 'gag bsdam pa thod brgal gyi gdams pa la/sngon 'gro zag bcas kyi ye shes rgyud la skye tshul/dngos gzhi de nyid ngo sprod pa/tag smo4ltar tshad gtor sog sngon du bas nas dpe lan gsum bklags nas ngo sprod do/de yang lnga 'a bdun gyi ngo sprod de/sku lnga/ye shes lnga/rig lnga/'od lnga/rma lnga/shes rang lnga/mkha 'gro lnga'o//rjes rnal 'byor bzhi'i sgom tshul bstan pa gsum/dang po la/sgo gsum gyi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang ba/sgo gsum gyi gnad bdun/ye shes gsum gyi mtshon tshul bstan pa dang gsum/tsit+ta sha sgron gyi nang ༷sa du bum sku rnam dag dbyings kyi sgron ma'i mdangs dkar 'jam

rdzogs 'a mkha' 'gro snying smi gi mud yig mas gsal 'bum phrag snang bzhi'i 'od zer/ nang ma 9)rtsa'i sgron ma'i lpo rgyud rgyang gas chu sgron nas thon/dbying rnam dag gi sgron mo thig le stong rma lu gu sa lang/de'i tshe ka dag dang lhun grub dbyer med pa'i shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma ngo lod par sar bsan snying na mig tu tshol phe rtsa dar dkar gyi skud pa lta bu tshol ba de'i nang na ye shes rgya dkar gyi nyi yi ltar 'char slo/mig gi sad du gzigs sta pasabya go/chos sku'i gzig04yo/longs sku thad zur/sa sa da zur du phob pa mas sa po'o//de ltar yang /sgo ralas/chos sku'i gzigs stangs seng ge yi//'khrul pa'i 'jigs pa tso bral nas//rdo rje'i mig gis mthong bar 'gyur//zhes sogasagasungs so//dgos pa ni/gan skab su rig pa'i ye shes dbang i mdzo sum du gas/mthar lhun snang gni zad na lhagamed du la'i rgya'o//dang po la/phyi 'ag rten gyi bya spus gi ho du lus bkol ba/nang chos kyi ho du bsgos ba/ga4 ralabaskyod phra mo k+ṣe yang spong /lus kyi bya ba gsum/phyi 'ag rten gyi gto/nang kha' ga4 nga skyabarjod ga mo tsam yang mi byed/ngag gi bya ba gsum/phyi 'ag rten gyi bya ba bsam pa/nang sgo mo sgrub sog bsam pa/ga4 brtog pa phra mo'ang sbangasapas byar med kyi rnal 'byor rgyud la skye bas 'das rjes las/gnas brtan grol ba'i gdengs thob nas//phyi nang bya gtso btang ste//zhes dang /slong gsal las/mdzo sum gnad du dbab pa'i phyir//phyi nang gsang phe bya ba ni//lusang ga yid kyi sgo sprugs btang /zhes gsungs/yid kyi bya ba gsum/thal mir las/ma' sum gnad ni lu sha smos//sgo tsho skad rnams nges par bas/de yang lus ni sku gsum las/khrin du 'da' bar mi bya'o//zhes gsung pas/gnyis pa la chorme sku seng rkang yo mthil gnyis sprad/lag gnyis rdo rje khu oṃ bas phyi nang gang rung du ldog pa 'dam khal nang du ldogs gal a che/ro ra brgyangs/mig gyen la ga kho pa chos nyid kyi sbyan song bas so//a mong phe dgo pa nang gi sting pa da/a mong ma yin pa ka dag gi don rtogs/ge'i zhugs tshul/longs sku glang po che'i bzhugs tshul/pu mo gnyis dang lag(7na)pa'i gru mo gnyis sa la btsugs/rting pa gnyis 'phong kyis mnan/g.yas g.yon gyi sor mo bzhig 'gram pa dang /mthe bos yon ma ba smo/mig thad dar blta g.ye shes kyi spyan yod/thun mong ba g.yo byed kyi sa na/a mong ma yin pa sa grub kyi sa lor//sprul sku drang srong tsog pu'i bzhugs tshul dang gsum/rkang pa'i long bugs da spu phyinang 'de yo skrun kyang yid pa las che/lag pa gnyis snol nas pus mo bas pa smo me thab drug 'i gang du mig thur du zur blta zur ṣ+ka kyi tshul shes rab kyi spyan yod/thun mong ba drod skye snyo sting sto r+sās/a mo/ rdo yin pa lus snang snyo khas su lang/de bzhi du gsum ga

lag tsho //lnga'i 1nga rig/rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang bla bzang rgya ma gsung 'bum/ 28la sodang 4 ma reg k+ṣe du rma rang babs su bzhag pas/a mong pa stil pa dang wo mongs pa mi 'phel/thun mong ma yin pa rig pa'i klong du grol wo /sang rgyas kyi gsung gi ngo bor 'tshang rgya/sems rten med nam mkha' stong pa la ma yengs par gto bas thun mong ba rig pa'i ye shes dbang tsho sgor lang/a mong ma yin pa phung po bag med du 'as//gsum pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i bsgom tshul la/lta ba/ri bong rwa lta bu'i stong pa ma yin pa gsal stong zung 'jug lon med rang gnas kyi bsnyo gto nam mkha lta bu mkho bzhag gi lta ba/'ja' r+sā/sprin/chu mas/sgyu ma'i rta glang lta bu rjes thob kyi lta ba/sgom pa/rang rig rang gsal 'phor grigang med pa gsal le nge gnas pa spros pa thams cad dang bral bar bsgom pa'o//spyod pa/de'i tshe gang la yang gza' gto ched 'dzin ṣ+ka pa spyon pa ltar blang dor med pa'o//'bras bu dang bzhi/goms pa klong du gyur pas dgag sgrubare dogs dang bral bas gdod ma'i gzhi la rang shar rang grol du 'gro ba'o//ngo sprod dang 'dis ni/gnas skabs su chos nyid yid spyod du ma lus par ma' sum du mthong la/mthar thug de mthong ba'i gnad kyis/dge sdig gis mi gos shing tsho bar ho kyang rang bzhin sprul sku'i ṣ+ka du skye'o//sgron ma snang byed las/ri bo cog sgo'i lta ba'i sgo (7ba)rgya mtsho cog bzhag sgom phe 3//snang gsar sgog spyod phe ra//rig gcog bsags bu'i 3//ra sto ldan phe rnal wor de//nge pa'i don la blo 'dres yo/zhes gsungs sgo//gsum pa snang nyams kyi skye tshul bstan nas nyams su len thabs bshad pa la/snang ba bzhi'i 'char tshul/mtha' brten bzhi'i rang bzhin goms tshul/grol pa chen po bzhi'i rang sa 'dzin tshul dang gsum/ dang po la/ chos nyid mngon sum/ dbyings kyi nang du rig pa tshud de thig le gsum phrel gyi snang nga dbang pho ma' sum du gyur pa oṃ ho do//gnas skabs su chos nyid yid spyod dang bral mthar thug gdod ma'i sar grol ba'o//nyams gong 'phel/thig le rim par 'phel ba gyen 'greng rtsibs shar mig mangs ris sogs 'od lnga'i gur khyim rje d+ku 'phel snyo 'char gdang /rig lnga'i sku phra mo 'char ba sogs so/rig pa tshad phebs/tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su nub te rigs lnga tshog bu'i dkyil 'khor ོ pos khyab par snang bas 'og min gyi sto las 'a po rang snang bsar la phebs/chos nyid zad pa dang bzhi/phyi kho snang gi 'phel zad/nang sgyu lus kyi chos zad/gsang ba rtog tshogs kyi sgos zad/rdzo dang 'khrul pa thams cad rang zad de/snang dang mi snang du lon pa'i blo zad pa sogs so//gnas skabs su snang bsto3 kyi byu byed/mthar thug bzad lhag med / ༷'i rgya'o//gnyis pa/mtha' rten bzhi'i rang bzhin

rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying tig gi 'khrid yig mchan gsal 'bum phrag snang bzhi'i 'od zer/ nang ma (pegoms tshul la/ mi 'gul ba gsum gyi gzhi bca' ba/ lus ma 'gul bas rtsa mi 'gul/ rtsa ma 'gul bas mig mi 'gul/ mig ma 'gul bas rlung mi 'gul/ rlung ma 'gul bas sems mi 'gul/ sems ma 'gul bas rtog tshogs ra pas ra dngasanas gnas pa'o/ /sdod pa gsum gyi tshad bzung ba/ phyi snang ba sdod/ nang sgyu lus stod/ gsang ba rma sems ca pa'o/ /3 rmi lam gyis lon/ rab la rmi 'am rgyun go/ weng la 'od gsal du la 'a/ tha mas rmi lam du ngo shes pa'o/ /rtags sgo gsum la 'char te/ chos nyid mngon sum gyi dus lus rus sbal 'khar gzhed du (8na)bcug pa lta bu/ ngag lkugs pa lta bu sems bya brnyisabazung blta bu/ gong 'phel la/ lus skyes bu nad kyis gdungs pa lta bu/ ngag ston pa lta bu/ sems mi dug gi zin po lta bu/ tshad phebs la/ lus glang chen 'dam chud/ ngag grul bum lta bu/ sems skyes bu 'byug na da byang blta bu/ chos nyid zad pa'i lus dur khrod kyi mi ro lta bu/ ngag brag cha/ sems na bun lta bu'o/ /thob skye rgal 4 dang thob/ 'a su ka pa la rang dmu 'thob/ rma semasal4dbang thob pa'o/ /pa gsum kyi gzer gdab pa/ gdengs sangs rgyas kyi yon to thob tu re bdang / ma thob pa'i dogasapa med/ lor bar mi lhung du re ba dang / lhung gi dogs pa med pa'o/ /bzhi'i drod tshad dang bzhi/ gdod ma'i gzhi thog tu grol bas gzhen nu bum pa'i skur mngon par byang chub brnyes pa ste/ de dag gis tshe 'dir grol ba'i man ngag go /gnyis pa brtson 'grus 'bring bar dor 'tshang rgya ba la/ skye gnas kyi bar do la thosabasam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa ded dpon gser gling du phyin pa lta bu/ 'chi kha'i bar do la gsal gdab pa rgyal po'i bka' 'phrin bskur ba lta bu/ chos nyid kyi bar do rang snang la yid ches pa ma pang du bu bcug pa lta bu/ srid pa bar do la las kyi 'phro mthud pa yur ba kong chag pa la wa 'dzugs pa lta bu'i gdams ngag dang bzhi/ brtson 'grus tha ma rang bzhin sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgya ba'i rjes su gto rgya mdzad do/ /brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ shrī sidha/pad+ma thod 'phreng / mkhar chen bza'/ gter ston tshul rdor/ klong chen rab 'byams/ khyab brdal lhun grub/ 'di dus kyang mar gtor gos 'khor sogs dgos/ grags pa 'od zer/ sangs rgyas dpon po/ thugs sras (8ba)zla grags/ kun bzang rdo rje/ rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / sna tshogs rang grol/ bstan 'dzin grags pa/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ 'phrin las lhun grub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma/ yang na/ gter ston nas/—55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesho ban legs pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ g.yung ston pa/ ye shes bzang po/ tshul khrims mgon po/ mgon po rgyal mtshan/ rgyal sras chos rje/ myang ston chos rje/ gdubs rat+na shrī/ nam mkha' shes rab/ mnga' ris paṇa chen/ legs ldan rdo rje/ skyi ston tshe ring pa/ klu sgrub chos rgya ma/ nam mkha' rigs 'dzin/snang thugs mchag 'od 'bar/ gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na nam mkha' shes rab nas legs ldan rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na/ sho seb lung du drung jo jo pa/ chos kyi grags pa/ nam mkha'i mtshan can/ mnga' ris paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na/ dri med 'od zer/ 'od gsal klong yangs/ lhun sdings rab 'byams/ spyang lung gzhen nu blo gros/ rab gsal zla ba/ paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na sho ban nas/ bde legs rgya mtsho/ spyang lung ba man 'dra/ paṇa chen sku mched gnyis kyi gsan yig sgo bstun nas bris pa yin/ zhes rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro ri snying tig gi 'khrid yig mtshan gsal 'bum phrag snang bzhi'i 'od zer 'di'ang za hor gyi bzhes drin can gter bdag gling par nyams 'khrid nos dus zin bris su btab bo// // —56

g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / nang ma (ger༅༅//g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na ma o ṣa dhi rā dzā gu ṇa nā thā ya/med du byung ba'i gsang ba gsum gyi ma la ya yi dri bsung gis//dug gsum tsha gdung nad kun sel ba'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan ma//rgyal ba kun dngos sman gyi bla ma tsan dan ljon pa'i bdag nyid can//gang gi thugs rje'i grib bsil dag gis 'gro rnams bde ba'i dpal la sbyor//sku gsum gas 'dus sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang //gdul bya'i snang ngor la'i pa'i zlos gar la/g.yu thog mgon por grags de nges don du//dkyil 'bor rgya mtsho'i gtso bor lhun gyis grub/khyod gsung gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin sum ston rje//snying thig bstan pa spel phyir bsams bzhin du//sprul pas rnam par rol pa'i rig sngags 'chang //bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal po dbang po'i sde//dpal ldan theg pa mchog gi mkha' dbyings su//zab don 'byor pa'i nyin byed 'phrin las kyis//skal bzang 'dab brgya rab tu rgyas mdzad pa'i//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kun phyag gi yul//yang zab bla ma sman rgyal dbyer med du//sgrub pa'i las byang yongs 'du sa brtol dbang //mchog thun dngos grub char du 'bebs byed na//blo ldan mtha' dag dang ba'i yid kyis nyone//de la 'dir 2na ) zab lam kun 'dus bla ma sman rgyal sgrub pa'i las byang khrigs chags 'khyer bde ba brjod par bya'o//thog mar skyabs sems rdo rje sems//tshogs zhing gtor bsngo mtshams gcad dang //sdig bshags byin dbab mchod gtor brlab//sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim mo//dang po skyabs 'gro ni/na mo rigs 'dus rdo rje la4 //phyogs dus dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos//bdag gzhan byang chub ma thob bar//snying nas nye bar skyabs su mchi//gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/nam mkhas khyab pa'i sems can rnams//sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir//rtsa ba gsum gyi go 'phang mchog/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shem thob bar du bsgrub par bya/ /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ /rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng / /hūm̐ dkar las grub rdo rje sems/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ /phyag gnyisardo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /thugs kar zla steng hūṃ gi mthar/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don byas/ /bdud rtsi mtheb sor nas 'dzags pas/ /rang gi lus bkrus sdig sgrib kun/ /ma lus byang zhing dag par gyur/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bzhi pa tshogs zhing ni/ rab yangs mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /pad+ma (2ba 'dab bzhi'i lte ba'i dbus/ /sman rgyal dbyer med ku ṇa'i zhabs/ /zhi 'dzum 'gro la chags pa'i nyams/ /dbu skra lcang lo me tog spras/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin ut+pa la'i/ /yu ba nas bzung snyan gyi thad/ /bye ba'i steng du glegs ral mtshan/ /g.yon pa chos 'chad pad sdong gi /rtsa ba nas bzung 'dab ma rnams/ /snyan gyi thad gar rgyas pa'i steng / /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa la/ /gur kum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan dang / /nor bu gser rdor a ru ras/ /g.yas g.yon dbus gsum rnam par mtshan/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' can/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i/ /'dab bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang gi /lha mo pi wang bya rgod dang / /mi rkang gling bu me long 'dzin/ /mdzes sdug rgyan ldan lang tsho rgyas/ /bde stong rab rgyas mchod pa 'bul/ /gzhan yang rtsa gsum chos srung bcas/ /ma lus 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ /hūṃ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gshegs/ /seng khri pad stong nyi zla'i steng du bzhugs/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus phyag rtag tu 'tshal/ /dngos wor yid sprul phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ /nyes lhung nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang / /gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bzhin du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes gang bsags byang chub bsngo/ /'khor ba dong sprugs bde chen mchog thob shog /lnga pa gtor ma gtong ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig dpal chen rta mgrin du/ /gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rdzas kyi skyon sbyangs rin chen snod yangs su/ /bdud rtsi'i ngo bo 'dod pa'i dngos por gyur/ /oṃ āḥlha/ thugs —58

g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / nang ma 9)ga'i (3na khod zer lcags kyu lta bu yis/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha dang rigs drug 'gro /gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir rab 'dus shig /sam ya dzaḥ sam ya sto/ ā+oṃ a: nas sha lta'i bar dang / ā+oṃ a kā ro mu kho sarba dharma ṇi/ a du zhut+pa mi twat+ta ā+oṃ āḥ& phaṭa swāhā/ na ma:sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khre saḥ sarba tad khaṃ ud ga te lpa ra ṇa hi me ga ga na kho gri sna ta ba smra ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dkar gtor bsngos la/ hūṃ/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dam tshig can rnams dang / /gzhi bdag tsho gos kun mchod sbyin gtor ma long / /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /'gro drug lus ngag yid gsum rab tshim nas/ /sdug bsngal kun bral bde la spyod gyur cig /ya hi la na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te ā+oṃ sam+bha ra 6bha ra hūṃ/ kha kha/ ji hi khā hi/ sam ya na ra gan badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis dmar gtor bsngos/ hūm̐/ nyon cig skal med bgegs kyi tshogs/ /nga ni gdod nas lhun grub pa'i/ /khro rgyal kun gyi rje btsun yin/ /bdud dpung thal bar brlag par byed/ /gsang chen rags 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /khyed cag 'jug pa'i skabs med pas/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen ci yod kyang / /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di long la/ /gzhan dang gzhan du byer zhing dengs/ /'dug na brlag par gdon mi za/ /sum bha ni sogs dang / sarba bhū ta u tsa sna la phaṭa/ drug pa mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūṃ sgyi/ rang byung ye shes khro bo'i rgyal/ /ma rig log rtog bgegs kyi gshed/ /lha 'drer 'dzin pa'i 'byul snang bgegs/ /bde chen slong du rang grol (3ba)mtshams/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus pa/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma rgya gram me dpung gis/ /go mtshams med par legs gtams pa'i/ /'jigs rung sra brtan srung ba yi/ /gur khang mtshams las ma 'da' cig /ā+oṃ āḥlha gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ gnod byed 'byung po sarba bisnan u tsa ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra tsakra rat+na pad+ma dme dz+wa la raṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ bdun pa bshags pa ni/ srung 'khor nang gi mdun gyi bar snang la/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /badz+ra sam dzaḥ—59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheskyabs gnas bdag la brtser dgongs mdzod/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /mi dge gang bgyis mthol zhing bshags/ /khyad par rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gi /nyes lhung dri mas sbags pa kun/ /snying nas bshags so dngos grub stsol/ /brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūṃ/ bde chen 'gyur med chos sku'i klong yangs nas/ /grangs med gzugs sku'i rnam par ston mdzad pa'i/ /rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal dkyil 'khor gyi/ /zhi dang khro bo'i lha tsho gos dgongs su gsol/ /bla ma rdor sems rigs bzhi 'khor dang bcas/ /rta phag yab yum chosaskyong dam can tshogs/ /mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bzhengs la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen ma lus phob/ /gnas khang 'di la gzi brjid bkrag mdangs skyed/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas la mthu stobasanus pa stim/ /rig 'dzin tsho gos la byin rlabs dbang bzhi skur/ /re ba'i 'bras bu mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi tiṣ+ṭha a be sha ya a aḥ dgu pa mchod gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ā+oṃ yig dkar po 'od 'bar (4na)ba/ /rigs lnga yab yum ngo bo nyid/ /mtshan ldan thod par zhu ba las/ /'chi med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta hūṃ hrī thā/ā:yig dmar po 'od 'bar ba/ /'khor ba skye med dbyings su sgrol/ /mtshan ldan thod par zhu ba la/ /nyon mongs 'joms pa'i rak+ta ra gyur/ /mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ yig mthing kha 'od 'bar ba/ /bde chen thugs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /mtshan ldan thod par zhu ba las/ /'dod yon mi zad gtor mar gyur/ /ā+oṃ ā a hā ba kla ta te dzo ba kla ta ba la pā te gu tho sa ma ya hūṃ swāhā/ /gyi yig 'od lnga rab gsal ba/ /las rnams kun byed nam mkha' mdzod/ /mtshan ldan thod par zhu ba las/ /phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab/ /a nas/ shasta pā dza me gha ā+oṃ āḥlha/ rū pa nas/ spar+sha pā dza me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥ// mahā me sa rak+ta rka ni ri ti bo dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu tho pā dza hoḥting 'dzin rnam gsum gzhal yas khang / /lha skyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag /mchod bstod bzlas pa'i rim pa rnams/ /nyams len dngos gzhi'i bya bar nges/ /dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum ni/—60

g.yu thog snying thig gi la byang dpag bsam ljon shing / nang ma 9)hūṃ/ chos rnams mi dmigs spros dang bral/ /skye med stong gsal nam mkha' che/ /ā+oṃ mahā shā n+ya tā dzñā na su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ de ltar ma rto gos sems can la/ /mi zad snying rje kun khyab bsgom/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi/ /ngang nas 'gro don bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer gyur/ /gnyis pa gzhal yas khang ni/ /de las e 'phros nam mkha' cher/ /yaṃ 'phros rlud gi dkyil 'khor te/ /raṃ 'phros rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'brug // las zhing chen sa gzhi gdal/ /ke las rus pa'i ri rab steng / /(4ba)re las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar/ /de dbus sna tshogs: 'phros te/ /yongs gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang / /khyams sgo rta babs mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /gsum pa lha skyed pa ni/ de dbusapad sdong 'dab ma bzhi/ /zla nyi bdud bzhi'i ro gdan steng / /saḥ ma ha ri ni sa rnams/ /dbus dang 'dab bzhi so sor gsal/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod/ /sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /tshur 'dus rdo rje gri gug gyur/ /de nyid gnas gyur dran rdzogs su/ /rta mchog dbang chen sku mdog dmar/ /dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsher/ /dbang sdud gri gug phyag g.yas 'phyar/ /mā ra'i khrag bkang thod pa g.yon/ /bdud bzhi'i steng na brkyang bskum 'gying / /rdo rje phag mos mgul nas mkhyud/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil bzhugs/ /phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar rdo rje dang / /rin chen pad+ma 'phrin las kyi/ /mkha' 'gro mthing ser dmar ljang mdog /rus pa'i rgyan spras gri thod 'dzin/ /brkyang bskum gar stabs tshul gyis 'gyeng / /spyi gtsug pad sdong 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa rdo rje thod pa g.yon/ /gcer bu rin chen rus rgyan spras/ /khro 'grum 'gying bag skyil krung gi /pang du rang rigs gsang ba'i yum/ /rab mdzes gri thod 'dzin pas mkhyud/ /phyogasabazhir rig pa'i ye shes kyi/ /ngo bo dkar ser dmar ljang mdog /rnam snang rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ /don grub rnam bzhi yum dang sbyor/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /rgya gram rab 'dzin cha lugs rnams/ /gtso bo ji bzhin bzhugs pa' mthar/ /yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams/ /sprin —61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shephung 'khrigs pa lta bur gyur/ /bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ /(ldan stu gyi chos dbyings spros bral ngang nyid las/ /rigs 'dus bla ma sku bzhengs shig /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ e ༅ hi/ lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus pa'i/ /gsang chen dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /dbyer med chu la chu bzhag bzhin/ /dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ hrī: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /kun 'dus bla ma sman rgyal gyi/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ /lusang ga yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /na mo a ti lu 'a pra ti dza sngo bdun pa mar pa 'bul ba ni/ me rtag bdug spos mar me dri dang bgos/ /rol mo la sogs yid 'ong phyir mar pa/ /dbang po lnga dang bsur wo tso r+ṣa me/ /dri wo dri chu thod rnga rkang gling sgra/ /dug gsum sku gsum dug lnga ye shes lnga/ /snang srid 'khor 'das bde chen klong du ma rdzo/ /a: nas/ shasta'i bar brjod de phyi nang gi ma rdzo pa dbul lo/ /thabs shes zla gsang thig le las/ /dkar dmar bde chen ye shes rdzas/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /gnyisamed ngang du 'bul gyi bzhes/ /bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu tho pā dza ho zhes gsang mchod dbul lo/ /hūṃ rtsa ba yan lag stong sbyar sman/ /dug lnga ye shes lngar gyur pa/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs mchod pa 'bul/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a khru ta hūṃ hrī:tha/ rgyal ba sman bla rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /dpal ldan phreng ba rje btsun g.yu thog zhabs/ /ye shes gzungs dang dpal ldan gzhen nu la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su (5ba)gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a khra ta hūṃ hrī:tha/ sangs rgyas rin chen rin chen rdo rje dang / /don grub rgyal mtshan dkon mchog skyabs kyi phul/ /rin chen bsod dbang rnal 'byor chen po la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta hūṃ khyoḥtha/ ri khrod zhig po zur mkhar mnyam nyid rje/ /dkon mchog pa dang nam mkha' dpal ldan zhabs/ /mnga' ris rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su —62

g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / nang ma rtogegasol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrī:tha/ bkra shis stobs rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i dpal/ /gsang chen chos kyi mdzod 'dzin ā nan+da/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta hūm̐ gyi tha/ kun 'dug rigs lnga rta phag yab yum dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho tshogs/ /sman gyi drang srong lha mor bcas pa la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta hūṃ hrī:tha/ zhes bdud rtsi sman mchod dbul lo/ /hrīḥ'akhor 'das phyi nang gsang ba shes bya dang / shes byed las 'das dam tshig rdo rje che/ /thabs shes mtheb srin phyag rgyas cho ga bzhin/ /myangs pas dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /kā ya wa ka tsit+ta sirnyi ā+oṃ āḥlha/ zhes dngos grub blang / hūṃ/ ༷ mtshan ldan 'bar ba'i snod/ /bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i snying khrag bcud/ /rnam rtog 'khor ba dbyings sgrol phyir/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod/ /mahā rak+ta sogs brjod de rak+ta dbul lo/ /hūṃ/ snod bcud gtor mar lhun gyis grub/ /gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs/ /'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan pa/ /bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha badz+ra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa (6na)sirnyi ā+oṃ āḥlha swāhā/ thu lo paṃ rgya snya/ hrīḥmaḥha ri ni sa tsit+ta hring hring / sa pa ri wā ra da ma ba smra ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra7) dam ba li ta kha kha/khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtore ma dbul lo/ /hūṃ/ skye ba med la thams cad skye/ /skyes tsam nyid la skye ba dran/ /'du 'bral med pa rdo rje'i glu/ /nyams dbyangs rang grol ye shes mchod/ /ā+oṃ te te hūṃ/ te na hūṃ/te phu byu ra ṇa sam ye hūṃ ho zhes rdo rje'i glus ma rdzo do/ /brgyad pa bstod pa ni/ hūṃ sgyi chos dbyingasabade chen kun gsal yangs pa'i ngos/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rta ljang dbang po yis/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'dab brgya bzhad mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa gsum rigs 'dus lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen lang tsho be+e ḍūr mthing kha dang / /lhan cig 'khyil ba'i bzhin lag mtshan dpe'i 'ja'/ /khro 'dzum 'gying bag rol ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam shes sgrib bral chos dbyings rta ljang can/ /in+d+ra ni lar 'gran bzod rdo rje'i rigs/ /zhe sdang kun+da zum byed mi —63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebaskyod pa/ /dkyil 'khor khyab bdag rigs kyi bdag po 'dud/ /gzugs phung rnyog bral rab dngasame long chu/ /zla shel zhun mar 'khru ba'i sangs rgyas rigs/ /gti mug mun pa drungs 'byin rnam snang mdzad/ /sku yi rig pa'i ye shes la phya ga 'tshal/ /tshor phung yongs dag mnyam nyid tsan dan shing / /gser sbyangs gtso mar 'gran bzod rin chen rigs/ /nga rgyal tsha gdung drungs skrun rin 'byung ldan/ /yon tan rig pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal/ /'du shes rnam dag sor rtog zil dngar bcud/ /byu ru'i lhun po'i rjes 'gro pad+ma'i rigs/ /'dod chags nad kun sel ba'i 'od (6brko pag med/ /gsung gi rig pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal/ /'du byed dag pa bya grub yid bzhin nor/ /mar gad gsar pa'i dpal 'dzin las kyi rigs/ /phrag dog dbul ba sel ba'i don yod grub/ /phrin lasarig pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal/ /gdod nas dbyer med chu nang zla gzugs ltar/ /mdzes sdug lha mor shar ba'i yum chen lnga/ /sked phra nu 'bur 'a rgyas pa' 'jo sgeg gis/ /zag med bde chen rgyas par mdzad la bstod/ /brtse chen snying rje'i chu gter ma zhabrugs kyang / /drag po'i 'phrin las yol med rlabs phreng can/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol ba'i he ru ka /dbang chen rta phag yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /dkyil 'khor khyab bdag dbang po'i gsang gsum gyi/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i rol gar grangs med las/ /legs grub rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro zhi khro'i lha/ /chos srung drang srong tsho gos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgu pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /sku gsung thugs la sngags phreng dkar dmar mthing / /'od zer dpag med 'phros pas sangs rgyas rnams/ /mchod pas mnyes shing byin rlabs ma lus bsdus/ /sems can sgrib sbyangs rtsa gsum go 'phang bkod/ /snod bcud gzhal yas lha dang lha mor gyur/ /mig gi snang ba mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sku/ /rtsa bar thos pa ma lus grags stong gsung / /yid ngor shar kun gsal stong rig pa'i gshis/ /blo 'das brjod med gnyug ma'i klong du gyur/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha badz+ra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi hūm̐/ ā+oṃ ā:lha swāhā/sum̐ le paṃ phyo snya/ hrīḥmaḥha ri ni sa tsit+ta hring hring / sa ma ya dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ sarba sirnyi hūṃ āḥ zhes —64—

g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / nang ma (nge)gtso 'khor thams cad dril ba'i sngags ring 'di la rgyun gyi bzlas pa bya'o/ /hūṃ khyoḥ skye med dbyings las 'gag (7na thad rtsal shar ba/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro 'dul rtsa gsum lha/ /rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren gnyis med bzhugs/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig bshags bstod cing bskul/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bzlas brjod ting 'dzin bsgom/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi zhing 'dod dgu rgyas/ /rang snang dbang bsdus log rtog dgra bgegs thul/ /mchog thun dngos grub dus 'dir myur stsol mdzad/ ces 'dzab bstod bya'o/ /tsho gos mchod byin brlab spyan 'dren 'bul/ /bshagasabasgral bka' srung mchod cing rol/ /lhag ma dngos grub ho mdo skyong / /rta brogato rag bzod gsol bsdu/ /bsngo smon bcu bdun mjug gi rim/ /dang bo ni/ hūṃ gyi rang wo ltar gsal thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /raṃ yaṃ kho 'phros tshogs rdzas bsregs sbyangs bkrus/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha gis ye shes bdud rtsir gyur/ /'dod yon lha mo mchod rdzas sprin phung gtibs/ /mahā ga ṇa tsakra sarba pha la ho: gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ gyi rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams/ /thugs dam thugs rjes brtser dgongs la/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes slad du/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sa ma ya dzaḥgasum pa 'bul ba ni/ ngo bo zag med bdud rtsi la/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa'i/ /tsho gos kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /brtse bas bzhes la dngos grub stsol/ /ga ṇa tsakra sarba pā dza ho/ bzhi pa bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu/ /gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ma lus dang / /khyad par sman gzhud las gsungs dam bca' las/ /'gal 'khrul nongs pa ma lus mthol lo bshags/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod/ lnga pa bsgral mchod ni/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs sngags dang (7ba)phyag rgya dang / /ting 'dzin mthu yis log 'dren dgra bgegs kun/ /thar med gru gsum lcags khang 'bar ba'i nang / /dmigs rten gzugs kyi nya bo 'di la khrug /hūṃ/ khro rgyal rta mgrin khrag 'thung he ru ka /'jigs rung zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin/ /sku smad gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur bu yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la mā ra yā/ /zhes bsgral/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag —65—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherus pa rnams/ /ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin brlabs nas/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'bor 'khor lo'i tshogs la dbul/ /bzhes nas 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod/ /ces btab pa bya/ drug pa chos srung mchod pa ni/ rgyas pa rdo rje 'chang ā nan+da sa mdzad pa'i dam skong dregs pa tshar gcod bya zhing /bsdu na 'di ltar/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i tshogs/ /mthu stobs gcig bsdus pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /dbyer med rje btsun ma hā gu ṇa yis/ /thugs rje'i mthu dpung dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /chos dbyings spros bral bde ba chen po las/ /gnyis med gnyis su rol ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /bstan srung dbang po dam can sde dgu'i tshogs/ /gnas 'dir thogs pa med par da tshur spyon//'jigs rung dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas dbus/ /dgra bgegs khrag zhag 'khyil ba'i chos 'byung nang / /pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs gdan steng du/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje rje btsun g.yu thog zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bskos dam bsgrags pa/ /dran par mdzod la rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /bka' srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du/ /me tog bdug spos snang gsal mar (8na)me dang / /dri chab zhal zas rol mo rta g.yag lug /bya khyi go mtshon sku gsung thugs rten rdzas/ /'bod pa'i g.yab dar drag po sgrub pa'i rdzas/ /sku mkhar pad+ma nyi zla mda' dar dang / /dmar chen gtor ma bdud rtsi rak+ta sogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /srin po'i gzugs can dar nag 'jol ber gsol/ /gri gug thod 'dzin beng chen rked la btsugs/ /mi mgo'i phreng brgyan rta nag rting dkar chibs/ /gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul khyod la bstod/ /srin mo mthing nag dre'u ga pa zhon/ /mtshon dru nad rkyal rab btags gri thod 'dzin/ /spyi bor zla tshes lte bar nyi mas brgyan/ /sngags srung e ka dza ti khyod la bstod/ /srin po dbu dgu bya rog mgo bos brgyan/ /phyag gnyis sprul zhags rwa yi mda' gzhu bsnams/ /lus po mig dang sku smad sprul mjug 'khyil/ /gza' bdud khyab 'jug nag po khyod la bstod/ /lce spyang gdong can phyag bzhi gri thod dang / /dgra zor rgyu —66

g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / nang ma khra/zhags mi mgo 'phyar zhing 'dzin/ /dur bya mgo dgu la zhon dur khrod bdag /mkha' 'gro lce spyang mchu dmar khyod la bstod/ /stag gi gdong can zangs gri rgyu zhags thogs/ /snying gi phreng bas lus brgyan g.yu 'byug zhen/ /stong gsum skad cig nyul ba'i mthu stobs can/ /gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po khyod la bstod/ /srin po 'jigs rung g.yas pa spu gri dang / /g.yon pa slo snying thogs shing mgo phreng brgyan/ /dang nag 'jol ber rab gsol seng ge zhen/ /dam can srog gi spu gri khyod la bstod/ /srin zhal spyi bor spyang gdong mche ring can/ /ral gri rtse gsum rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'dzin/ /mi lpags gos gyon rol bas mgo dgu zhon/ /srin po dgra dur 'jigs byed khyod la bstod/ /srin mo bya rog mgo can khrag ral sprug /g.yas (8ba)pa rgyu zhags dgra sta g.yon pa na/ /tsit+ta bsnams shing lcags spyang mgo dgu zhon/ /bdud mo shan ting ro zan khyod la bstod/ /srin zhal spyi bor bya khra'i mgo bo can/ /phyag bzhi mdung dang dug rkyal mi mgo rlon/ /phur pa bsnams shing dred mo mgo dgu 'on/ /srog bdag hab se nag po khyod la bstod/ /bka' srung sde dgu 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bstan dang rnal 'byor la 'tshe dgra dang bgegs/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar gnas kyang / /tshe srog mnga' thang mas la thal bar rlog /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /khyad par rje btsun ma hā gu ṇa yi/ /snyan brgyud snying thig nges don ring lugs dang / /gso rig gtsug lag 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang / /dpal 'byor snyan grags chos srid yon tan kun/ /bsams pa tsam gyis yid bzhin 'grub pa yi/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs/ /mdor na 'chi med grub pa pad+ma 'byung / /dbyer med 'gro mgon ma hā gu ṇa yi/ /dam tshig gnyan po dgongs la 'gal rkyen kun/ /zhi zhing mthun rkyen ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /bdun pa tshogs la longs spyad pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes/ ho/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /snang srid 'khor 'das ro mnyam pas/ /gsang chen bde ba'i longs spyod che/ /the tshom spangs te bzhes par mdzod/ /ga ṇa tsakra mahā pā dza sngo zhes tshogs phud bteg la 'dren/ slob dpon gyis/—67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she.e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /'dod yon ma smad rol pa che/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus par/ /gnyis med dgyes skyed 'di la spyod/ /a la la ho zhes blangs te rol lo/ /brgyad pa lhag ma gtang ba ni/ gas 'dus bla ma rgyal ba yi/ /bka' dang bstan pa srung byed cing / /lhag la dbang ba'i tsho gis rnams(9na〉kun/ /lhag mchod 'di bzhes tshon las sgrubs/ /u tsiṭa ba li ta bhak+ṣa giswāhā/ dgu pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ gtor ma gnas gsum du gtugs la/ hūṃ ho: bde chen klong yangs rgyal po'i zhing khams nas/ /bla ma sman rgyal rigs 'dus thugs dam can/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las byin chen po/ /dngos grub ma lus dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ ā:lha sarba sidhi pha la ho: bcu pa chad mdo ni/ mtsho skyes rdo rje rje btsun g.yu thog pa'i/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ /gsang chen sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin mched rnams kyis/ /gtor ma len zhing rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring / /bar chad sel zhing dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod/ khyud bzhi'i bshad nyan 'phrin las spel ba sogs/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar/ /gtong ma 'di long bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/bcu gcig pa bstan ma bskyang ba ni/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis po/ /sngon gyi dam bca' gnyan po nyer dgongs la/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las rnams thogs med sgrubs/ /bcu gnyis pa rta bro ni/ dpal chen khros pa'i rdo rje'i bro/ /dgra bgegs snying la chems se chems/ /dam sri 'byung po ma lus pa'i/ /lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya/ /bcu gsum pa gtang rag ni/ rigs 'dus bla ma dkyil 'khor lha/ /bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol/ /bcu bzhi pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ /rigs 'dus bla ma rgyal ba'i sku/ /brtse chen tshad med thugs rjes dgongs/ /bdag cag byis pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /lhag chad nor zhabrul bzod par bzhes/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni kā ya wa ka tsit+ta sa ma (9bsgo a a a/ bco lnga pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa kun/ /gnyis med chos kyi dbyings su 'ja' —68

g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / nang ma rtogeltar yal/ /mgron rnams rten la bzhugs shing gshegs pa rnams/ /slar yang brtse bas gnas 'dir 'byon par mdzad/ /sarba bud+dhā la maṇ+ḍal swa bhā wa ad+ma ko3lha/ bcu drug pa smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /sman rgyal gdod ma'i mgon po kun du bzang / /rang rig gsal stong gnyug ma lhan cig skyes/ /tshe 'di nyid la mngon du 'gyur bar shog / bcu bdun pa shisabarjod ni/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha/ /sman gyi bstan srung mkha' 'gro drang srong tshogs/ /phun tshogs rnam par dge ba'i bkra shis kyis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab par shog /rje btsun gu ṇa'i thugs bcud chu 'dzin cher/ /yang zab snying thig 'phrin las dbyar gyi rnga/ /tshig nyung don 'dus dbyangs su bsgrags pa na/ /skal bzang rma bya'i dga' ston ci yang 'phel/ /tha snyad rtog ger zhen pa'i dha dhu ras/ /myos pas theg mchog snying po'i gangs ri la/ /log rtog sngon por zhakhrul ba'i mkhas rlom rnams/ /zab don 'di 'dra lta ba'i skal bas dben/ /blo ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar 'khrid lam/ /'tshams med las kyang 'dag nus nges gsang chos/ /'gro mgon gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud gdams pa 'di/ /sum ston rgyud 'dzin las 'ongs kho bos thos/ /rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal g.yu thog rje/ /rje btsun sum ston rnam 'phrul dbang po'i sde/ /sdebacas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin kun dga'i dpal/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang de'i gsung gi bcud/ /bcud ldan 'chi med rnams kyi bdud rtsi gang / /gang zhig sangs rgyas sar 'khrid nus ldan tshe/ /tshe gcig (10na tshe/na mkhyen sgrub pa'i zab mo'i theg /theg mchog 'di yi dpe zlar 'os sam snyam/ /dge tshogs chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /nyes lhung mun pa'i smag rum drungs phyung nas/ /dngos grub rab dkar snang ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /skye dgu'i snying gi kun+da bzhad gyur cig /ces rje btsun g.yu thog pa'i snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing 'di ni gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag la blo gros kyi snang ba mchog tu rgyas pa'i bla sman byang ngos pa blo bzang gzhan phan dbang pos bskul ba la brten nas rdo rje 'dzin pa a nan+da sa mdzad pa'i las gzhung dngos grub kun 'byung la gzhi byas/—69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesnying thig phyi sgrub nas kha cung zad bkang zhing / tshig sbyor mang ba rnams nyud ngur bsdus/ mi bde ba'i tshig rnams kun gsar du bcos la/ phal cher gzhung dngos nyid byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba'i phyir rang sor bzhag ste/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs dam pa du ma'i bka' drin gyis gsang sngags gsar rnying thams cad kyi so so'i rang lugs rnams ma 'dres par khong du chud pa'i za tor gyi rigs las a wa dhū tī pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos kun 'dzin gyi lo dbyu gu zla ba'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la dag ri ldan pho brang du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅga lo/

thug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma 'dathug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston bzhugs so/ /las nyon des bskyed bcas la zhe sdang ba'i/ /dmar zlum lta stangs tsam gyis dgra sde'i snying / /zos pas ma tshim stong gsum yongs myul ba'i/ /dpal mgon che chung las mkhan 'khor tshogs kyi/ /mchod gtor rten sogs ma tshang ba med pa 'du bgyis/ brag rdzong ma'i lha'i rnal 'byor lta bu sngon du song nas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ gtor ma mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥ& zhu ba las byung ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ 'i rus pa phung po/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod cing / oṃ āḥ& ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgyar bcas pa ci mang brjod/ru mtshon a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mgon po pho rkyang / mo rkyang /lcam dral/ lha brgyad la sogs pa skabs su gang bab kyi dam tshig par bskyed/ de rnams kyi mdun dur khrod kyi sa gzhin/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su/ bdud rta bra nag pahrūl gyi shugs dang (2na skon pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng du/ ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po mun pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bdud kyi khram shing rtse mo gsum pa'i mgul na dar nag gi ba dan dang / mi mgo'i lan tshar 'phyang ba dgu la brten pa/g.yon pas mi snying rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa dug sbrul nag po'i zhags pa dang bcas pa zhal du 'jib cing phyir sprug pa/ lcags kyi ral pa nag po drag tu sprug cing gsig pa/ lcags kyi mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs nas ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ sku stod la ber nag gi ber zhol gsol zhing / sku smad gcer bu la dug sbrul mang po lang long du dkris pa/ skad cig nyid la stong gsum yud kyis bskor cing / dgra bgegs kyi srog dbugs sdud pa'i drag shul can/ de'i g.yon phyogs su ma bdud spu gri'i —71 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemached mo srin mo khros pa'i gzugs can gcer mo rgyan med rkang pa gsum bgrad stabs kyis gnas pa/ phyag gnyis kyis me dpung 'bar ba 'dzin cing kha nas me 'bar zhing gdong phyir phyogs pa/ yab yum gnyis ga'ang me rlung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par (2ba thas ma/ de rjes gtso 'khor rnams kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug dam la bzhes pa/mchod gtor 'bul ba rnams dkyus bzhin la/ khyad par bran bdud kyi skabs su lho phyogs ri rab kyi khong gseng nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa dang / mahā kā la lak+ṣa mud tsa kro dha ya ma rā dza hūṃ bh+yo: ma ri ma sha mud dza ya bh+yoḥsarba bi na sha snye mā ra ya i dam ba kla ta kha kha khā hi 'a hi/ zhes pas gtor ma 'bul/gdong bzhi pa lcam dral sogs chos skyong gzhan gyi thug yod na'ang / 'di bzhin du rang rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ nag po chen po lcam dral gyis gtso mdzad pa'i dam can srung ma'i tsho gos dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas phyogs bcu'i gnas rnams nas byon/ mdun gyi nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab par bzhugs par bsams la/ dar nag 'phyar/ rol mo rnams kyi sgra sgrog gu gul dang sha chen tshil chen gyi dud pa sbyar/ dam tshig gi rdo rje dar nag gi g.yab dar dang bcas pas g.yob cing / mi rkang dang bshug pa'i sgras 'bod/rnal 'byor ba ting nge 'dzin brtan po dang ldan pas/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dad pa dang / /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs(3na)bdag gi 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃ bh+yoḥ lha chen mahā kā la dang / /e ka dzā sa re ma tī/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra gnyi me/ /sring mor bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /sgo ma bzhi dang ru 'dren bzhi/ /pho nya dgu dang gaṇ+ḍi'i dmag /dur
