khrod bdag po phyogs skyong bcu/ /sdebargyad dregs pa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /hūṃ bh+yoḥ zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug dang / /yum chen bzhi dang —72

thug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma rtogepho nya'i tshogs/ /che btsan drag po mthu bo che/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /glog ltar 'gyug pas 'dir gshegs shig /'brug ltar grag pas 'dir gshegs shig /thog ltar 'dril bas 'dir gshegs shig /hūṃ/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga rtswa /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas 'di sa /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /hūṃ/ dam can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ /byin rlabs yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde chen rol pa'i gzhal yas khang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /hūṃ/ sbyar ba'i spos dang g.yab pa'i dar/ /rnga chen sgra dang dung chen gling / /rnal 'byor drag po'i ngar skad kyis/ /spyan 'dren ma thogs myur du spyon/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur cig /ces yid ma yengs par spyan drangs la/ /bsnyen sngags rnamasakyi mjug tu/ e rkye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing drag rol yun ring du bya/ de nas so so'i sngags kyi mjug tu (3ba)lha sno rda/ a: bras smo ye swāhā/ nas sha lta'i bar gyi phyi mchod dang / sngagasakyi mjug tu 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ /ru mtshon la rdo rje gzungs thag dang dar thag btags pa'i sne nas rnal 'byor pa bzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pas bzung dpon slob rnams mgrin gcig tu mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bod rbad bsad gsum brgya rtsa'am/ nyer gcig tsam re 'ur 'don bya/ de'i tshe rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ /mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku la phog pas/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i pho nya las mkhan nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi dgra bgegasalog 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor bcas kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus/ mdun bskyed rnams la thim pas gzi brjid nus pa blta bar mi bzod pa khams gsum thams cad 'dar khril li li yod par bsam/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gam gnyis gsum tsam gyis gzungs thag sogs nas bzung / 'og gi skul byed kyi bar/ shā sa na'i sngags rgyun ma chad par bzung / gzhan rnams kyis—73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegasol kha byas te/ de yang sngar gyi stegs bu'i kha'i gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su sha dmar po dum bu dgu dang / chang phud gtsang ma bzhag /g.yon du phye mar dang khrag chab bzhag /mdun du las kyi rdo rje zhig gis lcags snod gtsang ma'i nang du g.yas nas sha re/ g.yon nas phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug /gsol kha tshar re la de 'dra lan gsum re gtor chen la bstab cing / g.yas g.yon nas khrag chang (4na)kyang thigs re sdugs/ /rnal 'byor ba gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i bye brag kun thogs nas/ mdun gyi gtor rdzas dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen po stong gsum thams cad khyab par bsam/ de rnams mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal dmar gnam sa tsam gdangs pa'i nang du sib kyis bstab pas hab thob tu bzhes nas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes/ bdag gis ci bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub par bsams la/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūṃ/ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan nag po che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal can/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnam sa la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan nag po lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa dam par 'bul/ /dgyes pa'i sems kyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs dam 'phrin las nyer dgongs la/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams ma lus zhi ba dang / /'dod don mthun pa'i rkyen rnams ma lus 'grub pa dang / /thub pa'i bstan pa mtha' dag rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'dur dbyangs bya zhing / /hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po/ /rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ /lha srung yongs (4ba)kyi ded dpon/ /dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ /rigs 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / /rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra/ /dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ /bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ /mahā de ba'i sras mchog /lha chen dpal —74

thug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma (pe'abar/ 'jigs byed chen po/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ /mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi bdud po khyed kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi 'a hi/ zhes brjod cing /mgon po'i gtor sngags shā sa na lan gsum rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha dang po bltab/ yang sngar bzhin bshams la/ gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen mo/ 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dur khrod kyi bdag mo/ bdud kyi yum chen/ nad do cog gi bdag mo/ 'khor gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro/dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpung nyi khri tshig stong / /lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong dur khrod kyi bdag po/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sdebargyad/ bka' nyan gyi gnod sbyin yab yum/ las mkhan mon pa ming sring / mdun gyi bshul 'dren/g.yas g.yon gyi ru 'dren/ rgyab kyi rjes myul/ mkha' lding / bya nag /khyi nag /lcags spyang sngon 'gro/mi nag po 'o dod can/ sprul pa khro bo'i tshogs/ /bdud nag po gshin rje'i tshogs/ /gdong bas gyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi 'a hi/ mchod pa dam par 'bul zhing gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /rol chen dang / lha mo las(5na〉gon rnams kyi bod rbad bsad gsum bzla zhing / gsol kha gnyis pa bstab/ yang bshams la/ ho/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la nye bar dgongs te/ khyed rnams kyis dgyes shing mos pa'i thabs kyis bskyed la/rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa/ gdon bgegs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu skyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrubs dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du sdud/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog cig /g.yin yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyags chad kyi ma dang / blo lhag gi pha mdzod/ rgyab kyi slog pa mdzod/ mdun gyi 'khor ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slong / chad na 'thud cig /ral na tshems shig /stor na 'tshol la/ brjed na skul cig mgo gang —73—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegis yar la stod cig /dkyus gang gis mar la srings shig /g.yin yang legs pa brgya dang sprod la/nyes pa stong dang sdol cig /bsams pa yid bzhin du sgrubs la re ba rgya mtsho lta bur skongs shig /mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ /mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig /gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan la brtan par bzhugs te/ dgra dpung bshig la/bgegs dpung thams cad choms shig /dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor (5bcug /sangs rgyasakyi bstan pa srungs shig /dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang chen po stod cig /gzhan yang sgo la dar 'phyor la/ khrom du dung bus shig /gtam ngan rgyun chod la snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig /dam chosami nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la phyor la/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang byang chub sgrub pa'i mgon grogs mdzod cig /skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang rten dang gling mdzod cig /bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig /ces 'khor bcas dril ba'i sngags rnams rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gsum pa bstab/ slar yang de 'dra tshang ma tshar gnyis te yongs dril tshar gsum rdzogs pa dang / de dag gi lhag ma lus par rnams kyang bstab/gdong bzhi pa'i ru mtshon yod na gsol kha rgyas par 'di nyid kyi gtor chen gyi gsol kha las 'byung ba ltar bya/ mdor bsdu na 'di'i gsol kha gnyis la lha mo dang las mkhan gyi gsol kha'i mjug tu/sngo dpal ldan nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi srog shing / rnal 'byor rnams kyi dgra lha/ bdud 'dul sngagasakyi dbang phyug /srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgran bcu'i grong khyer lo ka pu ri gtan nas rlag par byed pa/lha ma yin gyi bu mo nam mkha'i glog 'phreng can rdul du rlog pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa/ yum las kyi gnod sbyin ma bzhi la/ g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu /mdun du srin mo nag (6na)mo/ rgyab tu siṅga li ma ser mo/ 'khor gnod sbyin dang srin po/ sha za/ zhing skyong dang bcas pa/ srog gi sgo bdud nag po/ las kyi bshan pa nyi shu rtsa —76

thug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma rtogegacig /skye 'gro'i bdud gcod/ dam nyams kyi srog len/ chos 'khor gyi srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam par 'bul lo/ /zhes dang / de rjes/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang zhes sogs brjod cing / beg tse la dbang ldan ma dang gong gi rdo rje 'dzin pa bldab/ de ltar gsol kha'i rdzas rnams kyang tshan re la tshan pa bzhi bzhi bstab par bya'o/ /de nasamanga' gsol zhing dbangs bstod rgyas par bya ba ni/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūṃ/ dpal chen thugs kyi pho nya mchog /lha chen mgon po nag po la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas mnga' gsol bas/ /dngos grub stsol zhing lam mchog ston/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis mnga' gsol bas/ /slu med thar pa'i lam sna 'dren/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos mnga' gsol bas/ /bar chad sel zhing sgrub po skyong / /dpa' bo dpa' mos mnga' gsol bas/ /dam tshig ldan pa bsrung zhing skyong / /dam can yongs kyisamanga' gsol bas/ /bstan pa'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /pho nya'i tshogs kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /myur mgyogs rno ba'i stobs dang ldan/ /bran gyi tsho gos kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /lha chen rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan cha can/ /klu chen rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /sbrul chen 'jigs pa'i chun pos dkris/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis mnga' gsol (6ba thas/ /dar gos 'jol ber lhab lhub can/ /ma mo rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /rims nad dal yams dgra la 'bebs/ /gza' chen rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /drag po'i gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs/ /bdud chen rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /dgra bo'i srog gcod myur du brtson/ /gshin rje rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ khams gsum 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /phyogs skyong rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /phyogs bcur dbang zhing 'phrin lasamadzod/ /dpal mgon bdun cus mnga' gsol bas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs/ /srung ma drug cu rtsa bzhis mnga' gsol bas/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i bar chad bsrung / /chos kyi dbyings kyisamanga' gsol bas/ /mi 'gyur nam mkha'i mdangs dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas rigs lngas mnga' gsol —77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebs/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la mdzes/ /rgyal ba drug gis mnga' gsol bas/ /rus pa'i rgyan chen drug gis mdzes/ /dregs pa yongs kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /dpal gyi chas chen brgyad kyisabargyan/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed mnga' gsol bas/ /mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /chos sgra chen pos mnga' gsol bas/ /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍa phyag dbus bsnams/ /dregs pa sde brgyad yongs kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /mthu dang rdo 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /srin po'i tsho gos kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog ga za'i tsho gos kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /dgra sha za zhing dgra srog gcod/ /rgyal chen bzhi yis mnga' gsol bas/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing 'jig rten skyong / khyu skar (7na〉tshogs kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /'jig rten sna tshogs las rnams byed/ /sa bdag gnyan gyis mnga' gsol bas/ /gdug pa'i nad kyis dgra bgegs 'joms/ /dkar po'i tshogs kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i bar chad sel/ /dbang chen rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud/ /nor lha rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /tshe dang 'byor pa 'khor rnams spel/ /khro chen rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /dgra bgegs log 'dren rlag par mdzad/ /gter bdag rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod char bzhin 'bebs/ /hūṃ/ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo che/ /lcam dral pho nyar bcas pa dang / /zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug dang / /che btsan drag po stag la zhen/ /phyag bzhi bya rog gdong can dang / /phyag drug beng dang legs ldan tshogs/ /dkar mo bdud rgyal trag shad dang / /ma ning gri gug zangs gyi can/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /gzi brjid chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /mthu rtsal chen por dbang bskur ro/ /drag shul chen por dpangs bstod do/ /thugs rje ldan par gsol 'debs so/ /'phrin las mdzad par bdag bskul lo/ /dgra bo sgrol bar dus 'debs so/ /hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyis bskor ba'i tshe/ /mahā de ba'i sras po mdzad/ /gnod sbyin 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /tshogs—78

thug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma 9)bdag brgyad kyis bskor (7ba)ba'i tshe/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo 'jig rten skyong / /nor lha 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /'jigs byed dgu yis bskor ba'i tshogs/ /drag po'i tshogs kyi gtso bo mdzad/ /'jigs byed 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /hūṃ/legs ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed/ /sdang dgra sgrol ba'i mthu bo che/ /dregs pa 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /bstan bsrung mgon po nag po khyod/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing ste/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra lha yin/ /srog gcod 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /hūṃ/ gsang ba chen po'i gnas mchag 'dir/ sha khrag gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /dza gad bdud rtsi rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /dri bsung ngad pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /'dod dgu sna tshogs char ltar 'bab/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /sngar bcol gtang rag 'di 'bul lo/ /da bcol zhu skyems 'di 'dren no/ /bzhes shig rol zhig dgongs par mdzod/ /mchod ni dam rdzasagator mas mchod/ /gsol ni spyan gzigs mchod pas gsol/ /rten ni ru mtshon rtags la brten/ /'bod ni dung chen gling bus 'bod/ /bskang ni mthun pa'i rdzas kyis bskang / /rbad do sdang byed dgra la rbad/ /bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul/ /phyos sod pa la bo dmag la phyos/ /bsten no mgon po rgyang ma ring / /bskur ro mgon po phrag ma lci/ /g.yab bo mgon po spyan ma brtul/ /'bod do mgon po snyan ma sra/ /gsol lo mgon po thugs ma ring / /gtong ngo mgon po rtsal ma zhan/ /dam (8na15na bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dam bcas zhal bzhes mdzad pa rnams/ /mthu dang ldan par mnga' gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs/ /mthu rtsal ldan par mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i dbu 'phang stod/ sha la sred par mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bo'i sha la habs se hab/ /khrag la rngam par mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bo'i khrag la hubs se hub/ /srog la dbang bar mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra srog da lta chod las shog /dmag dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /sdebargyad dmag dpung dgra la drangs/ /bstan srung chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan la gnod byed —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherdul du rlog /chos skyong r+ṣa por mnga' gsol lo/ /chos 'bor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /gsang sngags mthu dang nus pa bskyed/ /rnal 'byor dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /bcol ba'i las rnams myur bar sgrubs/ /zhi ba'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyas pa'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ /dbang gi las la mnga' gsol lo/ khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdus/ /drag po'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan la gnod cing sdang ba dang / /bla mar brnyas shing sems can 'tshe/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa yi/ /dgra bo dam nyams las ngan 'di/ /da lta bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /drag po'i mtshon cha char ltar phob/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs/ sha khrag rus la tsho gos su rol//don snying rnam lnga zhal du gsol/ /(8btan lag mgo chod rgyan du gyis/ /skyob pa'i lha dang myur du phye/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' ma bcag /bla ma brgyud pa 'i dam ma g.yel/ /rnal 'byor bdag ge ngag ma bcag /dus la bab bo srung ma'i tshogs/ khams gsum dgra bo'i srog dbugs la/ /dbang zhing rngam par mnga' gsol lo/ /zhes brjod/ de nas ba/zungs thag rnams bkrol/ /khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas/ mdun gyi srung ma rnams las pho nya las mkhan stong gsum khyab par 'phros/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med bsgrub cing / khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sha khrag rus pa rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drangs par bsams la/hūṃ/ dam can rgya mtsho mthu ma chung / /ma mo mkha' 'gro rtsal ma yin/ pho nya las mkhan bang ma bul /mgon po rgyab dpung ma zhan zhig /lha mo rdzu phral ma chung zhig /gnod sbyin las la ma g.yel zhig /pu tra dgra bo ma brjed cig /ru 'dren rngam pa ma chung zhig /pho nyas phyi bskol ma byed cig /sde brgyad rno ngar ma yin zhig /myur bar dmag la chas pa tshe/ /lha srin dmag gis bar snang khengs/ /dregs pa pho yis dmag tshogs de/ /g.yas dang 'gying zhing mtshon cha 'phen/ /dregs pa mo yis dmag tshogs de/ /g.yon nas 'dab cing khrag zor 'phen/ /sdo brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tsho gos de/ /phyogs nas—80

thug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma (gebaskor nas dgra yul 'joms/ /bud med nag mo gri thogs brgya/ /mdun nas rgyug cing dgra snying 'byin/ /skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ /g.yas(9na skos brngam zhing dgra sha za/ /nyan thos dgra bcom chen po brgya/ /g.yon nas 'dur zhing dgra khrag 'thung / /sngags pa nag po khros pa brgya/ /klad nas 'brang zhing dgra bo gsod/ /mon pa gar byed khyugs se khyug /mi nag bzhug glu kyur ru sa /las mkhan 'ur sgra chems se chem/ /pho nya 'dur rgyugs shar ra ra/ /bya nag lding 'khor lings6ling / /khyi nag 'khang zug chems se chem/ /lcags spyang 'dur sgra 'ur ru sa /khyung chen 'brug sgra ldir ri ri/ /dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung / /bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhan/ /bdag gi 'khor dang longs spyod dang / /dbang phyug ye shes rgyas par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ phas kya rbod gtong bzlog pa dang / /nad kha rimasakha dgra la bsgyur/ /phur kha zor kha dgra la sgyur/ /bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /ri rab rtse ltar mtho bar mdzod/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal bar mdzod/ /chu bo'i rgyun ltar ring bar mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /skye 'gro dar zhing bstan pa rgyas/ /yams nad mu ge mi 'byung zhing / /bkra shis phun sum tsho gis par mdzod/ /bran bdud bye brag tu bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ ri rab ri yi rtsa ba nas/ /las mgon chen po sku skyod cig /nam gyi gung dang nyin gung la/ /dam nyams dgra bo gsod cing spyon/ /'khor ni bdud mgon bdun brgya dang / /gza' bdud bdun brgya pho nyar bcas/ /dam las 'das pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su (9ba)gsol/ /mthun pa'i yo byad ji snyed rnams/ /tshogs bcas 'bul lo bstan pa'i las/ /bdag cag bsrung phyir 'dir bstan no/ /nag po'i bran phyir 'dir bstan no/ /bka' las ma 'da' 'dir bzhugs shig /dgos 'dod sgrub phyir 'dir bzhugs shig /ji srid ma gshegs bar dag tu/ /gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /gang bcol las rnams sgrub tu gsol/ /zhes lha mo dmag zor ma dung skyong lha mo bstan ma bcu gnyis nag po chen po 'chi bdag gshin rje bstan srung dam ༅ rgya mtsho/brjod/ de nas/ mgon po 'khor bcas 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ru mtshon —81 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegazi brjid nus pa phun sum tsho gis pa dang ldan pa/ phyar ba dang / phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ ces brjod/ de lta bu'i ru mtshon de nyid mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas sogs la rten du 'bul ba'i tshig 'di skad do/ hūṃ/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sdebazhi yi lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pa 'khor bcas dgongs/ /dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po che/ /e ka dzā smi 'dod khams ma/ /phyi nang las mgon zangs gri can/ /gnod sbyin nag po yab yum dang / /dam can pu tra ming sring gsum/ /pho nya ru 'dren gaṇ+ḍi'i dmag /bran bdud nag po lcam dral dang / /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud bcas/ /zhing skyong drag po gdong bzhi pa/ /las mdzad yum chen sring mo bzhi/ /sdebargyad bshan par bcas pa kun/ /dpal ldan dmag zor re ma tī/ /ma gcig dpal gyi lha mo (10na skong / /bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / /mgon po mahā kā la dang / /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje rnams/ /zab mo gter gyi srung ma sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /bdag la brtser dgongs rten la bzhugs/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i ro thang 'dir/ /kra/ ga mtsho 'khyil ba'i rba klong ljongs/ /dam nyams bam chen bskyel ba'i khrir/ /brtan par btsugs pa'i ru mtshon mdung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i srog shing rtser/ /rno dpal gri lcags mdung so la/ /dug khrag sngags rgod ngar dang ldan/ /lhab lhub 'bar ba'i me 'od 'phro/ /g.yag rgod rog po'i rnga yab kyi/ /zhol chen sprin nag lta bur gtibs/ /dar nag ba dan phan rtse gsum/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i 'phur lding g.yo/ /sku rten ro ras tsa ka li/ /gsung rten srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags/ /thugs rten gsal ba'i me long dang / /yon tan rten du nyer lnga'i rdzas/ /'phrin las rten du dar ras 'phan/ /bse lcags shing byang dam nyams kyi/ /mgo lag mgron bu'i lan tshar can/ /dril bu g.yer ka sil sil 'brol/ /phun tshogs rgyu las legs grub cing / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /thug chen 'bar ba drag po'i rten/ /rten mchog ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bzhugs pa'i pho brang chen por 'dzugs/ /byin —82

thug chog dbang drag rol pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma (perlabs thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /dngos grub char rgyun dus 'dir phob/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i gnas dang rten du 'dzugs/ /pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar/ /'brel med (10ba)'dus nas las kun sgrubs/ /dregs byed dmag dpung ru mtshon mchog /g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bstan dang rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /snang byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod kyi/ /srog shing tshe yi rten du 'dzugs/ /mi nor chos dang legs tsho gis kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing brtan par mdzod/ /de ltar ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /da bcol zhu ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bsam don 'grub pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /snang srid dregasabyed gzhi bdag rnams/ /ru mtshon 'di la brtan bzhugs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bstan pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe dang / /byang chub bar gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ mdun gyi bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams dang / snang srid kyi dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad mtsho la char babs pa bzhin du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan de nyid la thim par bsam zhing / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug khyed rnams ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang stod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ bstan pa dang rnal 'byor la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gi sum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig /ces lan gsum brjod cing / me tog gtor/ shisabarjod kyi (11na toshā ga skabs su gang bab brjod/ /'bras spungs gsang sngags pho brang gi rten thug btsugs skabs zin bris su za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa dza byu/ / /dpag dka' ma yan dkyus bca bzlas pa zhi ba zhi drag phyed ma drag khro gsum gyi sbyang ba/ mchod gtor byin rlabs slar yang bskyed chog nas bzung gtor 'bul gong ltar gzungs thag bcas pa bzla/sha can ma dang / de'i mjug tu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang sogs kyi gsol kha mnga' gsol gzungs thag —83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ (2she bgrol rjes bskul/de man gur ji lta ba/chos skyong gas rnams la mar gtor rnams byin sa dkyus ltar bya/thug rnam a mṛ tas bsangs/su gawa sbyangs/thug gi lha so sgom jo ni rtogs dang gsol khagang rigs kyi sgo nas bskyed cing spyan drangs/bzhugasagasol/mar pa ga sto las lha gyi bar bya/rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/dam ༅ mkha 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i gos dang sa pa mdun gyi na mo mkhar badz+ra mā dza spyan drangs/gdan 'bul/byu sto gal sa pa ri wā ra a nas sha sto bar gyi ma rdzo/nang mar 'bul/gzung thag dang sa chos skyong sgo so'i sngags rnams dmigs pa dang 4spobazla/hūṃ legasas mgon pon ga po khyod/ces pa nas dbang zhing rngam par mnga' gsol lo/zhes pa'i bar brjod nas mnga' gsol/gzungs thag 'grol/lha mo dmag zor ma dung skyong lha mo zhes pa man gong bsto no// //sarba maṅga lo/

tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi sgo na brtan bzhugs chog sgrigs lhan thabs dang bcas pa/ nang ma (petshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi sgo nas gzim chung brtan bzhugs kyi chog sgrigs dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la dgos pa'i lhan thabs bcas pa bzhugs thrergo/ /na maḥpad+mā ka rā ya/ ye shes 'od lnga dbang po'i gzhu ris gdangs/ /pad+ma thod phreng rigasalngar yongs shar bar/ /brten nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i cho ga yi/ /lag len brjed byang reg zig 'dri bar bya/ /de yang bla ma sde dpon sogs mchog dman gang la'ang dar lam gcod cing brtan bzhugs 'byer bde bya na/ stegs kyi khar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan gseb tu rgyasapar spro na tsakli gzungs thag /g.yas g.yon du tshe chang / tshe ril/ mda' dar/ gtor zlum dmar po gcig /las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / bgegs kyi gtor ma/ sman ra ka mchode pa/ logs shig tu mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i mchod gtor dar lam dang bcas pa phyag len ltar bsham/skyabs 'gro ni/ hūṃ/ rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i sku/ /'od gsal chen po'i dgongs pa can/ /thugasarje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad/ /bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /rang la ye (2na gis shar ba'i sku/ /mi 'bral rtse gcig dgongs pa can/ /byin gyis brlab cing bar chad sel/ /yi dam lha la / /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /brtse gdung byams pa'i dgongs pa can/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dngos grub ster/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la ཿ/ /lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrub bshags/ /'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad/ /don dam spros bral byang chub sems/ /rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ /lan gsum/ phyi rang nyid rta mgrin be con —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesdigs mdzub mdzad/ /thugs las sprul pa'i khro mtshon me dpung gis/ /tshe srog 'phrog pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po rnams/ /mthar bskrad rdo rje srung ba'i gur du gyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra tsakra dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ zlo (2ba3/ zhes bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor bsgom/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi byin dbab mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal yan 'chi med 'od snang ltar gyi mjug tu sangs rgyas mnga' bdag dang / dkyil 'khor chen po gnyis blangs la sngags bsgyur/ hrīḥ chos dbyings rnam dag pho brang nas/ /tshe dpag med mgon lha tshogs rnams/ /gnas mchog 'dir gshegs dbang chen bskur/ /byin dbab dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ā snyad na sam ya a be sha ya ā āḥ zhes byin dbab/ gyi 'chi med rigs 'dzin dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rdzas/ /phyi nad gsang ba'i rang byung mchod pa rnams/ /ma dag log 'khrul nyes pa'i nga rnams kun/ /ye shes 'bru gsum sbyang zhing byin gyis rlobs/ /raṃ yaṃ kho/oṃ āḥ& mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ khyu gra/ ma hā ba smra ta hūṃ/ ma hā rak+ta hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ji āḥ〉 nas sha lta āḥ& gi bar gyis tshe rdzas mchod gtor dang bcas pa byin gyis brlab/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ 'dzin med stong pa'i dbyings nyid las/ /chu las chu lhar brdol ba bzhin/ /pad+ma'i sdong po rgyas pa'i steng / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang bar/ /rang byung pad+ma tshe dpag med/ /dkar po longs spyod rdzogs sku chas/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang / /g.yon pa 'chi med tshe'i bum pa/ /'dzin pas yum gyi mgul nas 'khrud/ /pang du ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /snye ra ba gos dkar mo/ /dmar mo bcu drug lon pa'i tshul/ /nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rgyas/ /(3na gi yas pa pad+ma bdud rtsi yis/ /gang ba'i thod 'dzin yab la 'khril/ /gcer mo skra grol rnal 'byor ma'i/ /cha byad rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /gnyis ga'ang 'ja' 'od gur khyim dbus/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan pa'i/ /spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus/ /rigs 'dzin burnya thod phreng rtsal/ /dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyisapa/ /gsang gos snam sbyar mnyen zhu gsol/ /'khor lo bum 'dzin yum la 'khril/ /ma n+tar ba sangs —86

tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi sgo nas brtan bzhugs chog sgrigs lhan thabs dang bcas pa/ nang ma (pergyas spyan/ /'khor lo thod paḥ/ /mgrin pa longs spyod —/ /rigs 'dzin pad+ma:/ /dmar po / /gsang gosaḥ/ /pad+ma bum 'dzin / shwakya de wa gos dkar mo/ /pad+ma thod pa / /snying ga chos kyi / /rigs 'dzin rdo rjeḥ/ /sngon po —/ /gsang gosaḥ/ /rdo rje bum 'dzin / /ye shes 'tsho rgyal mā ma gi /rdo rje thod paḥ/ /lte ba sprul pa'i / /rigs 'dzin rat+naḥ/ /ser po jo/ /gsang gos:/ /rin cen bum 'dzin ཿ/ /kā la sirnyi rin cen sgrol/ /rin cen thod pa / /gsang gnas bde skyong 5/ /rigs 'dzin ga rma—/ /ljang gu ca/ /gsang gos ca/ /rgya gram bum 'dzin / /bkra shis khye 'dren dam tshig sgrol/ /rgya gram thod bca/ /yum rnams gcer mo skra grol ba/ /rus pa'i rgyan ldan lang tshor spras/ /mdzes sdug bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams/ /yab yum rdo rje pad+ma yi/ /skyil krung 'ja' 'od klong na bzhugs/ /spyan 'dren mchod bstod ni/ yiḥ rang bzhin rnam dag zhing khams nas/ /pad+ma thod phreng tshe dbang rtsal/ /'dir gshegs gnyis su med par bzhugs/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag (3ba/ri tshal zhing / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /sngags gsham du/ ji pā dza hūṃ nas shasta'i bar dang / snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med mgon dang / /pad+ma 'byung gnas mtshan ldan gzung ma lnga/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ā yudzñā na ma hā pañtsa ji hi/ ma hā ba kla ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ gyi dran pa tsam gyis 'chi bdag bdud/ /mthar mdzad pad 'byung tshe dpag med/ /e waṃ zung 'jug lnga tshogs la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /'dzab bzla ba ni/ tshe 'gugs gso dang bye brag gi dmigasapa rnams gzhung bzhin byas nas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ā yudzñā na sarba sirnyi ṇi zlo hūṃ dzaḥbadz+ra ā yu ṣe swā ༈zhes bzla/ tshe 'gugs ni/ bcom ldan mgon po sogs gsang rdzogs las byang bklags cho go ma nas blangs te mda' dar g.yab cing tshe 'gugs kyi dmigs pa bya/ ho/ nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo bzhi/ dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin mo bzhi/ dkar mo mdangs ldan ma'i bu mo sman btsun mo bzhi/ sngon tshe a su ra yi brag phug dben gnas su/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheganas dang / /bshes gnyen glang chen dpal gyi seng ge yis/ /zhing chen bskyel ba'i steng du bzhag nas kyang / /rdo rje lag gtad bdud rtsi lce yang bzhag /de tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar/ /tshur gshegs tshur spyon bod skyong bstan ma rnams/ /kun kyang lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /rol mo sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas te spyon/ /'dir gshegs dam skongs 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ma ma/ me me/ la la/ le le/ ta ta/ te te/rdo rje sring 'gro ma hūṃ bh+yoḥ mahā pañtsa a khra ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ mahā rak+ta kha raṃ ji hi/ mahā ba li ta kha raṃ khā hi/bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma sogs sbyar/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pasaganas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro sge lnga'i tsho gos zho badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma wā la ri gyisagadan dbul/ ā+oṃ pañtsa ḍā gi ni sa pa ri wā ra a lha//pā rdu/ puṅge du pe/ ā lo ke /garje/ ni li bye/shasta bra la swāhā zhes rigs lnga spyir mchod/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags/ lasaskyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ḍā zhi ni sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba kla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma dang / sngags mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod cing / mahā pañtsa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi zhes sman raka dbul/ lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal gyi dag snang mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bsun bzlog gi sdo tshan dang po gsang mchog gdod dbyings ma gtong / de bzhin du rdo rje'i gnas su rin cen/ pad+ma/ las/ sangs rgyas rnams bcug pa'i ljags byin rlabs dang / badz+ra gyi gnas su rat+na/ pad+ma/ rkarma/ burnya rnams bcug pa'i gtor ma phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams sbyar zhing /gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings sogs sde tshan phyi pa bzhi rim bzhin btang ba'i (4bskor lam rnams so so'i dus gcod/ brtan bzhugs dngos ni/ 'bul yul lhar bskyed/ bum pa phul te/ gyi ba po shis 'od gsal bum pa gzhal yas khang / pad+ma tshe yi lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gnyis med 'od zer kun tu 'bar ba'i bcud/ /gus pas 'bul gyi ye shes lnga rdzogs shog /kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ wā ka sirnyi 88—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebatab po mā ra ya/ sha khrag rus phung rdul du rlog zho badz+ra kro dha ha ya gi wa gnod byed sha / mā ra ya rbad/ ces bsgral/ gong gi sngags gsham du ma hā me sa rak+ta ke rje ti khā hi zhes pa btags/ lhag ma ni/ tshe dpag med mgon bka' 'khor ni/ /dam pa chos kyi srung ma rnams/ /zhes sogs lhag ma dang bstan skyong byang gter thugs rje chen po ltar bya/ nyer bsdu ni/ snod bas thams cad 'od lnga'i klong du thim/ /de nyid 'khor dang 'khor yang gtso bor thim/ /gtso bo mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /slar yang 'ja' tshon bzhin du bsal bar gyur/ : mtshan rdo rje'i rwa gdangs thog mda'i rgya can nang gi tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi sgo nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs gyi chog sgrigs dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la dgos pa'i lhan thabs bcas pa chu babs su za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ /sarba maṅga lo//

'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun gyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i zla snang / nang ma (ge'achi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun gyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i zla snang bzhugs so/ /oṃ a thā/ 'khor 'das rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng gi /rnam sprul gter ston rdor 'bum chos kyi grags/ /gdams pa'i bka' babs sngags 'chang dbang po'i sde'i/ /zhabs rdul gtsug tor rtse mor 'bral med bsten/ /'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang lung dang / /man ngag dmar khrid ston mdzad rdo rje 'dzin/ /chos dbyings rang grol deng nas byang chub bar/ /gto gyi skyabs su 'dzin na brtse bas skyongs/ /rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun bum bzang bcud/ /dam pa'i zhal lung brling bas rtogs dka' ba/ /gsal byed brgyud ldan phyag len ji bzhin du/ /'dri bar chos srung gter bdag gnang ba stsol/ /de la 'dir sprul pa'i gter ston chen po 'od kor rma bya'i mdongs mtha' can gyis byams sprin rdo sku'i zhabs dang pra dun tse'i dregs pa zil gnon gyi thugs gsang nas gdan drangs pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i smin byed dbang gi rim pa gter gzhung dngos dang de'i gsal byed khri srong rnam sprul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa gnyis gong ma'i phyag bzhes nyams 'og tu ma chud pa'i rigs kyis tshul bzhin ma rtogs par brten rjes 'jug 'dra'i reg zig bris pa 'ga' zhig mthong ba'ang dgongs pa'i phyogs tsam du ma song bar snang bas/ phugs phyag (2na〉spon rnam dag gi rgyun chad dogs pa'i sgo 'gegs phyir 'dri 'dun yod pa'i steng nye char rtsod bral gyi gter ston rtsa ba'i bla ma gter bdag gling pas bka' phebs pa dang du blangs te gsal byed bdud rtsi'i zla snang 'god pa la/ cog tse lta bu'i stegs steng khebs sogs bkod pas mdzes par malji zhi steng ka pā la mtshan ldan gyi nang du gtor ma rtsa ba dang lo 'dab las thon pa'i a ru ra zur brgyad pa'i dbyibs —91 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shecan mkhyid gang las mi chung ba bzo khyad thon pa mthong ba brgyud pa ltar bshams pa'i rtser gsang bdag gi tsakli mngon rtogs kyi gzhung dang mthun pa btsugs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod/sman raka /rgyal chen bzhi/ sman gyi bka' srung dregs pa dgu /bstan ma bcu gnyis/ gter srung yang le bar rnams kyi mchod gtor tshogs chas/ dbang rdzas kyi phur ma'i rdzas rab gnas chings dang ldan pa'i srung 'khor slob dpon gyi 'khris su rdor dril/ me rtag /khrus bum/ sa yul ci rigs par/ gu gul/ sol me/ bgegs gtore/ yungs kar/ rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du byas/ lha lha kha rgyan dpag bsam ljon shing dkyus ltar las gzhung gyer nas/ bdag bskyed bsgom/ 'dzab dgongasamagul rgyan (2ba)pañtsa li ka dang 'phrul gsang sngags byad mthong chog gi dgongs don ltar/ gsang bdag gi bzlas pa brgya stong skabs dang sbyar ba de las rim 'gros kyi je nyung du btang ba'i gu ru'i thugs sngags khyung sngags/ rgod dbyung gi sngags rnams dang gzhung du mi gsal yang tshi btul ma cung zad bzlas te bdag nyid nus ldan du bya/ de nas bgegs gtor bsngos shing hūṃ bzhi brjod nasarol mo spos dud sogs kyi tsham ngam dang ldan pas 'di skad do/ /bdag nyid gsang bdag gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ khro rgyal ngo bo mthing nag hūṃ yig bcu/ /'phros pas bar gcod gdon bgegasamatshams bcad de/ /tshur 'dus steng 'og phyogs mtshams srung ba'i gur/ hūṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ /lha/ 〉〉/hūṃ hūṃ/ khro bo rā dzas nad kha khog rims kha chings zhes pa'i sngags lan kha yar brjod/ slar yang bdag nyid gsang bdag yi dam lhar/ /gsal ba'i thugs ka gu ru'i gnas gsum nas/ /dkar dmar mthing ba'i yi ge 'bru gsum las/ /'od zer lcags kyu lta bur rab los nas/ /'og min lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas dang ni/ /ma la ya dang pad+ma 'od la sogs/ /dag pa'i zhing khams rnams nas bla ma dang / /dkon cog rin can zhi ba byang sems dang / khrag 'thung khro bo dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /chos srung rgyal po sde bzhi gter gyi bdag /bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ /ye shes las grub dpag tu med pa'i tshogs/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'gyur —92

'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun gyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i zla snang / nang ma (pemed rdo rje'i gdan/ /dri med pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa la/ /dam tshig ye shes dbyer med brtan par bzhugs/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bzhes dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /zhes mchod yul spyan drangs/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal sogs kyis bdun rnam dag bya/ dbang (3na ko tor dang mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bdag nyid thugs kar gu ru ye shes sems/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas nas yig 'bru gsum/ /ā+oṃ 'phros gtore ma'i ma dag nyes kun sbyangs/ /āḥ'aphros 'dod yon drug gi mchod par bsgyur/ /hūṃ los spel bsan ma mkha'i mdzod bzhin gyur/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha/ brjod tshig don bzhin yid la bsams gyur te/ /gtor ma'i dngos po kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /bye brag phyi nang gsang ba de kho na/ /tsho gis kyi 'khor lo 'chi med bdud rtsi'i sman/ /chags med rak+ta'i a lha rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /mchod pa'i lha mo rig ma bcu drug sogs/ /dpag tu med pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'di//rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ /yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos rnams la/ /gus pas 'bul lo bzhes shig thugs dam bskongs/ /nyams pa sor chud dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /gu ru ā+oṃ āḥ// ba lin+ta a khra ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ burnya dharma saṃ gha de wa ḍā ki ni ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/phyag rgyar bcas pa'i sngags kyis lan bdun dbul/ mnyes gyur lha tshogs bdag gi snying gar bsdu/ /slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung nang du btang / phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ /de nas slob bu rnams kyis bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal skor ba byas te ci 'byor ba'i/ /maṇ+ḍal me rtag phul la gsol ba btab/ /gu ru mkhyen rab rdo rje dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag lusang ga yid gsum smin pa'i phyir/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kya/ /snod rung dbang bskur zab mo stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi spyan sngar rgyud dag pa'i ched du/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad/ /bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /rang las ye shes shar ba'i sku/ /yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi/ /dam tshig (3bsgom par dag pa'i sku/ /mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags/ /'gro don sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /—93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesmon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod/ /don dam spros bral byang chub sems/ /rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ /zhes lan gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ /gu ru lhar gsal thugs ga'i ye shes :/ kha dog lnga ldan zhig los gtor mar phog /gtor snod nga phyi dkar nang dmar ba/ /ja ril me dpung 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /nang gi gtor ma bcud kyi 'gro ba kun/ /rnam dag rdzas kyi dngos po yi dam lha/ /gu ru pad+ma jo mo 'tsho rgyal yum/ /sprul pa'i bya khyung rigs gsum las sprul pa'i/ /dug gsum rnam dag rgod dbyung zhi khro'i 'khor/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i mkhar rdzong khro bo r+sā/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dod yon mchod rdzas bcas/ /rab 'byams dbang rdzogs bskur ba'i rten du gyur/ /lha bhe kha rgyan dpag bsam ljon shing tshar gcig brjod de mdun bskyed nan tan du gsal btab/ sngags byang nang gi sngags rnams kyang cung zad bzla zhing byin gyis brlab de nas gtor dbang dang po gtor ma rigs gsum mgon po'i lha tshogs su gsal ba'i thugs ka dang khyad par dpral ba'i ā+oṃ yig las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa ā+oṃ dang bcas pa byung / slob ma'i dpral bar thim pas lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /sku'i dbang thob pa'i dmigs pa ngo sprad/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ snod ni ban+ta 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /bcud ni lha tshogs yab yum sprul par bcas/ /rdzas ni mchod pa'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab/ /bu 'dir shog sku yi dbang mchog khyod la bskur/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā kā ya ka la sha a bhi ṇiñtsa asnye sha ya ba smra ta ma hā sirnyi sam ya āt+pa ko3lha/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ kā ya a bhi (4na)ṇiñtsa ā+oṃ/ zhes pa lnga'am gsum gang rung brjod/ bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po'i sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang mchog dam pa lha dang gnyis su med pa thob par gyur cig /ces bden pa brjod cing me tog gtor/ dril bu'am rgyas par spro na rol chen bya/ mtha' rten du lha bhe kha rgyan dpag bsam ljon shing tshar gcig brjod nas sgom lung phog ste lha sgom du gzhug /gtor dbang gnyis pa ni/ thugs ka dang khyad par mgrin pa'i —94

'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun gyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i zla snang / nang ma (pe.āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa āḥyig dang bcas pa byung slob ma'i mgrin par thim pas ngag gi na dag don sdig sgrib dag /gsung gi dbang thob/ gtor ma mgrin par ba khug /bskur tshig dngos gzhi gong ltar la sku'i dod du gsung gi dbang mchog /kā ya'i tshab la wā dzi'i 'byin 'jug /sngags mthar wā ka a bhi khiñtsa āḥ /gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ mtha' rten du sngags byang nas bshad pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum byed/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin du bcug ste rngub pa'i dus tshe bcud bsdu ba dang phyir dbyung tshe nad bsal ba'i dmigs pa sprod/ /gtor dbang gsum pa ni/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa hūṃ yig dang bcas pa byung / slob ma'i snying gar thim pas yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /thugs kyi dbang thob/ gtor ma snying ga /bskur tshig gong bzhin la thugs kyi dbang / tsit+ta a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo sogs rim bzhin 'don pa bsgyur/ mtha' rten du rdzogs pa chen po de dag la ngo sprad de cung zad mnyam par bzhag /gtor dbang bzhi pa ni/ thugs ka dang khyad par lte ba dpung pa g.yas kyi swā las 'od zer ser po dpag tu med pa swā yig dang bcas pa byung / (4ba)slob ma'i dpung pa g.yas dang lte bar thim pas sgo gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /yon tan gyi dbang thob/ gtor ma dpung pa g.yas dang lte ba/ bskur tshig gong bzhin la yon tan dbang mchog /gu khye/ gu gye a bhi ṇiñtsa swā/ yon tan mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo sogs rim bzhin 'don pa bsgyur/ mtha' rten du srin lag gnyis kyis phur sman chab kyis bran sgo dgu gzhan rnams la dngos dang mig gnyis kyi dod mkhur tshos la 'byug cing rdzas bur ma'am ril bu'i thum bu gdangs/ nad thams cad la bh+yo/ nad rims thams cad la bh+yo/ rims thams cad la bh+yo/ gdon thams cad la bh+yo zhes brjod cing thal mo brdab/ gtor dbang lnga pa ni/ thugs ka dang khyad par gsang gnas dpung pa g.yon pa'i hrīḥlas 'od zer ljang gu dpag tu med pa saḥyig dang bcas pa byung / slob ma'i dpung pa g.yon dang gsang gnas su thim pas sgo gsum bya ba dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib dag /'phrin las kyi dbang thob/ gtor —95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shem dpung pa g.yon dang gsang gnas/ bskur tshig gong bzhin la 'phrin las dbang mchog /ga rma/ dme ka la sha a bhi ṣañtsa khyiḥ/ 'phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo sogs rim bzhin 'don pa bsgyur/ mtha' rten du rdo rje'i khrab rings kyi 'khor lo che 'bring chung gsum gang rung rdzas chings dag bcas gdags/ 'di ni dbang rdzas kyi rten 'brel tsam yin gyi 'dri mkhan stan las ma langs pa sogs mtshan nyid tshang ba dka' bas blos khel gyi srung ba'i go cung mi chod/ sngags rul la la'i lag len la bltas na go chod shes kyang che'o/ /mjug gi ngo sprod ni/ de ltar dbang thob slob bu tha mal pa'i/ /gnas las gyur te lus lha ngag rgyud sngags/ /sems nyid gzhom med rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang / /dbyer med nyid du gyur la 'don yon sman/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis gang la (ldan)thogs med par/ /spyod pas phye bas nga rgyal legs bsam mo/ /de nas dga' ston tshogs kyi yo byad rnams/ /sngon du lasabyed kyis bteg gsang chu gtor/ /bdag gi thugs nas gu ru ye shes sems/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas nas yig 'bru gsum/ /ā+oṃ los tshogos kyi ma dag nyes kun sbyangs/ /ā7411 sa 'dod yon drug gi mchod par bsgyur/ /hūṃ 'phros spel bas na ma mkha'i mdzod bzhin gyur/ /ā+oṃ āḥ&/ zhes pasabyin rlabs gtsang ma'i snod du bshams/ /tsho ru ā+oṃ āḥlha ga ṇa tsakra a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bharnya dharma sa de wa ḍā gi ni ga ṇa tsakra pā tsa kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ zhes bsngos tshogs kyi 'thor phud slob dpon gyis/ phyogs bzhin gtor la bdag nyid lhar gsal bas/ /nang gi sbyin sreg don dang ldan par rol/ /de bzhin slob bu'i lag gnyis thabs shes nang / /sirnyi sa ma a ho su kha ho zhes brjod tshogs kyi dngos grub 'ag tu gtad/ bus blang sirnyi a la la sngo zhes/ rol la de nas ka pā la yi dbang / /bskur ba'i gtor ma de nyid spros byas la/ /gong bzhin dngos grub rdzas la rol du gzhug /dkar dmar gtor ma gtsang ma'i phud kyis bran/ /ā+oṃ āḥ&/ 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /chos skyong rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang / /sman gyi bka' srung mthu chen dregs pa dgu/ /gter bdag dmag dpon yang le ber rnams la/ /'bul lo mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /—96

'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun gyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i zla snang / nang ma (perigs 'dzin pad+ma'i bka' bzhin snyigs dus 'dir/ /gso rig bstan pa dar zhing nad rigs 'joms/ /bdag cag dpon slob bsam don grub par mdzod/ /ces pas bsngos las phyogasagatsang sar bskyal/ /sbyar byang lta bur 'dug kyang che ba brjod cing spro ba bskyed phyir 'di skad do/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i dgongs pa'i klong / /(5bshol phyir sprul 'khor gsum sogs zhus pa'i lan/ /gso dpyad bdud rtsi bum pa ma bu'i skor/ /gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa rtsa 'grel bcas/ /bstan pa srung phyir sku dgra bsgral thabs te/ /rnam pa gsum la sogs te mdor bsdu na/ /gu ru pad+masamadzad pa'i rig pa'i gnas/ /thams cad kun gyi snod rung 'dis chog go /nad pa gso ba la yang sngon nyid du/ /snod rung byas la de nas sman dpyad sogs/ /btang bas nus che mjug la bkra shis so/ /slob bu yon bdag snying dang 'dra ba la/ /srung ba man ngag sbyin par byed na yang / /sngon la snod rung byas la srung yon gyi/ /me tog 'bul du bcug la srung ba btags/ /de ltar byas pas gdags bya dag la yang / /bar gcod gdon gyi gnod pas mi tshugs so/ /zhes brjod me tog gtor la/ bya tshegasachung la 'gro don rgya che ba/ /snod rung rtsa ba mdor bsdus spros pa'o/ /'chi med bdud rtsis sgrib gnyis dri ma 'khrud/ /rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun bum pa'i bcud/ /ma lus sems can kun la khyab par shog /ces dang gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa bya'o/ /smras pa/ rnying rlom dregasapos nyer spos 'byung po'i bya/ /blun rmongs mun pa'i smag tu gar rtse zhing / /log bshad than skad sgrog rnams nyin mo'i mal/ /mi smra gnyid la yur na cung zad mdzes/ /rigs gsum dgongs don pad+ma'i thugs kyi bcud/ /ris med 'gro srog 'tsho ba'i sman dpyad 'dir/ /sngags btsun phal dang dpon tshang mtshan 'dzin pa/ /mang po'i spyan zur gzigs pa cung ma lhung / /bskal mthar bar pa ta sogs gso dka'i nad/ /drungs 'byin stod gter las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'thung 'dod gzur gnas mang por phan pa'i ched/ /snod rung dbang gi lag len lhug par bkod/ kho bo snga 'gyur bstan 'dzin gral ring la/ /chud pa'i snyan po'i ming dang mo ldan yang / /pad+ma ka ra'i byin rlabs snying dbus su/ /—97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'aphos pa'i bzang po'i skal can yin nam snyam/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar dge ba'i lha yi chus/ /semasacan kun gyi nad rnams gzhil mdzad pa'i/ /sman gyi bla ma be+e ḍūrla 'od dang / /mtshungs par phan bde'i sgo brgya 'byed par shog /ces 'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rnam dag dbang gi chu rgyun gyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i zla snang 'di ni mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bla ma dam par smin byed kyi gsol ba btab pas mtshams sbyar te gter chen chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pas 'di lta bu gyis zhes bkas bskul ba dang du blangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyi bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la goms pa'i za hor gyi rigs las g.yo ru lho brgyud du skyes pa'i sngags pa rgan po che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i ljags bsgrigs rdo rje'i gsung dngos gzhi sor bzhag la kha skong dang gas bsdebs phyag bzhes 'phyugs med du bag yod kyi lo rta chen zla ba'i nyer dgu la pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis pa dza ya stu// sarba maṅga lo/—98

lha brag gter byon nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dbang chog dang bcas pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma 9)lha brag gter byon nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dbang chog dang bcas pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bzhugs so/ /na mo nā thā yu rnan pa ri mi tā ya/ mi 'gyur bde chen cho ge sku gar gyi dbang / /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam rol tshe mtha' yas/ /'ja' lus ma ro zhe gyur sprul sku pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum dngosapo gcig gyur gtsug na mdzes/ /lcags kyi sdong po'i srog rtsa gzhe me bral khams/ /'chi med grub pa'i bcud len zab don sgo/ /'byed mdzad rigs 'dzin rgod ldem snyan grags rnga/ /kun khyab gter chen chos kyi rgyal po bsngags/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan se ston rin rgyal zhabs/ /khri srong rnam sprul che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /bka' drin mnyam med zur chen rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa brgyud bla mas byang chub bar du skyongs/ /rdzu 'phrul dpag dka' sngags srung srid pa'i rgyal/ /dam can skyes bu rdo rje legasapa sogs/ /gter skyong rnams kyis gnang ba nyer stsal nas/ /mi 'dzad dngos grub nam mkha' mdzod sgo phye/ /au ṇ+ḍi ya na'i mkhan po 'dzam gling 'dir/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang po thugs kyi bcud/ /'chi med tshe byad smin byed mtho ris nas/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu rgyun deng 'dir 'bab/de yang dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs slob dpon chen po pad+ma (2na)thod 'phreng rtsal gyis kha ba can gyi skye dgu rnams gdung ba sel ba'i slad du mtha' dbus thams cad zab mo'i gter gyi phyag rgyas btab pa'i nang tshan/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i sprul pa'i gter ston brgya phrag brdal bar byon pa'i nang nas ri khrod pa bzang po grags pa'i gter lung snying tig gnad kyi man ngag don bdun ma las/ byang phyogs mtho yor nag po'i sa phyogs su/ /ri bo bkra bzang zhes pa'i shar 'dabs su/ /chu khams glang lo sme ba'i mtshan rtags can/ /pad+ma nga yis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags/ /spyi —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebor rgod kyi ldem phru yang yang 'byung / zhes dang / de nyid kyi nang gter lha sras kyi zhus lan skabs las/ dus ga tha ma mthar thug sleb ka sa /ri bo bkra bzang zhes bya'i shar 'dabs su/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gcig gi smon lam gyis/ /nga yi gter 'don lha sras gdung brgyud skyob/ /thugasang la ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can zog pos 'dul/ /de yi skyon gyis log lta'i 'dam la tshud/ /chos dang chos 'dra mi phyed the tshom che/ /ri bo bkra bzang 'dabs su 'byung ba de/ /gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i bka' dang mthun/ /dge ba'i tshul spyod sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gung thang (2ba)rgyal po rje 'bangs skyob par nges/ /zhes gsal bar lung dang mthun par byon pa'i gter chen gyi rgyal po dngos grub rgyal mtshan nam/ mtshan yongs su grags pa rigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru can gyi byang phyogs brag ri dug sprul spungs 'dra'i rked par gzhom med rdo rje'i sgrom bur rgyas btab pa mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i nang tshan las/ lto gser mdzod ser po'i chos sde'i bye brag drag po thugs kyi sgrub pa'i hūṃ gi 'phrin las skabs las/ /de yi rjes 'jug rnal 'byor ba/ /man ngag 'di dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /brtson 'grus drag pos bar chad spang / /nyams len drag pos dngos grub thob/ /the tshom spangs la sgrub par mdzod/ /bu khyod yi dam 'di la mdzod/ /bdag dang zhal mjal lung ston nges/ /zhes rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi gdams skor chos tshan nyer lnga thems byang themasamed dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa'i bye brag chos tshan bcu dgu ba/ thems byang las/ rnal 'byor tshe srog gso ba'i phyir/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshe sgrub yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i tshe sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum las/ nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dang / dbang la brgyud tshul rnam grangs mang zhing phyag len kyang 'dra min sna tshogs snang ba las/ mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan dang / pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob chos rgyal mthi'i mtshan can yab sras kyi phyag len 'khrul med rtsa ba'i bla ma zur thams cad mkhyen pa las thob pa dang / snang ba ma nges kyi dogs gnam sprul pa'i sku mchog pad+ma 'phrin las la nye bar dpyad pa bzhin bkod pa la/ gter gzhung — 100

lha brag gter byon nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dbang chog dang bcas pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma 9)las/ yar ngo dus dang gza' skar bzang po la/ /sa bcad bkra shis dben pa'i gnas btsal te/ /'bru sbas rat+na sman dang snying po lnga/ khyun chad med pa'i chu yis bum pa bkang / /(3na btsang ma'i gos dkris dpag bsam sdong pos brgyan/ zhes pa ltar/ stegs bu'i khang rten khebs sogs kyisamadzes par byas/ /dbus su maṇ+ḍal lta bu'i khrar rdul tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad sngon po'ang/ ras bris kyang rung / de steng ma sgyu'i khar rin po che bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang bar bum rdzas nyer lnga dang / lugs srol 'di la dam tshig gi lhad ma zhugasapa'i rigs 'dzin rnams kyis bsgrub pa'i tshe rdzas/ chos sman khungs btsun btab/ mgul chings dmar po/kha rgyan tsakli/ gzungs thag /g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang / mdang rgod sgro mar dar tshon sna lnga me long tshe g.yu dang bcas pa/ li khri/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod/ g.yas su thugs sgrub kyi dpal gtor las bzhi lhun grub/ sman rak+ta/ rgyal po bzhi/ sngags srung / rdor legs rnams kyi gtor ma/ bgegs gtor/ tshogs mchod/ ar skya/ gu gul/ yungs skar/ 'thor nas/ rdor dril/rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du byas/ thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi sngon 'gro gzer lnga dang 'brel ba'i las byang / bsnyen pa sum brgya nyer gcig /'dzab bskul/ don bstod dang bcas pa/bsdu na sngags kyi 'phrin las tsam gyis kyang rung / thugs sgrub las byang dang 'brel ba rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po nan tan du mdzad/ ma 'grub na tshe chang tsam la brten kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur/ /de nas bdag bskyed la brgyud 'debs ni/ /mgon po tshe dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha mo tsaṇ+ḍali la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /gter ston (3ba'i gas 'dzin chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas byams bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ /se ston nyi ma bzang po la gsol ba 'debs//se ston mgon po bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs//spyan tshab mgon po zla ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /mnyam med chos kyi rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs//—101 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shechos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zur chen chos dbyings rang grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma lagaso le ba 'debs/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ hūṃ/ cho sgo sku longs sku sprul sku gsum/ /thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mnyam nyid rang bzhin dgongs pa can/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /ye shes rang snang thugs rje can/ /yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi/ /smon lam dbang gis 'gro don mdzad/ /bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /ma chags gsung gis 'gro don mdzad/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ /ma nor lam la 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /rang byung chen po sprul pa'i sku/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid la 'dud/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dngos grub ster/ /mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod sems bskyed ni/hūṃ/ bdag gis 'gro kha'i don bya phyir/ /tshe lo dpag tu med pa nas/ /brgyad khri'i bar du tshe srog ni/ /sra zhing brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ lha bskyed pa ni/ dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan/ /de steng bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /sku mdog dmar po skyil krung bzhugs/ /sprul sku'i cha byad dar chos mnabs/ /phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin/ /sku tshe yan lag (4na)rags pa'i tshad/ /phrag pa g.yas g.yon nyi zla 'char/ /dngas ma 'od lnga'i rgyab yol can/ khod pa'i nang nas bag chags kyi/ /snyigs ma gdos bcas thams cad sbyangs/ /'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis gang / /rā ga dmar po'i mdog ltar gsal/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas gsang gnas bar/ /lcags kyi srog rtsa smyug sdong tsam/ /ka ba btsugs pa lta bur bsam/ nang na stong 'bod gsal ma dngas/ kha dog lngar gsal 'od zer 'bar/ /srog rtsa'i phyi na sngags kyi 'bru/ /dung mdog zil chags lta bur bsam/ /bde ba can nas ye shes sems/ /rang 'dra spyan drangs mkha' la bzhugs/ /bum pa'i nang nas tshe bcud lud/ /bdag gi tshangs bug nang du babs/ /dbang bskur lha dang dbyer — 102

lha brag gter byon nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dbang chog dang bcas pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma 9)med gyur/ /lha dang srog rtsa bdud rtsi las/ /'od 'phros gsal 'tsher mdangs dang ldan/ /tho rangs sngags 'di brgya rtsa bzlas/ ā+oṃ hā/ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā yu dzñā na su bi ni shi ha te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te/ sa mya kle bud+dhā ya/ ta du thā/ chasarba /sku ra pa ri shurnya dharma te ga ga na samu gi te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhi/ ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ ṇi zlo badz+ra ā yu ṣe ā yu rton sirnyi a dzo/ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'od zer ni/ lcags kyu lta bus snod bcud gang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs sirnyi bsdus/ /phyogs skyong mkha' 'gro sdebargyad kyi/ /rdzu phrul tshe bkrag gzi mdangs phyogs/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang / /gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho dang / rtsi shing nags tshal rat+na'i tshogs/ /'byung ba lnga yi dngas ma bsdus/ /lha klu mi yi dbang thang dang / /bsod nams mi yi dngos grub bsdus/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od zer char ltar babs/ /thams cad ma lus bdag la thim/ /bdag lus bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ /stong gsal 'od (4ba)kyi gong bur bsgom/ /zhes dmigs pa dang bcas te 'dzab la chig dril bzla/ /bdag gi spyi bor byon pa yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' tshe dpag med/ /dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du/ /chu la chu bzhag lta bur gyur/ /de nas smon lam ni/ hūṃ/ skye 'chi gnyis med bde ba chen po'i dang / /mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ 'don pa de khyad kyis blo ka gcig gsar sgrigs/ /'byung lnga 'dus ba gsal 'tsher brten pa'i sku/ /thun mong tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /ā yu dzñā na stin+ta zlo/ ṇi : badz+ra ā yu ṣe ā yu dzñā na sirnyi a sa/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/khyod kyi sal 'god par shog /bltas pa tsam gyis srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /bsdigs pa tsam gyis sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /bsams pa tsam gyis dngos grub char du 'babs/ /skyon brgyud par bcasapa'i bkra shis shog /lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /zhes sogs kyis shis pa brjod/phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /sogs dge ba bsngo/ de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/gong ltar sngags dang ting nge 'dzin rgyas par bya/ bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus bum pa'i nang du bstim/ /—103

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherang las 'od 'phros tshe yi sirnyi bsdus/ /ting 'dzin gsal bas tshe yi 'phrin las bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa la dmigs nas/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ chosali rkang drug gas gas/kun mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang / /ji las rin cen bum pa ni/ /sto ldir zhabasazhus mgrin pa phra/ kha g.yel mchu 'phyang lha rdzas kyi/ /mgul dkris la rgyan dpag bsam shing / /chu dang sman bcud kyis gang dbus/ /lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan/ /de steng mgon po 'od dpag med/ /(5na༄sa pa nas/ dung mdog zil chags lta bur bsam/ zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar la/ myinub / tshe gur las/ phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ /bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /'chi med tshe yi lha tsho gos 'khor dang bcas/ /rang byung ye shes brda yi glus bskul nas/ /phyag rgya rol pa'i gar gyis spyan 'dren na/ /lhun grub gzhal yas gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /bdag dang skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la/ /'chi med tshe yi dbang mchog stsal du gsol/ /bde ba can nas ye shes sems/ /zhes pa nas/dbang bskur lha dang dbyer med gyur/ /dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ gal te thugs sgrub dang mi 'brel na mchod pas brlab dgos pa a skṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zlo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a: nas/ shasta'i bar brjod pa bdag mdun 'brel ma'i dbang du byas shing / bdag bskyed kho nar mi dgos/ bdag dang slob ma lha sogs tshig phrad bsgyur dgos pa'i rigs rig pas 'phrul shes dgos so/ /bcom gsar sgrigs/ldan tshe dpag med mgon la/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang / /bdug sbos sgron me dri bzang chab/ /zhal zas sgra snyan rol mo'i tshogs/ /'bul gyis dgyes par bzhes nas kyang / /'chi med tshe —104

lha brag gter byon nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dbang chog dang bcas pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma 9)yi dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā nga na sa pa ri wā ra ji nas (5ba po sta'i bar brjod/'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med kyis bstod/ lha 'di0na gyi gag rnams bdag bskyed ltar dkyuspom gcig tu mdzad na'ang so so'i thad du gol na gsal bar mngon/ dang srog rtsa bdud rtsi las/ /'od 'phros gsal 'tsher ma dngas dang ldan/ /gzungs thag nas bzung ste gong bzhin bzlas pa byed/ /de nas mda' dar g.yab cing tshe 'gugs pa ni/ bcom ldan mgon bo ye shes tshe dpag med/ /'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur lha mo'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe dang g.yang spel zhig /steng 'og phyogs bcu snod kyi 'jig rten la/ /'phros dang stims dang yang pa'i tshe khug cig /stong phrag brgyad cu bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kyis/ /brkus dang phrogs dang bzhams pa'i tshe khug cig /'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i las sbyor gyis/ /nyams dang zad dang 'thor ba'i tshe gsos shig /yid kyis dngangs dang spyod kyis brgyal ba dang / /yud kyis 'drogs pa'i tshe dang g.yang spel cig /tshe khug g.yang skyobs dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /'byung lnga 'od lnga 'bar ba'i tshe bcud bstim/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /gter srung bskang zhing tshogs mchod/ rtsa gsum bskang ba'i bar bya zhing / tshogs 'bul tshig dkyus bzhin gyi steng / tshe dpag med kyi mtshan sngags la ga ṇa tsakra btags nas 'bul/bdag 'jug gsang sngags rnying ma'i phyogs la len mi len mtha' gcig tu nges pa med cing / paṇa chen sku mched sogs mdzad pa shas che bas/ de dang mthun par rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nan tan du mdzad pas 'grub na legs/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa la/ slob ma rnams rdor sems sogs gang yang rung bas bsgrubs pa'i bum chus khrus nas dbyung / gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu/bgegs gtore bsngo zhing bskrad/ spyi dang bye brag brgyud pa'i lo rgyus sogs (6na)kyis spro ba bskyed/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ skye 'chi gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ngang / /sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ /skyabs sems ni/thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad/ /bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /rang las ye shes shar —105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheba'i sku/ /yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi/ /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags/ /'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod/ /don ma spros bral byang chub sems/ /rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ /lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par bya/ byin dbab pa la/ a skṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ rang blo ka khog gsar sgrigs/ nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas/ 'od 'phros slob ma'i lus la phog /nad gdon sdig sgrib rnam smin lus/ /sbyangs te stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan/ zhes pa nas/ 'od 'phros gsal 'tsher mdangs dang ldan/ /gyi bar brjod/ de nas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i dmigs pa dbang chog gzhan bzhin du brda sprad/ saḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar/ a ma ra ṇi dang / a be sha ya brjod cing spos rol dang bcas pas bstim/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brten par bya/ mda' dar dang bcas te tshe 'gugs/ gzhung las/ zhes brjod tshe bum spyi bor gtsug tu bzhag /gong gi snying po gsum gyis dngos grub bstim/ /bdag gi tshangs bug brgyud nas bdud rtsi babs/ khog pa gang zhing dngos grub thob (6ba)par bsam/ zhes pa ltar/ ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'od zer ni/ zhes sogs kyi mthar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud pa sku'i dbang / tshe 'gugs kyi mthar bum pa mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu blud pa gsung gi dbang / bla brgyud mi 'dra ba lugs gsum ga'am/ bsdu na gong gi gsol 'debs kyi brgyud pa rnams kyi mthar bum pa spyi bor bzhag /bum chu blud nas byin gyis brlab/ khyoḥ skye 'chi gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ngang gi mthar/bum pa snying gar bzhag cing bum chu blud pa thugs kyi dbang / ā+oṃ bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje tshe dpag med/ /'khor lo brgyud de bdag gi snying gar thim/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par bsam/ /zhes brjod pa'i thog mar bum pa spyi bo dang snying ga zhes pa'i skabs su snying gar gtugs nas lha —106

lha brag gter byon nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dbang chog dang tsos pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma 9)bstim/ sngags brjod cing tshe ril dang tshe chang sbyin/ na mo bdag gi tshe la bar chad med par gyur cig /'chi bdag gi bdud las thar bar gyur cig /tshe rgyas par gyur cig /tshe 'phel bar gyur cig /tshe'i bsam pa mthar phyin par gyur cig /tshe mthar phyin pa'i lus 'dis kyang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa byed nus par gyur cig /mthar bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las thar nas man par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /ces smon lam dang bcas te me tog 'thor/ dpral bar li khri'i thig btab/ dpral ba'i dbus su rta mgrin dmar po ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis be con sdigs mdzub mdzad/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī wa hūṃ/ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ tsit+ta gsang ba'i sgo srung ni/ /dbang gi rgyal po rta mgrin des/ /tshe srog bar chad bsrung bar mdzod/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi sgo chod la/ /tshe bdag chen por bzhugs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī wa hūṃ/ /dang po rtsegacig sems kyi rgya/ /gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya/ /gsum pa (7na〉sku gsung thugs kyi rgya/ /bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya/ /lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya/ /drug pa rta mgrin dbang gi rgya/ /bdun pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya/ /rgya bdun rim gyis btab pa las/ /su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na/ /gnod byed bgegs kyis lta ci smos/ /de phyir nga yis tshe sbas so/ /badz+ra rak+ṣa zhes tshigs rnams su rgya gram dang / cho me kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas zhes sogasal rdo rje snying gar 'jog /rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ /de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi/ /tshe dpag med mgon nga yin gyi/ /nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin/ /de ltar khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /nga la brnyas par ma byed par/ /ci gus pas nus mtsho ni par gyis/ /sam ya na ra skan/ zhes dam la bzhag /snga 'gyur phalacher la par bkab mi mdzad kyang / mung po byang chub gling pa'i phyag rdor dbang gzhung las/ /de nasarigs kyi bu mchog des/ /slob dpon mchod de zhabs la gtugs/ /mnyes pa'i yon dbul bran khas blangs/ zhes pa'i don ltar dam tshig bsdus te khas blangs pa sogs chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can sogs ba ched pas spyi 'gro ltar mdzad kyang legs char 'gyur/ tsho gos lhag chad mtho/ bstan —107

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheskyong / dngos grub len pa/ bdag bskyed kyi nyer bsdu/ smon lam/ shis brjod rnams dkyus ltar bya ba/ de yang gzhung las/ tshe sgrub lcags kyi sdong po 'di/ /tho rengs snga dro dang po la/ /ting 'dzin gsal bas brgya rtsa bzlas/ /tshe zad mtha' la thug pa yang / /'di bsgrubs lo brgya nges par thub/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin des/ /'di yi yon tan brjod mi yang / /pha rol phyin bcu sal ma bgrod/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du skye/ /zhes phan yon che bar gsungs pa ni mi bslu ba'i gtan tshigs so//yang yang gsal ba'i ting 'dzin 'phro 'du (7bcus/ /ring ring bskal par srog 'tsho'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /lhung lhung tshangs pa'i bu ga nas babs pa/ /'khyil 'khyil snying gi za ma rtag tu gtams/ /rgyal mchog pad+ma thod 'phreng thugs gsang bcud/ /bcud kyi nying khu 'chi med sgrub pa'i thabs thabasamakhas 'ja' lus yongs 'grub nye ba'i lam/ /lam bzang theg pa kun gyi yang rtser son/ /chos dkar 'bras smin smin grol nyams bstar bas/ /ring por mi thogs thogs med tshe 'di la/ /'od gzi stong 'bar 'bar ba mtshan dpe'i sku/ /ma 'gyur 'gro kun kun bzang sar 'god shog /ces lha brag gter byon nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i las byang dbang rdzo dang yos pa ga sgo'i chu rgyun 'di ni don grub ces pa sa lug rnam par rgyal pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling spyi tshogs gnas 'di ga'i tshe 'phrang la dmigs pa'i tshe chog kha mar mdzad pa'i dus rigs 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes la mdzes rgyan cung zad bgyis te za hor gyi sngags smyon bzhad pa rtsal gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so// //—108

byang gter lcags stong ma'i dbang chog gi lhan thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / nang ma 6)byang gter lcags sdong ma'i dbang chog gi lhan thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs / /rab dmar pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ni/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho dar la bab pa'i dpyid/ /nyin byed 'bum gyi gzi mdangs ga byed pa'i/ /tshe dpag med mgon 'chi med gnang ba stsol/ /phul byung tsho gis gnyis rtsa ba mchog tu brtan/ /kun mkhyen mdzad bzang lo 'dab phyogs bcur g.yo/ /sku gsum ro brgya'i gos bu g.yur za ba'i/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas dpag bsam ljon pa rgyal/ /mgon de'i zab gter sgo 'byed rgod ldem can/ /skye ba'i zlos gar mnga' ris legs ldan rje/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing dbang po'i sde/ /'khrul med brgyud pa'i lugs srol 'di rmad byung / /kun bzang gdod ma'i 'od gsal mngon 'gyur phyir/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i lcags sdong ma'i/ /dbang chog 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang dag /legs par bri la gter srung gnang ba stsol/ /de la 'dir rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyis byang zang zang lha brag nas spyan drangs pa'i chos tshan nyer lnga'i nang gi chos tshan bcu dgu pa tshe sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i sgo nas g.yin don du tshe'i dbang bskur bar byed pa'i rim pa gter gzhung du cung zad mi bsal ba rnams brgyud pa'i phyag len gyis rnam par brgyan te ngag bsgrigs su bya ba la sngon 'gro/ dngos(2na bzhi/ rjes dang gsum las/ dang po ni dus dang gza' skar bzang ba la gnas yid du 'ong bar stegs bu la rten khebs sogs rgyan spros mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar byas pa'i steng du rin po che'i bum pa 'bab chu tshad ldan gyi chus gang ba'i nang du bum rdzas nyer lnga bdud rtsi chos sman dang tshad ldan gong ma'i che'i ril bu 'i phabs rgyun sogasalegs par btab pa mgul chings kha rgyan tsaka lis brgyan/ g.yas su byin rlabs rten gyi rgyun dang ka ra bu ram sogs zan la bsres pa'i tshe ril bshams/ de dag gi mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i —109

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemachod pa nye skor du gter srung gi rgyun gtor med pa'am/ rgyas par spro na gter srung gi gtor ma yang bshams/ gzhan yang bgegs gtor/ yungs thun/ sol me/ gu gul/ li khri snod bcas/ rdo rje dril bu/ mda' rgod sgro ma longs ma spyad pa dar sna lnga me long g.yu dang bcas pa btags la/ tshe 'gugs kyi tshe dbyangs rol byed par spro na sbub chol dang rnga sogs kyang sta gon legs par byas/ bgegs sgrod/srung 'khor/ mtshams gcod rnams 'og nas 'byung ba ltar grub pa dang / de nas rang nyid gter gzhung bzhin skyabs sems nas bzung / 'dzab cung zad bzlas rjes/ slar (2bakhing mdun bskyed bum pa la dmigs te/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las: yig las/ phyi ni bum pa'i dbyibs can la/ /nang ni gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ /lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan/ /de steng bcom ldan 'od dpag med/ /ces sogs bdag bskyed ltar gter gzhung ji lta ba bzhin brjod/bdag gi tshangs bug nang du babs/ zhes pa/ lha yi tshangs bug nang du babs/ zhes 'don je/'od 'phros gsal 'tsher mdangs dang ldan/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa pa ri wā ra a: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchode/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i so gos blo sna gcig gis bstod/ 'dzab brgya stong sogs ci rigs pa bzla ba'i skabs bum rdzas tshe ril sogs la dmigs te ting nge 'dzin gyi spro bsdu/ ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'od zer ni/ zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa ltar bya/ de nas gsung rim pa dang bcas pa'am/ rang nyid gcig pus kyang rung ste mda' dar g.yab cing / bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med/ ces pa nas/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ zhes pa'i bar gter gzhung ltar gyi tshe 'gugs 'ang gcig byas te bum rdzas rnams nus ldan du bya/ rnal 'byor dang bdag ces pa slob ma la 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /gnyis la dngos gzhi ni las kyi rdo rjes bum chu brim/slob ma rnams phyag btsal zhing gral la 'khod/ bla ma skad cig gis rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi nga rgyal bzung / bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dngas shing thogs pa med pa 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan zhing rang rang — 110

byang gter lcags sdong ma'i dbang chog gi lhan thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / nang ma rtogegi dbang po mtha' (3na skog tshim pa'i byed las kyi nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sarba bi sta nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu lte saḥsarba tha kho ut+pa te lpa ra ṇa hi me ga ga na gro hā rda ba smra ta ye swā hā zhes lan gsum gyis bsngos/ na mo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas — chos — dge 'dun bla ma rig 'dzin drag po rtsal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la 'chi med tshe'i dbang zab mo bskur bar byed pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs nga po mi min mi ru brdzub/ lha min lha ru brdzub/ nang gi dngos grub phyir 'khyer ba/ phyi'i bar chad nang du gtong bar byed pa'i gdon bgegasathams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang gi gnas su song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje me 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur te/ gsung rim pa yod na rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūṃ/ gsang ba tshe yi 'phrin las sgrub pa la/ /bar chad bgegs rnams ma 'dug phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro dpal chen khros pa yis/ /lus srog thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag /hūṃ/ bzhi pa'i sngags dang bcas te spos dud rol mo thun brab dang bcas pas tsham rngams bya'o/ /hūṃ/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / /rwa gur bla bre khro bo mtshon cha 'khrug /kha dog lnga ldan ye shes me dpung gis/ /skad cig tsam gyis bar mtshams med par gtams/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma (3ba)lus pa rnam mkhyen yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa nas/ mngon par dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes pa'i bar chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i mngon par dbang bskur ba ji ltar bya ba'i 'chad thabs bzhin bya/ de nas dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skye 'chi gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ngang / zhes so gos gter gzhung gi sh+lau ka gcig gi rjes zlos lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar mgon po tshe dang ye — 1// —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheshes dpag tu med pa la rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud/las 'phro gter gyi brgyud pa sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tsho gos mngon sum du bskor te 'i bzhugs pa spyan sngar/ lam log pa las ldog cing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i slad du skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyir du/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum/ zhes pa nas/ bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ zhes pa'i bar gter gzhung ltar lan gsum rjes zlos byas/ de nas lam dman pa nyan rang las ldog cing sdom pa gzung ba'i don du/ bdag gis 'gro ba'i don bya phyir/ zhes sogs gter gzhung ltar tshig rkang drug gi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ de nas byin dbab pa ni/ /bla ma'i thugs nas 'od los pas/ /slob ma'i lusal phog pa yis/ /bar gcod sgrib sbyangs 'od phung gyur/ /de yang stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan/ /de steng slob ma 'od dpag med/ /ces pa nas/ dung mdog zil pa lta bur gyur/ ces pa'i bar las byang ltar brjod/ slar yang rang nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/(4na〉pa dun gyi thugs ka la phog /gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can nas mgon po tshe dpag med la rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i lus la char chen po babs pa bzhin thim par gyur/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te/ ye shes rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i lha tshogs kyis/ /'dir 'dus skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /nub phyogs pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng tshe dbang rtsal/ /— gter gnas ri rgyal bkra bzang shar 'dabs nas/ /rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru yab sras rnams/ / dag pa rab 'byams grangs med zhing khams nas/ /zab gter bstan 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /— —spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng nas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin/ /ཿdbang drag dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /dam can zab mo gter gyi bka' srung tshogs/ /— chus rgyan gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i gling rngams —112

byang gter lcags sdong ma'i dbang chog gi lhan thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / nang ma 6)nas/ /tshe yi ḍā ki 'byung lnga'i lha tshogs kyis/ /ཿཿ 'chi med rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /'chi bdag bdud sde'i dpung tshogs thal bar rlog /zad med tshe yi bdud rtsi char du snyil/ /tshe dpal 'byor ba rgyas pa'i byin chen phob/ /gzungs ring gi rjes su/ sa ma ya a be sha ya a u zhes spos dud rol mo drag tu bya/ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med/ /sogs kyi tshe 'gugs tshar gcig bya'o/ /de nas dbang dngos ni/ ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'od zer ni/ zhes pa nas/ stong gsal 'od kyi phung por bsgom/ zhes pa'i bar dang / skye 'chi gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ngang / zhes pa nas/ a yu dzñā na sirnyi u3/ (4bskos pa'i bar gter gzhung ltar brjod cing / tshig don ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du legs par byas/ bdag lus zhes pa dang bdag la zhes pa rnams slob mar bsgyur/ de nas rol dbyangs dang bcas te mda' dar g.yab cing / bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med/ /sogs kyi tshe 'gugs tshar gcig bya/ de nas tshe bum spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga'i gnas su bzhag nas/ bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje tshe dpag med/ ces sogs gter gzhung tshig rkang gsum dang / bdag gi zhes pa slob ma la bsgyur/ de'i mjug tu/ tshe dpag med mgon lha mo tsaṇ+ḍali/ /pad 'byung mtsho rgyal gter ston yab sras dang / /sangs rgyas byams bzang bse ston rin rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /zla ba mgon po mnyam med nub dgon pa/ /slar yang rdo rje mgon dang byis pa'i mtshan/ /ngag dbang grags pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sngags 'chang shākya bzang / /mnga' ris rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhabs/ /bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal po dbang bo'i sde/ /ཿ rig 'dzin chen po ngag dbang rdo rje'i dpal/ /chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun ā nan+da/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /ཿgzungs ring dang bcas pa brjod cing / stim pa'i dmigs pa gzhung bzhin byed/ de nas gzungs ring brjod cing bum chu dang tshe ril byin/ na mo slob ma'i tshe la bar chad med nga/ra gyur cig /ces pa nas/ mthar bdud bzhi'i 'jigasapa las thar nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gyi smon lam dkyus 113

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shenas khrung ba ltar btab cing / me tog gtor/ de rjes dpral bar li khri'i thig le byas la/ de'i dbus su dpal rta mgrin sku mdog
