dmar po (ldan tshe na la gcig phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ gzhu'i stod la 'brug sgra sgrog cing / smad la glog 'khyug pa/ mde'u nas thog ser 'bab pa/ rta skad phyogasabacur sgrog cing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis stangs stabs su bgrad pa cig gsal btab la/ rol dbyangs dang bcas te/ hrīḥ rtsa sgor dbang drag pad+ma dbang chen sku/ /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams kyi rol pa yis/ /tshe la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bcom ste/ /gzhom du med pa'i srung bas rgyas btab bo/ /hrīḥ pa dhan+ta krid ha ya gi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa badz+ra rak+ṣaḥ shis pa brjod pa ni/ dbyangs rol dang bcas te/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 'ja' 'od rab 'khrigs pa'i/ /yid 'ong lding khang dbus su pad sdong rtser/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje rig 'dzin tshe dbang rtsal/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /dpa' bo ging dang chos srung rgya mtshos bskor/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dri za'i pi wang bzhin/ /sgos pa med pa rna ba'i gsos su 'jibs/ /bdud sde sgrod pa'i hūṃ phaṭa nga ro'i sgra/ /dbyar gyi rnga gsang lta bur mgrin gcig ldir/ /zhi dang khro bo'i mchams 'gros gar gyi rigs/ /glog gi phreng ba lta bur kun tu 'khyug /rgyal srid rin chen bdun dang rdzas brgyad sogs/ /bkra shis rdzas kyis 'chi med lam kun khyab/ /shis pa brjod pa'i me tog phreng ba'i tshogs/ /bkra shis bde legs char ltar babs pa yis/ /'dir 'dus bdag cag skal ldan tshogs rnams la/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis shog /'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub bkra shis shog /dpal 'byor snyan grags dngos grub bkra shis shog /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /sogs kyi rjes (5ba)blos/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ deng nas brtsams te sogs tshe 'gugs sbrags ma'i dbang dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ lha bstim zin pas mchod bstod mi dgos shing /gter srung gter ma rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar te phul/ tshogs yod na thugs sgrub rnam gsum gang rigs la brten nas tshogs mchod gzhung ltar bya/ med na'ang bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis gang babs — 114

byang gter lcags sdong ma'i dbang chog gi lhan thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / nang ma 9)dang / las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /smras pa/ med byung ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i zab mo'i gter/ /gter gyi snying po mdzod lnga'i man ngag rgyun/ rgyun chad med par 'dzin mkhas mnga' ris rje/ /rje btsun legs ldan rdo rje brgyud par nges/ /zab zab rtogs par dka' ba'i chos tshul 'di/ /lhod lhod legs bshad smra ba'i rnam dpyod gang / /yang yang snga 'gyur chos tshul la goms pa'i/ /mtho mtho'i za hor rigs so ne snyoms las pas/ /gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin dam pa yi/ /bzhed pa'i don gyi re ba skong slad du/ /khrims su sdebs pa'i dge des lus can kun/ /'chi med gdod ma'i go 'phang mngon 'gyur shog /de ltar lcags sdong 'di la mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po'i phyag len lugs mi gcig pa ngo mtshar can zhig 'dug pa yid gto du rung bar snang mod kyang / 'di ni rig 'dzin chen po dang bse ston gyi lugs srol thun mong ba/ dbang po'i sde'i phyag bzhes ltar bkod pa yin la/gzhan du na ding dus rnying ma ba 'ga' zhig dbang don ngo sprod dang brjod bya gsal bar bsams nas gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs shing / gsar ma ba 'ga' zhig bka' ma'i mgon po phyag bzhi pa sogs rnying ma'i brda chad tsam med pa dag la sgrub chen gyi spros pa 'dor nas bka' brgyad sogs kyi rgyas 'gebs/ 'ga' zhig mi shes pa'i chos med par 'dod nas rnying ma'i dbang rjes gnang la (6na)gsar ma'i rigs 'gre ma gtogs rnying lugs kyi rnam dbye tsam yang med pa du ma zhig mchis pa la/kho bo'i blo gros kyi mig chung ngu zhig gis brtags tshe/ de thams cad chos la dbang za ba ste/ ji skad du rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sdogang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bzhig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i chos tshul rnam par dkrugs par song bas 'thad par mi sems shing /kho bo ni mdo sngags gsar rnying sogs gang yang so so'i brda chad las/ nya dang nyung ma bsre ma myong ba'i stabs kyis 'dir yang snga 'gyur rang skad gtsang mar byas so/ /zhes byang gter lcags sdong ma'i —113

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedabang chog lhan thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes pa 'di yang / gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i sku blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs bo'i sde'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa myong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i res su son yang / rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po sogs dam pa du ma'i bka' drin las/ ris med pa'i grub pa'i mtha' du ma la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad dkar ba'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/ brgyud ldan dam pa'i phyag len gyis legs par brgyan cing / gter gzhung dngos la mi gsal ba'i kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams bkang ste/ dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //—116

khra brag gter byon ma'i dregs 'dul bsnyen thabs rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzi byin/ nang ma (pekhra brag gter byon ma'i dregs 'dul bsnyen thabs rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzi byin bzhugs/ / dregs 'dul he ru ka dpal pad+ma 'byung / /dbyer med zur chen chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /deng nas kun bzang rang rig rang ngo sa /'phrod min de srid snying dbus pad mtshor bzhugs/ /de yang dgas lung khra mo brag nas pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spyan drangs pa'i gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po dregs 'dul gyi skor nye bar bsnyen pa la spyir phyag rdor dregs 'dul 'di la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa las/ ser ba 'bebs pa nas rdo rje'i phyag mtshan gyi las mtha'i bar phyi sgrub kyi las tshogs/ bum sgrub nas sde brgyad gnad 'khor gyi bar nang sgrub kyi las tshogos/ lasabazhi'i sbyin sreg gsang sgrub kyi las tshogs yin/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub pa gsum du bshad pa'i seng phur nyer gcig nas klu'i gdon 'grol pa'i bar sku sgrub kyi las tshogos/ klu bsad pa nas ngag mnan pa'i bar gsung sgrub kyi las tshogs/ gsang ba thugs kyi phur gcig nas tshogasalas kyi bar thugs sgrub kyi las tshogs/ yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi sgrub pa la las tsho gos zur du med/ sgrub pa'i khog 'bugs dang dbang chog sogs kun gyi kha skong du (2na stag da na'ang / deng sang dbang yang gtum po thugs kyi sgrub pa'i las byang gi gzhung bsrangs nas mdzad pa yin cing / zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung las/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub gang byed kyang gtum po thugs kyi sgrub pa'i las byang gis khog phug /lha rnams sgrub thabs so so'i gzhung bzhin bsgom dgos tshul thos pas/ dper na phyi sgrub lta bu la las byang gi khog gtum po thugs sgrub ji lta ba la/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du lha phyi sgrub rang nas gang bshad ma gtogs khro bo bcu sogs bskyed mi dgos/ de yang mtshams kyi sngon du sgrub khog nas bshad pa'i rgyal chen mtho —117—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'adzugs nas bzung dkyil 'khor rgyan 'god kyi bar gter gzhung 'di ga'i dgongs pa sor gnas la cung zad mi bde ba'i lhan thabs dgos pa byung na byang gter sogs nas kha bskang chog /dkyil 'khor 'di ba phyi sgrub gter gzhung na dbus gru gsum thur du brko ba sogs bshad 'dug kyang / rdul tshon nam ras bris lta bus 'thus/ gtor ma ni dpal gtor snying gzugs ma pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi ba can/bka' brgyad sogs(2brkong bzo dbyibs lam tsam mthun par rgyan spros gang legs byas pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ma sgyu'i khar bzhag /de la tsakli btsugs gtor gdugs mthing ga can/ sman raka mchod pa tshogs chas gter srung ldang lha'i gtor ma sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas/ srod thun la las byang gi gzhung bsrang tshogs kyi bar gtong ba phur pa sogs rnying ma spyi dang 'dra/dkyil 'khor steng gi sgrub gtor de dang por mchod rdzas su shes par byas nas las byang gi mchod gtor byas/ tsho gos la zin nas gtore ma skad cig gi lhar bskyed/ tshogs spyan drangs pa de la bstim nas tsho gos mchod 'bul ba rnying ma dkyus dang 'dra/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bdag lhar bskyed pa dang gtor ma lhar bskyed pa gnyis zhal sprod kyi tshul du dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du sogs gzhung na gsal ba bzhin byed bsnyen pa ma thems bar gyi thun gzhan rnams la las byang ma btang bar mngon rtogs dang mchod pa bsdus pa tsam gyis cho go /yang thun re tsam la las byang gtong bar shar na las byang gi dus gtor ma mchod rdzas su bsgyur/ bsnyen pa'i dus lhar bsgyur ba sogs rdzogs chen pa rig pa'i rang rtsal du skad cig skad cig la 'phrul shes pa 'di med na gsar ma ba'i rtag brtan ther zug 'dra ba de la tha mal gyi zhags shig yod/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum tsho gsum dang nyer gcig /de nas tshogs mchod sogs btang / lha dregs 'dul ngo bo gcig pu de na yin pas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs mi dgos/gtor ma'i tsa gli nang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs dang mthun par btsugs/ nang sgrub kyi mngone rtogs dang sbyar te las byang gi gzhung (3na tha srang / tsho gos mchode 'bul ba yan phyi sgrub dang 'dra/bsnyen pa'i dus gtor ma lhar bskyed pa'i bdag mdun gyi gsal kha 'di la med pas gzhung bzhin — 118

khra brag gter byon ma'i dregs 'dul bsnyen thabs rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzi byin/ nang ma rtogebyed/ bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag gcig /de nas yang gong bzhin tshogs mchod sogs phul/ tsakli brjes/gsang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs dang sbyar te las byang gi gzhung bsrang tshogs mchod kyi bar btang / 'di la yang bdag mdun so sor med pas gzhung bzhin bsnyen pa byed/ bsnyen tshad 'bum tsho gsum dang nyer gcig /de nas gsang sgrub kyi mjug nas bshad pa'i gnas lngar o rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro bzhi sogs lha lnga gsal btab/ bsnyen sngags gsham du ha ri ni sa dang las bzhi so so'i sngags gang rung re btags nas/ dper na mgrin pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyis mtsho ni te/ rgyas pa sogs las gzhan rnams la'ang lha dang sngags kyi rigs 'gre /las bzhi re re la zhag re re tsam gyis chog /de las mang ba phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin/ de yang phyi sgrub kyi bsnyen pa gzhud bzhin nyams su blangs pa bsnyen pa/ nang sgrub kyi bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs pa sgrub pa/ gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs pa sgrub pa chen po/mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi la brten pa las sbyor gyi dang po/ de nas las byang gi gzhung bsrang dngos grub blang ba sogs rnying ma spyi ltar byed/ mjug tu gsang sgrub las tshogs nas bshad pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bya/ rgyal chen gyi mtho 'grol ba sogs spyi dang mthun par byas nas sku mtshams 'grol lo/ /(3ba)srid gsum sde brgyad dregs pa ma lus pa/ /'dul mdzad gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po zhes/ /mtshan snyan dbyar gyi rnga sangs thos pas kyang / /blo gsal rma bya'i snying la dga' ston spel/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i zab gter rgya mtsho las/ shar gter rin chen 'bras bu'i bcud smin pa/ /mnga' bdag sras mo rin chen tshul rdor gyis/ /zab chos ro brgya myang 'di skal bzang dpyid/ /de 'dra byang bdag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i gar/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing dam pa yi/ /gsung gis nye bar bskul ba'i byed po'i mthus/ /za hor brnyes yi ge'i ris su bris/ /zur chen rdo rje 'chang de'i bka' drin gyis/ /chos 'di thos dang gter gzhung dgongs don ltar/ /bkod las rgyun med mgo skor blos byas kyi/ khungs bral dpe hrul rnams dang 'di mi 'dra/ /dge 'dis yid srubs sde dang bcas pa'i — 119
kyitsho

rdo rje gas pho las byang rgyun wer mthong bas rnam grol/ nang ma 9)rdo rje gtum po'i las byang rgyun 'byer mthong bas rnam grol zhes bya ba bzhugs//na ma sdi mū la phya de wā ya/pad+ma thod 'phreng gan jag thang ta yi//thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan gter bdag gling //rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor gus btud nas//gtum po'i las byang rgyun khyer nyung ngur 'dri//de yang lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi rnam sprul//gter ston chen po pad+ma gling pas yar 'brog brag dmar nas gdan drangs pa'i gsang bdag gtum po'i chos skor gyi nang tshan las byang gnam lcags 'od kyi dra ba dbang bskur gyi nges par gyer dgos kyang /bsnyen pa dang gdon 'grol gyi tshe rgyun 'byer mthong bas rnam grol bkod pa la/skyabs 'gro ni//bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa sku/zhes sogs lan gsum sems bskyed ni/sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du//zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/tshogs zhing ni/mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs pa'i rdo rje gtum po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes spyan drangs/rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal//sogs yan lag bcu pa bya//sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig/sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog/bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing //chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog/ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/mtshams gcod ni bgegs gtor bsngos rjes/hūṃ/bdag nyid gsang bdag thugs khros pas//gnod byed 'byung po bgegs kyi tshogs//khyod kyi lusangag yid gsum po//rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed//de bas bgegs gtor 'di khyer la//'di ru ma 'dug g.yin du dengs//hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod/srung 'khor ni/bdag nyid gsang bdag thugs ka nas//dkar ser dmar ljang mthing 'od 'phros//rdo rje phur pa gri gug gri//'khor lo me dpung gur gyis gtams//gnod byed mi min bgegs kyi tshogs//gsang bdag bka' las ma 'da' zhig /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebadz+ra gī li gī lwa ya phe le sho ṣa na tsakra dz+ra la raṃ rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ byin 'bebs ni/ rtog med spros bral chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /stong pa'i chos nyid ye shes rang snang ba/ /gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po 'khor bcas kyis/ /dbang dang byin rlabs mthu dang dngos grub stsol/ /sa ma ya a (2ba〉ze sha ya a a/mchod rdzas brlab pa ni/ ā+oṃ u ྅ su bhā wa bi shurnyaḥ sarba dharmā swa bhā wa bi shuzlo3lha/ raṃ yaṃ kho gis mchod gtor rnams kyi ma dag pa'i tshogs bsregs gtor bkrus/ stong pa'i ngang las : las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar mchod pa rnams nam mkha' gang bar spel la a: sogs brjod/ oṃ ma hā ke ni ri ti hūṃ/ ā+oṃ bodhi tsit+ta ga na gu tho hūṃ/ ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a sri ta hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ma hā ba kla ta hūṃ/ rten brten pa bskyed pa ni/ hūṃ/ chos rnams rang bzhin spros dang bral/ nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /'gro drug kun la khyab pa yi/ /brtse ba'i snying rje nyi ltar bsgom/ /stong nyid snying rje gsal ba'i glong / /rgyu yi rig pa hūṃ du gsal/ /de las 'od 'phros 'byung rim brtsegs/ /e yaṃ raṃ khaṃ / ke d+dhi/ dra las dur khrod gzhal yas khang / /thod pa skam rlon rtsig pa bcas/ /lha chen ka brgyad rngam zhing 'gying / /rus sbal ka gdan 'khun pa 'debs/ /gza' brgyad ka gzhu glog ltar 'khyug /lha klu'i gdung ma gdung stegs dang / ju skar nyer brgyad dral phyam bcas/ /zhing chen thog phub thod pa'i bad/ khyu ma'i dra phyed spras pa la/ /tsit+ta'i phod do dmar chen rgyan/ /mi ro'i rgyal mtshan keng rus 'phen//rtse na gnam lcags phyogs bcur lding / /rdo rje'i ya them ma them dang / /g.yas g.yon ri bzhi bcas pa dang / /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i sgo mo la/ /rdo rje nyi zla'i g.yag shing bcas/ /mi 'gyur ur mo'i zer gyis bsdams/ /pho brang rab tu yangs pa'i nang / /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong / /mthing nag gru gsum e (3na rko kyil steng / /thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i khar/ /gza' brgyad klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng / /rang rig hūṃ sngon yongs gyur las/ /rdo rje'i lta ba hūṃ gis mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ /sems can don byas tshur 'dus pa/ /skad cig yongs su gyur pa las/ /bdag nyid gsang bdag phyag rdor ni/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo — 122

rdo rje gas tsho las byang rgyun wer mthong bas rnam grol/ nang ma 9)rje gsor/ /phyag g.yon dug sbrul zhal du 'khyer/ /zhal ni bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs/ /spyan gsum dmar 'byug gyen thur g.yo/ /sma ra kha spu me stas 'phro/ /smin ma rab 'jigs glog ltar 'khyug /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil/ /rigs bdag sangs rgyas mi bskyod bzhugs/ /thod pa'i dbu rgyan brog zhu gsol/ /sku stod seng glang stod g.yogs gsol/ /smad dkris stag gi sham thabs can/ /thod pa skam rlon do shal dang / /sprul chun se ral kha yis brgyan/ /dga' bo 'jog po'i thod bcings can/ /'dab bzang dkar mo'i sku rags byas/ /klu ris bzhi yis phyag zhabs brgyan/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs tshul can/ /zhabs ni brkyang bskum dor stabs bgrad/ /me dpung klong na 'gying tshul bzhugs/ /spyi gtsug dpung pa pus steng lngar/ /gti mug 'joms pa'i khyung chen mthing / /zhe sdang 'joms pa'i khyung chen dkar/ /nga rgyal 'joms pa'i khyung chen ser/ /'dod chags 'joms pa'i khyung chen dmar/ /phrag dog 'joms pa'i khyung chen ljang / /rdo rje mchu la glog dmar lce/ /spyan gsum dmar po khrag klong 'khrug /g.yu yi smin ma bskal me 'bar/ /lcags rwa du ba pu ru sa /(3btog gtsug nor bu dgos 'dod 'bebs/ /'dab gzhog gdengs pas gnam sa g.yo/ /sder mos klu rnams pho nyar 'gyed/ /rin chen spu gseb thog ser 'bebs/ /sprul 'byer sdebargyad srog snying za/ khro bcusabar chad 'byung po 'dul/ /sgo srung bzhi yis bgegs rnams bsrung / /ā+oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa ma hā rak+ṣa sam ya hūṃ/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūṃ /klu rgyal dbang sdud snying po ye shes lha/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /klu bdud sbrul 'dzin rdo rje rgyal thabs can/ /rdo rje rtse bran 'bum brgyan khro bo'i rje/ /rdo rje klu 'joms nag po gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa dzaḥshā baṃ sto bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ klu gnyan pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje bzhugs su gsol/ /'khor lo pad+ma lnga yi gdan steng du/ /mkha' lding bya khyung klu 'dul bzhugs su gsol/ /badz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ chabadz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra ji sogs kyis mchod/ bodhi tsit+ta ho/ ma hā pañtsa pā tsa ho/ ma hā rak+ta 'a hi/ ma hā ba —123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelin+ta khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje can gyi sku/ /mthing nag 'jigs pa rdo rje'i gar stabs can/ /gdug pa'i klu 'dul bya khyung rigs lngas mtshan/ /gnyen por gyur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po/ de'i mthar ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas ci nus su bzla/ tsho gis mchode spro na skabs su gang babs(4na)bya/ /nyer bsdu ni/ smi gsang bdag phyag rdor lha tsho gos rnams/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir byon zhing / /sems can don kun grub nas kyang / /slar yang skye med klong du bsdu/ /badz+ra muḥ bsngo ba smon lam gyi mtha' brten par bya'o/ sprul sku pad+ma gling pa'i gter byon rdo rje gtum po'i las byang rgyun 'khyer mthong bas rnam grol 'di ni rang dang skal mnyam mang po phan pa'i blos za hor sngags spyon gyis reg zig tu bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so// //sarba maṅga le/ /— 124

rjes gnang rig gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las chu rgyun/ nang ma rtogerjes gnang rig gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las chu rgyun bzhugs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon po rnams/ /snying gi ze'u 'brur 'bral med rtag bzhugs la/ /bgrang ring skye ba'i dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ /byang chub thams cad de srid bar du skyongs/ /de yang snod ldan gyi slob ma'i rjes su 'dzin par byed pa'i rjes gnang / rig gtad/ byin rlabs la rdul tshon/ tshom bu/ gtor ma sogs so so'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i bca' gzhi rnams legs par bsgrigs te dbang sgrub song nas/ slob ma khrus nas dbyung / me tog bkye bsdu byed/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che bzhi las rgyud sde che ge 'di'i khongs su gtogs pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa lha 'di zhes bya ba'i rjes gnang dam rig gtad dam byin rlabs zhu snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa legs par gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa ni rgyud sde rin po che rnams las gsungs pa ltar sku lus kyi 'dug stangs drang por (2na)gnas pa dang thugs bsam gyi 'dun pa yang gnas khang dang sa phyogs 'di nyid kyang dngas gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i thar ba chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du da ltar gyi rdo rje slob dpon 'di nyid kyang tha mal gyi snang ba 'di lta bu ma yin par gang bya ba'i rjes gnang dam rig gtad dam byin rlabs bskur ba'i lha che ge mo dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa brtan po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ chos kyi sgra dbyangs grag stong skye ba med par sgrog pa srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad 'joms pa'i sgra lhang lhang yod snyam pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ de'ang mgon po zhi ba — 125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelhas/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'/ /skyes bu'i don bsgrub thob par gyur pa las/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis nas yang dag 'byor pa ga la rnyed/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'gro ba rnams kyi gtan gyi bde ba bsgrub par nus pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can da lam thob pa'i dus 'dir don ldan du byed nus pa'i chos rnam dag cig ma byas na tshe rabs phyi ma rnams su mi khoms pa'i gnas grangs med par (2ba〉mthums te mi lus 'di lta bu rnyed par dka' ba'i phyir/ci nas kyang 'dam kha ma log pa'i chos rnam dag cig mdzad dgos/ dam pa'i chos de'ang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs dgos pas/ gsan par bya ba'i chos ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal ba'i chos thams cad bsdu na theg pa dman pa dang theg pa chen po gnyis las/ dman pa ni/ rang gi bu la'ang ma chags pa'i/ /nyan thos rnams ni skal ba dman/ /zhes dang / dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi/ /gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams ni/ /sa rnams kun gyi gtan gyi gegs/ /zhes dang / lam shol la ma zhugs stobs chung ba/ /sogs ji snyed cig gsungs pas theg dman gyi lam ni sems can gzhan dag yal bar dor nas rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba las ci thar bsgrubs pas zhi ba'i mthar lhungs te sangasargyas thob pa la yid ches shin tu thag ring bar 'gyur zhing theg pa chen po'i rigs sad ba'i gdul bya yin phyin dman pa'i lam du bskur mi rung bas 'dir theg pa chen po la nges par 'jug dgos la/ theg pa chen po la'ang rgya chen por mos pa la dbang brtul chags bral gyi spyod pa dang sems can gyi don du 'gyur na gang 'tsham gyi spyod pa'i sgo nas sa dang pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa/ dbang rnon bde chen gyi spyod pas sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba sogs gdul bya'i mos blo sna tshogs pa bkri ba'i thabs su chos kyi rnam grangs mang du bstan kyang gtso bor gyur ba 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rgyu'i theg pa ni bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i mthar sa bcu gcig tsam mngon du byed pa (3na〉las ma gsungs pa'i phyir na 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa zhig la — 126

rjes gnang rig gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las chu rgyun/ nang ma (penges par 'jug dgos te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags//zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi theg pa'i thob bya sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin pa la don gcig tu zin kyang myur du 'tshang rgya ba la 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa khyad par du 'phags pa yin te 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs la ma rmongs pa dang / thabs mang ba dang dka' ba med pa ste tshe 'di 'am skye ba bcu drug tshun la rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang byed nus pas 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa zhig la nges par 'jug dgos la/ rgyud sde'i dbye tshul la'ang / sangs rgyas gsang ba las/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye las/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum du bshad cing / rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes pa ltar mu stegs byed sogs log par spyod pa rnams kyi 'dod chags/ 'tshe ba/ gtsang sgra/ de gsum ga chos su smra ba kun rjes su 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir du bla med/ bya spyod/ rnal 'byor te rgyud sdebazhi dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas rdo rje sa 'og sogs mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang por byas te rgyud sde lnga dang / bde mchog le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa (3brkong / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yi/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dag de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes bla med las kyang rnal 'byor gsang mtha' logs su phye bas rgyud sdedrug tu bzhed pa sogs rnam grangs mang na'ang 'dir yongs su grags pa rgyud sdebazhi'i dbang du byas te gsan bya'i chos 'di nyid dpe phyag rdor 'byung 'dul lta bu la mtshon na/ phyag na rdo rje la 'khor lo chen po dbang gi che ba/ mdo lugs brtag pa'i che ba/ sba ba ma ga dmasang ga gi tsheb ni/ slob dpon sba ba bas dkral ba ste gdams ngag gi che ba ni ma rgyud gtum chen yin la/ gtum po khyung gi che ba/ u tsa drag sngags kyi che ba/ rnam 'joms khrus kyi che ba/ 'gro bzang chos skyong gi che ba/ 'byung po 'dul — 127

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebyed stobs kyi che ba las/ 'byung 'dul la'ang so'i sngags 'chang chen po snye mdo shākya dpal bar yi dam gyi lhas dngos su gnang ba'i 'byung 'dul me dbang dang snar thang pa'i bka' srol brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i 'byung 'dul sogs rnam grangs mang yang 'dir rnal 'byor ma bla na med pa rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las byung ba bla ma rdo rje gdan pa nas ba ri lo tsā ba brgyud de rje btsun gong mar bka' babs pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang 'bul ba la zhes pa dang / spyan ras gzigs la mtshon na bya ba'i rgyud la rigs drug tu yod pa'i pad+ma'i rigs kyi byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ma nas bshad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rigs mang ba dang / zur bka' la'ang dpal mo lugs dang zla rgyal lugs sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' babs mang yang dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgyas 'debs(4na)pa'i brgyud pa rin po che sna bdun du grags pa'i nang tshan lnga pa dpon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang 'bul ba la/ zhes pa lta bus mtshon te rgyud sde'i dbye ba dang lha so so'i rigs dbye lugs sogs rig pas 'phrul shes byed/ sngon du 'gro ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba dang dngos gzhi slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis bya ba'i 'os su gyur ba ni bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang / mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub cing de dag la mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba dang byin rlabs brtan byed kyi bzlas pa sogs ni legs par grub/ de rdo rje slob ma'i bya ba la yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon lha che ge mor gsal ba'i spyan sngar khyer rang rnams kyi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dngos po thams cad maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi/ nyi zla zung gcig /lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam par sprul te maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma zhig dbul bar zhu zhes brjod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos shig mdzad pa zhu/ zhes rjes gnang so so'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i thun mong pa'i gsol gdab lan gsum — 128

rjes gnang rig gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las chu rgyun/ nang ma (pebyed/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir thugs bsam gyi khyad par 'di bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ de'ang 'khor ba la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can 'di dag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa yin la/ rgya mtsho ni gting zab cing mtha' rnyed dka' ba ltar 'khor ba'i gting mtha' de dang (4ba 'dra zhing chu srin na kra sogs srog chags ma rungs pa dang 'dra ba'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum dang mi 'dod pa'i rlung shugs drug po ltar las kyi g.yin dbang du gyur pas/ sems can de rnams la sdug bsngal ji lta bu zhig yod na/ dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dgas rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig za ba dang gsod pa dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal/ mi rnams la 'dod pa btsal gyis ma rnyed pa dang mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang lus bcad cing dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha rnams la 'chi 'pho ba dang gong ma nas 'og mar ltung ba dang mthar ngan song du skye bar shes pa na dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal las kyang ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal rnams yod par bshad pas sdug bsngal de las rang nyid gcig pu thar bar byed dam snyam na ma yin te sems can 'di dag thams cad rang gi pha mar ma gyur ba med cing ma byas res kyi gnod pa las bskyabs shing phan btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin/ 'di dag rnams 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis la la sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/la la de'i rgyu rngams po cher longs spyod/ blang dor la blta ba'i mig ma rig pas ldongs/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khor ba dang bral dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bu bsam zin/ mngon mtho dang nges legs la brdeg 'chos shing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi g.yang kha'i gram par byed pa 'di rnams de las thar bar byed pa'i thabs shig ma byas na ngo tsha dang khrel gzhung ye med pa yin la/byu (5na)thabs kyang rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i btson rar gnas bzhin du/ /'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus/ /zhes tshangs pa/ khyab 'jug /dbang phyug ste gtso bo gsum —129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegyis thog drangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi dbang phyug rnams la nus pa mi mnga' zhing / gang la mnga' na yul khyad par can dkon mchog gsum ni mkhyen pa'i cha nas gdul ba'i khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal gzigs pas rjes su 'dzin pa la mkhas/ brtse ba med na yal bar 'dod srid kyang ma rang gi bu gcig pu la brtse ba ltar ris med pa'i lus can la snying rje chen po dang ldan/ snying rje tsam yod kyang ma lag zhar ma'i bu chus khyer gyi ra mda' gzhan la spron pa bzhin ma yin par rjes su 'dzin pa'i nus mthu khyad par can mnga' bas yon tan de ldan la skyabs su 'gro bar byed pa yin la/ des na rang re rnams skyabs su song ste 'khor ba las thar ba tsam gyis chog gam snyam na ma yin te lus can mtha' dag srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar nus pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin pas de'i go 'phang thob pa'i phyir du theg pa chen por sems bskyed dgos pas/ de'i slad du mdun gyi rdul tshon nam tshom bu/ gtor ma sogs gang yin pa de nyid lhag pa'i lha che ge mor gsal ba'i mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams kyi sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags par gyur pa ma 'ongs pa na gsog par 'gyur ba/ da ltar yang gsog bzhin pa'i (5ba)sdig pa'i las ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa la sogs yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bgyid snyam pas gur las byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du/ bdag la dpal che ge mo'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol snyam pa'i mos gus drag pos gsol ba gdab pa la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de'ang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo zhes pa dang slob dpon rin po che sogs so so'i gzhung las byung ba bzhin dang la lar gsol gdab med pa'ang yod/ des sngon 'gro song nas dngos gzhi la ba ri lo tsā ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la lung gsum gyis 'chang ba'i rjes gnang mdzad cig /'ching lugs byas kyang sa lo'i 'jam dbyangs dmar ser dang ngor chen dkon mchog — 130

rjes gnang rig gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshams spyor 'phrin las chu rgyun/ nang ma (pelhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms sogs la chings cung zad mi 'dra ba yod pa so so ltar mdzad srol cing phal cher la dam tshig pa bskyed/ de la ye shes pa bstim pa'i gzhi bkod rjes/ sngags kyi bzlas lung / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gi chings mdzad pa yin pa zhib cha rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gnang ba'i 'byung 'dul gyi der gsal bar yod cing / slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i sgrub thabasargya mtsho'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs na sku gsung thugs kyi chings mdzad pa de'i byed lugs ni rje dbang rab kyis mdzad pa'i 'byung 'dul gyi yi ge sor bzhag gi lha gang yin kha sgyur/ de ltar lha che ge mo'i rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas gnas skabs de dag tu zhal gyis bzhes pa'i (6na〉dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du mdzad snyam pas gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang gtang rag bi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ maṇ+ḍal gyis mtshone pa'i lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i dngosapo thams cad dbul snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ nga ltar rjes gnang che ge mo gsan pa yin pas 'di dag la brton nas rang g.yin gyi don rgya chen po mdzadapa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod do/ /de'ang zur bka' dang spyi bka'i sangs rgyas byang sems la 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu dgos pa shas che/ la lar dmigs bsal gyi rdul tshon gyis pad 'dab lta bu 'dri ba'ang yod cing 'di rigs thams cad la 'bul gtor las dbang gtor gyi srol med/ gtor ma bzo 'di yin med pa zhig mgo bo la bzhag nas sangs rgyas shākya thub pa byin gyis rlobs shig ces sogs bka' bsgo dam bzhag byed pa rnams ni bzhad gad kyi gnas kho nar 'dug /rta mgrin gsang sgrub lta bu dang chos skyong gi rigs rnams la dbang gtor nges par dgos pa yin pas so sor ma 'dres pa'i yig cha gang yin dang bstun dgos pas thams cad la dpe gcig bkab nas rna bas thos tshadang kyi rjes gnang dang rig gtad sogs byed pa'i bla chen bla chung rnams kyi rjes su 'brang mi 'tshal lo/ gsang sngags rnying ma la/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyab— 131

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebadag kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ zhes pa nas/ mos pa brtan po (6bsgodzod yan gong ltar la/ de'ang mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ mthun par gyur pa'i yul na gnas pa dang/ /skyes bu dam la ni brten pa dang / /bdag gi legs smon sngon yang bsod nams kyi/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi ni khyed la mnga'/ /zhes phun sum tshogs pa du ma dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di nyid rgyal ba'i yum las/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdag kyang dge ba la spyod cing g.yin yang dge ba la bskul ba na dal 'byor snying po yod par byed pa de sangs rgyas kyis bsngags so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lan cig tsam rnyed pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di stong log tu ma song bar snying po lon pa zhig nges par byed dgos la/ snying po len pa'i thabs ni dam pa'i chos sgrub pa las gzhan du ma mchis shing /chos kyang rnam bshad rig pa las/ chos ni shes bya lam dang ni/ /mya ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/ /bsod nams tshe dang gsung rab dang / /'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o/ /zhes sgra yangs pa'i dbang du byas na du mar la jug kyang 'dir gtso che ba dam pa'i chos te mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las/rgyu la mos pa'i rgyu'i chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung par 'gyur/ /zhes bdag cag gi ston pas bka' dang po bden pa bzhi bar pa mtshan nyid med pa/ mtha' ma legs par rnam par phye ba ste chos 'khor rim pa gsum yongs grags su bskor nas gsang chen rdo rje theg pa ni 'og min sogs dag pa'i zhing dang / gzhan yang ri rab kyi rtse/phyon mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten sogs gnas mang por dkyil 'khor so so'i rigs kyi bdag po skur bzhengs nas dbang po rnon po'i gdul bya mchog rnams rjes su bzung ba yin cing / de'ang dga' rab rdo rje/ shrī sidha rigs 'dzin brgyad kyis gtsos pa'i paṇa grub du mas rdzogs pa chen po sems klong man ngag gi sde/ spyi ti/ yang ti/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul/ bka' brgyad spyi bye brag /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi 'jam rdor/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dril bu pa/ lhas pa/ spyod pa'i rdo rje — /32

rjes gnang rig gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las chu rgyun/ nang ma rtogernams kyi ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa/ kye rdor man ngag lugs/ nag po pa/ mtsho skyes/ ḍom+bi pa ste bzhi gnyis su med pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje sogs paṇa grub rnams kyis rgyud sde mtha' yas pa'i srol legs par phye zhing theg pa rim dgu dang rgyud sde bzhi sogs kyi rnam gzhag las gsang sngags gsar rnying zhes bya ba'i tha snyad ma mchis kyang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa rje khri srong lde'u btsan gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba'i ched du sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal skyon chen po gdan drangs te lha chen dgu dang bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs lha srin gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags te thub bstan nyin mo ltar mdzad pa'i tshe dam pa'i chos 'gyur ba'i bstan pa la snga dar dang sngags la rnying ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'e ti dang lo chen rin bzang tshun chad dar ba rnams la bstan pa phyi dar dang sngags gsar ma zhes pa'i tha snyad du mdzad la/ de'ang mdo sgyu sems gsum sogs ni phyon chen (7ba)po/ bi ma la mi tra/ lo chen be+e ro sogs kyis nyan gyis gtan la phab/ rma gnyags/ so zur gnubs gsum sogs te he ru ka dpal gos dkar lcang lo'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba mtha' klas pas rgyas par mdzad/ gter ma ni ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus mthar thug pa'i bar du dus dang bstun te bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i btsas su ri brag mtsho gsum gtsug lag khang dang gsang ba'i dben gnas mang por gsang ba'i phyag rgyas btab pa las can rnams kyis rim bzhin 'don par smon lam du mdzad pa/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa'i klong gsal spyi'i thems gsang ba bka' rgya can las/ bdag 'dra skyon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /sum stong lon nasabod kyi yul 'dir 'ongs/ /smon lam dbang gis rgyal po'i thugs dgongs bsgrubs/ /bsam yasali sogs gtsug lag brgya rtsa dang / /mtha' dbus kun kyang yid bzhin gter gyis bkang / /brgya dang bcu gcig bod kyi 'gro ba 'dul/ /thugs dgongs rdzogs nas nge yab gnas su 'gro/ /snying po'i thugs gter dpag med bsam yas kyang / /kun las khyad 'phags yang zab snying po'i gter/ /zhes pa ltar mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang zhing de 'don pa'i las can gyi — 133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegater ston la'ang tshad bzung dka' yang gtso bor gyur pa ni/ ji skad du/ thugs gter gcig ni lho brag srin mo sbar rjes can la sbed/ khyad par mkha' 'gro'i sgrub skor yin/ mnga' bdag sku yi sprul pas 'don par 'gyur/ /thugs gter gcig ni lho brag gnam skas brag la (8na〉sbod/ khyad par snga ma'i sgrub skor yin/ mnga' bdag gsung gi sprul pas 'don par 'gyur/ /zhes sku'i sprul pa mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer dang gsung gi sprul pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gnyis sku'i skye brgyud rim par byon zhing nyi ma dang zla ba ltar yongs su grags/ de'i yang srid thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ sgrub thabs yon tan gter mdzod las/ 'di nas tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral dus/ /nga yis thugs rjes sprul pa'i rigs 'dzin ni/ /pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal/ /phyi ltar rab byung sngags pa'i cha lugs can/ /nang ltar sems bskyed bstan pa'i khya bar brtson/ /gsang ba gnyis med rdzogs chen don dang ldan/ /chosargyal yab sras 'tsho rgyal smon lam gyis/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyi ma 'gegs spyod pa skyong / /de 'dra'i gang zag nub kyi phyogs nas 'ong / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ba byed/ /ces mnga' ris pad+ma dbang rgyal gyis bsam yas bar khang nas yongs 'dus rnam gsum gyi zab gter spyan drangs shing de'i yang srid yon tan gyi sprul pa ni/ rang gter myong grol pad+ma rā ga'i kha byang las/ da lta'i mgo nag spyi yi rgyal po khyod/ /smon lam dag pa'i skye ba rnam lngas 'don/ /dam rdzas 'di dang 'phrad pa'i skyes bu de/ /skye ba du mar zab gter la spyad pas/ /sku yi gzi brjid mtshan rtags bcu gsum ldan//bden pa'i ngag 'grub sgra dbyangs tshangs pa'i gsung / /thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo gting mtha' dka'/ /bdag dang rgyal bo'i yon tan sprul pa ste/ /'phrin las rnam pa lnga la rang dbang spyod/ /cesapa ltar (8ba/snang lhang brag /kham bu lung / 'jod po gser gyi mchod rten nas zab gter spyan drangs shing de'i skye ba 'phrin las kyi sprul pa ni slad nas 'byung bar 'gyur la/ thugs sgrub chos tshan nyer lnga'i thems yig las/ ma 'ongs bstan pa'i tha ma la/ /bskal ba dum bur rtsod pa'i dus/ /drag po gru gsum sne ba can/ /thogs rdugs med pa'i spyod pa skyong / /khro bo'i cha byad ngar dang ldan/ /shar — 134

rjes gnang rig gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las chu rgyun/ nang ma (penas 'byung ba'i gtad rgya gyis/ /zhes dang / snying thig gnad kyi man ngag don bdun las/ byang phyogs tho yor nag po'i sa phyogs su/ /ri bo bkra bzang zhes pa'i shar 'dabs su/ /chu khams glang lo rme ba'i mtshan rtags can/ /pad+ma nga yi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags/ /spyi bor rgod kyi ldem phru yang yang byung / /zhes zang zang brag nas rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyi mdzod lnga 'dusapa'i ba gter spyan drangs/ de'i skye brgyud ni/ rang gter las/ bdud 'joms skye ba nyi zla'i ming / /byang sems spre'u'i lo ba zhig /las can thog babs tshul du 'byung / /de yis 'di 'byin 'gro 'dul 'gyur/ /zhes mchog gi sprul sku mnga' ris legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjes zab gter mang du spyan drangs shing / gzhan yang drag sngags kyi bdag po gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ /gling pa bcu gcig dri med rnam gsum sogs sprul pa'i gter ston grangs med pa byon cing ding sang yang bdag cag gi rdo rje slob dpon chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas 'gro ba rnams 'dren par mdzad bzhin pa 'di ltar nas/skabs 'dir gsan bya'i chos ni/ chos(9na)kyi rgyal po mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gter byon drag po'i skor la/ rgyas pa gzhung chen bde gshegs 'dus pa/ 'bring po me'i spu gri /chung ba dpa' bo lha gsum/ thems med kha yar sna tshogs pa yod pa'i nang nas 'bring po me'i spu gri'i dbang la/ 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs te dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'dzab bzlas nas nus ldan du byed pa/ zab gter gyi srung ma la gtor ma phul te rgya 'grol ba'i 'phrin las 'chol ba/tshogs kyi 'khor los cho ga'i chad lhag bkang ba sogs lhag 'ad med tsam pa'i go yul song nas/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sku'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ zhes sogs gong dang 'dra/ des mtshone gter kha gang yin de ga'i che ba dang lo rgyus sogs rig pas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /deng dus gal chung dam pa'i chos la byed/ rjes gnang rig gtad gang dran gyis chog skabs/ /don du gnyer ba ngo mtshar che snyam nas/ /gsal byed yi ge 'bad pa chen pos bris/ /legs bshad shar ri'i rtswa nas zos bzhin du/ /drin tshor lci ba nub ri'i ngos gtong bar/ /ston pa kha yang klad med rang mtshang ste/ /de — 135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shephyir rta shi'i so bzhin dam pa gces/ /'dis mtsho ni dge ba nam mkha'i nor bu yis/ /ma rig rmongasapa'i smag rum mthar byas nas/ /'gro rnams gtan bde'i snang ba 'od po che/ /rtag tu spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por shog /ces brjed gnang rig gtad byin rlabs la nye bar mkho ba'i mtshams sbyor 'phrin las chu rgyun 'di ni mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas/ (9ba〉rgyar thams cad mkhyen pa/ rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar ba/ khyab bdag zha lu ba gsum gyis gnang ba'i phyag bzhes dran pa'i yul du gsal ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// //sarba maṅga lo/ — 136

lha brag gter byon las khyung gi 'phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma 9)lha brag gter byon las khyung gi 'phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /nag phyogs gdon bgegs gshed du rdo rje'i rwa/ /srid pa'i rtse mor gdengs pa bya khyung gi /sgrub thabs 'phrin las rim pa spel ba la/ /chos bdag gter srung dgyes pa'i gnang ba stsol/ /de la 'dir lha brag gter byon gyi rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs dang / las khyung gnyis las/las khyung gi 'phrin las ngag 'don sngon 'gro'i rim pa la/skyabs sems ni/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi rang la ye shes shar ba'i sku: yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i sku: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: sngon nas bsagasapa'i sdig sgrib bshags 'gro don sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do:sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems rang thong mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ zhes sogs brjod/ srung 'khor ni/ hūṃ/ rang nyid las kyi khyung chen gsal ba yi/ /thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya dpag med 'phros/ /gnod byed mthar bskrad rdo rje'i gur khang dang / /ye shes me (2na〉skus bar mtshams med par gtams/ /byung dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ byin dbab pa ni/ snro dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya niḥlas kyi khyung nag 'jigs pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob/ /chig dril sngags kyi mthar/ /dzin ga ru ḍa sa ma ya a be sha ya a gis sman rag gtor gsum mchod pa brlab pa ni/ ā+oṃ hūṃ swā e lhahri ma chu badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha sne yo u3: rak+ta man+ta la :: a dhu pu ā gha ྅: dngos gzhi'i rim pa la lha bskyed pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ chos kun ka nas dag pa stong pa'i dbyings/ /paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi — 137—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shem dang / /klu rgyal mang bo gdan du bting ba'i steng / /rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo khrom mthing nag /de las 'od 'phros rtsa gsum lha tshogs mchod/ /sems can don byas tshun 'dus yongs gyur las/ /bdag nyid las bya khyung gnag cing la'i/ /dbu dgu rdo rje'i rwa dbar nor bus brgyan/ /dbu skra smin ma dmar ser rab tu 'bar/ /nyi zla ltar 'khyil spyan mig phyogs bcur gzigs/ /zhal nas hūṃ dang kri krong sgra chen sgrog /phyag gnyis klu phran mang po bzung nas za/ /sku lus gnam lcags me yi tsha tsha 'phro/ /ye shes gnam (2bskogs ral gri'i sgro gshog brkyang / /mchu dang phyag zhabs sder mo ma lus pa/ /spu gri ltar rno lcags kyu bzhin du bkug /bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus bzhugs pa'i/ /dpral bar ā+oṃ dkar mgrin par skya dmar po/ /thugs kar hūṃ yig sngon pos mtshan pa yi/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sku ru gyur/ /spyan 'dren ni/ khro/ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas las kyi bya khyung nag po snyan gson zhig: sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul phyir spyan 'dren gyi: rings pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol khro/ badze ga ru ḍa sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ/bzhugs gsol ni/ khro/ rab 'jigs drag po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas 'dir sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus bsgral pa'i phyir las kyi bya khyung nag po 'khor bcas rnams: gnyis med brtan par bzhugasal 'phrin las mdzod sam ya a be sha ya a u/ mchod pa ni/ khro/ dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar spyar ba yi: mchod yon me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang : dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta ba smra rgyan sa bdag klu gnyan sha khrag rus pa sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: khro/ kurma ga ru ḍa ma hā sarba pā dza khā hi ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta khā hi: ma hā ba byu ta: ma hā me sa ma hā rak+ta: ma hā tsit+ta ma hā bha su ta: ma hā go ro tsa na ma hā ke : ti khā snyi bstod pa ni/ bde gshegs kun gyi mthu stobs ma lus pa/ /lasakyi bya khyung nag po'i skur bstan nas/ /sa bdag klu gnyan gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /rlag mdzad mthu stobs dbang po khyod la bstod/ /man ngag ltar chig dril gyi 'dzab bzla/ de nas drag tu —138

lha brag gter byon las khyung gi 'phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma ()bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs(3na)rgyas thams cad kyi zhes sogs gzhud ltar bya/ mjug chog gi rim pa la/ tshogs mchode ni/ thugs sgrub 'bring po'i tshogs mchod la lha sngags kha bsgyur nas bya/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus te/ de'i ngang la ka dag rig pa'i klong du cung zad mnyam par bzhag /smon lam shis brjod ni/ dge 'dis 'gro kun sa bdag klu gnyan gyi/ /dug dpal myong dang myong 'gyur sdug bsngal kun/ /byang ste rang rig dag pa'i ye shes byung / /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod nas grol bar shog /lus la snang stong lha sku'i bkra shis shog /ngag la grag stong sngags kyi bkra shis lha/ga /sems la rig stong ting 'dzin bkra shis shog /rtag tu bde stong ye shes bkra shis shog /ces smon lam shis brjod rgyasabasdus ci rigs pa skabs dang sbyar nas bya'o/ /gang zhig bsgrubs pas phyogs las rnam rgyal pa/ /bya khyung 'phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /lha brag gter gyi dgongs don 'thul med las/ /rang bzos bslad pa'i zog chos 'di na med/ /la la mi shes bzhin du rtsom 'dod blos/ /mun pa'i mda' ltar snga 'gyur sgrub 'phrin la/ /gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs byed rnams rang gzhan gyi/ /don du mi 'gyur snag shog gron du zad/ /sngags rlom rigs kyi bsnyems pa tsam min par/ /smin grol gdams par sgro 'dogs yongs dpyad mthus/ /smra ba'i mgrin pa bteg nas bkod pa'i dges/ /mchog thun dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub gyur cig /ces lha brag gter byon las khyung gi 'phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog mda' zhes pa 'di ni ngag dbang shes rab kyis bsnyen mtshams byed par nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ cung zad kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams (3ba〉pa gter tsheg med cing / phal cher gter gzhung mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs nyams pa med pa kho nas brgyan te/ kun bzang thugs rje'i zlos gar zur chen chos dbyings rang grol gyi bka' drin la brten pa'i chos tshul 'di la goms pa za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim blo bzang dngos grub bo// //sarba maṅga le/—139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheskad cig nyid la bde chen du bgrod par byed pa'i zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa bzhugs/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal kun stsol byed pa'i/ /bla ma rdo rje drag rtsal la brten nas/ /skad cig nyid la bde ba chen po sa /bgrod byed man ngag thor bu khrigs su bsdeb/ /skyabs 'gro gter gzhung gi rgyas pa'am/ /bsdu na/ bdag sogs 'gro kun ma lan mang du bya/ spyi bor sum brtsegasagadan dang dar chen khri/ /zhes sogs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'i mjug tu rlung nang du rdubs pa dang sbrags te/ bla ma'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par sa dmar po/ thugs skar hūṃ/ mthing kha rnams la 'od zer dmar dkar mthing gsum rim pa bzhin du byung bas/ lus kyi nang mer gyis gang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams rim pa bzhin 'thob/ /rlung phyir 'byin pa dang mnyam du lusang ga yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dang dam tshig nyams chag rnams dag par bsam/ bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs byas pa'i mjug tu/ spyi bo'i bla ma/ rang gi lus tha mal ba/ dmigasapa'i 'gro 'du gsum gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du cung zhig mnyam par bzhag /de rjes/ pad ma nyi zla ru dra pho mo rnams/ /bsnol steng rang (2na sko yi ge hūṃ mthing nag /yongs gyur rang nyid bla ma drag po rtsal/ /rab khros mthing nag dbu skra gyen du brdzes/ /zab chen ber dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa dril bu 'dzin/ /phru ma phus btab lta bu'i gsal stong sku'i/ /nang du dbu ma'i rtsa de smyug dong tsam/ /yar sna tshangs bug mar sna gsang gnas zug /rtsa de phyi dkar nang dmar de yi nang / /lte ba snying ga tshangs bu 'og gsum du/ /thig le gsum dang tshangs bug yi ge k+ṣa/kha dog dkar po mgo bo thur bstan pa/ /mig rna sna kha gsang gnas bshang lam dgu /mthing nag yi ge hūṃ dgus rnam par bkag /rang gi sems dang lte ba'i thig le gnyis/ /ngo bo dbyer med gcig tu —140

skad cig nyid la bde chen du bgrod par byed pa'i zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa/ nang ma (pegyur par bsam/ /rang gi spyi bo khru gang tsam gyi thad/ /rang lus 'dzin med spyi bo yi/ /zhes sogs spyan 'dren mchod bstod kyi bar brjod de bla ma zhi ba'i rnal 'byor gsal btab/ chos dbyings rang byung ma'i/ bdag kyang rjes 'jug thugs rjes byin gyis rlomes/ /zhes pa'i mjug so sor/ 'jigs rung bar do'i 'phrang las drang du gsol/ /ngan song sdug (2ba tha sngal gnas las skyob tu gsol/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma'i thugs kar 'dren du gsol/ /bde chen ye shes bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sbyor/ de nas dmigs pa ni hig ces lan gsum brjod pas lte ba'i thig le la thim/ des k+ṣa 'phul/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus k+ṣa drangs te thugs kar thim/ thig le de tshangs bug rgya mthongs kha phye ba 'dra ba nas yar ma shor ba byas te mar thim pas sngar ltar bab/gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du cung zhig mnyam par bzhag pa ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ro/ lag len dngos gzhi'i tshe gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba la k+ṣa yig mgo gyen du bstan zhing rnam shes dang gnyis su med pa'i thig le de tshangs bug nas skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du bla ma'i thugs gar 'pho/drod tshad rtags gsum sogs ni gter gzhung las shes par bya'o/ zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag bzhad pa rtsal gyis sbyar// //sarba maṅga lo/ —141 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lcags 'dra'i 'khor lo'i sngags byang bzhugs/ lcags 'dra'i 'khor lo'i sngags la/ rgya mtsho'i mun pa'i dmag bsdu ni/ lte bar sdig pa gsum la zhe myags dang snye dun sogs spyi dang 'dra//rgal gnyer la dgra bo'i tsit+ta breng shag snying mā ra ya/zla gam gyi logs gnyis la sdebargyad rnams kyi srog sngags tshan pa gnyis su byas nas gcig gi mjug tu tris nan bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i ban bon byad ma mkhan gyi lha srung rbad 'dre dang bcas pa'i lusang ga yid gsum mthu stobs nus pa thams cad ma ra ya sto bha ya nan/logs gcig la dgra bo'i lo snying sogs zhal shes ltar 'dri/yus la/ra ta ra khrag srog la yaṃ/tri ling dgra bo'i snying la shag/e /ya ma srog la hur thums gzir nan dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad nag po nā ga bhe ra srog la dza la dza la/ni hur thums dgra bo'i snying la rbad/rtsis/e raṃ baṃ kho shig tsit+ta gtubs/sa sa gtibs/mes tshig chus bskur/rlung gis g.yos/kha raṃ baṃ lhag sna ri tsi ri khas g.yon/dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya rbad sod/'og 'khor gyi zla gam gnyis la sdo brgyad kyi sngags wo steng 'khor ltar byas pa'i rbad 'dre 2na khyod gtong sdebargyad thams cad/bsam ga sbyor rtsub la4 ba'i ban bon sogs dgra bgegs rnams kyi gshed du phob cig bdud du phob cig sogs/logs gcig la rbad 'dre sdo brgyad rnams rang gshed 'bebs sogs 'dri/gtad bzlog dang byas pa bshig pa gnyis lcags sdig sor bzhag dang /mnan pa ri rab stobs chen 'jug kyang lcags sdig ltar bya'o//gshed po las rgyal gyi sngags ni/spre sa pa'i ma sgos pa sto 'a sgamya gas sogs/byi lid+ma'i 'doms dang g.yas g.yon la 'dri/du ra nā ga/byi du ra ra smo ti/༈re hā/zhe ge/ya me/raṃ smo/raṃ ka/k+ṣe mo/badz+ra kro ta/de rnyi gī lwa ya/ma mar smo/nyid du gsas/he sha rag thog/du phrag dun+ti/khi la ni/a du na/tri sha na/rā tsa ha sto/raṃ 'kho4khang mar tshe so gyir gzha du 'dri/tsa mu tsog / ti sta ro ni ro/tri ga nag/a tri swo dhu/tsa tri rī tsa/rā tsa nā ga/de wa ru tri/kha ra ga/k+ṣe 4

lcags 'dra'i 'khor lo'i sngags byang / nang ma 9)ma tri/ du rnyi/ du rnyi tri srog mā ra ya/ gha na pa ti/ bha na ke ro/ kā la du khrag /byi du rā na/ nā ga mo ti/ sa ga byi du/ rtsibs/ dgra bo ban bon byad ma mkhan sarba ste bha ya nan 'drid rbad sarba rtsa sbur/ srog la nan snying gzer brang shag raṃ yaṃ rbad/ mchog phag 'khor lo'i sngags ni/ smyu rdo rje'i rwa/ myags sogs/ bsam rtsibs nang / ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bo dmag dpung srid sde byad ma mkhan dang bcas pa'i tshe srog bsod nams thams cad : sa sngags/hur thus sa dzaḥ mkhrag snying thu mus ril raṃ shag rbad/ dgra phyi rtsisags te sa/po'i tsit+ta breng shag dzaḥ srog la hur thumasarbad/ cha rtsibs bas gyi kug/ badz+ra/lu wa wa sam hā kā lā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bo dmag dpung srid sde byad ma mkhan dang bcas pa'i tshe srog bsod nams thams cad mā ra ya rbad/ stong srog 'khor lo'i sngags ni/ spre sngag0god cilug pe ris pa be/ring gi rak+ṣa mo n+ta'i mtshams su ya ma tha/ a du raka/ pa tsa tri/ su ni tri/ ne ni a rbad sod/ a wā ga sto bha ya nan/ rbod gtong bzlog bh+yo/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bo dmag dpung srid sdeb na bon byad ma mkhan dang bcas pa : mā ra ya rbad sod/ btsan po seng ge'i lto bar gsod pa'i sngags ni/ spre rdo rje'i rwa/ myags sogs/ e rtsibs nang la/ka he du na sogs/ ā+oṃ bar gyi mu khyud sa mgo nang bstan du 'dri/ myags mthar thun sngags/ de'i mthar bsad pa las drug /oṃ bar gyi mu khyud kha mgo phyir gzha du 'dri/ badz+ra ka lha wa wa sam hā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ tshim hā kā la gu ṇa hri da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃpiṅka mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badze ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li hūṃ phaṭa/ lho 'brug pa'i lha srung rnamasakho rang rnams kyi gshed du phob cig mā ra ya/ (3na)bsam phyi rtsibs/ ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i ban bon dgra bo dmag dpung dang bcas pa'i srog la yaṃ shag hri myagasarbad dgra snying gzer/ rbud nan/ ha la ha la tsa ma ri phyung / de bzhin du slob ma stag /sngags pa spyi dang drag sngags mkhan sdig pa/ bon po phag /spyi'i spun rus sbal/ bud med bya/ rgyal rigs kyi sngags pa la seng ge kha 'brab/ ma mo mkhan lashwa na lce 'thab/ gshin rje mkhan la khyung 'thab/ bya khyung mkhan la rma bya sngags pa nang 'gras la rusasbal/ gtad mkhan la sprul nag /rdo rje spun la dme 'thab/ slob ma nang 'gras stag mo/ u rmo — 143

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shenang 'gras sam dge 'dun gyi sdel glang chen mche 'thab/ bon po la pho nya rkang mgyogs/ drag sngagasamakhan la thob/ bya khyung so brdar 'khor lo'i sngags ni/ khro zhes/ ga ru ḍa gnod byed dgra bo byad ma rtsa sbur ya/ srog nan snying gzer breng shag yaṃ rbad/ e hur thums dzaḥ ṇa shag ro myugs mugs ti rbad ya/e nan yaṃ bzlog bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i ban bon sngags pas byas pa'i rig sngags rbod gtong gi gnod pa thams cad phyir shig 'drid bh+yo/ e 4zha/ hur thums dzaḥ rtsa sbur srog nan/ snying gzer breng shag yaṃ rbad bsam ngan sbyor rtsub rtsibs/'chang ba'i ban bon sngags pas byas pa'i rig sngags rbod gtong gi gnod pa thams cad phyir shig shig /skye mu khyud/ ring la bshig pa g.yu spyang btags pa/zhes pa'ang za hor gyi ban+de sbyar/ /sarba maṅga lo//

btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma 6)btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ /blo 'das rig rtsal dpal ldan kun tu bzang / /rang sems bla ma'i ngo bor yongs shar ba/ /'khon rigs khyab bdag dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs/ /byang chub bar du gtsug tor rtse mor mdzes/ /bka' gter a ti'i chu klung rnam pa bzhi/ /bdag blo'i rgya mtshor 'bebs mkhas 'dren pa rje/ /zur chen thams cad mkhyen dang khra tshang ba/ /blo gros mchog gi rdo rjes rtag tu skyongs/ /khyad par lam 'di'i smin grol zil dngar bcud/ /sku gsum lang tsho'i srog song byed pa po/ sprul pa'i sku mchog chos rgyal gter bdag gling / /sems nyid gdod ma'i mgon las dmigs su med/ /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas thob pa'i chos lnga las/ /btags pas tshe 'dir phung po 'od sku sa /grol nus glegs bam 'khor lo'i rab gnas dang / /dbang bskur snyigs dus 'gro la gcig tu gces/ /de phyir yang tig yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /dgongs don ji bzhin dang po'i las can la/ /phan gdags rang gi dran pa gso ba'i ched/ /bklags chog mu thi la 'phreng mgul par spud/ /de la 'dir btags(2na)grol gyi rab gnas dbang bskur gyi rim pa la/ btags grol 'dri lugs dang / dkyil 'khor/bzhugs snod/ mchod pa sogs kyi bca' gzhi rnams yang tig gi btags grol man ngag rin po che'i snying po dang / rgyas par spro na/ bla ma yang tig gi rgyab yig sogs las shes par bya/ sngon 'gro bgegs gtor/ skyabs sems/ sgrib sbyor mchod pa brlab pa ni/ ā+oṃ su bhā wa shu zla sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dhi3lha/ phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad stong pa chen po/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥ las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus — /45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheyongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbyug to dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i pang na rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/gnyis ga'ang rin po che dang rus pa dang thod pa'i 'phreng bas rab tu brgyan pa/ spyan gsum khro bo'i lta stangs chen pos bskal pa'i me ri me phung gi dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ hūṃ/ nyon cig bgegs dang (2ba〉sog 'dren tshogs/ /lus ngag yid la gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bar chad 'byung po thams cad kun/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /nga ni dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dzin byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par gyur/ /ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra ha ya shrī wa rā dza hri ya ha ri ni sa rak+ṣa u tsa ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs thams cad rgya mtsho'i mthar byed nas/ /ye shes kyi me phung gcig tu 'bar bar gyur/ /bdag dang pha mas gtso bya ba'i pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /cho gel skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad snying re rje/ de dag thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang 'phrad par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /dga' ba chen po de dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang thams cad dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnasapar bsam/ spyi bor rdor sems bsgom zhing dmigs pa dang bcas ge brgya ba bzla/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ a lha/ pā thu/ pu po dhū pe/ ā lo ke /garnye/ ni wi du/ (3na〉na1PROB ā&/ yongs su gyur pa las/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dngas shing thogs pa med pas sa dang bar snang kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bus gang bar bsam/ bdag bskyed dang 'brel — /46

btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (geba'i spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod/ bstim pa/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ ā+oṃ yo ga shurnyo sarba dharmaḥsu bhā wa bi shud+dhi3lha/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma/a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rang bzhin gzhi'i kun tu bzang po mthing kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs gar bsnol ba/ e las chos nyid kun tu bzang mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa/ gnyis rka'ang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing / yab rdo rje'i skyil mo krung dang yum brtul zhugs kyi skyil mo krung gis 'khril ba'i yab kyi spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dkar po/ mgrin par rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum ser po/ snying gar rnam par snang mdzad yab yum mthing kha/ lte bar snang ba mtha' yas yab yum dmar po/ gsang bar don yod grub pa yab yum ljang gu/ yab yum thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan thams cad gtso bo yab yum dang mtshungs pa/ lag pa g.yas su lcags kyu ma dkar mo/g.yon pa zhags pa ma ser mo/ rkang pa g.yas la lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ g.yon la dril bu ma (3ba〉dzing gu zhi ba'i rgyan can sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gi thugs dar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i rwa lnga la ā+oṃ hūṃ lha hrīḥ.as mtshan pa'i phyi rol tu ā li bcu drug dang / kā li rnams mar me'i 'phreng ba ltar 'od gsal bar bsam/hūṃ/ kun tu bzang po bde gshegs rigs lnga'i gtso/ /ye shes mchog gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dbyings nas thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul gyi/ /yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes pa steng gi nam mkhar byon pa la/ ā+oṃ/ phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung rab 'byams rgya mtsho rnams/ /ma lus blo yis blangs te gus 'bul gyi/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū tsa me gha sa mu dra ju ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ hūṃ/rang nyid chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /— /47—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'agro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i lha/ /kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: bdag la gnyis su med par thim/ ā+oṃ u3 gis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ā+oṃ bu d+dha a bhi ṣi ñtsa ā+oṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣi ñtsa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣi ñtsa / / ā+oṃ pad+ma a bhi sti ñtsa 10 PROB podze a bhi ṣi ñtsa a: spyi bo'i gnas lngar rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ thugs gar pad zla'i steng gi rdo rje dang sngags rnams las 'od zer byung bas snod bcud thams cad lha dang lha ca zhin du gyur/sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'od (4na)zer gyi 'phro 'dus sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho ston par bsams la/ ā+oṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃ hrī a/ zhes pa sum brgya tsam/ dbyangs gsal so sor nyer gcig re dang / rten 'brel snying po'i mthar sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa shin+ti ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes btags pa tshar bdun tsam bzlas nas 'og tu 'thor rgyu'i me tog byin gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed ni/ ā+oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3rnya/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor pa rnams 'og min gyi zhing dang ston pa dang 'khor du bsams te mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gyi phung po gcig tu 'bar ba'i dbus su seng ge shar du glang po che/ lho ru rta mchog /nub tu rma bya/ byang du shang shang rnams kyi khri'i steng du pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du/ ā+oṃ hūṃ lha smi a las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pas sa bon rnams rim pa bzhin/ 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / ral grir gyur/ e baṃ lo raṃ yaṃ las phyag mtshan ldan gyur/slar yang 'od 'phros snod bcud lha dang lha mor gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba rnams dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pa can mthing kha 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas gzung ba yum dbyings phyug ma mthing kha dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ shar du mi bskyod pa dkar po bdud 'dul gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa yum mā ma (4bska dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan mchog sbyin gyis rin po che 'dzin pa yum sangs — /48

btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (pergyas spyan ma ser mo dang mnyam par spyor ba/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyis pad+ma 'dzin pa yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu skyabs sbyin gyis rgya gram 'dzin pa yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum thams cad kyi phyag na gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūṃ/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sdodapung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs/ zhes pas/ 'og min nas rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems grangs med pa dang / bla ma brgyud pa thams cad dang / phyogasabacu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin byon pa la/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri/ /zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ /phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /bde gshegs ma lus 'khor bcas mchode/ /oṃ badz+ra pu ma dhu pe/ ā lo ke /rjo/ni wi du/ sha lta 〉snyi/ ā+oṃ/ ye nas 'od gsal cho se sku dag pa la/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku mtshan dpe gzi 'od can/ /bla ma yi dam rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang / /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya (5na〉tsho'i tshogs la bstod/ ā+oṃ badz+ra e gu sha dzaḥ chu badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya ho/ btags grol lha'i skur gsal ba la gnyis su med par thim/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rigs lnga la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ /spyi gtsug tu bzhi a bhi ṣi thu spros/ dpral bar badz+ra astiṇiñtsa hūṃ/ rna ltag g.yas su rat+na a bhi ṇiñtsa lha/ ltag par pad+ma a bhi khiñtsa hrīḥ rna ltag g.yon du dmi a lha ṇiñtsa a/ zhes dbang bskur/ dpral bar ā+oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par snyad mar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par bsam/ yab kyi dgongs pa yum gyi dgongs pa yab yum gnyis med kyi dgongs pa ye shes nyer gcig tshar bdun brtan rjes glegs bam rigs lngar gsal ba 'od du zhu/— 149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheganas 'og min/ bdag ston pa kun bzang / chos a ti'i rgyud/ 'khor sems can thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems su mos nas/ bdag bskyed kyi dus sngags kyis bsgrubs pa'i me rtag gis gtor zhing / rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags rten 'brel snying po dang bcas pa brgya rtsa brgyad brjod nas/ 'bru dang /sman dang / rin po che maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul te/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yi/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /ā+oṃ (5ba badz+ra ra k+ṣe snya// zhes pa dang / me tog la sogs pa phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod la/ bla ma dang rigs lnga'i bstod pa rgyas par byas te/ me tog gis snyim pa bkang la mgrin gcig tu/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa dang / bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ che ge mo bgyi bas thog drangs pa' sems can thams cad smin par mdzad du gsol/ grol bar mdzad du gsol/ gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa gsum dang /rgyud dang bzlas rjes rnams tshar gcig brjod pa'am/ rgyud kyi snying po tshar bdun brjod la/ bkra shis kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas bkra shis brjod par bsams la/ me tog 'thor rol mo dkrol zhing mgrin gcig tu/ bde gshegs mi 'gyur sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /ye shes lnga ldan 'phrin las phun sum tshogs/ /gdod ma'i mgon po rigs lnga'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir phun tshogs shog /'og min ye shes bde chen rgya mtsho'i zhing / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho dpag med tshogs mnga' pas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang bde legs shog /bde chen rigs 'dzin bde gshegs 'gro ba'i yab/ /rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun gyis grub/ /so so'i sku dang ye shes phun tshogs pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang bde legs shog /dga' rab rdo rje shrī sidha dang / /phyon pad+ma 'tsho (6na)rgyal yum dang bcas/ /dngos grub sna tshogs 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang bde legs shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi — /5()

btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (peri bo 'dra/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i shis pa rgya che bar brjod pa'i tshe phyogs bcur bkra shis kyi bdud rtsi dang 'od zer gyi dra bas 'jig rten thams cad grol te sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la gnas par bsam zhing / ā+oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod dbang bskur na/ dbang phyug rab gnas kyi cho ga tshar gcig bldabs par/ glegs bam rigs lngar gsal ba 'od du zhu mi byed/ dbang gzhan dang ma 'brel bar bskur na khrus nas dbyung / bgegs bskrad/ rin chen sman 'bru'i me tog 'thor/ /gsol btab sgyu 'phrul las/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin/ /rdo rje bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /yang dag don gyi mchog dam pa/ /bdag la mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /bla ma kun bzang dang /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rigs lngar gsal ba la yan lag bcu pa gang 'os byed/ dbang gzhan dang 'brel na 'di yan mi dgos/ dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs dpon slob gnyis gas rgyud lhar bsam/slob ma tha mal du gnas pa'i gnas lngar rim pa bzhin ā+oṃ/ lha/ hūṃ/ khyiḥ a bsgoms pa'i ā+oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ phyi snod kyang ā+oṃ du gyur/ nang bcud kyang ā+oṃ/ gsang ba rang gi phung khams skye mched kyang ā+oṃ du gyur pa la rang sgra dir sgrog par bsams la/ ā+oṃ brgya 'am nyer gcig bzla/des mtshon lha sogs g.yin la yang 'gre/ de'i tshe snang srid longs sku'i zhing (6ba)khams su bsam zhing bla mas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /'khor 'das snang srid rang gi sems/ /gdod nas ma skyes rtsa ba bral/ /stong gsal rig stong chos kyi sku/ /gang shar rang grol sbrul mdud bzhin/ /spang blang gnyis med shes par gyis/ /zhes ngo sprad la/ yang / e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /mig rtse nam mkha'i khams su ltos/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'od gsal zhing / /thig le dbyings dang lu gu rgyud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang chen dbang / /don gyi snying po 'di nyid do/ /zhes pas mdzo sum ngo sprad la/glegs bam lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu/ yig 'bru 'od zer gyi gong bur gyur pa la rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob ma'i spyi bor ā+oṃ gsal btab/ dpral bar rgyud bzhes/ rgyud las 'od zer byung bas bla ma dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i dbang dang byin rlabs thams cad thob par — 151 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebasam la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pus ming 'di zhes bya ba la dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ smon par mdzad du gsol lo/ /grol bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /gang bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /rgyas par mdzad du gsol lo/ /sku rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dza kā ya a bhi ṇiñtsa ā+oṃ/ de bshin du sman gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas mgrin par āḥgasal btab/ rgyud mgrin par bzhag khri yid las/ 'od zer byung bas bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi (7na ji bang byin rlabs thams cad thob par bsams la gong gi tshig rnams brjod/ khyad par du gsung rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dza a stikhiñtsa aḥ /'bru'i maṇ+ḍal phul la/ snying gar hūṃ gsal btab/ rgyud snying gar bzhag /rgyud las 'od zer byung bas bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs thams cad thob par bsams la gong bzhin/ khyad par du thugs rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dza dharma ya a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ de nas dar tshon gyis gril la ga 'ur bcug ste/ 'di dbugs la slebs dgos pas drod dang ma bral bar rtag tu chongs shig ces brjod do/ /de'ang lusang ga yid gsum gyi gnas gsum du btags pas sku gsung thugs gsum du grol bar byed la/ skyes pas mchan khung g.yon dang / bud med kyis g.yas su gdags so/ sngar lung thob myong na snying po gsum brjod/ ma thob na btags grol tshar gcig klog go /dus gzhan du klog ba'i dus tshigs rnam pa brgyad las/ dang po nyi zla gzas 'dzin pa'i tshe phyi nang gi mchod pa bshams la/ rang nyid rnam snang yab yum mthing kha rdo rje skyil krung can 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas 'dzin par bsgoms pa'i lce steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa ā+oṃ gyis mtshan pa bsgoms la byin pa'i dus su bklag ste/ drug gam dgu dag cing gsal bar brjod pa'i rang sgras 'jig rten thams cad khyab cing 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad 'khor ba las grol bar bsam — 152

btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (pemo/ /nyin mtshan (7bskong la zin dus kyi zug pa'i tshe dud 'gro'i rigs la de'i kha zas dang mthun pa'i ston mo dang / sgom pa'i cha la srog 'don dang / 'brug pa'i tshe chos nyid kyi don bsgom par bya ste/ de nyid las/ nyi zla gza' yis zin dus na/ /'di ni lan drug dgu 'am ni/ /'khor lo'i lce yis rab brjod na/ /de'ang sprul pa'i sku dang mnyam/ /'di dus srog 'don dge ba bya/ /dud 'gro'i rigs la ston mo bya/ /chos nyid don la bsgom par bya/ /bklag par byed pa'i dus na yin/ /srog 'don snyoms pa'i de la'o/ /dud 'gro zung pa'i dus na yin/ /bsgom pa zhabrug pa'i dus su bya/ /de ltar su yis byas pa yang / /sprul sku'i yon tan thob pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sa g.yos byung ba'i tshe rang nyid mi bskyod pa yab yum dkar po bdud 'dul gyi phyogs kyang rdo rje 'dzin par bsams pa'i ljags kyi steng na rdo rje rtse gsum pa hūṃ gis mtshan par bsgoms nas/ drug gam bdun brjod pa'i rang sgra dang 'od zer gyis gnod pa dang 'tshe ba thams cad zhi nas rnam par grol bar bsams pa ni byer ba'i dus su bya zhing / rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa la tshogs lo grangs snyoms pa'i dus su bya'o/ /de'ang rnal 'byor pho mo lo grangs gcig la tshogs byas pas tshogs lo grangs 'grub bo/ /'khrug pa'i dus su skye bo la ston mo dang zug pa'i tshe so so'i gnas nas spyan drangs pa yin/ de nyid las/ gal te sa g.yos byung ba'i tshe/ /'di nyid lan drug lan bdun nam/ /yang na lan ni lnga 'am gsum/ /rdo rje'i lce yis bklag par bya/ tshogs ni rnal 'byor lo yi grangs/ /'di yi dus su rab tu btang / /dam tshig (8na〉mchoge ldan rnal 'byor pa/ /tshogs kyi ston mo 'di bzhin bya/ /bklag pa 'byung ba byed dus su/ /tsho gos ni snyoms pa'i dus na bya/ /ston mo de bzhin 'khrug pa'i dus/ /rnal 'byor ba ni zug pa yi/ /dus na so so'i gnas nas bod/ /'di ltar 'byung ba'i khyad par las/ /rnal 'byor de ni thar lam du/ /yang dag nges par 'jug pa yin/ /rdo rje 'chang ba rnams dang ni/ /skal ba yang dag mnyam pa'o/ /gsum pa 'od kyi snang ba byung ba'i tshe rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum ser po mchog sbyin gyis phyag rgyas rin chen bzung bar — 153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebasgoms pa'i lce steng du dung bsam pa las lan lnga 'am gsum mam gcig tu brjod pa'i rang sgra dang / 'od kyi nam mkha' dbyings kun khyab pas 'dod dgu grub cing grol bar bsams te snyoms pa'i dus su bya'o/ /byed pa'i tshe rlung bsgom zhing 'brug pa'i tshe rnal 'byor ma dgu'am bcu gcig la tshogs dang ston mo bya'o/ /snga ma las/ 'od kyi snang ba 'byung ba'i tshe/ /lan lnga gsum dang lan gcig tu/ /dung gi lce yis bklag par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma ni dam tshig can/ /dgu'am bcu gcig man chad la/ /bza' btung rtsub pa'i ston mo bya/ /bklag pa snyoms pa'i dus na yin/ /rlung ni byon pa'i dus na yin/ /ston mo zhabrug pa'i dus na'o/ /'di ltar byas pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ /sprul pa'i sku dang yod mnyam mo/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa sgra byung ba'i tshe rang nyid 'od dpag med yab yum dmar po mnyam bzhag gi steng na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa 'dzin pa'i lte steng du pad+ma bsgoms te/ byer ba'i tshe lan lnga (8bskor ma drug gam bdun du brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad rig pa'i dbang du 'dus shing / rang sgra dang 'od kyis sems can thams cad smin grol du bsam mo/ /snyoms pa la dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa dang / dge slong rnam dag la ston mo zug pa'i tshe bya ba ni/ de las/ sgra ni byung ba'i dus na yang / /lan ni drug dang bdun dang lngar/ /pad+ma'i lce yis bklag par bya/ /'di dus lha la mchod pa 'bul/ /dge slong tshul khrims ldan pa la/ /chos dang ldan pa'i ston mo bya/ /bklag par byed pa'i dus na yin/ /mchod pa de bzhin snyoms pa la/ /dge slong zug pa'i dus na'o/ /'di ltar su yis byas pa de/ /'di yang sprul pa'i sku dang mnyam/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa sad ser byung ba'i tshe/ rang nyid don yod grub pa yab yum ljang gu skyabs sbyin gyis rdo rje rgya gram bzung pa'i lce steng du ral gri bsams te/ zug pa'i dus su lan ci 'grub brjod pa'i rang sgra dang 'od kyi snang srid gang zhing / bar chad zhi nas 'dod pa'i don grub par bsam mo/ /snyom pa'i tshe rol mo sil snyan gyi mchod pa dang / /rnal 'byor ba lnga'am bco lnga gyer dus bos te/ /'khrug dus ston mo bya'o/ /snga ma las/ sad kyis rgyal khams khyab pa'i tshe/ /ral gri'i lce yis 'di brjod na/ /sangs — 154

btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (pergyas yon tan 'di yis thob/ /'di dus sgra yi mchod pa bya/ rnal 'byor lnga'am bco lnga la/ /tshogasakyi ston mo lan bdun bya/ /bklag pa zug pa'i dus na yin/ /mchod pa snyoms pa'i tshe na'o/ /byer ba la ni rnal 'byor bod/ /'khrug pa'i tshe na ston mo bya/ /'di ltar su yis byas pa la/ /sprul pa'i sku yi yon tan thob/ /drug pa rims dang (9na)yams nad byung ba'i tshe don yod grub pa sngar bzhin bsgoms pa'i lte steng du lcags kyu bsams te de las 'od zer gyi tshogs tshad med pa bsam la/ 'khrug pa'i tshe dgu 'am bcu gcig gam bcu dgu brjod pa'i rang sgra dang 'od zer gyis nad rims zhi nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas par bsam mo/ /snyoms pa'i dus su mi rtog pa bsgom zhing / /byer dus byis pa'i ston mo bya ba yang / /de las/ rims dang yams nad byung ba'i tshe/ /dgu dang bcu gcig bcu dgur ni/ /lcags kyu 'a lce yis brjod par bya/ /'di dus mi rtog bsgom par bya/ /byis pa dgu'am bco brgyad la/ /ston mo bya ba rab tu bsngags/ /bklag pa 'khrug pa'i dus na yin/ /bsgom pa snyoms pa'i dus na'o/ /byis pa byer pa'i dus na'o/ /ston mo zug pa nyid la bya/ /de ltar byas pa'i skyes mchog ni/ /'di la sprul sku'i yon tan thob/ /ces so/ /bdun pa mu ge byung ba'i tshe kun bzang yab yum mthing kha mnyam bzhag las 'od zer 'phro ba'i lte steng du zla phyed rdo rje rtse gsum pa gyes pa'i rnam par bsam ste/ byed dus gnyis sam gsum mam lnga brjod pa'i 'od dang sgras 'tshe ba zhi zhing byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par bsam mo/ /snyoms pa la dris mchod cing / 'khrug pa la bshan pa'am mu stegs bos te zug pa la ston mo bya ba ni/ de las/mu ge dag ni byung ba'i tshe/ kha ṭ+wāṃ lce yis 'di brjod na/ /sprul sku'i yon tan 'dzin pa yin/ /lan ni lnga'am gsum gnyis te/ /'di dus dri yi mchod pa bya/ /bshan pa 'am ni mu stegs la/ ston mo bya bar rab tu bsngags/ /bklag pa byer pa'i dus na bya/ /mchod pa snyoms (9ba)pa nyid la'o/ /sdig can 'grug pa nyid la ste/ /ston mo de bzhin zug pa la'o/ /'dis kyang sprul sku'i sa bon 'jog /ces so/ /brgyad pa phyugs nad byung ba'i tshe kun tu bzang mo yab dang mtshungs par bsgoms la zug dus — 155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebargyad dam bcu drug tu brjod pa'i 'od dang rang sgras 'jig rten gyi phyugs nad la sogs pa zhi nas sangs rgyas thob par bsam mo/ /byer dus mar mes mchode cing / snyoms dus dgra bcom pa 'am/med na rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan drangs la/ /'khrug dus ston mo bya ba ni/ de nyid las/ rgyal khams phyugs nad byung ba'i tshe/ /rang byung
