chen po'i yi ge 'di/ /lan brgyad dam ni bcu drug tu/ /rtse gsum lce yis 'di brjod cing / /'di dus ā lo ke mchod bya/ /dgra bcom pa dag bdun la yang / /ston mo bya bar rab tu bsngags/ bklag pa zug pa nyid la yin/ /mchod pa byer ba nyid la bya/ /dgra bcom snyoms pa'i dus na bod/ /zhabrug pa la ni ston mo bya/ /'di ltar byas pa'i skyes bu ni/ /sprul pa'i sabon nges par 'jog /'di la the tshom bya mi rung / /nges par 'bras bu dam pa thob/ /ces so/ /de'ang byer ba dang zug pa la sogs pa'i dus ni/ skabs 'dir nyin mtshan phrugs gcig gis brtsi ba yin te/ de'ang nyin dus kyi nam langs nas dros po che'i bar du byed pa'o/ /de nas gung la ma sleb par zug pa'o/ /gung mthing po ni snyoms pa'o/ /grib bsil phebs nas nyi ma nub pa'i bar ni 'khrug pa'o/ /mtshan dus kyi lhod byer ba/ srod yol zug pa nam phyed snyoms pa tho rangs zhakhrug pa'o/ /de ltar nyin mtshan gyi cha gang la rtags de nam byung ba'i byer zug gi rim pa dang sbyar la klog pa dang /bsgom pa dang / bod (10na)pa dang / tshogs kyi ston mo rnams bya ba yin no/ /'di dag gi sgom rigs ni gnad yig las byung ba bzhin bkod do/ /gzhan yang nya stong tshes brgyad dang / tshes bcu nyi shu lnga'i nyin mtshan la tshogs dang gtor ma bshams te/ rnal 'byor ba dam tshig can rnams 'dus nas bklags te/ tshogs la rol bas snang ba'i 'phel tshad dang / rtogs pa dang ting nge 'dzin skye zhing /nyams chags thams cad bskang ba dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa'i dus bzang po la bklags par bya/ bklag thabs ni bi ma la'i yang tig gi rgyab yig las shes par bya/ phan yon ni/lus la bcangs pa tsam gyis dge ba bye ba 'bum du 'gyur du 'phel zhing / nad dang gdon dang bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa dang / gang du bzhugs tshad mchod rten du 'gyur pas 'gro ba de nyid la —136

btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (gemakha' 'gro la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod cing dngos grub ster ba dang / phas kyi rgol bas mi tshugs pa dang / ye shes kyi snang ba gong du 'phel bas/ rig pa'i gtan srid zin pa dang / /bar dor rang ngo shes pa dang / /sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'grub pa la sogs pa ste/ sangs rgyas sras gcig las/ 'di yang 'gro ba sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes pa dang / dus gnad nges pa las/ 'di nyid bcangs pa tsam gyisakyang / /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba la/ /the tshom bya bar ci zhig dgos/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa las gzhan pas bcangs kyang grol nus te/ de nyid las/ byol song gzugs sam bud med dam/ /skye ba dman pa'i sems can gyis/ /'di dang bral ba ma byas na/ /nges par sku gsum 'bras bu thob/ /ces pa (10brkong / gal te byol song mgul du 'di/ /btags na de nyid kyang grol na/ /'gro ba mi rnams smos ci dgos/ /zhes so/ /'di su la snang ba de nyid skal ldan grol ba'i rigs can yin te/ dga' dang 'ga' las thams cad la snang ba'ang bsod nams kyis bsags pa la mi shong bas mi snang ba yin par/ de nyid las/ de yi phyir na gsang tshig 'di/ /thun mong nyid du 'phrad pa min/ /rigs ldan skyes bu skal tshe bas/ /'ga' la 'di nyid snang ba las/ /kun gyis mthong ba ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /'di nyid 'phrad pa'i sems can de gzugs brnyan cig 'dug kyang re zhig las kyis de ltar 'gyur mod/ rig pa'i ngo bo 'gro ba bzang ngan gang du'ang ma grub pas las 'di dang phrad pas grol nas rig pa bzhi la grol ba yin no/ /blun po kha cig dud 'gro la btags pas grol na dang cha byad de/ sems can thams cad la btags pas chog mod/ grol ba'i rtags ci yod/ lus ni ma 'gyur bar 'dug /zer ba ni log lta bdud chos mkhan tshig tsam shes pa skal med rtog ge ba'i rigs yin te yang dag pa'i rgyud chen por nges pa'i don du gsungs la/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ rigs sngags dang / sman dang / mkhyud dpyad dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung pa'i mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs dang ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod yul ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rdo rje 'chang gis thabs khyad — 157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepar can zab mo'i rten 'brel 'di nyid bla na med pa'i rig sngags su mdzad pas grol nges pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi thabs ni tshad med de btags pas grol pa yang mkhyen dgos so/ /ma mkhyen na sangs (11na)rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /grol ba sems grol ba ste/gshis rig pa'i ngang du phyin pa yin mod/ lus de sngar dang mi 'dra bar 'gro gar dgos/ dgra bcom pa rnams kyang grol ba yin mod/ lus 'gyur bar ma gsungs la/ rgyan yod med gnyis su gsungs pas/ grol ba la da lta rdzu 'phrul dngos su ston nus pas kyang ma khyab bo/ /dper na phyin ci log gi klan ka khyi zug pa spang pa'i 'os ma yin kyang / skal ldan kha cig tshig des mgo 'khor nas the tshom za ba bzlog pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /nges pa'i don la yid ches nas bsod nams tshad med pa'i phyir ro/ /ye shes grub pa'i rgyud las/ chos la sdang ba nges gsal ba/ /bsod nams 'bras bu gting dpag med/ /ces pa ltar yin no/ /de'i phyir 'di nyid 'chi dus su lus la yod pa'i sems can de sdig can yin las zad nas 'khor ba'i kha mi brgyud par grol te/ dus gnad nges pa las/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /'di nyid lus la gnas pa la/ /rigs drug skye ba rnam bzhi yi/ /grong khyer du ni 'jug mi srid/ ces so/ /de'ang gzhan la gsangs nas bcangs pas phan yon chen po thob ste/ de nyid las/ gal te 'di nyid snang ba'i mis/ /'di nyid yod par sus gzhan la/ /smra bar byed pa'i mi de yis/ /rang gi 'bras bu bklag par byed/ /de yi phyir na rang byung gi /yi ge 'di ni yod pa yi/ /tshig gi zur tsam brjod mi bya/ /ma gsangs dngos grub mi 'byung la/ /gsangs pas dngos grub phun sum tshogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas me tog 'thor/ (11ba)rab gnas dbang bskur 'jug pa bde bar byed na/ bdag mdun gnyis ka kun bzang dam rdor sems gtso rkyang gis la thus par mdzad pa'i phyag len yod do/ /a ti'i gdams pa nyams su bstar ba yi/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i lam gyi cha rkyen du/ /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas chos lnga'i nang tshan gyi/ /btags grol rgyud drug kun bzang dgongs pa'i bcud/ /mtshams med la sogs sdig lhung khur po ches/ /— 158

btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (nge/mnar yang 'di phrad ngan song lta ci smos/ /srid mtsho'i mtha' bral thar pa'i gling bgrod gtam/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i grong du dar dir gleng / /bsod nams byas 'di'i mtho ris chu gtsang gis/ /rigs drug rgyud la gos pa'i las nyon dri/ /nyer bkrus sems nyid don gyi rdo rje sems/ /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces btags grol gyi dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi chog sgrigs mu thi la'i 'phreng ba zhes pa 'di ni mkha' 'gro yang tig gi gzhung gtso bor bzung bla ma yang tig nas kyang kha bkang ste pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gsung rgyun ltar 'khrug bsdebs su za hor gyi ban+de gang shar rang grol gyis lcags bya hor zla brgyad pa'i gral tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed du ma la blo gros kyi snang ba dkar ba mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //sarba maṅga lo/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemakha' 'gro bsun bzlog gi bcas bgoms ci 'dod rtse dga' gsar glu/ zhes bya ba bzhugs/mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog la rgyas pa dkyil 'khor la brten na/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i yas rnams gzhung dang dpe ris go bstun te dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la 'god/ bsdus pa gtor ma la brten kyang dbyibs mtshungs/ 'bring po mdos la brten pa 'di lag len rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa'i dbang du byas/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang la yang bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro dgos pa dri med bsun bzlog sogs la mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la brten par bshad kyang / gter kha 'og ma dang rat+na gling pa sogs la zhi khro lta bur brten pa dang / bla ma zhi drag bka' brgyad phur pa sogs gang 'os zhig 'thad par bshad pas sa yul gang 'os su rdul tshon dang ras bris lta bu'am mi spro na/ sku rten/sman rag gtor gsum mchod pa tsam gyis 'thus/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter srung gzhis bdag rnams kyi gtor ma dang tshogs 'khor bsham/ mdun bskyed la rdul tshon gyi ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla sogs rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa bris/ de'i steng an bdar lta bu'i khar sa spyin po la ri rab bang rim bdun (2na7rtsegs su byas pa'i bang rim dang po'i steng du mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug 'phyar nyid / g.yon thod khrag thugs gar 'dzin pa/ dar dmar gyi stod g.yogs dang stag sham/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa thad sga mi lpags kyi spu len gong rmed srab mthur sprul gyis spras pa'i bong bu'i steng du phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du mkha' 'gro sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas khram shing 'phyar zhing g.yon nad rkyal/ dar dmar gyi stod g.yogs dang re lde'i sham thabs zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis sga srab sogs gong dang 'dra ba'i dre'u la zhen pa/ gtso mo'i rgyab tu mkha' 'gro sngon mo g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con/ g.yon thod — 160

mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog gi bcas bzhoms ci 'dod rtse dga' gsar glu/ nang ma (pekhrag /dar ljang gi stod g.yogs dang dar dmar gyi sham thabs can/ gong gi chas dang mtshungs pa'i rta la snyan pa/ de'i mtha' skor du gar mkhan bcu gsum/ bang rim gnyis par mchod lha bcu gsum/bang rim gsum par/ rma bya/ bya rgod/ khra/ bdud bya/ ne tso/ shang shang / (2bskyo ta/ bya nag /gong mo/ khyim bya/ bya glag /rtse mo/ bya rog gis mtsho ni pa'i sgro gzhog nag shas che ba'i rigs/ bang rim bzhi par seng ge /stag /gzig /g.yi/ dom/ dred/ spyang ki /sbre/ sre mong / phag /ce spyang / 'phar ba/wa sogs kha dog dmar shas che ba'i gcan gzan gyi rigs/ bang rim lnga par mar me dang lha bshos spel ma bcu gsum/ bang rim drug par 'brug /glang / rta/ rkyang / dreg bong bu/ gcod/ g.yag /ra lug /byi ba/ sha ba/ dgo ba/ bang rim bdun par stag dang mda' dar spel ba bcu gsum re/ khor yug tu rta/ dres glang po sogs srog chags sna tsho gis la khal bkal ba dang / phye sna tsho gos las byasapa'i ngar mi rnams brgya gsum re/ 'bru sna/ ja sna/ ras sna/ dar sna/ sman sna/ zas sna/ rin po che sna lnga/ lho rdzas/ byang rdzas/ spos sna/ gsur sna/ mi rta glang seng rma bya sogs kyis gtsos pa'i sha sna'i rigs/ khrag sna/ ra rgya bo'i khrag mtshal bya dmar po/ bse byad khra bo dang sngon btags pa/ 'brang rgyas dbus skyu/ ting lo/ sman pa/ mkhris pa/ bya nag sgo nga / bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs yas kyi rigs tshogis tshad/ lcags ri la pho gdong / mo gdong bcu gsum re/ nyi zla 'ja' ris/ khram ris/shing gri yul mkhar ris/ rnam rgyang / mda' 'phang bcu gsum re 'god pa rgyas pa'i lugs yin cing /'bring la bdun/ bsdu na gsum byed par bshad/ lcags ri'i tshab la (3na〉sgom khrid rnam rgyal mda' 'phang shing byang sogs btsugs na mdzes shing / zur bzhin 'phan gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi sogs 'dzugs/ sgrom khri mi byed na lcags ri'i phyogs mtshams gang 'os su 'dzugs/ mdos kyi g.yas su sha sna'i gtor mar sha rdzar dang / g.yon du khrag sna tshogs kyi gtor ma rgyan med gnyis sgar gri lam dang dmar rtsi/ gtor zor khrag zor bshan pa'i mda' zor/ khrag zor dang yugs sa'i me zor khrag zor dang dme i rdo zor/ khrag zor dang yungs zor/ sman raka /chu —161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheganyis sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi nang gi mchod pa tshar re/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro thad kyi gang 'os su cog tshe'i steng du mkha' 'gro 'bul gtor lnga dkyil nag mtha' dmar rgyan gang legs kyi mdun du glud chung re/bsgrub bya'i lus spos chus bkrus la 'bru lnga'i phye la brdzis pa lus tshad tsam mam/ chung na khru gang tsam/mdos gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar glud rdzas nam mkha' rgyang bu pho gdong mo gdong sogs tshang pa'i mthar glud bran bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba/ kham sa'i bud med bzhis zur bzhi nas 'debs pa'i tshul byed/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar du seng gdong dkar mo/ lhor phag gdong ser mo/ nub tu khyi gdong dmar mo/ byang du spyang gdong ljang gu rnams kyi phyag g.yas na gdugs dang / g.yon na rgyal mtshan/ shar lho stag gdong ma/ lho nub tu 'ug gdong ma/ nub byang du khyi gdong ma/ byang shar du phag gdong ma so so'i rang mdog g.yas gling bu dang/ g.yon (3ba tha tog 'dzin pas bskor ba rnams stan dkar po'i steng du 'jog /mkha' 'gro brtan bzhugs la dgos pa'i phod mda' dar kha dog sna lnga gang rung re btags pa/ dngul phor ram dkar yol tshe chang gis bkang bar mar gyi ze brog sbran pa lnga/ phye mar lnga/ tshe dpag med kyi sku/ tshe mdo/ pad spungs/ dung dkar/ phur pa/ mkha' 'gro lnga rgyan dang ldan pa/ dar lam kha dog lnga/ rkang gling / rol mo/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ thod rnga/ sman raka /g.yab dar sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du bgyis/ tshogs tha ma yan song nas/ bsangs gzhung las byung ba ltar sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis mdos yas mchod sogs yo byad thams cad byin gyis brlabs rjes/ ho/ dgongs su gsol nas/ ma mo'i tsho gos rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol gyis bar song nas/ brtan bzhugs 'bul yul gang yin khrir spyan drangs/mkha' 'gro dang dar lam bsgrigs/ zhu ba zhu lan ka tho ltar dpe nang bzhin btang thog steng nas mkha' 'gros gnang ba sbyin/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs kyi glud cung zad 'degs pa dang bcas bsun ma'i tshogs rnams zhes sogs kyis glud bsngo/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis gri thogs la dar lam rnams rim par bcad pa'i mthar bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod ces phud gtor/ dar lam sdud — /62

mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog gi bcas bskoms ci 'dod rtse dga' gsar glu/ nang ma rtogepar so so'i tshig dang bstun pa'i gtor ma gdeng tsam dang phud gtor/ dar lam bsgyur ba la so so'i mjug tu gser skyems gtor zhing gtor ma phyir dor/ mkha' 'gro (4na)rnams nang du 'ongs tetshogs la rol/ shar gyi gling 'di ci'i dang gling zhes sogs mkha' 'gro so so'i brtan bzhugs dang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku 'bul ba sogs lnga po spel mar mdzad/ de nas mdos gyer bzlog gi gzhung phyag rgya stong nyid chen po zhes pa nas/ snang srid lha 'dre'i lam bstan snang pa'i dgra la bstan gyi bar song rjes gser skye mas gtore/ de dag gong gi tshig rnams su thod rnga/ mi rkang / dung chen gsur dung gtong ba sogs byed thub pa rnams tshig dang bstun ste mdzad srol 'dug /lhag ma dang chad tho 'bul/ mdos dang zor rnams rol mo dang bcas te phyir btang / tshe chog la brten pa'i brtan bzhugs 'bul lo/ /mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog gi bcas bsgoms ci 'dod rtse dga' gsar glu zhes pa'ang za hongabazhes bris// //sarba maṅga lo/ —163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebasun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag thod phreng rtsal/ /zab gter bstan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi dbang / /drin can blo mchog rdo rjer gus btud nas/ /bsun bzlog lag len zhabrugs sde bas 'di ltar ro/ /de la 'dir mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog gi yi ge gter kha sna tshogs nas byung ba'i nang tshan gter kha 'og ma'i bla ma sprul sku'i sgrub pa'i las phran las byon pa'i bla ma zhi ba'i chos sder bzhugs pa gtso bor bkod pa la rab dkyil 'khor/ 'bring mdos/ tha ma gtor mar brten pa'i rim pa mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes las rtogs pa'i dbang du bgyis te bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i spros pa che ba'am bris thang sman raka gtor gsum tsam la brten pa sogs ji ltar yang bla ma zhi drag mkha' 'gro bka' brgyad kyi bye brag sogs kyi las gzhung bsrang ba nas tshogs tha ma'i bar song rjes mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa dang yas rnams la dmigs nas sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams spyan drang zhing mchod pa ni/ ho/ dgongs su gsol/ (2na)spros pa med pa'i dbyings mtha' bral rang bzhin gyi ngang las/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu/ thugs rje sprul pa'i sku/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dam pa 'dir/ spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ka /rigs lnga yab yum sras dang bcas pa dang / /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas la/ dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī sing ha/ pad+ma badz+ra/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub snyi nga po/ in+d+ra bo dhi la sogasarang bzhin gyi grub thob bye ba 'bum dang / sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma lo ka /dha ki lo ka /sarba ḍā ki la sogs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang / ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo nag mo 'khor nag mo — 164

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma (pebye ba'i tshogs dang /mgon po legs ldan srid pa'i pho rgyud dang bcas pa a ra li'i tsho gos ma lus pa thams cad/keng rus gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba 'dir//spyan 'dren gshegs nas bzhugasagasol/phyag 'tshal zhing phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/tshogs 2bdang gtor ma 'bul zhing /sdig pa bshags/rjes su yi rang /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/bskal ba grangs med du mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol/skyabs gsol byang chub chen por bsngo/hūṃ/bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru da:yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma:zhi ba lhun grub pad+ma dang :khro bo ra du byung ba rnams:zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa dang :bha kla rgyan gyi gtor ma dang :rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥsngags 'chang rnal 'byor sku tshe sringasaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog:྅/bcom ldan burnya he ru ga yum mchog burnya kro ti shwa ri ma zhal zas tsho gos kyi mchod pa dang :bha kla rgyan gyi gtor ma dang :rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥsngags 'chang rnal 'byor sku tshe sringasaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog:྅/bcom ldan badz+ra he ru ga:yum mchog rdo rje phag mor bcas:zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa dang :bha yi rgyan gyi gtor ma dang :rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥsngags 'chang rnal 'byor sku tshe sringasaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog://bcom ldan rat+na he ru ga yum mchog rin chen mkha' 'gro ma :zhal zas tsho gis kyi mchod pa dang :bha li rgyan gyi gtor ma dang :rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥsngags yong rnal 'byor sku tshe sringasaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog:lha/bcom ldan pad+ma he ru da:yum mchog pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma 3 na tshe skar zas tshogos kyi mchod pa dang :bha kla rgyan gyi gtor ma dang :rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la:sngags 'chang rnal 'byor sku tshe sringasaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog:྅/bcom ldan dpal chen rkarma he ru da:yum mchog las kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa dang :bha smra rgyan gyi gtor ma dang :rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥsngags 'chang rnal 'byor 5tshe srings:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog //bcom ldan mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med:

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi lha rin chen 'byung gnas yon to mdzod:rnal 'byor dam tshig sku yi gter:don yod grub pa 'phrin las bdag phyogs bcur sangs rgyas thams cad dang :byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho la:zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa dang :bha smra rgyan gyi gtor ma dang :rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la sngags 'chang rnal 'byor sku tshe srings:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog:snyi/rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje dang :'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī sing ha dang :pad+ma badz+ra sar ha ba dang :in+d+ra bo dhi la sogs dang :ji snyed bye ba 'bum gyi tsho gis bcas rnams:gdan pad+ma 'di ru bzhugs su gsol:sngags 'chang bdag la byin gyis glo bos zhal zas tshogis kyi mchod pa dang :bha kla rgyan gyi gtor ma dang :3bsgom lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la:sngags yong rnal 'byor sku tshe sringasaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog:྅/sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa'i he ru ka yi bka' nyan dang :sa brgyad non pa'i srung ma ste:ma gcig lha mo nag mo la:srid gsum nag mo'i tsho gos kyis bskor byang shar mtshams nas spyan 'dren no:rdzu phral stobs kyis gshegs su gsol:nad dang rims kyi bdag mo khyod:mthu stobs rgya 'phrul bsam mi khyab:nag mo bye ba 'bum gyis bskor mo rgyud chos kyi srung ma rnams bsun ma bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol:lha/dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung :legs ldan nag po mgon po ste:ma hā kā la mthu stobs can nag po stong gi tsho gos kyis bskor sha za 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed:ma mo bye ba las la 'khol:lha bdud dmag dpon mas stobs can dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsol:pho rgyud chos skyong srung ma rnams:ma hā kā la'i bka' byung gi bsun ma bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol:྅/sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la skyon yul gyi nub byang mtshams pad+ma ge sar sdong po la:ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags:'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor bran du lha srin sdo brgyad bskor khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol rnal 'byor bdag la dbang zhig bskur byin 4na ) rlabs

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma 6)mthu yi dngos grub stsol: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog: kye/ ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas ye shes mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnyis med mkha' ltar dag pa'i pho brang nas ma dang mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mi mngon dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dbyingasakyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod rnam dag gak+ṣ-i kha yas nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: 'dod dgu lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas: rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum gshegs su gsol: drag po e yi ga 'kha yas nas: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas ging chen ging chung la sogs te: dur khrod bdag po spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ye shes mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol: ma dang mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol las kyi mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rigs kyi mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol: sha za'i mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol ging chen ging chung la sogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol: dur khrod bdag po 'khor bcas gsan cing dgongs su gsol rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol dam tshig mkha' (4ba)'gro gsan cing dgongs su gsol: bstan srung ma mgon gsan cing dgongs su gsol ma mo'i tshogs rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: (ka)zhes mdun bskyed gsal btab cing mchod nas mkha' 'gro'i zhu ba dang gnang ba byin pa logs su gsal: zhu lan ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs kyi 'di skad do/ /kye/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams snyan gson dang : rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu 'di:khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul der nged mi gtong : mkha' 'gro'i yul las sdug pa med 'ja' tshon gur phub legs rgyu med: yang dag brtsis na yal nas 'gro: gnyis med mkha' ltar dag pa'i pho brang der me tog char rgyun 'bab pa yang : yang dag brtsis na yal rgyu yin: mi mngon dbyings kyi pho brang na rin chen gser gyi lding khang yang : yang dag brtsis na zhig rgyu yin: mkha' 'gro bde chen pho brang — 167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shen: mkha' 'gro'i 'du tshogs mang po yang : tshogs dpon dbyings nas byer rgyu yin khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul las sdug pa med: rigs bzang lha yi dpa' bo 'di: khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul du mi gtong khyed rang gshegs: 6)kyi/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams snyan gson dang : 'dod dgu lhun gyisagrub pa'i pho brang na: yid 'ong gter gyi longs spyod kyang : yang dag brtsis na sgyu ma yin drag po e yi gzhal yas kyi thod pa'i sku mkhar brtsegs legs kyang : yang dag brtsis na zhe sdang yin mi lpags bla bre yol pa yang : yang dag brtsis na gti mug yin: tshil chen mar me (5na skong gsal yang : yang dag brtsis na phrag dog yin: sha chen gtor ma spungs pa yang : yang dag brtsis na nga rgyal yin: rak+ta'i mtsho mo 'khyil ba yang : yang dag brtsis na 'dod chags yin rus pa'i rgyan cha mang po yang : yang dag brtsis na gnad med yin tshil chen dri gsur mnam pa yang : yang dag brtsis na zhim rgyu med dri zhim thos dud sna tshogs kyang: yang ngag brtsis na na bun yin khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul las sdug pa med: mkha' 'gro'i yul las ngan pa med: mkha' 'gro'i yul de dga' rgyu med mkha' 'gro'i yul de spro rgyu med: nged bod kyi yul 'a/sa dga' ba med bod kyi yul las skyid pa med: ci bsam dngos su 'grub pa yod: zas nor longs spyod byasapasachog: dungs pa yid kyisablangs pas chog: rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu 'di: khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul der nged mi gtong : rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes las rang rang gnas su da gshegs shig: (gan kye/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos rnams snyan gson dang : dur khrod dbyings kyi pho brang na dpa' bo'i bro brdung mtshar rgyu med:dpa' mo'i gar byed legs rgyu med bya ngang pa'i skad de snyan rgyu med ngur pa'i skad la spro rgyu med dar dkar rgyal mtshan legs rgyu med 〉 dar nag ru mtshon 'jigs rgyu med: rkang gling smyug gling snyan rgyu med gser gyi nyi ma dro rgyu med dung gi zla ba dkar rgyu med: skar phran tshom bu legs rgyu med:khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul de skyid rgyu med: mkha' 'gro'i (5bsgol du dga' rgyu med rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes las: de bas khyed rang gshegs pa zhu: ltang༄kye/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams snyan gson — 168

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma 9)dang : khyed skyon yul na ya mtshan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che ba yang : yang dag brtsis na zhim rgyu med:bdud rtsi'i zas kyi longs spyod kyang : yang dag brtsis na 'phel rgyu med: ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang der: thengs gcig bzhugs pa skyid rgyu med me rtag man+da ra ba de lan cig mthong bas dga' rgyu med: mdzes pa'i yid 'ong sna tsho gis kyang : skad cig dran pas dga' rgyu med khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul las sdug pa med: 'thab rtsod gnas las thar dus med: sha chen zas kyang zhim rgyu med: rak+ta'i mtsho mo zhim rgyu med: rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu 'di khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul der mi gtong ngo : rin chen dngul gyi sku mkhar la kha bad dung las byas pa yang : yang dag brtsis na 'dus byas yin: rin chen kyi zangs sku mkhar de byu ru kha bad byas na yang : bltas pas ngo mtshar che rgyu med khyed skyon yul la smon rgyu med: nged bod kyi yul las dga' ba med ci byed rang dbang thob pas skyid: rigasabazang lha yi skyes bu 'di khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul du mi gtong ngo : rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:rang rang gnas su da bzhud cig: 6)kyi/ mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos rnams snyan gson dang : bya rigasaskad snyan 'di na yod: gcan gzan sna tsho gos 'di na yod: rgyan cha sna tsho gos 'di na yod thod pa ltag sprod 'di na yod dung chen (6na)rkang gling 'di na yod sil snyan sgra snyan 'di na yod: yid 'ong dkor mdzod 'di na yod khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul la smon rgyu med: khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul der nged mi 'gro: rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu 'di dpa' bo'i pho nya byed mi khom dpa' mo'i tsho gis dpon byed mi khom khyed mkha' 'gro'i yul der nged mi gtong : rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la khyed rang gnas su da bzhud cig: (me)bye/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams snyan gson dang : bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi sha khrag rus pa'i glud bzang 'bul: rin chen 'bru yi phye dkar la: gzhi mdo gtsang ma'i chu yis bran drag po'i gtor ma zur gsum bcos: dmar tsho gos sha rus ri ltar spungs:bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho dang : dar tshon sna lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan mtshan ldan shug pa'i byang bu la bya bzang dkar mo'i spu yis brgyan 'dod yon lnga ru byin gyis brlabs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs — 169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shel glud du 'bul: mnyes shing tshim par mdzad du gsol: tshe yi dus la babs na yang : lo gsum bar du bsgol thob cig rkyen ngan thams cad bzlog tu gsol glud 'di bzhes la dgyes par mdzod bu lon lan chags byang bar mdzod phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig: (ja)sngon gyi tshon ma rnamasal/ kye/ bsun ma'i tsho gis rnams snyan gson dang : sangs rgyas dgongs pa las byung ba'i sku glud rin chen rgyan can 'di: mkha' dang dbyings las 'das pa med: (6ba〉5tshan dpes rab brgyan gzi brjid 'bar rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mi gnyis yon bdag 'di yi sku tshad yin: ngo mtshar can gyi glud 'di 'bul: rgyu sbyor yon bdag che ge yi: 'gro don bstan pa rgyas pa dang : sems can myang 'das dbyings su bkod: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs ba: gzugs sku yul 'dir bzhugs par zhu:mkha' 'gro'i dar lam gcod pa ni: dpal ldan bla ma 'di nyid kyi/ rgyal po sogs skye bo mig da rnams skabs thob sbyar/ lag tu gri thogs la 'di skad do/ hūṃ/ shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gdan nas sku bskyod la: dkar mo dung gi thor tshugs can gnas bzang dur khrod nyams re dga'aḥ gos bzang g.yang gzhi brjid re che skyogs bzang bhan dha mtshan re bzang : skyems bzang rak+ta bcud re che: zas bzang me sa ro re bda' dam tshig bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro phyag na shel gyi ral gri bsnams: shar phyogs dar lam dkar po chod: ྅/ lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ser mo gser gyi thor tshugs can: dur khrod gnas nas sku bskyod la: gnas bzang dur khrod nyams re dga' gos bzang g.yang gzhi brjid re che skyogs bzang bhan dha mtshan re bzang : skyems bzang rak+ta bcud re che: zas bzang mo sa ro re bda': dam tshog bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro phyag na gser gyi ral gri bsnams: lho yi dar lam ser po chod: ྅/ nub phyogs pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:dmar mo zangs kyi thor tshugs can dur khrod gnas nas sku (7na7skyod la gnas bzang dur khrod nyams re dga' gos bzang g.yang gzhi brjid re che: sgrogs bzang bhan dha mtshan re bzang : skyems bzang rak+ta bcud re che: zas bzang me sa ro re bda' : dam tshig bsrung zhid mkha' la 'gro: phyag na —170

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma 'dazangs kyi ral gri bsnams: nub kyi dar lam dmar po chod: ྅/ byang phyogs las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: sngon mo g.yu yi thor tshugs can dur khrod gnas nas sku bskyod la: gnas bzang dur khrod nyams re dga': gos bzang zhing chen brjid re che skyogs bzang bhan dha mtshan re bzang : skyems bzang rak+ta bcud re che zas bzang me sa ro re bda': dam tshig bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro: phyag na g.yu yi ral gri thogs byang gi dar lam sngon po chod: ྅/ dbus phyogs bzhi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: smug mo mchong gi thor tshugs can: dur khrod gnas nas sku bskyod la: gnas bzang dur khrod nyams re dga': gos bzang zhing chen brjid re che: skyogs bzang bhan dha mtshan re bzang : skyemasabazang rak+ta bcud re che: zas bzang me sa ro re bda' dam tshig bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro phyag na mchong gi ral gri thogs: dbus kyi dar lam sna lnga chod: khyed cag gzhan dang mi 'dra yi khyed cag gzhan dang 'dra rgyu la sngon tshe dpal gyi dam mnos pas dpal gyi gtor len srung ma yin: de nasaslob dpon pad+ma yis: dam la btags pa'i gtor len yin: da lta rnal 'byor (7bskobang phyug gis: thugs la btags pa'i gtor len yin bka' la btags so bka' rtags kyis: dam la btags so dam tshig skongs: thugs la btags so thugs dam bzhes: mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mkha' 'gro'i dar lam brkyang ba chod: nad sna rims sna dgra la sgyur: bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod: ces brjod/ phud gtor la dar lam bcad do: sam ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ de nasadar lam sdud pa la lag tu gser skyems thogs la 'di skad do: ྅/ shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma mi sdug sprul pa'i gzugs ston cing : skye 'gro dam tshig nyams chags shor khyed kyi bka' chad bar chad btang : gzung 'dzin dar gyi thag pa btags: cho 'phrul bka' chad ma btang bar: phud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la shar phyogs dar lam dkar po sdus shar gyi dal kha bsgyur du gsol kli/ lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma mi sdug sprul pa cir yang ston skye 'gro yongs la nad char 'bebs: dam tshig spang blang shor ba la: nad rigs gdug pa sna tshogs btang :— 17/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegazung 'dzin dar gyi mdud pas bcings phud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs dar lam ser po sdus nad kha rims kha phyi la sgyur: lho yi dal kha bsgyur du gsol: ྅/ nub phyogs pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma thugs kyi sprul pa sna tshogs ston nyams chags shor ba'i gang zag la 'thibs nad spyo ba'i nad kyang btang : dar gyi mdud (8na〉 dam pos bcings: ri ltar spungs pa'i gtor ma bzhes: bar gcod bdud du ma 'bab par: nub phyogs dar lam dmar po bsdus: bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol: ྅/ byang phyogs las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: khros pa'i cha lugs cir yang ston: dam tshig gnyan po nyams pa la: byings rmugs lkugs pa'i nad kyang btang : dar gyi rgya mdud theg pa btags: 'byor par bshams pa'i mchod pa bzhes: byang phyogs dar lam sngon po sdus: bdud mo'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur lha/ dbus su burnya rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ye shes thugs la rtog pa mi mnga' yang : sku yi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed: sems can skye 'gro nyon mongs la:gdug pa'i dmugs gza' bying 'thibs btang : dar gyi thag pa btags pa 'di phun sum tshogs pa'i bka' gtor 'bul: mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad ma 'bebs shig: dar thag rin chen sna lnga sdus:bar chad cho 'phrul phyi la sgyur: zhes dar lam sdud par bya ba'i ti ga'o: de nas phud thogs la dar lam bsgyur par bya ste: bh+yo: shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: phud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes shig: gnas mchoge 'di ru byin phob la: bar chad sol la dngos grub stsol: dar lam brkyang ba da sgyur zhig: bh+yo: lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma phud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes shig dngos grub char ltar dbab tu gsol rkyen dang bar chad khyod kyis gsol dar lam brkyang ba da (4)sgyur zhig: bh+yo nub pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma phud dang ga lha me ma 'di bzhes shig phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: mkha' 'gro'i dar lam da sgyur zhig: bh+yo: byang las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma phud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes shig mkha' 'gro bdud du ma 'bab par: dar lam brkyang ba da sgyur zhig: bh+yo: dbus sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma phud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes — /72

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma (pe shig: mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol: dar lam brkyang ba da sgyur zhig: tsho gos la longs spyod :mkha' 'gro lnga'i brtan bzhugs ni: 7 shar gyi gling 'di ci'i dang gling : shar gyi gling ni me tog gling :me tog rang yang dkar po'i gling : mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni ci'i dang rigs: mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni rdo rje rigs sku mdog dkar gsal mdangs dang ldan rang rang dpa' bo yab dang bcas: phyag gi gar stabs lings se ling : rus pa'i rgyan drug sil li li: zhabs kyi bro brdung khrigs se khrig:'khor kyang rang 'dra 'bum phrag ste: dpa' bo khyed zhing gdan 'dren yin: gu ru badz+ra thod phreng rtsal:zhi ba'i 'phrin las mthar phyin cing : rdo rje slob dpon bka' gnyan pas: da ni mi yi yul du bzhugs: mkha' 'gro rnams la de bzlas nas spun tsho mi sdod log nas 'gro: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe bkug nas tshe dar 'di phyag tu 'dzin par zhu tshe chang 'di zhal du gsol ba zhu: 'o skom thugasal bstim par zhu sku tshe mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs lo brgya'i bar du (9na tha rtan par bzhugs:de'i rjes rdo rje slob dpon gyis tshe dpag med kyi sku sogs rim bzhin thogs la: kye: sems can kun gyi mgon gyur bla ma rje phyon mkha' spyod gnas su mi bzhud par 'gro ba'i don du bod yul bzhugs par zhu bu slob gdul bya smin grol mdzad par zhu: 'chi med grub pa'i sku rten 'di bzhes la: 'chi med rigs 'dzin ngang la bzhugs su gsol: tshu〉 lho yi gling 'di ci'i dang gling : lho yi gling ni me tog gling : me tog rang yang ser po'i gling : mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni ci'i dang rigs:mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni rin chen rigs: sku mdog ser gsal mdangs dang ldan rang rang dpa' bo yab dang bcas phyag gi gar stabs lings rtse ling : rus pa'i rgyan drug sil li li: zhabs kyi bro brdung khrigs se khrig: 'khor kyang rang 'dra 'bum phrag ste: dpa' bo khyed zhing g.yin gdan 'dren yin: gu ru rat+na thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mthar phyin cing : rdo rje slob dpon bka' gnyan pas da ni mi yi yul du bzhugs: mkha' 'gro rnams la de ci spun tsho mi sdod log nas 'gro: lho yi phyogs nas tshe bkug nas: tshe dar 'di phyag tu 'dzin par zhu tshe chang 'di zhal du — 173—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegasol bar zhu: 'o skom thugs la bstim par zhu: sku tshe mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs: lo brgya'i bar du brtan par bzhugs: kye: sems can kun gyi mgon gyur bla ma rje skyon mkha' spyod gnas su ma bzhud par: (9ba 'gro ba'i don du bod yul bzhugs par zhu bu slob gdul bya smin grol mdzad par zhu tshe mtha' yas pa'i gsung rten 'di bzhes la: 'chi med rigs 'dzin ngang la bzhugs su gsol: kye nub kyi gling 'di ci'i dang gling : nub kyi gling ni me tog gling : me tog rang yang dmar po'i gling : mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni ci'i dang rigs: mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni pad+ma'i rigs sku mdog dmar gsal mdangs dang ldan: rang rang dpa' bo yab dang bcas: phyag gi gar stabs lings se ling : rus pa'i rgyan drug sil li li: zhabs kyi bro brdung khrigs se khrig: 'khor kyang rang 'dra 'bum phrag ste: dpa' bo khyed zhing gzhan gdan 'dren yin: gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi 'phrin lasamathar phyin cing : rdo rje slob dpon bka' gnyan pas: da ni mi yi yul du bzhugs: mkha' 'gro rnams la de bzlas nas spun tsho mi sdod log nas 'gro nub kyi phyogs nas tshe bkug nas tshe dar 'di phyag tu 'dzin par zhu: tshe chang 'di zhal du gsol bar zhu: 'o skom thugs la bstim par zhu: sku tshe mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs: lo brgya'i bar du brtan par bzhugs: kye: sems can kun gyi mgon gyur bla ma rje skyon mkha' spyod gnas su ma bzhud par 'gro ba'i don du bod yul bzhugs par zhu bu slob gdul bya smin grol mdzad par zhu: mi 'gyur chos sku'i thugs rten 'di la bzhes la:'chi med rigs 'dzin ngang la bzhugs su gsol: kye byang (10na8 gling 'di ci'i dang gling : byang gi gling ni me tog gling : me tog rang yang ljang gu'i gling : mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni ci'i dang rigs:mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni las kyi rigs: sku mdog ljang gsal mdangs dang ldan: rang rang dpa' bo yab dang bcas: phyag sko gar stabs lings se ling : rus pa'i rgyan drug sil li li: zhabs kyi bro brdung khrigs se khrig: 'khor kyang rang 'dra 'bum phrag ste: dpa' bo khyed zhing g.yin gdan 'dren yin: gu ru kurma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i 'phrin las mthar phyin cing :rdo rje slob dpon bka' gnyan — 174

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma (pepas: da ni mi yi yul du bzhugs: mkha' 'gro rnams la de bzlas nas spun tsho mi sdod log nasa'agro byang gi phyogs nas tshe bkug nas tshe dar 'di phyag tu 'dzin par zhu: tshe chang 'di zhal du gsol bar zhu: 'o skom thugs la bstim par zhu: sku tshe mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs: lo brgya'i bar du bzhugs par zhu: kye sems can kun gyi mgon gyur bla ma rje phyon mkha' spyod gnas su ma bzhud par 'gro ba'i don du bod yul bzhugs par zhu bu slob gdul bya smin grol mdzad par zhu:g.yas 'khyil yon tan rten mchog 'di bzhes la: 'chi med rigs 'dzin ngang la bzhugs su gsol:kye: dbus kyi gling 'di ci'i dang gling : dbus kyi gling ni me rtag gling : me rtag rang yang mthing kha'i gling : mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni ci'i dang rigs: mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni burnya'i rigs sku mdog mthing gsal mdangs dang ldan rang rang dpa' bo yab dang bcas (10ba)phyag gi gar stabasalings se ling : rus pa'i rgyan drug sil li li: zhabs kyi bro brdung khrigs se khrig: 'khor kyang rang 'dra 'bum phrag ste: dpa' bo khyed zhing gzhan gdan 'dren yin gu ru burnya thod phreng rtsal zhi rgyasadabang drag 'phrin las mthar phyin cing : rdo rje slob dpon bka' gnyan pas: da ni mi yi yul du bzhugs: mkha' 'gro rnams la de bzlas nas spun tsho mi sdod log nas 'gro: dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe bkug nas tshe dar 'di phyag tu 'dzin par zhu tshe chang 'di zhal du gsol bar zhu: 'o sgom thugasal bstim par zhu: sku tshe mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs: lo brgya'i bar du brtan par bzhugs kye:sems can kun gyi mgon gyur bla ma rje skyon mkha' spyod gnas su ma bzhud par 'gro ba'i don du bod yul bzhugs par zhu bu slob gdul bya smin grol mdzad par zhu phur pa 'phrin las rten mchog 'di bzhes la: 'chi med rigs 'dzin ngang la bzhugs su gsol: sngags pa la/ mthu stobs nusartsal ldan pa'i sngags 'chang khyed: phyon mkha' spyod gnas su ma bzhud par 'gro ba'i don du bod yul bzhugs par zhu bu slob gdul bya smin grol mdzad par zhu skyes pa la/ rigs bzang lha srasadapa' mdzangs skyes bu khyed: ཿ:sde rigs 'khor bcas skyong bar mdzad du gsol bud med la/— 175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherigs ldan lha yi sras mo dam pa khyed: 0bu nor longs spyod spel bar mdzad du gsol: zhes sogs rig bas dpyad nas 'don pa bsgyur: de nas mdos gyir ba ni/ kye/ phyag rgya stong nyid chen po 'dis:ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog (11na)byams dang snying rje'i sems bskyed kyis: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog bstod bskul 'phrin las sna tsho gis kyis dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog dar sna lnga yi mchod pa yis rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog: thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgra yis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog: rin chen sna lnga'i rgyan cha 'dis: rin cen mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog sha chen spos kyi bha li 'dis pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog:sman sna tshang ba'i dam rdzas 'dis las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog: mchod pa'i bye brag sna tsho gis kyi sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog rkang gling skad dang sgra dbyangs kyis rigasalnga mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog: sha sna tshang ba'i gtor ma 'dis: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog: khrag sna tshang ba'i gtor ma 'dis sha za mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog tshil chen gsur gyi dud pa 'dis ging che ging chung la sogs dang : dur khrod bdag po'i bsun ma bzlog dung chen rkang gi gling bu dang : mtshan ldan gsang ba'i rnga chung 'dis: sna tsho gis mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog:mi lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi 'dis ma mo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog rgya ma ra yi gsur dud 'dis dgra lha'i rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog: bse byang khra pho dar brgyan 'dis: rgyal po rnams kyi bsun ma bzlog glang chen khyung dang seng ge 'brug: rtsal chen seng ge la sogs kyis: lha yi rgyal po'i bsun ma (11ba〉zlog: mtshal bya la sogs skad snyan bya rigs kyis gnyan gyi rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog skyung kha rog po la sogs pa: gshog nag bya rigs thams cad kyis bdud kyi rgyal po'i chad pa bzlog: rta rkyang dre'u la sogs pa: rdog rigs sems can thams cad kyis dmu yi rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog stag gzig gung la sogs pa yi gcan gzan ri bkra thams cad kyis:gnod sbyin rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog: wa dang 'phar ba la sogs pa gcan gzan dmar po thams — 176

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma 6)cad kyis btsan gyi rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog: dar sna ba dan sna tsho gos dang : nag po'i rgyan cha sna tshogs kyis srin po'i rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog: sha ba dgo ba la sogs pa: ri dwags gzugasabarnyan sna tshogs 'dis sa bdag rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog: g.yag lug ra gsum la sogs pa nor phyugs gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'dis: yul gyi rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog nyi zla 'ja' tshon bris pa 'dis: gza' bdud chen po'i bsun ma bzlog: 'brang rgyasang lo zhal dkar 'dis sman phran rnams kyi bsun ma bzlog: gser g.yu rin chen khal bkal 'dis: dkor bdag rnams kyi bsun ma bzlog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'dis sman mo gangs sman mtsho sman dang : nags sman sa yi lha mo dang : lcags kyi lha mo me'i lha mo dang : 'byung bzhi lha mo'i bsun ma bzlog: ri rab rtse la bzhugs pa yi lha chen tshangs pa la sogs te lha'i sde tsho gos rnams kyi bsun ma bzlog lha yi g.yul ngo (12na'i sgyur zhig: ri rab rtsa bar bzhugs pa yi: sa bdag gtsang kun bsun ma bzlog:lha chen g.yul ngo da sgyur zhig: rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'di'i sha yi bsun ma da sgyur zhig: khrag gi bsun ma da sgyur zhig: rus pa'i bsun ma da bzlog cig dbang po lnga yi bsun ma da bzlog cig:rnam shes gsal ba'i sgron me da spor zhig: mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol mo ngan mtshan rtsub thams cad bzlog ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog: ban byad bon byad sngags byad bzlog:lo zla zhag keg thams cad bzlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog: ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad bzlog: bgegs rigasastong phrag brgyad cu bzlog rtsis kyi rde'u nag po bzlog mo ngan rmi lam ga pa bzlog: mi nag skye bo'i ya ga bzlog bran 'khol ga pa'i dmod mchu bzlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur: ngan bcu sdig bcu thams cad sgyur:mo ga pra ga thams cad sgyur sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la bzlog: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog ngar mi dang bcas te mdos gtong ba ni/ lha nam mkha' g.yu yi lding khang nas: nyi 'od — 177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'abar ba'i sman gcig ma: bzhengs shig bzhedas shig dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam bskul: dgongs shig dgongs shig thugs dam dgongs: 'bod pa'i 'gro ba grangs mang yang : ha cang nyon mongs ma (12ba)skyed cig bos nas thugs log ma mdzad cig gsangasanas le lo ma mdzad cig las kyi bsun ma bzlog tu gsol: lha klu sdebargyad la sogs pa: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i bsun ma bzlog: bstan ma yongs kyi gtso mo ste: dmag gi rgyal mo chen mo ste:dam la gnas shing 'phrin las mdzod zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa bzhes: ྅/ gangs kyi yum chen g.yu bun ma: ma mo yongs kyi bsun ma bzlog: lho yi skyi mthing g.ya' ma skyong : btsan gyi rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog: kha rag khyung btsun dpal gyi yum bdud gyi rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog: byang gi gser mthing g.yu bun ma: gshin rje'i rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog: gangs dkar sha med sman gcig ma: sman gyi rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog: byang gi byang thang ting mo sman 'brog srin rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog mo btsun khug chos g.yar mo bsil klu yi rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog: dpal chen gsang ba'i grogs mchogo ma: ri yi rgyal po'i bsun ma bzlog kyi mthing gangs kyi ra mo sman sha za ro yi bsun ma bzlog bstan ma btsun mo ra mo sman ma bsangs rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog kong btsun de mo bod khams skyong : ma bdud rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog: legs sbyor gser thang yi ge sman:dmu bdud rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog ba spu'i bu mo si la ma: gangs kyi rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog:na ra shel gyi sman gcig ma ma bsangs yongs kyi bsun ma bzlog: mi g.yo brtan pa'i sa 'dzin ma bgegs kyi rgyal mo'i bsun ma bzlog (13na 'dzam gling bstan pa'i bstan ma dang : bod khamasabaskyangs pas skyong ma dang : pad+ma 'byung gnas pho nya ste: rkyen rnams bzlog pa'i mthu mo che: dmag dpung bskyed la bar chad sol byad kha phur kha bzlog pa dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i bsun ma bzlog:zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa bzhes: 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo/ yang cig bsun ma bzlog pa ni: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo ste: dkar mo spyan gcig ma yi bsun ma bzlog nag mo — /78

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma 'daral gcig ma yi bsun ma bzlog slob dpon srung ma'i bsun ma bzlog: sngags pa kun gzhi'i bsun ma bzlog: bh+yo: yang cig bsun ma bzlog pa ni: chos skyong srung ma'i bsun ma bzlog: ma mo'i bsun ma bzlog tu gsol las kyi ma mo chen mo bzhi'i bsun ma bzlog dbang gi rgyal mo bzhi yi bsun ma bzlog: dam la gnas pa'i ma mo bzhi'i bsun ma bzlog: yid la skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro bzhi'i bsun ma bzlog da res lha mo dbugs 'phrog bzhi'i bsun ma bzlog: dgra bo'i snying 'phrog ma mo bzhi'i bsun ma bzlog las kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog: bstan skyong rnams kyi bsun ma bzlog steng phyogs lha yi bsun ma bzlog: 'og phyogs klu yi bsun ma bzlog: bar snang gnyan gyi bsun ma bzlog sgrub pa'i ma tshogs bsun ma bzlog: ging chen mchog gi bsun ma bzlog dbang phyug ma tsho gos bsun ma bzlog ma mo drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bsun ma bzlog 'bar ma (13brdza mo brgyad kyi bsun ma bzlog: srid pa'i ma mo brgyad kyi bsun ma bzlog: las kyi sring mo chen mo bzhi'i bsun ma bzlog bstan skyong ma mo 'khor dang bcas: las kyi bsun ma bzlog tu gsol tshogs dang gtor ma 'di bzhes las: byad kha rbod gtong bsun ma bzlog: 'byung ba lnga yi bsun ma bzlog: bla ma yi dam lha yi bsun ma bzlog dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can dang : srung ma rnams kyi bsun ma bzlog snang srid ma mo'i bsun ma bzlog 'dod yon mchod pa 'bul lags kyi: sems ngang nam mkha' sha dang sa: khrag dang chu ser drod dang me dbugs rlung 'byung lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: dri chen dri chu byang chub sems: sha khrag la sogs mchod par 'bul: mi rta glang seng rma bya'i sha sha chen lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: gzugs snang grags pa'i me tog dang : dge sdig la sogasamachod par 'bul: dga' ba nyams kyi mchod pa 'bul: yon chab me tog bdug spos dang : snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang : sgra snyan la sogs mchod par 'bul: dung chen—kha sbyor dung chen dang :sha chen tshil wo spos rnams dang : dur khrod wo po'i sa gzhi dang : dbang po lnga yi me tog bkod skong zhig dur khrod gzhal yas su: tshil chen zhun mar mar mes gtams mtshan ldan bkra shis ka — 179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pā lar:gtor ma ye shes bdud rtsir gyur bhan dha nyi shu'i dkyil 'khor du:sha chang khur ba la sogs pa ro brgya ldan pa'i tshogs 'khor bshams:mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā lar 'bru bcud a mṛ ta yis bkang :rtsa brgyad stong la 14na ra ba'i sman:mchod pa rgya chen khyed la 'bul:thabs dang shes rab dkyil 'khor du:rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad kyis:sgos pa'i sgra dbyangs snyan par gyer:gsung dbyangs snyan ngag drug cu'i sgra mchod pa rgya chen khyed la 'bul:snomachod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyi:gar stabs phyi nang mchod pa 'bul:rin chen khang pa yangs brtsigs dang :rin chen gser gyi bum pa dang :yid bzhin nor bu rin chen dang :rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dang :bkra shis rdzas brgyad mchod pa'i tshogs:gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang :bla bre dar 'phan lda ldi dang :mchod pa'i sprin phung ji snyed dang :bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang :mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs rnams la 'bul:lha klu sdo brgyad la sogs pa:'chi bdag gshin rje'i bsun ma bzlog:mi dang mi min la sogs te:byad kha phur kha zor kha rnams:byad ma rbod gtong mkhan la bzlog rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog mdos la ma 'then zhing kha bsgyur la lam bstan pa ni/kye/dgongasashig gnas mchogo dam pa 'dir dpa' bo dpa' mo 'khor dang bcas sngags 'amang rnal 'byor sku tshe srings bsun ma bzlog phyir dngos grub zhu:da ni gshegs shig gshegs re ran:da ni bzhugasapa'i yun ma ring :nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na:ma sring mkha' 'gro 'bod pa dir ri ri :lha bya sil snyan khrol lo lo:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis glu len gar byed khyugs ma khyug dpa' bo' bro brdung khrigs se khrig:dpa' mo'i 4ba〉shug glu kyur ru sa mkha' 'gro'i brda skad dir ri ri:gnas mchog de ni nyams re dga':gnas mchog de ni dang re spro:gnas mchog de ni dri re zhim:ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos rnams da bzhud 'tshal:rang rang gzhal yas khang du gshegs:khyod rang gzhal yas khang du spyod:skyel lo khyed rang gnas la skyel khyed rang bzhud pa'i bshul lam der:dri bzang de ni sman gyi yul:dri bzang spoX/da chil li li:'ja' māṃ sna lnga spungs rtse spupa

bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ nang ma rtogedar zab sna tshogs lhubs se lhub da ni khyod rang gnas su gshegs da gshegs da ni bzhud re ran:khyed rang bzhud pa'i bshul lam der:gshegs so gshegs so shar ra ra:khyod cag ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs:kye/mkha' 'gro'i lam bstan nub tu bstan nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na dur khrod gling mchog nyams re dga' bam chen mi ro dbangasache thob:tshil chen mar me 'od re gsal:rak+ta'i rgya mtsho mdangs re che:rkang gling dum chen skad re snyan:zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gos re dro thod pa'i sku mkhar brjid re che:mkha' 'gro'i brda skad dir ri ri dpa' bo'i gar byed khyugs se khyug dpa' mo'i glu len tser re re:sman spos dad pa chil li li:shing tog me rtag bkrags mdangs ldan:gsung snyan sgra dbyangs dir ri ri mdzes pa'i bya rigs rgya ma gyu gtsang po'i chu 'bab mer re re:zhal zas tshogs chen spungs se spung :dar gyi cod pan pur ru phun bza' dar dpyangs lhubs se lhub:g.yu yi 15na ) thig le thibs se thib:de 'dra'i gnas mchog nyams re dga' mkha' 'gro'i lam bstan de ru bstan:da ni gshegs shig gshegs re ran mkha' 'gro'i brda skad dir ri ri ḍā ma ru de khrol lo lo:dung dang pi wang skad re snyan:rgyan cha mang po sil li li de 'dra'i gnas su da gshegs shig rkyang ser rlung la chibs nasagashegs bya rgyal khyung la chibs nas da gshegs shig:rta drel bong gsum chibs nas da gshegs shig stag dang gzig la cings la da gshegs shig dom dang dred la chibs la da gshegs shig:khyi dang spyang zhir chibs la da gshegs shig mkha' 'gro'i lam bstan skyon yul du bstan snang srid lha 'dre'i lam bstan sdang ba'i dgra la bstan zhes brjod cing gser skyems gtor/lhag ma dang chad mtho btang /phyi rol nub phyogs kyi ri nag po'i rtser phyin la zor 'phang ba gzhan na gsal:de nas bstan ma bskyang /me chus rgyas 'debs shing srung 'khor bsgom nang du log sgo drung du bro brdung /tshe chog dang 'brel pa'i brtan bzhugs grub nas bdag bskyed mjug chog sogs spyi ltar ro//mchog dman bar pa'i skye dgu dus min du//bsun ma'i ཿpho nya bzlog par byed pa'i thabs//rigs 'dzin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shezhal lung phyag bzhes ma nyams pa/ /bkod 'dis 'gro kun rdo rje ltar brtan shog /dmar ser can zhes pa me sbrul chu stod zla bar phan bde legs bshad gling spyi tshogs kyis yo byad bsdus te tshe chog zhag bdun dang 'brel pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs tshe mchod dpon (15ba)ngag dbang shes rab kyis gra tshang du gser zho stong la bskor ba'i spyi rdzas 'bul ba dang bsun ma bzlog gi dgos byed rnams bsgrigs nas don gnyer chen pos bskul bar brten bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal zhes pa 'di ni za hor gyi ban+de zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga lo/

phyi nas mkha' 'gro bsun ma'i zhu ba/ nang ma 9)phyi nas mkha' 'gro bsun ma'i zhu ba bzhugs so/ /phyon sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bsun bzlog rgyas pa'i mdos thabs su bcas pa la:bsun ma'i mgron rnams kyis/ snga ma sngags ston/ skyes bu rigs bzang dang / bud med rigs bzang gang yin pa la/ nub phyogs bde ba can du bzhud dgos zer nas/ brod pa 'ding zhing gdan 'dren pa 'di skad do: zhan kye/ rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu khyed nged mkha' 'gro rnams la tshur gson dang :khyed bod kyi yul las sdug pa med: nged mkha' 'gro'i yul las skyid pa med: nged mkha' 'gro'i yul las dga' ba med: ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang na: 'ja' tshon gur phub khyil li li gnyis med mkha' ltar dag pa'i pho brang nas: me tog char bab sil li li: mi mngon dbyings kyi pho brang na:gser gyi lding khang ldings se lding : mkha' spyod nyams dga'i pho brang na: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnamasaspungs se spung : nged mkha' 'gro'i yul las skyid pa med khyed bod kyi yul las sdug pa med brel phongs las la zin dus med (2na thad kyi las la dal dus med: rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu khyed:nged mkha' 'gro'i yul der da gshegs shig: (ban kye/ rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu khyed nged mkha' 'gro'i yul der da gshegs shig mkha' 'gro'i yul las dga' ba med mkha' 'gro'i yul lasaskyid pa med 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i pho brang na ci 'dod gter gyi dngos grub yod drag po e yi gzhal yas na: thod pa'i sku mkhar ldem pa yod mi lpags g.yang gzhi rgyangs se rgyang : tshil chen mar me tal la la: sha khrag gtor ma spungs se spung : rak+ta'i rgya mtsho khyil li li rus pa' rgyan cha khrol lo lo: tshil chen spos dud thul lu lu mi rkang gling bu skad re bzang : nged mkha' 'gro'i yul las brod pa med gnas der 'dengs dang dga' skyid 'dzom rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu khyed: rna ba'i dbang po tshur gson dang nged mkha' 'gro'i yul las dga' ba med khyed bod kyi yul las— 183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesdug pa med: chags sems che la grol rgyu med: de bas phyon (2ba)gnas der 'dengs: rtog)gshegs kyang zer/ kye/ rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu khyed rna ba'i dbang po tshur gson dang : nged mkha' 'gro'i gnas de nyams re dga' dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog na dpa' bo'i gar byed khyugs se khyug: dpa' mo'i bro brdung chems se chem: bya ngang ba'i skad snyan sangs se sang : ngur pa'i skad snyan tser re re: mkha' 'gro'i glu len kyur ru phu dar dkar rgyal mtshan pur ru phu dar nag ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: rkang gling smyug gling skyur ru phu gser gyi nyi ma khyil li li: dung gi zla ba tal la la: skar phran tshom bu shigs rtse shig gnas der 'dengs dang gnas der skyid: nyams dga'i gnas der gshegs su gsol: ltang)kyi/ rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu khyed: nged bsun ma rnams la tshur gson dang : khyed bod kyi yul las sdug pa med bod kyi yul lasang na pa med bod kyi yul de gnas re chung : bdud rtsi'i chu la 'thung rgyu med: ye shes dbyings la gzhag sa med: me tog gling la blta sa med: mdzes pa'i yid la gdungs rgyu med: de bas bod kyi yul 'di sdug rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu khyed: da ni mkha' 'gro'i yul der gshegs: mkha' 'gro'i yul de gnas re bzang : rin chen gser gyi lding khang de kha pad g.yu la byas pa yod: rin chen dngul gyi sku mkhar de: kha pad lcags la byas pa yod: rin chen zangs kyi sku mkhar de: kha pad byu rur byas pa yod: rin chen lcags kyi sku mkhar de: kha pad (3na〉ba chong la byas pa yod: de 'dra'i gzhal yas nyams re dga' de 'dra'i gnas mchog dang re spro: gnas mchogo de ru da bzhud 'tshal: 6)bye/ rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu khyed nged mkha' 'gro rnams la tshur gson dang : phyon yul der 'gro re ran khyed mi 'gro ba'i dbang yang med bya rnams skad snyan tser re re gcan gzan ngar skad dur ru ru : rgyan cha mang po pur ru ru : thod pa ltag sprod khrol lo lo: sil snyan mang po sil li li: a la la ste nyams re dga' skal ldan rigs bzang dgyes par mdzod: phyon yul der khrid nas 'gro dpa' bo rnams la pho nyar bkod dpa' mo'i tshogs la 'phrin las bcol: gser gyi gdu bu khrol lo lo: dngul gyi mgul —184

phyi nas mkha' 'gro bsun ma'i zhu ba/ nang ma (ge.ong spongs se spong : da ni mkha' 'gro'i yul der gshegs: (che / kye/ rigs bzang dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor khyed: rigs bzang lha yi skyes bu 'di: nged mkha' 'gro'i yul der mi gtong na:rigs bzang dpa' bo de'i glud tshur thong zhig: sha khrag rus pa'i glud tshur thong zhig: sgra dang sen mo'i glud tshur thing zhig: mgo lus pags pa'i glud tshul thong zhig: nged mkha' 'gro rnams mi sdod log nas 'gro: ithi: rgya rgya rgya: sam ya: mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gnang ba sbyin pa 'di skad do:(pe kye/ khyed ni byang chub sems dpa' ste: rang don dri mas khyed ma gos mkha' nyams 'gro la khyed sems brtse khyed ni dpa' bo chen po ste: bdud dang mu stegs zil gyis gnon: (3bcud ni ye shes sems dpa' ste: 'khor ba'i skyon gyis yongs ma gos: bstan pa yun ring bsrung pa'i phyir:khyed kyi bka' bzhin sgrub par bgyi: nged rnams so so'i gnas su 'gro khyed rnams sku khams bzang bar mdzod: mkha' 'gro bsun ma rnams kyis gnang ba sbyin par bya'o: 'byon bzhud kyi zhu lan tshor:bla ma la 'di skad do: kye/ sems can rnams kyi mgon gyur bla ma rje khyed skyon yul du mi bzhud par:'gro ba sems can don du bod yul dbus su bzhugs par zhu bu slob rnams dang 'gro ba sems can la smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol: ces chas rnams dbul lo: sngags pa yin na: kye/ thugasarje'i mnga' bdag sngags 'chang khyed skyon mkha' 'gro'i gnas su ma bzhud par bzhugs par zhu:zhes mkha' 'gro rnams kyis zhu ba bya'oḥ maṅga lo/ / / /—183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shetshogs mchod 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin bzhugs/mkha' 'gro rnam lnga dgyes skong tshogs mchod rdzas/ /med byung dpa' bo'i dga' ston cho ga'i khrigs/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ /chog sgrigs 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin deng 'dir spel/ /de yang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can gyi tshe mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par byed pa'i dpa' bo'i dga' ston la tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes spyi ming sgos su btags pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga la las dang po pa dang thun mong ba'i nang tshan rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor 'bring po/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor dpa' bo'i ston mo'i cho ga bde chen rnam rol sogs rgyas par yod na'ang sgrub chog bskang gso sogs kyi dus kha'u brag rdzong pa'i phyag bzhesa'akhyer bder mdzad pa bzhin lag tu bstar ba la/ ba la dang ma da na gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba'i rim pa sogs mchod pa'i rdzas rnams stegs dang gdan gzhi (2na〉pa sogs pa'i khar bkod pas mdzes par bshad/ thog mar mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal te/ tsho gis kyi yo byad rnams la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ tsho gos pas badz+ra.a skṛ ta nas ha hoḥhrīḥ'i bar gyis nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ de nas tshogs kyi rtse mo nas za na rang nyid kyis za ba las sum 'gyur gyis che ba zhig dang / de mtshungs pa la zhig bla ma'i bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan gang yang rung ba'i mdun du bshams rjes/ phyag gsum btsal nas bla ma dang dkon cog gi drung du tshogs kyi phud 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod/ thams cad kyis zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ oṃ gu ru burnya bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pā dzi te khā hi/ zhes brjod/ de rjes thod pa'am ting par la sogs par ma da na sngar bzhin bzhag la phyag gsum btsal te/bla ma dang dkon cog gi drung du ma da na'i phud 'bul bzhi zhes brjod pas thams cad kyis/ dman — 186

tshogs mchod 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin/ nang ma (gepa'i yul las rab 'das shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig (2bsgo chog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ bdud rtsi mchog gis mchode par bgyi/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas/ /rtog pa kun lasarnam grol ba/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /gu ru bu d+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta 'a hi/ de nas zan dang bal gos las cung zad chung ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi rten gyi mdun du bshams la chab sbran nas/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi drung du tshogasamachod 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod thams cad kyis/ oṃ bha ga wa na ma hā kwa ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra/kā ya wā ka tsit+ta/ oṃ in+d+ra dza ma dza la dza kla bhu ta bsno bā u rak+ṣa tsaṇ+ḍa su jo mā de bā spa ta la pa ta lo aḥ sa bla swā hā/ i rda ba smra bhu lha dzigha phul+la dhu pa me sa skra gha rgyas sa spa gadz+dza swā dā khan+ti khu ṇi phe ḍa gha da/ oṃ a kwa ro mu kho sarba dha rmā 'o ā du nut+pa sno tā da/ oṃ mi / phaṭa swā hā/ bde mchog dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs la mdzad srol 'dug kyang ma byas pas chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bas btang snyoms su bzhag /gur mgon/ zhal bzhi pa/ las mgon/ gnod sbyin/ mkha' 'gro dang gzhi bdag sogs kyi gtor sngags tshar gsum mam re re gang rung brjod pa'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra pu 〉 u / nas sha lta'i bar dang / 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dbul/ de rjes phud phor du ma da na blug pa nam mkhar bteg la/ nang phud 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod/ thams cad kyis/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang /dpal rdo rje nag po (3na to kho po gur mgon lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang /legs ldan nag po gdong bzhi pa/ yum bzhi/ bka' stod gnod sbyin beg tse lcam sring / 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams dang / gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma rnams dang / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i —187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebastan ma bcu gnyis/ gnas bdag /gzhi bdag /yul bdag /grong bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ u / / ḍā dril dang rol chen mdzad/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ e ma'o ye shes wo po rnams/ /tshogs chen 'bar bas nyone mongs bsreg /'di 'dra'i bde ba thob nas ni/ /kun sa a ho su kha brjod/ /ces brjod thams cad kyis lkog bteg nas/ a ho su kha bha k+ṣa ye/ a ho su kha ho ya na/ ma hā mun+ta sirnyi ni/ pra wadhe na ni lha ni/ e ma bde ba longs spyod ces/ /e ma bde ba rab gsal ba/ /phyag rgya chen po grub pa 'dis/ /rab tu 'phel pa'i rol gar 'di'o/ /hūṃ he ha ha ha ho zhes brjod/tshogs rdzas 'grim pa ni/ mchod g.yog pa'i lag pa g.yon pas thod par ma da na blug la bzung /de'i steng du lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis ba la bzung la kha bkab pa'i tshul du byas te/ thog mar rdo rje slob dpon la 'bul ba'i rnam pas/ ho/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram zer khyi dang gdol ba sogs/ /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /zhes brjod/ des kyang sngar (3bgyi phyag rgyas blangs nas/bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral pa'i/ /de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/ /a ho ma hā su kha ho zhes brjod/ de bzhin du thamasacad la bskor te/ rig pa 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /zhes sogs brjod pa 'gre /'di sgrub pa po nyung 'dul gyi dbang du mdzad kyis tsho gos che na/ spyir rig pa 'dzin rnams dgongs su gsol/ zhes bsgyur nas/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsdus la rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhal nas ma da na hub gcig bzung nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas zhal bkru sbran la/ oṃ la gi ba smra ta bha k+ṣa si swā hā/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams tshim nas/ nang gi dngos grub phyir mi gtong ba dang / phyi yi bar chad mi gtong ba'i 'phrin las rnams yang dag mdzad du gsol/zhes brjod/ rdo rje'i glu ni/ kol+la/ ri ji/ ā bo lā/ mu skru ṇi ri/ ka klo lu/ gha ṇa/ gi bī ṭa ho/ bsno i/ka ru ṇi ki /a i/ na ro lā/ ta hi/ ba lu/ kha tho ga lha/ ma a ṇa/ pidz+dza a i/ ha la/ kwa li lha ra/ pa —188

tshogs mchod 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin/ nang ma (peṇi a6)/ du dhu n+da/ badz+dza a i/ tsa u ba(ma/ ku sbu ri/ sih+la/ ga sbu ra lā a i/ ma la i rjo na/ shā li dza/ ta hi/ bha ru khā a i/ phe kha ṇa/ khe ṭa/ ka ༅ / shurnya shurnya/ ṇa 5ni yas/ ni raṃ shu/ e ga tsa ḍā wi/ ta hi dza/ sa ra wa/ pa ṇi a i/ ma la/ a dze kun+da sa wa sna i/ ḍi ṇ+ḍi ma/ ta hi/ na brji a i/shis brjod ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ de ha sogs yod na'ang deng sang kye rdor sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar ram/phun sun tshogs pa sogs kyi shis brjod dang / mjug chog dkyus ltar mdzad pa yin no/ /tha mal ro la sred pa'i 'ching ba'i rgya/ /gcod byed zag med bdud rtsir rtag rol ba/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi yul las bza' bca' la/ /mngon chen sngags rlom phal gyi spyod yul min/ /ga ṇa tsakra'i pā dza nam mkha' mdzod/ /sgo 'phar phye tshe gnas gsum dpa' bo dang / /ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i dga' ston gyi/ /rab snyan rgyang glu rtag tu mgrin par len/ /'dis mtshone bsod nams yongs byas sa bon tshogs/ /skyed du bsrings pa a mra'i sdong po'i rtser/ /gtan bde ro brgya bda' ba'i gos bu la/ /nam mkha'i mtha' snyed 'gro kun spyod par shog /ces tshogs mchod 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin 'di ni mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par byed pa'i dus ston gal che ba'i tshe rnam par rgyal pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i phyag bzhes kyi ched du sa rta khra zla ba'i yar tshes la za hor gyi brjes sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so// //— 189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebasun bzlog gi zor byang bzhugs so/ /zor 'phang ba ni/ gser skyems btang la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ da lam gyi gtor ma chen po 'di: mkha' 'gro dam can mchod pa'i rdzas dgra bgegs dam sri sgrol ba'i mtshon: nad dang rimasakyi na bun 'thul: mtshon dang gnod sbyin char pa 'bebs bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo la mtshon gyi bskal pa sna tshogs phob: khrag 'thung sngags zor dgra la rgyob: 'phung par byed pa'i sri la gtor zor rgyob: gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la gtor zor rgyob: za ba'i 'dre la gtor zor rgyob bar gcod rkyen la gtor zor ya: bgegs dang dam sri rdul du rlog bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod: ྅ bh+yo/ shar rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya mo: g.yas na dug khrag zor 'phen ma g.yas pa bshan pa'i mda' zor thogs: g.yon pa shes rab gzhu bdungs la: g.yas pa thabs kyi zor rgyob cig:sdang ba'i dgra la mda' zor ya: gnod pa'i bgegs la mda' zor ya: za ba'i 'dre la mda' zor ya: yas kyi bdud g.yos de ring bzlog: mas kyi sri (2na/spangs de ring bzlog pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre de ring bzlog: nye ba'i byol kha de ring bzlog gnam la gza' skar ngan pa bzlog: sal zhag dus 'debs pa bzlog: nyi ma rlung mal ngan pa bzlog: zla ba zhag dusang na pa bzlog: chos kyi chosazor thams cad bzlog bon gyi bon zor thams cad bzlog: mo ༅ pra ga thams cad bzlog rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog: chags che nyam nga thams cad bzlog: bh+yo/ lho rin chen rigs kyi pho nya mo: g.yas pa dug khrag zor 'phen ma: g.yon pa yugs sa'i me zor rgyob: g.yon pa shes rab me spor la: g.yas pa thabs kyi zor rgyob cig: sdang ba'i dgra la me zor ya: gnod pa'i bgegs la me zor ya: za ba'i 'dre la me zor ya: yas kyi bdud g.yos de ring bzlog: mas kyi sri langs de ring bzlog: pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre de ring bzlog nye ba'i byol kha de ring bzlog gnam la gza' skar — 190

bsun bzlog gi zor byang / nang ma rtogengan pa bzlog: sa la zhag dus 'debs pa bzlog: nyi ma rlung mal ngan pa (2ba)bzlog: zla ba zhag dus ga pa bzlog: chos kyi chos zor thams cad bzlog: bon gyi bon zor thams cad bzlog: mo ngan pra ngan thams cad bzlog rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog: chags che nyam nga thams cad bzlog:bh+yo/ nub pad+ma rigs kyi pho nya mo: g.yas pa dug khrag zor 'phen ma g.yon pa dme ba'i rdo zor rgyob:g.yon pa rdo yi sgrogs 'phen ma: g.yas pa thabs kyi zor phongs shig: snang ba'i dgra la rdo zor ya:gnod pa'i bgegs la rdo zor ya: za ba'i 'dre la rdo zor ya: yas kyi bdud g.yos de ring bzlog:mas kyi sri langs de ring bzlog: pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre de ring bzlog nye ba'i byol kha de ring bzlog:gnam la gza' skar ngan pa bzlog: sa la zhag dus 'debs pa bzlog: nyi ma rlung mal ngan pa bzlog zla ba zhag dus ngan pa bzlog: chos kyi chos zor thams cad bzlog: bon gyi bon zor thams cad bzlog: mo ngan pra ngan thams cad bzlog rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog: chags che nyam nga thams cad bzlog bh+yo/ byang las kyi rigs kyi pho nya mo: g.yas pa dug khrag zor 'phen ma:g.yon pa dme ba'i rdo zor rgyob/g.yon pa rdo ye sgrogs 'phen ma/ g.yas pa thabs kyi zor phongs shig:sdang ba'i dgra la thun zor ya: gnod pa'i bgegs la thun zor ya: za ba'i 'dre la thun zor ya: yas kyi bdud g.yos de ring bzlog mas kyi sri langs de ring bzlog: pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre de ring bzlog: nye ba'i byol kha de ring bzlog: (3na skon ma la gza' skar ngan pa bzlog: sal zhag dusa'adebs pa bzlog: nyi ma rlung mal ngan pa bzlog: zla ba zhag dus ga pa bzlog: chos kyi chos zor thams cad bzlog bon gyi bon zor thams cad bzlog mo ngan pra ngan thams cad bzlog rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog: chags che nyam nga thams cad bzlog: ces brjod/ maṅga lo/ / / /— 191 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebartan bzhugs kyi chog sgrigs rab brtan rdo rje'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ /a mṛ tā tsho ji su sirnyi ra stu/ 'chi med grub pa'i dpal ster tshe dpag med/ /gnyis med tshe dpag rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /gter ston dngos grub rgyal mtshan brgyud par bcas/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas don gnyis lhun grub mdzod/ /rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyis zang zang lha brag nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub longs sku ma'i sgrub thabs la brten pa'i las byang sgrub mchog sogs kyi skabs nye bar mkho bar ma zad dbang tshig bla ma sde bdag sogs kyi brtan bzhugs la'ang kha bsgyur chog pa'i gsung rgyun rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi gsung las nye bar thos pa ltar chu babs su bkod pa ni/ bla ma drag po rtsal dang gter srung rnams kyi mchod gtor sman raka tshogs rdzas/ khyad par tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor rab rdul tshon/ 'bring ras bris/ tha ma'ang tshom bu la brten pa/ mchod gtor lnga dmar po/ tshe bum mgul chings dkar po/ tshe 'brang / tshe mda'/ snying po lnga/ tshe (2na)zan lnga/ tshe chang / bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ stan dkar rdo rje'i ri mo can/ rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad mngon par 'du byas te rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham/ rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams tshogs gral la 'khod nas thog mar thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang gzhud bsrang / tshogs la slebs pa'i mtshams su spyir rnying ma'i dkyil chog rnams la bdag mdun so sor mi mdzad pa mang yang 'di dang lcags sdong ma gnyis la bdag mdun so sor mdzad pa'i phyag len 'dug pas tshe'i bar chad bsrung pa'i phyir mtshams bcad pa ni/ smiḥ bdag nyid rta mgrin dmar po rab khros pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum sdang mig gzigs/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs smin ma sma ra 'khyug /dbu skra — 192

brtan bzhugs kyi chog sgrigs rab brtan rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma 9)kham nag gyen du brdzes pa yi/ /spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang gu rngog ma dmar/ /phrum phrum ser po zhus dkar rta skad 'tsher/ /phyag g.yas tsan+dan be con nam mkha' la/ /phyar nas gzugs khams 'degs (2ba〉shing g.yon pa yis/ /sdigs mdzub dang bcas 'dod khams zil gyis gnon/ /dur khrod mas brgyad sprul dang rin cen rgyan/ /ri rab stegs bcas zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis/ /pad+ma zla nyi ru dra brdzis pa'i steng / /gar dgu'i nyams kyi rol pas 'gying pa'i sku/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ khyoḥng ni pad+ma he ru ga'i: thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po ste: khro bo kun gyi pho nya yin spyi gtsug rta skad thengs gsum gyis 'jig rten srid pa'i rtse mo 'dar: bar du saḥyi rngam sgra yis: lha min gnod sbyin srin po brgyal: 'og tu zhabs kyis bro brdung pas: sa gzhi rgya mtsho 'chol zhing ldeg sku la bskal pa'i me 'bar bas: dregs pa sdebargyad ma lusabasreg: nga nyid dbang gi rgyal po yin: nga yi bka' las su 'da' ba: thal ba bzhin du brlag par bya'o tshwa pa dhan+ta kṛ ta ma hā kro dha ha ya gi wa hrīḥdabang hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: a ya ma tsa du nā ga phu tra ra glo ya smo yag: lha shā na sarba du ṣ+ṭa na mā ra ya phaṭa: sku las me 'bar 'jig rten khams kun bsregs/ /gnas lnga rta mchog 'ja' 'od ltar zhabrugs pas/ /khro mtshon rdo rje me yi gur khang gi /srung ba'i 'khor lo bar mtshams med par gyur bdag bskyed ni/ ā+oṃ su bhā wa shu snyiḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shud+dhi3lha/ma bcos shes pa so ma'i ngang nyid las/ /rang nyid tshe dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs/ /zhal 'dzum shangs (3na)kyi gzengs mtho spyan dkyus ring / /snyan gshog rgyas shing gnag snum thor tshugs can/ /phyag g.yas pad+ma'i sdong po thugasagar 'dzin/ /g.yon pa mnyam gzhag tshe bum dkar po bsnams/ /dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgur chu do shal 'phreng / /dpung rgyan se mo do dang phyag zhabs gdub/ /dar gyi cod pan stod g.yogs gsang ba'i gos/ sham thabs ska rags zhi rgyan bcu gsum spras/ /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gsal 'tsher gzhon nu'i tshul/ /lhun sdug gzi byin zhi ba'i tshul dgu'i dang / /lhan ni lhang nge lham me 'od du 'bar/ /thugs — /93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegar zla steng hūṃ yig dmar po las/ /'od 'phros sems can don byas rgyal kun mchod/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul byin rlabs tshur 'dus thim/ /skad cig rje las rin cen gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dra ba dang / /dra phyed shar bu la sogs rgyan rdzogs dang / /pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar bdag nyid ni/ /ltar gsal ngang nas thugs ka'i hūṃ dmar las/ /'od zer phyogs bcur los pas dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ /'og min gnas nas spyan drangs bdag la thim/ /bdag nyid 'od lnga'i rang bzhin bkrag mdangs rgyas/ /thugs kar nyi zla'i ga'u sen gang steng / /rin cen lnga las grub pa'i rtse lnga pa/ /lte ba'i dbus su yi ge ṇi ljang gu/ kha dog bzhi ldan hūṃ gis rab bskor ba/ /de'i phyir rdo rje'i lte ba'i mtha' skor du/ /gser gyi mdog can tshe yi snying posabaskor/ /de nas tshe gzungs rgyun mi chad par bzla zhing dmigs pa la nan tan bya/ /raṃ las (3bcud 'phros phyogs bzhi'i hūṃ la phog /hūṃ las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i rtse la phog /rdo rje las 'phros sngags kyi 'khor lor phog /de las 'od 'phros rin cen zur brgyad thugs/ /de las snod bcud 'jig rten la phog pas/ /tshe la gnod pa'i bar chad thams cad bsgral/ /bdag la phog pas bkrag mdangs rgyas par gyur/ /zhes dmigs pa dang bcas te nyams su blangs pas che nyi zla dang mnyam pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /mdun bskyed kyi rim pa ni/ ā+oṃ su bhā wa shu d+dha mi rba dharmā ཿsu bhā ba shurnyo3lha/ zlo yig dkar po 'od du zhu ba las/ /tshe bum dbyings zlum lto che mchu 'phyang ba/ kha g.yel zhabs zhus mgrin phra rgyan gyis spras/ /'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phro bar gyur/ /ni bi shwa bi shudhe ban+ta tsakra dzñā na maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/bum nang a dkar las byung bdud rtsi'i chu/ /'khyil steng rin cen las grub gzhal yas khang / /phyogs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang dbus dmar smug /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa lnga yi steng / /pha gu ser po dra ba dra phyed dang / /mda' yab pu shu shar bu rta babs bzhi/ /chos 'khor ri dgas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /'dod pa'i snam bur lha mo mchod pa 'bul/ /de dbus pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba sa /hrīḥyig dkar las mgon po tshe dpag med/ /dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gis/ /tshe — /94

brtan bzhugs kyi chog sgrigs rab brtan rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma 6)bum 'dzin zhing rdo rje skyil krung steng / /gos dkar lha mo pad+ma'i skyil krung gis/ /mnyam sbyor gnyis ka zhi rgyan bcu gsum spras/ /zhi tshul dgu ldan 'gying bag gar gyis bzhugs/ shar gyi 'dab ma'i steng (4na)du lwa su ma/ /dkar mo me long shel gyi bum pa bsnams/ /lho yi 'dab mar mā phywa sngon mo ni/ /rat+na'i phreng ba mthing gi bum pa bsnams/ /nub kyi 'dab ru ra gi tī dmar mo ni/ /pi waṃ brdung zhing byu ru'i bum pa bsnams/ /byang gi 'dab mar nirti ljang gu ma/ /gar gyi phyag rgya dbang sngon bum pa bsnams/ shar lho'i gru chad dhū pe dkar mo ni/ /spos kyi khang pa dung gi bum pa bsnams/ /lho nub gru chad purkye ser mo ni/ /me tog gzheng pa gser gyi bum pa bsnams/ /nub byang gru chad ā lo ke dmar mo/ /mar me'i kong bu byu ru'i bum pa bsnams/ byang shar gru chad ga rje ljang gu ma/ /dung chos in+t+ra ni la'i bum pa bsnams/ shar sgor dkar mo sgeg mo lcags kyu thogs/ /lho sgor ser mo sgeg byed zhags pa thogs/ /nub sgor dmar mo dbang sdud lcags sgrog thogs/ /byang sgor ljang mo mgyogs byed dril bu thogs/ /lha mo brgyad po zhi mdzes sems skyil dang / /sgo srung bzhi po phyag g.yon bum pa bsnams/ /cung zad khro nyams brkyang bskum tshul bzhugs pa/ /bcu gnyis po rnams spyan gnyis gnag snum gyi/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs lhag ma thur du 'phyang / /rin cen rgyan spras dar gyi stod g.yogs dang / sham thabs sku las 'od zer du ma 'phros/ /spyan drang ba ni/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sngon tshe thugs dam zhal bzhes bzhin: bdag gi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: e khye hi bha ga wan/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ (4ba7 sngo dzaḥ& baṃ 〉 spyan drangs nas bum nang gi lha la bstim mo/ /de nas/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ ye shes chen po gsal ba'i sku: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i:mgon po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo na mo pu ru sha ya ho: zhes phyag 'tshal lo/ kha cho de pa 'bul ba ni/bde bar gshegs so tshe dpag med: ye shes chen po gsung gi lha tshe yi lha tshogs thams cad la:kun bzang mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul: a lha bdug spos me tog dang : mar me dri chab mchod par — /(356

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'abul: bha byu ta yi gtor ma 'di: 'dod yon drug tu byin brlabs pa: ye shes lha tsho gis rnams la 'bul: bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ba she /hūṃ zlo ṇi dzaḥ thugs las 'od 'phros bum nang lha tshogs mchod/ /bdud rtsi tshur 'dus lus kyi nang kun gang / /'od zer phar los yab yum sbyor mtshams nas/ /byang sems drangs te rang gi thugs kar thim/ /zag pa med pa'i bde chen ting 'dzin rgyas/ /gos dkar nyi zla'i steng du tshe'i rang bzhin/ dkar 'tsher snum 'dril dkyil du ṇi ljang gu/ /zhal nas ā yu skyon : zhes sgrog /thugs nas lha mo bzhi dang 'od zer 'phros/ /ā+oṃ a mu ha ho lha mi sde brgyad rnams kyi che bkrag dang : sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bcud rnams bsdus: sa ma ya bho dhi tsit+ta badz+ra e ku sha dza: chos skyong gter srung 'go pa'i lha rnams kyis 'jig rten khams kyi tshe yi dngosagrub khug tshwa badz+ra ā yuḥ she a a/ (ldan〉〉tshe ba med pa tshe yi rang bzhin gyi/ /dkar la 'od du 'tsher ba'i rnam pa can/ /skar chen thang la phebs pa lta bu zhig /tshe yi rdzas rnams kun la thim par gyur/ /ces dmigs pa'i rim pa rnams la nan tan du bya'o/ /de nas gzungs thag nas bzung la lha bskul pa ni/ bcom ldan ye shes mgon po tshe dpag med thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i don la byon/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag yum gyi gzhal yas su byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi 'od du 'phro:tshe dang g.yang spel dbang dang byin phob cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra dzñā na ā yum hūṃ zlo ṇi dza: zhes brjod cing tshe bkug la bstim mo/ hūṃ/ shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: lu phye dkar mo tshe yi bdag: phyag na shel gyi bum pa bsnams: bum pa'i nang ni ga 'kha yas khang : phyi nang med par gsal ler gsal gzungs thag rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro: pad+ma me tog mdangs dang ldan: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe khug cig tshwa hūṃ/ lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: mā le sngon mo tshe yi bdag: phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams:bum pa'i nang ni gzhal yas khang : phyi nang med par gsal ler gsal: gzungs thag rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro: pad+ma'i me tog mdangs dang ldan: lho yi phyogs nas tshe khug cig : PROBPROB PROB/ nub kyi phyogs nasatshe 'gugs ma gi ti dmar po tshe yi bdag: phyag na mchong gi bum pa bsnams bum pa'i nang ni — /96

brtan bzhugs kyi chog sgrigs rab brtan rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (gegazhal yas khang :phyi nang med par gsal ler 5ba ) gas la:gzungs thag rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro:pad+ma'i me tog mdangs dang ldan:nub kyi phyogs nas tshe khug cig tshwaPROB/byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma ni rti ljang gu tshe yi bdag:phyag na g.yu yi bum pa bsnams bum pa'i nang ni gzhal yas khang :phyi nang med par gsal ler gsal:gzungs thag rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro:pad+ma'i me rtag mdangs dang ldan:byang gi phyogs nas tshe khug cig PROBPROB/lus kyi sha yi khams nyams na:'byung ba sa yi bcud bsdus la:sangs rgyas spyan gyis tshe khug cig bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsolaXṅgāhūṃ/lus kyi khrag gi khams nyams na:'byung ba chu yi bcud bsdus la:mā ma gi yis tshe khug cig:bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol : chu hūṃ/lus kyi drod kyi khams nyams na:'byung ba me yi bcud bsdus la:gos dkar mo yi tshe khug cig bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol : chu shā/lus kyi dbugs kyi khams nyams na:'byung ba rlung gi bcud bsdus la:dam tshig sgrol mas tshe khug cig:bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol/tshwaPROB/'byung ba sa yi zhing khams nas:rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugasapa'i las mdzad ma dkar mo mgyogs ma zhi byed 'od 'phro'i tshogs 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang sgyur la:shar phyogs snod bas tso gyi tshe khug cig nai hūṃ/'byung ba chu yi rin 'a sngon mo mgyogs ma rgyas byed 'gro ba pa lho phyogs ma ཿ / /'byung ba me yi
