pad+ma cad mar mo mgyogs ma dbang 6na〉sdudag 'gro ba nub ā+oṃ hūṃ/'byung ba rlung 'phrin las ljang mo mgyogs ma grub byed 'gro brtsa byang chu ཿ zhes tshe 'gugs pa'i cho ga bya/tshe bstim pa ni/hūṃ/srid pa gsum gyi tshe bkug rnams yi ge : la bstim par bya:: de 'od du zhu ba las tshe yi bum pa nyid la bstim bum pa'i nang gi 'od zer rnams 'byung ba'i snying po lnga la bstim snying po lnga yi bkrag mdangs rnams:lha yi snying po lnga la bstim tshwa sa/ swā hā/yi ge dpa' bo 'bru lnga po bdag gi snying gar thim pa yis snying nang 'od kyi khang bur gyur sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/tshogs mchod thugs sgrub gzhung ltar dang /ā+oṃ sa/ ā yu rnan de wa ḍa gī ni ma hā bha smra ta khā hi/zhes 'bul/dmag zor ma/bka' srung brgyad 'a sbyo//smu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemachod/ rgyal btsan gzhi bdag gi gtor ma rnams bsngo/ de nas brtan bzhugs dngos bya ba ni/ gang la bya ba'i yul de rol mo dang bcas te gnas khang du gdan drangs/ gdan khri la bzhugs su gsol/bsun bzlog rgyas pa med pa'i dus lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal gyi rigs lnga'i bsun bzlog gsang mchod gdod dbyings ma len/ brtan bzhugs 'bul yul de su bhā was sbyangs/ seng khri rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gdan steng du/ hrīḥ las rdo rje slob dpon tshe dpag med/ /dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis tshe bum bsnams/ /gos dkar yum dang gnyis su med par gyur/ /brtan bzhugs kyi yul dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor byed pa sngon chad phyag len gyi rgyun la mi 'dug kyang byas na 'brel (6ba〉chags shing legs par mngon la/ de ltar legs zhes 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po yang gsung / rigs 'dzin brgyud pa bskul ba ni/ gnas 'og min chos kyi dbyings nas rang gi spyi gtsug yan chad bla ma brgyud pas khengs par bsams shing / de thams cad kyi phyag na tshe'i bum pa re bsnams pa/ 'khor mkha' 'gro mang po lus kyi gar bed shigs se shig: ngag gi 'dzab dang snying po dir ri ri 'dren par bsams la thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba 'di ltar gdab bo/ /ā+oṃ rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar ba'i phyag len la mi mdzad kyang bkra bzang pa'i lugs la 'dug pa 'thad legs su sprul sku gter bdag gling pa gsung / mi3/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dzñā na mi yu she hūṃ sne ṇi dzaḥ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /ye shes snang ba lam me pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i dus la bab/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ u3 ā+oṃ badz+ra dzñā na gi kha yu mi she— pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas/ /ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che/ /snang ba mtha' yas / 'chi med / 65/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ /'chi med dbang po lha'i bla ma/ /tshe dpag med mgonaḥ/ 'chi med — / 65/ 'dzam bu gling gi gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas / 'chi med / zho / rigs 'dzin tshe yi zhing khams nas/ /gsum rig gcang ma dag pa ste/ /pad+ma saṃ bha'iḥ/ 'chi med ཿ/ 85/ rigs 'dzin tshe yi zhing khams nas/ /mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang / /blo ldan mchog sredaḥ / 'chi med ཿ / ā+oṃ / rigs 'dzin tshe yi zhing khams— 198—

brtan bzhugs kyi chog sgrigs rab brtan rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma rtogerkar thim pa yis: tshe yi 'od kyi gong bur gyur: zho mi3 swā hā/ sa ma ya ti la lhan/ zhes brjod cing tshe thams cad yig 'bru lngar gyur nas thugs dar bstim mo/ /tshe sba nyid rgyas btab pa ni/ hūṃ/ 'chi med tshe yi rang bzhin ni: ye shes(8bsko yi ngo bo ste: 'od lnga gsal la mdangs dang bcas/ /mi yi tshe ni snum la 'dril: thugs gar ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /thugs kyi klong du sba bar bya: mi dmigs stong pa'i go cha la sus kyang gnod par bya ba min: ces stong pa'i ngang la dar cig bzhag go /tshe bsrung ba ni/ dpral ba'i dbus su rta mgrin dmar po ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis be con sdigasamadzub mdzad/ hrīḥpad+mā n+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī ba hūṃ badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ྅: lus mgo mjug rdo rje'i go khrab tu gyur/ nang gi rtsa sgo bsrung ba ni/ hūṃ/ tsit+ta gsang ba'i sgo srung ni: dbang gi rgyal po rta mgrin te: tshe srog bar chad bsrung bar mdzod: 'chi bdag bdud kyi sgo chod la: tshe bdag chen por bzhugs su gsol: zho badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī ba ྅: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa /: dbang grub nas dngos grub blang ba ni/bum chu phyag tu phul nas/ bkra shis 'od gsal sogs tshigs bcad dngas ma bcud 'dren las blangs pa'i mthar/ kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ wā ka sirnyi u tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ tshe zan phul te/ hūṃ/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la ci 'dod rtsol ba med pa bzhin: lhun grub tshe dbang rigs 'dzin la tshe yi longs spyod 'di phul bas phun sun tsho gos pa'i dngos grub shog: tshe chang phul te/ hūṃ/ yid bzhin nor bu rin cen la longs spyod ngang gis 'byung ba bzhin: lhun grub tshe dbang rigs 'dzin la: tshe bcud dngos grub 'di phul bas rtsol (9na tha med pa'i dngos grub shog tshe ril phul te/ hūṃ/dmag dpon nor bu rin cen gyis phas kyi dgra dpung 'joms pa bzhin: lhun grub tshe dbang rigs 'dzin la tshe yi ril bu 'di phul bas dgra bgegs dpung 'joms dngos grub shog rgyas par spro na/ bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams rim gyis phul te/ rin cen rta ge mdzes lha rdzas gdugs dkar 'ji rdo rje slob dpon bskal brgyar rtag bzhugs nas zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor phyir 'bul lag bas na brtse bsab cheXgate 'dod pa'i 'bras sa bu stsole: tshig lhag ma gsum 'og ma rnams la 'gre /—201 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she wa kun gsal 'dren byed ldan pa'i gser nya 'di: —55 'chi med bdud rtsis po/nga ba'i bum bzang 'di:::ཿ yid 'ong 'dab steng 'dzum pa'i pad+ma 'di je chabakra shis g.yas su 'khyil pa'i dung dkar 'di:ཿ ཿ ཿ dge mtshan ri mo bkra ba'i dpal be'u 'di:ཿཿ : lugs gnyis srid rtser bsgreng pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di::tsha : gling bzhi kun la dbang sgyur 'khor lo 'di:zajojo zhes dang / rgyal srid bdun la/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i 'khor lo 'di:525 'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i nor bu 'di: tsha jo rmad byung bde ba ster ba'i btsun mo 'di:ྈྈ : chos srid don gnyis lhun grub blon po 'di: ཿ: stong gsum skad cig bskor nus glang po 'di tsha :za cang shes rlung gi shugs ldan rta mchog 'di:225 pha rol dgra dpung 'joms pa'i dmag dpon 'di tsha cha cha zhes dang / bkra shis rdzas brgyad tshig (9ba tha cad lhug spyi 'gro ltar 'bul/ 'di rnams gter gzhung dngos su mi gsal kyang brtan bzhugs g.yin 'gar snang zhing legs pa'i cha lag tu 'gyur bas bkod pa yin no/ /de rjes bsams pa lhun grub ma/ tshigs bcad smon lam gyi rigs dang / tshogs lhag sogs gong du ma song na dkyus ltar dang / dkyil 'khor bsdu skabs las byang yongs rdzogs mjug chog cha tshang ba mdzad do/ /de ltar mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon sogs/ /mi 'gyur seng ge'i khri la zhabs brtan pa'i/ /thabs tshul yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'di/ /kho ba'i blo gros rgyal mtshan rtser bkod do/ /dge des rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs kun/ /phan bde'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phrin las can/ /dang po'i mgon po 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi/ /zhing gyur srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig /ces lnga brag gter byon nang longs spyod rdzogs sku la brten nas 'phrin las dang sgrub thabs kyi 'grel ba pad 'phreng gnyis bsdebs par/drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i phyag len gyis kha bkang nas brtan bzhugs su bya ba'i rim pa rab brtan rdo rje'i 'phreng ba 'di nyid sngon nas reg zig tu byas kyang snang la ma nges kyi chad lhag kha shas byung 'dug par gter gzhung dang rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi phrin gzhung tshe dbang sogs chog sgrigs kyi —202

rigs rnams la zhib mor dpyad/ mchog gi sprul sku rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa (10na rdza po sogs phyogs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i dam pa rnams kyi bzhed srol gyis brgyan te/ rang gi brjed byang dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i zhal 'don sogs su 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang tshe ring ngo // //

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti hrīḥgacig ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa bzhugs so/ /na mo badz+ra gu ru pad+mā kā ra ā yu r+sā rat+na bha da sam ya hri hri dzaḥ zer wo' 'od/ lnga 'khrug pa 'i gzhi/ dbyings stong pa dang / rig pa rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud kyi nam/ mkha'/ la/ye r+sā du ma cas par/shes snying po rang byung / don gyi lhun grub kyi dus lta bu bde ba'i nyams can/ dpyid/ gsar du byas pa ma yin pa/ gdod ma nas rang bawo gyi/gsal ba'i/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas mchog /dam pa 'dir/ snang ba sku sgrar/ grag gsung / rang snang thams cad pa kun bzang chos kyi sku'i/ rig ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ ba ni skyabs sems kyi dod do/ /bla na med pa ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam pas grol bas gnas kyi rab dang / phul dang gtso bor/ gyur pa'i/ /phyogs bas dus pa snya sras bcas rgyal ba'i gzhal med kyis/ /phyur phan 0lha sa mi 'gog pas/ bur gtams pa'i rang rig ka nas dag pa lhun grub 'od ldan shar ba'i khang rnams ni phyi nang rgyab mdun steng 'og sogs gang du yang med pa'i zang thal le ba'i gshis/ 'og min gyi lha yi tsho gis/rnams/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ste/ rtsa pa gsum po kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsang gsum mi zad pa/ rgyan gyi 'khor rang gis rang la/ lo (2na/mchod/pa'i tshul gyis tshogs gsog pa'o/ /rtag pa bden par grub pa'i mthar lhung / ma yin pa sems/ stong pa nyid chos kyi sku/ /gtan nas ma grub pa'i/chad pa 'i mthar lhung ba/ ma yin pas stong pa'i nga nas/ rang gi rig pa longs spyod rdzogs/skur 'ja' sna lta shar kyang / /snang stong /gnyis po de dbyer/ med pa 'di zhes brjod bral/blo las/ 'das pa gnas lugs/ rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang /nas/ /'gyur med kyi bde ba 'pho ba/ chen po'i sku bdag gzhan thams cad la yod bzhin pa de ngo 'phrod pa'i sgo nas/ thob par 3|ga cig par smon lam gdab/ /de ltar sngon 'gro'i skabs ngo bo ka na dag cing / lhun grub 'od lnga'i zhing khams der dngos gzhi rgyu rkyen la ma bltos par rang / lus tshe lha sku mdog dmar po mda' dar bum pa 'dzin pa yum bcas/ kyi gnas lngar 'ja' zer 'od kyi gur/ dkyil/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab ba/ mchoge gi 'ja' zer 'od kyi —204

rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti sgyigacig ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa/ nang ma rtogegayis yas/khang gdod ma/nas grub pa der//sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi/lha tshogs rnams kyi gdan//pad ma dkar po nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus su rang gi/rig pa'i gdangs/'od sku'i rnam pa/can/gyi//yang yum/gnyis su med pa la rnam pa sgo sor snang ba/mnyam par sbyor ༅ spyi bor tshe dpag med dkar po/mgrin par dmar po/snying gar sngon po/lte bar ser po/gsang gnas2ba〉rtsa ljang gu/g.yon/tshe bum g.yas/mda' dar gyi phyag mas/dang //rin cen rus rgyan dar dpyangs gos/longs spyod sa pa'i/sku yi//rgyan rnam sku la/rdzogs la rang dang 'dra bar rnam pa migacig pa'i/sprul pas nam mkha' nas sa gzhi'i bar gang ba/dang //de yang /theg pa dgu yong rdzogs kyi lha yi rnam par yongs su/khyab/pa'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du dang mda' dar gyis g.yabs pas/phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi snying po/'byung bzhi 'i bas ser dkar dmar ljang gi rnam pa dang /nang bcud kyi sems yo lha klu mi sogs/'gro drug gi tshe dpag/dang //gsang ba mchog spang rtogs yon to gyi/snying po zhi dang khro bo'i/rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho byin mas/sogs//srid zhi'i khams kyi ngo mtshar ba yod do cog gi tshe nor dpal/lhor//bkra shis pa'i/'dod pa'i yon tan gyi phywa g.yang kun//chos kyi dbyings ka dag chen por spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang //gdod ma nas/lhun gyis grub pa'i/'od gsal snang ba'i rgyan du gyur ba kun//rigs rang la rang mas su bod bzhin pa nyi ma shar bas mun pa sangs ba ltar rang lus dam pa/brgya de nyid rigs lnga gsang r+ṣa rigs gcig sogs/'dus pa'i 'ja' zer thig le'i dkyil/'khor 'dir//'chi med kyi rigs 'dzin/ga khug ma tshe yi bcud ma lus pa bdud rtsi dang ba po shis rdzas rtags kyi rnam par/khug cig/par bskul te bstim//tshe rang lus/lha thod phreng sde lnga kun 'dus pa'i//mkha' la spyod pa'i dkyil lor 'dir lha rnams kyang rang rig don gyi/rigasa'adzin bla ma pad+ma 'byung gan ngos yin te//sra ṣ+ka /brtan pa rdo rje'i 'od zer 'bum phrag brtsegs pa'i//gur khang ye shes kyi/pho brang chen po 'dir//sngar 4sto/bkug pa'i tshe bcud rnams rang la byed na rdo rje tshe lda dang gzhan la byed na de'i thugs kar bsgrub pa de tshe lhar gsal btab pa'i 3na)thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u bstim pa/ra//nam yang /'dzag med brtan pa'i ched du bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs/phyag rgya 'am phyag mtshan gsung /yig 'bru sku'i so so/rnam pa/ /gcig tu 'od du zhu ba'i/daXs ma'i bdud rtsi yis ni/yongs su rgyas btab pa la brten

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shenas//zag bral 'ja' lus rdo rje'i rang bca gyi/rtsi yis btab/dzin la thob to bltar byas pa'i nas//snang srid kyi snod bas/thams cad khyoḥyig dmar po gcig la gcig tshol pho/lu gu rgyud//gzi brjid dang /ldan pyo'od phung dmar po/'khrug pa'i lha'i/rang sgrar bcas/bsang gnas//hrīḥhrīḥzhes bsnyen pa ji i nus kyi bar du bya la//gong gi rdzogs chen gyi gnad la nyams su blangs pa'i mthus gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i snying gi dbus na/gzhon nu bum sku chos sku dbyings kyi gzhin//chos rna ma' sum sogs/snang ba bzhi yongs sa rdzogs pa'i mthar/chos nyid zad/sar lol te 'pho ba r+ṣa po 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur/rang gzhir grol lo//chos thams cad/rab tu 'byams te rnam par/dag pa 'i phyirang la rma /rdo rje 'i bzlas pa'i nyams len byas na tshe'i/bcud du 'gyur zhing /gong du/lha dang /sngags dang dmigs pa dang ting 'dzin gsal stong /brjod bral gyi mtha'//dbyings rig snying yang la snang ba'i/'gros 'gag pa med pa 'od gsal/rdo rje snying po'i ngang /nas//skabs su zhi bal khro bor bsgyur te/'jigs pa med pa hūṃ gi drag sngags/ kyi sgra/ sgrog na/ /'di yis bar chad 'byung po rdul du rlog/nges//yang skad cig dran rdzogs la/phyi nang gi lha tshogs thams cad/thod phreng rig lngar gsal ba/gnas 'gyur te khrag tsong /drag po rigs lnga 'i rnam par skur ba/ni//sku la/dpal gyi chas(3ba tshe ༅ dang /dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang //gar gyi nyams dgu smos/khros pa'i mas dang stang stas/rngam snyo /gtum pa dang //khas g.yon/brkyang g.yas/bskum pa'i/'gying bag gis pad ma nyi ma ro ri gdan bugs pa'i rtser//g.yas phyag g.yon gnyis kyi g.yas/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang g.yon/ lcags kyi sdig pha mgo dgu pa 'dzin pa/las//yar mtho ba/srid pa'i rtse mo dang mar dma' ba/mnar med dmyal pa'i gnas yan chod/kyi bar thamasacad/ /phyag mtshan lcags sdig dang / sprul pa'i khro bo yak+ṣa me dbal sku las sa pa'i tsha sreg gi 'od zer gyis bkang nas/ /ye shes me yis rgyal bsen gdon bgegs thams cad rtsa sbur mes/bsregs/ pa ltar rdul du brlag /lhag ma cung zad lus pa'ang / 'ur 'ur chem chem gyi sgra dang sa sa pa'i/ rlung gis gtor/ /don bsgral bya sgrol byed thams cad ye nas dag pa'i/dam pa dbyings rig dbyer ma mchis pa/mi 'gyur rdzogs pa r+sā tsho ngang nas che//rdo rang ga snying dbus lngar med/rje'i gdan rang rag/la ༷ // ru'i thugs//skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi mtha'

rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti hrī gcig ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa/ nang ma khonganabral chen po'i ngang / /ngo bo chos sku/ rang bzhin longs sku/ thugs rje sprul sku ste sku gsum/ yangs pa'i klong /nas/ /hūṃ gi sgra dang 'phro 'du/ rnams dmigs pa med pas/ rang gi rig pa rang byung rang shar gyi/ ngo bor thim/ /rig phyi nang rtog tshogs thams cad 'byung ba'i rang gi /gzhi gdod ma'i sangs rgyas/ kun tu bzang po'i/ dgongs par/ka nas dbyings dag pa/ a ༷ skye med kyi dang du bzhag pas tshe sgrubasrung bzlog sogs kyi gnad 'gag thams cad 'dir tshang ngo / /zhesalha btsun nam mkha' 'jig med kyi dag snang shrī tsho / sbrags ma'i gsal byed kyi mchan bu 'di ni mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyisabaskul 0ltar 'o hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags(4na〉'o/ /zhes tsho gos gsog tshe sgrub bzlog pa thams cad kyi yang snying / 'brel bar gyur pa thams cad la bar chad rgya 'dre 'gong po sde brgyad ma rungs gdug rtsub thams cad bzlog par byed cing / tshe stobs nus pa las bzhi thams cad kyi sgrub pa thugs sgrub kun gyi yang snying / dag snang thams cad kyi snying bcud 'pho ba dang / bar do/ sa lam thams cad kyi gegs sel/ sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi snying po/ ka dag lhun grub snang bzhi zhi don mngon du byed pa/ khyuḥ& zung 'jug ḍā ki'i bla rdo/ chos srung gi srog 'khor/ rigs 'dzin srog gi sgrub pa'i yang snying zab pa'i mthar thug ithi/ /sa ma yā/ rgya rgya rgya/ bka' srung dam can gter bdag mdzod lnga gnod sbyin gyis srungs shig /skal pa dang ldan pa'i las ldan smon lam mtha' can rnams dang 'phrad par 3|ga cig /dam nyams kha gsag mkhan/ gtsigs med yal bar gtong ba rnams kyi snying khrag dga' ston la rol cig /skyon gsang mchog rol pa'i dur khrod du ye shes dbyings kyi ḍā ki ma dang / pad 'byung yab yum gnyis med kyi thugs bcud ni/ rang lo zhe bdun pa la thob ste/ nga lnga'i dus su yang rdzong drag sngags kyi phug pa dang nye bar grub thob me long gi sgrub gnas sho mo mtha' rtsa'i phug pa'i nye 'dabs su rig thog nas phab pa'o/ /zab rgya// //rigs lnga'i brtan bzhugs las rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs ni/ su sti/ gsang mchog gdod dbyings 'dzin ma las thon pa'i/ /lhun grub rgyan snang rol (4ba)pa dpag bsam dbang / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i 'bras bu'i khur lci ba'i/ /snyigs dus phan bde'i srog shing zhabs brtan shog /gdul bya gling bzhi bltas pa'i dbus —207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shenyid kyi/ /rgyal ba'i chos phung ba gam rtse mo nas/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i dril bsgrags pa'i/khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po zhabs brtan shog /thub gzhung dri med gtsug lag phul gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i gsang lam bla med theg kun rtse/ /gzhi lam rgyun mthar sa bcu'i mgon po khyod/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i gdan la rtag bzhugs gsol/ /ka dag gzhi la snang bzhis dbugs dbyung nas/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gzhen nu bum sku'i dbyings/ /'gro kun kun bzang go 'phang sar bkod pa'i/ /a ti'i bstan 'dzin mchog khyod zhabs brtan shog /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i bar chad dpung / /gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rje'i thugs gsung sku'i/ /mkhyen rtogs thugs rje'i dpung gis mthar bcoms nas/ /bdud tshogs g.yul las rgyal zhing zhabs brtan shog /rin cen mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs ni/ gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings phyi nang gsang ba'i klong / /rdo rje gdan dbus sku gsum ston pa yis/ /lung bstan ji bzhin mthu stobs nus pa'i dbang / /rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal tshab zhabs brtan shog /gang sku'i bkod pa sgyu 'phrul 'phrin las zhes/ bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe byed phyir bzlog nas/ /zab gsang bka' gter snying po'i 'od gsal dang / /rdo rje'i ting 'dzin mi g.yo zhabs brtan (na shog /rnam grol sgyu ma lhun grub rten 'brel gyi/ /rgyu 'bras mi bslu stong nyid snying rje'i grus/ /'gro kun srid zhi'i mtsho las sgrol mdzad pa'i/ /thar gling ded dpon mchog khyod zhabs brtan shog /chen po gsum bcud spros bral rang bzhin babs/ /sna tshogs grub mtha' mang po'i sgro btags kyis/ /gzhes par ma nusahrūl med rgyal ba'i thugs/ /zhing 'dir thub bstan rgyas phyir zhabs brtan shog /snang bzhi bgrod mtha' zung 'jug lam gyi rtse/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i gar mkhan pad+ma 'byung / /gzhan min khyod dngos zhing 'dir bskal brgya'i bar/ /bdag sogs mig gi bdud rtsir rtag brtan gsol/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs ni/ chos dbyings khyab pa'i rgyal kun dgongs mtsho las/ /chos dbyings mtha' klas rnam rol yid bzhin nor/ /chos dbyings nang bzhugs ston pa'i —208—

rigs 'dzin thog sgrub kyi yang zabs ti gyi tshog ma sog ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa/ nang ma khong)bstan mchog rtser//chos dbyings khyon na mdzes khyod zhabs brtan shog/bskal mang du mar tshogs gnyis sngon byas pas//rab 'byams rgyal pa kun dang ro gcig kyang //da dus gdul bya 'dren pa'i mgon nyid du//bsams bzhin skye ba bzhes khyod zhabs brtan shog/rdzogs ldan dang por mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi//tshul bstan zhi bder gzims la ngo mtshar ci/da dus gdul bya stob la mi dal ba'i//rgyal sras mgon po mchog khyod zhabs brtan shog/lha rdzas bur sgrig mnabs pa shākya'i rgyal//snga 'gyur bstan pa spel mdzad pad+ma 'byung //5ba ) rigs bdag kun tu bzang dang gnyis med khyod//'gyur med dad brgya'i gdan la rtag bzhugs gsol//phun tshogs tshogs gnyis ma lusabadag gir byas//srid zhi zhi bde tsam min rnam mkhyen sar//thabs mkhas mkhas grub dbang po khyod nyid kyis//ma lus lus med 'dren phyir zhabs brtan shog/kun mkhyen yongs gzigs shes bya'i pha rol phyin//'gro la rjes chags mtshan dpe'i skur bzhedas pa'i//bdag sogs gdul bya'i bsod nams mchod sdong khyod//mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la rtag brtan shog/skadze mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs ni/gang sku lta bas mi ngoms rdo rje bzhin//mi shigs sra brtan khri 'phang mthon po'i rtser//gdul bya mig gi bdud rtsir lham me ba//'gyur med bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan shog/gang gsung legs bshad chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i sgra//'gro ba'i mos khams dbang po dang 'tsham par//rang rang skad du rtag par lhang nge ba//'gyur med bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan shog/gang thugs mtha' bzhi rang dag gnyug ma'i babs//stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug lam gyi mthar//rdo rje'i ting 'dzin mi g.yo lhan ba pa/'gyur med bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan shog/thugs gsung sku yi mi zad rgyan 'khor gyi//mdzad 'phrin chos dbyings khyon la thug gi bar/'gro la phan bde ster ba'i rtsa lag khyod//zhing 'dir mi g.yo brtan par gsol ba 'debs//gsang gsum zhing dang gnas yul dur khrod kyi//phyogs bcu'i gnas dang sa gsum dbang sgyur pa'i//ḍā ki chos srung phyi nang sde brgyaX kyis//nyer 'tshe bsun ma'i dpung tshogs kun

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she(6na)bzlog cig /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs ni/ skye med thugs ni chos dbyings ngang nas zhi/ /lhun grub gar dgu sgrub pa bka' brgyad rgyan/ /snying rjes khros pa'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can/ /snying dbus dbyings rig pad 'byung ngo bor bzhugs/ /dbyings dang dbyings nang 'khor 'das spros pa kun/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi la byang chub nas/ /ma lus snang ba rang grol rdo rje 'chang / /mngon gyur gzhi yi grub thob zhabs brtan shog /rdzas mchog rin cen brgyad dang rgyal srid bdun/ /rtags brgyad lha mi'i mchod sprin dpal 'byor gyi/ /gzi 'od nam mkha' khengs pa'i glu gar dang / /ji snyed rol mo sgra yi mchod sprin 'bul/ /yid 'ong srid zhi'i khyon na 'gran bral ba'i/ /dngos grub bde ster bkra shis lha rdzas kyi/ /ngo mtshar mi g.yo rdo rje can gyi khrir/ /phyogs dus skyabs kun bden pas brtan bzhugs gsol/ /mngon byang lnga las grub pa'i sku rdo rje/ /bden don bcu gnyis chos 'khor bskor ba'i gsung / rnam pa nyi shu thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /bdag la gsang gsum dbang bskur mchog stsol zhig /ces nor 'dzin gyi thig le ngo mtshar gsar pa'i snang ba brgya phrag gis rnam par bkra bas skabs gsum gyi yul la 'khu zhing mkha' la spyod pa mngon sum gyi ga 'kha med 'bras gshongs kyi dben khrod lha ri rin cen snying por so sod du gnas skabs/ lus can phan bde'i srog shing thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i spyan yongs su yangs pa rigs 'dzin rgyal ba'i dbang po gang nyid bdag sogs 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi mchod sdong du zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten (6ba〉ra brel du ku su li ba kun bzang rnam par rgyal bas lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i phul gyis sbyar ba dge'o// //mchog gsum bla ma rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /yi dam kun dngos 'jam dpal tshe bdag lha/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /rtsa gsum byin rlabs bden pa'i nus mthu yis/ /za hor gdung las ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang rgyal ba yi/ /ring —210

rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti hrī mi cug ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa/ nang ma khong)lugs rgya mtsho'i gos can kun khyab par/ /rab spel zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rje ni/ /ji snyed bskal brgyar 'gyur med rang bzhin mchog /sra mkhregs rdo rje lta bur rtag brtan zhing / /phul byung ba ched don tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par myur du 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang chos rje phyon bstan 'dzin dang sgrub grogs rnams kyis me'i spu gri'i mtshams 'og nas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rab brtan rdo rje g.yung drung pad 'dab steng / /bdud rtsi'i bcud 'khyil dmar gsal bum pa'i nang / /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin gsal ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /'chi med grub pa'i rten 'brel lhun grub shog /tshe dpag med mgon thugs gar 'dab brgyad steng / /'od lnga'i sna tshogs rdo rje g.yung drung ris/ /thabs shes nyi zla zung du 'jug pa'i khrid/ /rdo rje slob dpon g.yo med brtan gyur cig /tshe dang ye shes dpag med mgon po dang / /yid bzhin 'khor lo rnam par rgyal ma sogs/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /thugs rjes smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub par mdzod/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam (7na〉pa gon mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /ngur smig gar bsgyur blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos can ma lus pas/ /spel phyir rje btsun bla ma zhabs brtan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rdo rje 'jigs mdzad lha/ /ye shes mgon po bka' sdod dmag zor ma'i/ /byin rlabs nus mthus bar chad kun zhi zhing / /'dod pa'i re ba yongs su skong gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa gnyis kyis gra tshang spyi tshogs kyi zhal 'don du bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams/ /rdo rje slob dpon lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lhun grub pad+ma 'byung gnas drag po rtsal/ /thugs rje bskul na mkhyen brtse nus dpung skyed/ /chos kun gang shar ye nas rang grol ba'i/ /che mchog 'dus pa'i zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal/ /gzhom med g.yung drung rang bzhin seng ge'i khrir/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi 'gyur bzhugs byin rlobs/ /rtsa gsum —21/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheyongs 'dus bka' brgyad lha tshogs kyis/ /ḍā gi rigs lngas brkyang ba'i dar lam chod/ /lha srin gdug pa'i bsun ma phyir bzlog nas/ /zhing 'dir mi g.yo brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /bde gshegs zhi khros skye 'chi med dbang bskur/ /gzung ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dbyangs long / /semasadapa' che rnams bkra shis char du phob/ /ging chen pho nyas bdud dpung pha mthar skyod/ /sgeg sogasalha mos 'chi med tshe g.yang khug /yum bas 'byung ba'i (7ba 〉 glo sdus nyams pa gsos/ /srid gsum che bkrag 'khor 'das yon tan kun/ /thugs gsang dpal gyi be'ur 'khyil bar mdzod/ /skyon bral pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng / /'chi med 'od snang yab yum rol gar gyi/ /brgya drug dga' bzhi las 'ongs dngas ma'i bcud/ /mi 'gyur srog gi zungs su 'gyur bar shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma kun 'dus tshe dbang rtsal/ /rang rig dag pa'i rang ngo yongs shes te/ /gtsug na 'bral med skyong ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'chi med rigs 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbu ma nyi zla'i gur dbus 'od mi 'gyur/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ khyud lnga'i rgyu sbyangs rigs bzhi'i sa bon du/ /thim pas rnam grol tshe yi dpal 'bar shog /sros/ rtsa'i dngas ma lnga ldan 'od phung nang / /rigasalnga 'dus pa'i mi 'gyur mgon po'i sku/ /ye shes sting gnas na par nges rnyed pas/ /'chi med sku gsum myur du 'grub par shog /chu dbyings rtsa yi sgron gsum gcig dril nas/ /mkha' la gdod ma'i rang byung ye shes rtsal/ /'ja' ltar snang bas tshe srog mi shigs pa'i/ /thig le chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar shog /slu med spang rtogs snang nyams gong du 'phel/ /longs sku'i zhing myul rig pa tshad du phebs/ /chos nyid zad sar 'byol ba rdo rje'i sku/ /'grub ste 'chi bdag bdud las rgyal par shog /lha sngags rdzas rlung thabs kyis bsgrubs pa dang / /mtshungs min rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng ltar/ /'pho ba chen po'i sku 'grub tshe la dbang / /skye 'chi med pa'i rigs 'dzin brnyes par shog /dad dang dam tshig gtsang ma'i zhing sa la/ /bden (8na stobs smon lam sa bon rab btab pa/ /rtsa gsum thugasarje'i char gyas legs smin nas/ /re ba'i 'bras bu nyer dud shis pa stsol/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad —212

rigs 'dzin thog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti hrī mi cug ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa/ nang ma (gepa 'di ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i gra dmangs rnams kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba ltar byang gter tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang gi bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyi lam dang mthun par za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /zhi khro che mchog ngo bor yongs 'dus pa'i/ /phyag rgyas bdud dpung zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal/ /rdo rje slob dpon gzugs su legs shar ba/ /srid pa'i mtha' snyed dkyil 'khor mgon por bzhugs/ /thod 'phreng rigs lngar rang snang shes rab mar/ /snyoms 'jug dngas ma'i bdud rtsis rtsa 'khor kun/ /gtams pas a nya srog gi ka ba'i zungs/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i khams su deng byin rlobs/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor gyi lha/ /gter srung dam can mthu stobs ldan rnams kyis/ /nag phyogs rtsa lag pham pa'i dkar po'i dar/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar 'phyar ba'i bkra shis stsol/ /ces pa 'di'ang lha sa byang gling pa blo bzang lhun grub spun ma sru rnams kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par rgyun 'dzugs kyi ched du ji srid kyi bar zhing phul nas zhal 'don tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'od mtshan dpag tu med pa snang mtha'i gar/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin grub pa thod phreng rtsal/ /ma smad thugs rje'i bum pa (sha ba tha zang po las/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rtag tu stsol/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal zhi khros rjes bzung pas/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal/ /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal mgon du/ /nges pa lnga ldan ji bzhin g.yo med shog /rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa'i chos srid bstan/ /mthu stobs nus pas gyen du nyer 'degs pa/ /dpal ldan nor 'dzin skyong ba mi yi rje/ /gzhes med rdo rje'i khri la rtag brtan shog /dzā ti'i dri bzang 'thul ba'i yul gru nas/ /rnam bkra za 'og 'thag pa'i rgyal khams bar/ /khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing rab lci bas/ /'gro rnams rdzogs ldan dga' ston la spyod shog /phyogs las rnam rgyal phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /smin grol rgyud 'grel man ngag rdo rje'i theg /legs par bshad pa'i khrims ldan —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherigs 'dzin gling / /srid mtha'i bar du bla nas blar 'phel shog /lhag bsam zhing sar dge ba'i sabon tshogs/ /yongs btab gos bzang snye ma ro bda'i bcud/ /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam skye dgu ma lus pas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du myong bar shog /dngos grub 'byung gnas rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /byin rlabs gter mdzod bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha/ /'phrin las kun sgrub 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ bsams pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub par shog /ces mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par snyan dar bcas phul ba'i dus nged rang dang sde pa gnyis ga'i ring 'tsho'i smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar pa'i yi ge ba ni tre'o ngag dbang nam mkha' 'o/ /(9na)phung khams skye mched au ṇ+ḍi ya na'i zhing / /snying bcud dngas ma / rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /'dab brgyad snying gi pad dkar ze'u 'bru'i steng / /snying tshil nyi zla'i gdan la rig rtsal gdangs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gsum gas 'dus lha/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtsug /rta mgo'i rtse mor rigs bdag snang mtha' yas/ /'od kyi thig le brkar ba mtshan rdo rje g.yas/ /g.yon pa bum 'dzin lha mo tsaṇ+ḍasnyi/ /tshe mda' bum pa 'dzin dang mnyam par sbyor/ /gnyis ka'ang bcu drug lang tsho dkar dmar mdangs/ /rus pa rin cen me tog dar zab spras/ /'od klong rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /dung khang zla gdan longs sku 'phags mchog dmar/ /phyag na shel phreng pad+ma thugs kar ā+oṃ/ /gtso bo'i ljags steng sal dbyangs gsal bskor/ /snying nas nyi zlar sprul sku pad 'byung dmar/ /thugs kur hūṃ mtshan nyi zla ga'u'i nang / /srog yig yum gyi thugs kur zhal sbyar gsal/ /rtsa khams dag pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor/ /rigs bdag nyi ma ltar 'bar 'od zer gyis/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs 'khor 'das tshe bcud rnams/ /bkug nas/ ti'i lam brgyud srog yig dang / /dbyer med 'pho ba chen po'i sku 'grub shog /sku gsum rigs kun 'dus pa'i byin chen char/ /phab pas zil gnon 'jam dpal bzhad pa rtsal/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin ji bzhin 'chi bdag gi /bdud —214

rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti gyig ṇi ga ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa/ nang ma (gelas rgyal pa'i bden tshig 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par rtses dang nas (9bzhang bco lnga sbyar ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad rgyun 'dzugs shig dgos tshul ltar mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sgrub skor snga phyi bar gsum du byung ba'i phyi ma lhang lhang brag gi gter byon dang rgya can las byung ba phyogs tsam mthun pa'i don gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas smon lam btab pa phan yon che bar mthong ste za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /snod bcud bde ldan zhing khams skye 'phags gar/ /snang dbus khri pad nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /dpal ldan bla ma tshe dpag med mgon skur/ /rab gsal 'khor ba stongs min rtag brtan shog /a nya mi 'gyur dhū ti'i ka ba can/ /snying dbus thabs shes zla nyi'i ga'u'i nang / /dngas ma'i tshe srog yig gzugs 'od bkrag 'tsher/ /bskal brgyar mi phyed g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /pad 'byung yab yum zhal lung tshes mngar bas/ /legs btags gsang mtshan rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /swā la'i sman ljongs phan bde'i nyer 'tsho mā /mi 'gyur smon lam bden tshig lhun grub shog /nor 'dzin skyong ba'i mi dbang zhabs brtan zhing / /chos ldan rgyal po'i khrims kyis 'dzam gling khyab/ /thub bstan bshad sgrub dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel/ /'bangs rnams lha yi dga' ston la spyod shog /slu med dkon cog gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i byin rlabs stobs/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma sogs srung ma'i mthus/ /bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog zhes nged rang dang sde ba'i ring 'tsho bstan 'gro rgyas pa'i smon lam 'di ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas (10na)rgya mtshos rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par 'dzugs rgyu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phrong rgyas bkras rab phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rnam rol las/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed la ston pa dngos/ /mi zad mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i bshes gnyen tshul/ /'dzin mdzad rigs kun bdag po —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she zhabs brtan shog /snyigs dus log par spyod pa'i 'gro mang dang / /khyad par rmu rgod bod 'bangs gnyen gcig pur/ grub mchog mtsho skyes rdo rje slar byon pa/ /bstan 'gro'i mchod sdong chen po zhabs brtan shog /mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /mthu ldan chos srung byin rlabs nus pa'i rtsal/ khyab bdag pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs rje'i gzis/ /gsol ba btab pa'i re las lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung pad 'phrin pas gus pas gsol ba btab pa'o/ /tshangs pa dung thod can gyis ring 'tsho'i ched du mdzad nas grwa tshang la tshugs shig par gsungs pa/ mchog gsum ngo bo rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung / /zhi dang khro bo'i lha yi tshogs kun gyis/ /dngos grub kun stsol bgegs dpung zhi bar mdzod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi mchog /ngur smig 'dzin pa gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mtha' yas bskal pa'i bar du zhabs brtan cing / /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ khyod ni sku tshe du ma'i sngon rol nas/ /'gro la snying stobs r+pā po'i mchog gyur kyang / /da dung 'gro ba'i don la mi ngal zhing / /(10bskokhor ba ma stongs bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba gnyisapa btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa dang / gru 'dzin dga' ldan rnam rgyal pho brang gi /lugs gnyis bskal brgya'i bar du skyong du gsol/ /tshe dpag med mgon 'phags ma rnam par rgyal/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'jigs pa brgyad skyob sogs/ /thugs rje bzhu blugs rdo rje'i srog gi zungs/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur byin gyisarlobs/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /gsung ngag chos kyi mdzod la dbang sgyur blo/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /yongs khyab bshes gnyen dam pa zhabasabartan shog /phas rgol sa srungs 'gros la 'jigs med par/ /thos bsam gdong lnga'i rtsal gsum go cha can/ /thub bstan gangs rir nyer bsgom lang tsho'i sde/ /'og min zhing gtso lta bur brtan par shog /zhwa ser bshad sgrub bstan pa dge 'dun tshogs/ /lugs gnyis pho brang skyong ba mi yi dbang / /—216

rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti sdigacig ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa/ nang ma 9)sku tshe chab srid mnga' 'bangs bde skyid rnams/ /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin bla nas sngar 'phel shog /myur mdzad mgon po dam can ma he'i zhal/ /'dod khams dbang phyug sprul pa'i chos rgyal che/ /lha dang drang srong bden tshig la dbang bas/ /smon lam ci btab lhun grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tshig nyung la don rgyas pa zhig tshogs chen dang grwa tshang du 'dzugs rgyu la rtsoms shig ces gnas chung lcog nas bstan srung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen pos bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags(11na thams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /zhe lcags bya chos rgyal ga 3ga gling ba'i mnal lam mo/ snang rnam dag rdo rje rigs kyi lha/ /zhi ba'i las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog /'byung ba chu dang nyon mongs zhe sdang las/ gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la/ /me long ye shes rdo rje tshe dbang bskur/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod/ /nga rgyal rnam dag rin cen rigs kyi lha/ /rgyas pa'i las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /lho phyogs rin cen mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog /'byung ba sa dang nyen mongs nga rgyal las/ gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rin cen tshe dbang bskur/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod/ /'dod chags rnam dag pad+ma rigs kyi lha/ /dbang gi las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ khub phyogs pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog /'byung ba me dang nyon mongs 'dod chags las/ gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chod kun sol la/ /sor rtog ye shes pad+ma tshe dbang bskur/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod/ /phrag dog rnam dag las kyi rigs kyi lha/ /mngon spyod las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog /'byung (11ba)ba rlung dang nyon mongs phrag dog las/ /gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la/ /bya grub —217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheye shes 'phrin las tshe dbang bskur/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod/ /gti mug rnam dag sangs rgyas rigs kyi lha/ /lhun grub las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /dbus phyogs burnya mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma bzlog /'byung ba mkha' dang nyon mongs gti mug las/ gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la/ /chos dbyings ye shesalhun grub tshe dbang bskur/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod/ /snang stong bde chen gzhom med rdo rje'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab rgyas rgyal kun gyi/ /ngo mtshar spyi gzugs gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /'gyur med sku yi rdo rje zhabs brtan gsol/ /grag stong 'gag pa med pa rdo rje'i gsung / /yan lag drug cu zab gsang chos kyi sgra/ /'gro blo'i bsam pa bzhin ston longs spyod rdzogs/ /'gag med gsung gi rdo rje zhabs brtan gsol/ /rig stong skye 'gag gnas bral rdo rje'i thugs/ /zab gsal ye shes chos kun 'byung ba'i dbyings/ khyab bdag rgyal ba'i snying po chos kyi sku/ /'khrul med thugs kyi rdo rje zhabs brtan gsol/ /kun khyab mkha' la 'phrin las nyin mor byed/ /'char nub yongs bral phan bde'i snang ba can/ /bstan 'gro'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i nyer 'tsho mchog /bskal pa rgya mtsho rab tu gsal gyur cig /tshul 'di 'khrul snang bden med kyi za zir bud med gzhen nu mdzes shing lang tsho rgyas pa zhig gis mnga' bdag btsan po'i (12na〉sku tshe'i bar chad zhi phyir rigs lnga'i lha la mchod gtor phul nas 'byung ba re dang nyon mongs pa res bskyed pa'i bar chad sel pa'i 'phrin las 'chol/ rigs lnga'i tshe dngos grub tu long / de'i bka' babs lha sras kyi rnam rol dang khyod la yod pas so zer/ rmi lam de gar don de tshang ba'i rtsom pa zhig byed khul gyi bri gzhi'i sam ṭa zhig btsal song bar ma rnyed cing / 'jim pa lta bu'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhig la bris nas 'bul khul gyi rdo rje de'i phyogs gcig skyabs mgon mchog gi phyag dang phyogs gcig nga rang gis bzung nas 'dug par rdo rje de'i rwa gnyis tsam 'gul pa'i brul la khyad tsam 'dug par brul na mi rung bas thabs shig lta dgos sems tshe/ mi dbang chen po'i sku 'phag nas dar dmar yug cig 'don pa gnang / des rwa —218

rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yang zab a ti spyi zla ṇi ga ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi rim pa/ nang ma rtogede mi 'gul bar bkyigs nas yang 'bul ba snang song bar legs pa'i rtog pa byed pa zhig byung ba/bud med de mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal lta bu zhig yin nam snyam pa dang / gong gi tshig rigs lnga'i skor rmi lam la gang byung ma brjed pas 'khrul snang bzhin dang / glo ka phyi ma bzhi'i tshig zur ma nges pa 'dra blos bcad nas bris pa dang / blo ka gsum tsam rtsa brjed kyi 'dri rgyu ma byung lags/ so skye'i 'khrul snang bden med ci brtol bskyed nas phul ba 'khrul med zab thugs chos kyi dbyings su bzod par bzhes par gsol ba 'debs shing / rten 'brel 'dra'i khyad nas ham pa bskyed nas phul ba lags/ /yid bzhin mtsho dbus pad sdong ze'u 'bru'i steng / /bde chen gar gyi nyams (12bskon tshe dbang rtsal/ /stong nyid snying rje'i rang gdangs 'tsho rgyal ma/ /mnyam spyor dngas mas srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /tsaṇ+ḍasnyi sogs 'chi med lha tshogs kyis/ /mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro lha srin gdug can gyi/ /bsun ma'i lam chod bla tshe srog 'phrog pa'i/ /rtsub sems dpal zhi phyir bzlog 'phrin las mdzod/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi phyag rgya zil gnon par/ /kun bzang 'jam mgon rig pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /gang shar rang grol rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byed por brtan gyur cig /gangs can lugs gnyis skyong ba mu khri btsan/ /gnam sa'i khyon la stobs kyi 'khor lo yis/ /dbang sgyur sangs rgyas rgya mtsho g.yung drung ba/ /a ho ka ba nyer tshugs zhabs brtan shog /rigs brgyud dpal 'byor longs spyod mnga' thang sogs/ /ngal gsos po yi bsod nams skal mnyam zhing / /'jig rten gsum gyi gtsug na zhabs sen zla/ /'char bar mes po tshangs pa'i mched por shog shwakya seng ge'i ring lugs ma lus dang / /khyad par zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /lha gcig snying stobs brtson pa'i dpung pa yis/ /nyer bteg srid mtha'i bar du yar rgyas shog /mtha' bzhi dbusakyi 'bangs su gtogs so cog /nad mtshon dbul phongs sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing / /ring po'i tshe dang mkho dgu'i 'byor ba rnams/ /lha yi grong khyer sal 'phos 'drar shog /'khor 'das yongs kyi yon tan ma lus pas/ /rnam par rgyal pa'i phan bde legs byung bas/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i gling 'di nyer —219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebakang ste/ /srid mtha'i (13na thar du dar zhing rgyas par shog /'dis mtshon thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /bsags pa'i bsod nams phung por spungs pa las/ /deng nas byang chub bar du phun tshogs kyis/ /mdun ma mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /khrims ldan rigs 'dzin 'dus gling tshogs rnams kyis/ /lhag bsam rnam dag kun blangs bden brjod dang / /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba slu med mthus/ /smon lam rab btab re ba 'bras ldan shog khrad gsum dbang sgyur dmag zor lha mo sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dang / /bkra shis dpal gyis dus kun khyab par mdzod/ ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad don bzang la tshig 'jam bde ba grwa tshang du 'dzugs rgyu zhig dgos zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /dge 'di'i dkon mchog rnam gsum thugs rje'i mthus/ /dga' ldan pho brang chos dang srid kyi bstan/ /de 'dzin ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bskal brgyar zhabs zung rdo rje ltar brtan shog /sa yi dbang phyug sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yi/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid ma lus pa/ /rnam mang thosapa'i sras dang 'gran nus par/ /bla ma yi dam srung mas byin gyis zla mes/ /lhag bsam ston zla ltar dkar rgyu sbyor ba/ /'dir snang tshe ring nad med bde skyed 'phel/ /(13ba ji bar lha mi'i rten bzang nyer brgyud nas/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog zhes pa 'di yang dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis rigs med la mang skol dus tshogs 'don du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /mtha' yas zhid bzhugs rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus blo bzang bstan pa'i gnyen/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho yi/ /zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gter chen po/ /gang 'dul 'gro ba'i re bskong bum —220

bzang mchog /lha mi'i 'dren mchog mthong ba don ldan rjes/ /lhar bcas 'gro rnams srid mtha'i bar du skyongs/ /bslu med dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum mthus/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yi/ /sku tshe chab srid srid mthar brtan pa dang / /phun tsho gos yar ro'i zla ltar rgyas par shog /chu khyi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug la tsher gseb chos skyong chen pos mdzad de rang phyogs kyi dgon che phra rnams la 'dzugs dgos tshul byung ba ltar par du bkod pa'o// //maṅga le/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemachod rten gyi stod smad bar gsum bsgrig pa'i ngag 'don bzhugs/mchod rten gyi stod smad bar gsum bsgrig pa'i ngag 'don ni/ dkon cog gsum gyi mtshan gzhug pa'i dus/ dge 'dun chos la dgra byung gi /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ra mda' rlog /gzu dang dpang du dkon cog bzhugs/ /bdag gis ma nyes pa'i bden pa bdar/ dgra bgegs kyi nyes pa bsgrag /thod sku sogs bum nang gi sku rnams bzhugs su gsol nas/ hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na/ /drag po e yi gzhal yas na/ /srog sdud gshin rje nag po ni/ /nag po dug chen 'khyil pa'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /phyag drug mtshon chas dgra bgegs sgrol/ /sku la dur khrod rgyan dang ldan/ khro rgyal thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /dregs pa lha srin rdul du rlog /dam nyamasadagra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /skye myags kyi mthar dgra bo'i tsit+ta hur thums dza: srog la dun rmugasabreng shag rbad/ bang rim dang por rim bzhin gshed bzhi bkod la/ /srin po ya ma rā dza'i sku/ /smug nag be con tsakra bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ya ma (2na)rā dza sa do me ya bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i ban bon skye bo rkang 'dre rbod gtong thams cad kyi srog la dun rmugs rbad/ gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /ser nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya bsam ༅ sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i ban bon skye bo rbad 'dre rbod gtong thams cad skyi srog la kho shag rbad/ bdud po ārla ma ru'i sku/ /dmar nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i ban bon skye bo rbad 'dre rbod gtong thams cad kyi srog la breng shag rbad/ gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu'i sku/ /ljang nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /yak+ṣi la ni rā ma ya bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i ban bon skye bo rbad 'dre rbod gtong thams cad kyi srog la —222

mchod rten gyi stod smad bar gsum bsgrig pa'i ngag 'don bzhugs/ nang ma (peyaṃ shag rbad/ bang rim gnyis par mon pa bzhi bkod la/ hūṃ/ dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo /lcagasakyi mon pa stag gi mgo /bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo /gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo /sprul pa las(2ba)kyi srog gshed bzhis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /kā li dun ting tsit+ta ro myagasarbad/ /ha la ha la dun ting tsit+ta ro myags rbad/ raka dun ting tsit+ta ro myags rbad/ rkarma bha ti dun ting ro myags rbad/ bang rim gsum pa bdud bzhi bkod la/ he le khyab pa shar gyi bdud/ /nag po 'dzum med lha yi bdud/ /so 'dar mugs pa nub kyi bdud/ /ral pa spyir bcings byang gi bdud/ /lasakyi bdud po chen po bzhi/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ru tā ru thums bha ti srog la thur thur mā ra ya/ bang rim bzhi par 'chi bdag bcu gnyis bkod la/ hūṃ/ lcags ri 'bar ba bcu gnyis la/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi bdud chen po/ /'jigs byed chen po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gdug pa dug gi kha rlang can/ /'bar ba gtum po tshogs kyi bdag /spyan gsum ldog pa'i sdang mig sgyur/ /zhal bgrad 'bar ba'i mche ba gcigs/ /lce myang mchu ni khrag gis brlan/ /so rno lag pa khrag gi dmar/ /zangs gri zhags pa nag po dang / /gdug pa'i mtshon cha mang po 'dzin/ /snying rje med par sod byed pa/ /rngams shing gtum po'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /kṛ ṣ+ṭha dza ma ri dgra bo'i tsit+ta breng shas dzaḥ srog la hur thumasarbad/ bang rim bzhi pa'i smad char zhag gshed so gnyis bkod la/ hūṃ/ ra ma bsal/khyams kyi 'obs sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ shar du bdud po khram shing thogs pa brgyad/ /lho na gshin rje be con thogs pa brgyad/ /nub na ma mo nad rkyal bsnams pa brgyad/ /(3na)byang du gnod sbyin ral gri bsnams pa brgyad/ /g.yon pa kun gyis 'khor lo skor/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /tī tsa pa la a shug me ya dun shag rbad bh+yo/ dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya rbad nan/ du tri ya tri ma tri shi tri ya/ dug shag myagasarbad bh+yo/ dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya rbad nan/ sgo bzhin sgo ba bkod la/ hūṃ/ srog bdag dkar po snying 'byin dang / /ma hā kā la 'jigasapa'i sku/ /bdud po yab rje nag po dang / /gnod sbyin sku mchog dmar po bzhi/ /drag po las kyi sgo —223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebazhi nas/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /tri ca pa la a shug me ya dgra bo byad ma'i srog la thums ril rbad bh+yo/ mā ra ya rbad nan/ ma hā kā la ya dgra bo byad ma thun khrag shag tsit+ta ro myagasarbad bh+yo/ ru tra du ru ya/ dgra bo byad ma'i rtsal dun rmugs rbad bh+yo/ ya ka ru lu ha ha ya/ dgra bo byad ma'i khrag la mugs ti thun rbad bh+yo/ mā ra ya rbad bh+yo/ seng khri'i mtsho gdan la za ma'i gshin rje drug cu bkod la/ hūṃ/ dkyil rma lis mi/ 'khor mu khyud lcags ri la/ /thad mkhar rtsang ni drug stol/ /pho gshed sum brgya drug cu dang / /mo gshed sum brgya drug cu dang / /gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu'i tshogs/ /mi lpags g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ /g.yas pa gnam lcags 'khor lo dang / /g.yon pa thun gyi gong zor bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzad/ /ya ma dun dun sha /gh+ri na gh+ri na/pa tsa pa tsa/ hu lu hu lu/ bhe ra bhe ra/ ha la ha la/ ya ya/ ma ma/ (3bsteg sa nag ma ha : hre ta ya ni dun bh+yo ya dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya rbad nan/ dmag sdud kyi bskul ni/ hūṃ/ nyon mongs las kyi ru tra 'di/ /ma rig mun pa'i smag rum du/ /dug gsum stobs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ /'chi bdag nag po tshe srog bdag /gsang ba bshad kyi lha khyed kyis/ /rang gshed mnan pa'i las mdzod cig /e raṃ baṃ yaṃ zhe sha gi tsit+ta gtubs/ dgra bo sa sa gtibs/ mes 'tshig /chus bskur/ rlung gis g.yos/ kha ri baṃ lhug sna ri tsi ri khas g.yon/ dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya rbad sod/ lcags sdig gi skabs byas pa bshig pa dang lcags 'dre'i skabs gshed po las rgyal gyi ngag 'don ni/ hūṃ/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /sngags pa nang rgyas byed pa'i tshe/ /lha srin stobs 'gran byed pa'i dus/ /drag sngags gcod 'gran byed pa'i tshe/ /gshed po las rgyal po khyod/ /skye ba snga ma'i las dbang gis/ /sgrub byed skyesabu chen po la/ /sdod pon dregs pa'i srog khang nas/ /srog snying sngags kyi rnam par phyung / /sems ni sngags kyi rgyud du byung / /'jig rten dregs pa'i srog sngags kyi/ /dam nyams las kyi ru dra la/ rang gshed dbab pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rak+ṣa/ nā ga /ya ma/ rag mo/ raka/ k+ṣe ma/ badz+ra kro ta/ dun ting gī lwa ya/ ma ma rag mo/ nyid du gtubs/ ha sha rag trag /du phrag dun ting / 'bil ni/ a dun —224

tri/tri sha na/ rwa tsa hasti/ rā tsa mu tra ga sha hūm̐ ti sta ri ni ro/tri nag /a tri su chu/ tsa tri rā tsa/ rā (4na)tsa nā ga /de wa ru tri/ kha rag k+ṣe ma tri/ dun ti hri srog mā ra ya/ gha na ba ti/ ra na ka ro/ kā la du bragabyi du ra na/ nā ga mo tri/ sag byi du/ dgra bo ban bon byad ma mkhan sarba ri bha ya nan/ 'drid rbad sarba rtsa sbur/ srog la nan/ snying gzer/ breng shag raṃ yaṃ rbad/ tshe bdag lugs gnyis kyi mchod rten bsgrig dus la nyer mkho 'di'ang za hor gyi bzhes sbyar// //sarba maṅga lo/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub bzhugs so/ /na ma ārla tā rā yi/ dus gsum rnam 'dren bskyed pa'i yum gcig ma/ /khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas bar chad las/ /rgyal byed mdos kyi chog khrigs mthong ba yis/ /don kun 'grub pa'i 'phrin las 'di na spel/ /de la 'dir rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos kyi cho ga nyams su blang ba la bca' gzhi'i rim pa rnams yig rtsing dang mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar legs par bshams/ bdag gsar ma sor bltag byed na bdag bskyed jo bo dang ba ri'i lugs gang rung nas len cing sman rag tshogs mchod dor sgo dbye man ni gzhan nas kha 'geng bar bshad pas skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ /bskyed sgos kyi bca' gzhi mañdzi dang maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bum rdzas nyer lnga blug pa'i bum pa kha rgyan can sman raka gtor gsum mchod pa rnams rgyas par bshams/ bum pa'i khar gzungs thag rdo rje bkod/ bdag bskyed ni/ na mo bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: zhes sogs 〈(ka gnyis kyis skyabs sems bya/ 'byung gtor btang la bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: ྅/ nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po rnams byang chub sgrub la mi dga' ba'i bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams: nga ni rab 'jigs khro bo'i rgyal: nga (2na tha bka' las ma 'da' bar lan chags glud gtor 'di long la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug myur du dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: khro bo khro mo'i tsho gos bcas kyis khyod kyi lusang ga yid dang bcas brlag par 'gyur gyis gzhan du min: de bas ma 'dug myur du dengs ma / bha ni rlu bha snrogro hā gro hā ྅: gro hā pa ya kṛ hā pa ya ྅: ā na ya ho: bha ga wan: bi sdi rā dza hūṃ phaṭa: gnyis pa mtshams bcad pa ni: ྅/ nga ni dbang chen rab 'jigs khros pa'i sku: mtshon cha'i 'od zer khro tshogs dpag med 'phro: rdo rje'i 'khor lo ral gri 'bar ba dang : dbyug to rgya gram phur pa la sogs gur: ye shes—226

rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma rtogelnga yi me dpung lnga ru 'bar: khro chung ya ka mang po skar ltar zha thug sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i dgra dang bgegs: thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu khyab par srungs: bka' dang mtshams las su yang 'da' ma byed zho badz+ra tsakra tik+ta rkarma gī la ya dz+wa la raṃ yak+ṣa kro ta dz+wa la ma dha la hūṃ phaṭa: ces mtshams bcad do: gsum pa mchod rdzas la bsangs chu gtor zhing byin gyis brlab pa (2ba ji su bhā was snod bcud thams cad stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las thod pa dang zlo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ā+oṃ ci ma zlo lha lha a yo badz+ra pu gyu sgru pe ā lo ke — ni li bye: shasta u3: na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu ge saḥsarba thā kho ut+pa te skyo ra ṇa i mo ga ga na kho: zhes brjod pas mchod gtor rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya dang ldan paḥ gzugs mdzes: sgra snyan: dri zhim: ro bda' reg 'jam: zhal bsil zhabs bsil: yon chab: dri chab la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pas nam mkha' dang sa gzhi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mchod pa'i bye brag dang 'dod yon gyi lha mos gang bar nan gyi byin gyis brlab bo sman raka gtor gsum sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi byed las khyad par can dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ ma hā pañtsa a mri ta hūṃ khyuḥṭha/ ma hā bha smra dha hūṃ tshong/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya bya/ bzhi pa rten gyi lha bskyed pa ni su bhā was stong par sbyangasapa'i ngang las gnas de nyid 'ja' tshon lnga'i 'od dang zer du 'byug pa khyad par du in+d+ra ni la'i mdog steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu yang ljang gur gsal ba dag par gyur pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i rgyab yol gyi dbus su hūṃ yig ljang gu 'od zer lnga ru 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mchod: sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs don byas tshur (3na tsher dus two la thim yongs su gyur ba las rje btsun ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang gu: phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin g.yon āt+pala'i yu ba mtheb srin —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegyis bzung nas snyan gyi thad ka nas kha bye ba: zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum zhal 'dzum 'od zer dang ldan zhing dbu gtsug na snang ba mtha' yas kyis brgyan pa: gzhen nu lang tsho rgyas pa: bcu drug lon pa: nu ma 'bur ba: sku ldem la 'gying bag dang ldan pa: sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thams cad rdzogs pa dbu rgyan snyan rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub: do shal dpung rgyan la sogs rgyan du mas spras pa:dbu skra ser zhing li ba spyi bor ci bangs pa zar bu 'phyang ba: dar lnga'i stod g.yogs dang : dar dmar po'i sham thabs can: nam mkha'i 'ja'am chu nang gi zla ba ltar snang ba la gdos bcas su ma grub pa:'od zer dang ldan pa zhig gsal bar yang yang bsgom de'i mtha' skor du yang sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig dang sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsgom rje btsun ma'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgrin par cho po thugs rkar hūṃ mthing ga dang twe yig ljang gu: lte bar gyi ser po re bsam: thugs ka'i yig 'bru gnyis las 'od 'phros: rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub nub phyogs u rgyan yul gyi shar ri bo ta la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas dang : lho phyogs seng ldeng gi nags nas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas byon par bsam lnga pa spyan drang ba ni: rol mo dang dbyangs snyan pos: ྅/ chos sku skye med ngang nyid las thugs rje'i smon lam (3ba〉pas zhakhrungs pa longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dpes spras: bcom ldan thugs rje'i ngang can ma tshur gshegs rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum: 'phags ma 'phags ma gshegs su gsol po ta la yi gnas mchog nas: thugs rje'i spyan dang lha yig la 'gro ba skyob par sku sprul ma yid bzhin dngos grub kun gyi gter: 'gro ba mgon med rnams la ni brtse ba chen pos gshegs su gsol: 'jigs brgyad zhi dang tshe dbang rgyas: khams gsum dbang sdud drag po yis: mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog pa dang : bdag la mchog dang thun mong sogs re ba'i 'dod don ma lusapa thams cad stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: ārla tā ra sam ya dzaḥlha baṃ ho zhes rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig la byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar khra phung nge bzhugs pa la —228

rje gzha seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma 'darang thal mo sbyar la ji snyed su dag gam: yan lag bdun pa gang rung ba zhig 'bul lo drug pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: ྅/ bsod nams dang ni ye shes kyiḥ tshogs gnyis rnam dag las grub pa'i pho brang gzhal yas 'od du 'bar pad+ma ge sar zla ba'i steng : bcom ldan 'phags ma'i tshogasarnams kun dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: ārla tā ra : ba dhu ki ni sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:zhes nam mkha'i ye shes pa rnams dam tshig bskyed pa la chu 'dres pa ltar dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam: yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad rigs lnga'i tshul du byon nas dbang bskur bum chus sku nang khengs spyi bor lud pa las rigs kyi bdag nyid snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan cing : gzhan (4na sko rnams la'ang rang rang gi rigs bdag gis brgyan par bsam bdun pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: e ma 'a dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum: 'gro drug bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro drug sdug bsngal gzir ba la: byamasapa'i thugs rjes skyob mdzad ma: sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: las kyi me chen 'bar ba la thugs rje'i chu yis bsil mdzad ma 'phags ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba nyen mongs la:'phags ma khyed ni lhag par brtse thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo: gang gis zol med blo yis ni:mos pas skad cig dran pas kyang : sdug bsngal sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo lha mo thugs rje'i ngang can ma brtse dang mkhyen dang nus par ldan yid bzhin ma la phyag 'tshal lo dus min 'chi ba la sogs pa:mi mthun phyogs rnams kun skyob ma skyabs chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo tā ra : ba dha gi ni a ti pu r+ṣabra ti dza sngo zhes phyag bya'o brgyad pa sku khrus gsol ba ni // sngon gyi rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon lu zhi'i tshal du bltams pa na tshangs dang brgya byin lha rnams kyis ji ltar dag pa'i khrus gsol ltar dri ldan chab ni dge ba'i chus de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol ye shes mchogo gi 'phags ma ni gtso 'khor lha yi tsho gos rnams la sku la sgrib g.yogs mi mnga' yang : bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang ba dang : 'gro rnams bsod nams bsag pa'i phyir dag byed chu yis sku khrus gsol —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebadag sogs nyon mongs (4bskyob dag nas: dri ma med pa'i sku thob shog zho sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ྅: zhes me long ngos la sku khrus gsol lo: de nas dar ram ras dri ma med pa thogs la: ྅/ dri bral yang dag mchog gi sku mnga' ba sred dang chags sogs dri ma mi mnga' yang :gtsang dang dri zhim ldan pa'i gos dag gis: 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams dga' bas sku phyi'o: zho hūṃ gyi kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā lha lha yi na bza' pañtsa li ka dang : dri med dag pa gar shi ka yi ras rje btsun 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas pa dang : phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun la dbul bar bgyi'o: yo sarba ta thā ga ta a laṅka ra ye swā 4 zhes na bza' dbul lo: dgu pa mchod pa'i bye brag rnams 'bul ba ni: dang po phyi mchod rnams las chu gsum 'bul ba ni: ྅/ dri med gtsang zhing dag pa bdud rtsi'i chu: yan lag brgyad ldan bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas spos dang ga pur tsan+dan la sogs pa bsil dang ngad ldan bde ba skyed byed pa: zhal bsil zhabs bsil yon chab la sogs pa: rje btsun 'phagasama'i tsho gis la dbul bar bgyi: a lha pra tī ts+tsha ye swā ga pā ldu pra tī ts+tsha ye swā 4 de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: spyi dang mthun par rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba la cha gsum du 'bul lo bcu pa 'dod yon gyi mchod pa 'bul te: rdo rje dril bu gsor zhing 'brol rol mo'i sgra skabs su bsgrag cing : ྅/ stong gsum 'jig rten phyogs dus thams cad du: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i bye brag ni dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis legs sprul te: rgyal ba'i yum mchog khyod la dbul bar bgyi'o: (ldan〉/rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan la mchod 'bul ma: lha mo dkar mo rab mdzesang nga tshul can dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ba'i mdangs ldan pa'i sgeg ma'i phyag na me rtag sna tshogs thogs rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o swo sa/ tā re : ba dha ki ni badz+ra puspro : rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shangs la mchod 'bul ma: lha mo ser mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can: ga bur tsan+dan rgya shug la sogs pa'i sgeg ma'i phyag na bdug spos sna tshogs bsnams rje btsun 'phags ma'i tsho gos la dbul bar bgyi'o: chu ā/ tā re : ba dha ki ni badz+ra sgru pe : rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs la mchod —230

rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma 6)'bul ma: lha mo dmar mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can: 'bru mar rtsi mar snang gsal 'od kyi tshogs:sgeg ma'i phyag na snang gsal dpag med bsnams: rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o: zho 〉〉 tā re : ba dha ki ni badz+ra ā lo ke snro rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sku la mchod 'bul ma:lha mo ljang gu rab mdzes ngang tshul can tsan+dan gur kum rtsi chen dri la sogs sgeg ma'i phyag na dri chab dpag med bsnams: rje btsun 'phags ma'i tsho gos la dbul bar bgyi'o: zho mi3 tā re : ba dha ki ni badz+ra — : rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ljags la mchod 'bul ma: lha mo dkar mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can: rang byung lhan skyes sbyar ba'i zhal zas sogs sgeg ma'i phyag na zhal zas dpag med bsnams rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o: zho unyu tā re : ba dha ki ni badz+ra ni wi du : rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor snyan (5ba〉pa mchod 'bul ma: lha mo sngon mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can:rnga dung dril bu pi wang 'byung ba'i sgra sgeg ma'i phyag na sil snyan dpag med bsnams rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o: zho sa/ tā re : ba dha gi ni badz+ra sha lta snro bcu gcig pa nang gi mchod pa ni: lha/ srid par gtogos pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na chogazugs ma ga rab mdzes ji snyed yod pa kun rdo rje gzugs ma'i tsho gos su kun sprul nas rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la dbul bar bgyi'o tshwa u3 badz+ra rū pa pra tī ts+tsha ྅: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na:sgra mchog skad snyan ji snyed yod pa kun rdo rje sgra ma'i tsho gos su kun sprul nas rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la dbul bar bgyi'o: chu u3 badz+ra sha lta ྅: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na:dri mchog bzang po ji snyed yod pa kun rdo rje dri ma'i tsho gis su kun sprul nas rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la dbul bar bgyi'o: zho mi lha badz+ra gharnye ྅: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na:longs spyod ro mchog ji snyed yod pa kun rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas: rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la dbul bar bgyi'o: 'o sa/ badz+ra rā se : srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byamasan rab mdzes na bza' ji snyed yod pa kun rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su rnam sprul nas: rgyal ba —231 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebaskyed pa'i yum la dbul bar bgyi'o: rlu u3 badz+ra sparnye sno srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na snang srid (6na)chos mchog ji snyed yod pa kun rdo rje chos ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la dbul bar bgyi'o: zho 〉〉 badz+ra dharma ma hā mu dra snro bcu gnyis pa bde ba'i gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: ྅/ rdo rje rigs kyi rje btsun 'phags ma la: zhe sdang ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi: mo long ye shes bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul: kun tu bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig:rin cen rigs kyi rje btsun 'phags ma la: nga rgyal ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi mnyam nyid ye shesabade ba'i mchod pa 'bul kun tu bde ba'i mchod pas dam lhas gyur cig pad+ma rigs kyi rje btsun 'phags ma la: 'dod chags ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi: sor rtog ye shes bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul kun tu bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig: las kyi rigs kyi rje btsun 'phags ma la: phrag dog ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi: bya grub ye shes bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul kun tu bde ba'i mchod pasamanyes gyur cig: de bzhin rigs kyi rje btsun 'phags ma la gti mug ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi:chos dbyings ye shes bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul kun tu bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig tshwa lha3 tā ra dzñā na pā dza sam ya snro bcu gsum pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni me rlung gi sbyor ba la sogs spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs: ྅/ ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i gtor ma ni rang byung rnam dag bdud rtsi'i ngo bo nyid ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi phung por gsal mchod pa'i lha mor dpag tu med pas gang : (6ba〉ga lnga bdud rtsi sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig tā ra : pa dha ki ni a skṛ ta ma hā ba li rnyi rak+ta sarba pu dza sno kha kha khā hi khā sti bcu bzhi pa bstod pa bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyis bstod pa las gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na zhes pas hūṃ/ spyan ras gzigs dbang brtse ba'i thugs rje can 'gro ba kun gzigs dag pa'i sbyin nyid las 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa'i bcom ldan ma brtse ba'i thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod zhal gcig —232

rje gzha seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos ga mthong bas don grub/ nang ma (pephyag gnyis in+d+ra ni la'i mdog gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i tshul:g.yas pa mchog sbyin g.yon pa ut+pal:dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod:rin cen rgyan spras 'dzu pa pa'i 'od zer can:longs spyod rab rdzogs rgyan rnams ma lus rdzogs:'phrin las rnam bzhi dngos grub kun gyi gter dgos 'dod re bskong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod:ces bstod rjes su phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bstod pa tshar gnyis btone rjes su bum pa la spro bsdu bya zhing mang du bzlas so:o tā re tu stu re tu re swā ༈zhes brgya dang :ārla tā ra zhes brgya tshar gyi rjes su yang bstod pa tshar gsum 'don:yang bsnyen pa brgya brtan rjes su bstod pa tshar bdun bya'o:bco lnga pa bshags pa bya ba ni:mosagus tshad med pas yid smad 'gyod pa skyed de thal mo snying gar sbyar la rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs thams cad dgongs:/bdag cig ma rig rmongs shing las ga pas:mi dge las kyi sgrib tshogs ci mchis pa gnong zhing 'gyod 7nas mas drag pos mthol zhing bshags ma ltar byamasapa'i thugs rjes dgongs nas kyang :nyes byas sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams byang bar shog badz+ra sa ma ye shudhe aḥzhes pa dang yig brgya bzlas so:bcu drug pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul zhing smre sngagasakyis gsol ba btab pa ni rje btsun ma'i rten gyi drung du thal sbyar pus btsugs lus ba spu g.yo bas gdong mchi ma 'byin cing bu ma la dungs nas ngu ba'i tshul du bya'o:kye hud 'phags ma 'phags ma byams ldan thugs rje can rgyal pa'i yum khyod gnas mchogo ga na bzhugs skyabs med bdag la dgos pa'i dus byung ngo thog med dus nas da lta thug gi bar rigs drug 'khor ba'i g.yang za dong ring 'dir skye ba grangs med sha khrag lus blangs kyang :byas pa'i las la don med chud re zos skye ba lan cig tsam zhig thar pa'i lam bsgrub pa'i 'brel yang bdag gis ma 'o rtogs sam 'phags ma'i thugs rjes bdag nyid btang srid dam thugs rjes bzung dang 'phags ma rgyal ba'i yum bdag ni ma rig lasang na sdig sgrib can mgon med bdag ni ma yis ma gzigs sam dungs pa'i nga ros 'o dod bos lags na ma khyod brtse ba'i thugs rjes mi 'dzin nam rigs drug 'khor ba'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedong du lhungs lags na: 'phags ma thugs rje'i zhags pas mi 'dren nam ma rig mun pa'i yul du gtan 'khyams na: 'phags ma thugs rje'i sgron me mi spor ram las kyi yul du dbang med 'khyams lags na: ma cig thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi 'dzin nam: dge ba'i myu gu lo tog skams (7ba)lags na: 'phags ma thugs rje'i char rgyun mi 'bebs sam: zhe sdang dug lnga'i me chen 'bar lags na ma cig thugs rje'i chu yis mi brlan nam dug gsum 'khrul pa'i nad kyis gdungs lags na:ma khyod thugs rje'i sman gyis mi gso 'am: dus 'dir ma khyod thugs rjes ma bzung na: deng nas phyin chad nges pa'i gnas med do: kye ma kye shud 'phags ma thugs rje can bdag la re ltos skyabs gnas gzhan na med skyid sdug re ltos gcig shes khyod shes na: thugs rje'i dpa' tshan skyed cig rje btsun ma: 'khor ba'i gnas su yun ring gtan 'khums na: nam zhig las zad gos bu thob pa'i tshe 'phags ma'i thugs rjes mi 'tshal don ma mchis las dbang btsan zhes bdag nyid bor gyur na thugs rje che zhes skyabs gnas su la byed: 'phags ma khyod la thugs rje'i stobs mnga' zhing :sngon 'brel gsol btab bden pa mi bslu na: thugs la le lo btang snyoms mi mdzad par skad cig nyid la thar par 'dren du gsol tshe 'dir mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad dang : rgyal po me chu lcags sgrog dug dang mtshon: rims nad sna tshogs chom rkun dus min 'chi: dgra dang bgegs sogs rmi lam mtshan ltasang na: chags che nyam nga 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs ma lus zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol: tshe dbang longs spyod dpal 'byor 'phrin las rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod khams gsum srid gsum snang srid thams cad kyi snang ba dbang du 'du (8na thar mdzad du gsol bdud dang dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun: tshar gcod drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol: bdag ni rtse gcig zol zog med pa yis: kha tsam ma yin snying nas gsol btab pas 'gro 'dug las byed gang gi phyogs dag tu'ang : bu gcig ma bzhin brtse bas bskyed du gsol: 'di dang phyi ma bar do'i gnas skabs su 'bral med rtag tu thugs rjes —234

rje gzha seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma rtogebazung du gsol: bdag gi rgyud la mi rtag byams snying rje dad dang brtson 'grus nges 'byung skyo shas dang : zab mo'i don dang stong nyid lta ba'i mchog: rtag tu nyams len skyo ngal med pa dang : tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par shog: ces skad cig ma yengs par sems dung dung bas gsol ba gdab bo: bcu drug pa dbang bskur ba ni: bum pa rje btsun ma'i rten dang bcas pa rang dang gzhan gyi spyi bor bzhag la rje btsun ma dngos su gsal ba'i gnas bzhi nas bskyed rim gyi skabs ltar gnas bzhi nas yig 'bru bzhi las 'od zer bar ma chad par bdag gi gnas bzhir 'phros shing thim par bsgoms la: ྅/ rje btsun 'phags ma thugs rje can: rnam dag sku yi sgo phye la: mi 'gyur rdo rje tshe yi dbang : skal ldan lus la bskur du gsol: ārla tā ra kā ya a bhi tiṣ+ṭha 'o: rje btsun 'phagasam thugs rje can: 'gag med gsung gi sgo phye la: 'gag med rnam grol gsung gi dbang : skal ldan ngag la bskur du gsol ārla tā re wā ga a lha ṇiñtsa skya rje btsun 'phags ma thugs rje can: sprosabral thugs kyi sgo phye la: spros med rdo rje thugs kyi dbang : skal ldan (8ba〉sems la bskur du gsol tsit+ta a bhi ṣañtsa snro rje btsun 'phags ma thugs rje can: sku gsum yongs rdzogs sgo phye la:'phrin las rnam bzhi 'gro 'dul dbang : skal ldan lus ngag yid la bskur: sarba a bhi ṇiñtsa saḥzhes gnas bzhir btug cing bum chu btung zhing khrus bya'o: mchod gtor mdos yas byin brlab ni/bdun gyi mchod pa dang mdos yas rnams la dmigs te bdag bskyed kyi mchod gtor byin rlabs rnams byas rjes/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ mdun du rin po che las grub pa'i khang bzang lcags ris bskor ba rtse zhol du yon bdag rnams kyi glud phung khams skye mched rnams yongs su rdzogs pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong / nam mkha'/ rgyang bu/ mda' khra/ 'phang khra/ pho gdong / mo gdong /gtor ma/ rin po che/ 'bru/ sman sogs mthun pa'i rjes thams cad bzang zhing gya nom pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur bsangs gzhung las byung ba'i sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs: mdun bskyed ni rje btsun ma'i —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesku gzugs la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a skṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rgyan rta babs/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar pa las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las āt+pal tī ljang gu mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rje (9na tha tsun sgrol ma sku mdog rin po che margad ltar ljang ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa phyag gi las mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon me tog ut+pal sngon po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyi bar du 'dzin pas 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gsab/ sor gdub la sogs rgyan dpag tu med pas spras pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang / dar dmar po'i sham thabs can 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ ye shes 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i dbus su bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa lta bus bskor ba'i spyi bor ā+oṃ/ mgrin par mi thugs gar hūṃ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang /g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sdedapung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal ba grangs med du ma sa /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/khyod bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu'aphrul byin rlabs sna tsho gos ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral bya'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su (9bsko sol/ /po ta la yi gnas mchogo nas/ /tī yig ljang gu las 'khrungs shing / /'od dpag med kyis dbu la brgyan/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas—236

rje gzha seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma 9)'phrin las ma/ /'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrusagasol/ /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /zhisangs rgyasang du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /rab 'byamasargya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ ārla tā ra sa pa ri wā ra a: pra ti ts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad sngags 'don pa bsgyur/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs gnyis pa blo la btud cing / /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ /spyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma/ /'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi/ /ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma/ /(10na〉sngos phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi dang po song rjes/ gong ltar chu gnyis nyer spyod kyi mchod pa 'bul/ de bzhin du/ phyag 'tshal ston rka'i zla ba kun tu zhes pa nas bzung ste/ phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar slo ka re dang / rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma tshang re spel/ de nas gtor ma cha bzhi'i dang po la dmigs nas/ oṃ myu la mā la shrī mdu mā a kā ro sogasabatags te lan gsum mam bdun gyis bla ma la/ oṃ tri rat+na la gtor sngags gtor ma gnyis pa dkon cog spyi la/ yi ge bcu pa la gtor sngags btags nas gsum pa sgrol ma la/ gtor ma bzhi pa dmag zor ma gur zhal sogs rang gang mos kyi chos skyong la 'bul/ mdos kyi mdun du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma cha drug re byas te dang po phyogs skyong la cha gsum ltar dang / gnyis pa gzhi bdag la/—237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegasum pa sde brgyad la cha gsum ltar bsngos rjes/ bla ma dkon cog gsum gyi mthu dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags dang / gzungs sngags dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu dang / bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyi mthus lha dang / klu dang / dri za dang / grul bum dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / brjed byed dang / spyo byed dang / rgad po dang / rgyad mo dang / bu mo dang / bu pho dang / 'khor g.yog dang / ma mo dang / mkha' 'gro dang / log 'dren dang / gshin rje dang / rgyal po dang / 'gong po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / gnyan dang / sa bdag dang / klu srin dang / gnod sbyin dang / 'byung po dang / btsan dang / bdud dang / yi dwags dang / (10bsko za dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / lo dang / zla ba dang / zhag dang / za ma la sogs pa la gnod pa'i sbyor ba byed pa rnams zhi bar gyur cig /ces brjod/ bzhi pa bgegs la cha gsum ltar bsngos rjes/ na ma dkon cog gsum nas byin rlabs kyi bar gong ltar la/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod sems dang gdug rtsub zhi bar gyur cig /ces brjod/ lnga pa rigs drug dang drug pa lan chags la gtong ba gtor ma brgya rtsa nas len/ tsho gis 'khor gter gzhung gang 'os nas kha bsgyur te tsho gos lhag yan gtong / de nas rol chen dang bcas rang rnam pa rta mgrin du gnas bsgyur te 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ dam pa chos skyong srung ma rnams/ /'dir ni bcol ba'i las rnams mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma glud rdzas 'bul/ /gnas 'dir gnod pa ma mdzad cig /snang srid lha 'dre sde brgyad po/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bka' la nyon/ /gzhan gyisarbad la ma nyan cig /gdon bgegs chen po thams cad kyang / /bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi bar gyis/ khyed rnams dgyes pa'i gtor ma dang / /gzugs brnyan mang po rnams dang ni/ /la rdzas lung rdzas 'dod dgur bcas/ /yid 'ong mchod pa spe zhol dang / /dar gyi gur phub ldir ri ri/ /'bru tshem dgu yi khri la bzhugs/ /dar glud rgyan cha sna tshogs dang / /yid 'ong rta pho legasamagyogs la/ /'bru yi ngar mi chen po bskyon/ /lus la gser g.yu mang pos brgyan/ /dar gyi gosabyon lhubs se lhub/ /smra ba mkhas la ngag snyan pa/ /bzhin ni legs la mdangs re che/ /'og na rta —238

rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma 9)zhen zhungs se zhung / /mgo la thod bcings pur ru sa /(11na thad 'jo sna tsho gos bsgyur la mkhas/ /g.yu yi lham chung zul lu lu/ /gser gyi ska rags khyugs se khyug /rnam rgyal ldem pa sku la brgyan/ /pho gdong mo gdong mi skad smra/ /mda' rigs 'dod dgu tshang ba rnams/ /yon bdag glud du khyed la 'bul/ /yid 'ong nor rdzas mang po rnams/ /zhal zas zhim la mngar dgu dang / /g.yog 'khor ngar mi bcu gsum dang / /sman spos mar me'i mchod pa rnams/ khyed rnams kun la 'bul lags kyi/ /sngags pa'i phur kha bsgril ba dang / /yungs kar thun 'gyas brab pa dang / /zor kha sna tsho gos 'phen pa dang / /de dag nus pa phyir la bzlog /bon po rnga gzhang dkrol ba dang / /sdun mar 'ur rdo 'phen pa dang / /drag sngags phra med nye 'byed dang / /sde brgyad drag po bskul ba dang / /de dag nus pa phyir la bzlog /chos skyong lha 'dre thams cad kyang / /la la dkor cha'i bshul du 'breng / /la la sngags pa drag pos rbad/ /la la las dang rgyu 'bras ston/ /la la rims dang dal yams ston/ /'ga' zhig bden pa'i ser ba 'bebs/ /char pa mi 'bab lo nyes byed/ /lam chags bu lon 'dren pa dang / /nye 'brel rogs kyi bshul du 'brang / /mdze nad gtong ba'i klu rnams dang / /gnod byed lan len 'dre rnamasadang / sha khrag srog dbugs za ba dang / /ngar snabs mi gtsang za ba dang / /'byung po'i lha dang sabadag dang / /lo dang sme ba spar kha dang / /kun kyang glud kyis mnyes gyur cig /gnod 'gal ngan pa zhi bar mdzod/ /bu lon lan chags khyer gyur cig /bdag cag longs(11ba 〉 spyod 'phel bar mdzod/ /rkyen ga bar chad phyir la bzlog /thod gtong nus pa bzlog tu gsol/ /bsam pa'i don rnams grub par mdzod/ /byams pa'i sems kyis mchod sbyin gyis/ /snying rje'i stobs kyis dam chosabashad/ khyod kyang ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da ni
