byang chub sems skyed cig /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan gyi lus la gnod ma byed/ /sdig spongs thar pa'i lam la bkod/ /nad dang dal yams bzlog tu gsol/ /tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod dang / /'bras bu thams cad 'phel bar mdzod/ /glo bur brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rnams bzlog/stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon rnams bzlog/yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa bzlog/mas kyi sri ru langs pa bzlog/pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre bzlog/ma yi byur 'dre la sogs bzlog/sdang ba'i dgra rnams bzlog pa dang //gnod pa'i bgegs rnams ma lus bzlog/gzhan yang lo geg zla keg dang //zhag geg ma lus bzlog tu gsol//lha 'dre sris la rku ba dang //'phung 'dre ma lus bzlog tu gsol//mi nad phyugs nad thams cad dang //byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog/mi kha dgra mchu thams cad bzlog/g.yul rnams ma lus zhi bar mdzod//dgra dang yams nad bzlog tu gsol//myos shing 'bas pa bsal bar mdzod//nyin gcig pa dang nyin gnyis pa//nyin gsum pa yi rims rnams dang //rims rnams thams cad zhi bar mdzod//nyam nga bag tsha bzlog tu gsol//'thab rtsod 'dums par mdzad du gsol//yul phyogs dge zhing dar ba dang //dam 12na khyos phyogs bcur dar bar mdzod//lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang //bkra shisabade legs phun sum tshogs pa dang //tshe dang bsod nams dpal du 'bar bar mdzod//mi tshe dge zhing dngos grub ma lus stsol/zhes bsngos nas lan kha yar gtong tshe mchod gtor dang yas rnams gsos te byin rlabs bya/phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi mchod pa nas bzung 'di'i bar tshogs 'khor ma gtogs shar mar gtong /mthar 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rnams mdos kyi nang du bsgril/mdosalam then/sgo dbye ni/mdos kha bsgyur la/kye/skyod do gshegs so bgegs dang dam srin tshogs//pho brang de ni da skyod 'tshal/chibs kha de ni da bsgyur 'tshal/shar gyi sgo bas sgo dbye 'tshal//rnam par rgyal bas 'phrang sol 'tshal//mdos 'gro de ni shar du 'gro//glud 'grim de ni shar du 'grim//shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung //dri za 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/khyed kyang mdos kyi bdag po ste//mdos bdag la sogs mdos bzhes shig/glud bdag la sogs glud bzhes shig/da gshegs de ni da re ran//pho brang de ni da skyod la'i//zas kha de ni da sgyur 'tshal///skyod do gshegs so bshegs dang ma srin tshogs//pho // de ni da skyod 'tshal//chibs kha de ni da sgyur

rje gzha seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma (ge 'tshal//lho yi sgo bas sgo phye 'tshal//lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phye//lho yi 'phrang bas 'phrang sol 'tshal//gshin rje gshed pos4nga sol 'tshal//mdos 'gro de ni lho ru 'gro//glud 'grim de ni lho ru 'grim//lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po/shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phye/gar gyi 'phrang bas 'phrang sol 'tshal//gshin rje 'bum gyi 12ba tshe khor gyis bskor/khyod kyang mdos kyi bdag po ste//mdos bdag la sogs mdos bzhes shig/glud bdag la sogs glud bzhes shig/de skyogs de ni da re ran//pho brang de ni da skyod la'i//chis kha de ni da sgyur la'i//hūṃ/skyod do gshegs so bgegs dang ma srin tshogs//pho brang de ni da skyod 'tshal//chibs kha de ni da sgyur 'tshal/zhub kyi sgo bas sgo bye 'tshal//nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po phye/khub kyi gong bas tsong sol 'tshal//rta mgrin rgyal pos yong sol 'tshal//mdos 'gro de ni nub tu 'gro//glud 'grim de ni nub tu 'grim//nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang //klu dbang 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/khyod kyang mdos kyi bdag po ste//mdos bdag la sogs mdos bzhes shig/glud bdag la sogs glud ba spyo shig/da gshegs de ni da re ran//pho brang de ni da skyod 'phro//chis kha de ni da sgyur 'tshal//hūṃ/skyod do gshegs so bgegs dang ma srin tshogs//pho brang de ni da skyod 'tshal//chisakha de ni da sgyur 'tshal//byang gi sgo bas sgo bye 'tshal//byang phyogs g.yu sgo sngon po phye//byang gi gong bas gong sol 'tshal//bdud rtsi 'khyil bas pong sol 'tshal//mdos 'gro de ni byang du 'gro//glud 'grim de ni byang du 'grim//byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras//gnod sbyin tsom gyi lor gyis bskor/khyod kyang mdos kyi bdag po ste//mdos bdag la sogs mdos bzhes shig/glud bdag la sogs glud bzhes shig/da gshegs de ni da re ran//pho brang de ni da skyod 'tshal//13na things kha de ni da sgyur 'tshal//de nas mdos kyi lam bstan pa ni/hūṃ/srid pa'i mdosabadag pho mo rnams lam bstan shar gyi phyog su bstan:shar gyi phyogs su mi bstan na dri za pho mo mdos la dgyes dri za pho mo bod lhang lhang :sri/ pa'i mdos r+ṣa khyod song la bdag cag dpon

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she slob 'khor bcas la: gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig: chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol lam bstan shar lho mtshams su bstan: shar lho mtshams su mi bstan na me lha pho mo mdos la dgyes me lha pho mo bod lhang lhang : srid pa'i mdos wo khyod song la bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la:gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig: chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol lam bstan lho yi phyogs su bstan: lho yi phyogs su mi bstan na grul bum pho mo mdos la dgyes grul bum pho mo bod lhang lhang :srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song la: bdag cag dpon slob 'bor bcas la: gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig: chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol: lam bstan lho nub mtshams su bstan: lho nub mtshams su mi bstan na srin po pho mo mdos la dgyes srin po pho mo bod lhang lhang : srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song la bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la: gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig: chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol lam bstan nub kyi phyogs su bstan nub kyi phyogs su mi bstan na klu lam (13brkokar po mdos la dgyes klu lam dkar po bod lhang lhang : srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song la: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la: gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig: chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol: lam bstan nub byang mtshams su bstan: nub byang mtshams su mi bstan na: rlung lha pho mo mdos la dgyes: rlung lha pho mo bod lhang lhang : srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song la bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la: gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig: chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol lam bstan byang gi phyogs su bstan byang gi phyogs su mi bstan na gnod sbyin pho mo mdos la dgyes: gnod sbyin pho mo bod lhang lhang : srid pa'i mdos wo khyod song la:bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la: gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig: chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol lam bstan byang shar mtshams su bstan: byang shar mtshams su mi bstan na dbang ldan pho mo mdos la dgyes dbang ldan pho mo bod lhang lhang : srid pa'i mdos r+sā khyod song la: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig: chags che nyam nga bsgyur du —242

rje tshon seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma (pegasol lam bstan steng gi phyogs su bstan steng gi phyogs su mi bstan na:tshangs pa pho mo mdos la dgyes:tshangs pa pho mo bod lhang lhang :srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song la bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig:chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol lam bstar 'og gi phyogs su bstan 'og gi phyogs su mi bstan na:sa bdag pho mo mdos la dgyes:sa bdab pho mo bod lhang lhang :srid pa'i mdos wo khyod song la:bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang zhig:chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol:kye/da ni mdos la kha bsgyunga'atshal:྅/phyogs phyogs nyi ma shar phyogs na dung lung dkar po'i nang shed na dung gi rta pho dajo/ba tsam bang re mgyogs la rgya ma rgyug:dung gi mi pho che ba tsam smra re mkhas te ldab ma ldib:de 'emi bzang rta re bzang :de na 'gro mkhas gtam re sdug:de na 'khor mang g.yog re shigs:de myogaser bzang g.yu re che:de na stag gzig ri mo bkra:ya bdud pho brang de ru skyod:ma bdud pho brang der skyod 'tshal:rgyal po'i pho brang der skyod 'tshal:bas gyi sho rde der 'grem 'tshal:ma mo 'du sa de ru 'tshal:the'u brang skyas sa de ru mdzod srin mo'i mtsher sa de ru mdzod:phyag gi sor rdor de ra rīmadzod ku re kyal ga de ru mdzod:'di na sdod pa'i yul ma mchis:mdos 'di 'bul lo slar ma log glud 'di 'bul lo sgab ma ngan:tshe 'di 'gugs so snyan ma gsang :zhes gser skyems btang ngo :kye/phyogs phyogs nyi ma lho phyogs na gser lung ser po'i nang shed na:gser gyi rta pho dgo ba tsam bang re mgyogs te rgya ma rgyug:gser gyi mi pho che ba tsam:smra re mkhas te ldab ma ldib:de na mi bzang rta re bzang :de na 'gro mkhas gtam re sdug:de na 'khor mang g.yog re shigs:de na gser bzang g.yu re che de na stag gzig ri mo bkra ya bdud pho brang de ru skyod:ma bdud pho brang der skyod 'tshal:rgyal po'i pho brang der skyod 'tshal:btsan 14bgyi sho rde der 'grem 'tshal:ma mo'i 'du sa de ru 'tshal the'u brang skyas sa de ru mdzod srin mo'i mtsher sa de ru mdzod:phyag gi sor rdor de ru mdzod ku re kyal ga de ru mdzod 'di zhen sdod pa'i yul ma mchos:mdos 'di 'bul lo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ () slar ma log glud 'di 'bul lo sgab ma ga:tshe 'di 'gugs so snyan ma gsang :kye/phyogasaphyogs nyi ma'i nub phyogs na zangs lung dmar po'i nang shed na:zangs kyi rta pho dgo ba tsam bang re mgyogs la rgya ma rgyug:zangs kyi mi pho che ba tsam:smra re mkhas te ldab ma ldib:de na mi bzang rta re bzang :de na 'gro mkhas gtam re sdug:de na 'khor mang g.yog re shigs de na gser bzang g.yu re che de na stag gzig ri mo bkra:ya bdud pho brang de ru skyod:ma bdud pho brang der skyod 'tshal:rgyal po'i pho brang der skyod 'tshal:btsan gyi sho rdo der 'grem 'tshal:ma mo'i 'du sa de ru 'tshal:the'u brang skyas sa de ru mdzod srin mo'i mtsher sa de ru mdzod phyag gi sor rdor de ru mdzod:ku re kyal ga de ru mdzod 'di na sdod pa'i yul ma mchis:mdos 'di 'bul lo slar ma log glud 'di 'bul lo sgab ma ngan:tshe 'di 'gugs so snyan ma gsang :kye/phyogs phyogs nyi ma'i byang phyogs na:g.yu lung sngon po'i nang shed na:g.yu yi rta pho dgo ba tsam bang re mgyogs la rgya ma rgyug:g.yu yi mi pho che ba tsam smra re mkhas te ldab ma ldib de na mi bzang rta re 15na tha zang :de na 'gro mkhas gtam re sdug:de na 'khor mang g.yog re thogs:de na gser bzang g.yu re che:de na stag gzig ri mo bkra:ya bdud pho brang de ru skyod ma ci bdud pho brang der skyod 'tshal:rgyal po'i pho brang der skyod 'tshal:bas gyi sho rde der 'grem 'tshal:ma mo'i 'du sa de ru 'tshal:the'u brang skyas sa de ru mdzod srin mo'i mtsher sa de ru mdzod phyag gi sor rdor de ru mdzod:ku re kyal ga de ru mdzod:'di na stod pa'i yul ma mchos:mdos 'di 'bul lo slar ma log glud 'di 'bul lo sgab ma ga tshe 'di 'gugs so snyan ma gsang :gser skyems gtor ro:thor lam bstan pa ni 'di skad do:bh+yo/shar lho nub dang byang phyogs su steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du:'phen no 'phen no zor 'phen no:mtho ba rnams ni zhabs sdus shig dma' ba rnams ni dbu smad cig klu gnyan rnams ni dbu chum zhig:bar pa rnams ni sku gzur cig:yul lha yul btsan sku gzur cig:'phrang pa rnamasani 'phrang sol cig:sgo ba rnams ni sgo phye zhig:/༷ gi de ni zor 'phangs pas sku la de ni phog ka

rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub/ nang ma 6)re: yungs kar gyi ni zor 'phangs pas: sku la de ni phog ka re mtshe yi de ni zor 'phangs pas sku la de ni phog ka re gtor ma'i de ni zor 'phangs pas: sku la de ni phog ka re khrag zor de ni mda' las tsha yungs(15ba〉rgor de ni rbab las drag mtshe zor de ni mdung las sno: gong zor de ni thog las drag do nub zor lam sgo phye zhig: bh+yo/ rnal 'byor gling bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas stag srin de ni zor ba'i gdong : dbu dgu phyag ni bzhi pa ste: do nub zor gyi dpung mdzod cig zor bdag chen po gshegs su gsol: de nas zor lam bstan pa ni: bh+yo/ zor lam shar gyi phyogs su bstan: shar gyi phyogs su zor 'phangs pas ma mo'i khrag zor nyin ches so: drag po'i dpal zor lto ches so:shar gyi dri za pho mo ni: dri za pho ni bub cing brgyal: dri za mo ni khrag tu skyug: dri za spun dgu dmyal thag bcad: sdang ba dgra la 'phangs pa'i tshe: thal ba'i rdul du brlags par bya: gnod pa'i bgegs la 'phangs pa'i tshe gnam lha dkar bo khrag tu skyug: ces zor lam bstan na rgyas pa byed na phyogs bzhi la'ang bya'o: phyi sgo yan la thun brab dang gu gul gyi dud pa gtong / phyi rol tu slar yang gser skyems btang / 'dre lnga bdud gcod dam thebs kyi sar mdos gtong / zor bskul dang bcasazor brdeg bstan ma skyong / srung 'khor bsgom/ sgo drung du bro brdung / nang du log nas/ bcu bdun pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ thal mo me tog dang bcas la: zho grub par gyur cig rje btsun thugs rje can:'phags ma khyed la bsnyen sgrub mchog pa dang / /bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthu byin gyis: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob par: 'phags ma khyed dang (16na/rtag tu mi 'bral zhing : nad med tshe dbang longs spyod 'phel pa dang : byang chub bsgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing : sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yi: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas thob par shog: ces lan gsum byas nas mdun skyed kyi rten la mchod bstod bya/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs dang / med pa rnams la btage gas gsol bya/ smon lam ni/ bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa yi: bsnyen sgrub la sog ba/—245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedage tsho gos dang : gzhan yang dge spyad bskul btab dang : rjes su yi rang las byung zhing : 'phags ma khyed mchod byin rlabs kyis nad med tshe ring dpal dang grags bkra shis bde legs mchog thob cing : bdag gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin shog ces lan gsum rjes su me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis bya: ho dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum mchog ma dgos 'dod re skong yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog: bkra shis kun gyi mchog brnyes don grub ma dpal ldan thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba'i 'phrin las kun 'grub myur ma dpa' mo ste: /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bkra shis shog cesadang / g.yin yang bkra shis smon lam ci rigs pa bya'o/ /rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten te/ /nad gdon zug rdu drungs nas 'byin pa'i thabs/ /mdos (16bsgog mtho ris chu bo brgyud ldan gyi/ /ba ched srol mes po'i ral ba'i klung las phab/ /sbyor dngos rjes tshang lag len mi shes par/ /'ol chod rdzun gtam bsgrigs 0pa'i smig rgyu la/ /bsil byed nyal 'gror 'khrul pa'i skye rgu rnams/ /sgom tshad gdung bas mya ngam thang 'khyams dogs/ /de phyir mkhas grub tshad med zhal lung las/ /'ongs pa'i yi ge 'di la nyer brten dang / /glu mkhan 'phyon ma'i gar dang mi 'dra ba'i/ /go don lag pa'i rtse mor da gdod son/ /dge bas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu lhag pa'i lha mdzad nas/ /'jigs chen brgyad dang sgrib gnyis bag chags dgra/ /pha mthar byed pa'i skal bar myur ldan shog /khyad par gangs ris bskor ba'i sman ljongs kyi/ /lus can rgyud la lha khyod thugs rje'i rgyun/ /'jug par zhal gyis 'ches pa 'gyur med du/ /mngon sum nyams su myang ba'i dge legs stsol/ /zhes rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgo nas bar chad bzlog pa'i mdos kyi gdams pa dpal di paṃ kwa ras 'brom chos kyi rgyal por gnang ba bka' gdams phyogs nas rim gyis brgyud na'ang bar skabs phyag len sa rnying gi phyogs su dar zhing / bya rgyud kyi rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs sor bzhag la brten pa'ang khungs btsun zhing mi legs pa med kyang mdos chog gi rigs 'di snga 'gyur gyi 'phrin las la brten na khog phugs pas khungs btsun gyi phyag bzhes la mdzad srol yod pas bdag —246

bskyed rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gter byon 'tsho rgyal skor gsum gyi nang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu la brten/ mdun skyed dang mdos chog skor yig rnying zhabrugs sde bas su byas/ mdos zor gyi sgo dbye ba sogs slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa'i mdos nas bkang ste cha lag tshang bar phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub 'di ni rang gzhan mang por phan 'dod kyi blos mtshams sbyar te za hor gyi ban rgan bzhad pa rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o// //sarba maṅga lo/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shetshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum thor bu las dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo la bstod pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / na ma lha ra su sta ye/ 'gyur med chos dbyings gser ldan yangs pa'i dbus/ /gsang gsum mi zad yon tan lhun po'i spor/ /'jigs rung lha dbang dpung tshogs 'phrul gyi sgos/ /dgra bgegs sngon gyi lha rnams 'joms la bstod/ /rab dmar khrag gi na kra'i grong khyer las/ /rab 'jigs 'bab ldan 'khrigs shing chen 'khrugs pa/ /bar mas srid rtser 'phyung lta'i sgra chen pos/ /rab rmongs bdud sde gdung pa'i ca co sgrog /sra brtan 'od srungs byin yang g.yo byed pa'i/ khugs drag rdul gyi rgyal mtshan 'tshub ma yis/ /sa 'dzin dbang po 'jig na mi rung zhes/ /bcu gnyis khyim gyi zhags pas ring du bcings/ /mdog lnga'i 'grod pa'i shugs kyang dub byed cing / khyu bdag la 'gran theg pa'i dbang po la/ /'phong grogs rus pa'i gzeb dang ka ne'i sgras/ /legs spud mi thod srab skyogs rnam par 'phyang / /ka ka ni la'i rdul rtsegs lhun po ni/ /stang zil lan brgyar byugs la snang gter gyi/ /tsha zer gos kyis klubs na khyod kyi sku'i/ /cha shas tsam la 'gran pa'i dpe ru bstan/ /gtum drag rab rngam g.yar ngo bstan tsam (2na)gyis/ /srid gsum rigs ldan tsit+ta bkas gyur na/ /ra ma ṇa yis nor sbyin gcung po dang / /lnga pa'i lam du gtam smra rdzun pa'i gtam/ /dmar ser gtsug phud 'khyil pa'i gzi 'od kyi/ /tsha gdung 'jigs pas 'phur byed tshogs rnams kun/ /bsrung phyir chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /mngon par brgyan gyi zol la bsnyen par nges/ /zhal khyim 'bras ldan dus kyi kun gsal dbus/ /snang byed rta bdun dkyil 'bor mngon bsal zas/ /ji snyed —248

'dod khas dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo la bstod pa nor bu dbang gi tso po'i do shal/ nang ma rtogeshes bya'i 'dab stong ba 'ad pa las/ /lkog gyur thun gsum ma de gang du bros/ /'dren byed 'gram dkyus rab gsal bzhin snod ngos/ /thun mtshams sgeg mo 'khyug pa'i gzugs kyi 'phrul/ /'gog med rtag tu shar ba'i lcags kyu yis/ /pi shwa dme'i yid kyis khengs pa phyogs/ /mi sdug zhal gyi sa'adzin dkar po las/ /dam nyams khrag gi yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ khugs drag ches cher babasapa'i dbu phreng gis/ /so skye'i gos ser 'grod byed rnam par brlan/ /rab gtsigs mche ba'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /gsung gi nga ro dbyar gyi (2ba'i gsangs dang / /ro 'dzin mjug brgya rab 'khyug rigs sngags kyi/ /rdo rje'i zegs mas log 'dren brag ri 'jom/ /'dzam bu na da las grub rna rgyan steng / /gtsug phud lnga ba 'khyil pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /sa gsum dregs ldan gnyis 'thung dbang po'i tshogs/ /'jigs te lnga pa'i grong du bros kyis dogs/ /g.yon phyogs thos 'dzin dbang po mdzes byed pa'i/ /rlung gi zas can smra ba'i 'dab stegs las/ /mi zad ha la'i zhags pas bangasadogs nas/ /sbyin skyes stobs ldan sa bon skyabs su bsten/ /cod pan rab dkar thod skam lnga yi phreng / /mi sdug aṇ+ḍa'i srad bu la brgyus te/ /yid 'ong sna tsho gos rin chen phreng ba yi/ /bkod legasa'adren byed dga' ston e ma mtshar/ /'brug sgra mngal 'dzin lus 'degs las grub pa'i/ /rnam bkra ngag gi mtshon cha'i rdzing ring rgyan/ /nor bu'i tog gis mtshan par rgyu skar tshogs/ /blta phyir lha yi lam las 'ongs pa 'dra/ gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'chang bzung can/ /bdud dpung phye mar 'thag pa'i dbyig pa ni/ /'dzin byed g.yas par mkha' la phyar tsam gyis/ /sa gsum ma lus gcig car 'dar bar nges/ /log 'dren mgo bo bregs pa'i ka pā lar/ /dmar nag khrag gis rab gang phyag g.yon gyis/ /zhal du btab pas gad ma gnyis la/ /yan lag mchog dang mi ldan gtam gyis rdzu/ /rnam mang gdul bya'i blo yi me (3na sgong ngos/ /sna tshogs sprul bsgyur ston pa'i gzugs sku'i khyon/ /tshad mas gzhal nas min 'di zhing bsal gyis/ /tshad ldan ston gyi gos su rung ba mtshar/ /gang gi byams brtse'i bcu gnyis bdag po yis/ /lus can sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan skyong ston yang / /—249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shere stas sbags pa'i bam chen mgo rlon gyi/ /mkha' dbang grangs ldan 'phreng 'di bzhad gad rgyu/ /bsus khyim 'jigs bral rab mtha'i ba gam la/ /legs bris dpung tshogs rnam bzhi'i gnas bcas nas/ /bcud bral ming gi lhag mar gtang ba'i tshul/ /gsal bar ston phyir nam mkha'i nor bus brgyan/ /phyi nang gsal 'grib med pa'i ye shes skur/ rab bkra stag lpags dar nag lhub lhub dang / /'byog 'gro zung gi gser ga bdun pa yis/ /ma rga par brgyan pa'i byed po su zhig yin/khram shing sho : mtshon gyi dru gu sogs/ /'jigs rung sha kra'i dpal mgrin snang byed mes/ /dgra bgegs chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi lus/ /lhag mar bsreg pa'i gul byung stobs ni med/ /rkyang ser rigs gnyis steng du zhabs pad zung / /skyil krung phyed pa'i tshul gyis mkha' dbyings la/ /mngon par 'phags pa'i shugs drag gar nyams kyis/ /rgya chen srid gsum tshad kyis 'jal ba bzhin/ khyod sku rab dngas lha yi lam yangs par/ mtshan dpe'i gzi byin dbang gzhus legs spras na/ /rin chen rus (3ba)pa brang 'gro'i chu khur gyi/ /sna tsho gis rgyan gyis skrud la mtshar du ci/ /mig gis blta bar bzod dka'i drag mo'i skur/ /bstan pa tsam gyis stobs ldan dregs pa'i tshogs/ /snyems pa btang nas khyod kyi bran bgyi na/ /stong gsum mi mjed bdag po gang du mchis/ /rab dkar ri dwags rgyan gyis su ba'i lus/ /mdzes sdug cha shas rdzogs la sred bral zhes/ /mi sdug snang gter gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /log 'dren sra smos tshal kun gcig car zum/ /seng ge mo'i bu'i stobs kyang zil gnon pa'i/ /mig sman 'bum sde'i mdangs can 'jigs gzugs la/ /skrag ste chos kun stong pa'i mkhar bros pas/ /ye shes me lce 'bar bas rjes su snyegs/ /thos 'dzin bdud rtsi'i lang tsho 'chi med dbyangs/ /snyan brjid yan lag drug cu'i phul byung gsung / /'jigs rung nga ro drag pos bdud sde'i snying / /dum bur gas kyang rna ba'i khung bu 'gebs/ /chos dbyings 'dam skyes rdzing bu'i ba gam dbus/ /gang thugs dpal khyim ze'u 'bru'i sgyu rtsal spyod/ /bde chen bung ba'i ri dwags ga can ma/ /ling gcugs grogs su bkug ste rtse dgar rol/ /rab 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus —250

'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo la bstod pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i do shal/ nang ma (pepa'i/ /gsang gsum las byung mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i tshogs/ gcig bsdus gang gi yon tan phung po'i khur/ /grag pa'i gser ldan lus ni e ma bsra/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las bcu gnyis bdag po yis/ /gang 'tshams legs bris lam gyi khyon yangs par/ /'ongs pas las ldan snang gsal rab rgyas shing / /dgra bgegs 'byung po'i spyi tshogs phye mar mdzad/ /thub bstan zla ba'i ma ma'i bcud kyi phul/ /rdo rje theg pa'i zil mdangs kā la shar/ /'khru ba'i sems 'chang bdud dpung sbyin skyesatshogs/ /'jom mdzad mgrin sngon lhag pa'i lha der bstod/ /gtsug phud mgrin par co 'dri'i (4na)pad gdan la/ /mngon par chags pas 'byud lta'i tshes bdag steng / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis spud 'dra'i ke la shar/ /gar dgu'i rnam 'gyur ston pa yod dam snyam/ /yid la dpyang thag 'dzin pa'i gang gi sku/ /zhal khyim dri bzang khang pa rgyas pa'i dbus/ /tshems kyi ze'u 'bru rab wegs bung ba'i sprin/ /dkar dmar mdangs sogs ma 'dres yid du 'ong / /ut+pal 'dab ltar mnyen 'jam phyag zung gis/ /'dab ldan mel tshe dar gyi phang phung can/ /bkod legs guñtsa nam gyi yol go'i nang / /yid 'ong rin chen phyur bur gtams pa 'dzin/ /mtshan bzang lang tsho'i gzi ldan khyod kyi sku/ /'chi med rdzas kyisand gsum lhab lhub dang / /rtse phran sen mo ro sogs rin chen phras/ /legs par spras pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes/ /chags bral chos kyi sprin gyi mkha' dbyings la/ /gang gi gsang gsum rta ljang mngon rdzogs kyang / /'gro kun pad dkar la chags zhabs zung ba/ /'od stong skyil krung las can 'dab brgya bzhad/ /rigs gnyis sngon 'gro 'jigs rung mun pa'i mdog /'bod grogs zag dung na kra'i spyi bo can/ /mngon par 'angs pas dgra dpung gnam 'phye'i tshogs/ /bsus khyim lnga pa'i slong du 'jug las gang / /'phrog byed gdong can dmar nag sha za'i gzugs/ /bsra brtan nor 'dzin sto bar 'grod byed zung / khugs drag stobs kyis bstabs pas sa gsum yang / /'jig snyam tshangs 'joms lus med tshul gyis gnas/ /dri bsnyan 'brug pa'i bgrang bya'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /sa gsum 'geng mdzad chu 'dzin sdug po'i ngos/ /byed pos rlung gi rgyal mtshan byugs 'dra'i mdog /stobs —251 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'agro'i steng du 'jigs rung gar gyis rol/ /(4brdo rje'i gzigs ma 'phrin las pho nya can/ /rnam 'gyur grangs med ston pa'i byi ru'i ri/ /ngo mtshar yid la 'god pa'i khyod kyi sku/ /chu glang gdan la mi sdug rnam 'gyur tshul/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan ri skyes sa 'dzin la/ /'bu ba'i khyod sku phyogs kyi rwa ldan steng / /mngon par 'phags pa'i gzi 'od ma bzod par/ /pad gnyer gling bzhi bskor ba'i rdzas la bsten/ /thun gsum dus kyi mkha' gang stug po'i dbus/ /sprin gyi lcug ma 'khyug lta'i gzugs kyi sku/ /mi sdug steng du gtum drag brngam tshul gyis/ /log 'dren dgra sde'i mgo bo cig car 'gems/ /sna tshogs las bzhi'i 'phrin las mel tshe'i ngom/ /brjod bral rnam 'gyur grangs med ston pa'i sku/ /mthu stobs pahrūl dpag dka' srid gsum la/ /dbang bsgyur bka' sdod dam can tshogs la bstod/ /gang gi thugs rje'i rgyu skar mu khyud kyis/ /mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i kun khebs stug po yi/ /dpung tshogs ma lus 'joms pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /rab 'byams zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod/ /mi zad gsang gsum zla ba'i ma ma las/ /legs 'ongs khyed thugs rta bdun dkyil 'khor gyis/ /lugs zung mthun rkyen 'od stong 'bar ba yis/ /rab 'byams rgyas pa'i las kun 'grub par mdzod/ /grangs med mdzad pa'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ khugs drag gsol 'debs ba shi'i thabs mkhas gos/ /ji snyed srid gsum rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pa'i/ /rab 'byams dbang gi las kun 'grub par mdzod/ /dpag dkar nus mthu'i phyugs bdag 'dab ldan can/ /rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gnam ru'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /dgra bgegs bcud bral grong khyer mthar byed pa'i/ /rab 'byams mngon spyod las (ldan〉kyin 'grub par mdzod/ khyad par bdag yid mkha' lding rgyal mtshan can/ /'dod don sa man+ta ka nor bu mchog /las bzhi'i ti skru'i na chung thabs kyi rgyus/ /thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dpal stug bstan pa yongs 'du sa brtol la/ /thun mong theg pa'i yal 'dab rab rgyas shing / /nges gsang bla med gang bus g.yur za ba'i/ /rig 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /ces dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo la bstod pa —252

'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo la bstod pa nor bum dbang gi rgyal po'i do shal/ nang ma (genor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i do shal zhes bya ba 'di yang / rang nyid lhag pa'i lha mor mi phyed dad pa'i shugs kyis mngon par bskul zhing / rab 'byams smra ba ngag dbang bsod nams rnam rgyal dang /rig byed pa blo bzang 'jam dpal sogs kyis mtshams sbyar ba la brten nas/ tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje yi sa yos sprad dus kyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs bzang po gnyis par/ kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa bltams pa'i dus chen gyi nyin/ 'chi med skyed tshal sal 'phos 'dra'i dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung mngon par dga' bar sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i mdzad pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /dmag zor lha mo bstod pa'i rab byed 'di/ /sgo grosargyal mtshan dad pas par du bsgrubs/ /dge des rtag tu rgyal ba dgyes byed sna ga /maṅga lo//—253

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedapal ldan dmag zor ma'i mnga' gsol bsam don lhun sdi/ba ma bsdo/gas the ( / /bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po lhag pa'i lha/ /'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan dmag zor mas/ /phun tshogs bkra shis dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur pa'i dpal/ /dngos brgyud rigs 'dzin rdo jo slob dpon dang / /kun bzang bde ba chen po ro gcig pa/ /dngos grub yongs kyi byed por mngang gsol lo/ /bla med sku bzhi'i ngo bo rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de'i gsung chags bral nyer zhi dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin mdzad theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun te/ /slu med skyabs mchag ngo bor mnga' gsol lo/ /bde chen rab rgyas stong nyid snying rje'i nyams/ khres rab rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar/ /rnam rol dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje dang / /mnyam sbyor dkyil 'khor gtso mor mnga' gsol lo/ /gsal stong 'dzin med rang sems rnal 'byor ma/ /grangs med rnam bzhi'i dpa' mor yongs shar ba'i/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das ḍā kyim/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi dbang mor mnga' gsol lo/ /phyi nang grub mtha' smra ba thun mong gi /(2na po dul bya'i snang ngor tshangs pa'i sras mo'i tshul/ /'dzin mdzad shes rab snang ba'i dpal ster ba/ /dbyangs can ngag gi lha mor mnga' gsol lo/ /mgo rlon rgyu ma'i 'phreng ba'i ga sha can/ /dgra bo'i snying khrag dron mo btungs pas kyang / /ma rngams srog dbugs len la rings pa yi/ /bstan srung yongs kyi rje mor mnga' gsol lo/ /phur pa phyag rdor rta mgrin la sogs pas/ /gsang ba'i mtshan gyi che bar mnga' gsol lo/ /rgya gar hor dang rgya nag bod yul sogs/ /dgon gnas kun gyi bdag mor mnga' gsol lo/ /lha klu gnod sbyin bdud srin gshin rje sogs/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ /'jigs rung rlung nag 'tshub —254

dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i mnga' gsol bsam don lhun grub ma/ nang ma (gema'i gur khyim gyis/ /grangs med sprul pa 'gyed par mnga' gsol lo/ /rlung gi shugs ldan rkyang ser dre'u yis/ /stong gsum skad cig bskor bar mnga' gsol lo/ khram bam nag po bdud kyi mtshon cha yis/ /dgra bo khram la 'debs par mnga' gsol lo/ /rnon po mtshon gyi dru gu sngo dmar gyis/ /dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod par mnga' gsol lo/ /btab pas 'phung nus (2ba7tsan sho dkar dmar gyis/ /dgra bo kha phung gtong bar mnga' gsol lo/ /nad kyi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i rdzing bu yis/ /dgra yul nad kyis brlag par mnga' gsol lo/ /sprul zhags kyis bcings nad kyi rkyal pa yis/ /dgra bo rims kyis 'phung bar mnga' gsol lo/ /mig sman ltar nag re ba'i stod g.yogs kyis/ /mngon spyod byu'aphrin las sgrub par mnga' gsol lo/ /snyan g.yas gdong lnga'i dbang po'i gad rgyangs kyis/ /dgra bgegs glang chen 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo/ /g.yon pa lto 'gro 'khyil pa'i dug rlangs kyis/ /dam nyams dgra bo 'ching bar mnga' gsol lo/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra rma bya'i sgro gdugs kyis/ /dpon slob dgon gnas skyong bar mnga' gsol lo/ /gtsug rum nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'od snang gis/ /legs nyes so sor 'byed par mnga' gsol lo/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con 'bar ba yis /dgra bgegs thal bar brlag par mnga' gsol 'o1/ /dgra bgegs snying khrag gis gang ka pā las/bde chen bcud kyis tshim par mnga' gsol lo/ /mig sman ltar gnag 'jigs rung srin mo'i skus/ /log 'dren thal bar rlog par mnga' gsol lo/ /nyi ma 'bum las lhag pa'i gzi brjid kyis/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal par mnga' gsol lo/ /dmar zlum spyan gsum phyogs bcur bgrad pa yis/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs par mnga' gsol lo/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa yis/ /steng gi lha rnams 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo/ /smin ma sma ra glog ltar 'khyug pa yis/ /sde brgyad 'byung po 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo/ /(3na 〉 lta gdangs mche gtsigs nga ro drag po yis/ /bstan pa'i ru dra 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo/ /thod skam rin cen lnga yis dbu brgyan pas/ /gas bdag rdo rje gzhen nur mnga' gsol lo/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal gyis/ /—255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedagra bgegs rtsad nas gcod par mnga' gsol lo/ /zhing lpags stag sham rus pa'i rgyan cha yis/ /dpal chen dkyil 'khor srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /byug pa'i rdzas gsum sku la nyer sbags pas/ /mthu stobs gzi byin bskyed par mnga' gsol lo/ /ral gri mgo rlon khrag 'dzag phyag mtshan gyis/ /mthu stobs rdo rje'i thog ltar mnga' gsol lo/ /dar nag gser gyi thig le'i gos bzang gis/ /'phrin las thogs med bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo/ /dug sbrul las grub srab 'thur gong rmed kyis/ /'og gi klu rnams bol bar mnga' gsol lo/ /sa gzhi khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'khrug pas/ gdug pa'i sa bdag 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo/ /mtshan ldan phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams kyis/ /mi 'bral rtag tu 'grogs par mnga' gsol lo/ /sra zhing rno ba'i rdo rje'i go mtshon gyis/ /rang bsrung gnod byed 'joms par mnga' gsol lo/ /yid 'ong 'dod yon lnga dang nyer spyod kyis/ /zhi ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo/ /phun tshogs bkra shis rtags brgyad spyan gzigs kyis/ /rgyas pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo/ /rgyal srid sna bdun mtshar du dngar ba yis/ /dbang gi 'phrin las bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo/ /phul byung nang gi mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /drag po'i 'phrin las(3ba〉bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo/ /gsang ba mnyam sbyor bde ba chen po yis/ /mchog gi dngos grub stsol bar mnga' gsol lo/ /mdor na bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sogs/ /rtsa gsum kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dpung / /gcig tu rab bsdus bstan srung dbang po'i mchog /bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bur mnga' gsol lo/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dmag zor lha khyed rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /ngo bor yid ches gtan gyi skyabs zhu na/ /'bral med lhag pa'i lha ru mnga' gsol lo/ /bdag cag mi nor dgon gnas sder bcas pa/ /'dod khams dbang phyug khyod la gnyer du gtad/ /brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa dang / /mthun pa'i legs tshogs 'phel bar mnga' gsol lo/ /lhag pa'i lha ngo mkha' ltar mngon mtho zhing / /mthu stobs gzi brjid nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'bar/ /'phrin las ma lus rdo rje'i pha lam ltar/ /—256

dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i mnga' gsol bsam don lhun grub ma/ nang ma (gegang la thogs med 'grub par mnga' gsol lo/ /dkar phyogs rgyal pa'i ba dan srid rtser bsgreng / /nag po bdud kyi ru dar sal bsnyal/ /chos srid lugs gnyis rnga srid rtser bsgrags/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mnga' gsol lo/ /dngos grub gter gyur rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /byin rlabs stsol mdzad dpal chen phur pa'i lha/ /'phrin las thogs med dmag zor rgyal mo yis/ /bdag sogs 'dod pa'i re ba skong gyur cig /ces 'dod khams kyi dbang byug dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo lha ngo bstod cing mnga' gsol bya ba'i rim pa bsam don lhun grub ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chu sbrul hor zla bzhi pa'i nang du (4na〉8ra sgrub dang mdosabaskang gi skabs byed dgos pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin tal khar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /maṅga lo/ / / /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she lha mo'i gsang mdos bsngo tshig bzhugs so/ / bh+yo/ ri rab lhun po gling bzhi gling phran can/ /rin wo ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos lo tog smin/ /nyi zlas mun sel lcags ris bskor ba'i nang / /dngos bshams yid sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gtor tshogs phyur bur spungs/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho lha 'phreng 'khrigs/ /dmar chen rak+ta'i rba rlabs g.yo ba 'dis/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can/ /re ti nad bdag bka' nyan dus bzhi'i lha/ /gangs kyi yum chen mched sogs bod skyong bstan/ /bcu gnyis dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /sgrib gnyis nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dpal dang / /lung rtogs rab rgyas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ga bur gur gum gyis bran mchod yon dang / /chu dang (2na)thang las skyes pa'i me tog bkra/ /sman spos shing sna dri zhim dud sprin gtibs/ /nyi ma nor bu rtsi 'bru'i sgron me spar/ /sman sna'i ngad ldang thugs gar byugs pa'i dri/ /bza' bca' lha bshos ro brgya'i bcud dang ldan/ /pi wang gling bu sil snyan rol mo'i sgra/ /rdzas mdangs kyis bsgyur zhi rgyas dbang mchod 'dis/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can/ /re ti nad bdag bka' nyan dus bzhi'i lha/ /gangs kyi yum chen mched sogs bod skyong bstan/ /bcu gnyis dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /sgrib gnyis nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dpal dang / /lung rtogs rab rgyas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /drod rlangs ma yal 'thul ba'i snying khrag 'phyar/ /dbang po sna lnga'i me tog 'phrig cing g.yo/ sha chen dud pa khams nag lang long 'thibs/ /tshil chen snang gsal dus mtha'i me ba'i na 'bar/ /bsad khrag mkhris pa —258

lha mo'i gsang mdo bsngo tshig nang ma (pegasar pa rdzing bur 'khyil/ sha rus rkang mar spungs pa'i bza' bcas gtams/ /thod rnga rkang gling tshogs pa'i sgra dbyangs dang / /'bod brda g.yab pa'i dar tshon sna lnga yis/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can/ /re twe nad bdag bka' nyan dus bzhi'i lha/ /gangs kyi yum chen mched sogs bod skyong bstan/ /bcu gnyis dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /sgrib gnyis nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dpal dang / /lung (2bskogs rab rgyasakhams gsum dbang du sdud/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rta mchog 'brong g.yag zhol mo 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ra lug bya nag khyi nag ce spyang sogs/ /gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu dang / /ri dwags mcho me dgu bgrang yas srog chags tshogs/ /srin po'i mgo lpagasaspras pa'i rkyang ser drel/ /be con nal thod 'phrin las bzhi sgrub pa'i/ /sna tsho gis phyag mtshan rgyan gos bzhen pa dang / /mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang med pa yis/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma ti/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can/ /re tī nad bdag bka' nyan dus bzhi'i lha/ /gangs kyi yum chen mched sogs bod skyong bstan/ /bcu gnyis dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /sgrib gnyis nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dpal dang / /lung rtogs rab rgyas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rang srung rdo rje'i go cha sra zhing brtan/ /pha rol phyer 'thag sna tsho gos mtsho ni cha gzings/ khrag rgyun 'dzag pa'i mi lngags bla bre bres/ /mgo rkang lag skra'i ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo/ /'phral bsad rgyu ma rlon pa'i lda ldi la/ /glo snying mkha' mchin mtsher pa'i dra byed 'phyang / /srid gsum 'phyo pa'i rlung nag gur chen phub/ /gshin rje'i bshasar lta bu'i zhing khams 'dis/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag lasabazhi'i rnam 'gyur can/ /re tī nad bdag bka' nyan dus bzhi'i lha/ /gangs kyi yum chen mched sogs bod skyong bstan/ /bcu gnyis dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /sgrib gnyis nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dpal dang / /lung rtogs rab rgyas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs—259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /yid 'phrog lha yi dga' tshal tshar du dngar/ /nad brgya sel ba'i sman gyi nags klung 'khrigs/ /rin chen khang bzang rgya phibs lcog gis mdzes/ /yid bzhin nor sogasalha mi'i dpal 'byor bsnyil/ /nam mkha' rgyang bu mda' 'phang dar tshon 'bru/ /ja sna shing gos sha sgang rams skag mtshal/ /btsod zhun snam ras las sgo sna tsho gis zong / /dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' bca' ngar mi glud/ /dbus skyu khrag kong bgrang yas mthun rdzas kyis/ /(3na)srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma ti/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can/ /re twe nad bdag bka' nyan dus bzhi'i lha/ /gangs kyi yum chen mched sogs pod skyong bstan/ /bcu gnyis dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /sgrib gnyis nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dpal dang / /lung rtogs rab rgyasakhams gsum dbang du sdud/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /'khor lo nor bu dbang rgyal bas mo dang / /sngon po glang 0 rta mchog dmag gi dpon/ /'od sngon 'phro ba'i ral gri pags pa 'jam/ /dga' ba'i nags tshal ci 'dod 'grub pa'i khyim/ /gdung sel gos dang nyon mongs bral ba'i mal/ /skad cig bgrod lham nye ba'i rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang 'dod yon lnga/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye mchod sprin gyis/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i0rnam 'gyur can/ /re tī nad bdag bka' nyan dus bzhi'i lha/ /gangs kyi yum chen mched sogs bod skyong bstan/ /bcu gnyis dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /sgrib ga lhas nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dpal dang / /lung rtogs rab rgyas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gsang mdos bsngo ba'i tshigs su bcad pa za hor bzhes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/—260

sgo dbyer zor srin mo'i za lam ma rnams/ nang ma9)sgo dbyer zor srin mo'i za lam ma rnams bzhugs so/ / hūṃ/ shar gyi sgo ma rta gdong dkar thabs shes lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis: shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phye gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bh+yo: // lho yi sgo ma phag gdong nag thabs shesazhags pa'i phyag rgya yis: lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phye: gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bh+yo: ྅/ nub kyi sgo ma dred gdong dmar thabs shes lcags sgrog phyag rgya yis: nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po phye gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bh+yo: ྅/ byang gi sgo ma spyang gdong sngo: thabs shes dril bu'i phyag rgya yisabyang phyogs g.yu sgo sngon po phye gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bh+yo: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma ga dze bra pe sha ya phaṭa bh+yo/ bzlog byed ma gcig spyan 'dren no: bsgyur byed ma gcig spyan 'dren no: srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol na: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin ye shes grub kyang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rdo rje ster mos ltas ngan bh+yo bzlog cig so so'i rigs dang ming sring (2na skom dral tshul: 'dod cing chags pa'i tshul 'chang rnal 'byor ma bh+yo/ dkar mo spyan gcig rdo rje rigs kyi lcam nyid kyi ming po rgyal po'i bka' bsgyur la: rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogs pa la shar phyogs glo bur ye 'brog shor ra re: bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro shar phyogs rgyal po cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yo/ srin mo shugs yong rin cen rigs kyi lcam nyid kyi ming po gshin rje'i bka' bsgyur la rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogos pa la 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khram la btab pa re: bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro gshin rje'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yo/ gar gyi dbang phyug pad+ma rigs kyi lcam nyid kyi ming po klu yi bka' bsgyur la rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor tu gtogos pa la: sa bdag klu yi byad du tshud pa re bzlog go dmar r+pā gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro klu yi cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yo/ gar gyi —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dbang phyug las kyi rigs kyi lcam nyid kyi 2ba thang po gnod sbyin bka' bsgyur la:rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogs pa la gnod sbyin gdug pa'i gdon gyis zin ta re:bzlog go dmar r+ṣa gtor ma 'di yis bzlog:bsgyur ro gnod sbyin cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur:bh+yo/dbyings phyug dbal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma kong btsun mtshon cha'i tsho gis kyi bka' bsgyur la rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogos pa la phyi yi dgra snying thams cad phebs ta re bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro mi snying glo 'phrog dgra la sgyur bh+yo/sngags srung e ka dza ti ral gcig ma bdud po skos rje brang dkar bka' bsgyur la rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du rtam gags pa la bdud kyi rgyal po'i khram nang brkyang ba re bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog:bsgyur ro bdud kyi khram kha dgra la sgyur bh+yo/e ka dza ti nag mo glog ma sprin bdud po re ti 'gong yag bka' bsgyur la:rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogs pa la nag po bdud kyi byan pos3na tha rkus ta re bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro bdud kyi cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yo/dkar mo chen mo nyi ma'i thod 'phreng can nyid kyi ming po gnam lha'i bka' bsgyur la rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogs pa la rgyal po dkar pos dmangs su 'bebs ta re bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro rgyal po'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yo/ma mo e ka dza ti thal mdog ma grong gi the brang dgra bo'i bka' bsgyur la:rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogos pa la 'byung po the brang yul du phebs ta re bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yisabazlog bsgyur ro 'byung po'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yo/sa bdag chen mo nag mo ral gcig ma sa yi the brang nag po'i bka' bsgyur la rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogos pa la the brang rnams kyi cho 'phrul shor ra re bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro the brang cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yo/gnam la shel bza' lo ro sman gcig ma dkar skya gza' bdud rnams kyi bka' bsgyur la rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogaXpa la drang sgong gza' yi gdug rtsub shor ra re:

sgo dbyer zor srin mo'i za lam ma rnams/ nang ma 9)bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog: bsgyur ro gza' yi cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bh+yo/btsan la lo ro rdo rje sman gcig ma: nyid kyi ming po btsan gyi bka' bsgyur la: rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogs pa la: btsan gyi rgyal po'i rta babs shor ra re bzlog go dmar wo gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro btsan gyi cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bh+yo/ nyul le 'jigs pa khrag gi ral gcig ma klu srin pho mo yongs kyi bka' bsgyur la: rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du ga rta gos pa la:klu srin rnams kyi cho 'phrul shor ra re: bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog: bsgyur ro klu srin cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yo/ lha mo nag mo las kyi dbang mo che: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad bka' bsgyur la: mdor na bdag cag (3ba tsher bor dang bcas pa la: snang srid ma mo'i khram nag brkyang ba re: bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog: bsgyur ro ma mo'i khram kha dgra la sgyur: lha/ nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi rjeḥ nga ni bde gshegs kun gyi gtso nga ni gshin rje kun gyi gshed: nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab nga ni mkha' 'gro kun gyi rje: nga ni ging chen kun gyi rgyal: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dam la 'dus dam/ can rgya mtsho dmag la 'chos: mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs spungs se spung : zhus chen stong sdosil li li: dpa' bo mda' sgra sgrengs se sgreng : dpa' mo dul brdab chems rtse chem: dar gyi ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: mtshon rtsa phur rtse rongs se rong : yungs kar rbab 'dril shar ra ra mtsho yi mde'u thung thal la la: gtor ma'i sgrogs brdeg chems se chem: khrag thun dug rlangs chil li li:dgra bgegs gnod byed rdul du rlog: gdab sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ragi li ki lā ya sarba bigha na paṃ/ dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa yang dag nas dmod pa drag sngags bar la sbyar zhing drag sngags so lnga pa'i mthar/ dam nyams gnod byed sha chun hur ze dzam ra ya rbad/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ snang ba'i dgra bgegs dam sri 'di: dang po ma rig gti mug 'thibs: bar du gzung dang 'dzin pas bskyed tha ma las ngan dbang gis 'khor: zhe sdang nga yi rgyud las byung :'dod chags ma yi mngal du bskyed: nga rgyal phrag dog las ga spyod lnga phung rtsad nas gcod pa'i —263

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she (4na phyir srog pa'i rtsa la phur zor rgyob nga rgyal snying la gtor zor yu gti mug sha la mda' zor rgyob 'dod chags khrag la thun zor yu: zhe snang rus la rdo zor rgyob phrag dog dbugs la dug zor mā: lnga phung lus la gri zor rgyob: rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra dang : mched dang lcam dral spyi yi dgra rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra dang : gzugs med dam sri gnod byed rnams yongs rdzogs zor gyis rdul du rlog dpal chen rngams pa'i zhal du stob: 'khor gyi khro tsho gos mchode par bzhes ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rngam zas kyis: ging chen rol pa'i rngam zas mdzod sems ni rgyal ba'i gnas su sbor hūṃ/ khrag gi kong bu lo tshad 'dis snang srid lha ༷dre'i chad pa bzlog: yungs kar thun gyi gang bu 'dis: gshin rje rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog brag la skyes pa'i mtshe zor 'dis nag po bdud kyi chad pa bzlog: dri zhim spos kyi sdong bu 'dis: rgyal po rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog yugs sa'i 'phang gi rtsang rnon 'dis ma bdud rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog: rabs chad khang pa'i dud pa 'dis gnod sbyin pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog: sha khrag sna tshogs bsags pa 'dis: klu bdud pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog myos byed 'ang gi spang ma 'dis: the brang rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog mar me gsal byed sdong bu 'dis mkha' 'gro rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog gdug pa shing gi tsher ma 'dis: gza' skar rnams kyi gnod pa (4ba)bzlog lha bsgoms khrag gis byugs pa 'dis sa bdag rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog me tog bcud can phab rtsi 'dis: dre bo rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog drag po'i dug sna mang po 'dis 'gong po rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog gyi ling rta yi tshil bu 'dis dmar po btsan gyi gnod pa bzlog: kyir mas phyi mo'i phye ma 'dis: dmu yi tshogs kyi gnod pa bzlog gu gul sbyar ba'i dri bsrung 'dis lha chen rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog bal tshon sna lnga'i tshon dkris 'dis rims nad dal yams thams cad bzlog: skyes pa pho yi mda' khra 'dis dgra bgegs mtsho ni cha thams cad bzlog za ma mo yi 'phang khra 'dis ltasang na mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog lung dgu 'dus pa'i chu sna 'dis: klu srin pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog: lung dgu 'dus pa sa sna dang : phung bshul dgu yi tshos sna —264—

sgo dbyer zor srin mo'i za lam ma rnams/ nang ma 9)'dis yul dang mkhar la chags che bzlog: rwa grod rdzas kyis bkang ba 'dis: mi kha smra mchu rtsod pa bzlog bya mo nag mo'i sgo nga 'dis sman mo'i tshogs kyi gnod pa bzlog phur pa dar nag btags pa 'dis gnod sbyin pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog pha shing stag pa'i khram shing 'dis skyes pa pho yi gnod pa bzlog: ma shing glang ma'i khram shing 'dis: za ma mo yi gnod pa bzlog: ru mtshon mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dis phyi 'khrug nang 'khrug g.yul ngo bzlog lcags phye zangs phye'i thun sna 'dis: rtags dang mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog mi mang thal mo brdeb pa 'dis: rbad 'dre rbod gtong (ldan skonod pa bzlog: bh+yo/ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur pa ji lha chen drag po'i gdug rtsub bzlog lha ma yin gyi rgyu thabs bzlog skem byed lcags kyus zin pa bzlog: drang srong bka' yi dmod pa bzlog: ma mo'i thun sngags byung ba bzlog: phra men ma yi nye 'byed bzlog: sa bdag klu yi gdug byad bzlog: pho nya'i rbod gtong byung ba bzlog phur pa'i dbal kha 'phen pa bzlog: yungasagar zor kha 'phen pa bzlog: mu stegs gdug pa'i byad kha bzlog brje'i hom pa'i ngan sngags bzlog: zhang zhung bon gyi btso dmar bzlog: sum pa'i glang dang ling kyang bzlog mi nyag bol le thams cad bzlog: khyung po'i btsan dang ga byed bzlog: glang la thong sha byed pa bzlog bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams bzlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog: gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu bzlog byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad bzlog gshis ngan 'gum pa bco lnga bzlog rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog 'byung ba rten 'brel ngan pa bzlog gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog: yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa bzlog: mas kyi sri ru langs pa bzlog ltag pa'i bdud du babs pa bzlog: dpral ba'i gshed du 'khor ba bzlog: pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre bzlog: dar tshan nang gi stong 'dre bzlog: pho sri mo sri chung sri bzlog: dam sri phung sri god sri bzlog: pha mes dur sri btsan sri bzlog bdud kyi than ngan (5bskong 'a ga bzlog lo skeg zla sgeg bzhi gshed bzlog: ga nam la zla grangs 'debs pa bzlog: sa zhag rtsis la 'debs pa —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebazlog gnam nas dal kha babs pa bzlog: sa nas dug nad langs pa bzlog: dus tshone rtsis pa 'debs pa bzlog mi nag skye bo'i ya ga bzlog: yul mi khyim mtshes dmod mo bzlog: g.yas nas pho brgyas mtsho ni brdar bzlog g.yon nas mo brgyas dug g.yos bzlog: mdun nas rtsang bzhin 'dzugs pa bzlog rgyab nas khyi bzhin 'brang ba bzlog: ngos la sprel ltar 'dzeg pa bzlog lkog nas 'bu bzhin g.yeng ba bzlog: srod la khyim bya 'tsher ba bzlog: gung la rta pho 'tsher ba bzlog: tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba bzlog 'ug pa spo la rgod pa bzlog: srin bya gong khar 'tsher ba bzlog:logs la wa spyang brgyal ba bzlog gnam la bya rgod sder 'dzings bzlog phu nas sha pho ru 'dzings bzlog: mda' nas nya mo rnga 'dzings bzlog bar nas bud med sder 'dzings bzlog ma bu'i byur sri thams cad bzlog pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur: phas kyi 'phung 'dre byed pa bzlog phugs kyi 'dre chen ngan pa bzlog: lus la nad ngan gtong ba bzlog: tshe la bar gcod byed pa bzlog sal byi ltar 'dzul pa bzlog:mkha' la bya ltar lding ba bzlog: thog tu rbab ltar ril ba bzlog: gdung ring sked pa tshigs pa bzlog mi la bar du gcod pa bzlog phyugs la god kha byed pa bzlog mi kha smra mchu thams cad bzlog: chags che nyam nga thams cad bzlog bsam sbyor ngan pa gtong ba yi: snang dgra gnod byed thams cad kun: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas kyang :gzhig dang sbar dang btul byas nas: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod tshal pa tshal pa dum bu dum bu rdul phran rdul phran phye ma phye ma brlag brlag: bzlog bzlog: bh+yo bh+yo: sarba maṅga lo//—266

'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdos kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma 6)'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdos kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs bsdos gang sdo/na ma 9 — de lte sarba sirnyi pra ya smo rab dkar dge legs chu gter che las don gnyis bum bzang za ma tog /mchog thun dngos grub 'chi med bdud rtsi skal bzang yongs la stsol mkhas pa'i/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tsho gos kun gcig bsdus bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin/ /'bon ston chos rje yab sras gtsug tu bsten no 'dzum zhal lhug par ston/ /bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa ma lus pa/ /gcig tu rab bsdus phrin las dbang phyug rdo rje gzhen nu khro bo'i dbang / khro bcu phra phyag sgo ma phur srung bka' nyan las byed tsho gis rnams kyis/ /nag phyogasabadud sde'i dpung tshogs choms la dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs mchog /bsrung bar zhal bzhes bstan srung gtso mo dpal ldan dmag dang zor gyi lha/ /rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bu ltar skyong zhing dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag mdzad pa/ /'dod khams dbang phyug bka' sdod bcas pas phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis sgrubs/ /mthu stobs rdo rje thog gi rjes 'gro la/ /myur mgyogs glog gis 'gran par bzod min pa'i/ /lha mchog ma mo'i dbang phyug re ma ti'i/ /dgyes bskyed mdos kyi rim pa 'dri byed na/ /ji ltar bsams(2na)pa'i yid kyi re ba kun/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis rab grub cing / /mi mthun phyogasarnams thal bar rlog pa yi/ /'phrin las g.yel med bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /de'ang dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i gtso mo 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo mdos kyi sgo nas dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i phrin las kyi rim pa bri ba la/ sngon du 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi/—267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherjes kyi rim pa dang gsum las/ dang po mchod gtor/ sman raka /mdos kyi bca' gzhi sogs lag len mtha' dag bla ma'i man ngag phyag bzhes/ mthong brgyud/ yig chung / dpe ris sogs sgo bstun dgos shing / kho bos zur du byas pa'i lag len gsal byed chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs la blo ldan rnams zhib mor dpyod pa gnad du che/ las len man ngag cung zad tsam yang ma shes par rol mo tsam dkrol rgyu yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas te/ chos srung bsten par rlom pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi gzugasabarnyan can rnams kyi spyod tshul rang re'i lugs 'di la ye ma shor ba gal che/ gnyis pa ni/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu'i 'phrin las kyis gzhung bsrangs/ chos skyong 'di'i bskang gso bzlas pa yan dang /e ka dzā sa sogs gter srung sde brgyad/ dkar bdud phur srung gi gsol mchod/ gzhan yang rgyun du (2ba)bya ba'i cho se skyong rnams dang / gzhi bdag gi gtor ma rnams phul grub rjes/ bstod pa ci rigs dang tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum song mtshams/ mdos gyer ba la/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ nam mkha'/ rlung / chu/ me la ste 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bskang mdos ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ steng gi dbus dang phyogs bzhir rin po che dang thod pa las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong pa phyi rol gyi rmang du gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ gling bzhi lcags ri mu khyud kyisabaskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ri rab kyi steng gi gzhal yasakhang gi nang du khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su zhes pa nas/ dbu la rma bya'i gdugs phub pa/ dre'u'i sngon du chu srin gdong can mthing nag zhagasaX dang mthur sna 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi na bza' gsol ba/ slad kyi rjes 'brang seng ge'i gdong pa can dmar nag gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gtso mo'i pho brang gi phyogs bzhi'i mdun gyi mkhar du bdud mo re ma tī mthing nag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mi lpags dang dar nag gi gos gyon zhing bong bu gu pa la bcibs pa/ g.yas kyi mkhar du nad kyi bdag mo mthing nag g.yas sho rde dang g.yon byang dmar —268

'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdos kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma 6)'dzin pa/ dar nag dang re ba'i gos gyon zhing dre'u la bcibs pa/ rgyab kyi mkhar du skyi mthing ma nag mo g.yas mi snying dang g.yon sdigs(mdzub mdzad pa/ mi lpags(dang stag lpags gyon zhid sha ba la bcibs pa/ g.yon gyi mkhar du khri sman sa le ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis chu srin gyi pags pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing dar dkar gyi thod dang gos gyon pa/ ( 2na)bya nag la bcibs pa/ gzhal yas khang gi mdun gyi g.yas zur gyi mkhar du dpyid kyi rgyal mo mthing nag g.yas spu gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin cing mi lngags gyon pa dre'u la bcibs pa/ rgyab kyi g.yas zur gyi mkhar du dbyar gyi rgyal mo dmar nag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa chu dar gyon zhing chu glang la bcibs pa/rgyab kyi g.yon zur gyi mkhar du ston gyi rgyal mo ser mo g.yas zor ba dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa rma bya'i sgro thul gyon zhing sha ba la bcibs pa/ mdun gyi g.yon zur gyi mkhar du dgun gyi rgyal mo mthing nag g.yas khram shing dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa rnga mo gu pa la bcibs pa/ bang rim gnyis pa'i mdun ngosakyi mkhar du bkra shis tshe ring ma dkar mo rdo rje dang bum pa 'dzin pa seng ge la bcibs pa/mthing gi zhal bzang ma sngon mo ba dan dang me long 'dzin cing rkyang la bcibs pa/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma ser mo kyi zas ba/zheng pa dang ne'u le 'dzin pa stag la bcibs pa/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma dmar mo nor bu dang gter gyi sgrom bu 'dzin pa sha ba la bcibs pa/ ltad dkar 'gro bzang ma ljang gu du rba dang sprul zhags 'dzin pa 'brug la bcibs pa/ lnga ga'ang khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams ldan/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ g.yas kyi mkhar du rdo rje kun grags ma sngon mo sbrul nag stong gi thul ba dang g.yag lnga gas rlone pa'i sham thabs can/ bya rgod kyi phur bu 'dzin pa/ g.yu 'brug la bcibs pa/ rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong sngon mo g.yag lpags rlon pa'i na bza' dang / khyung gshog stong gi sham thabs can/ zangs kyi phur bu 'dzin pa/ drel rta rkang gsum la bcibs pa/ rdo rje kun bzang ma dkar mo seng ge'i g.yang gzhi gsol zhing rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa seng ge la bcibs pa/ rdo rje bgegs (3ba)kyi gtso sngon mo glang nag stong gi na bza' dang / khyung gshog stong gi sham thabs can —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she rilcags phur 'dzin cing gser sha yu mo la bcibs pa/ rgyab kyi mkhar du rdo rje spyan gcig ma dkar mo dung gi khu 'phang gi na bza' la g.yu'i ska rags bcings pa/ khrag gi rkyal pa 'dzin zhing dung sha dkar po la bcibs pa/ rdo rje dpal gyi yum ser mo mi lpags kyi na bza' dang / mi snying khug pa'i sham thabs can/ dug mda' stor nag 'dzin cing khyung la bcibs pa/ rdo rje klu mo dkar mo mi mgo brtsegs pa'i thul pa gyon zhing zhing dbyug 'dzin pa/ phag rgod nag po la bcibs pa/ rdo rje drag mo rgyal ljang gu g.yag lpags stong gi slog pa dang / khyung gshog stong gi sham thabs can/ mchog phur 'dzin cing / 'brong rwa dgu la bcibs pa/ g.yon gyi mkhar du rdo rje dpal mo che nag mo seng lpags stong gi slog pa dang / sprul nag gtams pa'i sham thabs can/ khrag gi bum pa 'dzin cing kong rta dkar po la bcibs pa/ rdo rje sman gcig ma dmar mo gyi ling dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang / stag lpags stong gi sham thabs can/ ba so'i phur pa 'dzin cing drel nag kha ser la bcibs pa/ rdo rje g.ya' mo sil dmar nag sbrul nag gtams pa'i g.yang gzhi gsol zhid seng ldeng gi phur ba 'dzin pa/gna' ba yu mo la bcibs pa/ rdo rje dril bu gzugs legs ma sngon mo spyang ki'i slog pa dang / mi rtsib brgyus pa'i sham thabs can/ cang te'u dang gling bu 'dzin pa/ g.yu'i seng ge la bcibs pa/ gtso 'khor de dag gi bka' nyan las byed pho nya sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas rnams kyi ma dag dngos 'dzin thams cad rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i raṃ (4na〉pas ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ yaṃ las chos nyid kyi rlung gis gtore/ khaṃ las mtshan med kyi chus bkrus/ oṃ gyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod lngar gyur pa/ ā yis nam mkha'i khams gang ba dpal kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin ltar khyab/ hūṃ gis bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zad mi shes par spel/ swā sa gzugs brnyan thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa dang ldan pa/ hās 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug re ma ti 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs dang —270

'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdos kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogeganyis su med pa'i bde ba wo po'i rang bzhin du rol pa'i thugs dam gnyan po skong pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ral gri phur pa la sogs pa'i mtshon cha dang / nad rkyal/sho rde/ byang dmar/ dru bu/ khram shing / skam gsher gyi thun la sogs pa rno pa'i ngar dang dug gi dpal dang ldan pa/ btab pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab bo/ /spyan 'dren pa ni/ spos sbyor bsregs/ g.yab dar dang bcas te/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan kun tu bzang mo khros pa'i gar/ /gshin rje'i lcam gcig dpal ldan re ma ti/ /rigs 'dzin dgra lha 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /bde chen chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs shig /dam nyams dgra bgegs gshed ma mthu rtsal can/ /ma mo nag mo dregs pa kun gyi gtso/ /dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mu le ding gi pho brang nas bzhengs shig /nga ni dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu ste/ khro rgyal dbang po'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /bstan srung gtso mo dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /gsang chen sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dam la 'dus/ /(4ba/bh+yo/ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na/ /nyi ma byang shar pha gi na/ /brag dang chu 'thab phar 'das na/ /mu le ding gi nang shed na/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gur gyi nang / /me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus/ khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho'i klong / /bse mkhar dur khrod rgyan ldan nas/ /dmag zor rgyal mo gshegs su gsol/ /re tī nad bdag gshegs su gsol/ /bran g.yog mched bzhi gshegs su gsol/ /dus bzhi'i lha mo gshegs su gsol/ /mkha' 'gro mched lnga gshegs su gsol/ /bdud mo mched bzhi gshegs su gsol/ /gnod sbyin mched bzhi gshegs su gsol/ /sman mo mched bzhi gshegs su gsol/ /bka' nyan 'khor tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /thugs dam can du 'dra lags kyang / /dmag zor rgyal mo sna la spyon/ /nag mo glog ltar 'byug cing spyon/ /dmag zor rgyal mo da tshur spyon/ /gdung sems can khyod da tshur spyon/ /nag mo'i tsho gos kyis steng khams khong / khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdus/ /bh+yoḥ zhing chen la sogs gos kyi g.yab btang —271

'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdo kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (pestsol//rlung nag drag tu 'tshe pa'i gur khyim nang //rab dmar khrag zhag rba klong zhakhrug pa'i steng //sprul dang srin po'i sga srab gong rmed can//rkyang ser dre'u'i steng na phyed skyil bzhugs//mig sman brtsegs pa'i sa 'dzin dbang po la//nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i srin mo'i gzugs//bskal pa'i me dpung dbus na ma rga par 'gying //rab brjid dur khrod chos kyis rnam par brgyan//sna tsho gos mtshone cha gdug can snying la gzir//ha ha'i gad brgyangs srid gsum ma lus g.yo//sprul pa yang sprul bye ba phyogs bcur 'gyed/khams gsum kun las rnam rgyal khyod la bstod//dmag zor lha mo 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis//nad gdon kun zhi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas//mi nor dbang sdud dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod//bshags pa ni/bh+yoḥrdo rje 'chang dang lwa ba dmar po sogs//zhes so gos bya/ma mo'i lha bgyed pa ni/hūṃ/ma ni rgyal ba kun gyi mkha'//mo ni srid pa gsum gyi klong //ma ni skye ba med pa'i mkha'//mo ni 'gag pa med pa'i klong //ma ni tshangs dbyangs ldan pa'i mkha'//mo ni theg chen ston pa'i klong //ma ni spros bral dbyings kyi mkha'//mo ni sems kyi dbyings kyi klong //ma ni thabs chen ston pa'i mkha'//mo ni shes rab chags med slong //ma ni 'phrin las rgya chen mkha'//mo ni bde ba ster ba'i klong //ma ni chos sku don dam mkha'//mo ni gzugs sku sna tsho gis slong //'gro la phan dang bde 'byung pa'i//mkha' klong gnyis su bdag sgoms shig/khro bo'i nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/hūṃ/nga ni khrag 'thung khro bo kun gyi gtso//nga ni dbang phyug ma mo 6na spyo gyi rje//nga ni lha srin sdebargyad bran du 'khol//nga ni deng 'dir phrin las rnam bzhi 'tshol//srid pa'i che btsan thams cad bka' la nyan//nad bdag ma mosarims kha dgra la sgyur//byad phur dus min 'chi sogs 'gal rkyen bzlog/zhi rgyas dbang drag bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs//bsgral mchod 'bul ba la thog mar bskul ba ni/ri rab lhun po dang dpal ldan gnyan re ma rnams bya/de nas gser skyems ni/bka' drin 'khor med rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //dngos grub kun stsol rdo rje phur pa'i lha//'phrin laX sgrub mdzad 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//gser

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()skyems 'di bzhes bcol pa'i las kun sgrubs//re ti nad gtong bran g.yog rnam pa bzhi//dus bzhi'i lha mo tshe ring mched lnga dang //bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor tsho gis rgya mtshor bcas//gser skyems/tshe rabs du mar bsten pa'i dam can tshogs//pha mes brgyud nas 'go ba'i srung ma dang //dregs pa sdebargyad phur skyong gter srung rnams//gser skyems //de nas tsā ba khung nya bo sogasabaskyed de dgug gzhug byas rjes/dpral ba nas sprul bud med dkar mo'i tshogs//lcags kyu 'dzin byed dgra bgegs bla tshe khug/mgrin pa nas sprul bud med dmar mo'i tshogs//zhags pa 'dzin pas dam nyams dgra bgegs chings//thugs ka nas sprul bud med nag mo'i tshogs//lcags sgrog 'dzin pas dam nyams dgra bgegs sdoms//lte ba nas sprul bud med ser mo'i tshogs//dril bu 'dzin pas dam nyams dgra bgegs mos//gsang gnas nas sprul las byed pho nya'i tshogs//dgra bo lha dang phrol la bdud dang sprod//gzu dpang ni/rtsa ba gsum gyis dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis dang //chosasrung sdebargyad dregs pa'i dmag 6bstabs la//zol med snying nas ra mda' spron byed na//bden rdzun bshags phye brnag pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol//'khor bar yid 'byung snying nas dam chos sems//'gro kun mar shes byang chub sems rgyud 'byongs//gsang chen chos la spyod pa'i rigs 'dzin la//gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thul zhig srung ma'i tshogs//dka' ba khyad bsad bla ma yun du bsten//man ngag ji bzhin bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin//chos srung 'bral med bsten pa'i rigs //gnod //rgyal ba'i bstan bshig bla ma'i sku la bsdo//rigs 'dzin sgos dgra 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'jig/bden med gdug can dgra 'di yal bor na//srog 'phrog bshan pa'i ming yang ngo re gnong //rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung ngo zhes//drag po'i rnam par rol la dgos pa ci//de phyir gzugasabyang ming rus btab pa'i dgra//lo zla zhag tu ma bzhag snying khrag 'thung //g.yab dar dang bcas/bstan pa'i gdug can dgra bo 'di//sgrol phyir sprul pa grangs med pa//ston cig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//dmag zor rgyal mo da tshur spyon//bran /yog dmag sogs da tshur spyon//dus bzhi'i lha

'dod khams dbang phyug re ma t+ta dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdos kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma 'damo —/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis ma / /dam can rgya mtsho / /de nas 'don gyi rol mo bsgyur te/ pad sgor 'khyil nyal yan gyi 'chams rnams grub rjes/ /bh+yo: bdud mo nag mo re ma tis/ /ral gris dgra po'i lus la bsnun/ /nad kyi bdag mos sho rde dang / /byang dmar dkyus su dgra bgegs chug /khri sman sales mtsho ni rnon gyis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gnas gsum bsnun/ /ma gcig skyi mthing g.ya' ma skyong / /thun gyi char pa dgra la phob/ /bh+yoḥ dpyid kyi rgyal mo mthing nag gis/ /sbu gri rnon pos yan lag gtubs/ /dbyar gyi rgyal mo dmar nag gis/ /(7na skogs kyus dgra bo'i nang khrol drongs/ /ma yams nag mo mas rtsal can/ /gri gug 'bar bas mgo bo khos/ /chu srin klu mo re ma tis/ /dug khrag nad kyis spyo ru chug /bh+yoḥ ston gyi rgyal mo ser 'od kyis/ /zor ba rnon pos mgo lus phrol/ /dgun gyi rgyal mo mun pa'i mdog /khram shing nag po dgra bor thob/ /bstan ma bstoganyis mthu rtsal can/ /sna tshogs mtshone chas phye mar thogs/ /'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tis/ /phur bu snying la thob la song / /stob pa ni/ bh+yo: dpal ldan lha mo bka' nyan srung ma'i tshogs/ /gnam sa gdangasapa tsam gyi zhal nang du/ /dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i sha dar khrag /ma lus stob po dgyes pa chen pos rol/ /lta kā li de sa sa pa ra ma hā me sa sogs brjod/ mdos dngos gzhi gyer ba ni/ bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo re ma tī/ /ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo khyod/ /'od srung bstan pa nub kha sa /rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / /smon lam gcig tu btab pa'i mthus/ ā kya'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin kun/ /srung skyob mthu stobs mi bzad pas/ /'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson/ /sku ni kun tu bzang mo ste/ /gsung ni sgra dbyangs brjod 'das ma/ /thugs ni smra bsam spyi las 'das/ /kun gyi yum chen 'dir gshegs shig /khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan skyong gi /mdos bdag chen mos mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag wo mos glud 'di long / /bcol ba'i wen las bsgrub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ ri yi rgyal po ri rab 'di/ /ke ke ru dang be+e ḍūrla/ /pad+ma rā ga btso ma gser/ khyu ni rin chen gzhi las grub/ /lha mi'i 'dod yon kun dang ldan/ /bse mkhar rgya phubs lcog gis mdzes/ /rngam brjid pho brang gnas kyi —275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()rten//ri rab lcags ri nag 7ba khos bskor//gling bzhi gling phran rnam bkra ba//'dod khamasadabang phyug ma la 'bul//re tī nad bdag gnyis la 'bul//g.yog mo bka' nyan bzhi la 'bul/sprul pa dus bzhi'i lha mor 'bul//mkha' 'gro tshe ring mgo lngar 'bul//bstan ma bcu gnyis tshogs la 'bul//'khor tsho gis dam can rgya mtshor 'bul//bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag gis//bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//pho brang steng na 'ja' tshon ltar//rnam par bkra ba'i gdugs dang tog/ri rab steng na mthing nag gi/nam mkha' 'ja' ris rgyang bu gcig/bang rim gnyis pa'i phyogs rnams su//nam mkha' bcu gnyis rtse mo la//rma bya'i sgro phod dag gis mdzes//rgyang bu bcu gnyis rtse mo la//bya pho'i sgro phod dag gis mdzes//rtse mor mkha' lding nag mo ni//bcu gsum 'phur mkhas lings se ling //gsung snyan de ni skyur ru rtswa/spyan rtsa de ni jigs se hrig/'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul//re tī nad bdag gnyis la 'bul//g.yog mo bka' nyan bzhi la 'bul//sprul pa dus bzhi'i lha mor 'bul//mkha' 'gro tshe ring mched lngar 'bul//bstan ma bcu gnyis tshogs la 'bul//'khor tsho gos dam can rgya mtshor 'bul//bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag gis//bcol pa'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//bang rim gsum pa'i phyogs rnams su//rta drel rgyug cing g.yag rgod dang //lug la'i bya lding khyi seng 'phyo//nyi zla be con thod khrag dang //nad rkyal sho rde byang dmar dang //mar du khram shing re ba'i gos//mi glang stag lpags thod sgro dang //rus pa sprul rgyan byug pa'i rdzas//sga srab rlung nag 'tshe ma'i gur//sra ba'i go cha rno ba'i mar//mda' dang dar gyi cod pan can//sprul zhags mi snying rma bya'i gdugs//rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga//ba po shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa//mas pa'i dam rdzas tshogos rnams kun//'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul//re ti nad bdag gnyis la 'bul//g.yog mo ni tha ka' nyan bzhi la 'bul//sprul pa dus bzhi'i lha mor 'bul//mkha' 'gro tshe ring mched lngar 'bul//bstan ma bcu gnyis tshogs la 'bul//'khor tsho/sa dam can rgya mtshor 'bul//bzhes nas rnal

'dod khams dbang phyug re gti dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdo kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma 9)'byor bdag cag gis/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang 'bul ba'i mthun rdzas ni/ /lha yi chad ba bzlog pa'i khram/ /bdud kyi chad pa bzlog pa'i khram/ /ma mo'i dal yams / /klu yi mnan gtad— / /btsan gyi rgyu srang ཿ/ /gshin rje'i 'khor loḥ/ /rgyal po'i smyo 'bog : / /gza' yi ki gang:/ /byad zor rbod gtongaḥ/ /bal mo'i khrag zor / /'dod khams —/ /re ti / /g.yog mo ཿ/ /sprul pa / /mkha' 'grod /bstan mtsha/ /'khor tshogs / /bzhes nas:/ /bcol pa'i bang rim bzhi ba'i phyogs rnams su/ /mnga' khra dang ni 'phang khra dag /re re bcagasum grangs tshang zhing / mang gri yul mkhar ri mo can/ /pho gdong stag mas ri mo can/ /mo gdong dang 'phan / /pho gdong liṅga:/ /mo gdong glang gi —/ /pho gdong nor bu'i / /mo gdong mkhar thabasaḥ/ /spyan gzigs dkor nor longs spyod sogs/ /kun kyang bcu gsum grangs tshang pa/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor glud kyi tshad/ /'dod khamasaḥ/ /re tī / /g.yog moḥ/ /sprul pa:/ /mkha' 'groḥ/ /bstan ma / /'khor tshogs / /bzhes nas / /bcol pa'i / /gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /rtsabargyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman/ / dmar chen rak+ta'i — dang / /gtor ma 'brang rgyas sman le'i tshogs/ khrag dang mkhris pa sha dang chang / /bya mo nag mo gser mig ma/ /rams skag mtshal spos me tog sogs/ /btsod dang zhun mkhan nas 'bras gro/ /dmar chen khrag gi dbus skyu dang / /ngar mi khrag gi kong bu sogs/ /gtso 'khor so so'i mthun pa'i rdzas/ /ma (8ba〉spyang med par rab bshamasapa/ /'dod khams / /re ti / /g.yog mo / /sprul pa —/ /mkha' 'gro / /bstan ma / /'khor tshogs —/ /bzhes nas:/ /bcol pa'i / /'phrin las bcol zhing bzlog bsgyur bya ba ni/ bh+yoḥrtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad dang / /pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga sa /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ /dam la dgongs te glud bzhes shig /bdag la bltos pa'i yon bdag 'di/ /sngon gyi las kyi 'phro chungasate/ /dus la bab cing tshe zad kyang / /lo brgya'i bar du bsgol thob cig /rnal 'byor nga yi bka' ma bcag /ma mo'i thugs dam 'dis skongs la/ /nad gdon dgra bgegs zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedapal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ /khyod kyi lag pa g.yas pa na/ /bdud kyi khram bam gnam la 'phyar/ /skye 'gro gzugs su snang ba kun/ /sang phod ding sang su 'chi yang / /do gcig khyod kyi bram la 'debs/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di/ /gal te khram la btab zin na/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ khram kha phyis shig re ma tī/ /zlog byed ma yi dus la bab/ /sgyur byed ma yi dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ khyod kyi lag pa g.yon pa na/ /btsan gyi sho rde dkar nag 'gyed/ /skye 'gro gzugs su snang ba kun/ /sang phod ding sang su 'chi yang / /do gcig khyod kyis sho la 'god/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di/ khyod kyisasho la bkod zin na/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ lko rde dkar nag de spos shig /zlog byed ma yi dus la bab/ /sgyur byed ma yi dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ khyod kyi ma na khung g.yon pa na/ /nad kyi rkyal pa sngo dmar sped/ /sbrul nag lnga brgya'i kha chings can/ /skye 'gro gzugs su snang ba kun/ /sang phod ding sang su 'chi yang / /do gcig khyod kyis nad la 'debs/ /bdag dang (9na)rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di/ /gal te nad la btab srid na/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /nad kha sgyur gcig re ma tī/ /dal yams sgyur cig re ma tī/ /zlog byed ma yi dusalabab/ /sgyur byed ma yi dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la/ /'bras bu gsang sngags chosadar te/ /gsang sngags bon ltar gyer pa'i dus/ /dge sdig 'chol par spyod pa'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor yongs nyams ma mo 'khrugs/ /thugs dang 'gal pa'i rtags bstan pa/ /'dzam bu gling gi dbusaphyogs nas/ /bud med nag mo bsam mi khyab/ kha rlangs nag po btang ba'i tshe/ /mkha' la nad kyi sprin phung chags/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams byung / /ye 'byog sum brgya drug sto byung / /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad byung / /gsang sngags spyod pa grangs med yang / /gzhung bzhin spyod pa'i rnal 'byor nga / /bka' ltar spyod pa'i dbang phyug bdag /man ngag thugs kyi rgyud bskul te/ /dpal chen bdud rtsi rnam lngas mchode/ /ma sring dmar chen tsho gos kyis mchode/ /gsur chen dud pa rgyun mi gcod/ /—278

'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdo kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgro dbyangs/ nang ma 9)dbang phyug phu nas khus 'debs na/ /dpal ldan mda' nas snyan ma sra/ /ri klungs med par khu yis thob/ /dbang phyug mda' nas g.yab dor gyi/ /dpal ldan phu nas spyan ma brtul/ /nag mo'i tsho gos kyis stong khams gang / /sngon nas sring mo phur pa'i lha/ /da lta dpal ldan re ma tī/ /lha srin kun gyi gshed byed ma/ /skye 'gro kun gyi bdud gcod ma/ /dgra bo kun gyi snying 'byin ma/ /bgegasakun thal bar rlog byed ma/ /ma yi nang nas ma gcig ma/ /sring gi nang nas sring gcig ma/ /mthun pa'i mdos glud 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /nad gdon chags che nyam nga bzlog /yul phyogs(9ba〉ga phyogs 'di dag gi /nad rims dus kyi 'khrug pa bzlog /bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /gsang sngags bon gyer dge sdig 'chol/ /de tshe srid pa'i ma mo khros/ /ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa/ /'dzam bu gling gi dbusaphyogs nas/ /bud med nag mos stong khams gang / kha rlangs nag po btang pa'i tshe/ /nad kyi na bun sprin du chags/ /de tshe nad kyi bskal ba dang / /'byum pa dkar nag lhog pa dang / /skrangs nad bal ldag g.yan pa byung / /nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur/ /bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /sdang ba'i dgra yi steng du bzlog /bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la /gsang sngags bon gyer dge sdig 'chol/ /de tshe srid pa'i ma mo khros/ /ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa/ /'dzam bu gling gi shar phyogs nas/ /bud med dkar mos stong khams gang / kha rlangs dkar po btang pa'i tshe/ /nad kyi na bun sprin du chags/ /de tshe nad kyi bskal ba dang / /mdze nad shu ba g.yan pa dang / /glo gzer skya rbab rlung nad 'byung / /nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur/ /bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /sdang ba'i dgra yi steng du bzlog /bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /gsang sngags bon gyer dge sdig 'chol/ /de tshe srid pa'i ma mo khros/ /ma mo —279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shekhros pa'i rtags bstan pa/ /'dzam bu gling gi lho phyogs nas/ /bud med ser mos stong khams gang /kha rlangs ser po btang pa'i tshe/ /nad kyi na bun sprin du chags/ /de tshe nad kyi bskal ba dang / /mkhris pa sha ya mig ser dang / /rgya nad sha ser nad rnams khrung / /nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /rimasakyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur/ /bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /sdang ba'i dgra yi steng du bzlog /bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /gsang sngags bon gyer dge sdig 'tshol/ /de tshe srid pa'i ma mo khros/ /ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa/ /'dzam bu gling gi nub phyogs nas/ /bud med dmar mosastong khams gang / kha (10nas dmar po btang pa'i tshe/ /nad kyi na bun sprin du chags/ /de tshe nad kyi bskal ba dang / khrag nad gzer thabs le'u brgan dang / khyu gzer khrag skyug mkhal nad 'byung / /nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur/ /bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /sdang ba'i dgra yi steng du bzlog /bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /gsang sngags bon gyer dge sdig 'chol/ /de tshe srid pa'i ma mo khros/ /ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa/ /'dzam bu gling gi byang phyogs nas/ /bud med sngon mos stong khams gang / kha rlangs sngon po btang pa'i tshe/ /nad kyi na bun sprin du chags/ /de tshe nad kyi bskal ba dang / /bal nad smyo 'bog rimasand dang / /bla rdol spyo sogs sna tsho gos yang / /nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur/ /bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /snang ba'i dgra yi steng du bzlog /bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab/ /bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /gsang sngags bon gyer dge sdig 'chol/ /de tshe srid pa'i ma mo khros/ /ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa/ /'dzam bu gling gi dbus phyogs nas/ /bud med smug mos stong khamasagang / kha rlangs smug po btang pa'i tshe/ /mtshon gyi na bun sprin du chags/ /de tshe nad kyi bskal ba —280

'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdo kyi phrin la gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma 6)dang / /g.yul gcig 'thab rtsod sna tsho gos pas/ /grangs med mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'byung / /dusa'akhrug ma mo khyod kyi 'phrul/ /mtshon kyang ma mo khyod kyi mtshon/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /mtshon kha chod la dmag kha sgyur/ /bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /sdang ba'i dgra yi steng du bzlog /bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab/ /srid gsum bdag mo mas stobs can/ /sogs dang / lhun grub chos dbyings ma/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma dang char sprin ltar sngo ma bya/ bh+yoḥmathing nag mun pa'i mdog can srin mo'i gzugs/ /mi lpags dar nag gos rgya zhe bong bu bcibs/ /ral gris dgra srog gcod cing thod khrag nang / khrag 'thung bdud mo re ma tī la bstod/ /dar nag re ba'i gos gyon dre'u bcibs/ /phung byed sho rde nag po dgra la 'gyed/ /byang dmar stong gi dkyus la dgra bgegs 'jug /srog 'phrog nad kyi (10ba thad ga mo khyod la bstod/ /mi bzad srog la dbang byed khro mo'i gzugs/ /g.yang gzhi stag lngags rgya zhe zhing sha ba bcibs/ /don snying khrag gis sbagasapa zhal du gsol/ /skyi mthing nag mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /sku mdog rab dkar res 'ga' smug por ston/ /dar dkar gos gyon so bya rog po bcibs/ /chu srin gdug pa'i pags pa mkha' la 'phyar/ /'khri sman sa le dkar mo khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga dang / /bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong pa'i mthu rtsal can/ /'khor tsho gos dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gis la bstod/ /'chi med mchog stsol ma bya/ glud gtong ba ni/ badz+ra a phri tas bsangs/ /su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdzes shing yid du 'ong pa'i ngar glud/ /lusangag yid gsum phung po khams skye mched/ tshe srog dbugs dbang po lnga sogs tshang zhing / dar zab
