kyi gos/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa 'dod yon lngas khyad par du byas pa gyur/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs te/ rin chen 'bru tshogs las grub pa'i/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong ngar gyi mi/ /rtsab 'bu yis ma zos shing / /rtse mo sad kyis ma khyer pa/ /zho sha'i snying la dung dkar rus/ khu tig klad pa zer mo'i skra/ /zho sha'i mkhal ma mar gyi mdongs/ /lung thang mig la mgron bu'i so/ /—281

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()rkang pa g.yas pa thabs chen lcags//g.yon pa shes rab zangs la byas//lag pa g.yas pa rin cen gser//g.yon pa de ni g.yu la byas//lus ni rgyan dang gos kyis mdzes//smra mkhas pa de ngag re 'jam//yid ni rtog cing dpyod pa bkra/bla tshe srog gsum dbugs dang ldan//phung po lnga dang dbang bo lnga/ na khims li bco brgyad skye mgo ni//bcu gnyis po yang ma lus tshang //skyin bdag rke nas rgyan bkrol te//mgul par brgyan bas 'tsher ro re//sbyin bdag lus nas gos phud de//lus la bkon pas lhubs6lhub//'gro mkhas de ni khyung gi 'gros/khyung chen 'gros su ldegs6ldeg/mi zad nor gyi bang mdzod tshogs//rnam thos bu la 'gran bzod 'di//sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas//'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul//re ti nad bdag gnyis la 'bul//bran g.yog lha mo mched bzhin 'bul//sprul pa dus bzhi'i lha mor 'bul//mkha' 'gro tshering mched lnga 'bul//bstan ma bcu gnyis tshogos la 'bul//'khor tsho gos dam can rgya mtshor 'bul//mi bas glud dga' glud 'di bzhes//rin cen mdzes pa'i glud 'di bzhes//rigs 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon glud//sngags la 4 rnal 'byor bdag gi glud//mar grogs rdo rje skrun gyi glud//rgyu sbyar sbyin pa'i bdag po'i glud//skyes pa pho rnams kun gyi glud//za ma mo rnams kun gyi glud//yul mkhar nor rdzas kun gyi glud//glud 'di bzhes la mtshon kha phyes/kho dang byang dmar dkyusponas phyungs//nad rkyal kha sdoms mtshone du chod//mnan gtad byad kha dag las thon//bcings pa khrol la bsdams pa glod//gdon bgegs mi mthun phyogs rnams las//thar ro dmigs bya 'khor bcas thar//rgyal lo dkar po lha rgyal lo//pham mo nag po 'dre pham mo//bsgyur ro ltas ga dgra la sgyur//bh+yoḥdapal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī//nam mkha'i mthongs la bzhugs pa'i tshe//nam mkha'i mthongs kyi dpal mo btsun//de yang byang shar re ma ti//mdos glud yas kyi mchod pa 1babazhes//bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod//ces pa nas/dam tshig mthar gnas gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe//mo btsan chen mo rdo rje g.yar mo ༷sil//rnal 'byor grogs byed gsang sngags chos

'dod kham dang phyug re gti dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdo kyi phrin la gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma 6)'khor skyong / /de yang byang shar re ma ti/ /mdos glud yas kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ zhes ba'i bar 'don pa cung zad bsgyur/ /bh+yoḥ dgra lha srog lha la so gos pa'i/ /lha yi rigs gyur thams cad kyis/ /ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la/ /mchod cing bskor zhing phyag bgyis kyang / /jo mo de la spyan mi gzigs/ /phyag lan ma ster khro tshul ston/ /glud 'di 'ded khamasagatso mo bzhes/ /lha yi 'khu ldog zhi bar mdzod/ /klu rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i/ /klu yi ris/5gyur thams cad kyis/ /ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la/ /mchod cing bskor zhing phyag bgyis kyang / /jo mo de la spyan mi gzigs/ /phyag lan mi ster khro tshul ston/ /glud 'di 'dod khams gtso mo bzhes/ /klu yi gnod pa zhi bar mdzod/ /re tī 'gong yag la sogs pa'i/ /bdud kyi rigs gyur thams cad kyis/ /ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la/ /mchod cing bskor zhing phyag bgyis kyang / /jo mo de la spyan mi gzigs/ /phyag lan mi ster khro tshul ston/ /glud 'di 'dod khams gtso mo bzhes/ /bdud kyi khram kha dgra la sgyur/ /skyes bu lung btsan la sogs pa'i/ /btsan gyi rigs gyur thams cad kyis/ /ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la/ /mchod cing bskor zhing phyag bgyis kyang / /rjo mo de la spyan mi gzigs/ /phyag lan mi ster khro tshul ston/ /glud 'di 'dod khams gtso mo bzhes/ /btsan gyi gzer nad zhi bar mdzod/ /ma bdud rgyal mo la sogs pa'i/ /ma mo'i rigs gyur thams cad kyis/ /ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la/ /mchod cing bskor zhing phyag bgyis kyang / /jo mo de la spyan mi gzigs/ /phyag lan mi ster khro tshul ston/ /glud 'di 'dod khams gtso mo bzhes/ /ma mo'i dal yams dgra la sgyur/ /dkon rje dkor bdag la sogs pa'i/ /rgyal po'i rigs gyur thams cad kyis/ /ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la/ /mchod cing bskor zhing phyag bgyis kyang / /jo mo de la spyan mi gzigs/ /phyag lan mi ster khro tshul ston/ /glud 'di 'dod khams gtso mo bzhes/ /rgyal po'i spyo 'bog dgra la (12re/ /de nas 4 bstan/ gser skyems btang / sgo dbye ni/ rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag rnams/ /ting 'dzin sogs dang phyag rgya yis/ /deng 'dir dar glud kha bsgyur zhing / /zor kha gnyan po bskyod —283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebyed na/ /sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye zhig /'phrang ba rnams kyisang sol cig /snang srid lha srin gdug pa kun/ /dmag dpung tsho gis kyi mthu stobs bskyed/ /zor sna gnyan po'i ngar thon la/ /zor sna sdang ba'i dgra la drongs/ /zor sna gnod pa'i bgegs la drongs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams dgra steng bh+yo/ /zor bskul ni/ bh+yoḥ phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma shar phyogs pha gi na/ /yugs sa'i bu mo sgeg mo zhig /nga 'gro nga rings zer zhing 'dug /mdos bdag mo ni yin par nges/ /mdos dang glud 'di skyol la shog /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma shar lto pha gi na/ /bud med smyon ma zor thogs shig /nga 'gro nga rings zer zhing 'dug /mdos bdag mo ni yin par nges/ /mdos dang glud 'di skyol la shog /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na/ /bud med smyon ma zor thogs shig /nga 'gro nga rings zer zhing 'dug /mdos bdag mo ni yin par nges/ /mdos dang glud 'di skyol la shog /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma lho nub pha gi na/ /bud med rgan mo mkhar thogs shig /nga 'gro nga rings zer zhing 'dug /mdos bdag mo ni yin par nges/ /mdos dang glud 'di skyol la shog /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na/ /mgar ba'i bu mo gri thogs shig /nga 'gro nga rings zer zhing 'dug /mdos bdag mo ni yin par nges/ /mdos dang glud 'di skyol la shog /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma nub byang pha gi na/ /bshan pa'i bu mo lag dmar zhig /nga 'gro nga rings zer zhing 'dug /mdos bdag mo ni yin par nges/ /mdos dang glud 'di sgrol la shog /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma byang phyogs pha gi na/ /mgon med skyabs med dwa phrug cig /nga 'gro nga rings zer zhing 'dug /mdos bdag mo ni yin par nges/ /mdos dang glud 'di sgrol la shog /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma byang shar pha gi na/ /brje'i bu mo 'phyon ma zhig /nga 'gro nga rings zer zhing 'dug /mdos bdag mo ni yin par nges/ /mdos(12brkong glud 'di skyol la shog /bh+yoḥ dmag zor lha mo 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /snang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs steng du/ /mda' zor chu 'byugs sar ltar shar ra ra/ /sgong zor ri rab zor chen ril —284

'dod khams dbang phyug re ma'i dgye pa bskyed par byed pa'i mdos kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (geli li/ khrag zor nad kyi rba rlabs chil li li/ /kong zor rdo rje'i thog ltar rbad de rbad/ /byad kha phur kha nad gdon 'khrug longs sogs/ /thams cad sdang pa'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /steng du bzlog cing bsgyur pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces zor 'phang / gsum pa ni/ chos dbyings dbang phyug ma sogs dkyus ltar byas nas yas gtor thun rdzas rnams thog tu phul/ chad mtho bstan skyong spyi ltar bya/gtang rag mchod pa/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na gshegs pa sogs phyag len ltar dang /smon lam shis brjod dga' ston gyi dpal la rol lo/ /smras pa/ dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa des/ 'dod pa'i re 'dod skong ba ltar/ /srid gsum lnga mo 'di bsnyen pas/ /'dod pa'i don kun ngang gis 'grub/ /de phyir 'di nyid dgyes bskyed pa'i/ /mdos kyi rim pa'i 'phrin las rnams/ /gyes sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs su/ /lhag bsam dag pas yi ger bkod/ /rigs rus du mar snga 'gyur gyi/ /chos tshul 'di la goms pa'i mthus/ /sbyor dngos rjes tshad rnam dpyod kyis/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i dga' ston bsgrubs/ /dge des bdud sde'i dpung rnams kun/ /rnam par bcoms pa'i rgyal thabasakyi/ /don gnyis bde chen pho brang du/ /dga' bder 'jug pa'i dpal thob shog /ces phan bde legs bshad gling gi slob dpon chos rje ngag dbang blo bzang pas nye bar bskul bas mtshams sbyar ba dang / 'di skor gyi lag len gra gtsang du gsar du btsugs skabs sngon gyi rtsa ba'i yig rnying rnams dang brgyud ldan gong ma'i yig cha rnams la gzhi (13na)byas/ mnga' bdag nyang gi gter byon mgon po g.yul bzlog nas kyang kha bskang / tshig rkang go rim sogs legs par bcos te bskang mdos kyi dbang du bgyis pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i mdos kyi phrin las gyer sgom rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa 'di'ang rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa du ma'i bka' drin gyis gsang chen rnying ma'i phyogs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa dang ldan zhing / ma gshin phur gsum gyi sngags 'chang rim par byon pa za hor gyi rigs las byung ba'i rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa bla med rdo rje rtsal lam drag po rtsal du 'bod pas me phag sa —285
ma dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tsom/ (sheg zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags 'chang ngag dbang dge legs so//sarba maṅga lo// 286

gter srung dpal mgon stag zhon gyi gsol mchod bklags chog khyer bde bzhugs/bla ma phyag rgya zil gnon la/ /sgo gsum gus pas rab btud nas/ /gter srung dpal mgon stag zhen gyi/ /gsol mchod bklags cho go 'byer bder bkod/ /mchod gter spyan gzigasarnams phyag len ltar 'du byas la/ hūṃ/ rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po lcang lo can/ /ri bo ma la ya yi gnas mchogo nas/ /gnam lcags ur mo rab tu ta la la/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong mer re re/ /zhing chen rkang rus lhu dum khrol lo lo/ /'dab chags sha za mang po lding zhing 'dur/ /gsur wo dud pa'i tshogs ni 'khyil zhing las /de 'dra'i dur khrod rab tu 'jigs pa nas/ /gying chen mgon po yab yum sku bskyod la/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gying bdud ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā wā ma ti yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ sa ra raka he la dzaḥdzaḥ dun ru tra ru ṭaṃ bha ti dzaḥ shu la ra tsa tri shi dza ya dza badz+ra tri rna sa kha ṭaṃ tri sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ sa pa ri wā ra ā la ya ā la ya/ bra pe shā ya/ bra pe shā ya/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha bsgyu a bsgyu a/ a wa lo kā ya a wa lo kā ya/ ā kā chu ya hūṃ dzaḥ rdo rje bden pa'i spyan snga ma khas blangasadam bcas ma bsnyel bar/ /gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bzhugs la bcol pa'i 'phrin (2na7sa mdzod/ ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya sa/ hūṃ/ bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /dza gad bdud rtsi rak+ta dang / dbang po'i me tog gsur chen spos/ /zhun chen sgron me'i snang gsal dang / /dmar chen mkhris pa'i dri'i byug pa/ /dmar nag bsgos bu 'bar ba'i zas/ /rol mo'i sgra dbyangs mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kwa lā ya sa pa ri wā ra ji nas shasta bra tī ts+tsha ye swā hā'i bar brjod/ hūṃ/ lcang lor bcas pa'i dung chen —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa sha dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebs sa /byang chub sems dang paṃ sa rak+ta dang / /dri wo ku ku chu ste bdud rtsi lnga/ /gnyis med sbyar ba'i dam rdzas a mri ta/ /nag po stag zhen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a gra ta kha raṃ khā hi/ / bdud 'dul dbang phyug nag po 'jigs byed che/ /ma ha kā la rdo rje 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ khams gsum sgrol gying chen po'i dngos grub ni/ /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dus 'dir stsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pa ri wā ra kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ wā ka sirnyi snya/ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ hūṃ/ rlung nag 'kha ma'i klong dkyil nas/ /mon pa nag po brda mi 'phrod/ /mgyogs byed dpa' bo stag la zhen/ /bdud btsan srin po ma mo gying / /klu yi tshogs dang bcas pa yi/ /(2bskog po chen po 'khor bcas la/ /dam rdzas rak+ta dmar chen 'bul/ /bdag gi dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /ā+oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya pa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā me sa/ ma hā tsit+ta/ ma hā ke : tig kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya sa pa ri wā ra sam ya sma ra/ sam ya ma ti kra ma/ sam ya rak+ṣa nā/ kye/ stag la zhen pa'i nag po che/ /'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams kun/ /bcol ba ji bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ gtor tsho gis mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang / /e las gnam lcags 'byub khung nang / khri dang tri las dgra bgegs kyi/ /gzugs brnyan nyam thag rnam par gyur/ khri dzaḥti dzabadz+ra ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra spro ṭa2/ badz+ra gharnye ho/ badz+ra pra be shā ya phaṭa/ a be shā ya a/rang dang mgon po'i thugs ka nas/ /'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /gnod byed dam nyams dgra bgegs tshogos/ /skad cig tsam la 'dir khug cig /gri gug 'bar bas khog par shogs/ /tshe srog drod dang rnam shes go /srung ba 'bru gsum rnam par thon/ /rang gi gnas gsum dag la thim/ /oṃ 〉〉/ pho nya'i tsho gos kyi mtshon cha yis/ sha khrag rus pa dum bur gtubs/ /'bru gsum gyisams 'od zer gyis/ /dug gsum sbyangs nas bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /hūṃ/ da ni khro bo'i rgyal po ste/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje la4 / /rdo rje'i lus las rdo rje 'phros/ /thams cad ma lus zil gyis mnon/ /de yi bka' nyan mthu bo che/ /chos skyong mgon po bstan srung mgon/ /ma hā kā la mthu rtsal can/ /zas—288

gter srung dpal mgon stag zhon gyi gsol mchod bklags chog khyer bde/ nang ma 6)su dgra bo'i sha za zhing / /skom du dgra bo'i snying khrag 'thung / khyod ni sha za khrag 'thung ste/ /bstan pa gnyan po bsrung slad du/ /med du byung ba'i gtong ma dang / /dgra bo'i sha khrag mchod par bzhes/ /bcol (3na)pa'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /dam nyams dgra 'di da lta sgrol/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ /oṃ shrī sogs/ mgon po yab yum mon pa dang bcas pa'i sngags sbrel pa'i rjes su sa pa ri wā ra sarba bisna na sha / mā ra ya i dam pa kla ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ hūṃ/ srin po'i gzugs can mthing nag 'jigs pa'i sku/ /rin cen rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal 'phyang / /'jol ber gsol zhing gser sga rked la bcings/ sag ti'i lham gsol gar dgu'i nyams kyis brjid/ /phyag g.yas bde chen lha bdud dmag dpung 'gyed/ /g.yon pa snying khrag khrol ba'i lcags par 'dzin/ /gza' bdud stag chem smyon par sprul ba la/ /zhen nas stong gsum skad cig tsam gyis bskor/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang srog bdag rgyal po che/ /seng ge rngam par brdzus nas phyi bzhin rgyug /ye shes me dpung dmar nag dbus bzhugs pa'i/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la khyod la bstod/ /'dod khams bdag mo khram shing thod khrag dang / /nad rkyal 'dzin zhing lcags kyi drel rta zhon/ /thod sbrul rus rgyan mi lpags re lde'i gos/ /dug sprul ska rags spyi bor rma bya'i mdongs/ /lus la khrag dang zhag gi thig lesabargyan/ /sga yi snga phyir nad rkyal mtshon dru 'phyang / /snang srid ma mo bye ba'i 'khor gyi dbus/ /rab bzhugs mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod la bstod/ /g.yas pa rtse gsum mi ros brgyan pa 'dzin/ /g.yon pa ru mtshon 'phyar bas dmag sna 'dren/ /dar nag ber gyon 'jigs rung sku'i sprul pa/ khram thogs bdud kyi mon pa nag por bstod/ /g.yas pa ma he'i rwa dung cher bus bas/ /lha 'dre'i dmag sdud g.yon pa zhags pa yis/ /dgra bo'i (3bsko 'ching bse khrab dmar po gyon/ /gsung sprul srog gcod btsan gyi mon par bstod/ /g.yas pa lcags kyi spu gris dgra bgegs kyi/ khog pa gshog cing g.yon pa snying dmar po/ /gtso po'i zhal stob mi lpags rlon pa gyon/ /sngo nag bla 'gugs gying gi mon par bstod/ /dza la nag po phyag g.yas thod khrag dang / /g.yon pa rin cen gter gyi ne'u le —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'adzin/ /bar sbrul rgyan ldan rigs ga cha lugs can/ /zhabs gnyis nor bdag ser po mnan la bstod/ sha za khrag 'thung snying 'byin bla 'gugs dang / /gzer 'debs tshe 'phrog srog gcod mon pa bdun/ /gri thod 'dzin cing bdud dmag 'bum gyis bskor/ khrog gcod las la rngam pa khyod la bstod/ /mon mo nag mo bdud kyang rang 'dra'i 'khor/ /stong khams khengs shing bh+yo dang dza sgra sgrog /khrag thun zor gyi dpung tshogs char ltar 'bebs/ /mi bsrun nad bdag ma mo'i tsho gos la bstod/ /mdog nag ral ba mun gti bas pa gas rlone gyon/ khram shing zhags pa 'dzin cing rta nag nyon/ /snga shar bdud khram phyi shar mi ro bkal/ /bdud mgon ri nag spungs pa khyod la bstod/ /sku la dar dkar ral ba lhab lhub gyon/ /rgyal zhugadabu mdzes 'khor lo shasti thogs/ /rta dkar brum dmar zhen nas stong gsum myul/ /lha mgon rgyal po 'od lha dkar por bstod/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can khrag ral thur du gtibs/ /g.yas pa rtse gsum g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin/ /bskal pa'i me rlung gzug pa'i klong na bzhugs/ /gying mgon lcags zha nag po khyod la bstod/ /dar dmar ber dang thod bcings bse khrab gyon/ /mdung dmar khrag gi ba dan btsan zhags thogs/ /rta dmar rlung gi shugasacan steng na zhon/ /btsan mgon shu bo lag ring khyod la bstod/ /za 'og ber dang dar thod mdzes par bcings/ /(4na rdo rje rtse gsum steng du bya khra lding / /ra snying dmar po thogs nas spyang ki zhen/ /gying mgon rdo rje legs pa khyod la bstod/ /gdug pa'i kha rlangs sprin 'thibs sprul nag gis/ /gdengs ka g.yo zhing brang 'gro'i mjug ma can/ /sprul gyi zhags pa sbal pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /klu mgon nag po khyod la bdag bstod do/ khrag gi ral pa 'phyang zhing mi lpags dang / /re lde'i gos gyon rtse gsum ba dan 'dzin/ /mthing nag gur khyim dug mtsho'i klong na bzhugs/ /ma mgon rdo rje'i sder can khyod la bstod/ /lus kun mig gang mgo dgu sbrul mjug can/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan rwa yi mda' gzhu thogs/ /sprin dang rlung nag 'tshub ma'i khrod na gnas/ /gza' mgon khyab 'jug chen po khyed la bstod/ /gzhan yang tsan beng las sprul lha bdud dmag /mkha' dbyings 'dzin ma'i khyod kun rnam —290

gter zung dpal mgon rtog zhen gyi gsol mchod bklags cho go khyer bde/ nang ma 6)par gang //g.yas kyi ru 'dren lha dmag nyi khri dang //tshig stong go sra mtshon rno rta mchog zhen//g.yon gyi ru 'dren ma mo bye ba'i tshogs/khram shing nad rkyal thogs nas drel rta zhen//sngon gyi sna 'dren lho phyogs gshin rje brgyad//stag gzig dom dred 'phar spyang sprul nas rgyug/slad kyi rjesa'abrang byang gi gnod sbyin brgyad//lcags kyi bya khrar sprul nas mkha' la lding //mdor na sa dang bar snang ma lus pa//yongs gang mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab//bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor skyong mdzad pa'i//dam can 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho'i tsho gos la bstod//stag zhen mgon po 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis//khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen gsang ba'i bdag/pad+ma 'byung gan shrī/ gar+bha dang //gu tho tsan+d+ra rgya gar khrag 'thung nag/sgeg pa'i rdo rje bal bo nor 4bab 'dzin//gnubasachen sangs rgyas drang nga kun grags dang //sa ban 'bum grags skyo ban mthu po che//lce btsun mdo ser rong pa rgya lo'i mtshan//lte btsun blo ldan bla ma sri bu chung //rin cen rgyal mtshan chos rgyal dpal bzang po//dpon ston chos skyong pha rgod sngags lang rje//sdong ston blo gsal 'a zhwa ma' brtse'i dbang //bsod nams chos 'phel dbang phyug rab brtan rje//rdo rje lang dngos mgon po bsod nams dang //bka' drin mnyam med zur chen kun dga'i zhabs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig gnyan po rnams//nye bar dgongs la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/khyad par gnubs ban sangasargyas ye shes kyis//'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag zab chos kyi//gter gyi srung mar bskos shing gnyer gtad pa//ma g.yel mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab//sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid bshig/gsang chen theg pa mchog la log par blta//zab gter bdud kyis byas zhes ya ga sgrog/khyad par phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i skor//bal yul mu stegs ga pa'i chos yin zer//rigs 'dzin bdag la lha med zer nas brnyas//srung ma khyod la mthu med zer nas smod//log par 'dren pa'i dam nyams dgra po la//ma rung ltas ga grangs med char ltar phob//lo zlar ma 'jog srog chod bla tshe bskums/sha rus tshogs su roX9 cig kha raṃ khā hi//thogs med 'phrin las sgrubs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheshig sa ma ya//zhes 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi gter srung mgon po stag zhen gyi mchod gtor 'bul tshul bdud sde phyer 'thag ces pa 'di ni gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i gter srung gi gtso bo zhig tu 'dug pa bar skabs su rgyun chad pa lta bur snang ba las/gter srung gi gral du mchod gtor 'bul pa'i phyag len gyi rgyun tshugs (5na sko legs par mngon zhing /deng sang 'di la rang gzhan gyi cher rlom mang pos rjes gnang gi rgyas 'debs byas pa'i rgyun ma dag pa'i phung po chen po yong 'dug pa rang gzhan bslu ba'i byed por mthong nas yid brtan ma byas kyang /slar sngags rnying ma'i lugs ma nyams ba tsha pa rdo rje lang nas brgyud pa'i skor thob pa la brten nas za hor gyi ban+de zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi rgyun 'byer du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ri tshwa ā tsho rgyu'i ming can no// 92

gtsang rong gter gsar bla ma zhi drag gnyis kyi gter srung mchod pa'i 'phrin las/ nang ma (gegatsang rong gter gsar bla ma zhi drag gnyis kyi gter srung mchod pa'i 'phrin las bzhugs so/ /sku gsum rigs 'dus 'chi med tshe yi lha/ /'phrin las drag po ga me gu ru la/ /gus pas gas nas gang de'i zab chos kyi/ /gter srung mchod pa'i rim pa 'dri bar bya/ /de'ang sku gsum rigs 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / ga me gu ru gnyis kyi gter srung mchod thabs gter ston rin po che'i dus cung zad sba tshul gnang ba rgyun 'byams su song ba'i yi ge sogs kha gsal mi 'dug rung /da rma gu ru bsgrub par 'tshub cha'i rnam pa'ang tho re yong 'dug pa/ rigs 'dzig ngag gi dbang po yan chad du srung ma tshor tshogs dang bcas te mchod pa mdzad pa rjes 'jug rnams kyis ma nges pa'i mchod gtor chad skyon du 'dug pas kham bu lung gi rong btsan kha ba dkar po dang / klu mo lcam mo 'bum bza' gnyis la gtor bsngos bya dgos gsung ba rje bla ma pad+ma dbang gi zhal las thos shing / lhang lhang gi bdud la gtor ma chad na 'tshub yong ba kho bos dngos su grub pas/ bdud btsan klu gsum gyi ma rdzo gtor 'bul bar byed pa la/ bdud la bdud bshos nag po zlum po rtse mo cung zad bkug pa/rong btsan la bsgos zur gsum dmar po/ klu la (2na〉ku gtor dkar po sbrul gyis 'khyud pa/gsum ga la mtheb skyus bskor ba mchod pa sogs bshams te byin gyis rlob pa ni/ thugs lasalos pa'i raṃ waṃ khaṃ gsum gyis/ mchod gtor rnams kyi ma dag bsregs gtor bkrus/ /a dang oṃ las bhan+ta rin wo snod/ sha khrag dang ni bdud rtsi klu sman gyur/ /ā+oṃ sa// spyan 'dren pa ni/ lhang lhang mtshams phug gnas dang kham bu lung / /gnas chos srung bar skyon chen po yi/ /spyan sngar khasablangs bdud btsan klu gsum po/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /ru tra dung shu la tsan ga phuḥs pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ khrag gi arnya dbang po'i me rtag dang / sha —293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shechen dud pa tshul chen snang gsal 'bar/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas spungs/ /rkang gling thod rnga sil snyan rol mo'i tshogs/ /btsan rta dmar po bdud kyi rta nag po/ /sga srab chas mdzes go mtshon dar nag gos/ /sman raka gtor ma phyi nang tsho gis mchode kyis/ /stobs ldan bdud btsan gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang / /rtsi sman dri ldan mchod yon me rtag bkra/ /tsan (2brkon dzā ti spos dkar dud sprin 'khrigs/ khel sogs snang gsal klu sman dri chab dang / /ro brgya'i zhal zas snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'khrol/ /dar zab rin chen skyed tshal nags sman ljongs/ /chu klung mtsho dang rus sbal rgyan gyis mdzes/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i tsho gos gtore gyis/ /klu chen lcam mo 'bum bza'i thugs dam bskang / /ā+oṃ ru dra du rā tsa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba li ta kha raṃ khā hi/ lan gsum dang /gong gi sngags gsham du/ ma hā pañtsa dang rak+ta 'ang sbyar te 'bul/ /btsan la/ ā+oṃ shu la tsa rā tsa sogasakyis sman raka gtor gsum dang / klu la nā ga phuḥrā tsa sa gtore ma 'bul/ mthing nag mi bsrun bdud kyi gtso/ /dar nag ba dan zhags pa 'dzin/ /mthing nag gos gyon rta nag bcibs/ /bstod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /srog gi gshed po btsan rgod che/ /mdung dmar zhags 'dzin rta dmar zhen/ /bse khrab brtse rmog gyon zhing rngams/ /bstod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /klu mo dkar sngo rus sbal bcibs/ /dar gyi na bza' mdzes par gsol/ /rin chen nor bu bum ba 'dzin/ /bstod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ gtsang rong gter gsar bla ma zhi drag gnyis kyi gter srung mchod pa'i 'phrin las 'di ni/ zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las kyi gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi sngags spyon zil gnon drag rtsal gyis dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar/ /sarba maṅga lo/—294

sprul pa'i chos rgyal ོ po'i mdos kyi gyer gzhung bsam don lhun grub/ nang ma (pesprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po'i mdos kyi gyer gzhung bsam don lhun grub bzhugs/hūṃ/gdod nas dag pa ka dag chos kyi sku//lhun grub zhi khro'i zlos gar longs spyod rdzogs//thugs rje sprul pa'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung //sku gsum dbyer med dngos grub stsal du gsol//bskal ba dang por bdud dang klu yi sras//mas stobs dbang phyug dge bsnyen chen por grags//bar gyi bskal bar bha ta hor yul du//sgom gra'i dkor srung rgyas po pe ha ra//tha ma'i dus su bod yul gangs can 'dir//chos 'khor ma lus skyong ba'i srung ma che//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen bo 'khor bcas la//dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i mchod pa ni//rin cen shel dkar be+eḍūrla sngon po//pad+ma rā ga gser las grub pa yi//ri rab lhun po bang rim bzhi yi steng //pho brang sku mkhar gyophub lcog gis mdzes/khor yug sra brtan lcags ris yongs su bskor//nang du lha dang mi yi 'dod yon ni//phun tshogs ngo mtshar rgya mtsho so yongs gang ba//sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas rten du 'bul//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel//sngags 'chang bdag gis bco thaba'i don rnamasakun//na 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//steng na 'ja' tshon ltar ba po gdugasadang tog/sgro phod yungs kar gang bzang dag gis mtshan//dar gyi 'phan dang cod pan lhab lhub g.yo//nam mkha' rgyang bu spel mar tshar du dngar//chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang rol mo'i lis//'dod yon sna lnga sra brtan rdo rje'i go/rno ba'i mar cha zhwa phod sag theb dang //rin la rusargyan pags pa'i rgyal mtshan tshogs//sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas rten du 'bul//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel//sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i don rnams kun//'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//rta lug bya khyi byi ba ra dkar dang //spre'u seng ge stag gzig dom dred 9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonagung //'dab chags sna tsho gos glang chen rta g.yag drel//phun tsho gis 'dod yon khur ba'i khal ma dang //smyug rgod rtse rgyal bya dkar gsob kyi nang //rin byu ga'ur gsang ba'i srog 'bor dang //stag gzig ras ma snam ras dkar dmar sngo/kha dog lnga ldan rnga ma'i chun po rnams//sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor 2ba〉los rten du 'bul//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel//sngags yong bdag gis bcol ba'i don rnams kun//yod med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//phran tsho gis ro brgya'i dpal ldan ga sto ma dang //sdebargyad bsgos bu thi dar sman sna sha/pho gdong mo gdong shing gri yul mkhar ris//phung khams skye mched tshang ba'i ngar glud mdzes//bdud rtsi'i gser skyems tsho ba'i sha tshil gsur/sha wo spos dkar dud pa mda' dar lnga//ba po shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin cen bdun//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dam pa 'di//sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas rten du 'bul//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel//sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i don rnamasatso//yod med lhun gyis grub pa'i wen las mdzod//chos skyong rgyal po sde lnga 'khor yosarnams//rten las g.yo dam las ma 'da' bar//sangs rgyas bstan dang dge 'dun sde rnamasaskyongs//rdo rje'i slob dpon sku tshe wen las spel//gangs༅ bod kyi yul 'dir mi phyugs nad//'thab rtsod mu ge nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing //lugs gnyis khrims kyis 'gro ba ma lus pa//bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la spyod par mdzod/khyad par rigs 'dzin bdag gi nad gdon bgegs//zhi zhing tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas/khams gsum dbang sdus brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams//myur du snying khrag dron mo zhal du gsol//mdor na rgyal dbang pad+ma to ral spyos//rgod ldem legs ldan rje dang dbang po'i sde/khyab bdag bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs mdzod//ces mdos rgyun 'byer 3na ) tshul du 'byer bde ba 'di ni gnas chung lcog tu rten mdos gsar du btsugs skabs/chos skyong chen pos 'di lta bu bgyis zhes bkas bskul ba ltar/za hor gyi bzhes bgyis yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag daX 'phrin las so//

byes mas ge tu'i las byang sha bsgrogs dgra srog gcod pa'i spu gri/ nang ma 9)byes chas ke tu'i las byang ngag bsgrigs dgra srog gcod pa'i spu gri bzhugs/rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje//gcig bsdus rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnasadang //dbyer med drin can bla ma'i zhabs ga.o nas//byes chas ke tu'i ngag 'don khrigs su sdeb//byes chas ke tu sgrub par byed pa la mar gtor dam rdzas 'khor lo sogs gter g.yi dang man ngag ltar mngon par 'du byas nas rol mo da yos dang yos pas 'di skad do//chos kun mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las//mdun du rin wo sna tshogs las grub pa'i//sku mkhar rgya phubasalcags ri lcog gis mdzes//nang du thod pa skam rlon rab brtsegs par//sna tsho gos rus pa'i gdung ma dral lcam la/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yis thog zhal byas//mi mgo'i tog dang zhing lngags rgyal mtshan 'phyar//nang khrol rgyu ma dug sprul dra phyed 'phyang /sha rus spungs shing khrag gi zhim chu 'bab//bzod dka' 'gas rung gzhal yas khang gi dbus//rin wo rus pa baṃ ro gsar rnying rnams//phan tso bsnol zhing brtsigs pa'i khri steng du//bstan srung sprul pa'i chos rgyal byes mas ni//rnam ba zhi khro'i nyams ldan cung zad 'dzum//2na ldan du dgra la khro zhing gtum rngams can//zhal gcig phyag gnyis cha lugs rab byung tshul//g.yas pa shel phreng g.yon pa rtse gsum 'dzin//dbu la brtse zhu zhabs la sag lham gsol//zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis rab bzhengs pa'i//gar dgu'i nyams kyis rnam par rol ba la//gsang ba'i yum r+ṣa 'jigs rung blon po dang //dge slong 'bar gsil sngags nag phur bu thogs//bdud mo nag mo stag shar go mar can//na chung mon mo sman btsun a tsa ra//spre'u 'bag seng gar 'chams la sogs pa//snang srid dregs pa sdebargyad dmag tshogs dang //'khol po yang 'khol bran g.yog ༷ngag gzhug bcas//sa dang bar snang gang bas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bskor bar gyur//rang nyid lhar gsal spyi gtsug gdan steng du//rigs 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//zha khra'i nyams ldan dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor//lha srin dbang du sdud pa'i rnam 'gyur can//bdag nyid yi dam thugs ga'i sa bon las//'od 'phros bsam yas gtsug lag khang chen dang //dgung sngon mthon po la sogs gnas bsgoms nas//tshur spyon dam tshig pa dang gnyis med gyur//ma hā rā dza badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsam ya ti nga lhan/mchod 'bul ni/ma hā rā dza a nasashasta'i bar gyis mchode/ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a khra ta kha raṃ khā hi/ma hā rak+ta/ma hā bha li ta/bshags pa ni/bla ma yi dam bstan srung dgongs su gsol//bdag cag ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te//gsang sngags spyi yi dam tshig nyams pa dang /khyad par sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yi//sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa//snying nas bshags so 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//gsol zhing bskang ba ni/chos rgyal 'khor bcas spyan lam du/khrag gi a mtsho ltar bskyil//dbang po'i me tog 'ja' ltar bkrag chen dud pa sprin ltar 'thul//zhun chen mar me nyi ltar gsal//zhag gi dri chab rba rlabs zhabrug sha rus zhal zas ri ltar sbungs//snyan brjid rol mo chemasasechem//gar 'chams zlos gar shigs se shig/snyan pa'i glu len kyur ru mā/cang shes rta mchog 'dur zhing rgyug/'brong g.yag stobs ldan ngar zhing 'phyo/zhal dkar lug ni dal bur rgyu//'dab chags sna tsho gis mkha' la lding /khyi dang ce spyang mang po 'dur/stag seng glang po sna tsho gos 'gying//rdo rje'i go cha 'od du 'tsher//rno ngar mtshon cha mkha' la zing //zhwa nag phod ka rus rgyan dang //snam sbyar 'bar gsil bslang ba'i snod//'phyi ba'i sha dang don snod lnga/khrag dang rus pa pags pa'i tshogs//sman raka gtor ma gser skyems sogs//chos rgyal byes chas ke tu'i dang //gsang yum blon po 'khor 3na yo sa rnams//dgyes pa bskyed phyir gsol zhing mchod//thugs dam skongs la las kun sgrubs//rgyas par byed na gter gzhung gi gsol mchod rnams kyang skabs 'dir bya'o//bstod pa ni/sna tshogs ma nges sku yi rnam 'gyur //8/grangs med 'phrin las bsgrub phyir ston mdzad

byes mas ge tu'i las byang ngag bsgrigs dgra srog gcod pa'i spu gri/ nang ma (pepa'i/ /rigs 'dzin yongs kyi dgra lha mthu rtsal can/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen por bdag bstod do/ /snyan brjid drag sogs gsung gis sa gsum 'geng / /rab gsal thugs kyis dus kun gsal bar gzigs/ /dpag bsam shing ltar 'dod pa'i re ba skong / /thub bstan yongs kyi srung mar bdag bstod do/ /rnal 'byor drod myul dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod/ /'phrin las kun bsgrub rgyal po pe ha ra/ /dgyes dgur spyod pa'i yum dang blon po sogs/ /bka' sdod dregs pa'i tsho gos la bdag bstod do/ /bsnyen pa ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal spyi bor rigs kyi bdag /pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal btab rang nyid kyi/ /thugs las 'od los mdun gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ /dkar ser dmar nag mdangasaldan rgyal po'i tshogs/ /spros te nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dpal rgyas/ khams gsum dbang bsdus gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral/ /rgyal po rang gi dbang du 'dus nas ni/ /'phrin las gang bcol thogasamed bsgrub par gyur/ /ā+oṃ rā dza du na ling swā hā/ de nas zhag gsum gyi ring 'di ltar bya'o/ /e ma mi bzad btson khang 'bar ba'i gru gsum nang / /tri las sgrub pa byed pa'i sgab 'dre ni/ /gnod sbyin bre do bya mgo mi gzugs can/ /yan lag lcags sgrog bsdams(3ba)pa gan rkyal gyur/ /rang gi thugasanas sprul pa dpag med spros/ /lcags kyus bzung la zhags bsdams lcags sgrog bcings/ /dril bus myos te skad cig tsam nyid la/ /gnod byed bkug ste byang bu'i gzugs su bstim/ /ā+oṃ a tri dun tri mā ra ya khug /sgrub ba la bar gcod byed pa'i gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya nan nan/ /sku bha ya nan/ dza dza nan/ sngags bzla thun brdeg mjug tu mnan pa bya'o/ /bsgrub pa'i 'dzab bzla ba ni/ rang nyid pad sdong nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng khro chags zhi ba'i nyams/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa thod pa 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi gru mo'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yis mtshan/ /paṇa zhu chos gos dar nag gsang gos dang / /zab chen ber gsol gsal stong bde ba'i nyams/ /thugs ni chu shing 'bras bu 'dra ba de/ /rnam pa pad stong 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus/ /ye shes sems dpa' pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /rang 'dra mthe bong tsam du gsal ba yi/ /thugs ga'i sa bon dag las 'od zer 'phros/ /mdun gyi rgyal po 299—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)'khor bcas thugs rgyud bskul//lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu dang //rno ba'i mtshon cha nad kyi rkyal pa sogs//grangs med thogs pa'i gtso 'khor dpag med spros//dgra bo'i bla tshe 'gugs dang gsod pa dang //nad gdon bar ho wo 'tshe char ltar gtong //rgya gar mon pa spra dang spre'u sogs//than bya la sogs ltas ga chu ltar rgyug/mdor na dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul bzhin du//brlag pa'i wen las ma lus mdzad par gyur//ā+oṃ rā dza dun ling /shan+ti nan bod/kus thob/'ur rdo 'phongs/rdo sa phob/4na'ang yig stong 'bor gyis/i a li la'i sgra thong /nga'i nor stogs/zhes man ngag ltar bzlas pa bya'o//bskul zhing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/sprul pa'i chosargyal 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//slob dpon pad+ma gnubs ban nas brgyud de//gnam lcags me 'bar chos rgyal phun tsho gos rje//bkra shis stobs rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i dpal//rtsa ba'i bla ma pad+ma badz+ra sogs//dngos brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag/bstan pa srid sder bcas pa mtha' dag gi/nad gdon bar chad nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang //tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor kun rgyas shing //mi nor zas gsum ma lus dbang du sdus/khyad par snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra sems//de dgra gnod byed dug mtshon mas gter dang //dmag sogs sbyor ba gshom pa'i dgra bgegs kun//steng 'og phyogs su mtshams gang na gnas kyang rung //bla srog tshe gsum myur du zhal du thob//snying khrag las la bdun brgyud rtsad nas rdzo//rjesamed thal ba rma la bskur byas nas//mdzo spyod drag po'i phren las sgrub par mdzod//de nasabasgral pa ni/eḥmadun du lcags bsregs 'bar ba'i sa gzhi'i nang //btson khang gru gsum bang rim dgu pa can//me 'bar rlung 'khrug mun nag ches cher gtibs//gsod gcod sgra sgrog dug nad rlangs pa 'thul//thar med las kyi 'brub khung nag po'i dbus//: las dmigs bya'i dam nyamasadagra bo gang //nyam chung bu ga dgu nas snag khrag 'dzag/gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can//4ba〉na lag lcags sgrog gis ba//sa gan rgyal gyur//rtsab gsum gyi byin rlabs

bye mas ke khu'i la byang pag bsgrig dgra sgog gcod pa'i skru gri/ nang ma 9)nus mas dang / /bstan srung sprul pa'i rgyal po pe ha ra/ /gsang yum blon po 'khol po yang 'khol sogs/ / dregs pa sdebargyad dmag tsho gis nus mas yis/ /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba spyi yi dgra /rnal 'byor bdag la bsdob sgos kyi dgra /bla ma'i sku dgra zhing bcu tshang ba dang / /gzugasabyang ming nas btab pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /srid rtse mnar med bar du gar 'dug kyang / /lcags kyusakhug la zhags pas ske nas chings/ /lcags sgrog gis sdoms dril bus myos byas nas/ /liṅga 'di la da lta nyid du khug /bla 'gugs dang lha dbye'i sngags bzla/ pe har khros pa sku stod srin po'i gzugs/ /sku smad gnam lcags phur bu snying ga la/ /btab bas srog bcad rnam shes thugs kar bsdus/ sha khrag rus phung ma lus dum bur gyur/ /zhes bsad sngags bzla zhing bsgral/ /pe har 'khor bcasaganam sa lta bu'i zhal/ /gdong me la dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag bzhes/ /dmigs bya'i dgra bo bdun brgyud tshun chad kyi/ / bla tshe srog gsum zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ /zhes bstab pa bya'o/ /sgo dbye ni/ phyogs bzhi skyong ba'i rgyal chen sdebazhi dang / /sgo skas lam 'phrang bsrung ba'i lha 'dre dang / /steng 'og bar gsum dag tu gnas pa yi/ /gdug pa'i tsho gos rnams sngagasang bdag la nyon/ /deng 'dir drag po'i zor kha sgyur byed na/ /sgo bas sgo phye 'phrang pas wong rnams sol/ /mthu dang nus pas zor gyi dpung pa skyed/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i wen las sgrub par mdzod/gzu dpung ni/ rtsa gsum chos srung sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /ma (na gi yel ma g.yel rnal 'byor bdag la dgongs/ /'khor bar nges khrung snying nas dam chos bsgrubs/ /rdo rje slob dpon spyi bo'i rgyan ltar bsten/ /dam tshig sdom pa mig gi gos ltar bsrungs/ /gsang sngags zab don snying ltar 'bral med bsten/ /chos bzhin spyod la sdang ba'i dgra byung na/ /ra mda' mdzod cig mngon shes spyan ldan tsho/ khyad par yi dam bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin/ /mthu ldan sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po khyod/ /na gzhen so dkar tsam nas legs bsnyen nas/ /da lta skra dkar tsam du khyod bsgrubs so/ /sgrub khang gos ltar gyon nas khyod bsgrubs so/ /dka' ba khyad du bsad nas khyod bsgrubs so/ /—301—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bdag la snang ba'i dgra bgegs mi sgrol na//chos skyong bsten pa'i dgos pa nongs min nam//bstan 'gro'i spyi dgra bla ma'i sku yi dgra//rigs 'dzin sgos su bsdoba'i sdig can 'di//zhing bcu tshang bar dgongs shig spyan ldan rnams//snying khrag thang la 'pho zhig bshan pa'i tshogs/gser skyems ni//'bru bas bdud rtsi gser dang legs sbyar ba//rang rang 'dod pa'i dngos por byin brlabs 'di//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul//deng 'dir 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig/'bral med bsten pa'i chos srung tsho gos spyi dang /khyad par sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po ni//'khor bcas gser skye mas mchode pa 'di bzhes la//mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin lasamyur du sgrubs//dpal ldan srid gsum rnam rgyal rā hu la//lo zla zhag dang dus tshod la dbang ba'i//gza' dang rgyu skar sa bdag lha srin tshogs//gser skyems 'di bzhes mthun pa'i 5ba〉nyun las sgrubs/zor bskul ni/skyes bu dpa' btsan go rgyan mtshon thogs pa'i//gnam lcags thog ltar 'phen pa'i mda' zor 'di//dmigs bya'i dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du 'phen//mi nor phyugasagasum tshe srog mā ra ya//mig sman mdangs kyi phod ka zhwa nag rgyan//'jigs rung sngags nag tshogasakyi phur thor 'di//rigs 'gre/rnam pa zhi zhing ngo bo mi bsrun pa'i//'khar gsil lhung bzed chosagos rdul zor 'di////srin mo'i gzugs can bdud mo nag mo yi//gos nag g.yab cing brdab pa'i zor kha 'di// //ri rab gtor ma dug dang mtshon cha yi//rang bzhin gnam lcags las grub gtor zor 'di////zhes zor rnams rim pas 'phang //rang gi thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo dang //bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar zhing rlung nag 'tshub//chu bo rba rlabs zhabrug cing rdo rje yi//sra brtan srang ba'i gur khang chen por gyur//me chu'i rgyas 'debs/de nas sgo drung du gtor gzheng kha sbub/bro ni/bcom ldan dpal chen khros pa'i bro brdungs pas//snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs kyang 'dar bar byed//bdud dang dam sri'i tshogs kun rdul du rlog shar du zhi ba lho ru rgyas pa dang /khub tu dbang dang byang du drag po'i bro/khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogaX kyi brdungs pa las//mi bzad khro mo rnams kyis

bye mas ke tu'i la byang ngag bsgrigs dgra srog gcod pa'i sbu gri/ nang ma 6)rgyas btab bas/ /dgra 'dre byur gsum bskal bar ma ldang zhig /ā+oṃ lo hūṃ lo/ ste bha ya nan/ mnga' gsol ni/ mchog gsum ngo bo rigs 'dzin bla ma dang / /dngos grub gter gyur sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha/ /'phrin las lhun grub chos skyong srung ma la/ /dge legs kun (6na yo) rtsa bar mnga' gsol lo/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i gshis su g.yo med kyang / /ma rung 'dul phyir mi bsrun bshan pa che/ /dpal ldan sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas rnams/ /bstan srung dgra lha'i gtso bor mnga' gsol lo/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus tshes skong zhing / /bar chad mi mthun g.yul las rnam rgyal pa'i/ /bsam don lhun gyir grub par mnga' gsol lo/ mas brjod ni/ chos srung mthu rtsal bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nad gdon bar chad ma lusakun zhi zhing / /tshe dpal longs spyod chos kyi dga' ston sogs/ /sa steng chen por khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal po byes mas ge tu'i ngag 'don gter gzhung gi zur 'debs khrigs su bsdebs pa dgra srog gcod pa'i spu gri zhes bya ba 'di'ang gter ston gru gu yang wang gi gdung las son pa'i sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis kyis bskul pa'i ngor za hor gyi sngags btsun ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal lo// //sarba maṅga lo/—303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheganod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi mdos chog dbang drag grub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma pad+ma thod 'phreng dang / /dbang chen rta mchog la brtsad nas/ /gnod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi/ /mdos kyi 'phrin las rim pa 'dri/ /de yang byin gyis brlabs la rim pa bzhi yod pa'i g.yin gsum ma mo dang dmigs gsal gyi bsgyur kha ma ga rta gos 'dra la/ rten bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rten mdos ri rab kyi steng gzhal yas khang gi nang btsan yul zangs thang dmar po zangs brag gnam kha bsnyeg go /rtse la rgod smug lding ba/ logs la btsan skya rgyu ba/ rked na gcan gzan ngur ba/ rtsa bar dug chu khol ba/ brag ri dmar po'i nang du khrag mtsho khol zhing bse mkhar smug po zangs kyi sgo lcags can btsan mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus na tri bdun yongs su gyur pa las lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po tse dmar ba sku mdog dmar ljang ral pa dmar po me 'od 'khrigs pa/ spyan nas me'i skar mda' gzug pa/ zhal nas khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa mche ba rnon po gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ khro zhing (2na〉〈pe gsal rngam zhing gtum pa/ /sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can gsol bar rin cen gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ dbu la dar dmar gyi 'gying thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ bse phub dmar po rgyab tu 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas btsan gyi zhags pa dmar posadagra bo sku'i zhing / g.yon bse mdung dmar po dar dmar gyi ru mar can snying la bsnun pa/ rta bra bo sgab nag /dar gdan dmar po sga khra bo/ dngul gyi yob thag /zangs kyi yob chen gser gyi srab/g.yu'i mthur mda'/ dar dmar gyi srab skyogs/ sbrul nag gi gong rmed byas pa la bcibs nas stong gsum bskor ba/ sku la zhal gyi lha btsan sku mdog dkar ser khro gtum can sku la za 'og dmar khra'i —304

gnod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi mdo chog dbang drag grub pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma (pegos dang dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ g.yas su stag dong dang g.yon gzig shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis gser mda' gser gzhu re bkang ste dgra bo'i snying la brdeg pa/ smug po sha gdong sga srab can la bcibs pa/ gro shod bod kyi sgang dmag rje sku mdog dmar po me 'od 'bar ba rngam zhing (2ba)'jigs pa sku la le brgan gyi 'jol ber dang dar dmar gyi thod bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon zangs zhags dmar pos dgra bo bcings te g.yas kyis shang lang brdeg pa/ mtsha' lu rting dkar sga srab can la bcings pa/ ra tsa gos sngon gyi klu btsan sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba/ sku la chu dar sngon po'i ral gu la dug sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ dar sngon gyi thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas lcags mdung nag po dang g.yon dug sbrul gyi zhags pa 'phen pa/ rta ser po sga srab can bcibs pa/ rdo rengs dmar po'i grib btsan sku mdog dmar po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ber dmar gyi slog pa dang dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ stag dong g.yas dang g.yon du gzig shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po dang g.yon btsan gyi rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ rkyang dmar sbo dkar sga srab can la bcibs pa/ kai ka thod nag bdud btsan sku mdog ljang nag shin tu 'jigs pa/sku la dar nag ber chen dang bdud dar nag po thod du bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang g.yon du gzig shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas dar nag gi ru mtshon 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas 'breng zhags bla la 'debs pa/ rag pa gzhud nag sga srab can la bcibs pa/ rtsal thog rgyug gi gri btsan sku mdog khrag ltar dmar ba sku la zangs khrab dmar po dang dbu la dar dmar gyi thod bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang g.yon du gzig shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po me 'od 'phro ba (3na)gsor zhing / g.yon zangs kyi ral gri glog ltar 'khyug pa/ rta mchog rlung gi gzhog pa sga srab can la bcibs pa/ bdun ga'ang ri khyi spyang ki rol du khrid pa/ ri bya pho rog steng du lding ba/ btsan dmag 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskor ba dang bcas bzhugs par mos la/ gsol mchod gzhung bzhin gtong /—305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemados bsngo ba ni/ sngon tshe sangs rgyas 'od srungs bstan pa'i mjug /byang phyogs li yul lcang ra smug bo na/ pha ni rje btsun ma ni ut+pal rgyan/ /sras su ga snyings pa'i 'phyor pa zhes bya bas/ /dge slong tsan+d+ra bha har sdom pa blangs/ /nags tshal khrod gnas mchod sbyin byed pa'i tshe/ /lha lcam de byin dug sbrul 'jigs pa las/ /bskyabs tshe blon pos mthong nas ya ga bsgrags/ rgyal po khros te gsod du chas pa na/ /lha lcam lcebs sogs rgyu mtshan thos pa yis/ /sras des kha ba can gyi phyogs su bros/ /nam zhig dmag gis li sras gri ru bkrongs/ /gdug sems smon lam btab pa'i 'bras bu las/ /btsan rje zla ba thod gar rigs brgyud du/ khrag gi sgo nga skyes pa brdol ba'i nang / /bas rgod gnod sbyin r+pā po tse dmar ba/ /zhe sdang mthu yis mgo las bdud btsan nag /rus las lha btsan drod las brag gi btsan/ khrag las gyib btsan chu ser klu yi btsan/ sha yi ras las gyib btsan drug byung bas/ /btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun zhes grags pas/ /srid gsum tshe srog za zhing 'phung byed tshe/ /dpal chen rta mgrin dbang gis dam btags pa'i/ /lha (3ba tha tsan dgra lha'i rgyal po skrun bdun po/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /chos 'khor gnyan po'i srung mar bka' bsgos pa/ /'dir spyon 'dir spyon rten pa'i mdos la bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /lha khyod dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod rdzas ni/ zhal dang be+eḍūr pad rwag gser sbyangs las/ grub pa'i lhun po bang rim bzhi ldan steng / /pho brang sku mkhar rgya phubs lcog gis mdzes/ /gling bzhi gling phran mtha' na lcags ris bskor/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mun pa sel/ /dpag bsam shing dang 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /ma rmos lo tog rin cen ri bo mtho/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun gyis/ /gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rten mdos 'di la rtag tu brtan bzhugs nas/ /sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro brgya'i zas/ /'jam mnyen gos dang khrag chang mchod yon sbrang / /dbang po'i me tog gsur chen dud sprin 'khrigs/ /zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab 'khyil/ sha rus zhal zas rol —306

wa wa gnod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi mdo chog dbang drag grub pa'i dga' ston/ nang ma (pemo sna tshogs ldir//rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛ ta/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ldan gtor ma'i tshogs//dmar chen rak+ta'i rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo//'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi mchod sprin 'dis//gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rten mdos 'di la rtag tu brtan bzhugs nas//sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs//steng na 'ja' ltar bkrab dar zab gdugs//sgro phod gang bzang phyag mtshan rtag gis mdzes//sna tsho gos dar gyi 'phan dang cod pan g.yo//'jam mnyen 'dab chags 4na ) sgro spus thod bcings ba'i//nam mkha' rgyang bu dbang po'i gzhu ris can//mda' khra 'phang khra grangs tshad bsnol mar bkod//lcags zangs bse yi khrab rmog spa bse'i phub//sna tsho gos rnga ma'i rgyan ldan zhol btags sogs//rang bsrung rdo rje go cha'i tshogs rnams kyis//gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rten mdos 'di la rtag tu brtan bzhugs nas//sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs//dmar nag lcags mdung bse mdung dar lce can//zangs lcags ral gri dgra sta mda' dang mdung //'ching byed rgyu ma 'breng ba dug sprul dang //zhags pa dmar po lcags kyi a long can//dar dmar za 'og dmar khra le brgan las/grub pa'i 'jol ber rtse ber dmar nag dang //ral gu sngon po sngon dmar dar gyi thod//sag lham dmar bo gser gyi ska rags la//rin cen sna tsho gis phra yis rab spras pas//gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rten mdos 'di la rtag tu brten bzhugasanas//sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol pa'i las kun sgrubs//cang shes rta mchog bla bo sgab nag dang /sha gnang smug po mtsha' lu rting dkar can//gser gyi mdog ldan rkyang dmar sbo dkar dang //rag pa gzhung nag rlung gi shugs can la//dar gdan steng du rta sga khra bos mdzes//dngul gyi yob thag zangs kyi yob chen dang //gser srab g.yu zab dar dmar srab skyogs can//dug sprul nag po'i gong rmed rgyan spras nas//stong gsum skad cig myul pa'i bzhon pa 'dis//gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //spyan mdos 'di la rtag tu brten bzhugs nas//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesngags 'chang bdag gis bcol pa'i las kun sgrubs/ /glang chen stag gzig lpags (4ba〉pa zhing chen gos/ /mi mgo skam rlon do shal rin cen rgyan/ /g.yag rgod ra lug khyi 'phyo bya nag lding / /gnam la 'phur dgu sal 'dzul dgu dang / /ri dwags 'phyor dgu rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng / /skyes pa pho dang za ma mo yi glud/ /pho gdong mo gdong shing gri yul mkhar ris/ /sman sna dar zab shing tog ja sna dang / kha rigs bza' bca' sna mang 'bru tshogs kyis/ /gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rten mdos 'di la rtag tu brten bzhugs nas/ /sngags yong bdag gisabacol pa'i las kun sgrubs/ kha dog lnga ldan rnga ma'i chun po dang / /snam ras dkar dmar sngo dang stag gzig ras/ /dzo ke mon pa bud med zlos gar bsgyur/ khyad par rin can las grub ga 'u'i nang / /bla rdo gsang ba srog gi 'khor lo bcas/ /sna tsho gis rin cen du mas legs gtams dang / /dregs pa rang bzhin 'du ba'i rten rdzas sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha' khyen gang bas/ /gnod sbyin mchen bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rten mdos 'di la rtag tu brten bzhugs nas/ /sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol pa'i las kun sgrubs/ /btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun 'khor bcas kyis/ /thub bstan 'phel zhing de 'dzin tshogs rnams brtan/ /'jig rten spyi dang yang sgos bod yul 'dir/ /rgud pa kun zhi bde skyid 'phel bar mdzod/ khyad par rigs 'dzin bdag cas dgon gnas sde/ khyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po bcas pa la/ /snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra yid la sems/ /da dgra tsher ltar rtsub pa sde dpung gi /stobs 'byor mnga' thang tshe dang bsod nams snubs/ /bla tshe dug la srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /mdor na ming dang brda tsam ma lus par/ /thal (ldan tha'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /bdag sogs dpon slob yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang stobs 'byor dang / /lung rtogs yon tan la sogs srid zhi yi/ /legs tshogs ma lus rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na sangs rgyas gnyis pa thod 'phreng rtsal/ /pad+ma dbang rgyal gnam lcags me 'bar —308—

rje/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /bsams pa'i ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /gnod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi mdos chog gi rim pa dbang drag grub pa'i dga' ston zhes pa 'di ni za hor sngags spyon gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedapal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin las yid bzhin gter mdzod bzhugs/gu ru pad+ma sirnyi a dhi byu na a dhi nga te su hā/ gsol ba btab na smos ci dran pas kyang / khrad zhi'i gdung sel pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo sa /yid ches dad pasagatan gyi skyabs su bsten/ /las los skal ldan a jo dpal po yis/ /mchims phu dge ba'i brag nas spyan drangs pa'i/ /mdos kyi 'phrin las gyer gyis yang gha bza'/ /dgyes par byed pa'i tshul 'di med du byung / /de phyir rgyal kun ngo bo rdo rje 'dzin/ /zur chen chos dbyings rang grol bka' drin las/ /rten bskang bzlog mdos rnam dbye khong chud pas/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bzhed srol zhabrul med dgod/ /de yang bod kyi yul bdag chen mo bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi gnod sbyin ma bzhi'i nang tshan dpal ldan yang gha bza' 'am rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal du grags pa dgyes byed mdos kyi rim pa la mgon po g.yul bzlog dang byang gter sogs nas bshad pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi spyi mdos dang sgos mdos sprul pa'i gter ston zur mkhar a jo dpal pos bsam yas mchims phu dge (2na tshe ru gong gi brag nas spyan drangs pa'i skor las mchims phu'i gter nyid gtso bor bzung gter kha gong 'og dang byang gter sogs g.yin dag las nyer mkho rnams lhan thabs su byas te 'god pa la/ dang po rdzas gsog pa ni/ spyir mdos la bka' gter gyi gzhung nas byung ba'i yi ge rnam grangs mang ba dag khong du chud par byas nas rten mdos bskang mdos bzlog mdos sogs las bzhi sgrub lugs kyi kha sgyur spyi mdos sgos su bsngo ba/ sgos mdos spyir bsngo ba/ pho sna mo yisadrang ba/ mo sna pho yis drang ba/ gyer thog nas gsogs dang gsogs thog nas mdos ngos zin pa sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len che phrar blo byang la sgrub pa bka' brgyad spyi bye brag gi dbang nos shing —310

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin las yid bsnyo gter mdzod/ nang ma ()bsnyen pa thengs ba'i sngags 'chang zhig gis lag tu bstar dgos pa'i phyir zhib pa g.yin nas rtogasapa'i dbang du byas te 'di ga'i sgos chos gter gzhung las byung ba ltar 'bru'i ngar phye'am sa bzang bo la rin po che brdar ba bsres par jo mo'i sku 'bag dang / bud med nag mo rta la zhen pa/ g.yu bya phug ron/ khu byug sngon po/ gang mo gro mo/ (2bsko ba yu mo/ rta dkar po/ lug gro mo/ ra rgya mo/ btsan bshos/ sman le/ ngar glud bcu gsum/ nam mkha'/ rgyang bu/ mda'/ 'phang / de dag ni rab brgyad/'bring bdun/ tha ma lnga/ gzhan yang za 'ug /dar sna lnga/ sngag rgod/ g.yag rnga dkar po/ nas gro sran ma'i bca' yos/ zhal zas dang spyan gzigs sna tshogs pa dang dngos su mi gsal ba'i rdzas rnamasakyang 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsham pa ni gong gtor bdag bskyed kyi phyi nang gsang mchod rnams dang /gcan gzan sogs g.yang gzhi gang yang rung ba'i steng du ri rab kyi rtser sku gzugs bca' ba gter kha so sor rnam 'gyur mi mthun pa mang du yod pas gang byas kyang don la mi 'gal mod 'dir mchims phu'i gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar 'og nas khrung ba'i mngon rtogs bzhin dang / bang rim rnams la gtor ma sogs lho rdzas byang rdzas kyi mthun rdzas/ khri la spyan gzigs kyi shing byang /nam rgyang / mda' 'phang / rtsed/ steng du gdugs sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bkod pasamadzes par bsham mo/ /gsum pa mdos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phye phud/ mda' dar/ gser skyemasadang bcas pa sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab nas mgron rnam bzhi la phud kyis bskang /bka' brgyad spyi dang bye brag gang rung gi 'phrin las kyis gzhung bsrang ba tsho gos tha ma yan gyer/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi skur bsgyur ba ni/ pad nyi ru dra pho mo'i gdan steng (3na)du/ gter kha 'og ma'i dgong don bsdus pa gsar rtsom/ rang nyid khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin che/ /rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar/ /phyag drug rdo rje thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin/ /bar pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis zhing dbyug 'phyar zhing ri rab 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dur khrod mas kyisabargyan/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes brjod/ mdos shes pa rnam pa bzhi —311 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelas dang po ri rab gzhal yas khang du shes pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ chos rnams mi dmigs stong gsar rtsom/ pa nyid kyi ngang / /mkha' rlung chu sa 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor steng / /ri rab rin cen bzhi las legs grub pa/ /bang rim gsum steng rin cen gzhal yas khang / /g.yas g.yon mdun gsum lcog kun rgyan gyis spras/ /phyi rol med du gser ri rol mtsho bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran lcags ri mu khyud kyis/ /yongs bskor 'dod yon tsho gos kyis gang bar gyur/ /gnyis pa dregs pa'i las mkhan pho nya las byed du shes pa ni/ dbus phyogs gsar rtsom/ rin cen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su/ /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /sku mdog rab dkar mdzes shing brjid pa la/ /yid tsam khro nyamasaldan pa lha mo'i gzugs/ /gnag snum dbu skra thor tshugs dar gyis bcings/ /lhag ma'i zar bu thur du sil bur 'phyang / /phyag g.yas 'phrul gyi me long zhags pa dang / /g.yon pa lcags kyu dar snasabargyan pa 'dzin/ /rgya dar smug po tshig gu'i ri mo yis/ /(3ba〉ya mdzes tse ber steng na dar dkar las/ /legs grub go zu lhab lhub tshul du brtsegs/ /gser sbyangs rang bzhin brog zhu mgul rgyan dang / /phyag zhabs gdu bu do shal se mo do/ /ska rags rgyan cha g.yu dang mu tig sogs/ /rnam mang rin cen mdzes pa'i phra yis spud/ /snyan cha g.yu yi go ra dngul phra can/ /zhabs la sag ri'i mo lham sne ring gsol/ /dung sha dkar po mdzes pa'i rwa bcu ldan/ /dung gi sga srab g.yu yi mthur rmed can/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i steng na dal 'gros su/ khyu ba'i tshul steng skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs/ /g.yas kyi khang bzang nang du sku'i pho nya/ sku mdog rab dkar lha mo dung gha bza'/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyi bya khra dgra la 'gyed/ /g.yon pa zor bas dam nyams dgra srog gcod/ sha ba yu mo sga srab can la bcibs/ /g.yon gyi khang bzang gsung gi pho nya mo/ /mdog dmar ma mo'i gzugs 'dzin mam gha bza'/ /re lde gyon cing sre long phreng ba g.yas/ /g.yon pa dar mdung dgra bo'i snying la 'debs/ / drel rta sga srab rgyan 'gyas spras la bcibs/ /mdun gyi khang bzang thugs kyi pho nya mo/ /sku mdog sngon mo shel bzang sman gcig ma/ /phyag gnyis dngul gzheng zas bkang dar sna 'dzin/ khyu ru dung gi khyad par rgyan gyis —312

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin las yid bzhin gter mdzod/ nang ma ()spras/ /rdo rje'i rwa gdengs 'brong g.yag zhol chen bcibs/ /gsum ga dar gyi na bza' rin cen rgyan/ /ma mo gnod sbyin rigs gyur bka' nyan dang / /las byed pho nya'i 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ /gsum (4na)pa mthun rdzas ya stags glud skongs su shes pa ni/ /raṃ las me gsar bsgrigs/yis dngos po'i skyon rnams bsregs/ /waṃ las rlung gis dngos po'i skyon rnams sbyangs/ kho las chu yis dngos po'i skyon rnams bkrus/ /ā+oṃ gyis 'dod pa'i longs spyod lnga dang ldan/ /mi yis sa gzhi bar snang yongs khyab nas/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod spel/ /hūṃ gis med byung bdud rtsi chen por gyur/ /swā yis gzugs brnyan thams cad dpe byad dang / /phung po khams dang skye mched ma lusaldan/ /hā yis yang gha bza' ni 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang gnyis med byin rlobasakyis/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i nus ldan gyur/ /ā+oṃ lha3 tri waṃ paṃ tre rat+na tri lo kya phaṭa/ bzhi pa mthun rdzas dug mtshon du shes pa ni/ sna tshogs mtshon phur rtsong gsar phags/ sogs drag po'i rdzas/ /gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i thog lta bur/ gyur nas dgra bgegs ma lus rtsad gcod cing / /thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i nus ldan gyur/ /sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis kyang byin gyis brlab po/bzhi pa spyan drang ba ni/ shing sna/ spos dkar/ tshil chen gyi dud pa sogs btang / thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i tshul du 'phros pas dpon g.yog bzhi mngon rtogs dang bskul nas 'byung ba ltar sil sgra dang bcas byon pa bsams la/ rol mo dbyangs dang g.yab dar bcas te/ bh+yo/ rma ri rab stims rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ chog dang gi ga kho ma/(4ba thar ljang gyon nas phyag na tsit+ta bsnams/ /mi dred nag mo zhen nas dam nyams 'gugs/ /glo bur sems kyi ye 'byog zhi ba'i phyir/ /byang gi rma chen bong nas gshegs su gsol/ /rma ri rab 'byams tog kho zur sa zad yos pa/rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /sku mdog dkar gsal rin cen dar zab mdzes/ /be con dang ni rin cen gzhed pa bsnams/ /'bar ba bcibs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ dkar mo gas rtsom/ gser g.yu'i thod gdengasasmug nag gos/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs lcags kyi thod bcings mdzes/ /rwa dgu'i 'byong bcibs sman —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mo stong gis bskor//dbu ru snye mtshams gnas nas gshegs su gsol//dkar gsal zhi ma khro nyams gnod sbyin mo//dar gos rin cen rgyan spras me long zhags//lcags kyu dar snas legs spud rwa bcu pa'i//dung sha bcibs nas gnas 'di gshegs su gsol//las sgrub dung gha bza' dang mam gha bza'/khrel bza' sman gcig sku gsung thugs kyi sprul//'khor tshogs dang bcas dbyar gyi char sprin ltar//dgun gyi 'thor rma bzhi du gshegs su gsol//ho/dmar mo khro gnyer ga kho kha 'og ma nas mnga' ris pa na dze+e si po ches tshwa g.yo las zur sa da skur ba/can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin mo//sngon tshe a su ra yi brag phug dben gnas su//slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //bshes gnyen rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yis//zhing chen bsnyel pa'i steng du bzhag nas kyang //rdo rje lag gtad bdud rtsi lce la (na tha zhag/de tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar//tshur spyon tshur spyon yang gha bza' 'khor bcas//kun kyang lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas//rol mo sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas//bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas te spyon//'dir gshegs dam skongs 'phrin las grub par mdzod//hūṃ/sngon tshe dur khrod chen nyang gter/po bsil ba'i tshal//ye shes mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyi//spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i//bstan skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol//sngon tshe bal po kha la rong dgu sa/slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi//spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i//bod skyong rma ri rab 'byamasaganas 'dir gshegs//rang rang sdebargyad du ma'i 'khor bcas rnams//dam can rnal 'byor sgrub po 'khor bcas la//thugs ni brtse bas rjes su nyer dgongs la//spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnasa'adir gshegs su gsol//lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas yang gha bza' sam ya dzaḥdza ༷dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma sam ya dzaḥdzaḥgong gsum sman gcig sam ya dzaḥdzaḥlnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ā+oṃ/rang gi mdun du grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbus/thams cad mkhyen pa dge snyun rgya mtshom mdzad pa//ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i gzhal yas su//dar zab kyi/ g.yogs rin cen gdan khri la//bstan pa skyong

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi tshon las yid bsto gter mdzod/ nang ma 9)mdzad gangs ri'i dbang po (5ba lnga zhin/ /rab mdzes phyag g.yas me long zhags pa dang / /g.yon pa 'gugs byed lcags kyu dar snas brgyan/ sha ba la bcibs brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyod kyi sku yi pho nya dud gha bza'/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyi bya khra dgra la 'gyed/ /g.yon pa zor bas dam nyams dgra srog gcod/ /yu mo la bcibs g.yas su bzhugs su gsol/ /gsung gi pho nya mam gha bza' zhes ma/ /re lde gyon zhing sre long 'phreng ba g.yas/ /g.yon pa dar mdung dgra bo'i snying la 'debs/ /drel rta la bcibs g.yon du bzhugs su gsol/ /thugs kyi pho nya shel bzang sman gcig ma/ /phyag g.yas dngul gzhed zas kyis bkang ba bsnams/ /g.yon pa dar gyi lhab lhub g.yo byed ma/ /'brong g.yag la bcibs mdun du bzhugs su gsol/ /g.yin yang mched mo bstan ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /sman mo bdud dang btsan dmag 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /gnas 'dir bshad sgrub bstan pa spel ba dang / /rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs/ /sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūṃ/ nga ni che mchog he ru ga kho kha'og ma/gaḥ/ sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor pa'i/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /de bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /ming sring bzhin du dam bsres pa'i/ /dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /rdo rje dri chu bdud rtsi mchog /pañtsa a khra ta sbyar te/ /bstan skyong rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /(6na) sku gsung thugs sprul g.yog 'khor la/khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis/ /lce la bdud rtsi bzhag nas ni/ /sngon tshe ji ltar mna' bor bzhi/ /nga yang dam las mi 'da'o/ khyed rnams dam las ma 'da' zhig /gal te dam las khyod 'das na/ khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis/ /snying khrag bzhes te 'thung par byed/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /badz+ra ya ka hūṃ hūṃ/ drug pa mchod pa 'bul zhing thugs dam bskang ba ni//thabs dang shes rab rten kha lo kha/gnyis med pa'i/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /ra sa ya na la sogs pa'i/ /bcom ldan che mchog yab yum la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /—315

rgyal dbang lnga pa sha das blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (2shem hā pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khul la 'bum gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /rma ri rab 'byams zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ /rten du btsugs na rang dbang med par 'du/ /srid pa chags pa'i ma mo'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mgo 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /bh+yo/ bstan skyong rma ri rab 'byams la/ /phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul/ /dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul/ /snang gsal mar me spyan la 'bul/ /dam (6badzes gtor ma ljags la 'bul/ /thod rnga gling bu snyan la 'bul/ /mi lpags g.yang gzhi sku la 'bul/ sha chen spos kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /zhun chen mar me'i mchod pa 'bul/ rdo rje dri tso ma rdzo sam rdzo/ /ā+oṃ badz+rad+ku lha pe/ ā lo ke /ga rje/ ni bi bye/ sha lta pā tsa me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sam ya hūṃ/ bh+yo/ rang byung nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ /gos chan 'khur ba zan dang chang / /mi sha la sogs sha lngas brgyan/ /gti mug sha ni zan las zhim/ /'dod chags khrag gi chang las zhim/ /zhe sdang keng rus dzo ltar spungs/ /nang gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /ma hā pā dza hobh+yo/ gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ /zag bcas phung po rnam pa lnga/ /sku yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /'dod chags zhe sdang nyon mongs lnga/ /gsung gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /thig le dkar dmar bde gsal dbyings/ /thugs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /bla med gsang ba'i blo bral dang / /blo dang ldan pa sna tshogs rnams/ /gzung 'dzin med par 'bul lags kyi/ /dug gsum lusangag yid dang gsum/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /ma hā pā dza hoḥ bskang ngo bskal pa'i li zur sa da los pa/ thugs dam bskang / /chos dbyings mkha' 'gro pho brang nas/ /mngon rdzogs rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang / /gling bzhi'i mnga' bdag yin pa'i phyir/ /rma ri rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /bstan ma skyong ma ti ma dang / /ya ma'i tshogs kyi thugs dam (7na tha skang / /'khor bcas sha snas bskang ba ni/ /ri rab srid pa'i bum rtse nas/ /ye shes mchogo gi ma mo la/ /seng ge dkar mo'i sha yis bskang / /mi rtog nam mkha'i mkha' stong nas/ /dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma la/ sha chen —316

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin las yid bzhin gter mdzod/ nang ma 9)mchog gis thugs dam bskang / /ba lang dkar po'i sha yis bskang / /dpa' gtum stag mo'i sha yisabaskang / /pu shud rma bya'i sha yis bskang / /thogs med bya khrung sha yis bskang / /mi snang 'jol mo'i sha yis bskang / /bya rgod dkar po'i sha yis bskang / /ce spyang nag po'i sha yis bskang / /gti mug dred mo'i sha yis bskang / /nga rgyal 'phar ba'i sha yis bskang / /zhe sdang sbrul gyi sha yi bskang / /bsten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /lug nag spyi dkar thugs dam bskang / /'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rol mo'i sgra yis thugs dam bskang / /rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /rtag gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang / /rgyun du mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ khyun gyi gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang / /rak+ta skom du 'thung ba'i phyir/ khrag gi rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang / /srin bya bya rog ngur pa sogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / sha sna stong gis thugs dam bskang / /snying sna 'bum gyis thugs dam bskang / /bh+yo/ srid pa chags byed la sogs la/ /gung ru (7ba〉stod kyi dkor cha dang / /rgya yul mthil gyi dar dang zab/ /mdo khams smad kyi ja dang zog /mang yul stod kyi sman dang spos/ /spa gro smad kyi btsod dang zhun/ /byang kha stod kyi tshwa dang nya/ /bod kha smad kyi 'bru dang bcud/ /lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /ā+oṃ/ lhun grub chos dbyings zhi skang thams go mkhyen pa dge 2na rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ bde ba chen po'i dngos/ /rnam pa re ba skong mdzad mthun pa'i rdzas/ /dngos bshamasayid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /nam mkha'i khams kun bkang ste 'bul ba ni/ /rin cen gser dngul 'od 'bar snod yongs su/ /'bras chang rgun chang nas gyi chang phud sogs/ /mtsho ltar rab bskyil gtsang ma'i gser skyems 'di/ /bstan skyong chen mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tsan dan shug pa a ka ru la sogs/ /dri zhim ngad ldan spos sna brgya phrag tshogs/ /bsregs pa'i dud sprin nam mkha'i khams gang bas/ /dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma 'khor bcas bsangs/ /rin cen sga srab mdzes pa'i dar snas brgyan/ sha ba dung gi rwa bcu zangs se zang / /sprin dkar g.yo 'dra'i rta mchog —317—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()glog ltar 'byug/'jam pa'i spu ldan shel ltar 'tsher pa'i lug/'ja' tshon ltar bkra'i rgyan ldan ra skyes sogs//g.yu bya phug ron tshogs rnams thibs se thib/khu byug myos pa'i sgra 'byin lang ling g.yo//bya nag srin mo'i tsho gos ni zlos gar bsgyur//skad snyan byi'u sna tsho gos glu dbyangs len//mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs rnams kyis thugs dam bskang //ja chang phud sogs btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil//ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas sna tsho gos dang //'bru sna la sogs bca' pa'i bye brag dang //dkar gsum mngar gsum gtsang ma'i phud kyis mchod//lha rdzas me tog tsho gis kyis bar snang gang //rab 'bar sgron me'i phreng ba ma' du mngar//gdangs snyan skad kyi 'gyur pa brgya phrag sogs//sil snyan rol mo'i bye brag kun kyang 'bul//stong gsum khyon ltar rin cen snod yangasasu//ri rab lta bur spungs pa'i gtor ma 'di//ā+oṃ u3 gis bdud rtsi'i byin bsasanas//bstan skyong chen mo 'khor bcas zhal du 'bul/tsho gos 'khor 'bul ba ni/bh+yo/tshogs rten kha'og ma rtsa ra rtsa'i da skur ba/kyi dngos po bsregs sbyangs bkrus//raṃ waṃ khaṃ chas//bde bar gshegasaso bcom ldan 'das//sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag ṣ+ka can//rdo rje drag rgyal 'khor cas la//zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa 'bul//ga ṇa tsakra pu dza bha lin+ta khā hi/bh+yo/gzi ldan 'bar ma 'khor bcasarnams//phyi nang gsang gsum tsho gos la rol//dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol//mi mas rkyen dang bar ho sol//rtsab yan lag dam tshig kun//zhal zas tshogis kyis mthol lo bshags//badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥtshogs bar pa btang ba ni/e rkye hi ni tshur spyon 'khor dang bcas//ma tri sha la rol zhig mchod pa bzhes//dmar chen khrag la rol zhig mchod 8bab bzhes//gsur chen tshil la rol zhig mchod pa bzhes//rus chen rkang la rol zhig mchod pa bzhes//dgra bgegs sha khrag rusapa la khā hi//tha ma stob pa ni/ma mo thams cad dbyings su dgyes//phyag na dbang drag phur pa dril//bsad mnan spar pa'i las mdzod cig/ā+oṃ bh+yo : che ge mo la dzaḥche mchog ma mo'i lha tshogasarnams//zhal gdangs ljags 'dril tshems gtsigaX nas//dgra bgegs dam nyams zhal du stab bo

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi tshon las yid bsto ga kho mdzod/ nang ma 9)kha raṃ khā hi/ /ma hā rak+ta go ro tsa na kha raṃ khā hi/ lhag ma btang ba ni/ bh+yo/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du/ /bcom ldan dpal chen phud la dbang / /bar du tsho gos la mi rol du/ /dam can srung ma tshogasal bdag /de nas dmar gyis mi sbran du/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro khrag la dgyes/ /lhag ma kha chus mi sbran du/ /rje dang 'bangs kyi khyad par che/ /lhag ma phud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mdzod/ /bh+yo/ yul ga kho kha'og ma nas mnga' ris paṇa r+sā si po tshes gas pa/gcig dbu ru snye mtshams na/ /rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /dkar mo gser g.yu'i thod gdangasacan/ /na bza' smug nag 'bar ba gsol/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs lcags thod 'dzin/ /chibs su 'byong byu rwa dgu bcibs/ /'khor du sman mo stong gis bskor/ /brkos bu snying dang gtor masabaskang / /bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnams sgrubs/ /ho/ dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi srung ma chen mo/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ma'i gtso mo chen mo/ /(9na pho ba dpon pad+ma'i bran g.yog chen mo/ /sgrub chen rnams kyi bka' nyan chen mo/ /nor dang chos kyi gter srung chen mo/ /bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma chen mo/ /gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor chen mo/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ /nad pa ga sgo ba'i byin rlabs can/ /sri'u gso ba'i dpal mo che/ /rno mthong ston pa'i mngon shes mkhan/ /phyugs ma skyong pa'i g.yag rdzi mo/ /sngon tshe khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /dam rdzas mchode gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bod khams rtag tu bde ba dang / /rims nad yams nad bcad du gsol/ /rnal 'byor 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang / /nad dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /chags che nyam nga thams cad bzlog /dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog /'phrin las bzhi sogs dngos grub kun/ /sgrub pa po la myur du stsol/ /yang gha bza'/ dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma/ /gong gsum sman gcig ma sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa khā hi/ rdo rje drag rgyal dkar gsal mdog /smug nag gos can rwa bcu bcibs/ /mchod gtor 'di bzhes wen las mdzod/ /kun kyang rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs/ /yab ni rdzi rgan shel gri bun/ /yum ni gnod sbyin gdug pa'i rigs/ /gnyis med snyoms zhugs sprul —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepa'i sras/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin bstan ma'i tshogs/ /rang rang sdodapung stong phrag 'khor/ /la la dkar mo zla ba'i mdangs/ /la la gser 'od kun tu 'bar/ /la la (9ba)dmar mdangs srid gsum sdud/ /la la ljang nag 'od zer can/ /la la zhi tshul dgyes pa la/ /la la khro tshul 'jigs byed la/ /la la sna tsho gos sgrub pa mo/ /kun kyang phyag g.yas rdo rje dang / /g.yon pa nor bu 'bar ba bsnams/ /rin cen thod gdengs rgyan phreng can/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las kyi/ /rang rtags dngos grub kun kyi bdag /ma rdzo gtor 'di bzhes chos nor spel/ /ji ltar bsams pa'i 'dod don kun/ /bcol ba tsam gyis grub par mdzod/ /brtse gdung drag pos ma dang sring / /bstan ma'i tsho gis rnamasamachod bstod na/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrubs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces spos dang rol mo dang phud dang gtor mas phyogs bzhir mchod/ gang 'dod re ba rdzogs par 'gyur/ /dpal gyi gsung las byung ba ste/ /gnod sbyin chen mo yang gha bza'/ /las kun bdag nyid khyad par du/ /zhi dang drag po'i las mdzad ma/ /bstan 'dzin stong zhing bstan bshig rnams/ /gang 'tsham chad pas 'dul bar mdzod/ /sngags gsham du las gang 'dod sbyar/ /hūṃ/ ma mo rdo rje bstan ma'i tshogs/ /ma rtags rten 'brel bcu gnyis po/ /rnam dag skye mched mkha' 'gro ma/ /tsho gos drug yul drug rab rgyas nas/ /dge legs bsam don kun 'grub cing / /bde chen ye shes 'bar bar mdzod/ /'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba mo/ /ye shes grub kyang las kyi gnyer/ /rdzu phrul thogs (10na thad snying nye grogs/ /sngon tshe rdo rje srin po'i bka'/ /bar du pad+ma thod phreng lung / /de nas rigs 'dzin bla ma'i mchid/ /da lta bdag gi re ba skong / /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bla ma rdo rje srin po la/ /phyag byas mkha' 'gro bgraganyis kyi/ /pha rabs tshul du bstod par bya/ /hūṃ/ don gyi dbyings las ye shes yab/ /yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /snang stong yab kyi rjes bran las/ /bde stong ma bdud bcu'i nang tshan/ /nam gyi shel gri dkar po las/ /chags pa'i ma mo gnod sbyin ma/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i byin rlabs las/ /gnod sbyin chen —320

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi tson la yid bsto ga kho mdzod/ nang ma 9)mo yang gha bza'//skye gnas bzhi yis thugs dam bskang //mthar thug bde chen zung 'jug las//snang srid bde chen gcig tu 'khyil//snang ba yab la stong pa yum//rig rtsal sras kyi tsho gis dang bcas//'khor 'das ro mnyam thugs dam bskang //bskang ngo mchod do ma chen tshogs/dngos grub dam pa deng 'dir stsol//bstod pa ni/hūṃ/rdo rje gan kha'og ma/dbang phyug ye shes khro rgyal gtso//gdug pa'i dbang gis khro bo'i skur bstan pa//dur khrod mas brgyad sku la rab tu brjid//phyag drug phyag na mtshon cha sna tsho gis bsnams//zhabs gnyis ru dra'i steng na stabs kyis bzhugs/khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin sku la bstod//dmar nag ral ba 'bar zhing dom nag rgyug/rma ri rab stims sku la phyag 'tshal bstod//bh+yo/bstan 10bab skyong thams go mkhyer dge nyon rgya mtshos mdzad spra/mdzad dpal ldan yang gha bza'//gsang mtshan dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma ste//rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal//rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen mo khyod la bstod/khyod sku rab dkar shel gyi ljon pa bzhin//lhab lhub dar dang rin cen rgyan phreng g.yo//rin cen dbu rgyan 'phur lding cod pan can//chos 'khor skyong mdzad dpal mo khyod la bstod//sku gsung thugs kyi bga' nyan gtso mo gsum//dam tshig ldan pa'i mched gyur bstan ma'i tshogs//las byed sdebargyad bzung mo sman mo'i tshogs//sa dang bar snang gang ba rnams la bstod//las sgrub pa la ngo mthon du dpa' bskyed pa'i phyir gsol kha'i 'phrin lasa'adir ma zad bskang ba rkyang pa la'ang spyod rung zhing bskang ba'i tshe 'dzab byed na de grub rjes mdzad pa'ang phyag len du snang ba/nas phye gtsang ma la sman sna/rin po che dang spos sna/mar/chang rgod sogs bsres shing bran pa'i rang bgos mtheb skyus skor zhing rgyan spros dang bca' yos sogs kha zasakyi bye brag sna tsho gos pa dar snas brgyan pa bzhi/dam tshig gi rgya phor chang bzang po sman phabs btang pas bkang la/mar gyi ze brog gis spras pa bzhi/gzhan yang bskang ba'i mthun rdzas kyi yas dngosasu bshams pa gang yod kyang de dag gi mdun du bkod/mdos dang gsol kha'i chos thams cad sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs/sgra/dri/ro/reg

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang (11na)pa 'di dang / dgyes pa'i spyan gzigs/ mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems dam pa dang bcas pa 'di rnams/ rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma/chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing / mthu dang stobs kyi bdag mo/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma/ snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba/ dam can sgrub pa po bu bzhin du skyong ba/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgra dang bgegs thams cad skad cig gis brlag par byed pa'i drag shul can rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ mtshan gzhan jo mo yang gha bza'/ gsang mtshan rdo rje dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan phreng gi lhab lhub can/ phyag g.yas 'phrul gyi me long bsnams nas snang srid gsal bar ston cing / zhags pas dam nyams kyi mgul nas 'ching ba/ g.yon pa lcags kyu dar sna tsho gos kyis brgyan pas dgra bgegs rnams kyi srog rtsa gcod cing snang srid dbang du sdud pa/ chibs su sha ba rwa bcu la bcibs pa/rma ri rab 'byams kyi rtse la bzhugs nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi dgon gnas skyong zhing bka'i bya ra mdzad pa gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ gzhan yang sku'i g.yog mo dud gha bza' mtshe'u'i rong la gnas pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyi bya khra bsnams nas sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed cing /g.yon lcags kyi zor bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod pa/ sha ba yu mo la bcibs pa bdud mo'i tshogs(11ba thas bskor ba la gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /gzhan yang phag tshang gi rong la gnas pa/ gsung gi g.yag mo mam gha bza' re lde nag po'i na bza' gyon pa/ phyag g.yasan sre long gi phreng bas legs nyes rtsis la 'debs shing g.yon dar mdung dmar po dgra la 'phyar ba/dre'u la bcibs shing btsan dmag 'bum gyis bskor ba dang bcas pa la gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /thugs kyi g.yog mo shel bza' sman gcig sku la za 'og gi na bza' brgyan cing chu dar sngon po'i lhab lhub can/ dung gi cod pan dang byu ru'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas dngul —322

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin la yid bzhin gter mdzod/ nang ma 9)skyogs zas kyis gang ba gtso mo la stob cing g.yon pa dar gyi lhab lhub bsnams pa/ phag tshang gi rong la bzhugs shing 'brong g.yag rog po la bcibs nas bka'i bya ra mdzad pa/ sman mo 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /zhes phud rnams gtore la bstan skyong chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ sngon slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam la btags/ rang rang gi srog gi snying po phul nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang / rnal 'byor dam tshig can rnams kyis ji ltar bsgo ba'i 'phrin lasabasgrub par khas blangs dam bcas pa'i dam tshig rjes su dran par gyis la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon cog gi dbu 'phang stod/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe srings/(12na〉nyun las sgrubs/ khyad par du yang bdag
