cag dpon slob dgon gnas dge 'dun kyi sdedang bcas pa la nyin gsum gyi bya ra/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe ma g.yel bar bsrung ba dang / skyob pa dang / sba ba dang / /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde/ bshad sgrub kyi bya ba rnams yar ngo'i zla ba ltar du rgyas par mdzod cig /khams gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod phun sun tsho gos pa thamasacad dbang du sdus shig /bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang dgon gnas 'di dag la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad myur du zhi zhing dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ gal te zhi bas 'dul bar ma 'tshal na ltas dang cho 'phrul sna tshogasapas spa bkongs la skad cig nyid la gang la gang 'tsham pa'i drag po'i chad pas thal bar brlag par mdzod cig /mdor na gang la gang bsgo ba'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par myur du grub par mdzod cig /ces 'phrin las 'chol lo/ /bdun pa bskul zhing 'phrin cholas 'al ba ni/ bh+yo/ rma ri ga kho kha'og ma/ nam mkha' rigs kyi rgyal mo ste/ /'jig rten rigs la dbang sgyur las mkhan ma/ /ber ljang gyon cing dgra bo'i tsit+ta —323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonagasol//dmar mo srog gcod ma yi thugs dam bskul//rtse zhes gtsug lag 'od 'bar mkho ga kho//chings su 'brong bu dar ma bcibs//sman rag mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//ma mo mkha' 'gro ma lus pa'i//12ba〉༷ sgor tshogs du mas bskor ba ni//kun kyang gdug pa'i lag cha thogs//kun kyang srog dang dbugs la dga'//kun kyang sha za khrag la dga'//kun kyang mdangs 'phrog bcud len ma//rgyal blon 'bangs dang yang g.yog sogs//sdo brgyad mang po'i 'khor dang bcas//de ring mthu dang dpung bskyed la//bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang //stong phrag drug cu'i bgegs rnams bzlog/gtad khram ga sngags rbod gtong dang //dgra 'dre'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog/dam can bstan srung khyed rnams kyis//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la//tshe ring nad med bde skyid spel//yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod//'gro kun phan bde'i dpal 'byor dang //'jig rten khams kyi 'dod yon rnams/khug cig sdus shig dbang du sdus//bla ma'i sku dgra bstan la gnod//sngags 'chang sgrub la bar gcod pa'i//sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs//sod cig rgyob cig rengs par mdzod//zungs shig chings shing rdul du rlog/de yi sha zo khrag la 'thung //dgra bgegs pha rol gnas su sgrol//sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang //bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'gro don 'phel//rgyal khams bde zhing bkra shis pa'i//bstan ma rnams kyi 'phrin las mdzod//hūṃ/nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/thams go ma ye pyodage 2na rgya mtshogamadzad pa/srid gsum dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed/khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal//de ring bstan skyong tsho gos rnams la//dam ldan ) tshig 'phrin las gnyer du gtod//bstan skyong rdo rje drag mo rgyal//sku gsung thugs kyi g.yog mor bcas//bsam yas dpal gyi mchims phu sa/slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi//rta mgrin khrag 'thung sku 'khor du//dbang bskur bka' dang dam la bzhag/de tshe gsang ba'i mtshan btags pa//rdo rje dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar//de nas sgrags kyi yang rdzong du//gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis//gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du//dbang bskur 24

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdo kyi tson la yid bzhin ga kho mdzod/ nang ma 9)bka' dang dam la bzhag /de nas dpal gyi phug pa mā /slob dpon nyan chen dpal dbyangs kyis/ /yang dag sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bstan pa bsrung ba sa /bka' bsgos dam tshig gnyer du gtad/ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /bka' bsgos rang gi khas blangs pa'i/ /dam tshig gnyan po dran gyis la/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i spyan gzigs dang / /dam rdzas mchode gtor 'di bzhesal/ /bcol pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /gong gsum skyong ba'i sman gcig ma/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje gzi ldan 'bar/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug yang gha bza'/ khyod nyid dgra la khros pa'i tshe/ /chibs su slog phreng 'bar ba bcibs/ kha nas bskal pa'i me dpung 'phro/ /shangs nas dud sprin thul lu lu/ /rjes su me dpung 'bar ba khrid/ /mkha' la slo bur chu 'dzin 'khrig /'brug sgra drag po phyogs bcur sgrog /gnam lcags(13ba〉ser chen drag tu 'bebs/ /sagazhi me dang chu yis 'gengs/ /bdud bya skyung ka mings6ying / /bya nag mchu ser thibs4thib/ /sman mo'i shon skor khrigs rtse khrig /bdud dmag mang po nyer re re/ /bzha gyi rta rgyug shar ra ra/ /dga' na rgya mtsho mkha' la skyel/ khros na nyi zla thang la 'brebs/ /bgad na ri rab phye mar 'thag /de lta'i mthu rtsal cho 'phrul can/ /'khor dang bcas ba khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa la gnod cing / /dge 'dun sdo rnams dkrug cing 'joms/ /skye bo yongs la gnod sems can/ khyad par dgon gnas 'di nyid dang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /sdang zhing gdug pa'i bsam pa can/ /mi dang mi min dgra bgegs rnams/ /ltas dang cho 'phrul sna tsho gos pas/ /'jigasashing skrag nas spa bkongs la/ /lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ /snying khrag dron mo myur du 'thung / /da lta nyid du brlag par gyis/ /gdug can dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ /gnyen 'khor phun tshogs kun dang phrol/ /skyob pa'i lha dpon rnams dang phye/ /zas nor longs spyod nyams su chug / bdun brgyad 0 chad brlag par gyis/ /bcol pa'i las 'di ma bsgrubs na/ /slob dpon chen po'i bka' dang 'gal/ /rang gi dam tshig khas blangs rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi re ba bcad/ /de bas dam tshig —323—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ma bsnyel par//bcol pa'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs//brgyad pa dbang du bsdub ni/rang nyid khro bo'i bskyed rim/gsar la che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed de/'di skad do//hūṃ/nga ni mo'i sa gtom/rta mchog rgyal po ste//nga ni dregs pa'i bdag po yin//nga ni lha 'dre kun gyi rje//nga yi bka' las mi nyan na//rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed//de bsang yi bka' la nyen//gong gong chum chum lasal shog/ā+oṃ to ga kho gcil bzlog gi g.yi /sa/ swā hā/badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka ya mān+ta ka pad+ma kro dhī shwa ri badz+ra ki li ki lā ya tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na/kā la rū pa/badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha pad+ma sa mu ka ā po〉 ya/ā kur+sha ya/ban+ta ya/byu ya/to sha yā/to sha yā/mo ha yā/mo ha yā/shrī ma hā kā la 4 ྅ pa badz+ra yi dzña sarba ḍā ki ni hri da ya/ha ha hi hi/e a ra li hūṃ dzaḥ/zhes brgya rtsa bzla/dgu pa bsnyen cing sgrub pa la ma yengs par srog gi snying nas 'bad pa ni/ā+oṃ a pe a/yang gha bza' sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ/ā+oṃ a pe a gzi ldan 'bar ma sam ya dzaḥdzaX/ā+oṃ a pe a/sman mo chen mo sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ/ma ma ru lu ru lu ma ting ma bh+yo/zhes mchims phu'i gter kha las byung ba ltar ci nus su bzla zhing gter kha gzhan dag las 'byung ba bya bar 'dod na bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang wo ngos bzung ste bzla/zhi rgyasadabang drag gi dmigs pa'i rim pa zhal rgyun las 'byung ba bzhin nyams su bstar ro//bcu pa mdosaglud kyi rabs dang yas kyi cho 'brang 'don pa ni/ra ka'i gter byon las shes par bya'o//bcu gcig pa mdos bsngo zhing 'phrin las 'chol pa ni/14ba ) bh+yo/yul skyal bzlog ni rma yul thang brgyad nas//rma chen sbom ra'i lcam gcig ma//gdung rus g.ya te rma chen bza'//byang gi sman ting ting mo btsun//g.yag lpags stong gi slog pa la/khyung gshog stong gi gshog pa can//chibs su 'brong bu rwa dgu bcibs//phyag na mchong gi phur ba bsnams//nyi 'od ma bdun 'khor gyis bskor/khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab//mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la//bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyamasartsad chog nas da//hūṃ bh+yo badz+raki li gī lā hūṃ dzaḥ/dgra la bh+yo/bh+yo/ga4sgrigs/shel dkar dbang sngon pad rā ka dang //gser sbyangs las grub ri rab hu/ra//rin cen khang bzang mdzes pa'i lcog/rgya

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin las yid bzhin gter mdzod/ nang ma 9)phubs nor bu'i tog gis spras/ /dra ba dra phyed dril sgra 'brol/ /dar dbyangs nor bu'i rgyan gyisaspud/ /srog shing dpag bsam ljon rtser gdugs/ /logs la gsal phyed nyi zla 'khor/ /rtsa bar gser ri rol mtsho bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran lcags ris bskor/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs ldan/ /yid 'phrog rngams brjid gnas kyi rten/ /rnam bkra nam mkha' sgro phod can/ /rgyang bu spel legs phreng bar bsgrigs/ /yul mkhar pho gdong mo gdong dang / /lha bdud ma mo klu dang btsan/ /gshin rje rgyal po gza' rgod byed/ /rbod gtong ma mo'i khrag zor sogs/ /gnod byed ma lus bzlog pa'i khram/ /mda' khra 'phang khra thabs shes tshul/ /rnam par shes pa tshe srog dbugs/ /phung khams skye (15nasgo ched dbang po lnga/ /tshang ba'i ngar glud rgyan gos can/ /'byor ldan yid 'ong 'bum phrag spel/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod dbang po lnga/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun/ /btso ma gser gyi brog zhu la/ /lha dang mi yi rin po che/ /yid 'phrog sna tshogs phra yis brgyan/ /gser g.yu mu tig spel pa'i thod/ /sna tsho gis rin cen phras spras pa'i/ /mgul rgyan gdu bu rtse mo do/ /do shal ska rags g.yu'i go ra'i/ /snyan cha la sogs mdzes pa'i chas/ /srab 'jam rgya dar can gyi gos/ /tshig gu'i ri mo ldan pa'i ber/ /dar dkar gos zung lhab lhub g.yo/ /g.yag lpags stong gi slog pa dang /khyung gshog stong gi sham thabs brjid/ /zab ber ljang gu'i re nag gos/ /sag ti'i mo lham rtse snyung dkar/ /snang srid gsal ba'i me long zhags/ /dar sna lngas brgyan lcags kyu dang / /be con rin po che'i gzheng pa/ /mchong phur mi snying rtsa lag bcas/ /lcags kyu bya khra zor ba dang / /sre long phreng ba dar mdung g.yo/ /dngul gzhed zas bkang dar tshon lnga/ sha pa rwa bcu 'phar pa dang / /'byong bu dar ma rwa dgu pa/ /dom nag smyon pa mi dred rgyu/ sha ba yu mo rta dkar drel/ /sga srab la sogs chas kyisaspras/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang mdzo g.yag glang / /stag gzig gsa' phyi ce spyang 'dur/ /gro mo'i lug dang ra rgya mo/ /g.yu bya phug ron khu byug sngo/ /gong mo gro mo khrung khrung dkar/ /bya rog rgod glag brtse bya khra/ /go bo ngang (15ba)pa gla ba dang / /dgo ba gna' ba rgya la sogs/ /gnam la 'phur dgu sa 'og —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (2shetu/ /'dzul dgu ri dwags 'phyo dgu'i tshogs/ /bud med nag mo rta la zhon/ /rdo rje'i go khrab btsun po'i rmog /zhol btags rnga gdus 'ja' ris can/ /phub dang lcags gzhibs rang srung go/gri gug ral gri dgra sta mdung / /sgrogs dang dpag r+pā mda' po che/ /pha rol 'joms pa rdo rje'i mar/ /smyug rgod rtse rgyas g.yag rnga dkar/ /dar sna lngas brgyan mda' bo che/ /bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta'i mtsho/ /rtag gtor rgyun gtor bskang gtor spungs/ /'brang rgyas bgos bu ting lo sbar/ /sman le khrag sna'i dbus skyu dang / /dmar po 'bum sde'i btsan gyi bgos/ khrag kong ngar mi mdzes sdug brjid/ /seng ge mi dang ba lang dkar/ /stag mo pu shud rma bya khyung / /'jol mo bya rgod ce spyang dred/ /'phar ba sbrul la sogs pa yi/ sha sna mi gcig stong phrag bshams/ /mi rta ba lang la sogs pa'i/ /snying sna 'bum phrag bcal du bkram/ /brgya phrag shing tog ro bda'i zas/ /phrum thud phye mar 'bur ba tshwa/ /gro nas sran 'bras so pa khre/ /'bru sna ka ra bu ram sbrang / /nas gre sran ma'i bca' yos dang / /sna tsho gis zas sna'i bye brag tshogs/ /rnga chang zho chu rnam grangs stong / /'o chol gser skyems btung ba bskyil/ /be+eḍūr ma rgad dbang sngon shel/ /pad rwa ka gzi g.yu mu tig mchong / /byu ru nal gser dngul zangs lcags/ /sna tsho gos lha mi'i rin po che/ kha dog rnam mang zab gos dar/ /ras snam (16na skog gzig la — / /mtha' yas srog chags pags pa dang / /btsod dang zhu mkhan rams skag mtshal/ /bzang drug tso dan a ga sa /ga gur spos sogs sman sna stong / /dzornga zom rnga rnga bo che/ /rkang gling dung chen rgya gling dang / /sgra snyan sil snyan pi wang glu/ /g.yab dar rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs bsgreng / /thugs dam skong byed mthun pa'i rdzas/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dpal ldan drag mo rgyal la 'bul/ /sku sprul dung gha bza' la 'bul/ /gsung sprul mam gha bza' la 'bul/ /thugs sprul shel bza' sman la 'bul/ /bka' gnyan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /mdos bdag chen mos mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag chen mo glud bzhes shig /dgyes pa chen pos wen las bzhi'i/ /bsams pa don kun lhun grub mdzod/ /dam bsgrag cing zlog sgyur —328—

dpal ldan yang gha ba rimado kyi tshon las yid bsnyo ga kho mdzod/ nang ma 9)'phrin las 'chol ba ni//bh+yo/slob gsar chugs/dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis//gzi ldan 'bar ma 'khor bcas kyi//srog gi snying po nyer blangs nas//dbang bskur dam la btags min nam/khamasakyi rma wo sbom ra'i mgul//byang gi ting ting ting mo btsun//ser mo las mkhan gsang mas du//rdo rje drag mo rgyal zhes ba khas//gas yang rlangs r+sā dpal seng dang //gnubs wo sangs rgyas ye shes sogs/grub brnyes rig sngags yong mang pos//bka' dang dam la btags min nam/khyad par nyang ral yab sras dang //6ba〉6sa dbang thugs sras pad+ma dbang //dmar zhags raso grags rgyan pa//bkra shis mas can shes rab 'od//chos blo dbang phyug blo gros dang //bsod seng 'jam dbyangs blo gros zhabs//dam pa chos tshul nam mkha' dpal//'jam dbyangs rgyal mas pad+ma dbang //legs ldan rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs//dbang rab mgon po bsod namasamachog/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol sogs//rtsa brgyud bla mas bdag cag gi/grogs por gto do gzhung ma ga//mdza' bor gto do khrel ma bor//bran du gto do rkang ma ga//mthurtsal ma zhan 'phrin las sgrubs/khyod la 'phrin las gtad pa ni//bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde rnamasaspel//sa skyong rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas//bod khams ru bzhi'i rgyal khams kyi//mi nor phyugasagasum bsrung zhing skyobs//bdag cag dmigs byar bcas pa'i tshe//zad kyang lo brgya'i bar du srings//chos srid dpal 'byor legs tshogos rnams//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod//rigasa'adzin bdag cag yon mar rnams//snang srid lha srin sdebargyad kyi//byad du bcug na byad thag ra/khram la babs na khram kha phyi/kho la bkod na sho rdel spos//nad la babs na nad kha sgyur//zlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod//gzhan yang bar du gcod byed pa'i//nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang //stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs//sum brgya drug cu'i ye 'brog gdon//byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang //dus min 7na sko6 ba rnam pa brgyad//ltas ga brgyad cu rtsa gcig rnams//zlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod//༷brum nag 'byum yan lhog pa dang //skrangs pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebal ldag g.yon pa'i nad/ /mdze shu phol mig skya rbab rlung / /glo gzer sha ya mig ser dang / /rgya nad sha ser khrag gi nad/ /gzer thabs le brgan rgyu gzer dang / khrag skyug mkhal nad la sogs pa/ /zlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan bo mdzod/ /bal nad smyo 'bog glo rdol dang / /g.yul 'khrug 'thab rtsod mi kha za/ /dug sbyor bsam ga gros ngan bshams/ /mis ltas nyams dang mtshan ma ngan/ /geg sri ngan pa langs pa dang / /chags che nyamasang la sogs pa'i/ /bar gcod mi mthun phyogs noms kun/ /zlog sgyur 'phrin las gzha po mdzod/ /bstan skyong 'khor bcas ma cu rtsal skyed/ /nad gdon bar gcod dgra bgegs kun/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /bcu gnyis pa glud yas rnams byin gyis brlabs nas gtong ba/ bcu gsum pa mdos glud la bsgyur zhing khrom sna bsgyur ba/ bcu bzhi pa sgo dbye zhing mdos glud kyi lam bstan pa/ bco lnga pa gser skyemasagatong ba/ bcu drug pa mjug zor gyis gcod pa/ bcu bdun pa yas gzhi sprul pa rnams ra ka'i gter byon bzhin bya/ de nas mdos rnams phyir sbags/ gtong sar slebs nas gser skyems gtong /bh+yo/ bstan ma 'khor bcas mthu rtsal skyed/ ga4 chugs/ /mdos yas 'di yi sna drongs la/ /(17ba)bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /nad gdon chags che nyam nga dang / /byang phur gto zor geg sri ga/ /dmar bshal rgyu tshad gag lhog gzer/ /'brum pa be ge bar pa ta/ /nywa log 'khru skyug la sogs pa'i/ /mi phyugs nad rigs ma lus pa/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du sgyur/ /zlog sgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces bzlog sngags bzla zhing rol mo brdung / /mtshon cha brdeg cing zhing lpags brdul/ /spyos gdab/ me chus rgyas 'debasabyed phyi mig mi blta bar nang du log go /ho/ 'di ga4 chugs/ ltar dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin/ /mi mdzad nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs nas/ /yar la mchod cing mar la byin pa'i mthus/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas thugs dam stongs gyur cig /sku gsung thugs rnams mnyes shing rab tshim pas/ /sgrib gnyis bar gcod kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas/ khams gsum dbang 'dus dgra —330

dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin las yid bzhin gter mdzod/ nang ma 9)bgegs rdul du rlog /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ tshe 'gugs shing bkra shis brjod pa sogs/ mjug spyi ltar bya'o/ /'di ni bzlog mdos gtso bor byasakyi/ rten mdos dang bskang mdos su byed na shing byad rnams kyi kha bsgyur gyi 'phrul shes dgos shing bsngo tshig /dpal ldan drag rgyal rten du 'bul/ gsar bsgrigs/ bskang ba'i tshe/ dpal ldan drag rgyal thugs dam bskang / zhes dang / glud bdag chen mo glud bzhes shig /rma ri rab 'byams 'khor bcas rnams/ /rten (15)pa'i mdos 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /bdag sogs sgrub po rgyu sbyor gyi/ /yul khams grong gnas rtag tu srungs/ zhes dang / rma ri rab stims 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugasadam gnyan po dbyings skongs bas/ /nyams chags bar chad mi mthun phyogs/ /'bras bu ngan pa kun zhi zhing / /dgyes pa chen pos sogs drang gzhan yang tshig zur bsgyur dgos rig pas dpyod/ rten mdos la brtan bzhugs dang bskang mdos yang thog tu spags pa kha gso zhing byin gyis brlabs la/bh+yo/ sngon ga4 ga smos/tshe pad+ma thod phreng la sogs pa/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i g.yar dam gnyan po las/ /mi 'da' gnod sbyin chen po yang gha bza'/ /sku yi sprul pa dkar mo dud gha bza'/ /gsung gi sprul pa dmar mo mam gha bza'/ /thugs sprul mthing kha shel gza' sman gcig ma/ /bka' 'khor gnod sbyin ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams/ /dbu ru snye mtshams rma ri rab 'byams sogs/ /rang rang gar bzhugs gnas nas da tshur spyon/ /dar tshon sna lnga g.yab pa'i brda ston na/ kha ba'i bu yug lta bur 'thib cing spyon/ sha chen spos dkar shing sna'i dud 'thul na/ /dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin du lang long spyon/ /gser skyems sman raka btang ba sbreng byed na/ /'thor rlung drag po'i rdul bzhin 'tshub cing spyon/ /lha mchog 'khor bcas thugs dang mthun pa'i rdzas/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla dang / /nam rgyang mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong (18ba)sogs/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor mkho dgu'i 'byor pa rnams/ /spungs pas mi zad mdos chen nam mkha' mdzod/ /legs par dbul gyi dgyes pa chen pos bzhes/ /bdag cag dgon gnas rgyu sbyor —331 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bcas pa la//dus min 'chi ba nad rims 'thab rtsod g.yul//dgra bgegs gdon gyi 'tshe ba ma lus zhi//tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang dang //bshad dang sgrub pa lung rtogs yon tan sogs/khrod dang zhi ba'i phun tsho gis ma lus pa//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel pa'i 'phrin lasamadzod/zhes gar bzhugs kyi phyogs su 'bul//gsol ba'i 'phrin las ni/srid zhi dpal 'byor ma/bkra shis rol mo'i byin 'bebs rgya cher bya/nang du rten la brtan bzhugs sogs mjug chog spyi dang 'dra/zhib cha mtha' dag gsang chen rnying ma'i ring lugs la sbyangs pa'i rig sngags yong ba zhig la sgro 'dogs gcod dgos pas dpe mthong bas cho go pa ni ma yin no//dang por g.yung drung bon gyisamachod pa'i lha//bar du mtsho skyes rdo rje'i bka' nyan mo//tha mar rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i srung ma che'i//mdos kyi 'phrin las lag len khrigs bsdebs pa//mi shes rang bzo mkhan po'i 'ol chod dang //gzhan gyi sbyar byang brjes pa'i g.yo khram sogs//ma yin snga 'gyur cho rtse tshul 'di ko la//sbyangs pa gdengs tshod yod nas mgrin pa bteg/dge des dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma yis//dgra bgegs 'byung po'i dpung bcas tshar bcad de//srid dang zhi ba'i legs tshogos bla nas19nablar//spel ba'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod//gangs can ljongs kyi yul bdag bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi ya rgyal gnod sbyin chen mo dpal ldan yang gha bza'i mdos kyi 'phrin las yid bzhin gter mdzod 'di ni chog sgrigs shig byas na legs sam snyam rang blo 'khrul pa'i kun rtog la shar ba bzhin zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol dang khyab bdag khra tshang ba chen po'i bka' drin las mdos kyi lag len mtha' dag la smra ba'i spobs pa cung zad rnyed pa za hor gyi sngags spyon rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyis kun dga' zhes pa shing stag rgyal zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor gyi dus sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags par bgyis pa bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par gyur cig/༷rba maṅga lo/

bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdo kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma 9)bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs bzhugs so/ /na ma snye kā la burnya pad+mā ka rā ya/ snang srid dregs pa kun gyi srog snying la/ /dbang sgyur mtsho skyes pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /dbyer med khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /rtsa gsum kun 'dus ngo bor gtsug na mdzes/ /bde gshegs zhi khro kun 'dus bka' brgyad kyi/ /mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas lha/ /rang sems ka nas dag pa'i me long ngos/ /dpal ldan kun tu bzang mo'i rol gar mkhan/ /tshur mthong 'gro blor gangs can bod kyi yul/ /ring nas skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis tshogis/ /'phrin las mdos kyi mchod pas dgyes bskyed pa'i/ /gyer sgom dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs len/ /de'ang bod yul kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di bsrung zhing skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis mnyes par byed pa'i mdos kyi 'phrin las nyams su bstar ba la/ spyir mdos la lha 'dre stong gi dra ba dang / /ma mo gling bzhi/ mgon po g.yul bzlog ra ka'i gter byon gyi gto snang srid sil bu/ dga' rab rdo rje'i mdos 'chong sogs bka' gter gyi yi ge phyi mo rnams nas khog phub pa zhig dgos shing / bye brag gi (2na7dos la'ang gsogs thog nas mdos dang gyer thog nas gsogs ngos zin pa/ so so'i mthun rdzas bsham lugs/ spyi mdos sgos su gtong ba dang / sgos mdos spyir gtong ba/ pho mdos mo la gtong ba dang / mo mdos pho la gtong ba/ las bzhi gang 'tshol gyi kha sgyur/rten mdos bskang mdos bzlog mdos sogs phra zhib la sgro 'dogs bcad cing / sgrub pa bka' brgyad spyi bye brag gi dbang dang / srung ma'i srog gtad sogs legs par nos pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba mtshan nyid 'di dang ldan pa zhig gis nyams su bstan dgos pa'i phyir na/ mdos gtor sogs kyi bca' gzhi rnams gtor gzhung dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag len la bltos pas/ dang po rdzas —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebasag pa/ gnyis pa mdos bshams pa rnams zur du shes par byas te/ gsum pa mdos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sngags pa bdag nyid ber nag thod dmar kha g.yu kha gser sogs kyi chas su zhugs/'bru sna bre bcu gsum gyi steng du gsang 'phyi la mda' dar rin chen btags pa btsugs/ rgya phor dang dngul skyogs gser skyems (2ba)kyis bkang / sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs nas/mgron rnam pa bzhi la gsol kha btang / de nas bka' brgyad spyi bye brag gang rung gi 'phrin las gzhung bsrang / 'dzab bzlas tshogos las yan rdzogs par byas/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi skur bsgyur ba ni/pad nyi zadang ga khog yi gi dgong don bas pags rtsom/ru dra pho mo'i gdan steng du/ /rang nyid khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin che/ /rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar/ /phyag drug rdo rje thod khrag thugasagar 'dzin/ /bar pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis zhing dbyug 'phyar zhing ri rab 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dur khrod chas gyis brgyan/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes gsal btab mdos shes pa rnam pa bzhi dgo pa'i dang po ri rab gzhal ya khang du shes pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ chos rnams gsar rtsom/ mi dmigs stong pa nyid kyi ngang / /mkha' rlung chu sa 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor steng / /ri rab rin cen bzhi las legs grub pa/ /bang rim gsum steng rin chen gzhal yas khang / /phyogs mtshams lcog mdzes sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ phyi rol rmad du gser ri rol mtsho bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran lcags ri mu khyud kyis/ /yongs bskor 'dod yon tshogs kyis gang bar gyur/ /gnyis pa dreg pa'i gzugs ba pho nya la byed du shes pa ni/ dbus phyogs rin chos dbang dbang gter gyi dgong don bsdus pa'i gsar rtsom/ chen mdzes pa'i gzhal yas su/ khrag zhag rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /dre'u nag po sga (3na)srab rgyan spras steng / /bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan nag mo re ma ti/ /phyag g.yas shang lang g.yon pa nad rkyal 'dzin/ /thod skam dbu brgyan thod lho do shal 'phyang / /zhing wo g.yang gzhi re sde'i sham thabs gyon/ /rin chen rus pa sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan/2 /sku la khrag zhag thal chen rdzas gsum byugs/ /klad du bya rog nag po lding zhing 'phur/ /me dpung 'tshub mar —334

bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdo kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma (pe'akhyil ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /bcu gnyis lcog nad mdun nas g.yas skor du/ /bdag mtsho 3ga gi ga kho byon/nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma sku mdog mthing nag rin chen rgyan gyis spras chu srin rgyal mtshan dang ni me long bsnams: 'brug la bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : sku mdog sngo nag rin chen rus pas brgyan rno ba'i shang lang rdo rje zhags pa bsnams rkyang la bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang : sku mdog mthing nag rin chen rgyan gyis spras: gser gyi rdo rje tshe yi bum pa bsnams seng ge bcibasanas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: 'byog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi ga6 sku mdog mthing nag mun pa'i go zu can ru mtshon rtse lnga dang ni zhags pa bsnams dre'u bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma sku mdog dkar mo dar gyi lhab lhub can: 'dzomasapa'i zor ba gter gyi bum pa (3ba〉snams: sha ba bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum sku mdog dkar mo rma bya'i thod dang ldan ḍā ma ru dang gsal ba'i me long bsnams khyung la bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad gter chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo ni:sku mdog dmar mo dar dang rin chen brgyan sprul gyi zhags pa rin chen par bu bsnams: rta mchog bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: rma ri rab stims rdo rje drag mo rgyal sku mdog dkar gsalarin chen dar zab mdzes be con dang ni rin chen gzhed pa bsnams 'phar ba bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong : smug nag dar dang zhing lpags rlone pasabargyan mda' dar dang ni rin chen za ma tog sprin gseb rlung bcibs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad btsun la rag mo rdo rje sman gcig ma sku mdog dmar ljang rin cen sna lngas brgyan lhab lhub dar dang dngos grub 'brang rgyas bsnams mdzo mo bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad sman btsun khug chos rdo rje g.ya' mo bsil sku mdog dmar mo rin chen rgyan gyis spras: rin chen 'bad pa sgra snyan ting shag bsnams sha yu bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shem sku mdog dmar ser rin chen rgyan gyis spras snyan pa'i dril bu rin chen pad+ma bsnams stag la bcibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad gsar phags/ kun kyang za (4na tshe rog dar gyi tse ber gsol/ /sna tshogs rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sman mo bdud dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa/ grangasamed 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor bar gyur/ gsum pa mas rdzas pha stags glud skongs su shes pa ni/ raṃ las gsar sgrigs/ me yis dngos po'i skyon rnams bsregs/ /yaṃ las rlud gis dngos po'i skyon rnams sbyangs/ khaṃ las chu yis dngos po'i skyon rnams bkrus/ /oṃ gyis 'dod pa'i longs spyod lnga dang ldan/ /〉yisasagazhi bar snang yongs khyab nas/ /mi mdzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod spel/ /hūṃ gis med byung bdud rtsi chen por bsgyur/ /swā yis gzugs brnyan thams cad dpe byad dang / /phung po khams dang skye mched ma lus ldan hā yis re ti bstan skyong 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang gnyis med byin rlabs kyis/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i nus ldan gyur/ /ā+oṃ sa/ tre waṃ baṃ tre rat+na 〉 lo kya phaṭa:sto spums rdza dug yon dang dug dpal du shes pa ni/ gsar rtsom/ sna tshogs mtshon phur rtsed sogs drag po'i rdzas/ /gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i thog lta bur/ gyur nas dgra bgegs ma lus rtsad gcod cing / /thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i nus ldan gyur/ /sngag drug dang phyag rgya drug gis kyang byin bslas po/ sto pa spyan drang ba ni/ sgos/a kas spos dkar/shing sna/tshil r+sā gyi dud pa bto /rol mo dkrol/g.yab dar dang cas nas/chos dbang gi ga kho byon/ bh+yo/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo spyan 'dren no: sku gcig ma la mched bzhi ming dgu ma nyi ma byang shar mtshams nas gshegs su gsol kun gyi gtso (4ba〉du mdzad pa'i re ma 〉 sku yi rgyan du zhing chen g.yang gzhi gyonaḥ g.yas g.yon phyag na nad rkyal shang lang bsnams drel rta rkang gsum bcibs nas 'dir skyod la mang yul dur khrod klong nas gshegs su gsol: bdag nyid chen mo bkra shes tshe ring ma ber nag rgyan nas phyag na khri baṃ thogs bdud sha zhen nas bdud dpung bzlog pa'i phyir don mthing nya lam gangs nas gshegs su gsol dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' mo skyong : ber son gyon nas phyag na zhags pa 'dzin gser gyi mdog can rta —336

sto skyong bas ma ༅ gnyi kyi mdo kyi mun las dpyid kyi rgyal 'gru dbyangs/ nang ma (pemachog ser po bcibs gza' bdud nag po'i gnod pa bzlog pa'i phyir pha ri gnas kyi gangasanas gshegs su gsol gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang ber dmar rgyan nas phyag na thod khrag 'dzin bong bu gla ba zhen nas stong khams g.yul btsan thogs 'dul phyir la phyi'i gangs nasagashegs su gsol:'byog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi ga〈ber ljang rgyan nas be con zhags pa 'dzin khams kyi rnga mo zhen zhing 'jig rten g.yo gnod byed bgegs kyi bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir 'brog sman lung gi mtsho nas gshegs su gsol:bdud mo 'khor sa gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma:ber dkar rgyan nas thod dang ral gri 'dzan seng ge zhen nas dgra bgegs 'gugs par byed:rgyal po'i bar chad cho 'phrul bzlog pa'i phyir gya ba phu yi gangs zur gnas nas gshegs kha rag ldanad+kung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum ber ser gyon nas phyag na dgra sta 'dzin khyung la zhen nas mi bskyod dbyings na bzhugs:gshin rje'i gdon dang dgra dpung 'joms pa'i phyir kha rag shar gyi gnas nas gshegs su gsol:seng wo mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo ni:ber dmar rgyan nas phyag na lcags kyu 'dzin dom nag zhen nas lho mon dbyings la gshegs rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog pa'i phyir jo mo nags rgyal gnas nasagashegs su gsol me ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal:ber ljang gyon nas phyag na tsit+ta bsnams mi dred nag mo zhen nas dam nyams 'gugs slo bur sems kyi ye 'brog zhi ba'i phyir byang gi sman chen bod nas gshegs su gsol:gnod sbyin 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs kong bas de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong :ber dkar gyon nas la ṣ+ṭha byed zhags pa 'dzin:rwa bcu sha ba smo nas bdud dpung 'joms sa bdag klu yi nad gdon zhi ba'i phyir:rkang po shar gyi phyogs nasagashegs su gsol gtsang la ra rog rdo rje sman gcig ma ber ser gyon nas phyag na dril bu 'dzin:mdangs chen gtsod la zhen nas gto bzlog ma gnod sbyin gdug pa'i nad gdon zhi ba'i phyir bsam sdings rgyab ri'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol sman btsun yug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil:

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ber dmar gyon nas dam nyams srog rtsa gcod:phyag na tshon sna lnga yi dru bu 'dzin:'bri la zhen nasadam nyams nad la 'debs:rta nag tsha tsha 5ba〉du nas gshegs su gsol g.yu yi dril snyan rdo rje gzugs legs ma ber nag gyon nas 'gugs byed lcags kyu 'dzin rkyang la zhen nas stong gsum g.yul bar byed 'phung byed nag mo'i gdon rnams bzlog pa'i phyir bod kyi dbus ri'i gnas nasagashegs su gsol:sman btsun 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol hoḥnag ga kho kha 'og yon mnga' ri4ṇa ོ gyis gas/mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo bzhi//dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin mo bzhi//dkar mo mdangs ldan ma'i bu mo sman btsun ma bzhi//sngon tshe a su ra yi brag phug dben gnas su//slob dpon chen mo pad+ma 'byung gnas dang rnams gshegs su gsol:sngon tshe bal bo kha lam rong dgu phu slob dpon wo po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i bod skyong bstan 6nasgo bcu gnyisaganas 'dir gshegs rang rang sde brgyad du ma'i 'khor bcas rnams dam can rnal 'byor sgrub po 'khor bcas la thugs ni brtse bas rjes su nyer dgongs la:spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol:'o e khyu 〉shā gi ni sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ gzho ma ma/me me/la la/le le/ta ta/te te/kha ragaḥm ma sring 'gro ma hūṃ bh+yo ྅:/lnga pa bzhugs su gsol zhing bka' bsgo ba ni/hūṃ bh+yoḥrlung ming gi ga bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma 6)gzhal yas nas lcags kyi drel rta mgyogs pa'i gdan steng na nag mo mi sprul bdud mo mche ba can mngon spyod las kyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir mthing nag ro yi gdan la bzhugs su gsol:bh+yo/bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo chen mo bzhi bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo ber nag rgyan:rnal 'byor dbang gi 'phrin la bzhugs su gsol:sam ya a phebs:denas spu khi bsgo tsho/6ba//nga ni ga kho ra gam/che mchog he ru ga sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor pa'i ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal khyod 'das na khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis snying khrag bzhes te 'thung bar byed:de bas dam las ma 'da' bar bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod badz+ra yasga hūṃ hūṃ/drug pa mchod pa tshol zhing thugs dam snang gni/hūṃ/thabs dang ga kho kha'og ma shes rab gnyis med pa'i rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman ra sa ya na la sogs pa'i bcom ldan che mchog yab yum la rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchode 'bul thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol:ma hā pañtsa a khra ta kha raṃ khā stim shes 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nas dpal ldan re ma ti'i zhal yo dbang lnga pa ngag dang blo bzang rtsam gsung tshom/ ()ldan dkyil 'khor nas dpal ldan lha ri'i zhal du kha raṃ khā 3〉〉nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nas gangs kyi yum ོ zhal du kha raṃ khā gi 'phung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas kong btsun de mo'i zhal du kha raṃ khā gi dur khrod tsho gos kyi dkyil 'khor nas btsan la ra rog zhal du kha raṃ khā 〉gling bzhi rtsa yi dkyil 'khor nas ma btsun ug chos zhal 'khor nas rtag pa'i rgyal mo lnga'i zhal du kha raṃ khā 〉rten du btsugs na rang dbang med par 'du:srid pa chags pa'i ma mo'i lisayos zhal du kha raṃ khā gi rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyas ma la sngobh+yo/gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni:zag ༷༷sa phung po rnam pa lnga sku yi mar par bzhes su

thugs kyi mchod par bzhes su gsol bla med gsang ba'i blo bral dang :blo dang ldan pa sna tsho gis rnam gzung 'dzin med bar 'bul lags7dug gsum lusang ga yid dang gsum sku gsung thugs kyi mchod par mo'i thugs dam bskang :'byung lnga rnam dag dkyil 'khor nas dpal ldan lha ri'i thugs dam bskang :dbyings 8na skong ye shes gnyis med pa'i ga pas kyi yum chen thugs dam bskang :snang srid kun la dbang bh+yo zlog mdzad pa'i phyir:ser chen mkha' lding thugs dam bskang :gling bzhi'i mnga' bdag yin pa'i phyir me ri rab stims thugasadam bskang :sman mo'i gtso mo yin pa'i phyir:kong btsun de mo'i thugs rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rgyal 'phar ba'i sha yis bskang :zhe sdang sbrul gyi sha yis bskang :bsnyen pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir lug nag spyi dkar thugs dam bskang :'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir rol mo sgra yis thugasadam bskang :rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir:rtag gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang :rgyun du mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir rgyun gyi gtor mas thugs dam bskang :dam tshig gnyan po bsre pa'i phyir bdud rtsi sman gyi thugs dam bskang :rak+ta skom du 'thung ba'i phyir:khrag gi rgya mtsho so thugasadam bskang :srin bya bya rog ngur sogs kyis 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang :sha sna stong gis thugs dam bskang :snying sna 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang :bh+yo/srid pa chags byed la sogs la:gong ru stod kyi dkor cha dang :rgya yul mthil gyi dar dang zab mdo khams smad kyi ja dang zog mang yul stod kyi sman dang spos spa gro smad kyi bcod dang zhun:byad kha stod kyi tshwa dang nya bod kha smad kyi 'bru dang bcud lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang :tshogs bya ba ni/bh+yo/gter kha 'og ma/tsho gis kyi dngos po bsreg sbyang bkru re yaṃ khaṃ ā+oṃ 〉〉/bde bar gshegs sgo bcom ldan 'dasasangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid can bod skyong bstan ma bgraganyis la zhal zas tshogis kyi mchod pa 'bul ga ṇa tsakra pā tsa pa kla ta khā gi bh+yo/bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor bcas rnams9na ji nang gsang gsum tsho gos la rol dam skong dbang dang dngos grub stsol:mi mas rkyen dang bar ro sol rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun:zhal zas tshogis kyis mthol lo bshags badz+ra sa ma ya sngon khyo hi/tshur spyon 'khor dang bcas ma tre sha la rol gcig mchod par bzhes:dmar chen khrag la rol cig mchod par bzhes:gsur chen tshal la rol cig mchod par bzhes:rus chen rkang la rol cig mchod par bzhes:dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa la khā hi khā lag btas ba/ma mo thams cad dbyings su dgyes phyag na dbang drag phur pa 'dril bsad mnan spar ba'i las mdzod cig tshwa bho : che ge mo la dzaḥche mchog ma mo'i lha tsho gis rnams zhal gdangs ljags 'dril tshems gtsigs nas dgra bgegs dam nyams zhal du btab bo kha raṃ khā gi ma hā me sa/ma hā rak+ta/go ro tsa na ya kha raṃ khā sti

rgyal dbang lnga par gdas blo yong rgya ma tsā gsung 'bum/ ()yul cig srang yul pa tra na btsan mo rdo rje ye shes mchogo:mthing nag drag shul rngam pa'i zhal:me bya mdzes pa'i thul pa gsol gser dang g.yu yi thod gdengs can:chibs su 'ol mo kha khra bcibs:'khor du sman mo stong gis bskor bsgo yo bu snying dang gtor mas bskang bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnams sgrubs bh+yo/yul cig snye mo dbang yul na khrung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum mthing na gag dugapa'i rngams tshul can:na bza' mu men mdzes ba gsol brag nag spungs pa'i thod gdengs can chibs su drel nag rting dkar bcibs:'khor du sman mo stong gis bskor:bgos bu snying dang gtor mas bskang :bdag gi bsam ba'i don rnams sgrubs bh+yo/yul cig dbu ru snye mtshams na rab stims rdo rje drag mo rgyal dkar mo gser g.yu'i thod gdengs can na bza' smug nag 'bar ba gsol ral pa'i thor tshugs lcags thod 'dzin chibs su 'brong chen rwa dgu bcibs:'khor du sman mo stong gis bskor:bsgos bu snying dang gtor mas bskang :bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnamasasgrubs:/yul cig kong yul bre sna na kong btsun rdo rje bod khams skyong sku mdog 'ja' tshon spel legs 'di smug nag me stag 'bar ba gsol:gser ra lta ci spel ba'i thod gdengs can chibs su rta nag rting dkar 10ba ) bcib 'khor du sman mo stong gis bskor bsgos bu snying dang gtor mas bskang :bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnams sgrubs bh+yo/yul cig na len bri len na la ro rdo rje sman cig ma sku mdog sngo nag nam mkha' ltar sprin nag spungs pa'i thul pa gsol ral pa'i zar bu g.yas rnams g.yon du 'khyil:chibs su rkyang bu dkar bcibs 'khor du sman mo stong gisabaskor bshos bu snying dang gtor mas bskang :bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnams sgrubs:/yulacig dar tshon gser gdengs na khug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil sku mdog gzi 'od 'bar ba la na bza' g.yu yi stong zhol gsol:gser g.yu spungs pa'i thod gdengs can chibs su chu rta sngon po bcibs 'khor du sman mo stong gis bskor bsgos bu snying dang gtor mas bskang :bdag gisabasam pa'i don rnams sgrubs bh+yo/yul cig gnaX mtsho phyug mo na g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gsung snyan

bod skyong gan ma ༄ gnyis kyi mdo kyi tson las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma 9)ma dkar mo mdangs ldan 'od 'phro ma na bza' ser khra 'bar ba gsol:gser g.yu spel ma'i thod gdengs can chis su chu glang zal po chabs 'khor du sman mo stong gis bskor:bsgos bu snying dang gtor mas bskang :bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnams sgrubs ho/dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi srung ma wo mo//mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i gtso mo chen mo//slob dbon pad+ma'i bran g.yog chen mo//sgrub wo rnams kyi bka' nya wo mo//nor dang chos kyi gter srung r+pā mo//bod khams stong ba'i bstan ma 1na thin mo//gsang sngags sgrub pa'i snar 'byor tsho mo//dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mas mo che//nad pa gso ba'i byin rlabs can/khre'u gso ba'i dpal mo che//rno mthong ston pa'i mngon shesamakhan//phyugs ma skyong ba'i g.yag rdzi mo//sngon tshe khas blangs dam bcas bzhi dam rdzas ma rdzo gtor 'di bzhes la bod khams rtag tu bde ba dang :rims nad yams nad bcad du gsol:rnal 'byor 'khor sa sa bsrung ba dang :nad dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod chags che kho nga thams cad bzlog dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog 'phrin las bzhi sogs dngos grub tso sgrub pa po la myur du stsol:la la/li li/ta ta/te te/mam/tshe me/rdo rje sring 'gro ma3 bh+yo/mahā pañtsa 'a hi/hūṃ/dpal gyi sprul pa'i rdo rje 'dzin rdo rje ca grags dkar gsal mdo sgan bza' 'ja' ris 'brug sngon bcibs ma rdzo gtor 'di bzhes wen las mdzod rdo rje spyan mthing ser nag mdog sprin phung gos can sha mo changs mchod gtor 'di bzhes wen las mdzod rdo rje g.yu bun dmar gsal mdog gangs dkar gos can stag khrag bcibs mchod gtor 'di bzhesawen las mdzod:rdo rje bgegs gtso dmar smug mdog dkar mdzes gos can 'brong wo bcibs mar gtor ba 'di bzhes wen las mdzod rdo rje kun bzang shel dkar mdog dar dkar gos can yu mo bcibs mchod gtor 'di bzhes 'phrin las mdzod:rdo rje btsan mo mthing nag rngams rma bya'i gos can 'ol mo bcib mchode gtor 'di bzhes 'phrin las mdzod rdo rje khyung btsun mthing nag rngams mu men gos can drel /ga bcibs mchod gtor 'di bzhes 'phrin las

'ja' tshon mdog:smug nag gos can rta nag bcibs:mchod gtor 'di bzhes tshon las mdzod rdo rje sman cig nam mkha'i mdog sprin dkar gos can rkyang bu bcibs mchod gtor 'di bzhes 'phrin las mdzod:rdo rje khug chos gzi 'od 'bar:g.yu yi gos can rta zhol bcibs:mchod gtor 'di bzhes 'phrin las mdzod rdo rje g.yu dril dkar mdangs can na bza' ser khra chu glang bcibs:mchod gtor 'di bzhes 'phrin las mdzod:kun med sgrubs bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod ces pa'i spos dang rol mo dang phud dang gtor ma phyog phar mchod gang 'dod re ba rdzog par 'gyur dpal gyi thugs sprul bdud mo bzhi spyir ni 'phrin las zhing bstan bshig rnams gang 'tsham chad pas

bod skyong bstan ma ༄ gnyis kyi mdos kyi phren las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma 6)'dul bar mdzod sngags tsā ma la'ang gang 'dod sbyar ba yin/hūṃ/sku las mngon par sprul pa yi:sman btsun nang gsang ba'i dga' ba bzhi dbyer med ye shesabazhi dang bcas:bcu drug bdag nyid r+pā po ma snang srid thams cad mchod bstod bzhes:lugasa'abyung lugs ldog rten 'brel rnams:dga' bzhi'i ngo bor rnam rlangs bdud chen dang :sman btsun chen mo rol pa las sman btsun ye shes chen mo bzhi /ma zla dus bzhis thugs dam bskang :mthar thug

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo phyong rgya mtsho'i gsung tshom/ rtonabade chen zung 'jug las snang srid bde r+sā gcig tu 'khyil snang ba yab la stong pa yum rig rtsal sras kyi lis dang bcas 'khor 'das ro mkho thugs dam bskang :bskang ngo ma rdzo do ma wo lis ngos grub dam pa deng 'dir sngo:dza'i po gtso/hūṃ/rdo rje tshod43sar lho/dbang phyug ye shes khro rgyal gtso gdug pa'i dbang gis khro byed ma nag mo khrag 'thung gser gyi ral pa can:sbyang me bu yug 'khyil bas dbu la brgyan sbrul gyi gdengs kas klu rnamasadabang du sdud nyi zla rked brgyan khams gsum zel gyis gnon ro dang bong bu wo nag ral pa gyen du 'khyil ba yi dpal ldan lha ri'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod bong bu wo nas bdud dpung g.yob par byed gangs kyi yum wo sku la phyag 'tshal bstod rnga mo smo nasastong gsum zil gyis gnon:'byog r+ṣa 'khor 'dul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod dkar r+ṣa ral sprug srin po dbang du sdud gangs dkar sha med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod ljang ser ral pa 'bar ba'i thor tshugs tso kha rag khyung bas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod 'ol po smo nas gnod sbyin gtso mo mdzad:ser ོ mkha' lding sku la phyag 'tshal bstod dmar na gar la ba wor wo dom nag rgyug me ri sgo stims sku la phyag 'tshal bstod dkar dmar mdangs can sha smo grong khyer rgyug kong bas de mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod ser nag ral ba sprug cing mdzo mo wo ba 'a la ra rog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod ral pa sprugs la /༷ wo bu yis 'debs mo btsun lkug chos sku la

bod skyong gan ma bcaganyi kyi mdos kyi skrun las dpyid kyi rgyal 0glu dbyangs/ nang ma (pephyag 'tshal bstod ral ljang dgo zhen srid pa 'khyam par rgyug g.yu yi dril snyan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod 'dir spyon dgra bo'i zhun chen tshil la gsol dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la:bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod:bh+yo/bdag wo wo mo tog kho/rdo rje kun grags mo chis su chu glang bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdo kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma (gelas mdzod brgyad bdang du bsngu ba ni/ rang nyid khro bo'i bskyed rim gsang che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed la/ hūṃ/ nga to gto gsal zlog gi g.yi / ni che mchog he ru gaḥ nga ni pad+ma dbang chen yin sku ni ri rab bas kyang che: gsung gis/ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog shangs nas bskal pa'i 'thor rlung 'tshub: mig nas me yi phung po 'bar:smin ma khro gnyer rba rlabs 'khrug: ral pa kham nag srid rtser 'bar: phyag mtshan mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrug dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas nga : khro rgyal thams cad sku la rdzogs gzi brjid phyogs bcur me ltar 'bar: bskal pa'i me yi klong dkyil na: dregs pa ma lus las la 'khol: khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud: 'jig rten khams kun g.yo 'gul byed dam las 'da' ba'i snying khrag 'thung : bdud dang log 'dren zhabs kyis gnon dam nyams ma lus srog nas gzir dbang gi rgyal po las 'chol gyis: nga yi bka' las gang 'da' ba: lus sems rdul du rlag pa byed: de bas dam can ma (17ba〉rus pa gong gong chum chum dam la 'du: zho lha/ swā hā/ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka ya mān+ta ga pad+ma kro dhī shwa ri badz+ra gī li ki lā ya tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro kha ṇa/ kā la rū pa/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha pad+ma bas mu ka ā po'o ya/ ā rka〉 ya/ ban+ta ya ༷ ya/ to sha yā to sha yā/ mo ha yā mo ha yā/ shrī ma hā kā la sarba rū pa badz+ra sarba du sti sarba ḍā ki ni hri da ya/ ha ha hi hi/ e a ra li hūṃ dzaḥ zhes brgya rtsabs bzlas la dbang du bsdu'o/ /dgu pa bsnyen cing bsgrub pa la/ ma yengs par srog gi snying po nas 'bod pa ni/ badz+ra a ra li dzaḥ badz+ra a ra li snro badz+ra ti ti : : badz+ra bha ra : : badz+ra sa bya sno badz+ra ti ti snro badz+ra ma ti sno badz+ra ṣi ba snribadz+ra kha ra li sno badz+ra ying po snro badz+ra sag sha phyir: badz+ra du phyir sar na phaṭa: ma dung bh+yo: ma dung bh+yo: ྅ hūṃ dza dzaḥ zhes bzla zhing dmigs pa dang zhi rgyas dbang drag ge kha skur sogs zhal las shes so/ /r+sā pa mdos glud kye rabs dang / yas kyi chos drang 'don pa ni zur du sheng par bya ri/ /༅ snyag pa mdos bsto sto lon las las pa ba ni/ bh+yo /gnam byang gter sgos mdos gyi bar snang lha mo bstan ma ri: nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs pa yi:gnam gyi bu mo 'phrul mo che: gos su mun kwa/ nag po gyon: dgu tshigs mdzes pa'i thod ldem can:bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas: mdos bdag chen mos mdos long la glud bdag chen mos —353

ljang sngon gsol:gza' skar mang po'i 'khor dang bcas:bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas:zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas:drel po'i khal dang bcas:mdos bdag chen mos mdos long la glud bdag chen mo glud bzhes shig:bh+yo/lho phyogs nag mo mche ba can na bza' zhing lpags rlon pa gsol:gser gyi thod ldem thor tshugs can:bran g.yog 'tshub ma bcibs dgra lha'i rgyal mor bzhugs pa yi:bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas:sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas:drel rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bdag chen mo glud bzhes shig bh+yo/mo btsun khug chos g.yar mo bsil gsang mtshan rdo rje g.yar mo rgyal na bza' ci yang ma nges te:mu tig dkar po'i thod ldem can:'khor ni sha za 'bum gyisabaskor:chibs su sman sha yu mo bcibs bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas:sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas:drel rta mang po'i khal dang bcas:mdos bdag chen mos mdos long la glud bdag chen mo glud bzhesashig spyo/kong bas de mo rdo rje bod khams stong :gsang mas rdo rje gnyis med 'od 'bar ma:na bza' smug nag btibs pa la:'jigs su rung pa'i me stag 'phro:gser gyi thod ldem thor tshugasacan:chibs su sprin dkar ngang pa bcibs:'khor ni ma bdud mang pos bskor:lo gshed btsa' dang mu ge'i bdag bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas:sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas:zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas:drel rta mang po'i khal dang bcas:mdos bdag wo mos mdos long la glud bdag wo mos glud bzhes20na shig:bh+yo/ting ting gangs kyi dkar mo shag:gsang mtshan rdo rje kun grags ma:na bza' bya rgod thul ba gsol:nag mo mig gcig dung gi thor tshugs can lcags kyi lan phran mche ba can:'khor du chu sman 'bum gyisabaskor:sa bdag rims kyi bdag mo ste:bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas:drel rta mang po'i khal dang bcas mdos bdag chen mos mdos long la glud bdag chen mo glud bzhes shig bh+yo/legs sbyor yi ge'i gser thang mo gsang mtshan rdo rje kun tu bzang :na bza' gser gyi mdo lo ris rin chen brtsegs pa'i thod ldem can:chibs su lha 'bri dkar mo bcibs:'khor ni gangs sman 'bum gyis bskor bka' yi gangs sman bzang mo'i yum bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas:sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas:zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas drel rta mang po'i khal dang ba/sa:mdos bdag wo mos mdos long la glud

—/wa ge ge ge ge༄ba nyis kyi mdos kyi tshon las dpyad ku sto mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma 6)bad ga chen cho glud bzhes shig:bh+yo/g.yu yi drel rta zu le mo:gsang mtshan rdo rje ye shes mchoge:na bza' gcod kyi thul ba gsol g.yu yi dril bu sil li ma:chibs su gtsod po kha dkar bcibs 'khor 20bdu byang sman 'bum gyis bskor dbyar bzhin mi srun lcags ral ma dgun bzhin mi srun rlung nag skru tshub ma'i bdag:bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas:zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas:drel rta mang po'i bal dang bcab mdos bdag chen mos mdos long la glud bdag che na mos glud bzhes shig:bh+yo/bang gi 'brog ma na g.ya' mo skyong:gsang mtshan rdo rje dril bu ma na bza' g.yag lpags rlon pa gsol lcags kyi thod ldem thor tshugs can:chibs su 'brong po kha dkar bcibs:'khor du byang gi 'byog mas mang pos bskor mi la gnod cing sdig byed ma bran g.yog mang pa'i 'khor dang bcas:sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas:zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas:drel rta mang po'i khal dang bcas:mdos bdag chen mos mdos long la:glud bdag chen mos glud bzhes shig skyo/nam mkha'i rgyal mo khong ting shagacigs nga mtshan rdo rje dpal 'bar shag:na bza' bya rgod thul pa gsol:rin chen mdzes pa'i thod ldem can chibs su sman sha yu mo bcibs:g.yu yi dngul chu ya la la:ser ba khu 'phang thag gi bdag 'khor du gnam sman stong gis bskor:bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas:sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab 21na skob mang po' rgyan dang bcas zang zing mang po' glud dang bcas:drel rta mang po'i khal dang bcas mdos bdag chen mos mdos long la glud bdag wo mos glud bzhes shig:bh+yo/gangs kyi ram shag la ro sman gcig ma:gsang mtshan rdo rje rtsal ma kun grags ma na bza' bya rgod thul ba gsol mtha' ma chu bdud mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor:bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcasasil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas:lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas zang zing mang po'i glud dang bcas:drel rta mang po'i khal dang bcas mdos ༷dag chen mos mdos long la glud bdag chen

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemo glud bzhes shig: de phyir gnas 'dir ma sdod par: bh+yo bh+yo dam nyams dgra la bh+yo zlog zlog dam nyams dgra la zlog zlog sgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: kye/ yul tog khog yul zlog /ni lho kha mon kha na: glan thang ma mo btsun gyi lcam mo ni: gdung rus btsun te glan bza' mo: lho yi skyi mthing g.ya' ma skyong : g.yag lpags rlone pa'i slog pa la: khyung gshog stong gi sham thabs can: phyag na zangs kyi phur pa bsnams: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs sngon mo ma bdun 'khor dang bcas: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la: bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas cho de: : badz+ra hūṃ badz+ra li li ma hūṃ bh+yo: bh+yo/ yul (21ba ji gsang 'phyo la gnasan: gangs kyi yum chen g.yu bun ma: gdung rus gnyen te sha bza' mo: dgra lha'i rgyal mo lcam gcig ma seng ge dkar po'i g.yang gzhi gyon: tshibs su seng ge dkar po bcibs: phyag na rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams dkar mo ma bdun 'khor dang bcas: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas chod: ྅ lo 'greng badz+ra tib tib ting ting badz+ra ma ཿ bh+yo/ yul ni kha rag yul drug na 'dar bu stong thang rje yi lcam: gdung rus btsun te khyung mo bza': kha rag khyung btsun dpal gyi yum na bza' mi lpags rlone pa gyon mi snying khug pa'i sham thabs can: chibs su bya rgyal khyung chen bcibs: phyag na dug mda' stong nag bsnams:ser mo ma bdun 'khor dang bcas: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas da: / bh+yo ri li li hūṃ bh+yo dza dza dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo/yul ni dbyar yum char stod na dbyar thang gtsug gi lcam mo ni: gdung rus gnyan te dbyar bza' mo mo btsun ug chos dbyar mo bsil: sprul nag gtams pa'i g.yang gzhi gsol chibs su rna bu shad la bcibs: phyag na seng ldeng phur ba bsnams: dmar nag ma bdun 'khor dang bcas: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di (22na tshe sgong la: bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas cho de: ྅ ma ma hūṃ/ badz+ra bo ma hā hā dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo/ kong yul de ni bre sna phu kong lha —358

bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma 6)dkar po'i lcam mo ni: gdung rus gnyan te kong bza' mo: kong btsun de mo bod khams skyong :seng lpags stong gi slog pa gsol: sprul nag gtams pa'i sham thabs can: chibs su kong rta dkar po bcibs: phyag na khrag gi bum pa bsnams: nag mo ma bdun 'khor dang bcas: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la: bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyamasartsad nas chad: ྅ kho chad chad ma hri bh+yo dzaḥ dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo/ yul ni she yul she stod na: gangs dkar rdzong gi kha shed na: dung ru dkar po'i lcam mo ni: gdung rus gnyan te she bza' mo: sha med gangasadakar sman ga ṇi ga ma dung gi khu 'phang sku la gsol: g.yu yi ska rags thams se tham: chibs su dung sha dkar po bcibs: phyag na khrag gi rkyal pa bsnams: gangs sman 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas:khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la: bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas chad: ྅ badz+ra dza la rda hūṃ ting bh+yo dza dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo/ yul ni byang 'brog sna brgyad na:'byong rje thang lha'i lcam mo ni: gdung rus gnyan te 'brong bza' mo: byang gi 'phrog srin 'khor 'dul ma glang nag stong (22ba〉she slog pa la: khyung ba khog stong gi gshog pa can: chibs su gser sha yu mo bcibs phyag na lcags kyi phur pa bsnams: sa bdag ma bdun 'khor gyis bskor khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyamasartsad nas chod: / badz+ra ti ba shel hūṃ sring he he ha hūṃ bh+yo dzaḥ dgra po'i srog la bh+yo: bh+yo/ yul ni rma yul thang brgyad na: rma chen sbom ra'i lcam gcig ma gdung rus gnyan te rma chen bza' byang gi sman ting ting mo btsun: g.yag lpags stong gi slog pa la: khyung gshog stong gi gshog pa can: chibs su 'byong bu rwa dgu bcibs: phyag na mchong gi phur pa bsnams: nyi 'od ma bdun 'khor gyis bskor khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas cho de: lha bh+yo badz+raki li gī la hūṃ dza dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo/ yul ni yar klungs ya phug na: yar lha sham po'i lcam mo ni: gdung rus gnyan te she'u bza' mo: g.yu yi dril bu sil li ma: sku la spyang —359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheki'i slog pa gyon mi rtsib brgyus pa'i sham thabs can: chibs su g.yu yi seng mo bcibs phyag na g.yu yi dril bu bsnams: sngon mo ma bdun 'khor dang bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab:mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas chod: ྅ shel (23na)kha sa pra si ha ra hūṃ bh+yo dza dgra bo'i srog la bh+yo: bh+yo/ yul ni rta yul spang bkra na: rta ka shar gyi lcam mo ni: gdung rus gnyan te rta bza' mo: dkar mo mig gcig mche ba can: rta la btsan po sman gcig ma: mi mgo brtsegs pa'i thul pa gsol: chibs su phag rgod nag po bcibs phyag na zhing gi dbyug pa bsnams: dkar mo ma bdun 'khor dang bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la: bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas chod: ྅ nai nai rdu hūṃ bh+yo dza dza dgra bo'i srog la bh+yo: bh+yo/ yul ni la yul la stod na gnod sbyin snying 'phrog lcam mo ni gdung rusaganyan te la bza' mo btsan la 'a rog sman gcig ma: gu le dkar po'i stod g.yogs la stag lpags stong gi sham thabs can: chibs su drel nag kha ser bcibs lag na ba so'i phur bu bsnams dmar mo ma bdun 'khor dang bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas cho de: ྅ nyung hu ma bh+yo dza dza dgra la bh+yo:bh+yo/ yul ni byang yul byang stod na: skyi mthing gangs kyi la ra sman sbrul nag stong gi thul ba la g.yag lpags stong gi sham thabs can phyag na bya rgod phur bu bsnams: chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon mo bcibs bka' nyan ma bdun 'khor dang bcas khyod kyi (23ba khrigs dam dus la bab mthun rdzas mdos glud 'di long la bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams rtsad nas cho de: ྅ o tshol a li ma hri ki li ma bh+yo hūṃ dza: dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo/ bod khams skyong ba'i mthu rtsal can: bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: sngon gyi slob dpon bka' bzhin du: dam tshig gnyan las ma 'da' bar 'brang rgyasamatshal gyi thig bran can gtsang ma'i bal de shub bes brgyan dbus su ma mo'i sku rten bzhugs:mda' khra g.yas la 'phang khra g.yon: ngar glud mtsho yungs brgyan pa mdun nam mkha' rgyang bu phrag —360

bod skyong bstan ma bcaganyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma (gepar btsugs khram bam nag po lag tu bskur: sem bu ngar bya la sogs pa mthun pa'i mdos glud 'di bzhes la: nad dang rims kyi dal kha rnams: bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra la sgyur: chags che nyam nga ma lus pa bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra la sgyur: khram kha shod kha dgra la phob: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo la: nag mo tshogs kyi khram sna thod ma ma nag mo dun ting ma: sa ma ya sarba dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo/shel gas gas/ dkar dbang sngon pad+ma rā ka dang : gser sbyangs las grub ri rab rtser: rin chen khang bzang bcu gnyis lcog rgya phubs nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ /dra ba dra phyed dril sgra 'brol/ /dar dbyangs nor bu'i rgyan gyis spras/ /srog shing dpag bsam ljon rtser gdugs/ /logs la gsal byed nyi zla bskor/ /rtsa bar gser ri rol mtsho bdun/ /(24na gling bzhi gling phran lcags ris bskor/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs ldan/ /yid 'phrog rngam brjid gnas kyi rten/ /rnam bkra nam mkha' sgro phod can/ /rgyang bu spel legs phreng bar bsgrigs/ /yul mkhar pho gdong mo gdong dang / /lha bdud ma mo klu dang btsan/ /gshin rje rgyal po gza' rgod byad/ /rbod gtong ma mo'i khrag zor sogs/ /gnod byed ma lus bzlog pa'i khram/ /mda' khra 'phang khra thabs shes tshul/ /rnam par shes pa tshe srog dbugs/ /phung khams skye mched dbang po lnga/ /tshang ba'i ngar glud rgyan gos can/ /'byor ldan yid 'ong 'bum phrag spel/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga/ /ba po shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun/ /btso ma gser gyi brog zhu la/ /lha dang mi yi rin po che/ /yid 'phrog sna tshogs phra yis spud/ /gser g.yu mu tig spel ba'i thod/ /thod mdzes gser la g.yu yis spras/ /brag nag spungs pa'i thod bcingasarngam/ /rna rgyan gdu bu mgul pa brgyan/ /se ral kha dang dar zab kyi/ /dkar ser dmar ljang nag smug ber/ /sbrul nag stong sbrel g.yang gzhi dang / /g.yag lpags tho pa'i sham thabs can/ /'ja' tshon rnam pa bkra ba'i gos/ sham thabs khyung gshog las grub pa/ /chu 'dzin dkar po'i thul pa dang / /seng lpags gangs dkar spungs pa'i gos/ /glang nag stong gi slog pa dang / /na bza' g.yu yi mtha' 'jag can/ /dung gi khu 'phang na bza' la/ /(24bsti5dzes byed g.yu yis ska rags spras/ /—36/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedar dkar g.yu yi mtha' can gos/ /rma bya'i thod dang zhing lpags kyi/ /slog pa mi snying sham thabs dang / /rma bya'i sgro thul rab tu bkra/ /mi mgo brtsegs pa'i thul pa klubs/ /tse ber mu med mtha' 'jag can/ /bya rgod thul pa sbrul sham dang / /smug nag zab gos me stag 'phro/ /gyi ling dkar po'i pags pa'i gos/ /sprin nag spungs pa'i thul ba dang / /stag sham spyang slog mi'i rtsib ma/ /srad bur brgyus pa'i sham thabs tshogs/ /bya rgod rkang dang zangs lcags mchod/ /bse dang seng ldeng phur pa'i mtshon/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan me long dang / khram shing shang lang rdo rje'i zhags/ /thod khrag rdo rje tshe'i bum pa/ /be con ru mtshon rtse lnga pa/ /ral gri khrag rgyal zor ba mda'/ /cang te'u zhing dbyug dug sbrul zhags/ /par bu gzhed pa mda' dar snying / /rin chen sgrom bu lhab lhub dar/ /'brang rgyas ting shag g.yu'i dril bu/ 19/rin chen pad+ma 'dab stong 'dzum/ /g.yu 'brug sha ba chu glang rta/ /rkyang ser bong bu 'brong g.yag 'bro/ /rnga mo dre'u rlung nag 'tshub/ /stag khyung gyer ling 'ol ba dom/ sha ba rwa bcu mi dred rngams/ /'phar ba rlung gis bskyod pa'i sprin/ /rus sbal mgo dgu btsod mdzo rtol/ /bgrang yas bzhen pa bsam mi khyab/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ra lug khyi/ /ce spyang gsa' gzig khrung khrung dkar/ /bya rog rgod glag bse bya khra/ /go bo ngang pa gla ba dang / /dgo ba rna ba rgya la sogs/ /(25na〉nan ma la 'phur dgu sa 'og tu/ /'dzul dgu'i ri dwags 'phyo dgu'i tshogs/ /rdo rje'i go khrab btsan po'i rmog /zhol btags rnga gcus 'ja' ris can/ /phub dang lcags gzhibs rang srung go /gri gug ral gri dgra sta mdung / /sgrogs dang dpag chen mda' bo che/ /pha rol 'joms pa rdo rje'i mtshon/ /bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta'i mtsho/ /rtag gtor rgyun gtor bskang gtor spungs/ /'brang rgyas bskos bu ting lo sbar/ /sman le khrag sna'i dbus skyu dang / khrag kong ngar mi mdzes sdug brjid/ /seng ge mi dang ba lang dkar/ /stag mo pu shud rma bya khyung / /'jol mo bya rgod ce spyang ded/ /'phar ba sgrul la sogs pa yi/ /sha sna mi gcig stong phrag bshams/ /mi rta ba lang la sogs pa'i/ /snying sna 'bum phrag gcal du bkram/ /brgya phrag shing tog ro bda'i zas/ /brum thud phye mar khur ba tsha/ /gro nas sran 'bras so ba —362

bod skyong bstan ma ༅ gnyis kyi mdos kyi wen las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i shā dbyangs/ nang ma (gekhre//'bru sna ka ra bu ram sbrang //sna tshogs zas sna'i bye brag tshogs//ja chang zho chu rnam grangs stong //'o chol gser skyems btung ba bskyil//be+e ḍā dmar gad dbang sngon shel//pad rā ka gzi g.yu mu tig mchong //byu ru nal gser dngul zangs lcags//sna tsho gos lha mi'i rin po che/kha dog rnam mang zab gos dang //ras snam stag gzig la sogs pa'i//mtha' yas srog chags pags pa dang //btsod dang zhun mkhan rams skag mtshal//bzang drug tsan dan a ga sa/ga pur spos 25bsogs sman sna stong //dzornga zom rnga rnga bo che//rkang gling dung chen rgya gling dang //sgra snyan sil snyan pi wang glu//g.yab dar rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs bsgreng //thugs dam skong byed mthun pa'i rdzas/31/dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs//dpal ldan re ma tī la 'bul//bdud mo mched bzhi'i tshogs la 'bul//gnod sbyin mched bzhi'i tshogs la 'bul//sman mo mched bzhi'i tsho gos la 'bul//mdos bdag chen mos mdos bzhes shig/glud bdag chen mos glud bzhes shig/dgyesapa chen pos 'phrin las bzhi'i//bsam pa'i don kun lhun grub mdzod/dgags cing bzlog sgyur lasalak+ṣa pha/bh+yo/ga45skos/slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis//bstan ma bgraganyis khyed rnams kyi/khrog gi snying po nyer blangs nas//dbang bskur dam la btags min nam//byang gi gnam mtsho phyug mo sa/ting ting gangs kyi dkar mo shag/bdag nyid wo mo khyod mas du//rdo rje kun grags ma ru btags//mon yul jo mo lha ri sa/rdo rje g.yu sgron gangs sman dkar//skyin mthing khyod kyi gsang ba'i mtshan//rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong zhes btags//brin gyi la phyi chu dbar du//dpal ldan bkra shisatshe ring ma//gser thang mo khyod gsang mas du//rdo rje kun tu bzang mor ba khas//yar 'byog g.yu mtsho phyug mo sa/'brog chen lha lcam rdor dril ma//g.ya' mo skyong khyod gsang mtshan la//'khor 26na 'das rdo rje bgegs gtsor btags//lha phu gangs ri dkar po sa/gangs kyi yum chen 'od 'bar ma/sha med khyod kyi gsang ba'i mtshan//rdo rje g.yu bun ma ru btags//tu mtshams rjo mo bar ga sa/stong thad rje lcam khyung bza' mo/khyung btsuX khyod kyi gsang ba'i mas//rdo rje dpal gyi yum

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()du ba khas//byang stod dmar gyi mtsho 'gram du//bawo mo rdo rje ye shes mgo/khong ṣi shag khyod gsang ba'i mtshan//mkha' lding rdo rje klu mor btags/khams kyi rma chen sbom ra'i mgul//byang gi ting ting ting mo btsun//ser mo las mkhan gsang mtshan du//rdo rje drag mo rgyal zhes btags/shar phyogs kong yul bre sna mā/kong btso/ de mo 'od 'bar ma//kong bza' mo khyod gsang ba'i mas//rdo rje bod khams skyong du btags//se gnyal lo ro'i gnas mchog tu//gangs kyi ram shag la ro sman//rtsal mo grags khyod gsang mtshan du//rdo rje sman gcig ma ru btags//gtsang gi jo mo nags rgyal du//sman btsun khug chos g.yar mo rgyal//g.yar gza' mo khyod gsang ba'i mtshan//rdo rje g.yar mo bsil du btags//bud kyi jo mo g.yu ri la//rdo rje ye shes g.yu dril ma/khe bza' mo khyod gsang mtshan du//rdo rje gzugs legs ma zhes btags//gzhan yang glang chen dpal seng dang //gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes so gos/grub brnyes rig sngags 'chang mang pos//bka' dang dam la btags min nam/khyad par nyang ral yab 26bsras dang //chos dbang thugs sras pad ma dbang //dmar zhabs ras 'a grags rgyan pa//bkra shis mas can shes rab 'od//chos blo dbang phyug blo grosadang //bsod seng 'jam dbyangs blo gros zhabs//dam pa chos tshul nam mkha' dpal//'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan pad+ma dbang //legs ldan rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs//dbang rab mgon po bsod nams mchog/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol sogs//rtsa brgyud bla mas bdag cag gi/grogs por gto do gci ma ga//mdza' bor gto do khrel ma bor//bran du gto do rkang ma ngan//mthu rtsal ma zhan 'phrin las sgrubs/khyod la 'phrin las gtad pa ni//bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde rnams spel//sa spyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas//bod khams ru bzhi'i rgyal khams kyi//mi nor phyugs gsum bsrung zhing skyobs//bdag cag dmigs byar bcas pa'i tsha//zad kyang lo brgya'i bar du srings//chos srid dpal 'byor legs tshogs rnams//yar ngo' zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod//rigs 'dzin bdag cag yon mchad rnams//snang srid lha srid sde brgyad kyis//byad du bcug na 64

bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma (gebyad thag chod/ khram la babs na khram kha phyis/ tag la bkod na sho rdo spos/ /nad la babs na nad kha sgyur/ /zlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod/ /gzhan yang bar du gcod byed pa'i/ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang / /stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs/ /sum brgya drug cu'i (27na rdzi 'drog gdon/ /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang / /dus min 'chi ba rnam pa brgyad/ /ltasang na brgyad cu rtsa gcig rnams/ /zlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod/ /'brum nag 'bum yang lhog pa dang / /skrangs pa bal ldag g.yan pa'i nad/ /mdze shu phol mig skya rbab rlung / /glo gzer sha ya mig ser dang / /rgya nad sha ser khrag gi nad/ /gzer thab le brgan rgyu gzer dang / khrag skyug mkhal nad la sogs pa/ /zlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod/ /bal nad smyo 'bog slo rdol dang / /g.yul 'brug 'thab rtsod mi kha za/ /dug sbyor bsam ngan grosang na bshams/ /rmis ltas nyams dang mtshan ma ngan/ /geg sri ngan pa langs pa dang / /chags che nyam nga la sogs pa'i/ /bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /zlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod/ /bstan skyong 'khor bcas mthu rtsal skyed/ /nad gdon bar gcod dgra bgegs kun/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /gas7pa glud las rnams byin gyis brlabs nas gtong ba/ ban gsum mdos glud bsgyur zhing khrom sna bsgyur ba/ bas bzhi bsgo dbye zhing mdos glud kyi la mo bstan pa/ bco lnga pa gser skyems gtong ba/ ban drug pa mjug zor gyi gcad pa/ bstobadun pa las gzhi dre rnams ra lha'i gter byon bzhin bya/denas mdos rnams phyir bteg /gtor mar sleb pa dang gser skyems phul/ bh+yo/ bstan gsar sgrigs/ ma bcu gnyis mthu rtsal skyed/ /mdos yas 'di yi sna drongs la/ /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /nad gdon chags (27ba ji nyam nga dang / /byad phur gtad zor skeg sri ga/ /dmar bshal rgyu tshad gag lhog gzer/ /'brum pa be ge par pa ta/ /nywa log 'khru skyug la sogs pa'i/ /mi phyugs nad rigs ma lus pa/ /dgra dang bgegasakyi steng du sgyur/ /zlog sgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces bzlog pa bya wo / rol mo brdung / mar char ba/snyo lngags brdul / sbyor gdab/ me chu'i rgyas 'debs bya zhing phyi mig mi lta bar nang du log /hoḥ 'di gsar sgrigs/ ltar —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin/ /mi mdzad nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs nas/ /yar la mchod cing mar la byin pa'i mthus/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs gyur cig /sku gsung thugs rnams mnyes shing rab tshim pas/ /sgrib gnyis bar gcod kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas/khams gsum dbang 'dus dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ tshe 'gugs shing bkra shis brjod pa sogs mjug spyi ltar bya'o/ /'di ni nad rims bzlog pa sogs bzlog mdos gtso bor byas pa yin gyi bskang mdos byed na de ga'i kha bsgyur dang / mdos rnams yang thog tu mdos glud so sor gtong ba/ rten mdos su byed na de ga'i phyag len phra zhib rnams mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon yun du bsten te gsang chen rnying ma'i ring lugs zhakhrul pa med pa khong du chud par byas nas nyams su bstar bar bya'o/ /smras pa/ a ho dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa las/ /'dod pa'i re ba yongs su bskong ba bzhin/ /bod skyong bstan (28nasgo mnyes byed cho ga yis/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las lhun gyis cis mi 'grub/ /rgya bod mkhas grub ma dros klung chen las/ /mdos gtor mchod pa'i 'phrin las gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /blo ldan khyab 'jug dga' ba'i zhabs bsil du/ /sbreng yang skam ngan brag rtser ga la 'bab/ khyad par phyon mkhan po pad+ma zhes/ /'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags 'chang ba de'i/ /thugs bcud bka' gter 'phrin las grangs mang yang / /tshad ldan shes pa'i sngags 'chang nyin skar tsam/ /skye mang rgyud dang rigs rus stobs 'byor khris/ /bsnyems pa'i snga 'gyur ban sngags phal mo che/ /mi smra'i gnyid la g.yur na tha snyad dang / /rtog ge'i tshig bo shad mkhan gyi spyod yul min/ /de phyir rigs kun khyab bdag mes rnams kyis/ /zab don gdams pa'i rin chen thod bcings mthus/ /sgrub phrin gling bzhi yongs la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i mang bkur rgyal sar son/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sa gzhin nyes brgya'i shing / /rtsa ba sbom por skyed du yongs bsrings pa/ /'phrin las rnon po'i mtshon gyisadrungs phyung ste/ /rang rig kun bzang ye grol mngon 'gyur shog /de'ang dpal skyon chen po'i zhal —366

bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ nang ma (gelung las/ nye bar 'ongs pa'i lung bstan mang por bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs su bstan ma'i sgos mdos gal che bar gsungs kyang deng sang ha cang gi grags mi che zhing / lha brag gter byon gyi sgos mdos snying po tsam las sbyor dngos rjes gsum mtha' dag mi gsal ba 'dug par lung bstan dus bab kyi rtsod bral gter ston (28ba tshe sprul pa'i sku 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pas 'di skor la chog sgrigs bklags chog ma lta bu byung na legs pa yod 'dug ces gsung gleng gnang ba dang rang nyid kyang 'dri ba'i mdun pa yod pa'i steng zhang sna dam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul pa'i sku mchog byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po'i yang srid blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'i gsung gis kyang bskul ba la brten nas/ kun tshang ba rgyas pa/ ser bzhag pa 'bring po/ ser tshos gnyi ga bzhag pa bsdus pa long skabs dang sbyar chog pa'i bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs 'di ni/ lha brag gter byon la gzhi byas/ gter kha gong 'og dang ra ka'i gter ma sogs nas legs cha bsdus/ cung zad kha 'geng dgos pa rnamasatshig sbyor gsar du bsgrigs te/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo zur chen chos dbyings rang grol gyi bka' drin la brten nas phyogs 'dir blo gros kyi snang ba dkar ba'i za hor gyi rigs las sngags smyon gang shar rang grol gyis thun mong zhes pa lcags khyi hor zla dgu pa'i dmar cha'i ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes dge bar pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so// //sarba maṅga lo/—367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedrang srong khyab 'jug rā hu la'i las byang dug mda' nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs/rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i tshogs/ gcig bsdus gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dbyer med dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas 'dud do brtse ba'i spyan gyis skyongs/ srid gsum dregs pa zil mnon mtsho skyes rje/ /drag sngags gter gyi sgo 'byed las 'brel rtsal/ /tshul 'dir mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams phyag gi yul/ /gang zhig las la sbyar na smos ci dgos/ /gdengs ldan gnad kyis bskul ba tsam gyis kyang / /dgra dpung phye mar 'thag pa rā hu la'i/ /phrin las dug mda' nag po deng 'dir spro/ /mchod gtor spyan gzigasardzas rnams brgyud ldan gyi/ /'byul med mthong brgyud phyag bzhes ltar bshams nas/ /bdag bskyed spyir btang dmigs gsal skabs thob rnams/ /dpyod ldan man ngag ji bzhin nyams su long/ /a khra tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad zla'i steng / /hūṃ las sna tsho gos rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ/ /mtshan par 'od los rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang/ /ra gur bla bre ye shes (2na〉 'bar ba'i/ /srung 'khor dbus su 'jigs rung dur khrod che/ khrag mtsho rba klong zhabrug dbus e las ni/ /gru gsum mthing nag mkha' mnyam lte ba la/ baṃ raṃ a : tri las pad+ma dang/ /nyi zla dgra bgegs gan rkyal bsnol ba'i steng/ /du ba'i mdog can tri las 'od 'phros pas/ /dgra bgegs tshar bcad tshur 'dus trir thim pas/ /gza' bdud dud kha zhal dgu'i steng dbus dkar/ /bya rog mgo bcas zhal rer dmar zlum spyan/ /sum ldan ral pa dmar ser gnam sa khyab/ /thod skam lnga pa rin chen rtse phran can/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan ral gri'i yu ba can/ /g.yas 'dzin g.yon par sprul zhags 'og ma gnyis/ /mda' gzhu 'geng zhing dug mda' dgra la 'phen/ /sku smad dug sprul 'khyil zhing 'jigs —368

drang srong khyab 'jug rwa hu la'i las byang dug mda' nag po/ nang ma (pepa'i kha/ /lto bar rab 'grad sku la spyan stong mdzes/ /ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phe phe sgra/ /zhal nas rab sgrog dgra bo che che gsol/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan che zhing yan lag rags/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od las lhag skur/ /sprul gyi do shal chun po se ral kha/ /mi mgo'i do shal dar nag rin chen rgyan/ /(2ba/ye lpags g.yang gzhi stag lhags sham thabs gsol/ kham bas gsum yongs su kheng ba'i par bzhugs pa'i g.yas/ khrag mtsho rus khrir rdo rje srin po yab/ /zla gam rak+ta ra rdo rje glog 'gyu yum/ /yab yum sras gsum nub dang shar lho byang / /lho nub shar dang nub byang lho dang ni/ /byang shar rnamasasu gdug can gdan steng na/ /ljang sngon chen po drang srong dkar ser dang / /bdud po rog ti biṣ+ṭi pa tra dang / /biṣ+ṭi rā dza du ba mjug ring dang / khyab 'jug chen po sgra gcan 'dzin pa ste/ /nang gi gza' chen rnams dang phyogs bzhi na/ /stag srin zor gdong bam srin dred kyi gdong / /kong srin glang gdong 'byog srin chu srin gdong / /gdong mo bzhin bcas de dag phyi rol tu/ /nyi ma zla ba la sogs gza' chen brgyad/ /bdud dang gshin rje la sogs lha srin brgyad/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs lha chen brgyad/ /dga' po 'jog po la sogs klu chen brgyad/ /smin drug la sogs rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang nag po stong gi tshogs/ sha za 'bum sdom mo bye ba dang / /lha dmag bye ba dung phyur la sogs pa/ /mdor na srid gsum 'byung po'i dmag tshogs bcas/ sha dga' khrag sred dbugs rngub ro la 'jib/ khro gtum cha lugs cho 'phrul cir yang ston/ /srid gsum thal bar rlog pa'i mthu stobs can/ /'khor gyis yongs bskor gtso 'khor thams cad kyi/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ /rang gyi thugs ka las byung 'od 'phros pas/ /gar bzhugs gnasanas gza' bdud rā hu la/ /'khor bcas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig rnams/ /dran pa tsam (3na gyisasngags 'chang bdag cag gi /las rnams bsgrub phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ hri shag tu ra ga raṃ na ge tsit+ta tre ma yong za 'gri ha hi ke she la dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni/ /hūṃ kun bzang sprul pa phyag na rdo rje yi/ /pho nya zhing bcu'i dgra bo 'dul ba la/ /'jig rten —369—

drang sgong khyab 'jug rā hu la'i la byang dug mda' nag po/ nang ma 9)bha ling gtor mas / /dza gad phud kyis / /bdud rtsi sna lngas / /khrag sna lnga yis / /chu sna lnga yis / /'dod yon gtor mas / /de ltar bskang ba gso gso nas/ /rnam 'byor nyams chags skong gyur cig /bstod pa ni/ //lhun grub sku gsum rol pa'i ngang nyid las/ /dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar 'byin khro gtum can/ /dregs pa kun gyi nang nas rdo 'phrul gyi/ /zla bral gza' bdud rā hu la la (4na tha stod/ /'jigs rung bzod bar dka' ba'i dur khrod nang / /dmar nag rba klong zhabrug pa'i khrag mtsho'i dbus/ /lhun po lta bu'i mi sdug srin po'i gzugs/ /rab 'bar bskal ba'i me dpung gyon la bstod/ /dmar zlum mig stong blta bas legs nyes da/ kha gdangs nyi ma zla ba sto ru za/ /rno ngar mtshon gyis brnag pa'i dgra snying 'bigs/ /dug sbrul zhags pas log 'dren 'ching la bstod/ /tsha grang 'thab pa'i rkan rdeb dug rlangs 'phyo/ /gnam lcags me yi thog 'bebs ser ba gtong / /dgra dpung yul bcas phye mar 'thag byed pa'i/ /srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba khyod la bstod/khyod kyi 'khor na phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /gza' chen brgyad dang gdong mo rnam pa bzhi/ /lha srin sdobargyad srid gsum 'byung po yi/ /grangs med dmag tsho gos 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /de nasabaskul zhing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ/ ska dang rog ti mgo dgu bya rog dbu/ /mgo brgyad gza' chen brgyad de gri rgod dang / /drang srong nad dang ser chen glo bur gzug /'jig rten stig dang lha srin ma lus dang / /srog gcod mu ge nad yams ska dang brgyad/ /log 'dren dgra la 'bebs pa'i dus la bab/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /gyi srin po'i gzugs can mgo dgu ro smad sprul/ /sna tsho gos mtsho ni 'dzin gnam lcags thog chen gyis/ /dgra bo ma lus gsod pa'i mthu bo che/ /lho nub mtshams nas sku bzhengs zla rjes spyod/ shar du brgyu zhing byang shar mtshams nas ni/ /sku bzhengs nyi ma'i rjes spyod nub tu brgyu/ /nyin (4bsgo tshan brgyu bas mtshams bzhi phyogs bzhi 'joms/ /dus tshod tshes grangasang ba lnga yi bdag /sdebargyad bran 'khol 'jig rten khams kun 'khrug /lo nyes 'khrug pa thog ser 'bebs—371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheshing gtong / /mdun du su byung khyur mid gtong byed pa'i/ /'jig rten 'di na zla bral mthu rtsal can/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' ma bsnyel bar/ /dam rdzas / /rnal 'byor:/ /hrīḥ ljang sngon ོ po drang srong dkar ser dang / /bdud po rog ti phri pa tra che/ /biṣ+ṭha ra dza du ba mjug ring dang / khu 'jug chen po sgra gcan 'dzin pa ste/ /gza' chen brgyad kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /sngon gyi khas blangasaḥ / /dam rdzas:/ /rnal 'byoraḥ/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sbas shing gab pa'i gdong mo mched bzhi ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'brug gi sgra sgrog cing / /bar snang khams nas drag po'i glog 'byug pa/ /ri rab rtse nas gnam lcags thog chen 'bebs/ khrung mo gdong mo mched bzhi'i dus la bab/ /sngon gyi khas blangs / /dam rdzas / /rnal 'byor / /'dzam gling phyogasamatshams nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas/ /bar snang khams la dbang sgyur gza' chen brgyad/ khyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs te/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sngon gyi / /dam rdzasaḥ/ /rnal 'byor / /chad mtho ni/ /sman rag sbran la/ /hūṃ/ sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis/ /sis rgya mtsho'i mtsho gling du/ /nam mkha'i gza' rnams dam la btags/ /brka' (ldan〉 gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ yar stod sha gangs kyi ra ba sa /rigasa'adzin r+ṣa po ku mā rā dza dang / /rdzogs wo rnal 'byor klong wo rab stims kyis/ /ye shes thig le'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /mnga' bdag gza' rnams ma lus thams cad kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang / /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba dang / /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar mchad dam/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ khres gtore ma skabs thob dang sbyar te skyel/de nas bris sku sogs yod na brtan bzhugs smon lam mjug chog rnams bya'o/ /de ltar drang srong —372

khyab 'jug nag po yi/ /las byang chad lhag med cing khyer bde 'di/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i btsas su bkod/ /skal med log lta can la gsang ba'i rgya/ /drang srong khyab 'jug rā hu la'i 'phrin las dug mda' nag po zhes bya ba 'di'ang / phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi rgyun 'byer du bde ba'i ched/ chos skyong 'di nyid nye bar bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i rig sngags rlung ba'i brgyud du son pa zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rjes chu pho rta lo khrums kyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi gral tshes la nye bar bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /sarba maṅga lo/
