rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khyab 'jug rten mdos kyi 'phrin las drang srong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar bzhugs/dregs 'dul gsang bdag ngo bo thod phreng rtsal//zab gter sgo 'byed rin wo tshul rdor sogs//rtsa gsum kun 'dus ngo bor gus btud nas/khyab 'jug rten mdos kha skong rim pa 'dri//de la 'dir gza' bdud chen po dug gi spu gri khyab 'jug rā hu la'i rten mdos kyi rim pa la/dregs 'dul gshin rje sogs yi dam gyi lha gang yang rung ba'i 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs/'dzab bzlas/de nas mdos byin gyis brlab pa la shes pa rnam pa bzhi las/ri rab gzhal yas su shes pa ni/sngon du phur pa gshin rje sogs yi dam gzhan gyi gzhung bsrangs na/bdag skyed bsgyur ba ni/stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du / las bdag nyid gtum po ni shin tu khros pa srin po'i gzugs//gdug pa'i steng na brkyang bskum bzhugs mthing nag rngam pasaphyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar g.yon pa sdigs mdzus mdzad pas khyung gi bya khra 'gyed 'dar rgyal zhal la rngam pas mche ba gtsigs spyan gsum gdangs pas bskal pa me ltar 'bar sma ra ag tsho mes smin 2nasgo bzhin du bsdus zhal gdangs ljags 'dril khro gnyer rab tu brjid dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes sprul gyis brgyan rigs lngas dbu brgyan dur khrod mas brgyad gsol me dpung dkyil bzhugs thugs kar nyi ma'i steng :rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ la sngags kyis bskor g.yas su 'khor bar bsam zhing sngags 'di bzlas ca tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa:ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa a mṛ tagabasangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad zla'i steng du hūṃ las sna tsho gos rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer los pas/rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla bre/ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chu/ pa'i nam mkha' rlung chus ste 'byung ba rim gyi

khyab 'jug rten mdos kyi tshon las drang srong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ nang ma 9)brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rten mdos ri rab nag po bang rim gsum pa/ thod pa rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mi mgo'i tog dang zhing lpags kyi rgyal mtshan/ rgyu rlon dang dug sbrul gyi dra ba dang glo snying mkhal mchin yan lag gi dra phyed/ rus pa'i pur shu dang mda' yab sogs dur khrod kyi rdzas sna tshogs las grub pa 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ (2ba tha rlung 'tshub pa'i pho brang chen po khrag gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus su/ e las gru gsum mthing nag nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i lte bar/paṃ las sna tsho gos pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ a las zla ba/ : las dgra bgegs pho mo gan rkyal du bsnol bar gyur/ dregs pa'i gzugs can pho nya las byed du shes pa ni/ gdan gyi steng du tri du ba'i mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus tri la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ sprul pa'i gza' bdud rā hu la sku mdog dud ka /mgo dgu bya rog mgo dang bcu'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas pa chu srin gyi rgyan mtshan ral gri'i yub byas pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa sprul zhags mda' gzhu 'geng ba/ dug mda' dgra la 'phen zhing / sku smad dug sbrul 'khyil ba/ sku la spyan stong gi khrag mig mdzes pa/ mi lngags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / sprul nag gi se ral kha dang do shal chun bu dar nag dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lnga dang rin po che'i rtse bran gyis brgyan pa/ zhal nas ha ha dang hūṃ hūṃ dang / phaṭa phaṭa phe phe gyi sgra sgrog cing / dam nyams dgra bo zhal du chem chem gsol ba/ sku che la yan lag rags pa/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid las lhag pa/ sku khams gsum yongs khengs par bzhugs pa'i g.yas su/ khrag mtsho rus pa'i khri steng du/ dza las yab rdo rje srin po sngo nag zhal gsum gsum dgu pa phyag g.yas g.yon na dbyug to dang / khrag mtsho bsnams pa/ zhe sdang 'bar ba'i klong (3na sko bzhugs pa'o: g.yon du zla gam rak+ta'i dkyil 'khor du/ phu las yum rdo rje glog 'gyu dmar nag dbu dgu rngam brjid la khros pa/ sprul zhags khrag mtsho 'dzin pa/ 'dod chags 'khol ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o: de rnams kyi phyogs mtshams su gdug pa can rnams kyi gdan la/ nub tu ya las—375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheljang sngon chen po ljang nag zhags pa dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ ma mo rol pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o: shar lhor tse las drang srong dkar ser phyag gnyis sprul zhags dang tri shu la 'dzin pa/ dgra lha'i dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba'o: byang du du las bdud po rog ti mthing nag sbrul dang bdud zhags 'dzin pa bdud dmag 'bum gyis bskor ba'o lho nub tu tsa las srin po sku nyi pa tra dmar po phyag na sbrul dang gri chen bsnams pa srin po'i tshogs kyis bskong nas bzhugs pa'o: shar du a las bi gyi rā dza dud ka chu srin dang stag mgo 'dzin pa dgra lha'i dmag tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'o:nub byang du na las du ba mjug ring mthing nag phyag na spu gri dang dbyug to 'dzin pa gshin rje'i dmag tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'o: lhor ya las khyab mjug chen po ser nag sbrul zhags dang chu srin 'dzin pa/ klu bdud tsho gis kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'o: byang shar du sha las sgra gcan 'dzin pa dud kha chu srin dang khram shing 'dzin pa lha srin sde brgyad kyis bskor ba'o: de dag thams cad kyang shin tu rngam zhing gtum ba khros pa'i gzugs can la/ lus mig gis khengs pa/ dbu dgu pa kha gdangs shing mche ba gcigs pa/ shangs nas nad kyi na bun 'thul ba/ sbyan (3bskos bskal ba'i me 'bar ba/ zhal nas rgyob dang / gsod gyi sgra sgrog pa/ ba spu'i bu ga nas thog dang ser ba 'bebasapa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang 'dra ba'o/ shar du ma las stag srin zor ba'i gdong dkar ser/ stag sham sprul gyis brgyan pa/ phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa: lhor ra las baṃ srin dred kyi gdong can ser nag mi lhags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag sham gsol pa/ sbrul dang thod pa'i se ral kha 'phyang ba/ phyag na thod dbyug bsnams pa'o: nub tu tsa las kong srin ba lang gi gdong dmar nag stag gzig gos su gsol ba/ dgra sta dang zhags pa bsnams pa byang du sha las log srin chu srin gdong ljang nag stag sham dang mi lhags kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis ri bo bskyel zheng klad la bskor ba de dag thams cad srin mo khros pa'i cha lugs can/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar pa'i dbus su/zhing chen gyi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ de'i phyi rol tu shar du pa wa sangs dkar po g.yas pad+ma dang —376

khyab 'jug rten mdos kyi skrun las drang sgong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ nang ma (pegayon shing rtag bsnams pa/ shar lhor phur bu mthing ga pu ti bsnams pa/ lhor lag pa ljang gu g.yas chos 'am da dang g.yon ut+pal bsnams pa/ lho nub tu dmag dpon dmar po g.yas bdud rtsi bum pa dang g.yon sgron me bsnams pa/ nub phyogs na nyi ma dmar po g.yas me rtag dang g.yon rin chen 'bar ba bsnams pa/ nub byang na zla ba dkar po ku mud bsnams pa/ byang phyogs su sgra gcan dud ka g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon ral gri bsnams pa/ byang shar du spen pa dmar po g.yas dbyug to dang g.yon dgra sta bsnams pa/ shar du lha dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje smug nag ral pa snyil pa be con 'dzin pa/ khub tu klu dmar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ljang ser ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar lhor rgyal po (4na rkokar ser baṃ dbyug 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu btsan dmar po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dmu ljang ser nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ byang shar du bdud nag po mdung nag 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha chen po brgyad/dga' bo 'jog po sogs pa'i klu chen po brgyad/ brgya byin dang me lha la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/shar phyogs su smin drug dmar po rin po che'i za ma tog bsnams shing pad+ma'i khri la bzhugs pa/ snar ma ljang gu rin chen snye ma bsnams pa glang po che'i khri la bzhugs pa/ mgo ser po rin chen myu gu bsnams pa sha ba rwa bcu'i khril bzhugs pa/ lag dkar po rin chen sgrom bu bsnams ba sbrul gyi khri la bzhugs pa/ nabs so ser po rin chen za ma tog bsnams pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi khri la bzhugasapa/ rgyal ljang gu rin chen 'bar ba bsnams pa bum pa'i khri la bzhugs pa/ /skag ljang gug yasadabyug to dang g.yon bum pa bsnams pa bya rog bsnol ba'i khri la bzhugs pa/ lhor mchu dmar po rin chen 'bar ba bsnams pa ma he'i khri la bzhugs pa/ gre dmar po rin chen sgrom bu bsnams pa rin po che'i khri la bzhugs pa/ dpo ljang gu rin chen ga'u bsnams pa gser khri la bzhugs pa/ me bzhi ljang gu rin chen myu gu bsnams pa rma bya bsnol ba'i khri la bzhugs pa/ nag pa ljang gu po ti bsnams pa rma bya bsnol ba'i khri la bzhugs pa/ sa ri dmar po rin chen myu gu bsnams pa g.yu spyang —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()sngon po'i khri la bzhugs pa/sag ljang gu rlung 'tshub bsnams pa glang po che'i khri la bzhugs pa/nub tu lha mtshams dmar po pad+ma dmar 4ba ) po bsnams pa rin po che'i phub steng gi khri la bzhugs pa/snon dmar po pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa stan nang tshangs can gyi khri la bzhugs pa/snubs ljang gu pad+ma rgyas pa bsnams pa rus sbal gyi khri la bzhugs pa/chu stod ser po pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa nang tshangs can gyi khri la bzhugs pa/chu smad ljang gu pad+ma dmar po snams pa ma lha'i khri la bzhugs pa/gro bzhin ser po pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa mon khur gyi khri la bzhugs pa/byi bzhin dmar po pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa nang tshangs can gyi khri la bzhugs pa/byang du mon dre ljang gu ut+pal ljang gu bsnams pa nang tshangs can gyi khri la bzhugs pa/mon gru ljang gu ut+pal sngon po bsnams pa khyung gi/khrums stod ljang gu ut+pal ljang gu bsnams pa seng ge'i khri/khrums smad mthing nag ut+pal sdong bu bsnams pa glang chen gyi khri /nam gru nag po ut+pal ljang nag bsnams ba ra'i/dbyu gu ljang gu pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa ma he'i/bra nye ljang gu pad+ma ljang gu bsnams pa 'khor lo'i/mgyogs byed nag po la sogs pa'i nag po stong /khyab byed ma mo la sogs pa'i sha za 'bum/'bar ma gtum byed la sogasam mo bye ba/lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/srid gsum 'byung po bye ba'i tsho gis gzhan yang mkha' la 'gro ba/shugs kyis 'gro ba spyo byed/srul po la sogs pa 'byung po'i tsho gos dang bcas pa sha la dga' ba khrag la sred pa/dbugs la rngams pa/ro la 'jib pa/khro zhing gtum pa/cha lugs du ma ste cho 'phrul cir yang ston pa/srid gsum thams cad skad cig na gis thal bar rlog pa'i mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tsho gos kyis bskor bar gyur/mthun rdzas ya stags glud skos su shes pa ni/a khru tas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sbyan gzigasamathun rdzas thams cad kyi ma dag pa rnams/thugs ka nas spros pa'i raṃ las mes bsregs/yaṃ lasarlung gis gtor/byu las chus bkrus/ā+oṃ gyis 'dod yon lngar bsgyur/ā:sa nam mkha'i khams kun khyab/hūṃ gis bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dzad med du /la/swā sa gzugs bas thams cad mas dang

khyab 'jug rten mdos kyi 'phrin las drang srong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ nang ma 6)dpe byad phung khams skye mched dang ldan/ hās khyab 'jug chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugasadang gnyis su med par rten la brtan par bzhugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ mthun rdzas mtshon cha dang dug dpal du shes pa ni/ a sri tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gri mdung mda' gzhu sogs phyag mtshan rnams rno ba'i ngar dang dug gi dbal dang ldan pa btab pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gis brlab/ gtso bo'i thugs kar skyon pad+ma tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs gar ye shes kyi gza' bdud rā hu la dkar po phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba chos skyong gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar ā+oṃ/ mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūṃ/ rang yi dam dugs la ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ sangs rgyas rin chen snying po/ bcom ldan shākya (5ba)thub pa/ skyon pad+ma la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dran pa tsam gyis/ sngags yong rnal 'byor ba bdag gi las bsgrub pa'i ched du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ badz+ra sa ma ya dza:tri sha sogs brjod/ 'phrin las gzhud ltar btang / hūṃ bar snang yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /klu srin tsho gis pa'i mas po che/ /ro stod srin po ro smad sprul/ /mgo dgu mgo lus mig gis khengs/ /bar snang khams na bzhugs tsa na/ nyi ma zla ba sto ru za/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du bzhugs tsan/ /klu rnams kun kyang dkrug cing slong / /lha srin sdebargyad nang byan byed/ /gza' rgod yongs kyi dmag dpon khyod/ /sangs rgyasarin chen snying po dang / /bcom ldan shākya thub pad+ma 'byung / /gter ston tshul rdor klong chen zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig bzhin/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /nag po bdud kyi ba dan bsnyil/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba bzhin/ /deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag cag gi /zhi rgyas dbang drag las bsgrub phyir/ /mthing nag ri rab gru gsum dbyibs/ /rin chen thod mkhar gnas kyi rten/ /gtso 'khor sku gzugs yongs rdzogs dang / /dar mdung khra bo sku yi rten/ /rtsa sngags—379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bris pa gsung gi rten//ra rog sha snying dam rdzas rten//srog 'khor bla rdo mi 'bral rten//zhal phyung nam mkha' 'ja' ris can//rtse mor pho rog sgro yis brgyan//logs la dar nag pur ru sa/mgul la yungs kar shar ra ra/khyab 'jug zhal dang gnyis med rten//mda' khra sbrul (6na lkogs thog ser ris//lcags 'phang dung gi me long can//rgyang bu nag po nyi zlas brgyan//pho gdong mo gdong mdzes pa'i gzugs/zhang gri yul mkhar ri mo can//rnal 'byor mi nor glud kyi rten//bsgos na ga khrag kong us kyu dang//gtor tshogs 'phrin las 'chol ba'i rten//rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman//dam tshig gcig tu bsre ba'i rten//dmar chen rak+ta mthun rdzas rten//mi nag bya nag rta nag g.yab//rtol nag ra lug khyi dang phag/dgu dgu gzha/na yang stag gzig dang //sprul dang spre'u gdong dmar 'brug/glang r+pā 'dod 'dzo'i ba la sogs//drang srong 'khor yos dkor nor rten//pad+ma ut+pal me tog tshogs//sman sna shing sna dud pa'i sprin//snang gsal mar me dri bzang chab/mang tog bza' dang bca' ba'i tshogs//sgra snyan rol mo glu gar mdzes//mig sna rna lce snying rnams spungs/sha tshil gsur gyi dud pa 'thul//tshil chen ro skrar me dpung 'bar/khrag gi btung ba'i a sbreng //phyi sha pags pa rus pa dang //nang khrol byang sems dkar dmar tshil//btsos dang rjen pa'i sha sna tshogs/sha rul khrag rul nya rul dang //ra mchin sha khrag ba dmar 'o//stag ras gzig ras bse byang dang //lcags byang dung sogs mthun rdzas rten//dzāti tsas ga bur dang /khogang 'gi'u waṃ ru rta til//rma bya'i gdongs dang gur kum sogs//klu sman nad kun sel byed rten//gser dngul zangs lcags mu tig g.yu//pad rā ga dbang sngon byu ru shel//sna tshogs rin wo 'byu sna dang //ja sna zas6brko dar zab sogs//longs spyod phun tshogs rgyas byed rten/khrab rmog zhol rtags sra ba'i go/mda' mdung ral gri dgra sta zhags//phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tsho gis pa//ba dan rgyal mtshan ru mtshon sogs//dgra 'joms g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten//rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen khri//bkra shis rtags brgyad dpag bsam shing //gling bzhi ༷nga phran ri rab sogs//stobs 'byor mnga' thang

khyang 'jug rten mdos kyi phren la drang thong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ nang ma rtogergyas byed rten//lta sgom spyod dag dam tshig gtsang //gza' bdud che khyod rang gi sems//dregasa'adul he ru ka dpal du//nges pa rnyed pa mchog gi rten//de ltar rten pa'i mthun rdzas rnams/khyab 'jug r+ṣa po'i rten du 'bul//srin po yab kyi rten du 'bul//klu mo yum gyi //ljang sngon r+pā po'i rten du 'bul//drang srong dkar ser//bdud po rog ti'i//'i sti ba ḍā//biṣ+ṭha rā ༅ //du ba mjug ring /khyab 'jug wo po'i//sgra gcan 'dzin pa'i//stag srin zor gdong//baṃ srin dred gdong//kong srin glang gdong//chu srin gdong can //gza' chen brgyad kyi//lha srin ste brgyad //lha chen brgyad kyi //klu chen brgyad kyi//phyogs skyong bcu yi/khyu skar nyer brgyad //nag po stong gi /sha za 'bum sde'i //ma mo bye ba'i//lha dmag dung phyur/srid gsum 'byung po'i//de ltar khyab 'jug 'khor bcas rnams//gzhal yas rten la brtan par bzhugs//mthun pa'i rdzas la dgyes par rol//dngos wor yid sprul mchod pa bzhes//dang por sangs rgyas rin wo snying//rdo rje'i 'chang dang gsang 7na〉dag bka'//bar du dga' rab rdo rje dang //'jam dpal bshesaganyen shī sidha//pad 'byung bi mā mi tra'i bka'//tha mar gter ston las 'brel rtsal//slong chen rab mas nas bzung ste//legs ldan rdo rje dbang po'i sde//ngag gi dbang po drin can rje//chosadabyings rang grol la sogs pa//rig gas 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma yis//mgo la dam tshig rdo rje bzhag/lce thog bdud rtsi chos sman blug/dam tshig gnyan po rab sgrags pa/nyer dgongs sangasargyas bstan pa srungs//de 'dzin tshogs kyi sku tshe srings//dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod//dge 'dun dzi rnams dar zhing rgyas//'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid spel/khyad par gangs can bod yul 'dir//mi phyugs nad rims mu ge dang //g.yul 'khrug 'thab rtsod la sogs pa//mi mthun nyesatshogs kun zhi zhing //bde skyid dpal la spyod par mdzod//yang sgos rigs 'dzin bdag cag gis//bsrung bar bcug pa'i mi nor la//gnod cing 'tsho ba'i nad gdon bgegs//bar chad mi mthun phyogs spyi dang //bye brag ban bon dmod /thu byed//sdebargyad za kha zug pa dang //drang srong

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegaza' rgod bsdongs zla yi/ /gzer phog kha rlangs mthong reg gi /dug dang 'khu ldog nyes pa kun/ /ma lus zhi zhing bzlog par mdzod/ /bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba yi/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus pa/ /zha rengs kha mig ltag par skyol/ /smyo lkugs nyams shing srog rtsa cho de/ /yul zhing mkhar la thog ser dang / /than dang ltas ga char pa phob/ /(7ba〉dor na zhi rgyas dbang drag gi /'phrin las gang bcol ma lus pa/ /bsams pa tsam gyis 'bad med du/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin lasamadzod/ /bstod bskul bya/ /gsang ba gsol 'debs ni/ /ho dgongs su gsol lo/ khrag po'i lasal grub ba'i mthu dang rtsal mnga' ba/ /ye shes kyi sprul pa chen po/ 'jig rten khams kyi gtso bo/ chos skyong gza' bdud nag po khyod/ /kun bzang he ru ka dang ngo bo chos nyid du r+sāg pa/ /rang bzhi ye shes su mtshungs pa/ /mtshan nyid 'phrin las thogs pa med pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms pa'i dpa' bo/ /snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi rje bo/ /lha ma srin sdebargyad kyi sde dpon/ /sprul ba'i chos skyong chen po khyod kyis rigs 'dzin rnal 'byor ba bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gces pa'i bu bzhin du skyongs shig dam tshig can gyi srog bzung zhig: sgrub pa po'i grogs mdzod cig dam nyams pa'i dgra bo thams cad sgrol cig: chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyod ni/ zhi ba'i mdangasadang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag po'i dgra bgegasasgrol ba'i las la myur ba/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i bdag po/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug /sgrub pa po'i bsam gtan gyi drod myul bar byed pa'i gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pa/ bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bgyi ba'i sgrub rten 'di rnams la bzhugs pa dang gnas par mdzod cig rnal 'byor pa bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig bde ba chen po'i zhing du (8na)'gro ba la/ bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa lasaskyob pa dang / lam gyi bskul ma mdzod cig yang dag pa'i sal 'khrid pa'i sun ma dang 'phrin lasamadzod cig: snying po byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam la nam yang mi —382

khyab 'jug rten mdos kyi skrun las drang thong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ nang ma 6)'jug cing /thar pa byang tso kyi phyogs 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bar mdzad du gsol:'jig rten 'dir yang bdag mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal zhing /zas nor longs spyod thamasacad dbang du bsdu ba dang /mngon spyod kyi las gang la'ang thogs pa med par 'grub bar mdzad du gsol bkra shis bde legs thams cad 'byung zhing ci bsams pa lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol gdab 'phrin las 'chol zhing me tog 'thor yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bkang /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/chos skyong gza' mchog 'khor bcas rnams//rten 'dir mi 'bral rtag bzhugs nas//bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi//wen las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzod//ā+oṃ su bra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā//zhesabartan bzhugs bya/sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal//rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkrashis shog/dngos grub char 'bebs gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin//dregs 'dul dkyil 'khor lha yi bkra shis shog khrid gsum dregs pa yongs kyi dmag dpon mchog/gza' rgod khyab 'jug chen po'i bkra shis shog/gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs8ba ) bya'o//de ltar khyab 'jug wo po rā hu la'i rten mdos kyi 'phrin las drang srong kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes bgyi ba 'di ni gsang sngags pho brang gi mtshams khang shod kyi gza' khang du rten mdos 'dzugs pa'i dus las 'brel rtsal gyi gter gzhung gi mdos nag dang dug dbyung /mgon po g.yul bzlog gi nang tshan khyab 'jug gi mdos g.yang 'gugs kyi yi ge sogs las kyang zhib mor dpyad de za hor kyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim ba blo bzang /ngos grub bo//sarba maṅga lo/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedrang srong log tri pā la'i las byang chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs bzhugs/na mo gu ru sto ma hā rnyi bi ma lu ya/ rgyal kun mthu stobs khro chu khol ma'i rgyun/ /gtum chen gsang ba'i bdag por blug pa'i gzugs/ /phyag na rdo rje gdengs pa'i mdo nyid la/ khams gsum cig car 'dar bar mdzad khyod bsngags/ /chu nang gzugs bzhin sna tsho gis sprul ba'i gar/ /drang srong dri ma med pa'i 'od zer zhes/ /dmod pa'i ga bur gzegs mas nad gdon bgegs/ /tsha dbal kun 'joms sngon med zla ba che/ /mgon de khros pa'i mod la sdebargyad dpung / /mthar byed zhe sdang rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal/ /stong phrag nyi ma 'bar ba'i 'od po ches/ /snyigs dus bdud mun ming gi lhag mar byas/ /dharma a shwa ka yi thugs kyi bcud/ /rgyal dbang pad+mas gter du rgyas btab pa/ /sgo 'byed nyang ral chos kyi dbang phyug ces/ /gter ston nyi zla zung 'brel las 'ongs cho me/ /rig gtad lung dang man ngag mthong thos pa'i/ /rnying rlom gangs can pa khro'i mngal gang yang / /lam 'di'i srol 'byed rin cen phun tsho gos zhabs/ /mya ngan med de bsams bzhin srid pa bzung / /rigs rnams kun khyab chos dbyings rang grol (2na8pal/ /zab gter bka' babs sprul sku gter bdag gling / /thugs rje'i zer gyis rang blo pad+ma'i kha/ /phye ba'i bka' drin tshad gzhal ga la rnyed/ /de phyir smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs mtho bas/ /snong ldan don gnyer mang por phan pa'i ched/ /chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs 'di/ /las 'phro nyer sad dpa' rtags lag char byin/ /de la 'dir drang srong dri med 'od zer zhi drag gi 'phrin las kyi rim pa mthong bas don gsal nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du bkod pa la/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum/ dang po la brgyud 'debs ni/ drang srong dri med dharma a shwa ka /bram ze legs grub pra bha hasti dang / /shārnyi gar+bha pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba —384

drang thong log tri ga la'i las byang chog gas gan mo lcag rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma 'da'adebs so sdo brgyad zil gnon shog/khri srong yab sras nyang ral 'gro ba'i mgon//chos kyi dbang phyug pad+ma dbang rgyal dang //mar ston sangs rgyas gnyan ston bkras seng la//gsol ba //chos nyid rang grol sangs rgyas lhun dbang dang //kun dga' ba po shis rgyal sras chos kyi rje//chos 'phagasabazang po shākya dpal bzang la//gsol ba 'debs so//'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan mkhar 2bdabyings rdo rje dang //rin cen phun tsho gos mnga' ris legs ldan zhabs//chos rgyal phun tsho gos dbur spyon chos grags la//gsol ba//dkon cog lhun grub chos rgyal gter bdag gling //slar yang bkra shis rgya mtsho khu dbon dang //zur rigs lhun grub rdo rje yab sras la//gsol ba/yab dang 'bri gung rigs 'dzin nā ro pa//rnam gnyis gtsug bsten chos dbyings rang grol zhabs//zla med drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la//gsol ba //rig gtad lung dang man ngag dmar 'khrid la//brten nasabaskyed rim bsnyen srung bzlog bsad kyi//'phrin las kun grub ma dag mkha' dbyings su//lhun grub 'od lnga'i ye shes rdzogs par shog/skyabs 'gro ni/rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo gsang ba'i bdag/zhi ba'i drang srong skur bstan dri ma med//sde brgyad gnyen por log tri khro bo'i rgyal//byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi//lan gsum/sems bskyed ni/'gro ba'i don du rang rig kun tu bzang //rang zhal mngon sum blta la sgrib byed kyi//las nye ne rnam rtog 'khrul ngor shar ba'i gegs//'dul phyir sngags rgod log tri bsgrub par bya//lan gsum brjod/tshogs zhing ni/tre rat+na maṇ+ḍal/paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa gam gu rla maṇ+ḍal a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/badz+ra sa ma ya dza:rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal//dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo//mchog gsum ston pa'i zhing gyur la//gnyis med yid kyisaskyabs su mchi/dngos lor yid kyis rnam sprul ba//dag ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol//dngosagrub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs//nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi//phyogs bcu 'khor gsum 3na jig pa'i chos//ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang //dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med//rjogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do//bdag dang mtha' ༷sa sems can rnams//dus gsum bzhugs la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelus dbul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /bgegs sgrod ni/ hūṃ/ pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng na/ /rang nyid zhe snang rdo rje mthing nag mdog /sku las sprul pa'i khro bo me dpung dang / /mtshon cha'i tsho gis kyis stong khams khyab par gyur/ /gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis bshams/ /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong sde brgyad gzhi bdag zhing skyong gdon bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra a du sha dzaḥs bkug /gtor ma bsangs gzhud nas byung ba'i sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis brlab bsngo gnyis ka bya/ phyogs skyong sde brgyad rnams dang khyad par yul phyogs sa phyogs 'di kun na gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag zhing skyong gtsang phud la dga' ba rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag cag rnams drang srong log tri pā la'i 'phrin las zab mo nyams su len pa la bar gcod mi 'byung ba'i stong grogs mdzod cig /nag phyogs sha khrag la dga' ba lan chags dang gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs nam mkha' la 'phyo ba/ bar snang la rgyu ba sa gzhi la 'grim pa/ 'byung ba la brten pa/ skyabs grib la gab pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub pa chen po mthong thos mi bzod pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la byams pa'i sems kyis so so rang rang gi gnas dang rten la dengs (3ba〉gig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo sprin rab 'byams kyis ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas phye mar brlag par 'gyur/ hūṃ/ bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas/ mthing nag hūṃ gi 'od zer las/ /stong gsum khro bos rab gang zhing / /rngam sgras 'jig rten kun bkang nas/ /gnod mdzes khro bo ma yin pa'i/ /gdug pa g.yo 'gul ming yang med/ khro rgyal mtshon cha me ri 'bar 'bar ba'i mtshamasalas ma 'da' zhig /bsnyen sngags dang hūṃ bzhi'i sngags/ /drang srong gi dmod pa brjod/ /srung 'khor ni/ hūṃ/ khro bo mtshon cha bskal pa'i me dpung gis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus rab gtamasanas/ /phra mo'i rlung yang thar bar mi nus pa'i/ /sra brtan rdo rje'i gur gyis mtshams chod cig /bshags pa ni/ /hūṃ/ bdag gis tshe rabs thog med tshun chad nas/ /da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan —386

drang srong log tri ga la'i las byang chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma 6)chad du/ /lus kyis sdig byas spyod pa ngan du spyad/ /ngag gis tshig kyal smra ba mang du brjod/ /yid kyis blo nor log par sems la sogs/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis las spyad kun/ /bkram pa'i lha tsho gis rnams la bzod par gsol/ /ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang / /de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i dregs pa rnams/ /mi g.yel skyon mthong tsam nas brlag par mdzad/ /nor zhagi la chags nyams mchis na bzod par gsol/ /bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /'di phyi'i rkyen dang sgrib par mi 'gyur gsol/ /yig brgya brjod/ byin 'bebs ni/ hūṃ/ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang lcang lo can/ /nags tshal dra ba 'khrigs pa'i phug pa na/ /dri ma med pa'i 'od zer (4na yang srong che/ /sdebargyad gnyen por zhe sdang rdo rje'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis bgrad/ /rgyan med sku la bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar/ khyed kyi thugs rje'i thugs dam rgyud bskul na/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir spyon la/ /rigs 'dzin sgrub pa po la byin phob cig /lus la rdo rje sku yi byin : / /ngag la bden tshig gsum gi byin / /yid la rang byung thugs kyi byinaḥ/ /yon tan 'gran med drang srong byin:/ /'phrin las 'gro 'dul rnam bzhi'i byin / /dbang chen dbang skur drang srong dri ma med/ /byin chen byin phob drang srong dri ma med/ /mas chen mthul drang srong dri ma med/ /dngos grub mchog stsol drang srong dri ma med/ /bdag nyid las kyi gos bu mchis par mdzod/ /trang du'i gsham du sam ya a be sha ya a zhwa zhes brjod/ mchod gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las re waṃ khaṃ/ /'phros pas mchod pa'i rdzas rnams kyi/ /ma dag dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bkrus/ /oṃ las rin chen snod yangs su/ /mchod pa'i yo byad rang rang gi /ming yig dang po thig le yis/ /mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga/ /kun du bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod mnga' bas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho mnyes byed gyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra.a ā / nas sha lta ā:/ gi bar dang/ /badz+ra sarba pā dza me gha hūṃ/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang —387

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelas rin cen snod/ /nam (4ba7kha' lta bur rab yangs dbus/ /: las lha dzos gtor ma ni/kha dog dri ro reg byar ldan/ /rang gi gnas gsum yi shes mtshan/ /ā+oṃ las 'od zer gtor mar phog /'bags btsog sbyangs te ā yig las/ /'od 'phros bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor spel/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros nus pa bskyed/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mang por gyur/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ ma hā ba lin+ta te dz+wa ba lin+ta ba la ba te gu ༅ sam ye swā hā/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las re me zhe 'phros pas/ drag po'i mchod rdzasasman rag gtor gsum dang bcas pa'i nyes skyon rnams bsregs gtore bkrus te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams gyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhub las byung ba'i khrag gi a dang zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog sha chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/rkang gling thod rnga'i rol mo rnams sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a ā sne nas shasta'i bar brjod sman phud kyi snod bcud rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las las rlud / raṃ las me/ kai la thod pa'i snyed bu gsum gyi steng du ā:las bhan+ta yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar byang sems/ seng ge'i sha /sman bzang po drug shar gyi rtsibs la dri chen/ glang po che'i sha /dzā ti lho'i rtsibs la sha chen/ rta'i sha /ka ko la/ nub kyi rtsibs la pad+ma rak+ta/ rma bya'i sha /li shi /byang gi rtsibs la dri chu/ khyung sha /gur kum rnams rlung gis me sbar te zhu ba yongs su gyur (ldan)pa las phyag mtshan bcu so so'i lte bar hūṃ ā+oṃ swā la hā / lī māṃ rlu twe gyis mtshani pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rigs lngar gyur pa'i spyor mtshams nas byang chub gyi sems dkar dmar gyi rgyan babs pa'i steng du rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu nas thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ā+oṃ ā:྅ sarba pañtsa a mri ta hūṃ phyi tha/ lag pa'i sor mo bsnol la mthe bong gnyis bsgreng pa'i ngos la mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra bha ྅ ba chu ta bi shwa tsa kra hūṃ/ rdo rje'i gter —388

drang srong log: ga la'i la byang chog sgrigs kan ma lcag rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma 9)snod /pā la yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ lag gnyis khu tshur mdzub mo mche ba 'dra bar byas la/ ā+oṃ ma hā smi ta rgyal maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ gti mug sha'i gtor ma ri bo tsam du gyur/rdor thal bskyod ba rak+ta sbreng ba'i rgyas/ ā+oṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa lamaṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ 'dod chags khrag gi gtor ma rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ lag pa so'i phreng ba ltar byas la/ ā+oṃ ma hā ska ni ti dzol maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ zhe sdang rus pa'i gtor ma gram bu ltar khrol bar gyur rdor thal snying gar gtu gas rjes mgo thod gyi rgya lus la lan gsum bskor la de'i rjes su mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe bong gnyis te bzhi po rtse sprad sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol te bsgrengs la/ ā+oṃ ka pā la ba su ta ra '-i kro sro : wa bh+yo ru lu ru lu hūṃ/ ba lin+ta maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ngo bo rang bzhin rnam par dag cing med du byung ba la rnam pa sha khrag rus pa'i rang bzhin srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i dgyes skong dam par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ& gsum dang e a ra li tri hri dzaḥ(5bajo zhes byin gyis brlab/ rak+ta'i snod bcud mi dmigasapa stong pa nyid du gyur ba'i ngang las pad+ma 'bar ba'i snod chen por/ ra las rdo rje sgeg mo dmar mo mkha' nas khrag babs te nyon mongs pa bag chags dang bcas pa 'joms pa'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba slong rgya mdud kyi tshul du 'khrugs pa las/ lha mo nyid 'od du zhu nas thim pas 'khor ba stongs par gyur/ā+oṃ āḥ/ ma hā rak+ta sa mān+ta maṇ+ḍal hūṃ phaṭa/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thun mong sbyang gzhi dag byed ni/rang lus tha mal dhū ti'i nang / /snying thad pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /nyi zla'i gdan la āḥdakar po/ /de las 'od 'phros sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdor pad+ma ni/ /dmar po 'dab ma bzhi steng du/ /ā ga ri bong 'dzin pa'i mdog /'od 'phros lus gang nad gdon sbyangs/ zhi ba bskyed ba ni/ skad cig bdag nyid drang srong ri/ /sku mdog sngo skya keng rus gzugs/ smin ma ag tshom rgya mdor slebs/ /ras dkar smad dkris stod g.yogs can/ /skyil spung tshul bzhugs rnye bsnams//'khor du drang srong 'bum gyis bskor/ /snying gar nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /srog gi snying po hūṃ mthing nag /co du'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ /ā+oṃ trang du hri na trang du dzaraḥ khri tsho gcig sogs gong —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bsnyen 'bad//'di ga'i bsnyen pa'i dus gong 'og gi drag po'i sgos chos rnams dor ba'i lasabyang sbyar te bsnyen pa byed cing rgyun gyi lon las la ma byas kyang rung mod/'on kyang lha bsgom pa dang bzlas pa cung zad byed pa rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i phyag bzhes la/6na tshe sgod pas byas na legs zhes sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub gsung /drag po'i rten brtsen pa bskyed pa ni/rang nyid drang srong zhi ba sa/gsal ba 'od du zhu ba yi//stong pa'i ngang nas: yig las//byang chub chen po'i mchod rten ni//dkar po gdan khri bang rim gsum//ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng //bum pa bre dang chos 'khor gdugs//nyi zla nor bu'i tog gis mdzes//gsal 'tsher 'od zer phyogasabacur 'bar//bum pa'i sto ba yangs pa'i nang //rang lus gnam lcags rdo rje ni//yar rtse nam mkha'i mthongs la thug/mar rtse dbang r+pā gzhi la rig/rtse mo rab tu rno ngar ldan//byad ma'i lte yis brang khegs dbus//snying dbus ni bcas dkyil du gzer//rtse mo'i bar du byad ma yi//chosaskyong lha srung pho lhar bcas//yar gyi lte bar zhe r+ha rdo rje go rdzo rkang gsum po sa wer gyi a 44 dmig ༅ dzor r+sār+sā'adi 'dagol bi no/rwa rtse'i nang du ni//bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang/khye mor bya khyung nag po ni//sbrul gdug bzung zhing 'bar dbus gnas//rdo rje'i lte ba yangs pa'i nang //spyi ga 'od du zhu ba las//gser gyi tsakra rtsibs brgyad dbus//rang nyid rdzus skyes khro bo ni//mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa//dang po gnyis kyis tho ba dang //ral gri 'bar ba rab tu gdengs//mtha' gnyis gnam lcags lag mthil la/'di bzlog go drag bodang spung pa gtso bor ston pa'i dbang du bya kyi sa dang srung ge sogs la mtha' ma ga gis kyis ma ro de rten ba kho ces dang sa wer bzlog pa'i dus su mtha' gnyi gnam lcags thal mo rdegs na pa lamatha' ma gnyis kyi ri ra spu bteg zor lam mtha' gnyis drag po'i zor rdzas thog sog rig 6bto la sgyur shes dgo so//sor mo lcags sdig mgo dgu 'phyar/kham nag dbu skra gyen du brdzes//nyi zla'i gdan la brkyang bskum bgrad/man tu khro zhing mi sdug pa//rgyan med me dpung dbus na bzhugs//dbu yi dpe gsar rnying mang por phrag pa g.ya ༷༷ra yod cing /lho brag sprul so gos gsar ma 'dre kyang da ltar

drang srong log tri pā la'i las byang chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma 9)bri mod/ /dbu gtsug tu byed pa rje tsho khung ba'i 4kho pa a mong nga ma yin pa'o/ /gtsug tu drang srong ni/ /sku mdog sngo skya keng rus gzugs/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste 'khor du drang srong 'bum gyis bskor zhes pa'i bar len/ spyi bor rigs kyi bdag bo sa /kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /rnam pa pad+ma thong 'phreng rtsal/ /mthing nag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /gsang yum 'tsho rgyal dkar mos stid/ /gnyis ka'ang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i tshul/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung can/ /gtso bo'i thugs gar hrī: yig las/ /'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad dbus/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du / /badz+ra pā ṇi ye shes sems/ /rang 'dra'i khro bo'i skur gsal ba/ /de yi thugs kar rin po che'i/ /gur khang smug po mchong bcag 'dra'i/ /zur brgyad lte bar nyi ma'i steng / /ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig gzugs/ /mthing nag gsal 'tsher 'od du 'bar/ /smra byed gnam lcags rdo rje ni/ /rtse dgu lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan/ /lce rtsar a las zla ba gnas/ /rtse dgu khong gseng yod pa'i rtser/ /mchong bcag 'dra ba'i phaṭa dgus mtshan/ /las byang dumigasal nga rnams bu led kyi nyer bsdu'i dgongs don bzhin bkod pa las khungs med kyi rtog bzo min no/ /snying ga'i hūṃ lasa.ā+oṃ los pas/ /byang chub mchod rten phyi rol tu/ /'khor lo dkar (7na sta'i gur khang ni/ /zlum po sra zhing mkhregs pas bskor/ /snying ga'i hūṃ lasa3 los pas/ /'khor lo'i gur khang phyi rol tu/ /rdo rje sngon po'i gur khang ni/ /zlum/ po:/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las swā los pas/ /rdo rje gur khang phyi rol tu/ /rin cen ser po'i gur khang ni/ /zlum po / /snying ga'i hūṃ las los pas/ /rin cen gur khang phyi rol tu/ /pad+ma dmar po'i gur khang ni/ /zlum poḥ/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las hā 'phros pas/ /pad+ma'i gur khang phyi rol tu/ /ral gri'i ljang gu'i gur khang ni/ zlum po / /snying ga'i hūṃ las waṃ 'phros pas/ /ral gri'i gur khang phyi rol tu/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gur khang ni/ /zlum po:/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las re 'phros pas/ /rlung gi gur khang phyi rol tu/ /dus mtha'i me yi gur khang ni/ /zlum po ཿ/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las bo 'phrosapas/ /me yi gur khang phyi rol tu/ /rba klong 'khrug pa'i gur khang ni/ /zlum poḥ/ /snying ga'i hūṃ lasalo 'phros pas/ /chu yi gur khang phyi rol tu/ /ri bo rgya gram gur khang ni/ /zlum po:/ snying ga'i hūṃ las—391—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ye 'phros pas//sa yi gur khang phyi rol tu//nam mkha' gnam lcags gur khang ni//zlum po//bar mtshams rnams kyang rang rang gi/rigs mthun kha dog mtshon cha can/khro tsho gos gtams shing dug rlangs 'khrigs//phyi rol rang sngags dbyangs gsal dang//rten 'brel snying po'i sngags kyi phreng //'dzab dmod tshig gi nga ro sgrog/gzhom zhig med pa'i gur du gyur//lha tshogs rnams kyi gnasagasum du//ā+oṃ dkar sa dmar 7bstu sngon po//hūṃ las 'od zer rab 'phros pas//rgya gar yul dbus lho yi phyogs//ri bo kun 'dus rtse mo yi//nags tshal dra ba'i klong dkyil nas/khrang srong dri med 'od zer ni//'bor du drang srong tsom gyi bskor//dpal ldan zhe sa rdo rje la/khro pho lis dang bcas pa rnams//mkha' la glog stong 'byug pa bzhin//thogs pa med par 'dir spyon cig/ā+oṃ trang du bi yang du dzaḥdza sbyin 'dren ni/hūṃ/dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis//tshur gshegs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na//rgya gar yul gyi lho phyogs ngos//yul ni rgya gar in+da'i yul//ri bo kun 'dus rtse mo na//nags tshal dra ba'i klong dkyil na//rin cen sna lnga'i khri steng na//slob dpon drang srong dri med ni//drang srong 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor//ma lus 'khor dang cas rnams//sems can don la gshegs su gsol//lha srin sdebargyad gnyen po sa/gtum chen drag po'i skur bstan pa//sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa rnams//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las kun//thogs med bsgrub phyir gshegasasu gsol//sdo brgyad 'dul phyir //byad ma bzlog phyir//'byung po 'dul phyir //rgyal bgo 'dul phyir //dgra bgegs 'dul phyir//mas gye ti badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ sngos gnyis su med par bsam/bzhugs su gsol ba ni/hūṃ/zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams//pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//drag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams//nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sam ya ri/hūṃ/bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan//g.yang srong 'khor bcas byon pa legs//ji srid brtan par bzhugs su gsol//ji srid brtan par bzhugs nas kyang /khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag la gzigs//thugs 3 9 ༷dag la dbang bzhi skur//phyag 'tshal ba ni hūṃ/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'abul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra garnye āḥ// lha dang mi yi bza' dang 4'a/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i bsgos bu 'di/ /drang srong 'khor bcas zhal du 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ra sa āḥ&/ du kū la yi ras bzang sogs/ /lha mi'i reg bya sna tsho gos pa/ /drang srong 'khor bcas sku la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra spar+sha lhaḥsnyi/ gtor ma ni/ hūṃ/ dkar gsum dngar gsum shing tog dang / /'bru sna dang sbyar 'dod yon lnga'i/ /rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di/ /drang srong 'khor dang bcas(9na 'a 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi kha kha khā hi khā hi du na ya swā hā/ ā sha co du tri na shing du dzaḥX kha khā hi khā hi du na ya swā hā / drag po'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/log 'dren sdebargyad bsgral ba yi/ /snying khrag dron mo'i mchod yon 'di/ /zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcasal/ /'bul gyi 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ ṛ ṣi kro ta rā dza a: pa ti hūṃ ts+tsha swā hā/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po bsgral ba'i khrag /dung chen snod gtams zhabs bsil 'di/ /zhe snang rdo rje 'khor //'bul gyi 'phrin lasaḥ/ /sngags mjug tu pā hūm̐ / /mig lce rna ba sna dang snying / /drod ldan 'phrig pa'i me tog 'di/ /zhe sdang—/ /'bul gyi / /sngags mjug tu puṅge / /sna tshogs sha sna sman dang spos/ /sbyar ba'i khams nag dud 'thul ba/ /zhe snang:/ /'bul gyi / sngags mjug tu ju pe / /rkang mar tshil gyi zhun chen po/ /skra las spar ba'i sgron me 'di/ /zhe sdang :/ 'bul gyi / /sngags mjug tu ā lo ge / /khrag zhag mkhris pa 'khyil ba'i dri/ /ngad ldan thugs gar byug pa'i rdzas/ /zhe sdang —/ /'bul gyis / /sngags mjug tu ga rnye / /slo snying mkhal mtsher mchin pa sha /klad rus spungs pa'i zas mchog 'di/ /zhe sdang / /'bul gyi / /sngags mjug tu ni wi du / /rkang gling thod rnga dung li rnga/ /'o dod rgyang glu bshug pa'i sgra/ /zhe sdang —/ /'bul gyi / /sngags mjug tu shasta ཿ / sman mchod ni/ /hūṃ/ gdod nas rnam dag rtsa brgyad stong (9bskyor sman/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i dam tshig rdzas/ khyud drug kun sgrol dug lnga rab sel ba/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā sarba pañtsa a gra ta kha raṃ khā hi/ brgyud mchod ni/ /tshig rkang gsum po brgyud 'debs ji lta ba la/ sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /zhes bsgyur zhing sngags sbyor/ /gsang ba'i 394

drang thong log tri pā la'i las byang chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma 'ad bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'dzin/ /dzi brgyad gnyen bor drang srong khro bo'i rgyal/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang cas la / /ā+oṃ ṛ ṣi kro ta rā dza mahā sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ ā+oṃ āḥ// dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs 'chang ba/ /mi byed rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs dang ldan/ /deng bdag gsang bdag sku gsung thugs 'dzin pa/ /gsang bdag sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /kā ya sirnyi lto/ /wā sa sirnyi ā: tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ gtor ma ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod par sbyar ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon to lnga yis rab brgyan pa/ /gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /sngags mjug tu mahā ba lin+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /rak+ta ni/ gdug can dgra bgegs khrag gi dngas ma'i mtshor/ /mkha' dbyings pad+ma rak+ta'i 'bab ldan kun/ /gcig bsdusamatshams sprin la 'gran dbu phreng can/ /rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /sngags mjug tu ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khya hi/ sbyor sgrol ni/ mas ldan gzung ma dang sbyar bcu drug cha/ /yongs rdzogs dga' bzhi'i bde (10na)chen rab rgyas shing / /dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i/ /spyor sgrol mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /sngags mjug tu ma hā me sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ /ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ke ni ti khā hi/ bodhi tsidha ma / ru dra pra be sha ya phaṭa/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa li/ /drang srong chen po dri med ni/ /bag chags sgrib pa mi mnga'i phyir/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i phyir/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis drang srong sku/ /'dod chags dug lnga spong ba'i phyir/ /sku mdog sngo skya keng rus gzugs/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phyir/ /dbu skra lcang lo gyen du 'khyil/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /zhal nas sde brgyad spu gri gsungs/ /sdebargyad gnad la bor ba'i phyir/ /phyag na gser gyi rdo rje bsnams/ /sprul bas kun la khyab pa'i phyir/ /'khor dang drang srong 'bum gyis bskor/ /sdebargyad dbang du sdud pa'i phyir/ /ri bo kun 'dusartse la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa yin pa'i phyir/ /sku la na bza' ras gos gsol/ /sa bcu zil —393

rgyal dbang lnga par ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ ()gyis gnon pa'i phyir//nags tshal dra ba'i phug na bzhugs//tshe dang bsod nams spel ba'i phyir/mang tog sna tsho gis zhal du gsol//sangs rgyas stong gi sprul pa'i sku//drang srong khyed la gusaphyag 'tshal/khyod kyis bdag la dngos grub stsol//sde brgyad dbang 10bdu sdud pa'i phyir//mthu dang pahrūl bdag la stsol//hūṃ/lha srin sdebargyad ga tshe po mā/dri med 'od zer khro ba'i skur//rab bzhengs zhe sdang rdo rje ni//sku mdog stang zil brtsegs pa yi//ri rab nyi mas 'khyud pa bzhin//bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can//dbu sgra dmar ser nam mkha' khyab//dmar zlum spyan gsum glog ltar 'byug/srin po lta bur rngam zhal gdangs//mche ba'i gra nas khrag rgyun 'bab//ljags 'gril rkan sgra drag tu ldeb//sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar//sbom zhing thung la yan lag rags//rgyan med gcer bu 'jigs pa'i gzugs//phyag g.yas gnam lcags tho ba yis sdebargyad thams cad rdul du rlog/g.yon pa ral gri 'bar ba yis//mgo lus yan lag dum bur gtubs//mtha' gnyis gnam lcags lag pa'i mthil//dgra bgegs cha lang bzhin brdabasapa'i/kha khrag sor mo sdig pa yis//lhag ma med par chem che mar//res 'ga' thun zor thog ser 'bebs//skabs 'gar byang chub mchod rten 'dzin//ri rab la so gos phyag mtshan gyis//so sor ma 'dres las kun bsgrub//zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhugs//sku las 'bar ba'i me dpung gis/khrod gsum thams cad sreg par mdzad//zhal nas drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon//phab pas sde brgyad 'byung po 'dul//thugs ni mi ༅ ra bde wo ldan//sangs rgyas kun gyi mas stobs rnams//gcig bsdus gsang ba'i bdag po dang //dbyer med khyod la bdag 11na tha stod do//bskul ba ni/hūṃ/sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang //las ga dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang //bar ho rgyal 'gong 'dul ba dang //byad ma rbod gtong bzlog pa dang //lha srin sdebargyad 'dul ba'i phyir//drang srong chen po rab khros shing //nyon mongs dug gsum 'joms pa'i phyir//dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs//zhe /༷ dug lnga gzhom pa'i phyir//rigs lnga'i sangs

drang sgong log tri ga la'i la byang chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma 6)rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs//mi dge bas rnams la ba'i phyir//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs//lha srin sdebargyad 'dul ba'i phyir//drang srong 'khor bcas thams cad bzhengs//bar chad log 'dren 'du thaba'i phyir/phyag mtshan thams cad mtshon char bzhedas//bzhengs shig drang srong wo po'i tshogs//'dir spyon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig/'phrin las bcol ba'i dus la bab//byad ma bzlog pa'i//rgyal 'gong 'dul ba'i //dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab//che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa'i dmigs pa ni/rdo rje lte ba'i hūṃ yig las//'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros//sdebargyad snying nas dbang med drangs//mdun du bkug pa'i spyi bo sa/rdo rje rgya gram bzheng pa yis//'gul 'byog spangs te 'dar bar bsam//hūṃ/nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab//nga ni gshin rje kun gyi yum//nga ni khams gsum kun gyi bdag/nga ni dbang phyug chen po ste//nga ni srog gcod kun gyi rje//nga ni srid pa kun gyi bdag/nga ni 11ba ji 'gro kun gyi bdag/nga ni snying khrag kun gyi bdag/khyod kyi snying khrag nga la yod//nga yi las rnams khyod kyisasgrubs//dpang gzu ni/hūṃ/sangs rgyas thams cad gzu dang dpang //dam chos rin cen gzu dang dbang //dge nyon bos pa gzu dang dbang //dkon cog gsum po gzu dang dpang //chos skyong srung ma gzu dang dpang //rgyal 'gong ོ po 'dul ba'i phyir//drang srong ོ po dri med khyod//sku ni mi 'gyur brtan pa la//phyag mtshan 'khor lo bsgyur bzhin du//dgra bgegs mgo la 'khor lo skor//rgyal 'gong lus la 'khor lo skor//sdebargyad srog la 'khor lo skor//'khor lo g.yas su bskor tsa na//rgyal 'gong snying la 'khor lo skor//'khor lo g.yon du bskor tsa na//mo gdon snying la 'khor lo rgyob//'dzab bzla bar gnas pa rtsa shes pa'i don ni/rang gi lce ni gnam lcags kyi/khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i//lte bar nyi ma'i gdan steng du//hūṃ la bsnyen sngags ring mo yis//g.yasabaskor 'od zer 'phro bar bsam//mgrin pa'i dkyil gyi don ni//lce rtser a las zla ba yi//dkyil 'khor āḥyis mtshan pa'i mthar//zhi ba'i sngagaX/sa g.yas skor du//mgal me ltar 'khor 'od

drang thong log tri ga la'i la byang chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma (pe.a ya ma du ru tsa shan ldebargyad kyi srog laḥ / tsi du sod tsi du sod rbad thibs/ khreg lhu ru gtugasarbad phyogs/ /ha la ba ti nan/ /ga na pa ti rbad rmugs/ 'khor ba dul rbad choms/ gnod byed 'byung po'i kā wā tsi brlag brlag rbad hu ra/ dgra bgegs che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad rbad/ gnod byed rgyal po thams cad ra tsa hab le hab le sod/ /klu thams cad nā ga ling nā ga ling / 'byung po thams cad ka hri ku tra sod/ bgegs thams cad 'gug ge 'gug ge sod/ gza' thams cad the rtse the rtse sod/the'u rang thams cad ra tri ra tri mā ra ya sod/ bsen mo thams cad ro tri ro tri mā ra ya sod/ dre bo dre mo thams cad sum tri sum tri mā ra ya sod/ gnod byed dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya sod sod rbad rbad dzaḥdzaḥ'adi la thun sngags dang drag sngags spu gri ring mo gnyis ka tshang ba zhal shes bzhin dbye shes dgosaso/ /drang srong dmod pa 'di nyid do/ /bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa thams cad 'di ru ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /srid pa rtse nas shig cig /srid gsum rmang nas skyel cig /'khor ba gting nas phyung zhig /bskal pa'i mes (13na)sregs shig /dam tshig gi dmod pas sdigasashig /bka'i chad pas chod cig /gnam lcags thog gi ral gris spyi bo'i gtsug nas khos shig /gang ni / non cig /srid gsum gar skyes gar gnas kyang sdig can 'di'i steng du rdo rje me'i char chen po phob cig /gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ sbyor ba ngan pa thul cig /bka' bsgo 'di yi nus pa yis/ /thal phye rlung gis gtore ba ltar/ /gnod byed de ru gnas mi 'gyur/ /drang srong dmod de zlog tu nan/ /zhes brjod de thal mo lan gsum brdab/ de'ang rgyun 'byer ram bsnyen pa'i thun gyi thog mthar/ man ngag sems la shes pa ni/ /snying nang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ/ /mthing nag zhig la sems gtad de/ /ma bcos phang sar bzhag pa'i ngang / /ka dag chos sku'i rang zhal blta/ /zhesabarjod cing don la mnyam par bzhag /'di ni zhi drag gi bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi khrigs rim ltar bkod kyi/ rgyun 'byer gyi srung bzlog bsad pa byed na rtsa bsnyen ci rigs bzlas rjes su chos rgyal 'bri gung ba rin cen phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyun 'khyer snying po gsal ba nas srung bzlog bsad —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gsum blangs pas ba cing 'phrin las mi gyer bar rgyun 'byer kho na don du gnyer na thun bsdu ba/spyod lam/gtor 'bul spro na bya ba sogs de nyid sor bzhag legs so//mthar chad lhag skong phyir ā li kā li dang yig brgya bzla/gter srung mchod pa ni/hūṃ/dge bar+sā she'u kha ri dang //jo bo klu bdud mgo dgu dang //ston ka nag bo: pa tsa//gter srung tshogs 13bsgoms gnas 'dir spyon//nyer spyod 'dod yon gtor ma dang //mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs kyis mchod//nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci ma mis bshags//thugs dam skong ngo dngos grub stsol//ā+oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtore ma bsngo/ā+oṃ de wa nā ga a nas/sha lta pra twe ts+tsha swā hā/hūṃ/mkho mthing gter srung shel ging dkar//tshur spyon dgyes pa'i stan la bzhugs//sman rag gtor gsum phyi nang gi/'dod yon mchod pa rgya mtsho 'bul//bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs//zab chos 'chad nyan sgom sgrub la//phrag dog nyer 'tshe med pa yi//bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//oṃ ma hā rā dza kiṅka ra sa pa ri wa ra ma hā bas ma hā rak+ta/mahā ba li ta khā hi/sngags ma sdug tu a nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchode/gsum pa mjug la/tshogs rdzas dngos po rnams la chu chang dang sman raka bran te drag sngags kyis bgegs bskrad rjes/bsang sbyang byin rlabs bya ba ni/hūṃ/rang nyid ltar gsal thugs srog yi ge las//raṃ waṃ 'a gsum me rlung chu 'phros te//tsho gis rdzas nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs bkrus bas//rnam dag 'dod yon 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gter//zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur//ā+oṃ āḥ/ ha ho phyi zhes lan gsum brjod/spyan drangs shing dbul ba ni/hūṃ/chos dbyingasabade chen pho brang nas//bla ma dkon cog rnam gsum la//zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul /dbang bskur byin rlo bos smin grol stsol//'og min chos dbyings pho brang na//yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la//zhal zas tshogs 14na8 mchod pa 'bul//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//ri bo kun 'dus rtse mo na//drang srong dri med 'khor bcas la//zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul//sdebargyad dbang sdud dngos grub stsol//yang ༷༷༷ dregs 'dul khro rgyal dang //sprul 'khor drang

drang srong log tre ga la'i la byang chog sgrigs gnam lcag rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma (pesrong 'bum sdel//zhal zas tshogis kyi mchod pa 'bul//'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzod//bka' gsang dam tshig gnyan gnas pa'i//zab gter bka' yis srung ma la//zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa 'bul//gter chos bstan pa 'phel rgyas mdzod//stong khams phyogs bcu'i klong yangasan//bka' nyan dregs pa sdebargyad la//zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa 'bul//bstan pa bsrung ba'i wen las mdzod//bsngo zhing bskang bshags bya ba ni/na mo/rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon cog yi dam lha//dam can rgya mtsho bstan srung ma lus dang //dregs 'dul drang srong sprul pa 'bum sder bcas//bka' nyan gter bdag dregs pa'i tsho gos bcas la//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas ma lus dang//zhal zas tshogis kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang //nyams chags nongs mchis ma lus mthol zhing bshags//skongs gyur mchog thun las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol//yig brgya brjod//bsgral ba ni/e ni tri dzaḥsnyi/yi dam lha dang drang srong r+ṣa po yi//dmod pa'i bden rdzo brjod pa'i byin chasakyis//gnod byed dgra bgegs gzugs ming liṅga la//myur du phob cig sarba ni tri dza //rings par khug cig badz+ra a du sha//myur du chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/14bskom por sdo mes shig badz+ra slo ṭa baṃ//drag por sgrol zhig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi sngo/gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba ni tri aṅga sha dza:zhes dgug bstim drag tu bya zhing //ā+oṃ log tri pā la nan dzaḥsogs brjod/rdo rje phur pa gī la ya/sangasargyas 'phrin las yongs rdzogs sku//dregs 'dul drang srong sprul pa'i sras//sras mchoge badz+raki li ya//dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog/oṃ trang du dang /badz+ra gī lu ya dgra bgegs sarba ni tri sha / hur thum dza mā ra ya rbad//drag sngags spu gri brjod de phur pa btab cing ral gyis gtubs/sman raka bran la/hūṃ/rab 'jigs drang srong nag po 'khor dang bcas//bzhengs shig bgos shig sku bzhedas shig/ri rab tsam du che ba'i sku bzhengs shig/stong khams nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye zhig/rno gdug gangs ri gtams 'dra'i mche ba gtsigs//bar snang glog stong 'byug 'dra'i ljags skyod la/sha rus don snying khrag la rngam pa yi//dgra ༷gegs byad ma bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di//zhal du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shestob bo kha raṃ khā hi/ /mgur du 'dril lo a ra li/ /bzhes shig rol zhig kha raṃ khā hi/ /thong du dang log tri pā la nan sogs rtsa sngags zhabs su dgra bgegs nga posarba ni tri sha nyu ma hā me sa khā hi/ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ mahā tsak+ṣu 'a hi/ dmod pa'i bden stobs brjod/ lhag ma ni/ 'bru gsum dang a kā ros 'dod yon du byin gyis brlab la/hūṃ/ 'dod yon zag med dpal gyi pham phabs 'di/ /thog tha bar gyi phud lhag tsho gos mchode la/ /ji ltar dbang ba'i (15na sko tsho gos ma lus pa/ /so sor mnyes mchode dgyes rol dngos grub stsol/ gha na tsakra u sto ni ba lidha khā hi/ /chad mtho ni/ hūṃ/ sngon lcang lo can gyi pho brang du/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje yis/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dam btags tshe/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor stong grogs byed par ma chad dam/ /ji ltar khas blangs bzhin du 'phrin lasamadzod/ /de rjes ri bo kun 'dus rtse mo mā /drang srong chen po dri med 'od zer gyis/ /dregs pa ma lusazil gyis mnan pa'i tshe/ /bka' yi gtor mtsha / /rnal 'byor stong grogs byed:/ /ji ltar khas blangs / /de 'og lho phyogs in+t+ra'i grong khyer du/ /rgyal bas lung bstan mya ngan med pa yis/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud las la bkol ba'i tshe/ /bka' yi gtor ma:/ /rnal 'byor stong grogs byed / /ji ltar khas blangasaḥ/ /de 'og chos 'khor dpal gyi bsam yas su/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng gis/ /drang srong dmod pas sdobargyad tshar bcad tshe/ /bka' yi gtor ma / /rnal 'byor stong grogasaḥ/ /ji ltar khas blangs / /de 'og zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang du/ /thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor chos dbang gis/ /dregs pa'i sdod pon bran du 'khol ba'i tshe/ /bka' yi / /rnal 'byoraḥ/ /ji ltar khas / /da lta ba po shis byin chags gnas mchogo 'dir/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam gyis/bsnyen sgrub las sbyor tshul bzhin 'gyid pa'i tshe/ /bka' yi —/ /rnal 'byor / /ji ltar / /bstan skyong ni/ hūṃ/ bstan pa skyong mdzad ma dang sring / /dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes/ /khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma/ /me stag zla 'od byang rgyal ma/ /gser thang kun bzang sharnyi dpal/ /klu mo gzi 'bar —402

drang thong log: ga la'i la byang chog sgrigs gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma 9)la sogs pa'i (15ba tha stan ma bcu gnyis gtore ma long / /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnamasabazlog /'o༅ཿ/ badz+ra a phrita khā hi ma ma lha ma ma lha khā hi 'a hi/ bro brdung ni/ hūṃ/ drang srong 'khor bcas rol ba'i bro/ /sdebargyad snying la chems rtse chem/ khro bo khro mo rol pa'i bro/ /sdebargyad snying la:/khro bo rnams kyis bro brdungs pas/ khro mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs so/ shar du zhi ba'i bro brdungasapas/ /nad gdon bar ho zhi bar shog /lho ru rgyas par thojo/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par shog /nub tu dbang gi bro za/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang sdud shog /byang du drag po'i —/ /dgra bgegs dam sri zhi bar shog /ā+oṃ co du tri na co du dzaḥdzaḥ shārnyi/ thu / pā shi/ /mā ra ya rbad/ /gto rag ni/ hūṃ drang srong zhi khro'i lha tsho gis la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chags nyes lhung ma lusabashags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya brjod de lhag chad kha bkang / /nyer bsdu ni/ hūṃ/ da ni bsam gtan dkyil 'khor bsdu/ /bskyed rim ting 'dzin lha yi sku/ /snang stong sku yi klong du thim/ /'dzab bsnyen dmod tshig sngags kyi sgra/ /grag stong gsung gi:/ /skye med rang shar rig pa'i rtsal/ /gsal stong thugs kyi / /rang gdangs rten 'brel srung ba'i gur/ /ye shes rnam lnga'i slong du bsdu/ /dug rlangs 'ja' tshon —/ /sa chu me rlung gnam lcags gur/ yum lnga'i rang bzhin / /'khor dal pad rdor rin chen sogs/ /yab lnga ye shes / /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /rang gdangs 'od lnga'i / /steng 'og thabs shes 'khor lo yang / /zung (16na po yugarten 'brel / /rig gdangs rtse dgu'i 'od lus kyang / /'od zhu lter gnas lha la thim/ /lha rnams 'od zhu rim gyis thim/ /tha mar thugs srog tho la thim/ /de yang ra ta khog pa mgo /zla tshes thig le'i dbyings su thim/ /thig le dmigs med ngang du phaṭa/ /slar yang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs sku/ /dri med 'od zer nyid kyi ngang / /nyal na chu la ldang na me/ /'dug na brag la 'gro na rlung / /gsal ba ngar ldan spyod lam mo/ /smon lam ni/ /hūṃ/ dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /gsang bdag drang srong zhi dang khro bo yis/ /rjes bzung bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rab rgyal nas/ /tshe 'dir 'pho ba chen —403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo ba nga rgya 4 tshogasung 'bum/ (2shepo'i sku 'grub shog mas brjod ni/ hūṃ/ lus la snang stong sku yi ba po shis shog /ngag la grag stong gsung gi bkra shis shog /sems la rig stong thugs kyi bkra shis shog /bde stong mchog gi bkra shis kun khyab shog /drang srong dmod pa'i mas yis sde brgyad dpung / /sbur ma me lces bsregs 'dra'i snyan grags kyis/ /phyogs 'dir mos pa'i sngags ban ches mang rung / /tshad ldan shes pa nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin/ lkog ser dri ngad ldang ba'i man ngag rnams/ /gab dkrus thor bu'i tshul du yongs tshang yang / /mthong brgyud dmar 'khrid med par yig nag la/ /brten pa tsam de nam mkha'i mdzub ris 'dra/ /de phyir rang dang skal mnyam mang po la/ /phan ched lhag pa'i sems kyis nyer drangs nas/ /blos byas phrul ba'i sbun pa mi 'thor bar/ /phyag len dkar mo'i 'bru tsho gis phyur bur spungs/ /grangs ring brgyud pa'i gdung dang skyes sprul rnams/ /'ug pa spu gra gzings ltar (16bsgo bgying bar/ /thos bsam sgom pas snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog /zungs zhes thal mo sbyar nas bdag gsol 'debs/ /sngon byung gdon tshogs zad pa med pa'i steng / /gsar skyes dam sri dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i/ /dus 'dir sngags 'chang ral khur ldan rnams kyis/ /drag sngags dmod pa'i mtshon char 'bebs par bskul/ /gangs can phan bde'i srog 'phrog 'byung po'i gdon/ /de yi rgyud brlams mir bcas ma lus pa/ /dge ba'i gnam lcags brag ri'i thal mo'i bar/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul bzhin 'thag gyur cig /phun tshogs nyi ma 'jig rten kun la 'char/ /mdo rgyud bstan pa'i myu gu dus su smin/ /byang chub mchog gi gos bu g.yur za ba'i/ /bkra shis dga' ston dpal la spyod par shog /ces drang srong log tri pā la'i las byang gi chog sgrig gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs 'di ni/ /thog mar rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i grwa pa kha shas la sgrub khag btsugs skabs dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs mtshams pa ba rnams kyis bskul ba dang de rjes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho/ /byang 'dren dbu mdzad dkon cog rgya mtsho gsum gyis bskul zhing rim gyis 'dri 'dun yod pa'i steng drin can bla ma —404

drang thong log tri ga la'i la byang chog sgrigs gnam lcag rdo rje drag 'bebs/ nang ma (pertsod bral gyi gter ston sprul sku gter bdag gling pa dang / /spang 'gro mgon chos kyi dbang phyug gi gdung gsob gnas gzhi chos rje pad+ma tshe dbang rigs 'dzin gnyis kyi gsung gis bskul ba dang phyogs 'di la mkhas shing grub ba brnyes pa'i mnga' ris bla chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis yang bskyar 'phrin yig las drangs te bskul ba la brten g.yo ru lho rgyud du (17na tshe1sa pa'i za hor gyi sngags rgan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis gter kha gong 'og gi yig rnying / cho ge rgyal gnam lcags me 'bar gyis mdzad pa'i las byang dang rgyun 'byer/ /bu lod rin chen bzang po'i tshogs mchode sogasakhungs thub kyi yig cha rnams nas gang dgos 'khrugs bsdebs su bsgrigs/ khong zad mi gsal bar blos mtshams sbyar te/ /chu glang nag pa zla ba'i dmar cha'i dga' ba dang po la pho brang chen po bo ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun ba 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa 'dis kyang nag phyogs 'byung po'i tsho gis rnams 'joms pa'i rgyur gyur cig / —403—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()drang srong log tri pa la'i srung bzlog thun mong ba nyams su len tshul btsan mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul sgrogs bzhugs so//na mo bi mā la ra sma ye/sdebargyad tsha ngar ma cu stobs chu rgyun gyis//gzhil mdzad yi dam bcud phur sngags rgod kyi//nyams len gnad dril rtogs 'di bla ma'i drin//bsams kyin snying dbus pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur spyon//srung bzlog bsad mnan bcas kyi rim pa la//rgyas 'bring bsdusapa'i rnam gzhag pha mtha' yas//zhal shes dmar 'khrid med na gab dkrugs kyi//glegs bam byisapas lha khang blta dang mtshungs//deng dus chos don gnyer ba ches nyung bas//lag len mtha' rgya gcod pa nyin skar tsam//de phyir dang po'i las can 'ga' zhig ched//'dri bar rtsa ba gsum gyisaganang ba stsol//de la 'dir bram ze'i sngags rgod log tri pā la'i srung bzlog bsad mnan sogasanyams su len par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas bla ma zhi drag dang bka' brgyad spyi bye brag ci rigs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par thob cing sgos gyi 'di'i rig gtad/lung /man ngag nos/zhi ba'i gong bsnyen rab sum 'bum/'bring chig 'bum/tha ma'ang tshig khri/rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rab bye ba 'am tha ma 2na〉kyim 'bum thems pa 'am yang na mchan ma'i bsnyen pa rtags ldan du thems pas las sbyor gyi rim pa lag tu len pa la gtor ma la brten pa'i srung ba/bzlog pa rkyang pa/bzlog bsad drag po'i bcas rgyas pa mchod rten dkar nag la brten pa/bcas bsdus pa gtor ma la brten pa/'byung bzhi dang bzlog bsad kyi las khol bur bsgrub pa rnams las/dang po srung ba nyams su bstar ba la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su cog tse lta bu stegs ji ltar 'os pa'i khar 'bru nag ngar btags kyi phye la 'bru sna lnga/man ngag las byung ba'i rdzas ṭ+wāṃ /mas bsres pa khrag chang gis sprus pa'i gtor ma

drang thong log tri pa la'i srung bzlog bzha mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul skyogs/ nang ma (pezur gsum dkyil dmar mtha' nag pa/ /'khor ldebargyad kyi gtor mas bskor ba me ri sogs drag po'i rgyan spros tsham ngam can/ rtsang dmar/ bsad sha dmar po/ rtsang la btsugs pa'i liṅga kha sbub pa rgyu lding / mtsho yungs/ yong skyu kha phyir bstan khrag kor sogs dpe ris dang mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar bzos pa'i gtso 'khor gyi gtor ma'i nang du shog dril dang gtor gdugs kyi khrod du srung bzlog gi (2ba tshe tswa sgor lo man ngag bzhin 'phyugs med dang rab gnas can gyi tsa gli btsugs pa ma sgyu'am khri'u'i steng du bzhag /mtha' skor du sman raka /drag po'i gtor ma zur gsum 'khor sdebargyad kyis bskor ba/ de dang dbyibs 'dra ba'i rtag gtor/ khrag chen bsres pa'i chu gnyis/ rang rdzas bsres pa'i dbang po lnga bcos ma'am nas nag gi me rtag sha chen sbyar ba'i spos/ tshil rkang 'bru mar gyi mar me/ chang la mkhris chen sbyar ba'i dri chab/ sha rus bsres pa'i lha bsgos dmar po zur gsum sogs nang gi nyer spyod sbreng tshar du bkod/ zur zhig tu thun gtor zur gsum gyi logasagasum ong skyu sbyar ba'i khrag gis brgyan pa/ gtor zor la/ rtsang mtsho yungs mtsho ni cha'i rigasa'adzugs/ kong thor / mda' zor/ khrag zor/ rdo zor rnams kyi rdzas dang phyag len phu long kyisamadzad pa'i zor gyi rim pa las byung ba ltar bya zhing / gtor ma'i stegs bu'i phyogs mtshams gang der 'god/ sgrub khang gis yul gang bde 'am gsang bdag dang drang srong gi rten lta bu'i drung du stegs mtho bar gong gnon drang srong zhi ba'i gtor ma/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ de dag gi mtha' skor ci rigasabar sgos kyi chos skyong dang gter srung gi gtor ma/ tshogs chas/ gzhi/ bgegs kyi gtor ma/yungs thun/ gu gul/ g.yab dar rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad 'du bgyis/ yar ngo 'am mar ngol yang zung ste srung ba la shis pa'i gza' skar dang bstun mtshams bcad/ sgrub pa po rnams stan bde ba la 'khod/ las byang gi gzhung bsrangs/ zhi drag gi bsnyen sngags dang srung sngagasabargya phrag (3na〉mom bzlas/ /tsho gos tha ma yan phul/ /lhag ma btson du bzung ste nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ /nang par thor thun nas 'dzab la thug gi bar btang / /mchong smug gur nang dbyangs—407—

rgyal dbang lnga ba nga gdabang blo ba nga rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegasal zhu ba las/ /dkar dmar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyar dbus/ /lha yig khog par ting 'dzin semasadapa' ni/ /mthing nag mdog ldan hūṃ gi klad kor du/ /bla ma slob dpon hūṃ gi g.yas su pho/ /g.yon du mo rigs mdun du gang gces pa/ /rgyab tu 'khor g.yog 'og tu sa mkhar dang / /rta phyugs yul zhing bsrung bya ma lus gsal/ /bdag lce rdo rje rtse dgur gsal ba yi/ /lte ba'i hūṃ la srung ba'i sngagasaphreng las/ /'od zer los pas rwa rtse'i phaṭa dgur phog /de nas dza:yig dmar po dgu byung las/ /'phros pa'i 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /las bye pho nya sprul pa yang sprul dang / /gsum sprul khro bo khro mo dpag med tshogs/ /spros pas rang gzhan bsrung bya thams cad kyi/ /tshe dang srog gi ngo bo ni'i rnam par/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyis brkus phyogs nas/ /mtho ba nam mkha' dma' ba dmyal ba'i sa/ /nyi zla'i them bar sprin gyi go bar khrod/ /ri rab lcog bar 'dzam gling yul gru sogs/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla gar khyer zhing / /sbas dang bskungs nas yod pa ma lus pa/ /sprul pa'i pho nya khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyis nyer gzigs nas/ /gnod byed thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog /tshe srog yi ge'i gzugs can de phyogs nas/ /hūṃ gi rnam par rang g.yin bsrung bya yi/ /thugs kar bstim pas srog 'thud tshe nyams(3bskral/ /slar yang lte yi 'od zer 'phro 'du yi/ /bla ma yi dam bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud chos skyong byin rlabs mthu/ /lha srin sdebargyad rnams kyi srog gi snying / /lha mi'i tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang dang / /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rnam lnga'i bcud/ /thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas ni/ /bdag gzhan bsrung bya kun dang dbyer med par/ /thim pasabakrag mdangs mthu stobs ldan par bsam/ /ā+oṃ log tri pā la nan srung/ sag pa sha nan srungs/ /nā ga du du nan srungs/ ma me ma me srungs/ /tsir tsar tsir tsar srungs/ baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu srungs/ rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya srungs/ ho ra ho ra srungs/ tsi dus tsi dus sod/ shig lhu ru gtubs/ ha la pa ti nan/ 'khor ba dul/ gnod byed 'byung po'i kā wā tsi brlag brlag khri lha hūṃ dzaḥ bdag cag dpon —408

drang srong log tri pa la'i srung bzlog bzha mkhar bsrung ba'i tshil skyogs/ nang ma (geslob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/zhes pa'i sngags phreng rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i//phyi rim 'od zer g.yas su yongs bskor zhing//lha rnams zhal nas srid pa'i sngags kyi sgra//dir dir rab sgrog gur khang tshogs las kyang //'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba lta bu'i sgras//srid pa gsum khyab bdag g.yin bsrung bya la//'tshe ba'i rig sngags byad stems rbod gtong dang //lha srin sde brgyad gnod pa las skyob bsam//zhes dmigs pa dang bcas sgrub ba po rnamasang ga bsdams la nyin mtshan kun tu sngags kyi sgra ma chad par bzla/de'ang thun drug tu bcad pa'i thun dang po ging zan la 'dzul ba'i thun mthar gtor chen 4na 'a sha zan dang sman raka sbran/thun gtor la rak+ta sbran/nam mkha' med par gyur na yang //sngags kyi dngos grub med mi srid//lha dang drang srong gis bshad pa'i//rig sngags bslu ba mi srid na//'dod chags bral bas bshad pa yi//gsang sngags sbyor ba bslu ba ni//ma byung byung bar mi 'gyur ro//zhes brjod de don la nges pa brtan po gting tshugs par byas nas/dgra 'dre dmigs bsal gang yin gtso bor byas pa'i dgra bgegs rnams dgug gzhug tshar gcig bya/slar yang sman raka sbran te las byang bzhin sngags rgyas drag po'i gtor ma byin gyisabarlabs/bla med mchog gi mchod pa bzhes//sogs kyis gtor ma bsngo zhing nyer spyod dang sman raka 'bul/hūṃ/rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa//gsang ba kun 'dzin drang srong dri ma med//drag po'i khros pa zhe sdang rdo rje'i sku//sprul pa yang sprul drang srong 'bum sde dang //lha srin dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rgya mtsho rnams//bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam dbyings nas bskul//mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung tshogs rab skyed cig/ba smra sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor//srung snyo skyob pa'i phren las sgrub pa dang //nad gdon bar gcod zhi ba'i las mdzod cig/tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas pa'i las //mos bzhis khams gsum dbang sdad las//gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las//ces thun gtor gtor chen la 'bul zhing sman raka sbran/chogs 'khor gtong /slar ༷༷ 9thun gtor gcig bshams pa la sman raka 4ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesbran te 'dod yon du brlab/ gtor r+sā la sha zan sman raka sbran/ de bzhin du seng stag kha bgeng ba'i dus/ /chu srin rnga ma g.yab pa'i dus/ /bdud dmag la mas pa'i dus/ /srin po sto ba la drab pa'i dus/ /gshin rjes khram la 'debs pa'i dus/ /gzhan lnga por yang 'dzab bzla ba dang thun gtor gtong ba sogs snga ma ji lta ba bzhin bya/ srung ba'i ring thun rer mchod pa gsob las mi brje/ rdul phyags mi byed/ gos mgo mjug dang phyir mi bsgyur/ stan mi sprug /phyag mi 'tshol/ mdor na srid pa'i gter khyim sogs drag sngags kyi sdoms tsam rnams nas bshad pa'i bsnyen sgrub spyi la gces pa'i zhal gdams rnams nyams su bslangs te/ mtshams ma ral ba gnad du che'o/ /de ltar srung ba'i rtags dngos nyams rmi lam ci rigs su byung ba dang rtag gtor la rak+ta sbran te/ dgug gzhug dang bcas bskul tshig gi 'bul ba'i bar thun gtor ji lta ba la gtor ma thog tu 'bul/ gtor chen la sha zan sman raka sbran nas byin rlabs gtor bsngo gzhung bzhin byed/ gdod gsol ni/ mtshan ldan bla mas bka' yi lung bstan cing / /tshe rabs du mar rjes su 'brel ba las/ /da lta zhal mthong dngosagrub brnyes pa'i lha/ /'di phyi gtan gyi bar chad sel ba'i mgon/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus drang srong dri ma med/ /bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i gos bu mchis pa dang / /mi dang mi min duḥ kha'i 'tshe ba las/ /brtse ldan khyed kyi thugs rjes skyob tu gsol/ /ā+oṃ trang du tri na trang du dzaḥdzaḥsarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ/sku gsung thugs gsang ye shes rol pa che/ /rmad byung 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'khor lo dang / /(ldan)bdag gi lusang ga yid gsum dbyer med du/ /byin rlobs mchoge thun dngos grub myur du stsol/ /ā+oṃ to du / /rmongs zhabrul dug lnga'i dbang du song ba las/ /tshe 'dir mi dge'i las la ci spyad dang / /sngon bsags sdig pa'i rnam smin 'bras bu yang / /'phags mchog khyod kyis byang zhing dag par mdzod/ /ces rje btsun bkra shis phun tsho gos kyis mdzad pa dang gzhan yang yang bzlog gi 'dod gsol lha yi lha mchog ma'i 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed ces pa drang srong dang khro zhes par bsgyur zhing bskal ba dpag med yang bya/ gzhan yang bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phrog pa spyi yi bgegs/—410

drang grong log tri pa la'i srung bzlog bzha mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul skyogs/ nang ma 9)bdag sogs bsrung bya la 'tshe sgos kyi gdon//mi bsrun 'byung po'i rtsa sbur drang srong gi/dmod pa'i me yis gzhob tu sreg par mdzod//snyigs ma lnga bdo lha srin sdebargyad zhabrugs//ban sngags bon dang mu stegs mthu byad gtong //'phung byed 'gong pos skye ba'i rgyud dkrug brlams//smon lam log pa'i dam sri ches cher 'phel//de phyir dus ga 'di ru lha khyod kyis//mthu dpung bskyed la gnod byed ldebargyad spyi/khyad par rgyal bsen 'gong po dre bo btsan//dam sri klu gnyan sa bdag tsha ngar chog/mas byad rbod gtong rang gshed rang la phob//gdon bgegs 'byung po'i srog rtsa dmar po chod//nad gdon chags che nyam nga thams cad sgyur//tshe dpal lung rtogs yon to 'phel bar mdzod//ces 'dod gsol smon lam ci rigs bya//dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya bzla zhing ngag 'grol lo//gnyis pa bzlog pa rkyang 5ba pa ni/gtor chen kha phar bsgyur zhing 'khor lo gnyis kyang rgyab mdun phyi nang mi 'dzol ba byed/stan kha sbub/gos mgo mjug ldog/man ngag bzhin sna zhur 'then/bya rog gi zhwa rgyun du gyon pa 'am ma bde na cung zad re a 'gor gyon/las byang gzhung bsrang ba lha bskyed pa'i bar btang nas bdag mdun gnyis ka lhan cig tu bskyed pa'i zhan la ting nge 'dzin can gyis kyang 'grub mod dmigs pa gsal phyir zor rnams byin rlabs kyi ched du/zor gtor skad cig stong pa'i ngang //drag gtor gnas gyur rdzus skyes su//rab khros drang srong khro bo'i rgyal//mun pa ltar nag 'jigs pa'i sku//zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis bgrad/kham nag dbu skra gyen du 'khyil//spyan bgrad sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug/zha kha gdangs mche gtsigs ljagasa'adril zhing //drag sngags me yi tsha tsha 'phro//gcer bu rgyan bral phyag bzhi yi//dang po gnam lcags tho ral dang //'og gnyis drag por zor rdzas thogs//che brjid gas rngam 'jigs pa'i sku//yang sprul rang 'dra'i khro bo'i tshogs//drag zor thogs pa 'bum sder bcas//dregs pa sdo brgyad ma lus pa//dbang sdud zil gnon bran du 'khol//dmar nag me rlung 'tshub dkyil klong //'khor bcas sdodapung bzhon par bcas/khros gcig /ma pa'i tshul gyis gsal//slar yang drag gtor de

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo sde rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)nyid kyi//rtsa bar bsad khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil//zhing gi lhu dum phyol zhing lding //rked par zor bdag khro bo'i tshogs//rlung ltar 'tshub cing glog ltar 'byug/rtse mor nad mtshon bu yug khrin〉lhub//drag rtsal nus ldan 'jigs pa'i zor//thogs rdugs 'gyings bzlog ma mchis shing //gang la brgyab pa'i dgra bgegs rnams//thal ba'i rdul du brlag nus bsam//zor rdzas mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang //dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po ltar//che brjid nang gi zor a rnams//rang rang srog gi yi ge las//skad cig rdzus skyes dregs pa'i tshogs//bka' nyan sdo brgyad 'dus pa'i dmag/mgon po yungs zor thogs pa 'bum//'chi bdag mtshon zor thogs ba 'bum//'gre/gshin rje dug zor thogs pa 'bum//sa bdag mdzo zor thogs pa 'bum//klu bdag nad zor thogs pa 'bum//ma mo khrag zor thogs pa bum//bas rgod mtshe zor thogs pa 'bum//bdud nag khram zor thogasapa 'bum//gza' bdud dug zor thogs pa 'bum//rgyal po gtor zor thogs pa 'bum//'gong po phur zor thogs pa 'bum//las rdo zor thogs pa 'bum//dmu bdud rtsang zor thogs pa 'bum/mi nag mda' zor thogs pa 'bum//bud med g.yab zor thogs pa 'bum//bshan pa gri zor thogasapa 'bum//zor bdag dregs pa'i dmag dpung ni//srog bdag sdebargyad drag shul can//la la ri rab 'degs shing 'phen//'ga' zhig rgya mtsho rngub kyis 'debs//de bzhin stong khams me ru spar//bskal ba'i rlung gis 'thor zhing sbud//mda' mtshon gnam lcags thog mda' 'bebs//me rlung 'tshub ma thul lu lu/kha nas drag sngags shar ra ra//dug nag rlangs pa bun ba bun/khrag gi char 'bab sil li li//ku sgra bsro sgra dir ri ri//rab 'jigs bshug glu kyur ru sa/gad brgyang 'brug sgra chems6brdzi chems//gdug rtsub thog ser shar ra ra//sna tsho gis ru mtshon sbur ru sa/mda' mdung mardzo rnon yer re re//zhub chen bzhon pa nyer re re//mun nag las skor khyil li li//sdobargyad drag po'i dmag dpung rnams//go cha sra la mtshon cha rno//rno myur drag rtsal ldan pa ni//stong khams gang ba'i dpung du gyur//spyan 'dren nasaXdzab la thug gi bar btang rjes//rang nyid zhe sdang

drang srong log tri pa la'i srung bzlog bzha mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul skyogs/ nang ma (gerdo rjer gsal ba yis/ /mtha' ma'i phyag gnyis gnam lcags rab 'bar ba'i/ /lag mthil sdigasamadzub dbus su dgra bgegs dang / /byad ma gdon bgegs thams cad mngon sum du/ /gsal ba'i ting 'dzin nga rgyal gdengs ldan pa'i/ /lha tsho gos zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i sngags/ /sgrog cing gur khang las kyang 'brug stong ltar/ /ldir bas rbod gtong lha srin gnod pa bzlog /sngags phreng las 'phros 'od zer gyis bskor ba'i/ /'phro 'dus byang ma'i steng du babs par gyur/ /lce dbyibasaganam lcags rdo rjer gsal ba yi/ /lte ba'i hūṃ dang sngags las 'phros pa'i 'od/ /rwa dgu'i sbubasabargyud rtse mo'i phaṭa dmar po/ /bskul ba las 'phros ye shes me yi zer/ /mgar gyi tsha tsha zhun ma ltar 'phros dang / khro bo pho nya slog ltar 'byug pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs byad ma rbad 'dre rbod gtong tshogs/ /rgyal bsen 'gong po dam sri shi 'dre btsan/ /klu gnyan sa bdag la sogs gnod byed kyi/ /sde brgyad rnams la phog pas sbrang bu mer/ /lcebs ba ji bzhin shigs hrags thul thul tshig /bsam sbyor ga (7na)pa'i nus stobs rdul du brlag /rbad 'dre sdebargyad 'byung po ma lus pa/ /rbod gtong mkhan sogs dgra bo kho rang gi /gshed du babs nas sha zos khrag 'thung zhing / /rus mur pags bshus rlon pa gos gyon nas/ /ming dang brda dang tha snyad tsam du yang / /lus pa med par rdul du brlag par bsam/ /ā+oṃ log tri pā la nan bh+yo bzlog /sag pa sha nan bh+yo bzlog /nā ga du du nan bh+yo bzlog ma me ma mi bh+yo bzlog tsir tsar tsir tsar bh+yo bzlog /baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu bh+yo bzlog rbad tra ko sha ya bod tra ko sha ya bh+yo bzlog /ho ra ho ra bh+yo bzlog /tsi du sod tsi du sod/ shig lhu ru gsas/ ha la pa ti nan/ 'khor 'dul/ gnod byed 'byung po'i kwa wā tsi brlag brlag /dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya bh+yo bzlog /ces 'bad de bzla/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba yi mtha' phyag rdo rje'i brag ri ltar gyur pa'i/ /lag mthil nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sor bcu gnam lcags sdig pa mgo dgu pa/ /thal brdabs dgra bgegs dmar tshil btang ba yi/ sha khrag dum bur 'thor ba sdig pa'i khas/ /lcib lcib zos pas lhag ma tsam du yang / /ma lus rjes shul med par —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebarlag par bsam/ /nam mkha' med par sogs kyis bden pa brjod rjes/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa sogs yang bzlog ltar la phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag po zhes pa'i tshab la drang srong zhi khro sngags rgod log tri pā la'i zhes bsgyur thal brdab lan gsum dang drang srong gi dmod pa tshar gcig brjod/ thun gtor gtong ba dang zas za ba'i snga rol tu'ang thal (7ba〉rdab bya/ thun mthar gtor chen kha gso/ thun gtor sha khrag mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan nga/ gtor ma'i stod khro bo la smad chad dgra bgegs su gsal ba la rak+ta sbran/ dgug gzhug lan gsum byed cing sman raka sbran te byin rlabs nas bzung 'bul tshig ba li sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la yan srung ba ltar/ chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /sde brgyad 'byung po bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /dmigs bkar gdon 'di bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /rmi ltasamatshan ngan bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /lo keg zla keg bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zhag geg za keg bzog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phog khres brjod/ lcags sam bhan+ta sa bskul zhing gshin rje zhes pa drang srong du bsgyur nas thabs sam dgra phyogs su 'phang / khrom bzlog sogs bzlog sngags zab mo'i rigs bzla/ drang srong gi dmag tsho gos kyis rgyal 'gong dam sris mtshon pa'i dgra bgegs gang yin pa'i phyogs su song ste tshar bcad/ rbad 'dre dang sde brgyad rnams dgra bo'i gshed du babs nas brlag par bsam/ thun gtor gsar ba bshams pa khro bor bskyed/ gtor chen kha gso ba sogs srung ba'i skabs dang 'dra/ thun mtshams la zor
