sngags kyang cung zad bzla zhing zhor sgrub byed/ mtshams khang du phyag bdar bya/ mchod pa brje bzlog pa'i rtags dngosanyams rmi lam du byung ba dang rtag gtor thun gtor bzhin 'bul/ gtor chen gsos nas byin gyisabarlab cing bsngos te 'dod gsol lha mchog ma/ bskal ba dpag med ma/ bstan 'gro (8nasgo sogs bya/ thal brdab dang bden tshig brjod/ dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya bzlos te ngag 'grol lo/ /bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ mchog gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma dang/ /yi dam zhi khro dam can srung —4/4

drang srong log tri pa la'i srung bzlog bsdo mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul skyogs/ nang ma (pema'i tshogs/ /drang srong dri med sprul 'khor bka' sdod bcas/ /thugs dam gnad las bskul lo sam ya/ /bh+yo/ dregs 'dul khro rgyal chen po'i dus la bab/ /sprul pa'i drang srong 'bum tsho gos mas ma chung / /'khor gyi lha srin sdebargyad rtsal ma zhan/ /myur mgyogs pho lha'i tsho gos rnams bang ma bul/ /chos shig chos shig dzi brgyad dmag dpung chos/ khyug cig rgyug cig dgra bo'i yul du rgyug /phob cig phob cig than dang cho 'phrul phob/ /phyogs shig phyogs shig srog dbugs bla tshe phrogs/ /dmigs par gang byas dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ /lo zla ma 'gor myur du ma bsgral na/ /drang srong wo po'i bden tshig nyams 'gyur te/ /bka' nyan dregs pa'i tshogs rnams mthu re chung / /de bas dam rdzas ba smra gtore ma dang/ /dgra bo'i sha khrag rus la rngam zas gyis/ /byad ma'i lha srung rang gshed rang la phong /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ drang srong wo po dri med dge ba yi/ /bka' nyan las byed lha srin dregs pa rnams/ /so so'i gnas nas dpung tsho gos tho ne par bcas/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon gnas 'dir dam la spyon/ /bh+yo/ dregs pa sdebargyad mtshan nyid ni/ khun nag 'tshub ma 'khyil li li/ /nad kyi na bun thul lu lu/ /thog ser bu yug chil li li/ khrag gi char babs sil li li/ /kai kai glog dmar (8bskams se kem/ /ma rungs 'brug sgra 'ur ru sa /mi sdug mas ma shar ra ra/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs thor ro ro/ /dregs pa sdo brgyad dgra la bh+yo/ /lha klu bdud btsan ma mo dang / /srog bdag gza' bdud gshin rje dmu/ /gnod sbyin rā tsa 'gong po'i tshogs/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /snang srid lha 'dre dregs pa'i tshogs/ khyug cig da ni las la chos/ khug cig khug cig bla tshe khug /dgra bgegs bla tshe da khug cig /srog rtsa chod la snying rtsa gtubs/ /sdebargyad dmag dpung dgra la bh+yo/ /dgra bo mi nor kha phung thong / /ltas ga cho 'phrul sna tsho gis phob/ /bskul lo rbad do mthu ma chung / /drang srong bden pa'i bka' ma bcag /rnal 'byor dam rdzas chud ma gson/ sha khrag rgyan ldan ba kla long / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /mnga' gsol ba ni/hūṃ byu/ chos kyi dbyings las longs spyod skur snang ba/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i 'od zer —415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelas/ /sprul sku dregs 'dul drang srong dri med ces/ /sangs rgyas stong gi sprul par mnga' gsol lo/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa yis/ /bag chags sgrib tsho gos spangs par mnga' gsol lo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis drang srong cha lugs 'dzin/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan par mnga' gsol lo/ /sku mdog sngo skya skem rid keng rus tshul/ /'dod chags dug lnga spangs par mnga' gsol lo/ /dbu skra lcang lo gyen du 'khyil ba yis/ khams gsum dbang du sdud par mnga' gsol lo/ /sma ra ag tshom rgya mdor nyam pa yis/ /'dod dgu char ltar 'bebs par mnga' (9na po sol lo/ khrel dung wang mig snyan rgyan spras pa yis/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol bar mnga' gsol lo/ /zhal nas sdebargyad srog gi spu gri gsung / /sangs rgyas bstan srung chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje nam mkhar gdengs/ /sdebargyad gnad la bor bar mnga' gsol lo/ /g.yon pa lung thang phreng ba 'dren pa yis/ /lha srin dregs pa'i srog 'phrog mnga' gsol lo/ /sku la ras dkar na bza' klubasapa yis/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun bsgrub mnga' gsol lo/ /'khor du drang srong 'bum sdes bskor ba yis/ /sprul bas kun la khyab par mnga' gsol lo/ /ri bo kun 'dul rtse la bzhugs pa yis/ /sde brgyad dbang du sdud par mnga' gsol lo/ /nags tshal dra ba'i phug na bzhugs pa yis/ /sa bcu zil gyis gnon par mnga' gsol lo/ mang tog sna tsho gos zhal du gsol ba yis/ /tshe dang bsod nams spel bar mnga' gsol lo/ /rnal 'byor gdung bas gsol 'debs mnga' gsol bas/ /thugs rjes byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /hūṃ / / de las yang sprul skad cig rdzus skyes su/ /zhe sdang rdo rje mthing nag khro bo'i rgyal/ /gcer bu rgyan med rab 'jigs rngam pa'i sku/ /spros bral 'gyur med chos sku mnga' gsol lo/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs zung bgrad pa yis/ /don dam 'phrin las thabs shes mnga' gsol lo/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril me stag 'phro/ /gnod byed gzhob tu sreg par mnga' gsol lo/ /spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug /myur mgyogs(5ba tshe'u na las bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo/ /rdzi smin sma ra ag tshom tsha tsha 'gro/ /nyams —416

drang srong log: pa la'i srung bzlog bzha mkhar bsrung phe 'grus skyogs/ nang ma 6)pa sgrol mdzad dpa' bor mnga' gsol lo//dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes shing 'bar//dkar phyogs bstan pa rgyas mdzad mnga' gsol lo//bad nyi dgra bgegs gdan la 'gying ba yis//chags bral gdug pa zil gnon mnga' gsol lo//phyag g.yas gnam lcags tho chen nam mkhar 'phyar//dgra gdon mgo bo 'gems par mnga' gsol lo//g.yon pa bsam gcod rno ngar ral gri gdeng //gnod byed gzugs phung gtub par mnga' gsol lo//'og ma'i phyag gnyis mchode rten nam mkhar bteg/rnal 'byor tshe srog bsrung bar mnga' gsol lo//res cig nyi zla cha lang drag tu rdeb//bzlog bsad sha khrag 'thor bar mnga' gsol lo//de tshe sor mdzub sdig pa dmar nag bcus/sha khrag lhag med rol bar mnga' gsol lo//yang cig sa 'dzin lhun po mkha' la bskyod//dgra bgegs gnon cing gzir mdzad mnga' gsol lo//rang 'dra'i khro chung dpag med 'phro 'du yis//thogs min 'phrin las bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo//drag sngags lo 'du lcags kyu 'phreng ba yis//ma drangs khrung ba 'gugs par mnga' gsol lo//bka' yi bden tshig dmod pa'i mthustobs kyis//drag rtsal nus mthu dpag med mnga' gsol lo//ye shes bskal me'i klong du bzhugasapa yis//nyen mongs dgra gdon bsreg par mnga' gsol lo//bka' nyan sdo brgyad dmag tshogasagrangs med gyis//dgra bgegs rdul du rlog par mnga' gsol lo//dam ldan gter srung dregasatshogs ma lus pas//dam chos bstan pa 'phel rgyas mnga' gsol lo//dam 10na sa brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//dam gtsang rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor yos kyi//'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//snang grags dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//dgra gdon thal bar rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//mchog thun lasabazhi'i 'phrin las ma lus pa//lha mchog ma hā ṛ stis sgrub par mdzod//bzlog bsgyur ni/de ltar lha tshogs rnams rab tu dgyes pas bzlog bsgyur gyi las rnams thogs med du mdzad par bsam la/ bh+yo/dregs 'dul drang srong dri ma med//de sprul rdzus skyes khro wo ni//'jigs byed zhe sa rdo rje dang /4

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khro rgyal de yi sprul ba dang //yang sprul dam can rgya mtshor bcas//bka' tī dregs pa sdebargyad tshogs//rang rang g.yog sprul pho nyar bcas//'khor dang bcas pa khyod rnams la//bzlog bsgyur 'phrin las bcol ba ni//sngags 'chang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams//do cig deng sang phan chod nas//sang phod da tsam tshun chad kyi//lo zla zhag dus spar sme dang //srog lus dbang klung dgra gshed dag/gza' chos skar sbyor byed pa ga//sa bdag phyogs ga la sogs pa//mi mthun 'gal rkyen bzlog tu gsol//lha bdud ma mo rgyal btsan sogs//sdebargyad khros shing 'khrugs pa yis//'go nad yams rims 'brum bu dang /khyu gzer gag lhog gto nad sogs//nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog/lha klu gnod sbyin rgyal bsen sogs//gdon 0ba ) rigs stong phrag bco brgyad dang //bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad stodang //byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog/ltas ga brgyad sto rtsa gcig bzlog/ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog/glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu bzlog/snga zhags mda' ltar 'phen pa bzlog/phyi zhags drub ltar 'thul ba bzlog/lha chen drag po'i gdug rtsub bzlog/lha ma yin gyi sgyu thabs bzlog/skems byed lcags kyus rin pa bzlog khrang srong bram ze'i dmod pa bzlog/mgon po'i par bu bskor ba bzlog/gshin rje'i zhakhrul 'khor bcas pa bzlog/phur pa'i dbal kha btab pa bzlog/phra men nye 'byed gtong ba bzlog/pho nya'i rbod gtong rkang mgyogs bzlog/brje'i 'bum skor byung ba bzlog/bon pos zo dmar 'phangs pa bzlog/mu stegs ga sngags btang ba bzlog/yungs kyi thun zor 'phen pa bzlog/sngags pas sngags zor 'phangs pa bzlog/byad phur rbod gtong byung ba bzlog/mnan gtad khram la btab pa bzlog/sreg 'phang las sbyor byas pa bzlog/yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa bzlog/mas kyi sri ru langs pa bzlog/pha mes rgan sri langs pa bzlog/ma sru'i rgan sri langs pa bzlog/byis pa'i chung sri langasapa bzlog/dpon slob dam sri langs pa bzlog/bra dang mo rtsis ga pa bzlog/rmi lam mas ltasangan ba bzlog/la nye kha yogasang na pa bzlog/༷ /chu kha smras ngan pa bzlog/dug mtshon bsam sbyor

drang srong log tri pa la'i zung bzlog bzhi mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul skyogs/ nang ma 9)ngan pa bzlog /btsa' sad ser ba lo nyes bzlog /mi nad phyugs nad ngan pa bzlog /thog 'khyug gnam lcags lce 'bar bzlog /spyo 'bog brgyal nad ngan pa bzlog /sa klu mdze phol shu 'bras bzlog /gza' nad hur thum gtong ba bzlog /snga (11na8gra lag gis bdar ba bzlog /phyi dgra yid la bzhag pa bzlog /da dgra mdun du sdod pa bzlog /lus kyi na tsha ngan pa bzlog /sems kyi sdug bsngal ngan pa bzlog /bsam don mi 'grub bar gcod bzlog /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun bzlog /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bsgyur ro drang srong dmod ༷ / /zor ro dgra dang bgegs la zor/ /chos soganod byed gdon la chos/ /pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur/ /mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur/ /spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur/ /chung bdud dal kha thad du sgyur/ /rab 'jigs log tri'i lha tshogs rnams/ /dam rdzas gtore ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /dregs pa sdo brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /bskul lo rbad do mthum chung / /drang srong bden pa'i bka' ma bcag /sngags 'chang dam rdzas chud ma gson/ /drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces dang bzlog sngags bzla dmod mo bya zhing thal mo brdab bo/ /sgo dbye ba ni/ sgrub khang steng du gser skyems 'bul/ bh+yo/ zor byung dang po gang nas byung / /dang po zor gyi byung sa ni/ /ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs su/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yis/ khregasapa 'dul ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /dregs srog dbang du sdud pa'i phyir/ /drag sngags rno dbal 'brug stong sgra/ /rab tu bsgrags pa'i sngags zor gyis/ /dregs byed lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /rab 'jigasadangangs skrag rengs shing brgyal/ /brgyal ba sangs nas dregs pa'i tshogs/ /'khor dang 'bangs su khas blangs nas/ /(11ba'ang rang srog gi snying po phul/ /dang po sngags zor de ltar byung / /de 'og bar gyi bskal ba la/ /rgya gar yul gyi lho yi phyogs/ /lho phyogs in+da'i yul dbus su/ /chos rgyal dha rma a shwa de/ /sa bdag klu dug nad kyis zin/ /dus dang bskal ba de tsam na/ /nags tshal dra ba can gyi klong / /ri bo kun 'dus rtse mo nas/ /chos longs sprul sku drang srong che/ /dri med 'od zer spyan drangs —419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shenas/ /drang srong dmod pa'i bden tshig gi /drag sngags dpal zor 'di brgyab bas/ /rgyal po klu yi snyun las grol/ /bar du sngags zor de ltar srid/ /de rjes dha rma a shwa dang / /bram ze legs grub pra ha sti/ /'phung byed shan+ti gha rgyu dang / /pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs nas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod kyis/ /bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha/ /lha mchog drang srong drag rtsal can/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bsgrubs bsgrubs nas/ /byin rlabs mthu dpung ma nyams pa'i/ / drag sngags spu gri'i dpal chu khrag ga 'a ma sogs dang sbyar/ zor 'di/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams phyogs bcu yi/ /lha klu gnyan dang phyogasaskyong sogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong dang ma nyes pa'i/ /lha srin yongs la mi 'phen no/ /sku gzur dbu smod zhabs bskum zhig /dbang phyug bdag gis ma nyes so/ /'di ltar drag po'i dpal zor 'di/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bar du gcod pa'i rkyen la 'phen/ /rgyal bsen gnod byed 'dul ba'i phyir/ /drang srong lha tsho gos dbyings nas bzhengs/ /sprul 'khor 'bum sde las la phyos/ /drang srong chen po dri med khyod/ /sku ni mi 'gyur brtan pa la/ /phyag mtshan 'khor (12na〉sgo bsgyur bzhin du/ /dgra bgegs mgo la 'khor lo skor/ /rgyal 'gong lus la 'khor lo skor/ /sdebargyad srog la 'khor lo skor/ /'bor lo g.yas su bskor tsa na/ /rgyal 'gong mgo la 'khor lo rgyob/ /'khor lo g.yon du bskor tsa na/ /mo gdon snying la 'khor lo rgyob/ /sdang ba'i dgra la sngags zor yā/ /gnod pa'i bgegs la sngags zor yā/ /za ba'i 'dre la sngags zor yu/ / 'phung ba'i sri la sngags zor yā/ /gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du rlog /spu gri ring mo dang zor sngags bzla zhing zor rnams thebs dang bstun nas dgra phyogs su 'phang / gtor chen la sha zan rak+ta sbran/ /dgug gzhug gsum dang sman raka sbran te byin rlabs 'bul tshig bzlog pa'i sham bu can gyi bar thun gtor ltar bya/ yig brgya brjod/ bzod gsol bya/ lha mchog ma/ bskal ba dpag med ma/ bstan 'gro ma/ mkhyen brtse nus mnga' ma yang bzlog ltar la tshig phrad kha bsgyur ba/ nam mkha' med par sogs smon lam bden brjod bya/ hūṃ/ gtor chen lha tsho gos ye shes pa/ /sku rten 'khor lo rnams la bsdu/ /dam tshig sems—420

drang srong log tri pa la'i srung bzlog bzhi mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul skyogs/ nang ma rtogedapa' rang nyid dang / /dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis med bsam/ slar yang gtor ma gsal 'debs man ngag ltar bya/ sha zan rak+ta sbran rjes dpal 'bar btsugs/ dgug gzhug nas 'bul zhing 'phrin bcol gyi bar gong dang 'dra ba dmag lho'i tshul du 'bul/ gong gi bskul ring thung gang rung gtong /gtor lam then la gtor chen phyir spags/ gong gi bskul dang bzlog gzhung (12ba〉nga bzlog ltar skabs 'dir byas kyang rung / tsho gos lhag dang chad mtho gtong / gshegs skyems su gtor ma gso ba nas/ 'bul ba'i bar gong ltar byas rjes dgra 'am thebs phyogs su gser skyems/ lha tshogs bskul ba/ lcags sam bhan+ta'i bskul tshig dang bcas man ngag ltar sngags rnams dang gtor ma 'phen pa'i dmigs pa zhal shes ltar bya/ rang ma nyes pa'i dpang btsugs/ kho'i nyes pa bsgrag /dmod mo bya/ bris sku dang 'phyar dar brdab/ ral pa sprug brang brdung / 'o dod 'bod/ dul mo rdul/ thal mo brdab bo/ nam mkha' med par sogs bden tshig brjod/ me chu'i rgyas 'debs byed/de nas sa la chos khrung rim gsum lte bar ni bris pa'i steng du me sgra chus bsad bya/ gtor gzheng kha sbub/ gtor mnan dang 'dul sbyong gi bro brdung / gtor gzhed la bsnyel la sman 'brus bkang /bshal chu'am gtor ma zur du bshams pas bstan ma bskyang / ni'i steng du mtho brtsigs pa log trir bskyed la ban skor dgu bya/ nang pa sangs rgyas pas bdag la byas pa'i rbod gtong thams cad zhig par gyur cig /ces brjod/ bon skor dgu bya/ phyi pa mu stegs pa dang bon gyis bdag la byas pa'i rbod gtong thams cad zhig par gyur cig /ces brjod/ bye ma'i la dgu byas par gom pa dgu tshul la spo/ la dgu lung dgur phyin par bsams la phyi mig mi blta bar nang du log /tshe 'gugs bla ma dang nor lha'i gtor ma ma gtogs pa'i gtor ma rnams la sman raka sbran/ ā+oṃ sa/ gis byin gyisabarlabs/ /bskul tshig srung (13na tha'i sham bu can gyis thog tu 'bul/ gtang rag /bzod gsol/nyer bsdu/ smon lam/ shis brjod dkyus ltar bya'o/ /gong gi sa bcad phyi ma rnams ni dpal 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i snang —42/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelas kyi yig cha dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag bzhes las shes par bya zhing srung bzlog thun mong ba la'ang /sngon chad yi ge nag 'gros 'di 'dra bkod pa mi 'dug pas chos kyi 'byung khungs dang / brgyud pa/dam tshig /bstan 'gro'i bde thabs sogs mi sems par rang gi tshe stobs 'byor sgrub tsam gyi don du chos rgyun tshul bzhin mnos par dpe mthong tsam gyis nyams su len pa'i dam med kha gtsang can gyi lag tu shor na ston yul dang ston mkhan gnyis ka klu bdud mgo dgu dang rgyal po shel ging gnyis kyis mi nor phyugs gsum gyi steng du chad pa phob cig sa ma ya/ da ltar sngags rgod log tri dmod pa'i mtshon/ /dgra bgegs sdebargyad 'dul ba'i spu gri zhes/ gangs ljongs snga 'gyur mkhan po mtha' dag la/ /rlung rtar grags pa'i che ba mgrin gcig gleng / /phal cher ming tsam las gzhan gnad ma rtogs/ /la la phyogs mthong tsam gyis lag len byed/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang rags pa'i phyag bzhes las/ /phra zhib gnad kyi dpya 'phrang ma sgrol lus/ dha rma a shwa ka de'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /'bri gung gnam lcags me 'bar yab sras kyi/ /ba ched srol mkhas pa'i drin las thos pa'i mod/ /me long byad bzhin ma 'dres so sor mthong / /mes po mang po'i lag pa rim brgyud la/ /a pha'i nyams(13bskong a ma'i rmi lam gyis/ /brgyan pa'i rgyun zhes rang tshugs bzang po can/ /rmongs brtad mkhan rnams rwa pa'i phugs su nyol/ /skyon paṇa zhu tsam gyis snga 'gyur bstan/ /zin na tshes sla mal du slo lhod mod/ /pad 'byung dgongs don skyor zlos byed pa yi/ /ma babs las 'di kho bo'i res su son/ /gangs can bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid srog /'phrog pa lha min gdon gyi chom po'i mgor/ /bsod namasaganam lcags thog gi mda' chen 'dis/ /a tsa ka yi dog pa ltar 'gas shog /dgra gdon gzugasabarnyan 'char gzhi rang rgyud sgrib/ /dngas pa'i rdzing bu skem nus tshogos gnyis kyi/ /nyi ma'i gzi 'bar sku bzhi'i 'od stong gis/ /'jig rten gsum du khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces drang srong log tri pā la'i srung bzlog thun mong ba nyams su len tshul btsan mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul sgrogs 'di ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi nyams len dang bstan pa'i btsas su bsams —422

te za hor gyi sngags smyon zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis chu glang hor zla gsum pa'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs gragasapas bgyis pa 'dis kyang srung ba btsan po'i mkhar gyi rtse nas bzlog pa'i 'phrul skyogs 'phangs bsadagra bgegs thal bar rlog pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesngags rgod log tri'i hom gyi lag len nyi ma'i snying po bzhugs so/ /dpal ldan drang srong zhi khro dang / /dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gus pas btud nas las kyi mtha'/ /sdud byed sreg pa'i lag len 'dri/ /de yang/ rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa dang / gzhung gi man ngag nyer bdun pa'i bcu pa gnyis las bshad pa'i rgyud don ltar na gshin rje sogs gzhan nas kha bkang ste sbyin sreg rgyas par byas pa 'thad na'ang man ngag bcu ba nas bshad pa ltar me'i las spyor tsam la lcags slang sogs su drag po'i shing gi thab khung gru gsum pa brtsigs/ de'i g.yas ngos su gdan la gtor chung sha khrag gis sbrags pa brgya rtsa/ ling chung brgya rtsa/ yam shing dang mar nag 'os 'tsham bshams/ sreg rdzas dang thab khung drag sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasa.a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rje dang tri las dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag las byung ba'i sreg rdzas gsum so so'i rnam pa can ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin drag po sreg pa'i las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ dgra bgegs rtsi tri mā ra ya dzaḥ(2na)dzaḥ lan gsum gyisabarlabs/ me spar su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las drag po'i thab khung gru gsum pa kha dog nag po bang rim gsum dang ldan pa kha khyer gdengs shing mchu 'phyang ba rgya che ba'i nang du hrīḥlas gser gyi 'khor la rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar/ drang srong me lha'i ngo bo nyid/ /skad cig rdzus skyes khro bo ni/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /zhes pa nas/ mchong bcag 'bar ba'i phaṭa dgus mtshan zhes pa'i mjug tu/ lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum du zhes pa nas/ mthu rtsal dbang dang dngosagrub stsol gyi bar bya/ tre du'i mjug tu rte nas shasta'i bar dang / ā+oṃ raṃ ṣi kro ta rā dzā arnya nas shasta'i bar bya/ sngags mthar ma hā pañtsa dang rak+ta btags la phul/ sku las 'bar ba'i me dpung gis/ /zhes—424

sngags rgod log lha'i hom gyi lag len nyi ma'i snying po/ nang ma(gepa nas/ dbyer med khyod la bdag bstod do/ /me lha zhe sdang rdo rje zhal gru gsum rab tu gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje nag po rtse gcig pa'i rnam ba can 'bar zhing glog ltar 'byug pa la raṃ yig dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa dang dgang blug (2bsko rtse la hūṃ yig nag po re res mtshan par bsams la/ drag sngags/'khor ba 'dul gyi mjug tu pra ti ha ta dz+wa la ya/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya rbad dz+wa la raṃ zhes raṃ zhes yaṃ shing zung du sbyar ba kha shas phul/ de nas ca asna ye bdag cag sogs dgang blug gis mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa 'bul/ gtor chung rnams drag sngags 'khor ba dul gyi mthug tu gong gi spel tshig ltar 'bul/ sgrub 'khor rnams dang ling chung brgya rtsa brgyad po sngags dang spel tshig gong ltar phul/ de nas sngags mchode dang bstod pa gong ltar byed/ yig brgya brjod cing chad lhag kha bkang /ā+oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ ces sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ zhes pa 'di yang me sbrul gyi lo sngags rgod log tri'i mchod rten gyi sgrub pa rgyas par btsugasapa'i dus mchode dpon ngag dbang shes rab dang sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho gnyis kyi dogs sel byung bas rkyen byas ngag don brjod bde bar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ —425

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()drang srong log tri'i gtang rag bzhugs so//rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros par lto phyogs nags tshal dra ba can nas drang srong khros pa zhe sdang rdo rje/dbu gtsug tu drang srong zhi ba rigs kyi bdag po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal dang bcas pa drang srong 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥpad+ma ka mā la ya sto/drang srong chen po 'khor bcas la//bdud rtsi chab kyis khrus gsol bas//nyams chags mi gtsang dri ma kun//ma lus byang zhing dag gyur cig/mchod yon me rtag bdug spos dang //mar me dri chab zhal zas sgra//'dod yon lnga ldan mar pa 'di//drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//drod sa sam yal dbang bo lnga/sha chen bsregs dud sprin ltar 'khrigs//rkang tshil zhun chen sgron tshegs la/khrag zhag mkhrisapa thugs kar 'byug/phyi nang sha tshil rus pa'i bsgos//dung wo rnga dang rkang gling 'bud//bdud rtsi sman dang dmar chen khrag/dam rdzas gtor ma spyan gzigs 'bul//sdebargyad rang gshed rang phab nas//gzugs can dgra bo bcom pa dang //bgegs dpung tsha ngar bcil ba sogs//sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dang //slad nas las 'cho le don chen du//zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas la/'bul lo dgyes par bzhes nas kyang //srung bzlog bsad mnan 'phrin las mdzod//ā+oṃ raṃ ṣi kro ta rā dza sa ri wā ra arnya nas sha lta'i bar dang //ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ma hā bha li ta /ma hā me sa /ma hūṃ rak+ta //1bsgo hā tsit+ta //ma hā bha su ta//ma hā go ro tsa na //ma hā ska ni ri ti /hūṃ/thugs ni mi 'gyur bde chen ldan//sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs rnams//gcig bsdus gsang ba'i bdag po dang //dbyer med khyod la bdag bstod do//zhes pa'ang spyi bla mi 'gyur brtan pa phyogs gtogs nang 'khrugs kyis bcoms pa dang /slad mar yang gtang rag sogs la mkho ba'i ched du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge /༷ 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//sarba maṅga lo/

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad las spyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang spyon sna rtse'i mtshon 'khor/ nang ma 9)sngags rgod log tri pā la'i bzlog pa dang bsad pa'i las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang spyon sna rtser bkod pa'i mtshon 'khor bzhugs/gu ru tho : rde wā rak+ṣi ta se bhi ra dhi dzi rna ku sa /sngags rgod log tri'i phyag len dpya 'phrang la/ /ma rdugs gdengs ldan bshes gnyen dam pa 'ga'/ /'bad pas bsten pa'i drin yin byang chub bar/ /snying dbus pa khror bsgom la gcig tu spro/ /drang srong nus mthu glang chen smyon pa'i snar/ /man ngag mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rab bkod pa/ /zab gsang 'phrul gyi zhal gdams dug dbal can/ /yid grubs dam ga dpung phye mar 'thag pa'i thog /stong bshad mkhar 'byams la paṇa brgyud chos rgod/ /gzhog rgyangs gdugs ltar thug pa ma yin par/ /rgya khra zan 'jug drang srong dmod pa'i mchus/ /lag rjes rim byung gsung sgrog yon gyi dpe/ /mtha' dbus lha min gdon gyi rig sngags mdas/ /thal byung 'bigs pa'i cher snyigs dus ngan 'dir/ /bzlog pa'i lcags ri mthon po'i pad steng nas/ /'byung bzhi bsad mtshon phyogs bzhir cis mi 'phen/ /de phyir man ngag khro chu'i mde'u la/ /snang srid sdebargyad dregs pa'i dar btags shing / /drag sngags thig stong (2na skor ba'i gnam lcags thog /log 'dren gtsug tu 'bebs so bag yod byos/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa bzlog bsad drag po'i bcas rgyas pa mchod rten dkar nag la brten nas nyams su blang ba la/ /srung ba dang ma 'brel kyang skyon du mi 'gyur na'ang mchod rten nag po'i sgrub pa'i tshe stong gnon gyi pu ri dkar po nges par dgos shing / gtso che ba zung 'brel du mdzad pas mchod rten dkar po'i rgyu/ rdzas/ bzo dbyibs/ 'khor lo/gzungs bzhugs sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len 'khrul pa med pa'i rab gnas can/ bkra shis pa'i lo zla gza' skar tshes grangs legs pa dang bstun nas tshags su chud par bya/ mngon spyod kyi skor —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesrid pa'i gter khyim dang rdo rje gtsug lag sogs drag sngags kyi spyi sdom rnams las bshad pa bzhin dus tshod nag rtsis pa'i lo zad zla zad sngags pa zor 'phen du grags pa zla ba bcu pa lta bus mtshon nyi ma rlung bar du zhugs pa smin drug sa 'og tu ma song ba'i zla ba gang yang rung ba'am dgra dmigs bsal la de ga'i lo khams dang bgegs la (2ba〉na nod pa gang byung dang bstun rung na'ang sngags pa kha rul gyi zla ba dang ma 'grig pa nges par dgos/ bcas bya ba'i chos kyi nyin dus 'khor dang dbyangs 'char nas bshad pa'i 'chi sbyor/ bdud rgyal/ bdud nyi/ sreg sbyor lta bu 'phrod ga pa dang / gza' skar gyi ngo bo drag cing rtsub pa/ zin phung / ki dang sogs nag rtsis las byung ba'i sa bdag gdug pa can rgyu ba dang bstun/ maṇ+ḍal/ mchod rten/ 'khor lo sogs bca' zhing / de'ang ba po mi shis pa dang drag po'i rdzas sna tshogs las grub pa'i sa stegs gshin rje gza' gdong sogs sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gzhan las 'byung ba ltar 'brub khung bang rim gsum la kha khyer la rtsad thod pa me ris bskor ba/ thod pa dang bu ri shong tshod kyi dong gzhan las ring ba'am yang na las khung bang rim phyi nang gsum pa so so'i khar rtsang dang me ris bskor ba/ de'i mthil du rabs chad thod pa'i ag rtse dang phag spyang gi thod pa'i mchu sbyar ba'i steng na mchod rten nag po man ngag las byung ba'i rdzas dang bzo dbyibs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mgo mjug ldog pa'i bang rim man 'brub khung gi nang du chud pa/ pu ri dang thod par 'jug pa'i bzlog bsad/ 'byung gzhi sdebargyad kyi 'khor ling rnams yongs rdzogs sam skabs sbyar gang dgos 'dri ba'i snag tsha/ brig zhi/ gshed dbab sogs byug nas kyi rim pa/ dgra'i zag rdzas dang 'dre la de'i dod mtshungs sngags dang spel tshig 'dri lugs sogs gsung rgyun phyag len mthong brgyud ltar bcas thog ma'i dgug thun ma grub bar snod zur po zhig tu spus chog pa srung shā ring pu ri dkar nag gnyis(3na7sbyor ba mu lha mo/ /bsgrigs/ de'i steng na ro g.yam gyi kha bkab dang mchod rten dkar po'i zhabs sprod/ maṇ+ḍal dang bca' gzhi lha srin chags pa'i rten du skyon chen pos gsungs pas pu ri dkar nag gi bca' gzhi srung ba'i dus nas bsgrigs grub pa dgos/ 'dir yang bzlog ltar gtor —428

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad las spyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang smyon sna rtse'i mtshon 'khor/ nang ma 6)chen mi bca' bas mchod rten gyi nye skor sa yul gang 'gab tu bshams chog pa'i drag po'i sgrub gtor dpe ris su mgo gtor du ngos bzung yang gsang sngags ṣi ma'i skabs shes pa bsun dgos pas sgrub gtor ro/ khur gsum dbus dmar mtha' nag pa mthar sdebargyad kyi bsgos bu/ ong skyu/ mtshe yungs/ rtsang gis bskor ba/dkar rgyan sar las mthar thug pa'i tshe dkar ma mi yi par gad/ dmar rgyan sogs rgyan spros dang bcas pa/sman raka /zar rdzas/ gong gnon drang srong zhi ba'i mchod gtor sogs sa dngos gzhi/ a mong ba'i skabs ji lta ba la khyad par dregs pa'i sde dpon gyi gtor ma rta rmig 'khor lo dar gyi cod pan can/ lha dbye'i rdzas sbyar ba/ bya lug gi dang sgro la sngags rdzas man ngag dang ldan pa/ drag po'i thun rdzas lag len bzhin thog ma nas bzos pa bsgrubs te dar btags pa/ bla phur/ snying phur/ srog phur/ gdab phur/ tho ba/ gtun khung / hom chas kham sa'i ga'u gru gsum/ 'phung re/ ring cha/rtsang / thod pa/ sa tshon/ ro skra/ la cha/ khro zhal lam/ rgya gram gyi theg ro g.yam/ rang thag sogs 'byung gzhi tshang ba'am skabs 'thob sbyar ba'i chos rnams mngon par 'du (3ba)byas/ bzlog bsad rkyang pa nyams su blangs pas mi 'grub pa min na'ang srung bzlog rim bzhin mdzad pa'i phyag len mang zhing legs pas srung ba'i sgrub pa sngar thun mong ba'i skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba la gtor gdugs kyi 'og gi 'khor lo bsrung bya spa ba'i tshab la mchod rten gyi 'khor lor bsrung bya sba ba'i dmigs pa bya ba tsam mo/ /srung ba grub rjes gza' tshes drag po dang bstun we gung phyogs su las byang thog mas go gcod na'ang gsal 'deb kyi go du a thams go la mdzad pa dngos gtsang / las byang gi tsho gos tha ma yan song ba dang/ dgra gtso bor byed na dregs pa'i sde dpon gyi gsol ba btang nas sngags sdebs las byung ba'i bskul gtong / lcags snod du ling 'khor rnams gcer la mgo bo mdun du bstan nas bzhag ste/ gdab las kyi ngag 'don bya ba la/ dang po gser skyems 'bul ba ni/ dgra lag gtso bor byed na tshe bdag gi gser skyems tshig rkang dang po rtsa brgyud bla ma gshin rje'i zhes pa log tri'i zhes bsgyur/ bgegs la gtso por byed na rdo rje gro lod gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gser skyems kyi che mchog pad+ma rdo rje gro —429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelod rtsal zhes pa drang srong dri med rdo rje rtsal zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ gnyis pa mkhyen gsol ni/ dgra la byed na 'bri gung chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas ma gtong /bgegs la byed na bdag nyid sangs rgyas ma nas rang dbang med par drag pos gtan la phob kyi bar dngos gzhi gong ltar la/ ban sngags bon dgra nag pos 'tshe ba dang zhes pa/ gnod byed sdebargyad 'byung pos 'tshe ba dang / bstan (4na)pa'i ru dra nag po klad snying gis zhes pa/ /spyi sgos 'phung bar byed pa'i 'byung po yis/ /rang gi chos srid 'byor bas ma ngoms bar/ /gzhan la phrag dog bstan la brnyas pa yi zhes pa/ /nad rims mi kha byur chags dus min 'chi/ /dbul phongs mi 'dod sna dgu ster ba yi/ /phyi dgra zhe sdang sogs kyi dgra'i tshab bgegs/ byad ma dgra bo zhes pa gdon bgegasa'abyung po/ nyes byed dgra bo gzugs phung rnam shes bcas/ pha tshan yul 'khor mi nor sde dpung rnams zhes pa/ gnod byed sdebargyad dmigs bkar 'byung po 'di'i/ /gzugs phung rnam shes 'khor g.yog dpung bcas rnams/ zhes pa'i tshig phran bu kha bsgyur/ gsum pa 'brub khung bskyed cing dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ las ngan thams cad smin par byed pa'i btson khang drag po'i dbus su yan tshe bdag smad las kyi 'brub khung bskyed chog ji lta ba la phag spyang gi gshin rje pho mo 'jigs su rung ba gnyis kyi bar du ni las dmigs bya'i dam nyams nas ngo bor gyur gyi bar/ bgegs ma byed na tri las dmigs bya'i sde brgyad dam sri 'byung po dmigs bsam yod na byad dbyibs ji lta ba brjod pa'i rtsa phe sa bcad bzhi dang lnga bar ya thod ma thod pa/ ye med na phag spyang gi thod pa zhes pa dor/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa/ gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ dgra la dgug gzhug byed na 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po zhes pa drang srong sngags rgod log tri pā lar bsgyur pa'i khug cig yan brgya'am nyer gcig sogs skabs dang sbyar/ bgegs la byed na che mchog (4ba)pad+ma rdo rje gro lo rtsal gyi chab/ drang srong sngags rgod log tri pā lar bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs phob cig yan rdo rje gro lod bzhin len/ bzhi pa bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang zhes pa nas dgra —430

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang spyon sna rtse'i mtshon 'khor/ nang ma (pebagegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab yan las byang ltar/ lnga pa che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūṃ yig las zhes pa nasang yi las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs zhes pa'i bar las byang ltar dang / yang cig hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas zhes pa nas rdo rje'i lte ba'i gdan du bsam zhes pa'i bar brjod pa'i mthar snang srid sdebargyad thams cad kyis/ dgra bgegs 'gugs bzlog gsod pa sogs/ ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /thogs pa med par sgrub par bsam/ /drug pa drag tu bskul zhing 'gugasapa ni/ /bh+yo/ mchod bstod bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i ye shes lha/ /'jig rten dregs byed yongs kyi srog snying bdag /thogs med 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i drag rtsal can/ /rab 'jigs drang srong log tri'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskyod cing bskyod cing mnyam nyid dbyings nas bskyod/ /bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas bskul/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dregs 'dul drang srong chen po'i dus la bab/ khro rgyal zhe sdang rdo rje'i dus la bab/ /sprul 'khor drang srong 'bum sde'i dus la bab/ /bka' nyan dregs pa sdebargyad dus la bab/ /do nub da dus nam gyi gung thun la/ /dregs pa sde brgyad dbang du bsdus la shog /snang srid dregs pa'i srog snying phyogs (ldan〉pa shog /gnod byed dgra gdon byad ma khug la shog /drang srong chen po thugs rjes byin ma chung / /dregs 'dul khro rgyal rdzu phrul rtsal ma zhan/ /bden tshig dmod pa'i drag sngags dpal ma rdugs/ /sprul 'khor sde brgyad las byed bang ma bul/ /dmigs par gang byas dgra gdon byad ma 'di/ /lo zla ma 'gor myur du ma bsgral na/ /drang srong chen po'i bden tshig nyams 'gyur ram/ /bka' nyan dregs pa'i mthu rtsal rdzun du che/ /de bsasman raka gtor ma mchod pa'i tshogs/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /yid la gnag pa'i dgra gdon gnod byed bgegs/ /gzugs ling ming dang byang bur btab pa 'di/ /lcags kyu can gyis snying nas bzung la shog /zhags pa can gyis ske nas khrid la shog /lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms la shog /dril bu can gyis rdul du rlog la shog /yi dam lha dang drang srong chen po yi/ /—431

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedamod pa'i bden stobs brjod pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /che ge mo zhes gzugs ming liṅga la/ /myur du phob cig sarba ni tri dzaḥ/ /rings par khug cig badz+ra a gu sha dzaḥ/ /myur du chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ /dam por sdo mos shig badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ khrag por sgrol zhig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ho/ /gnod byed dgra bgegasasarba ni hrī e ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ zhes drag tu bskul lo/ /'gugs pa ni/ bdag lce rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte ba yi/hūṃ las 'od 'phros rwa rtse dgu la phog /de las dzaḥ'aphros rta rmig 'khor lo bskul/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad rang gi lce rtse las/ /spros pa'i dzaḥlas lcags kyu zhags(5ba)pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril thogs rang 'dra'i khro bo'i tshogs/ /grangs med bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad dmag /sna tshogs mtshon 'dzin stong khams khyab rnams kyis/ /lcags kyus dgra bgegs dmigs bya'i snying nas btab/ /zhags pas mgrin bcings mtshon cha rgyab nas brdeb/ /skad cig nyid la drag po'i 'brub khung nang / /lid+ma ra sib thim dgra bo dngos su bsam/ /log tri pā ya nan dzaḥ sarba ni tri dgra bgegs che ge a byu sha dzaḥde bzhin du sde brgyad so sor sbyar ba'i mthar/ tsi du song nas 'khor 'dul gyi mjug tu yi dam lha dang drang srong bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis myur du phob cig ni tri dzaḥ che ge a du sha dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags ci 'grub bzla zhing dgug bstim bya/ dgra gtso bor byed na tshe bdag khro chu sogs nas bshad pa'i bla 'gugs/ tshe srog yid gsum 'gugs pa'i sngags rnams len/ de ltar thun drug tu bcad nas 'gugs pa'i las gtso bor byas te khugs nges pa'i rtags mtshan gshin rje me'i spu gri'i phyag len dang sa da mi mas pa zhwa dpe lham 'gebs mi byed/ yid ches kha yar ma byung gi bar bya/ bdun pa lha dang dbye ba ni/ dgra bo'i lhas bskyabs pa'i rtags byung ba'am min na'ang rung ste/ rang lce rdo rje'i rtse nasasprul pa yi/ /mtshon cha sna tsho gos thogs pa'i khro bo dang / /bya rog lug pa'i pho nya dpag med phros/ /dgra bo'i 'go ba'i lha lnga chos srung rnams/ /'ur rdos bya khyu bdas bzhin bskrad pa yis/ /skyabs med bye'u phrug thang la 'khyams ltar bsam/ /las kyi gshin rje'i gshed po thams cad dang zhes pa/ /(6na skreng srong khros pa'i pho nya thams cad dang zhes par bsgyur ba'i lha dbye tshe bdag smad las ltar —432

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge grang snyen sna rtse'i mtshon 'khor/ nang ma (pebyed cing gu gul gyi du bas gdug /sgro gnyis kyis bya ba/ rdzas dud gtong lugs man ngag bzhin bya/bgegs gtso bo yin na lha dbye mi dgos rung deng sang sngags ban mang po bgegs la bla dgas brgyag cing lha dbye byed 'dug pa/ bla ma ma bsten pa'i zag zog dpa' thal gyi skyon kho nar snang /dgra la bla dgas brgyag pa dang dgra bgegs gnyis kar mi 'gyur ba'i gzer gyis bsdams/ brgyad pa nyes pa bsgrag pa ni/ hūṃ/ dug lnga'i dbang gyur dgra gdon khyod/ /rang nyes las ga rang la smin/ /da lta bsgral pa'i zhing du gyur/ /sngon gyi nyes byas la 'gyod cing / /phyis nas mi bgyi'i dam bcasanas/ /byang chub thob pa khyod smon cig khres brjod/ dgu pa dgug thun brab pa ni/ hūṃ/ skam thun rlon thun rdzas rnams dzi brgyad kyi/ /dmag dpung mtshon ma sna tsho gos nad dang mtshon/ /gnam lcags thog ser phab bas snying ga'i nang / /gnas pa'i rnam shes mar me lta bu bsad/ /lusang ga yid gsum thal ba'i rdul du brlag sha khrag rus pa lhag med zos par bsam/ /bh+yo/ nga ni zhe snang rdo rje ste/ /nga ni drang srong dri ma med/ /drang srong dmod pa'i bden tshig gis/ /lha srin sdo brgyad dregs pa rnams/ /a zor pho nyar bdag bskul gyi/ /stong gsum thun gyi pho lhas khong / /mtsho yungs ma' rdo zangs lcags phye/ /dug khrag drag po'i thun rdzas rnams/ /so so'i pho nya mtshon cha thogs/ /nad mtshon thog ser than ltasang na/ /(6bas rung phyogs kun dgra bgegs steng / kha char bu yug ltar phob la/ /dgra bgegs mi nor yid tshe bsod/ /mi nor yul zhing longs spyod rnams/ /skad cig nyid la brlag par gyis/ /gzhan yang bu lod kyis mdzad pa ni/ bh+yo/ sna tshogs thun rdzas drag sngagasadamod mtshon 'di/ /bka' nyan sdo brgyad drag po 'dus pa'i dmag /mgon klu sa rgyal ma gza' btsan bdud sogs/ /sna tshogs gzugs can mgo brnyan bzhen par bcas/ /phyag mtshan sna tshogasadrag po'i thun rdzas rnams/ /dgra bgegs 'di yi gzugs phung yul mkhar la/ /drag po'i thun zor brdeg pa'i dus la bab/ /gnam lcags thog ser ki kai dgra la bh+yo/ /dal yams khrag nad bu yug dgra la bh+yo/ /mdze 'brum phol mig glang thabs dgra la bh+yo/ /spyo 'bog brgyal nad lhog gzer dgra la —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebh+yo/ /nad mtshon glo bur gri 'thab dgra la bh+yo/ /mi rung ltas ngan gya gcig dgra la bh+yo/ /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu dgra la bh+yo/ /glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu dgra la bh+yo/ /nad rims bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dgra la bh+yo/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dgra la bh+yo/ /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la bh+yo/ /lo zla zhag dus ga ngan dgra la bh+yo/ /mo ltas rmi lam mtshan ltas dgra la bh+yo/ /zhes bskul te thun sngagasaring mo bzla zhing thun brab/ bcu pa thal rdeb dmod pa ni/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje gsal ba yi/ /zhes sogs thun mong ba ltar brjod cing bzlog sngags lan bdun/ thun sngags tshar gcig gi rjes su thal mo brdab/ drang srong gi dmod ring brjod nas kyang thal mo rdeb bo/ /de nas ling 'khor rnamasarabs thod/ phag (7na spung gi thod pa/ lce'i khug ma/ mchod rten so sor man ngag ltar lteb nasabacug /thun thag phyir drangs pa'i sne mo rang gis bzung g.yas g.yon du sgro btsugs/ 'phung re'i gur phub ste nang du mar me'i mdangs mi 'phog pa dang liṅga la bdud rtsi mi 'thor ba gal che/ bcu gcig pa sgrub dngos ni/ thun so so'i 'gor las byang zor sgrub sogs 'dzab la thug gi bar thun mong ba ji lta ba la gser skyems nas bzung dgug thun thal deb kyi bar rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bya/ de nas bzlog pa'i bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba yi zhes sogs bzlog pa'i dmigs pa thun mong ba'i dus ltar la de'i mjug tu/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ gis bskul ba yis/ /rtse mo'i phaṭa las dzaḥdang 'od zer 'phros/ /sde brgyad tshogs rnams rang dbang med bkug ste/ /so so'i 'khor lo rtsibs kyi sngags la thim/ /sngags rnams sde brgyad dngos su gyur pa yis/ tan rul sbrang ma bzhin du dgra bgegs la/ /rub rub 'dus nas dmigs bya bsad bzlog gtor/ /bsregs sbyangs mnan pa'i las rnams thogs med bsgrub/ /rtsibs la sdo brgyad pho brang btab pa yis/ /dgra bgegs thal bar gnod byed ldebargyad gang yin zhin la la sbyor byed na sngags dang dmigs pa'i kha sgyur byed shes dgos so/ /rlog pa'i las byed bsam/ /zhes sde brgyad kyi dmigs pa'i kha sgyur sbyar/ bzlog pa'i sngags rgyun bcas nas 'bad de bzla/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje gsal ba nas bzung dmod ring gi thal brdab par bya/ bcu gnyis pa —434

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang spyon sna rtse'i mtshon 'khor/ nang ma 6)gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ sgrub (7bskoto me la sha zan dang sman rag sbran/ thun gtor la rak+ta sbran te dgug gzhug nyer lnga gsum slog sto mdang gas li sgor dmigs/nas bdun gyi bar ci rigs pa byas rjesadrag gtor byin gyis brlabs te bsngo/ mchog gsum ma/ drang srong chen po ma'i bskul mjug tu 'bul tshig sham bu can dang / lcags sam bhan+ta sa bskul nas thun gtor dgra bgegs kyi phyogs su 'phen/ khrom bzlog sogs sngags bzla/ nyes pa bsgrag pa nas bzung thal dgugs rtsa khe rtags nges gong na byung zin pa'i dang du byas te a rdeg pas gshin rje dang sa mi wa bar ma zad lang nas gshin rje dang log tri gnyis kar drod ra kyi mtshams 'dzin man pa/myong bas thon dgos par tso 'dus bkang kyi skam skam gra byed rgyu mi yong ngo / /rdeb kyi bar gong ltar bya zhing thun gtor gsar ba bshams nas thun mtshams la zor zhor sgrub byed pa'i bar thun mong ba dang 'dra la sgrub pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang cha mtshungs/mngon spyod kyi skabs 'dir thun thog ma yan pa dang lha dbye'i sgrom bu re dkar po la ma reg pa gal che/ sngags sdebs bzhin mgo can mgo bo gcod pa'i bzla lugs byed/ dgra gtso bor byed na bla rgyub sogs so so'i dus ma nor bar sngagasadang bla phur snying phur srog phur gyis lag len bya/ pha rol lhas stob tshe na dbye ba'i man ngag zab mo bya/de ltar bzlog rtags ma byung gi bar thun drug tu nyams su blangs pas rtags (8na〉thong ba dang rtag gtor gtong ba nasang ga 'grol ba'i bar 'dra/ bcu gsum pa bsad pa'i las sbyor ni/ gser skyems nas dgug thun dmod ring gi bar dang bzlog dmigs mjug tu sde brgyad kyi dmigs pa 'dogs pa'i bar byas rjes/ phag spyang thod pa gshin rje pho mo sa /gsal ba'i zhe sdang 'dod chagasadug rlangs kyis/ /dgra bgegs rtsa rgyus thams cad rul zhing myags/ /snying gar ni'am tri yi khog pa na/ /phaṭa yig dmar nag 'od zhu lhaḥyig las/ /mu khyud med par lcags sregs 'khor lo ni/ /rno dang ldan pa g.yon du drag 'khor bas/ /dgra bgegs srog rtsa nyal nyal bcad cing gtubs/ sha khrag dum bur btang ba ldebargyad kyis/ /hab sgra dang bcas dir dir zos par bsam/ /ā+oṃ log tri pā la nan sod nas kā wā tsi brlag brlag gi mthar dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya —435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesod yā/ ni tri mā ra ya rbad wā/ zhes sngags rgyun bcas nas bzla/ drag gtor 'bul ba/ bskul rnams bzlog pa ji lta ba la gtor ma'i 'bul tshig ba kla sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la yan srung ba'i skabs ltar la dgra gtso bor byed na/ dmigs bya'i dgra bo gzugs ling ming bcas 'di'i/ /bla khug dbugs phyogs mgo 'khor khrag tu skyugs/ /brgyal zhing lus sems phrol la srog rtsa chod/ /tshe yi 'du byed bkum la myur du sod/ sha khrag gzugs phung 'byung ba'i zhal du thob/ /bsad rtagasasrog snying dmar po khyer la shog /byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phog /bgegs la gtso bor byed na/ /gnod byed sdebargyad dam sri 'byung po 'di'i/ /rnam shes khug la mthu stobs sde dpung rtsal/ /gzi brjid dug rlangs byad grib gdong gzer sogs/ /bsam ga sbyor rtsub nus pa thams cad choms/ /lus (8bcug phrol la srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /dbugs dang tshe yi 'du byed hur thum bkum/ sha khrag gzugs phung 'byung ba zhal du thob/ /ming tsam brda tsam med pa thal bar rlog /ces bskul ba'i rjes su lcags sam bhan+ta sa bskul te dgra bgegs kyi phyogs su 'phang / bzlog bsad kyi sngags zab mo'i 'ur ba slong / nyes pa bsgrag pa nas bzung dmod ring thal rdeb kyi bar gong ltar la thun rdeg pa'i tshe bsad pa'i dmigs rim man ngag ltar bya/ thun gtor gsar ba bsham pa nasazor zhor sgrub kyi bar bzlog pa dang 'dra/ gzugs can la thun gyi nges pa med par bla srog 'gyu dus dang bstun/ bla phur/ snying phur/ srog phur sngags dang bcas nas brdeg ste dgug phyung bcad pa'i las bya zhing bla srog 'dzom dus thun zor dang bden pa brjod dgos pa'i gnad 'gag zab mo zhal las 'dri/ 'dir bzlog pa'i dus nas thun mthar thun brdeg pa sogs gshin rje gza' gdong gi thun thams cad la mi brdeg pa dang cung zad mi mthun na'ang bsad las zin nas kyang 'byung bzhi'i las byed pa'i rang skad la lkugs ma'i rigs 'gre'i dbu spros mi 'tshal lo/ /thun drug tu nyams su blangs pas rtags mthong ba na rtag gtor gtong ba nas ngag 'grol ba'i bar yang mtshungs/ bcu bzhi pa 'byung bzhi'i las sbyor ni/ bdag lce rdo rje lte ba'i hūṃ yig las/ /'od zer rwa dgu'i rtse mo'i khong —436

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad la sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang spyon sna rtse'i ma' 'khor/ nang ma 6)seng brgyud//dmar nag phaṭa dgu bskul las ljang gu/'phros pa rlung gi 'khor lo'i gzugs ris dang //rtsibs brgyad la phog bris pa'i 'khor lo de//'byung ba rlung dngos gyur nas stong gsum gang //dgra bgegs rlung gis g.yos shing gtor byas te//thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam/dmar nag phaṭa dgu bskul las re dmar po//'phros pa me yi 'khor lo'i gzugs ris dang //rtsibs brgyad la phog bris pa'i 'khor lo de//'byung po rlung dngos9na mur nas stong gsum gang //dgra bgegs me yi gdung zhing bsregs byas te//thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam/dmar nag phaṭa dgu bskul las me sngon bo//'phros pa chu yi 'khor lo'i gzugs ris dang //rtsibasabargyad la phog bris pa'i 'khor lo de//'byung ba rlung dngos gyur nas stong gsum gang //dgra bgegs chu yi bsubs shing khyer byas te//thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam//dmar nag phaṭa dgu bskul las nan ser po//los pa sa yi 'khor lo'i gzugs ris dang //rtsibs brgyad la phog bris pa'i 'khor lo de//'byung ba rlung dngos gyur nas stong gsum gang //dgra bgegs sa yisa'athibs shing mnan byas te//thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam//ā+oṃ log tri pā la nan ya raṃ 'byung ba gcig g.yoganyi kyi las tsam tha ma mi byed na sngag kyi sham bu zur khyad yod pa zhal la 'a/baṃ nan zhes sham bu can dmigs pa dang bcas te thun drug tu bzla zhing sde brgyad bskul ba'i dmigs pa rnams kyang bya/gtor ma 'bul tshig gi ba kla sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la yan bzlog bsad ltar la/gnod byed dgra bgegs sde brgyad 'byung po spyi/khyad par dmigs kyi bkar ba'i che ge 'di//bskal ba'i rlung gi 'tshub mas bskrad cing gtor//dus mtha'i me yis rtsa sbur bzhin du sregs//chu bo rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i klong du khyer//sa chen ri yis bskal bar mi ldang gnon//'byung ba'i stobs kyis rdul phran bzhin du rlog/ces btags pa'i mjug tu lcags sa mas bharnyas thun gtor bskul te 'brub khung nang du brdeg/bzlog bsad kyi sngags bzla ba nas bzung ngag 'grol ba'i bar 'dra/bco lnga pa nas spor ba ni/de ltar bsgrubaXpas bzlog bsad 'byung bzhi'i las gang 'grub kyi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shertags brtan por mthong ba'i tshe 'khor ling rnams tshur phyung la lcags snod du gcer/ gser skyems nas bzung thun brdeg thal rdeb kyi bar gtang rjes gyer sgom rtse gcig tu bsgril te/ e ma khams gsum sems can rnams/ /ma rtogs zhabrul pa snying re rje/ /snying rjes bsgral pa'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ /thugs rje thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /phung bo bsgral ba'i zhing du byas/ /rnam shes yum gyi mkha' la sba/ /ye shes dpa' bor byin brlabs te/ /rig pa chos kyi dbyings su 'phangs/ khyod ni rgyal ba'i sras su skye/ /zhes brjod/ slar gdab phur liṅka'i ni 'am tri mig tu bsgril zhing btab la/ hūṃ/ ye shes rtsal ldan phur bu 'di/ /dgra bgegs snying la btab pa yis/ /nyen mongs dug lnga rtsad nas gcod/ /las ga rnam smin 'phro bcad nas/ /ye shes dbyings su gnas spar ro/ hūṃ/ dgra gdon khyod kyi snying nang na/ /lus srog rnam shes chags pa'i rten/ /rlung dngas sngo skya mthe bong tsam/ /de nang rak+ta'i dngas ma ni/ /dmar ser rgya sran ga'u tsam/ /de dbus rnam shes ngo bo ni/ /thig le dkar po yungs hrū tsam/ /de la ye shes phur bu yi/ /rno dpal gzi 'od reg tsam gyis/ /rlung gi dngas ma 'ja' ltar yal/ /rak+ta'i dngas ma thab kyis bskams/ zhom shes ngo bo thig le de/ /ye shes phur (10na)bu'i khong gseng du/ /byang chub rgyun lam nang du zhugs/ /chang bzung logs brgyad pho brang du/ /dpal chen yab yum thugs ka mā /skad cig nyid la thim ma thag /de lusasol sdong gog po bzhin/ /nag khog gzi bkrag med par gyur/ /phaṭa ā+oṃ badz+raki li gī lu ya/ ye yaṃ raṃ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ bho dhi tsit+ta ni tri saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ zhes 'don sgom zung 'jug la dmigs pa shin tu gsal bar bya'o/ /gdab phur de nyid lag tu bsgril zhing / hūṃ/ rdo rje phur bu gī lā ya/ /sangs rgyasa'aphrin las yongs rdzogs sku/ /dregs 'dul drang srong khro chen gyi/ /sras mchog badz+ra gī lwa ya/ /bsgril zhing bsgril zhing btab tsam gyis/ /dgra bgegs lusang ga yid gsum dang / /phung khams skye mched 'byung ba lnga/ /las na ne bag chags shes sgrib bcas/ /skad cig nyid la bsgral nas kyang / /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ trang du tri na trang du dzaḥdzaḥ/ badz+raki li ki lā ya dgra bgegs—438

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang spyon sna rtse'i mtshon 'khor/ nang ma 9)sarba ni tri sha tre trig nan rbad nan bhi na tsit+ta rbad nan ni tri hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad rbad/ cesadang thun sngags spu gri drag sngags ring mo'ang bzla zhing liṅga rnams kyi gnas lnga dang dbang po lnga dang /bla gnas rnams su sreg pa'i rigs la dpal tshub tsam du gdab bo/ /mi bzad pa'i mtshon cha thogasate/ hūṃ/ da ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas yin te ye shes sku/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang / /pad+ma rgya gram rab 'bar ba/ /ye shes rno ba'i mtshon cha yis/ /dgra gdon bag chags(10ba)zhabrul pa'i sems/ /log rtog 'khor ba rgyun chod cig /ā+oṃ mas byung ni badz+ra tha la hūṃ/ ā+oṃ rgyu/ hūṃ hūṃ/t+t+waṃ ne/ hrī : / aḥ:/ tshal ba tshal ba mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ/ zhes mtsho ni mas bsnun pa'i tshe/ /phur ba'i dpal nas mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char babs pas kho'i gzugs phung rnams dum bur btang bar bsam/ rlung chu sa bzlog bsad kyi liṅga rnams sgrol ba'i tshul tsam ma gtogs dngos su dum bur mi bsgral/ me'i ba rmang gzhi rgyas pa'i skab yin na rabs thod nang gi bsad 'khor bsgral tshul tsam las dngos su min brdzus sbyang rtse'i khug ma'i nang gi bsad 'khor bsgral nas me'i 'khor lo dang lhan cig sbyin sreg byas kyang rung ba yin no/ /'khor lo dum bur btang la bsgral lo/ /ling ro rnams gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa drag sngags kyi ngar btagasapas brdung zhing / gtun khung yum gyi bha gar thob yab kyi rdo rjes brdungs pas kho'i rnam smin gyi lusadamar nyog nyog brdungs nas brlag pa bsam zhing / hūṃ/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ /bka' las 'da' byed sdig can 'di/ /rdo rje'i mtshon chas bsgral nas kyang / khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ /rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs pa na/ /lha yang rung ste brlag bgyid na/ /dgra gdon gnod byed smos ci dgos/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma a ko ṭa ya kha tham kha tham kha tham/ zhes brdung ngo / /rgyas par ni zan ling sha khrag rus pas spags pa zhig gong du 'khor lo liṅga rnams dang lhan cig tu bsgral pa'i ling ro sha khrag rusapar bcas pa gtor mar btab la/ bsdu na 'khor lo rnams gtor mar 'bul tshul tsam byas kyang rung / sman raka sbran (11na 'a/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings ngang las snying rje yi/ /rtsal snang khro bo'i skur bstan pa/ khro rgyal zhe sdang rdo rje zhes/ /mthing nag mi sdug khro tshul can/ khams gsum srid gsum za byed pa/—439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ (2shekhyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /ri rab tsam gyi skur bzhengs shig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongasashig /gangs ri gtams 'dra'i mche ba gtsigs/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i ljags bskyod la/ /dgra gdon bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus/ /phung khams skye mched dbang po lnga/ /don snod klad rkang khu bar bcas/ /zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi/ /mgur du 'dril lo a ra li/ /dbyings su bstim mo sam ya/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā snyi bh+yo/ dregs 'dul khro rgyal 'bar ba yi/ /sku gsung thugasayon 'phrin las/ /sprul pa yang sprul la sogs pa/ /las byed rno myur rdzu snyul can/ /bye ba 'bum sde'i tsho gos bcas rnams/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /ri rab tsam gyi skur bzhengs shig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs shig /gangs ri gtams 'dra'i mche ba gtsigs/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i ljags bskyod la/ /dgra gdon bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus/ /phung khams skye mched dbang po lnga/ /don snod klad rkang khu bar bcas/ /zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi/ /mgur du 'dril lo a ra li/ /dbyings su bstim mo sam ya/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā snyi bh+yo/ khro rgyal zhe snang rdo rje yi/ /yang g.yog brka' nyan las byed pa/ /mgon po sa bdag klu rigs lnga/ /ma mo btsun bdud gza' rgyal 'gong / /snang srid dregs pa sde dpung bcas/ /rang rang sprul pa yang sprul dang / /g.yog dang yang g.yog pho nyar bcas/ /stong gsum gang ba'i dregs pa rnams/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /ri rab tsam gyi skur bzhengs shig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs shig /gangs ri gtams 'dra'i mche ba gcigs/ /glog stong 'gyur 'dra'i ljags bskyod la/ /dgra gdon bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus/ /phung khams skye mched dbang po lnga/ /don snod klad rkang khu bar bcas/ /zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi/ /mgur du 'dril lo a ra li/ /dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya/ /bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā sti /zhes dbul zhing bstab pas dgra gdon byad ma'i sha khrag rnams khro rgyal dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pas hab hab hub hub chem chem gsol zhing dgyes pa'i gad mo'i 'brug stong ldir ba ltar bsgrags nas tshim zhing dgyes par bsam/ dmod pa'i bden stobs brjod pa ni/ bka' ltar mi byed —440

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge grang smyon sna rtse'i mtshon 'khor/ nang ma 9)cing sogs nas zlog tu nan gyi bar sngar thal rdeb kyi skabs ltas bya/ gzhan yang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /bcu drug pa mnga' gsol thugs rje'i zlos gar ma dang bzlog bsgyur thun mong ba'i skabs ltar bya/ bzlog sngags bzla/ dmod pa bya zhing thal mo brdab/ rgyas par spro na thun brgyab pa'i rjes su bzlog gzhung 'di tshar re btang na legs gsung / bcu bdun pa las la sbyar ba ni/bsad bzlog dang 'byung bzhi sde brgyad kyi 'khor lo rnams mnan sreg 'phyar g.yeng byed lugs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len zhal las shes par bya zhing me 'khor sogs sreg pa'i las spyor byas pa'i thal ba rnams phyed mnan pa dang lhan cig tu spa/ lhag ma ri rtse nas rlung la 'phyar ro/ /thog nas gser skyems 'bul zhing zor 'phen pa thun mong ba'i skabs dang 'dra/ sgrub gtor de shes pa sum ldan yin pas drang srong gi dmag tshogs su gsal btab/ sha zan gyis gso ba dang sman rag sbran pa nas bzung chad mtho'i bar thun mong ba ltar btang rjes/ dgra bgegs kyi liṅga gang yang rung ba zhig dpal 'bar gyi me la bsregs te/ gzu dpang dang bcas pa zhes sgra drag po lan gsum bya/ gshegs skyemasakyi gtor ma phul nas them 'og gam lam rgya gram sogs dmigs gang yin du sa 'khor gyis mtshon pa'i gnon dgos mngon spyod spyi gzhung nas bshad pa ltar bcas rnams thog ma nas lag tu blangs pa'i 'don cha mtha' dag chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal dmar chung gi chog sgrigs kha bsgyur na brjod bde zhing legs/ chu rlung sogs las gzhan rnams yul dus kyi 'phral du ma thub na slar gza' tshes dang bstun chog pas mnan pa'i rjes su za lam ston pa'i phyir gser skyems/ bskul/ gtor ma 'phen pa nas bzung shis brjod kyi bar dkyus bzhin no/ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa bcas bsdus pa'i gtor ma la brten pa ni/ sa stegs 'brub khung gi rgyas bsdus gong dang 'dra ba'i khar thun mong pa'i skabs bzhin gtor chen bca'/ 'khor ling gi lag len rnams zhal shes mthong brgyud bzhin bstar/ gtor ma lhar bskyed pa sogs thun mong ba'i skabs dang gzhan ma mchod rten rang gi sgos chos dor ba'i bca' gzhi ngag 'don dmigs pa mtha' dag bcas rgyas pa'i skabs sor —44/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebazhag go /rtsa ba'i lnga pa 'byung bzhi dang bzlog bsad kyi las khol bur bsgrub pa ni/ mchod rten dang gtor chen gyi spros pa dor zhing 'brub khung du las gang byed kyi 'khor ling (12ba 'a brten nas sgrub pas lag len gyi khog rgyas pa nyid kyis 'bugs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang mtshon don dang sbyar ba'i 'byung bzhi cig car ba'i las bshad pa'i nyams su bstar na dam sri'i 'tshub lhongs kyi tshe mar la lcags bsregs ltar 'gro ba myong bas grub bo/ /'di dag rnams mthong brgyud dang zhal shes phra zhib la bstos na'ang sngon byung gi gter byung dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yig cha'i khrod na shin tu gsal ba zhig byung song bas brgyud pa'i bla ma dang gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa la cung zad tsam yang mi sems par sdang sems dang ldan bzhin du rang gi dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi ched du 'bad pas 'tshol ba'i snod min la stom pa dang rgyu nor ngo dga' tsam gyi ched du 'tshol bar bshad na ra spu'i 'ur rdo bzhin du rang la 'khor ba'i nyen che bas rta shi'i so ltar dam par byed dgos pas bag med 'chol par bstan pa byung na chos 'di'i gter gyi srung ma rnams dang khyad par bshan pa gza' rgod mig dmar gyis mi nor thams cad kyi steng du chad pa drag po thog ltar phob cig /sam ya/ sngags rgod log tri lag tu lon no zhes/ kha bo dbyings su 'dzer ba'i ban sngags kyis/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i sto ba gang na yang / /tshul ldan shes pa nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin/ /nga tsho'i khengs pas mkhas gzhan mi bsten 'gying / /la la sngon nas song zhes zog rdzun byed/ /'ga' zhig a pha'i gsol zhal gtsang bar chen/ /phal cher skyur bzi'i blo shed 'dre la 'tshong / kho bos tshad ldan mkhas rnams 'bad pas btsal/ /lag len dka' ba'i gnad kyi 'phrang la gcur/ /pad (13na)'byung dgongs don mchog sprul 'bri gung pas/ /lon de blo dang brtson pas khong du chud/ /'di ko chos kyi khe tshong byed 'gel lag khor na rang thog 'khor zhing bstan dang 'gro /'phung nyen che yang bdag dang bdag 'dra ba'i/ /rmongs rnams brjed ngas 'jigs pa spang phyir bkod/ /dge tsho gos spu grisadaga' rab dbang phyug mgo /bcad zhan sde brgyad snying rtsa 'dar ba dang / /lhan cig dkar po'i chos —442

sngags rgod log tri'i bzlog bsad las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge grang spyon sna rtse'i mtshon 'khor/ nang ma rtogel 'gro ba kun/ /zhugs nas gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub par shog /ces sngags rgod log tri pā la'i bzlog pa dang bsad pa'i las sbyor gyi gsal byed yi ge glang spyon sna rtser bkod pa'i mtshon 'khor 'di ni zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa sngags 'chang dkon mchog lhun grub sogs phyogs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i mkhas pa rnams 'bad pas bsten pa'i mthu las man ngag phra mo tsam la'ang the mi tshom pa'i gdengs tshad can g.yo ru lho rgyud du skyes pa'i za hor gyi sngags smon zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis bod yul bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dam sri 'byung po 'dul pa'i sgrub pa rnam par rgyal pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling par 'dzugs skabs/lag len khyer bde ba'i ched du bag yod ces pa chu glang nag po zla ba'i dmar cha'i nyer bzhi la 'dzin ma'i spo las mngon par 'phags pa'i pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa 'dis kyang mi bsrun pa'i dgra tsho gis rnams g.yul thog tu gsod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/ / / /—443

rgya yod bang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)gnyan chen thang lha'i 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhugs/pad+ma thod 'phreng khyod zhabs byang chub bar//gtsug tu stsol ba med par rtag bsten nas//lha chen tshangs pa'i rgyal po dgyes bskyed pa'i//'phrin las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun deng 'dir sbreng //skyabs sems ni/thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad//bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi//rang la ye shes shar ba'i sku//yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi//dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i sku//mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos la skyabs su mchi//sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags//'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir//smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do//sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir//gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad//don dam spros bral byang chub sems//rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom//zhes lan gsum brjod/gong gnon gyi lha bskyed pa ni/skad cig gis rang rig gyiyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/dbang chen rta mchog sku mdog dmar nag dbu tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du slebs pa/zhabs rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyang ba/nyi zla gza' skar rked la 'khor ba/ri rab la stegs byas pa/phyag g.yas pas gzugs khams 'degs shing /g.yon pas 'dod khamasaganon pa/dur khrod kyi chas kun 2na gyis brgyan pa/rta skad g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu bsgragasapas pho rgyud mo rgyud gza' klu thams cad dbang du sdud pa/gyi/ phaṭa gsum gyi sgra 'brug ltar ldir ba/khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gyur/hrī khyo hā kro ta pad+mā n+ta kṛ ta ha ya snro wa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ya ma rā tsa du tri phu ti hrīḥ/ phaṭa/ces ci rigs bzlas la bstod pa ni 'jam rol dang bcas/rta mgrin rgyal po dbang gi lha//dregs pa kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung //bla ma rigasa'adzin sprul sku la//sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'aX lo//mchod gtor brlab pa ni/hrī a hā kro ta

gnyan chen thang lha'i 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma (pepad+mā — kṛ ta ha ya gh+ri ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phyi nang gsang pa'i mchod rdzas rnams bzang zhing gya noms pa/ lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pā ra pā ra/ su ra su ra/ a wa rta ya a wa rta ya lho badz+ra sla ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i pang las las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du (2ba)ma sa/ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi ro bcud thams cad bsdus te gtor mar thim/ yi ge gsum yang 'od du zhu nas dbyer med gcig tu 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du bsam/ oṃ skya/ ma hā bha lin+ta te dz+wa bha lin+ta bha la bha te gu phya sam ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis byin gyis brlab/ rten bskyed pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du shel gyi khang bzang rin po che sna tsho gos kyi sgo lcog 'od 'bar ba/ rtsa bar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'phyur ba/ rked par 'ja' 'od na bun gyi gur phub pa/ rtse mor sprin dkar rin po che'i zil char 'bebs pa/ sa gzhi ljang sngon me tog sna tsho gos rgyas pa/ khor yug tu gnam lha brgyad kyi gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten lta bus bskor ba/ de'i steng du nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la stobs ldan rta mchog ngang dkar la rin po che'i sga rgyan du mas mdzes pa'i steng na lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog shel gyi ri bo ltar brjid pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum rab tu bkra ba/ dbu skra'i thor tshugs dar dkar pos bcings pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan pa'i sba lcag nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa shel dkar phreng ba 'dren pa/ zab chen dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi ber gsol ba/ spyi bo nor bu 'bar ba'i tog dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tsho gos dang bcas pa/ sku gzhon zhing mdzes pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du yum gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma sku mdog sngo bsangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis la spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas rgyal —443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shematshan dang g.yon me long 'dzin cing / dbu skra thor tshugs lhag ma'i zar bu thur du 'phyang ba/ sman btsun mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad (3na)kyis gtso bo la 'dud pa'i rnam pa can g.yu 'brug la bcibs pa/ shar du zhi mdzad rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ lhor rgyas byed rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ nub tu dbang gi lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ byang du las kyi khro bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ shar lhor lha chen skyes bu bzhin bzang / lho nub du lha chen gyi ngo bo 'brong g.yag zhol dkar/ nub byang du dpal bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/byang shar du lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po/ rnam 'gyur de rnams kyi 'khor du mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu/ dmag tsho gos bye ba 'bum sde/ thams cad kyang dpung tsho gis bzhi pa'i cha lugs su 'jigs shing dpa' ba/ steng dang phyogs mtshams kun nas sprul pa'i dung khra dkar bo lding zhing / dung spyang pho mo dang / 'brong g.yag zhol chen mang po khro la ngar ba/ de rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du aḥdakar po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer dang / bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi dkyil la gnas pa'i yiḥyig dmar po las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sku lha chen po sprul 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du byon par bsam/ hūṃ/ ye shes gzhal yas bskyed kyis rgya ma chung / /seng ge glang chen khri bshams dpangs ma dma'/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gting bkrag ma zhan/ /ye shes lha mchog bsnyen cing rgyang ma ring / /'jig rten srung ma bsgrub kyi mthu ma chung / /'dir gshegs nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ sam ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥsnyi baṃ lho/ pad+ma ka ma la ye rto/ phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra sa pa ri wā ra a / pu 〉 nas/ sha lta bra stu ts+tsha swā hā'i bar brjod/ sman gtor 'bul ba ni/(3ba) // rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a yi ta/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūṃ/ dkar gsum dngar gsum bzang sman 'bru dkar zin/ /legs sbyar ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa/ /ro mchog brgya phrag ldan pa'i bha —446

gnyan chen thang lha'i 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma (gelin+ta/ /'bul gyis bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ /lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljagasa3 las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bas thams cad drangs te gsol bar shraPROBPROB PROB badz+ra thang ka ra sa pa ri wā ra ma hā bha li sta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ gtso bo la bdun nam nyer gcig /ā+oṃ a kā ros gtso 'khor spyir lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ bskang rdzas rnams/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad 'byung gyur ba/ /zhes sogs sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ /g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang ma'i mchod yon sbreng / /sna tshogs me tog 'phreng ba'i thod chings mdzes/ /dri zhim bsangs spos dud pa sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /rin chen 'bru mar snang gsal 'od mdangs bkra/ /ga pur gur gum dri sbyor byug pa'i rdzas/ /ro bda' lha mi'i zhal zas ri ltar spungs/ /snyan brjid rol mo gyer dbyangs bsam mi khyab/ /lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul/ /rta mchog ngang dkar sga srab chas kyis mdzes/ /'brong dkar dung khra gtsang lug shel ltar 'tsher/ /gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan dar 'phan lda ldi bres/ /rang skyob go dang dgra 'joms sna tsho gis mtshone/ /zab ber rin chen rgyan sogs zhi drag chas/ /sba lcag (4na〉zhel phreng la sogs phyag mtshan rigs/ /gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu dang/ /ri dwags 'phyo dgu'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang / /rin chen sna bzhi las grub lhun po la/ /gser gyi ri bo rol mtsho bdun gyis bskor/ /gling bzhi gling phran rin wo ri bo dang / /yongs 'du'i ljon pa 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /ma smos lo tog rgyal srid sna bdun dang / /nye ba'i sna bdun bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs/ /lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi 'byor tshogs kyis/ /lha chen tshangs pa 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi smyug rgod dar snas brgyan/ /bris 'bur zhal brnyan ye shes sems dpa' 'khyil/ /dar dkar gzhi mar legs bris snying po'i phreng / /lha chen chags pa'i phyi sgrub rten du 'bul/ /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ dang 'bru gsum gyis brlabs pa'i/ /gser skyems bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho wo po 'di/ /steng 'og gdon dang rgyal 'gong dam sri sogs/ /bar ho 'dul —447

rgyal dbang lnga pa nga gdabang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)phyir mchod bas thugs dam bskang //gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs//mi zad 'dod yon tsho gos kyis mchode pa 'dis//dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa yis//dngos grub ma lus stsole phyir thugasadam bskang //dkar gsum gtsang phye sman phud yongs sbyar bar//sna tsho gis rgyan gyi khyad par bkod legs pa/khrel mkhan rin chen sgo lcog 'phar ba'i dbyibs//dam rdzas gtor ma nang gi rten du 'bul//lha chen tshangs pa'i rgyal po chen po dang //gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgron mnyam sbyar ba//zag med dga' ba bcu drug cha rdzogs pa'i//bde chen gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang //bde gsal mi rtog dbyings rig dbyer med pa//dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bgrod gcig lam//lha 4bslob thugs kyi dgongs pa zab zhi dang //ji bzhin mnyam par bzhag pas thugs dam bskang //bstod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/hūṃ/dpal ldan lha yi lha mchog khyod//'dzam gling byang phyogs kha ba can/kha ba can gyi byang ljongs su//sa gzhi ljang sngon rtsi bcud rgyas//me tog pad+ma 'od du 'phro//gangs dkar shel gyi phreng bas bskor//yid 'ong mtsho r+ṣa mdangs dang ldan/shel mkhar rin wo sgo lcog wor//rtsa ba yid bzhin rgya mtsho rtse brten//rked par 'ja' 'od na bun thibs//rtse mor dkar gsal dgos 'dod kyi//rin chen char 'bebs ga sgra sgrog/gzhal yas de yi nang shed na//nyi zla pad+ma rta mchog steng //dam can rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal//sku mdog dkar la khro 'dzum 'gying //phyag g.yas rdo rje'i sba lcag 'phyar//g.yon pa zla ba'i shel phreng 'dren//dar dkar thod bcings dbu skra'i rtser//yid bzhin nor bu 'bar bas brgyan//sku la ber chen phrug gsum gsol//gzhon mdzesayid 'phrog rgyal po'i mas//'od zer sna tsho gis phyogs bcur 'phro//mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu dang //dmag dpung bye ba 'bum sdes bskor//kun kyang khro gas brjid pa'i gzugs//dar r+pā rol mos nam mkha' gang //bde gshegs stong gi bstan pa bsrung //pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' bzhin bsgrub//chos rgyal mnga' ris bu bzhin skyong //dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha mdzad//rje dpon yongs kyi dgra ltar gyur//rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal ༷ ༷stod//lha wo yongs kyi rje bor bstod//dri za'i

gzha r+sā thang lha'i phren las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang mo9) rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /deng nas rigs 'dzin mchog thob bar/ /snyan pa nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /grags pa gza' skar 'od ltar khye/ /dbu 'phang ri rgyal rtse ltar bstod/ /rig brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar spel/ /dgos 'dod dpag (ldan thas ma shing ltar stsol/ /sdebargyad dregs pa bran ltar bkol/ /smyo 'dre rgyal po rdul bzhin thul/ /dam med mna' zan bgegs bzhin sgrol/ /bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'grogs nas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsole/ /zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab cing me tog gtor/ /yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bgang / /ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag blo rmo mes pa yis/ /bgyis pa dang ni 'gyid stsal gang / /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang / /bdag sogs brjed ngasaci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /'di ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor nas rten la bstim zhing brtan bzhugs kyang bya/shis brjod ni/ hūṃ/ gar dbang 'od mtha' yas pa chos kyi sku/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad rta mgrin longs spyod rdzogs/ /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ /dbyer med ye shes sum ldan bkra shisashog /sa brgyad brnyes kyang bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon tshul 'dzin gas gyi rigs/ khri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /rnam 'gyur cir yang ston pa'i ba po shis shog /zhi rgyasadabang drag las kun bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /gsang yum mched blon sprul pa yang sprul dang / /sdebargyad dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung tsho gos sogs/ /grangs med 'khor tsho gis rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /bdud dang rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po'i rigs/ /dngos dang yid la brlabs pa'i skye bo'i mtshon/ /nag po'i rtsa lag ba dan rab bsnyal (5ba)te/ /dkar phyogs rgyal mtshan bsgreng pa'i bkra shis shog /bod skyong lha rigs dngos dang dngos 'dra ba/ /che mnyam bsod nams ldan pa ya rabs kyi/ /sku lha gnyan po mdzad nas gangs ljongs 'dir/ /bde skyid dga' ston dpal 'bar bkra shis shog zhes—449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)me tog gi char dbab bo//byang sems nam mkha'i snying po gdul dka'i 'gro/gnyan por srid gsum bdag bo tshangs pa che//mchod bkang tshig nyung don tshang 'byer bde ba//phyogs 'di goms pa'i blo gros mas las byung /khri srong rigs kyi thig le'i bag chags mthu//yongs sad bod dang bod chen 'dzin ma'i gzhin//dbang sgyur sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dgra lha mchog/gsol ched za hor bzhes yi ger bkod//sor mo'i 'du byed gong dkar dkar brag pa//ngag dbang byams pa'i rnam dpyod kyisabasgran pa'i//bsod nams gos bu yid srubs las rgyal nas//'gro kun skyid pa'i nyi ma gung 'char shog/sarba maṅga le/ 40

stag zhon/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/ bka' srung brgyad mchod/ thang lha/khyab mthug /rgyal btsan/ rdor legs/ zhing skyong /mthu chen sde bzhi/ phur srung rnams kyi gsol mchod/gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bcas pa bzhus/sa/dpal mgon stag zhen gyi gsol mchod bklags chog 'khyer bde gsar sgrigs nas phyung ba ni/ mchod gtor spyan gzigs rnams phyag len ltar 'du byas la/ /hūṃ/ rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po lcang lo can/ /ri bo ma la ya yi gnas mchogo nas/ /gnam lcags ur mo rab tu ta la la/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong mer re re/ /zhing chen keng rus lhu dum khrol lo lo/ /'dab chags sha za mang po'i lding zhing 'dur/ /gsur wo dud pa'i tsho gos ni 'khyil zhing las/ /de 'dra'i dur khrod rab tu 'jigs pa nas/ /gying chen mgon po yab yum sku bskyed la/ khru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gying bdud ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya tri yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ trag raka ha la dzaḥdzaḥ dun ru tra ru ṭaṃ bha ti dzaḥshu la ra tsa tri shaṃ dzaḥ 2 dza badz+ra tri rna sa kha sna tri sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ sa pa ri wā ra ā byu ya yu la ya/(2na)bra be shā ya bra be shā ya/ tiṣ+ṭha tilga brnya ya bsgyu ya/ a wa lo kā ya/ a wa lo kā ya/ ā gas ya hūṃ dzaḥ // rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyan snga ma khas blangs dam bcas ma bsnyel par/ gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bzhugs la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rasam ya pre/ hūṃ/ bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /dza gad bdud rtsi rak+ta dang / /dbang po'i me tog gsur wo spos/ /zhun r+pā sgron me'i snang gsal dang / /—451—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedamar chen mkhris pa'i dri'i byug pa/ /dmar nag bsgos bu 'bar ba'i zas/ /rol mo'i sgra dbyangasamachod par 'bul/ /ā+oṃ shrī ma hā kā wā ya sa pa ri wā ra a nas/ sha lta pra la ye swā hā'i bar brjod/hūṃ/ lcang lor bcas pa'i dung chen bas sa /byang chub sems dang me sa rak+ta dang / khri chen go ku chu ste bdud rtsi lnga/ /gnyis med sbyar ba'i dam rdzas a mṛ ta/ /nag po stag zhen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya sa pa ri wā (2ba)ra ma hā pañtsa a khra ta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūṃ/ bdud 'dul dbang phyug nag po 'jigs byed che/ /ma hā kā la rdo rje 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ khams gsum sgrol gying chen po'i dngos grub ni/ /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dus 'dir stsol/ /ā+oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ wā spro sirnyi 〉 tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ hūṃ/ rlung nag las ma'i klong dkyil nas/ /mon pa nag po brda mi 'phrod/ /mgyogs byed dpa' bo stag la zhen/ /bdud btsan srin po ma mo gying / /klu yi tshogs dang bcas pa yi/ /nag po chen po 'khor bcas la/ /dam rdzas rak+ta dmar chen 'bul/ /bdag gi dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā wā ya sa pa ri wā ra ma hā me sa/ ma hā tsit+ta/ ma hā ska : ti kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya sa pa ri wā ra sam ya sma ra/ sam ya ma ti kram/ sam ya rak+ṣa ( / kye/ stag la zhen pa'i nag po che/ /'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams kun/ /bcol ba ji bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ gtor tsho gos mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang / /e las gnam lcags 'brub khung nang / /rtsi dang tri las dgra bgegs kyi/ /gzugs brnyan nyam thag rnam par gyur/ khyu dzaḥtri dzaḥ badz+ra ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra spo ga bo/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍahobadz+ra pra be shā ya phaṭa/ a be shā ya a/ rang dang mgon po'i thugs ka las/ /'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /gnod byed dam nyams dgra bgegs tshogis/ /skad cig tsam la 'dir khug cig /(3na)gri gug 'bar bas khog pa shogs/ /tshe srog drod dang rnam shes go /srung ba 'bru gsum rnam par thon/ /rang gi gnas gsum dag la thim/ /ā+oṃ sa// pho nya'i tsho gos kyi mtshon cha yis/ sha khrag rus pa dum bur gtubs/ /'bru gsum gyis mtshan 'od zer gyis/ /dug gsum sbyangs nas bdud —452

stag zhen/ rgyal r+ṣa dzi bzhi/ bka' srung brgyad mchod sog kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma (pertsir bsgyur/ /hūṃ/ da ni khro bo'i rgyal po ste/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje 44 / /rdo rje'i lus la rdo rje 'phros/ /thams cad ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /de yi bka' nyan mas bo che/ /chos skyong mgon po bstan srung mgon/ /ma hā kā la mas rtsal can/ /zas su dgra bo'i sha za zhing / /skom du dgra bo'i snying khrag 'thung / khyod ni sha za khrag 'thung ste/ /bstan pa gnyan po bsrung slad du/ /rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang / /dgra bo'i sha khrag mchod par bzhes/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /dam nyamasadagra 'di da lta sgrol/ /dus la bab bo sam yā/ /byu sogs/ mgon po yab yum mon pa dang bcasapa'i sngags sbrel ba'i rjes su/ sa pa ri wā ra sarba bigha na sha hūm̐ mā ra ya i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/lan gsum gyis dbul lo/ /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gtor chog steng nas za hor bzhes nyung ngur bsdus pa'o/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi mchod pa ni/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ /zhes pa nas/ sha rdi'i bar phur pa'i sgrub chen dngos grub rgya mtsho ltar gtong / /byang gter bka' srung brgyad kyi (3ba)gtor ma so sor ram mdor bsdus 'byer bde byed pa phyag len ltar skabs thob dang sbyar te bshams la/ hūṃ/kun bzang thugs sprul sangs rgyas kun gyi yum/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ bha ji thogs/ /smug nag sprin dkar 'ja' yi mtha' can gyon/ /e ka dzā khyi ral gcig gshegs su gsol/ /dur khrod brgyad dbus ma mo ro kha ma/ /nam gru tsa murnyi gsum / /nyi ma byang phyogs gnas nas re ma tī/ /ma gcig dpal ldan gnas 'dir ཿ/ /dmar nag pad+ma khros pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dbang gi ma mo mched bdun / /ri lung thang dmar zangs mkhar dmar po nas/ /sgrol ging wo po btsan rgodaḥ/ /steng phyogs nam mkha' 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /legs ldan chen po gnas 'dir:/ /snying nye bka' nyan gter bdag gzhog rgod rtsal/ /dam can rdo rje legs pa:/ /dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje wor ba rtsal/ /sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs la / kha ba can gyi yul bdag srung ma che/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor bcas:/ /bkra bzang ri bo'i gnas nas nye ba'i dbang / /ri de'i phyogs bzhin lha bdud btsan klu —453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)yi//dge bsnyen khrom pa skyes bzhi mtshams bzhi nas//klu sras bu le dkar po rgyal thang dkar//klu btsan spun gsum rno myur nag pa sogs//gter srung 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//ā+oṃ badz+ra tra ga raka e /dzā smi ma ma ra smo tra tra traka/ma hā ya ka nag mo/pad+ma rnga kyi ni ya ma shu tri/ma hā kā la/badz+ra su hūṃ/badz+ra thang ka ra/ma ma/kha kha/4na tha la/le le/ta ta/te te/dha rma pā la sab ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥde nas ma rdzo 'bul ni/hūṃ/bka' srung 'khor dang bsas pa'i spyan lam du//rak+ta gsur wo dud pa tshil byu sgron/sha rus zhal zas thod rnga rol mo'i sgra//dam rdzasagator ma bdud rtsi a khra ta//dri za'i rgyal po bgos dang g.ya' gangs chu//spos dkar dud pa rin cen rnam pa lnga//dar dang za 'og gos dkar gtsang ma dang //gsang lug la sogs rang rang mas pa'i rdzas//klu rnams dkar gsum bdud rtsi rin cen lnga//klu sman la sogs rang rang dgyes pa yi//'dod pa'i lo mes spyod tsho gos rnams rab 'bul gyi//dga' bder spyod lamathun pa'i las rnams sgrubs//gong gi sa pa ri wā ra'i mjug tu//ma hā pañtsa a khra ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ma hā bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/'phrin bcos ni/bga' srung ldebargyad mched zla bran g.yog rnams//rgyal ba'i bstan dang rnal 'byor ma g.yel srungs/khyad par gsang sngags zab mo'i chos 'di skyongs//log par 'dren pa'i dam nyams dgra bo la//bsad bskrad rengs rmo mes rdzul sna tsho gis ston//bod khamasaru bzhi nad 'brug nyer 'tshe las//skyobs la gnas wo byin rlobs zab ga kho srungs//mdor na bcol ba'i las kun sgrub par mdzod//ces rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi gtor srungs rnams la mchod gtor 'bul tshul mdor bsdus 'di yang med du mi rung ba'i phyir thugs sgrub rnam gsum gyi cha 4b.lag tu gter gzhung dngos bstan ma 'phyongs pas 'byer bde ba'i slad dur hor bzhes bkod pa'o//thang lha sger du gsol ba ni/hūṃ/ye shes lta brag spyos gas lhad med/gzhal yas bskyed kyisargya ma chung //seng ge glang chen khri bshams dpangs ma dma'//nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan bting bkrag ma wā//ye shes lha mchog bsnyen cing rgyang ma ring 4///jig rten srung ma bsgrub kyi ma lhum yo /'dir

rtog wo/yi ོ sdog/bka' srung brgyad ma rdzo sogs kyi gsol mgo dang gzhi bdag ga sto ma/nang ma 9)gshegs nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal//sam ya dza'aḥ//sku lha'i yab smos pa/'o de gung rgyal lags/sku lha'i yum smos pa//g.yu bya gshog gcig lags//sku lha nyid smos pa/ya zhun gnyan gyi lha//gzhugs yul mtshan gsol ba//'dam shod snar ma lags/khri rgod g.yu ljang 'khril//dbyar sngo dgun yang sngo//bzhugs yul nyams re dga'//dgyes so lha yi yul//mi chos mtshan gsol ba//thang lha ya zhur lags//lha chos mtshan gsol ba//dri za'i rgyal bo ni/khur phud lnga pa lags//gsang ba'i mas
