gsol ba//rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal//sku la ci gsolan//dar dkar ras dkar gsol//chas su ci chis na//lha rta tswa dkar chibs/khams gsum tso tu rgyu//mdog dkar 'od zer wor//g.yas na spa lcag tsor//ma bdun las la 'gyed//g.yon pa shel phreng 'dren//thugs dam dbyings su zlo//sprul pa ci 'gyed na//rta dmag 'bum sde'agyed//phran g.yog 'khor dang bcas//'dir ldan ) spyon 'phrin las mdzod//dam can kun gyi lha//dam med ༅ gyi gshed//mna' zan kun gyi bdud//rnal 'byor tso gyi dpal//sgrub mchogabadag gi grogs//'phrin las skal phog pa//spyo ba'i 'dre 'dul zhing //snang ba'i dgra srog gcod//mgyogs su rta gto kyi//i thogs zor ma lci//rno ru mardzo brdar gyi//rtse mo dbal mas/sgyu dang do sngo na//do thag ho ta re//mgyogs dang ༅samakho na//yas thog shor ra re//sa dgras 'byer ra re//byams kyis skyong ta re//dus la bab bo sam ya//dam si rjes su dran par gyis//las la bab bo bgegs kyi rgyal//bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha khyed//chos skyong rgyal bo lha yi sras/khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha yin//skyon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis//dam la btags pa'i dam tshig can//da lta ci bsgo'i las rnams nye ne//phyi rabasabastan pa'i tha ma la//skyon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi//rjes su 'jug pa'i sngags 'chang dang //chos rgyalakhri srong lde'u bas gyi//lha brgyud chags pa'i rje regs rnams//mtho mtho gung la rig pa dang //dma' dma' bu bzhin skyong bar gyis//bod khamaXru bzhi phyugs bzhin stongs//bsam yas lha khang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dang blo sang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedakor bzhin srungs/ /bskal ba tha ma'i sems can la/ khyed kyis srung skyob ma byed du/ /dang po byang lam bar pa sa /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yis/ khrog snying gzir ba mi dran nam/ /bar du bsam yas has po rir/ /dbang chen (5ba lnga d+ma he ru das/ /dbang du bsdus pa mi dran nam/ /tha ma ri rgyal ba po bzang gi /rtse mor lha srin kun bsags nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu yis/ /dam tshig phog pa mi dran nam/ /nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ khyod ni gnyan chen thang lha yin/ khul ni dbus gtsang ru bzhi yin/ /byin rlabs sprin ltar thibs se thib/ /thugs rje char ltar shar ra ra/ /dam tshig mdangs ldan yal la la/ /thang lha gnyan po gshegs su gsol/ /sku lha gnyan po 'khor bcas la/ /brjid ldan bzang rir bsgos kyis mchode/ /g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang mas mchode/ khri zhim sposadakar dud pas mchod/ /gser dngul rin cen sna lngas mchode/ /rngon cha dar dang za 'og mchod/ /gsang lug gos dkar gtsang mas mchode/ /oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra mun nying khu sha li sha a khra ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mas stobs nus pa'i tshogs/ /gcig bsdus gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dbyer med dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas 'dud do brtse ba'i spyan gyis skyongs/ /srid gsum dregs pa zil gnon mtsho skyes rje/ khrag sngags gter gyi sgo 'byed las wel rtsal/ /tshul 'dir mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma'i tsho gos rnams phyag gi yul/ /gang zhig las la sbyar na smos ci dgos/ /gdengs ldan gnod kyis bskul ba tsam gyis kyang / /dgra dpung phye mar 'thag pa rā hu la'i/ /'phrin las dug mda' (6na skog po deng 'dir spro/ /mchod gtor spyan gzigs rdzas rnams man ngag ltar/ /'khrul med mthong brgyud phyag bzhes ltar bshams nas/ /bdag bskyed spyir btang dmigs bsal skabs thob rnams/ /dpyod ldan man ngag ji bzhin nyams su long / /a mri tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad zla'i steng / /hūṃ las sna tsho gis rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ/ /mtshan par 'od los rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / /ra gur bla bre ye shesame 'bar ba'i/ /srung 'khor dbus su 'jigs drang dur khrod che/ khrag mtsho rba klong 'khrug dbus e —456

stag zhon/ rgyal chen dzi bzhi/ bka' srung brgyad mchod sogs kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma 6)las ni/ khru gsum mthing nag mkha' mnyam lte ba la/ /pa raṃ a ni tri las pad+ma dang / /nyi zla dgra bgegs gan rkyal bsnol ba'i steng / /du ba'i mdog can tri las 'od 'phros pas/ /dgra bgegasatshar bcad tshur 'dus trir thim pas/ /gza' bdud dud kha zhal dgu'i steng dbus dkar/ /bya rog mgo bcas zhal rer dmar zlum spyan/ /sum ldan ral ba dmar ser gnam cho/ /thod skam lnga pa rin cen rtse phran can/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan ral gri'i yu ba ldan/ /g.yas 'dzin g.yon par sbrul zhags 'og ma gnyis/ /mda' gzhu 'gengs shing dug mda' dgra la 'phen/ /sku smad dug sbrul 'khyil zhing 'jigs pa'i kha/ /sto bar rab bgrad sku la spyan stong mdzes/ /ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phe pho sgra/ /zhal nas rab sgrog dgra bo chem chem gsol/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan che zhid yan lag rags/ /(6bsnya ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od las lhag skur/ /sbrul gyi do shal chun po ser la kha/ /mi mgo'i do shal dar nag rin chen rgyan/ /mi lhags g.yang gzhi stag lpags sham thabs gsol/ khams gsum yongs su khengs par bzhugs pa'i g.yas/ khrag mtsho rus khrir rdo rje srin po yab/ /zla gam rak+ta ra rdo rje glog 'gyu yum/ /yab yum sras gsum nub dang shar lho byang / /lho nub shar dang nub byang lho dang ni/ /byang shar rnams su gdug can gdan steng na/ /ljang sngon r+pā po drang srong dkar ser dang / /bdud po rog ti biṣ+ṭi pa tra dang/ /bisna rā dza du ba mjug ring dang / khyab 'jug wo po sgra gcan 'dzin pa ste/ /nang gi gza' chen rnams dang phyogs bzhi na/ /stag srin zor gdong kham srin dred kyi gdong / /kong srin glang gdong 'brog srin chu srin gdong / /gdong mo bzhir bcas de dag phyi rol tu/ / nyi ma zla ba la sogs gza' chen brgyad/ /bdud dang gshin rje la sogs lha srin brgyad/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs lha chen brgyad/ /dga' bo 'jog po la sogs klu chen brgyad/ /smin drug la sogs rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang nag po stong gi tshogs/ sha za 'bum sdom mo bye ba dang / /lha dmag bye ba dung phyur la sogs pa/ /mdor na srid gsum 'byung po'i dmag tsho gos bcas/ sha dga' khrag sred dbugs rngam ro la 'jib/ khro gtum cha lugs cho 'phrul cir yang ston/ /srid —457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo r+sāng rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gsum thal bar rlog pa'i mthu stobs can//'khor 7na ) gyis yongs bskor gtso 'khor thams cad kyi//gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur//rang gi thugs ka las byung 'od 'phrosapas//gar bzhugs gnas nas gza' bdud rā hu la//'khor bcas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig rnams//dran pa tsam gyis sngags 'chang bdag cag gi/las rnams bsgrub phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//badz+ra sam ya dzaḥhri shag ru rag raṃ na ge tsit+ta tre ma ma yong za 'gro ha hi ke she la dzaḥdzaḥsam ya dzaḥdzaḥspyan 'dren pa ni/hūṃ/kun bzang sprul pa phyag na rdo rje yi//pho nya zhing bcu'i dgra bo 'dul pa la//'jig rten 'di na 'gran zla med pa'i sku//chos kyi dbyings nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//gnam lcags rtse nas spyan 'dren//dur khrod gnas nas //'jigs pa'i gza' mchog /mthong ba'i dug can //reg pa'i dug can/kha rlangs dug can /khyab 'jug chen po//sprul pa'i gza' brgyad//skar wo phong dar //du ba mjug ring //ljang sngon r+ṣa po //ma ru tse nyid//gdong mo mar bzhi/khyu skar nyer brgyad//lha srin sdebargyad //bga' nyan 'khor tshogs//oṃ ra hu la skṛ hā ā byu ya hūṃ dza bzhugs su gsol ba ni/thogs med drag rtsal rdzu'aphrul mnga' ba'i lha//'bar ba'i gdan la dgyes par bzhugs su gsol//rā hu la sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan//phyag 'tshal ba ni/mngon spyod 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i bstan srung che//7bskrag bo ra hu la la phyag 'tshal lo//rā hu la a ti pu hoḥbra ti ts+tsha hoḥsman rag gtong gsum ni/gza' mchog rgyal po sprul pa yang sprul dang //'bor bcas dam rdzas bdud rtsi a mṛ ta//dmar wo rak+ta gtor ma 'di bzhes la//dbang dang dngos grub stsol la dgra yul du//thog ser phob cig srog ser skyin thang gi/las rnams mthar phyin sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//rā hu la sarba pañtsa a yi ta khā hi/rā hu la ma hā rak+ta khā hi//rā hu la ma hā ba li ta khā hi/bskang ba ni/hūṃ/khyab 'jug chen po 'khor bcas kyi//spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir//me tog stong gis thugs dam bskang //snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir//glu gar rol mos /shangs kyi dbang po 4 /8/gsur chen dud pa//ljags kyi dbang po//me

stag smo/rgyal ོ ldebazhi/ bka' zung brgyad mchod sogs kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma khonganas sha yis / /thugs kyi dbang po / /rol mo sgra yis / /rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /rtag gtor chen pos / khyun du 'phrin las 'chol ba'i phyir/ khyun gtor nar mas —/ /gnas kyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /thod mkhar 'bar bas:/ /bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /nyi zla pad+mas / /mthun pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rak+ta dmar gyis ཿ/ /dam tshig gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud ni sman gyis / /dam nyams dgra bo gsod pa'i phyir/ /tsit+ta snying gis / /dgra bgegasasha la za ba'i phyir/ /me sa sha yisaḥ/ /dbang po sna lngas —/ /go ro tsa nas:/ /keng rus tshil wo / /nang (zha)khrol sna lngas / /tshil chen snang gsalaḥ/ /byang sems dkar dmar / /bha ling gtor masaḥ/ /dza gad phud kyis / /bdud rdzi stsa lngas:/ khrag sna lnga yis / /chu sna lngas yis / /'dod yon gtor ma thugs dam bskang / /de ltar bskang ba gsogaso nas/ /rnal 'byor nyams chags skong gyur cig /bstod ba ni/ hūṃ/ lhun grub sku gsum rol pa'i ngang nyid las/ /dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar 'byin khro gtum can/ /dregs pa kun gyi nang nas rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /zla bral gza' bdud rā hu la la bstod/ /'jigs rung bzod par dka' ba'i dur khrod nang / /dmar nag rba klong zhabrug pa'i khrag mtsho'i dbus/ /lhun po lta bu'i mi sdug srin po'i gzugs/ /rab 'bar bskal ba'i me dpung gyon la bstod/ /dmar zlum mig stong blta bas legs nyes da/ kha gdangs nyi ma zla ba sto ru za/ /rno ngar mtshon gyis brnag pa'i dgra snying 'bigs/ /dug sprul zhags pas log 'dren 'ching la bstod/ /tsha grang 'thab pa'i rkan brdeb dug rlangs 'phyo/ /gnam lcags me yi thog 'bebs ser ba gtong / /dgra dpung yul bcas phye mar 'thag byed pa'i/ /srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba khyod la bstod/ khyod kyi 'khor na phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /gza' chen brgyad dang gdong mo rnam pa bzhi/ /lha srin sdebargyad srid gsum 'byung ba yi/ /grangs med dmag tsho gos 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /de nas bskul zhing 'phrin las bcol ba ('ji/ hūṃ/ gi gang rog ti mgo dgu bya rog dbu/ /mgo brgyad gza' chen brgyad de gri rgod dang / /drang srong nad dang ser chen glo bur zhabrug /'jig rten zhabrug dang lha srin ma —459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lus dang //srog gcod mu ge nad yams gi dang brgyad//log 'dren dgra la 'bebs pa'i dus la bab//dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//gyi srin po'i gzugs can mgo dgu ro smad sbrul//sna tsho gos mtshone 'dzin gnam lcags thog chen gyis//dgra bo ma lus gsod pa'i mthu bo che//lho nub mtshams nas sku bzhengs zla rjes spyod//shar du rgyu zhing byang shar mtshams nas ni//sku bzhengs nyi ma'i rjes spyod nub tu rgyu//nyin mtshan rgyu bas mtshams bzhi phyogs bzhi 'joms//dus tsho de tshes grangasang ba lnga yi bdag/sdebargyad bran 'khol 'jig rten khams kun 'khrug/lo nyes 'khrug pa thog ser 'bebs shing gtong //mdun du su byung khyur mid gtong byed pa'i//'jig rten 'di na zla bral mthu rtsal mā//sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' ma bsnyel par//dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//gyi ljang sngon r+pā po drang srong dkar ser dang //bdud po rog ti chu pa tra che//biṣ+ka rā dza du ba mjug ring dang /khyab 'jug chen po sgra gas 'dzin pa ste//gza' wo brgyad kyi thugs dam dus la bab//sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' ma bsnyel par//dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//phyogs bcu nam mkha' 9na〉ngas pa'i dkyil 'khor nas//sbas shing gab pa'i gdong mo mched bzhi ni//nam mkha'i dngas nas 'brug gi sgra sgrog cing //bar snang khams nas drag po glog 'byug pa//ri rab rtse nasaganam lcags thog chen 'bebs//sring mo gdong mo mched bzhi'i dus la bab//sngon gyi khas blangasadam bca' ma bsnyel par//dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//'dzam gling phyogs mtshams nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas//bar snang khams la dbang sgyur gza' chen brgyad/khyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs te//sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la bab//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir//sngon gyi khas blaXdam bca' ma bsnyel par//dam rdzas rgyan gyi

stag smo/ rgyal 'a sdog/ bka' srung brgyad mar sogs kyi gsol mgo dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma 6)mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ho mtho ni/ sman rag sbran la/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis/ /ji rgya mtsho'i mtsho gling du/ /nam mkha'i gza' rnams dam la btags/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/hūṃ/ yar stod sham po gangs kyi ra ba mā /rigs 'dzin wo po ku mā rā dza dang / /rdzogs kho rnal 'byor klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /ye shes thig le'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /sngags bdag gza' rnams ma lus thams cad kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mad dam pa bstan nas kyang / /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba dang / /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad (9bskom/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ khes gtor ma skabs thob dang sbyar te skyel/ /de nas bris sku sogs yod na brtan bzhugs smon lam mjug chog rnams bya'o/ /de ltar drang srong khyab 'jug nag po yi/ /las byang chad lhag med cing 'byer bde 'di/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i btsas su bkod/ /skal med log lta can la gsang ba'i rgya/ /drang srong khyab 'jug rā hū la'i 'phrin las dug mda' nag po zhes bya ba 'di ni gsar rtsom thor bus cung zad bde ru bto zhing phal cher gter gzhung gtso bor byas te rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi rgyun 'byer du bde ba'i ched chos skyong 'di nyid nye bar bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rig sngags 'cha ba'i rgyud du son pa zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rjes chu pho rta lo khrums kyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi gral tshes la nye bar bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse ni/ grub pa'i dbang po'i gar gyis rnam rol ba/ /srid gsum bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dngos grub kun stsol bgegs kun gzhom par mdzod/ /lhun grub gdod ma'i gshis las ma g.yos kyang / /bstan pa bsrung phyir sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /—461—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonacir yang 'char 10na ) pa sprul pa'i cho ge rgyal che//'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir da tshur spyon//sna tsho gis rin cen las grub gzhal yas khang //mu tig tsho gis 'bar rin cen ba gam can//ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i pho brang du//pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//dus gsum rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng gis//dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas kyang //bstan pa bsrung dang dam ldan 'phrin las kun//sgrub par bka' bsgos dam bcas dran par mdzod//dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma ri ltar spungs//zag med bdud rtsi'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil//phyi nang spyan gzigs sa dang bar snang kun//rgyas par bkang ste 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//gtor ma dbul/zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub par dang //bstan pa bsrung phyir khro chags ni dang sgeg/nyams brgya'i rol pas gar mdzes rnam 'gyur can//rgyal po sku lnga'i sku la bdag bstod do/khyod zhal nam mkha' mche ba'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs//ljags kyi glog 'phreng srid gsum za ba bzhin//ha ha'i gad brgyangs hūṃ hūṃ 'brug sgra can/khams gsum dbang sdud khyod la bdag bstod do//rang bzhin lhun grub gdod nas spros dang bral//ma bcos rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos//kun khyab kun gyi rang bzhin cir yang 'char//gnas lugs don gzigs khyod la bdag bstod do//rnam mang yon tan tsho gos la mnga' brnyes 0bskong /khyod la mchod bstod bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa las//'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i yon tan kun//phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad khyod la bdag bstod do//zhi rgyas dbang drag rab 'byams 'phrin las kun//dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bka' bsgos ba'i na//thogs pa med par sgrub mdzad dam tshig can//chos skyong chen po khyod la bdag bstod do//hūṃ/zag med ye shesabade chen gyi//rnam rol las byung stong gsum khyon//gang ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//de ring bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen las//byung ba'i mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun//zhi zhing tshe dang bsod nams dang //'khor dang bstan pa rgyas par mdzod//'jig rten gsum na gnas pa yi//zas nor longs spyod thams// dang //dregs ldan skye bo ma lus pa//skad cig

stag zhen/ rgyal 'a sde bzhi/ bka' srung brgyad mchod sog kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma 'danyid la dbang du sdus/ /log par sems pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /phyogs dang mtshams na gnas pa kun/ /rdul phran tsam yang ma lus par/ /skad cig nyid la tshar chod cig /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ khyad par bdag gi bsams don rnams/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces chos rgyal chen po la mchod bstod 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa gong ma chos rgyal chen po'i bka' lung spyi bos mchod de chos smra ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang ra sa 'phrul snang (11na)du sbyar ba'o/ /bde chen chos sku snang ba mtha' yas dpal/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku rta mgrin dbang gi lha/ /grangs med sprul pa'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum dbyer med dngos grub char chen phob/ /gdod nas dag pa gsal stong dbyings kyi ngang / /lhun grub zhi khro rab 'byams 'od lnga'i klong / /gcig lasadu mar snang ba chu zla'i gar/ /rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i mdangs bkrag ltar/ /las bzhi so sor sgrub pa'i thugs gsung sku'i/ /sna tsho gos cho 'phrul stong gi gzi byin dpung / /skyed la sde brgyad tsho gos kun dbang du sdus/ /snang srid dregs pa kun gyi cod pan du/ /mi 'da' rdo rje'i phyag rgya nyer bkod nas/ /bod yul gangs can ljongs 'dir bstan 'gro yi/ /phan bde'i legs tshogis ma lus rab rgyas shing / khyad par rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag gi /chos srid 'dod pa'i re ba skong ba dang / /srung ba rdo rje'i ra bar ga'i rnams kyi/ /bar chad kun zhi mthun pa'i dngos grub spel/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas mi srun pa'i/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa sogs/ /'phrin las thogs med sgrub pa'i gzu dpang mgon/ /dusa'adir mdzod cig pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i dam tshig gnyan po dang / /rnal 'byor gdung ba'i yid kyis 'bod byed na/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcas rnams/ /(11bskosang ba'i pho brang che nas sku bzhengs shig /phul byung bde chen dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / khro chags zhi sogs rnam 'gyur grangs med kyis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong pa'i mthu rtsal can/ /chos rgyal sku 463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lnga 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs//dam can sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas ma ga 'dir//phyi nang gsang mar rten pa'i dam rdzas rnams//chos skyong 'bod pa'i r+sā du bshams lags na//dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur thibs bzhin spyon//rkang gling dung r+pā 'brug gi sgra ltar ldir/sha la spos dkar bsreg cing dmar r+pā sbrengs//dar tshwa sna lngas g.yab na bstan srung khyod//dgun gyi 'thor rma bzhin du las bzhin spyon//snyan 'gyur dbyangs dang sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra//ting 'dzin gsal dang gdung sems drag po yi//dregs pa'i sdod pon gnas 'dir spyan tshon na//tshur spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs//dpal chen khrag 'thung dbang por legs bzhugs nas//bdag gis rgyal po r+ṣa po mchod cing bstod//srung ma khyod kyis bdag gi 'phrin las rnams//sgrub pa'i rdo rje dam las ma 'da' zhig/kha dog sna tshogs rab bkra'i me tog dang //dri bzang bsregs pa'i dud pas nam mkha' gang //me shel mar me'i 'phreng ba tshar du dngar//bzang po'i sman gyi ngad ldan dri chab zha thug/ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin lha mi'i zhal zas spungs//snyan cing brjid pa'i grangs med rol 12na sko 3 tshogs//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcas la//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/khrag gi a: dbang po'i me rtag dang /sha chen dud pa zhun chen mar me spar/sha rus zhal zas rkang gling rol mo'i sgra//mi lpags gcan gzan g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang /khyu ma'i dra ba glo snying yan lag gi/lhu dum lda ldi 'phreng bar spel ba rnams//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcas la//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//cang shes rta mchog dar gyi cod pan can//'brong g.yag ma he rno ba'i rwa wo gdengs//glang seng khyi spyang ra lug 'dod 'jo'i ba spra sbrel khyim bya mon nag a tsa ra//rnga mo bong bu drel sogs bzhene pa'i tshogs//'bag seng glu gar rtsed 'jo mtha' yas pa//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcas la//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//zhwa nag phod ka theb zhu gsag theb dang //za 'og 'jol ber snam sbyar pags pa'i gos//sbrul gyi pa po rin cen rus pa rgyan//sra brtan go khrab rno ba'i mardzo cha'i tshogs//464

stag wo/rgyal ོ dzi bzhi/nya' srung bas ma rdzo sogs kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/nang ma 6)stag sprel bya rgod spyang gi za 'og gi/rgyal mtshan phyogs bcu ma lus zil gnon pa//sprul pa'i chosargyal sku lnga 'khor bcas la//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//rtsa brgyad yan lag stong spyar a skṛ ta//dgra bgegs snying khrag bskyil ba'i rak+ta'i mtsho//sgrub gtor khang bzang rgya phubs tog gis mdzes//mchod gtor sha khrag gsang phyi'i rtags kyis brgyan//gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcas la//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//phyi rten srog 12ba〉zagasadakar po mdzes shing brjid//nang rten smyug rgod rnga ma dar sna brgyan//gsang rten mdos rigs sna tsho gos sku 'bag dang //dregs pa rang bzhin 'du ba'i rdzas kyi mchog/bla rdo srog gi 'khor lo bcasapa sogs/khyud dang man ngag de bzhin legs bshams pa//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcasal//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//ba po shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin cen bdun//lcags ri mu khyud ri rab lhun po dang //gling bzhi gling phran nyi ma zla ba zung //'dod pa'i 'bras ster dpag bsam yongs 'du'i shing //yan lag brgyad ldan mtsho dang rdzing bu sogs//lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod ji snyed pa//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga ga bor bcas la//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//rgyal po sku lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas//ā+oṃ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i rda bha kla ta kha kha khā hi/lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtso bo dang /a k+ṣa ro lan gsum gyis 'khor rnams la dbul/sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar arnya sogs kyis mchod/'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod 'bul/chos dbyings bde ba che las ma g.yos kyang //log 'dren dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral pa'i phyir//srog bdag bshan pa'i gzugs kyis rnam rol ba//sprul pa'i chos rgyal r+ṣa po sku lngar bstod//gdong lnga'i dbang po rab tu dgyes pa'i steng //zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogaXmatshon cha thogs/khro ldan〉khum gar gyi rol

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i mthu stobs can//'phrin las rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod do//mun pa bye bas byugs pa'i lhun po la//nyin byed 'bum gyisahrūd 'dra'i gzi byin can//glang wo zhon nas stong gsum skad cig myul//thugs kyi rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod do//mig sman mdog can srin po khros pa'i gzugs//seng ge zhon nas brnag pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol//grangs med cho 'phrul sna tsho gis ston mdzad pa'i//sku yi rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod do//dpag par dka' ba'i mthu stobs rdzul gyis//chosa'akhor skyong mdzad gnon sbyin shing bya can//sku mdog nag po dgra bo'i bla tshe 'gugs//yon to rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod do//rta gdong me yi phung po ltar dmar zhing //'jigs brgyangs nga ro drag pos sa gsum g.yo//rlung gi shugs 'chang drel rta la zhen pa//gsung gi rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod do//zag med bde ba'i nyams ldan gsang ba'i yum//bka' nyan blon po sprul pa yang sprul dang //ru 'dren sdebazhi dregs pa sdebargyad kyi//'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gis la bstod//chos skyong rgyal po sde lnga 'khor bcas rnams//rigs 'dzin mtsho skyes pad+ma thod phreng gis//dbu rtsa mchims phu shel gyi brag phug tu/khrog gi snying po blangs nas dam la btags//de rjes myang ban nyi ma 'od zer dang //mnga' bdag chos kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa//zab gter brgyud 13ba lnga'i bla ma grangs med kyis//dkyil 'khor zhal phye sngon gyi mtha' tshig bsgrags//pad+ma dbang dang legasaldan rdo rje'i zhabs//bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal po la sogs pa'i//pad+ma'i gdung gsong rig pa 'dzin rnams kyis//dam tshig gnyan po bsgrags pa deng 'dir dgongs//rgyal pa kun dngos dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal//mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams rgya mtsho sde//rigs 'dzin bdag gis mchode bstod gnyer gtad pa'i//dam bca' dgongs la bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs//phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bo'i bstan pa dang //de 'dzin skyes bu khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde//bshad dang sgrub pa'i cho ge ldan bya ba kun//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod//gangs ris skor ba'i bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir//mi nad phyugs nad mu ge maX dmag dang //dus zhabrug mtha' 'dre'i kha rlangs

stag zhon/rgyal ོ dzi bzhi/bka' srung brgyad mchod sog kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/nang ma 6)kun zhi nas//bde skyid dga' ston dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod//blo chen 'jam dpal dpa' bo ngur smig gi/rnam rol skal bzang dpyid gyur grags pa'i sde'i//dri med lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa mchog/srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams rgyas par mdzod//nor 'dzin chos bzhin skyong ba mi yi bdag/gnam bskos gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong gis//dbang sgyur sa spyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang dang //sku tshe chab srid brtan cing 'phel bar mdzod//ngo mtshar sdebazhi dga' ston dang ldan pa'i//phyogs las4na sgom par rgyal ba'i pho brang che'i//bstan srid yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal bo mchog/srid zhi'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'bar gyur cig/mchog thun dngos grub phan dang bde ba'i dpyid//nges gsang legs par bshad pa 'dus pa'i gling //lugs zung rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon che//srid pa'i rtse mor bar du bsgreng bar mdzod//rgyal ba'i bstan bshig dkon cog dbu 'phang smad//bla ma'i sku dgra sems can bde skyid 'joms//rnal 'byor sgos su 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs rnams//mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar chad cig/khyad par za rig sngags lang bar gcag la zhes ra/hor sngags 'chang bdag cag la//snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra yid la sems//da dgra gnod byed dug mtshon dmag ga sgoms byed//phrag dog mtho gnon legs bsub nyes pa sgrog/rang nus ma thon gzhan dag khyi ltar rbad//dngos dang brgyud nas 'tsho ba'i dam nyams dgra/yid la brnag cing bsgral pa'i zhing gyur pa//steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar 'dug kyang /kha rje dbang thang stobs dang gzi brdzid choms//lo slar ma 'jog bla srog tshe gsum khug/don snying dmar po zhal du bstab nas kyang //rjes med rlung la skur zhig rtsal ma zhan//skyabs 'os srung ba'i 'khor lor bcug rnams kyi//bar chad nyer 'tshe'i tsho gos kun rab zhi zhing //tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor legasatshogs kun//'phel zhing rgyas pa'i stong grogs mtha' dag mdzod//4ba〉kun mkhyen 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa mchog/thos sgom lar rtsod rtsom pas 'dzin pa sogs//kha byung rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kun//bsams pa ji bzhin // gyis grub par mdzod//tshe ring nad med legs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonapa'i yon tan spel//srid gsum zil gnon khams gsum dbang du sdus//phun tsho gis 'dod pa'i don gyi re ba rnams//'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//mdor na 'dod 'jo'i ba dang bum pa bzang //dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor bu ltar//dgos 'dod stsol ba'i chosaskyong chen po yis//dgra lha mdzod la bkra shis dge legs stsol//zhes sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po la mchod gtor 'bul tshul dngos grub char 'bebs 'di'ang gnas chung pe har lcog tu mdos btsugs skabs chos skyong chen pos 'di ltar gyis zhes bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rgya mtsho'o//sa lug hor zla drug pa'i nang du chos skyong chen pos bskul ma byung ba ltar brtsams pa nas rgyal btsan gnyis khol du phyung ba/:'jig rten mchod bstod dkyil 'khor gru 'dzin pa//dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i nang tshan nas//pe har rgyal bo sku lnga gsang yum dang //blon po 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho da tshur spyon/khyad par dgra lha skyes gcig gsung gi rgyal//blon po rdo rje grags ldan mthu rtsal can//sku lnga'i rnam rol gcig tu ma nges par//ston mdzad sprul pa'i chos rgyal 15na nas 'dir gshegs/khrag gi sgo nga bdun las nyer brdol ba'i//btsan rgod dmag dpon 'bar ba spun bdun dang /khyad par tse'u dmar bo yang le ber//pho nya mngag gzhug 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon//dmar chen gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la bsnyeg/khrag chang btung ba rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul byed na//rol zhig kha raṃ khā hi zhal du dbul//pad+ma thod phreng so zur gnubs myang sogs//sngags 'chang rnams kyis khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du//dbang bskur dam tshig gnyan po nyer phab nas//thub bstan skyong ba'i srung mar ma bskos sam//ma g.yel ma g.yel sngon gyi tha tshig dgongs//gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig rgya ma dral//rdo rje'i ri mo spyi bo'i gtsug ma yal//lce la bdud rtsi'i ro mchog ma nyams pas//bshad sgrub bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas//bstan 'dzin skyes bu bla mchod sde gnyis spel//gangaX /ngas yul 'dir 'thab rtsod mu ge nad//dus kyi

stag zhon/ rgyal chen ldebazhi/ bka' srung brgyad mchod sogs kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma 'da'akhrug pa ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /dga' ba'i dpal ldan sdebazhi'i pho brang che'i/ /chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i mnga' thang dar/ /chab srid brtan cing dbu chog btsun pa sogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /'dir mkha' 'gro'i brda yig zhig 'dug kyang 'god thabs med rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod/paṇa — sku 4ri kyig khog yi lhad med/gyi pad+ma tsan+ta ma hā kro dha ha ya lji ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa:mchod gter legs par bshams la byin gyis brlakhas(15bti/ rol pa skya bdun gyi las byang ni /dregs par brgyud pa yin pas bskyed mi dgos la/ bdag nyid rta mgrin dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i yi ge las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu spros te/ so so'i gnas nas spyan drang ba ni spos dang phye mar bsreg cing : dar dmar pos g.yabs la gdung ba'i nga ros 'bod pa ni: kye/phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na btsan yul zangs thang dmar po na pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pa che btsan rol pa skya bdun ni: phal cher sku mdog dmar po la phyag na ba dan zhags pa bsnams sdo brgyad dregs pa'i tsho gos dang bcas tshur spyon tshur spyon gnasa'adir spyon shu la hrī'i dz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ bh+yo/ btsan mkhar dmar po'i nang shed na: sha khrag longs spyod bsam mi khyab: yid 'ong spyan gzigs kun nas mdzes dam tshig gtsang ma'i gdan la bzhugs:sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: kye/ skyes bu rol ba skya bdun ni: 'phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyab pad+ma dbang gis bka' stsal pa'i dam tshig gnyer bdag khyod la bstod gtsang ma'i sku khrus 'di 'bul lo:bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la: thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mdzod: a bi shurnye swā lha gtsang ma'i bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs: me rtag snang gsal dri mchog dang : zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mdzod sgru pe/ pudhi paṃ/ — / ni bi bye/ sha lta pā tsa lho kye/(16na jis bu srog gi bdag po ni 'jigs byed rol ba sdebadun tshogs khyed la dgyes pa'i longs spyod ni sha khrag dmar gtor ri ltar spungs zag med bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil rak+ta'i yon chab rdzing ltar gtams spyan gzigs longs spyod skar ltar bkram: rnga gling rol mo 'brug ltar —469—

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sgrog glu dbyangs snyan pa'i tsho gos dang bcas dam can mched bdun thugs dam bskang :btsan 'khor 'bar ba'i//sde brgyad bsdongs zla'i //dkor srung dam can//las bzhi pho lha'i//hūṃ bse mkhar dmar po ldems se ldem dar dmar ru mar pur ru phub dan dmar po yengs rtse yeng :dregs pa mda' 'phen sgrengs se sgreng :las byed bshan pa rol lo lo bshug pa'i 'bod sgra dir ri ri bh+yo/che btsan bdag po'i thugs dam bskang :slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga phu thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la khri srong lde bas rje rigs dang :rnal 'byor dam ldan brgyud par bcas dam tshig gcig tu skyong ba dang :sku la bsdoba'i rigs brgyud chod:log lta'i sdodapung cham la phob sngags 'chang rdo rje'i dam ma dral:bcol lo gnyer ro mas rtsal skyed yal yol 'drid skor ma mdzad cig ngo bsrung zas phyir ma 'breng mdzod thugs dang 'gal ba skongs gyur la bu sdug tsha bo bzhin du skyongs:zhes phud gtsang phyogs bcur gtor zhing bskul lo brag btsan 6bsgo ched bdun gyi gsol ba'i las byang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis mdzad pa rje'i sku lhar bsngags pa'o su mya sbu rgya rgya tsopad+ma dbang chen gyi bka' srung ngo:kha the badz+ra si po che tso r+sāng rtse' phyag ba tshes ga rtsa lha med rtsegs/swā skyo sa mā dzaḥlan gsum/rdo rje legs pa dgra la bh+yo//dam can rdo rje legs pa khyod//sku la nges pa ma ma mis so//sku yi sprul pa cir yang ston//chibs la nges pa ma mchis so//seng ge dred dang ra skyes mibs//zhal nas gdug pa'i ngan sngags sgrog/phyag na gser gyi rdo rje gsor//nam mkha' yangs pa'i khams shed na//'brug sgra drag po 'ur ru sa/bar snang yangs pa'i khams shed na//glog dmar de ni khyugs rtse khyug/sa gzhi langs pa'i khams shed na//thog dang ser ba shar ra ra//mthing gi khu 'phang sil li li//sgrub khang gnyan gyi nang shed na//rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khyil li li//gsang ba'i bshug klu kyur ru sa bso sgra wo po 'ur ru sa/de na dam can wo po bzhugs//mngag pa'i pho nya khyod yin no//'gugs pa'i lcags kyu khyod yin no//'ching ba'i zhags pa khyod yin no//gsod pa'i mtshon cha khyod yin no/zhol 40

stag zhon/ rgyal wo dzi bzhi/ bka' srung brgyad mchod sogs kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtore ma/ nang ma 9)'byor bdag gis khyod bsten no/ /sngags kyi srung ma gshegs su gsol/ /mthun pa'i grogs po gshegs su gsol/ /'gro ba kun bzang gshegs su gsol/ /bdud kyi dmag dpon gsheg su gsol/ /'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ khyod kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni/ khrog (17na)med dbugs kyis thugs dam bskang / /dbugs med srog gis thugs dam bskang / /dgra bo'i rnam par shes pas bskang / /dzam bu ti bas thugs dam bskang / sha khrag gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /zhal zas tshogis kyis thugs dam bskang / /rak+ta'i rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang / khri zhim sposakyis thugs dam bskang / /gsal byed mar mes thugs dam bskang / /chang dang snying gis thugs dam bskang / /rnga dang dbyangs kyis thugs dam bskang / /gar dang rol mos thugs dam bskang / /bi waṃ gling bu ḍā ma sa /snyan pa sgra yis thugs dam bskang / /tsho gos 'khor rgya chen thugs dam bskang / /mchod gtor spyan gzigs 'di bzhes la/ /bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / /dge 'dun sde rnamasaskyong ba dang / /rkyen ga bar gcod bzlog pa dang / /mthun rkyen bsgrub cing dngos grub stsol/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags/ lasaskyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig ba dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bas thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra swā dhu sa pa ri wā ra i dam baṃ li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/sngags mthar a: nas shasta'i bar gyis mchode/ 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod dbul/ /dam can mgar ba'i mtshan can nag po khyod/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu skra dmar ser 'khyil/ /g.yas kyi phyag na khro chu'i tho ba thogs/ /g.yon gyi phyag na (17bsgo gar ba'i rbud pa bsnams/ /ra la chibasashing sku la ber nag gsol/ /spyan rtsa dmar zhing ljags ni glog ltar 'byug /dam nyams dgra bo khyur mid byed mdzad pa/ /zhal nas rkan sgra drag po bsngags pa yis/ /log par lta pa'i bgegs rnamasa'adar du 'jug /srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad kun/ /zil gyis gnon cing dbang du sdud mdzad pa/ /dam can mgar ba nag po khyod la bstod/ /dam can khyod kyi thugs dang ci 'gal—471—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ba//ma rig dbang gis nyes ba byung ba rnams//rab tu 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags//nyes pa thams cad bzod par bzhes su gsol//bdag gis bstod cing bshags pa'i bsod namasakyis//bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus zhi ba dang //bsam pa 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol//zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi las byang gnam lcags spu gri gsar sgrigs nas khol du phyung ba ni/hūṃ/kun tu bzang po rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung //gter ston rin cen tshul rdor la sogs pa//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can//zhing skyong 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i tshe//'phags yul rdo rje gdan nas //gsang sngags theg pa'i bka' srung mdzad pa'i tshe//skyon gsal ba'i gnas nas //dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad pa'i tshe//nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul 1ni skos //lha srin sdebargyad dmag sna tshon pa'i tshe//dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas //grangs med sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i tshe//te rtsegangs kyi ri nas//ma sring bstan ma'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i tshe//la phyi sgrub pa'i gnasanas //rigs 'dzin dgra lha chen po mdzad pa'i tshe//gnas mchog tsa ri tra nas/dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i tshe//rngam pa sgra sgrog che nas//zab mo gter gyi srung ma mdzad pa'i tshe//zil r+ṣa gsang ba'i phug nas/tshur spyon tso spyon seng gdong yab dang yum//bam ro pho mo dregs pa sdebargyad tshogs//grangs med 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams//dam las ma 'da' thogs mad da tshur spyon//ā+oṃ ma hā kā la sidha mu kha hūṃ phaṭa tri stsi dzaXḍa zhi ni lhan ra ma hūṃ phaṭa tri hring dzaḥs pa ri ༷'awā ra e bye hi badz+ra sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ&/'jigs rung dur khrod wo po'i dbus//pad nyi dgra bgegasagadan steng du//bdud mgon yab yum 'khor bcas rnams//dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol//sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/hūṃ/mas stobs rdo 'phrul bsam mi khyab//bdud mgon nag po seng ge'i gdong //yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la/4/'phrin las bsgrub phyir phyag 'tshal bstod//a ti

stag zhen/ rgyal wo ldebazhi/ bka' srung brgyad mchod sogs kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma (pepu lho bra ti ts+tsha 〉 srung ma 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tsho gos kun/ /dngosabashams yid kyis sprul nas 'bul/ /bzhes nas bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /(14〉snyi ma hā kā la sidha mu kha si na ra ma tri hri ya ma rā dza du tri phu tri sa pa ri wā ra a nas/ sha rdi'i bar brjod/dmar chen gtor ma'i ri ltar spungs/ sman phud rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil/ /dmar chen khrag gi ji sbreng / /dam can 'khor bcas bzhes su gsol/ /gong gi sngags gsham du i rda bha kla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā me sa go ro tsa na tsit+ta bha su ta ke : rta kha raṃ khā hi/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ hūṃ/ bskal ba dus mtha'i me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i rta mchog steng / /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams kyis rnam rol ba'i/ /zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can khyod la bstod/ /mdog dmar mi sdug srin mo khros pa'i gzugs/ /dgra bo'i don snying bzung nasakhrag rgyun 'thung / /rlung gi shugs ldan btsan rta dmar po chibs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod la bstod/ /mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ /rbad na dgra bgegs bdun brgyud rtsad nasagacod/ /las kun thogs med sgrub pa'i mthu rtsal can/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams la bstod/ /chos dbyings bde ba che las ma g.yos kyang / /mi srun bshan pa bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong / /yab yum gnyis kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ ga khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dam nyams dgra /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar 'dug kyang/ /tshe srog stobs wor mnga' thang kha rje choms/ /lo zlar ma 'jog snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /(19na〉dog ser dri ga spyi bo tshugs su 'gro/ /bya sder sar btsugs rkang pas dmar gtor 'phen/ /bam chen pho mo'i thugs dam dus la bab/ sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ r+sāl 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dam nyams dgra /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar 'dug kyang / /tshe srog stobs wor mnga' thang kha rje choms/ /lo slar ma 'jog snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /'jigasapa'i gzugs can sna tshogs mtshone cha thogs/ /stong gsum myul zhing dgra bo'i bla tshe brku/ /'khor —473—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tsho gos rgya mtsho'i thugs dam dus la bab/sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dam nyams dgra/steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar 'dug kyang //tshe srog stobs 'byor mnga' thang kha rje choms//lo zlar ma 'jog snying khrag zhal du gsol//bh+yo/rigs rgya zhang khrom gyi gter byon lcags 'dra pad lugs su gtogs/'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //gnubs chen rdo rje yang wang gi/dam laganas pa'i dad shugs 'amang //gsang ba snying 'dzingasagater bdag rnams//sgrub pa'i stong grogs bgyid pa dang //rang nyid mchod pa bzhes slad du//gnas 'dir dad pas spyan 'dren gyi//dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol//badz+ra ku sha dzaḥdzaḥgator ma su bhā was stong par sbyangs//stong pa'i ngang las ra las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho r+ṣa por gyur/ā+oṃ 〉〉/lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/na ma a rba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥzhes so gos kyis phul/'dod don gsol/sgrub pa po'i snying mi dga' ba'am//tshig pa za ba'am/khro snying 'dod pa'am/shes pa mi bde ba la sogs byung na/gter srung gi skyon yin pas/chos skyong la gtad rgya bkrol te sngon du zil gnon gyi gtor ma bsngo'o/gter bdag mchod pa ni/19bsgo ṇ+ḍal gru gsum nag po'i khar/gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa bzhag la/de la drag po'i sngags kyis lha tsho gos la phul/gsol ba btab/g.yas su rdo rje rgya gram dkar po'i steng du gtor ma dkar po la ra dkar mo'i 'o ma blug/chab klu sman dang bcas pa blug/de klu bdud rdo rje spyan gcig dang rtse lha mthu bo che la phul/g.yon du rdo rje rgya gram dmar po'i steng du gtor ma dmar po zhig bzhag go/de lha sa'i bdud bas dang /dzolhud mo'i gter bdag dang /yer pa'i rdzong bdag la bsngo'o//sgrub pa po'i rmi lam zhabrug pa dang /dgra bo sgrol na bya'o//bdag nyid thod bcings/zhu ba pos phyag btsal/yon phul/rnga brdung zhing spos dud bto la 'di skad do//bh+yo/'gyur ba med pa chos kyi dbyings//chos sku 'gyur ba med pa las//longs sku ya mān+ta /byung //longs sku ya sdu/ ka las//sprul sku tshe bdag nag po byung //ston

rtog zhon/rgyal ོ sde bzhi/ bka' srung brgyad mar sogs kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma 6)pa'i sku gsung thugs la bab/ /bh+yo/ g.yung phu'i rtse lha mthu bo che/ /chibs su rta dkar phrum dmar chibs/ /sku la dar dkar slog pa gsol/ /dbu la dar dkar 'gying thod bcings/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon/ /phyag na dar dkar mdung ring bsnams/ khyu thums snying gzer dgra la ā/ /dgra bo'i yul du dmag drongs shig /bh+yo/ yer pa'i rdzong bdag mas bo che/ /chibs su zhur dmar mdongs po chibs/ /sku la dar dmar ber chen gsol/ /dbu la dar gyi 'gying thod bcings/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon/ /dar dmar ru mtshon gnam du 'phyar/ /btsan gyi zhagasapa klad la bskor/ /dam nyams dgra la btsan zhags (20na〉sbob/ /gri 'thab pho gzer dgra la phog /bh+yo/ lha sa'i bdud btsan mthu bo che/ /chibs su bra nag rting dkar chibs/ /sku la ber nag sum brtsegs gso me/ /dbu la thod nag 'dom gsum bcings/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shubasagayon/ /phyag na dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar/ /bdud zhags nag po mda' ltar 'phen/ /'thibs nad nag bo dgra lam/ /bh+yo/ klu bdud rdo rje spyan gcig ma/ /chibs su rus sbal dkar khra chibs/ /sku la sdig pa'i g.yang gzhi gsol/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ /sram gyi rgyal mtshan gnam du 'phyar/ /sbrul nag zhags pa klad la bskor/ /klu nad mdze shu dgra la yā/ /zhes bskul lo/ /gtor ma phul/ de nas zhu ba po la lag gtor byas la/ chos lag tu gtad/ de ltar byas na bkra shis byin che/de ltar ma byas na slob dpon mdzes khyer/ slob ma spyo 'ong ngo / /'di'i sgrub lugs gtad rgya lo rgyusazur du gsal lo/ /gnubs bu chus g.yas ru rdza lhud mo'i mkha' 'gro ma gros 'debs sa ru sbasaso/ /de bla ma zhad khrom gyis brtane/ dregs pa can bzhi po 'dis/ /bla ma'i las ka bya yi gsungs/ /chos skyong du song nas gtore ma re gud du dgos so gsung / snying 'dzings dang / stag zhen snying gcig ma'i gtad rgya 'grol ba'i gdams pa/ spu ngan bdag gis phyi rabs gang zag don du gter dang phyogs gcig tu sbas so/ 'di las lhag pa yod na na ra spun/ ithi/ rgya rgya rgya/ zab rgya/ gter bdag mchod pa gal che bas dbang sgrub dus su nges par bya'o/ ma byas na 'khu ldog yong bar grags shing —475

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemangon no/ /gsar bris/ phur srung mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ dpal chen (20ba thar bu sgrub pa'i srung ma mchog /dkar mo nyi zla stong gi 'phreng ba can/ /g.yas pa ri rab 'phen cing g.yon pa yis/ /gling bzhin bh+yo bzlog rab byed nyi zla brgyas/ /dbur brgyan dgu brgyas do shal rin cen dang / /stag lpags sprul chun dar dkar na bza' can/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum khro mo'i nyams ldan pa/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /bdud kyi rgyal po thod 'phreng mun pa'i mdog /g.yas pa ba dan g.yon pa mgo 'phreng 'dzin/ /dar nag gos rgya ne bdud rta nag bo chibs/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rigs 'dzin slob dpon chen po'i spyan snga sa /phur bu'i srung mar khas blangs mthu rtsal can/ yā nag mched bzhi re ma mched bzhi dang / /brtsemo mched bzhi skyes bu sgrol ba'i ging / /sde bzhin bcas sogs phur bu'i srung ma'i tshogs/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /dkar bdud srung ma bcu drug spyan lam du/ /dmar chen sha rus gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa mtsho ltar bskyil/ /rak+ta khrag gi arnya rba klong 'khrug /dbang po'i me tog sha chen dud pa dang / /zhun chen mar me sha rus zhal zasatshogs/ /rkang gling snyan pa'i rol mor bcas pa 'bul/ /mthun pa'i dam dzos 'di rnams rab bzhesal/ /rigs 'dzin bdag cag bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang / /las sbyor bskyed rim phyag rgya gar 'chams sogs/ /srid pa phur bu sgrub par byed pa la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /gsar bri gag ni bdag gtor ma ni/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las (21nad+kung ba'i gtor ma rang rang gi dbang po rnams tshim par byed nus pa'i 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ u3/ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ sa gzhi yul grong la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad badz+ra sa mā —476

stag zhen/ rgyal 'a ldebazhi/ bka' srung brgyad mar sogs kyi gsol mchod dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ nang ma rtogedzal spyan drangs par bsams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rmā 'o ā ju nu khru sno tā ta oṃ skya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ oṃ a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid sa'i lha mo bstan ma/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa gnas bdag /gzhi bdag /grong bdag /yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang / ma ltar byams shing sring ltar nye ba rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs 'a rgyas kya bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / gnas mgron gyi dam tshig srungs/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pasabya ba dang spyod pa nyes pa la ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las gto me grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ na maḥ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bden stobs brjod/ sarba ma sgo lo/—477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog sgrigs mi mthun smag rum sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos bzhugs/sngon 'das bskal ba grangs med dus nas kyang //lo byung don gnyis lhun grub 'dzam gling na//zla bral rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor sgyur che//slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas rtag tu skyongs//de'ang thems yig las/sand gnyan nad 'joms pa'i phyir//nad bdag stobs 'jomasaman ngag yod//ces pa ltar rdzas yo byad rnams phun sum tsho gos pa gzhung dang bla ma dam pa'i zhal shes bzhin bsham zhing rang lha'i rnal 'byor tshogs mchod yon dang sngon 'gro bsangs khrus sogs song nas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/hūṃ/sngon gyi bskal ba dang po la slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bka' dang dam la btags pa yis 'dzam gling bod kyi lha 'dre rnamachos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyan:kha rag gsang ba'i lha brag sa bstan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags gtsang gi kha rag g.yag mig sa 'brog mo thams cad dam la btags bsam yas dbu rtse'i rigs gsum du rgyal po thams cad dam la btags khams kyi gla ba rkang gcig sa the brang thams cad dam la btags na skos kyi la thog brag dmar du dri za pho mo dam la btags byang gi gnam mtsho phyug mo phu pho rgyud thams cad dam la btags na mar rgod gong lha btsan du 'brog mo thams cad dam la btags mal do bkung gi rgya tshal du klu rigs thams cad dam la btags rang dod lung pa nag po phu srin po pho mo dam la btags:gu ru yar la gshegs pa'i tshe mang yul bye ma'i la thog sa lha srin sdo brgyad dam la btagag ya' dang gangs kyi rtse mo phu sman btsun thams cad dam la btags pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga phu bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyis rang rtags srog gi snying po phul mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa dang :༷/na gnas chos 'khor skyong ba dang :gtsug lag

nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog sgrigs mi mas smag yum sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ nang ma (peganyen po bsrung ba dang :dal yams thams cad bzlog pa dang :bod khams skyob pa'i grogs bye da par khas blangs dam bca' ma byas sam de phyir bka' las ma 'da' bar sngon gyi dam tshig dran par gyis khyod kyi srog snying nga la yod 'du 'du lha srin dam la 'du:2ba tshe/ nu 4 4 las la rlu:gser skyems bshos bzang gtsang ma 'di bod kyi gzhi bdag thams cad dang :'go ba'i lha lnga mchod phyir 'bul sa phyogs 'di yi gzhi bdag rnams khyod kyi mthu rtsal dbyung dgos nusam cu ldan pa'i gzhi bdag rnams rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs mdzod la sa phyogs 'di yi nad rims bzlog dmag dpung dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog ltas ngan bra ngan thams cad bzlog:bdud dang dam sri 'gong po bzlog nus mthu chung ba'i lha 'dre rnams rang rang bsam pa bzang po yis khyed rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs srung :nga yi bka' la mi nyan par log par 'khu ba'i lha 'dre rnams rdo rje khrag 'thung khros pa yis sdang mig gzigs pas brlag par 'gyur snyi hūṃ hūṃ/badz+rakrota hūṃ/sam ya/ma ma ru lu/: ba ang :ru dra dha mun yu thun shu la dzaḥr tsa tsa/yak+ṣa k+ṣa/gh+ri badz+ra/rag sha ra/badz+ra sa du hri/hi she/tri/sa nā ga phu/sa ma ya/a mṛ ta na ra skan /hūṃ/stong ye shes kyi ma mo mgo po la ga' ma dang gsar skyem nyam/gsum stong gi gzhal yas nas dam tshig dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas dbang chen rta mchog yab yum la mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bus gyis bskor gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol stong gsum stong gi shar phyogs nas be+eḍūr dag ba'i gzhal yasanas rdo rje mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:stong gsum stong gi lho phyogs nas rin cen gser 3na ) gyi gzhal yasanas rin cen mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:stong gsum stong gi nub phyogs nas pad+ma rā ga'i gzhal yas nas pad+ma mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol stong gsum stong gi byang phyogs nas:in+d+ra nī la'i gzhal yas nas las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol /༷ gsum stong gi mkha' spyod nas stug po bkod

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i gzhal yas nas:sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol stong gsum stong gi zhing khams nas blo yi bkod pa'i gzhal yas nas:snang ba ye shes bye ba 'bum gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:stong gsum phyogs pa'i gzhal yas nas:mtshams kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas nas dur khrod mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gnasa'adir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:'jig rten dur khrod gling dgu nas:bam wo gsar rnying gzhal yas nas sha za mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ma sring tshul bzung dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma:dngos grub ster ba'i 'dre yi mkha' 'gro ma snying gi grogasamadzad ye shes mkha' 'gro ma gnas 'dir spyan 'dren 3ba〉shegs su gsol ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes:bstan srung ma mo'i tsho gos bcas rnams gnasa'adir spyan 'dren 'gas su gsol:ye ka dzā smi ha ri ni sa/e gye hi dzaḥsnyi baṃ sngos ma dzaḥdzaḥ//dung mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng :ma chags pad+ma'i gdan steng du:zhing chen pho mo bsnol pa'i steng :sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sku bzhugs 'tshal:mthing nag 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng :ma chags pad+ma'i gdan steng du:zhing wo pho mo bsnol ba'i steng :rdo rje mkha' 'gro bzhugs su 'tshal:gser mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng :ma chags pad+ma'i gdan steng du:zhing r+ṣa pho mo bsnol ba'i steng :rin cen mkha' 'gro bzhugs su gsol:dmar gsal 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng :ma chags pad+ma'i gdan steng du zhing wo pho mo bsnol ba'i steng :pad+ma mkha' 'gro bzhugs su 'tshal:ljang gsal 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng :ma chags pad+ma'i gdan steng du:zhing chen pho mo bsnol ba'i steng :las kyi mkha' 'gro bzhugs su 'tshal:ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang :srid pa mo brgyud lha tsho gos dang :chos skyong las byed sdebargyad rnams pad+ma zhing chen gdan la bzhugs/e ka dzā smi ha ri ni sa/pad+ma ka ma la ye ste:bh+yo ma g.yeX ༷ g.yel dam can rnams ma 'da' ma 'da' dam

nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog sgrigs mi mthun smag dras sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ nang ma (getshig can: e las bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya ma chung : seng ge glang chen khri brtsegs brjid ma zhan:nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan brtsegs (4na)dpangs ma dma': zho las bskyed pa'i sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol: ྅ las bskyed pa'i mkha' 'gro mthu rtsal can: ma dang bh+yo las bskyed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma la 'du: ya las bskyed pa'i gshin rje dmag dpung bskyed: dza hri las bskyed gnod sbyin 'phrin las kyis yi dam rgyal ba bsgrubs kyang rgyang ma ring : dam can pho mo 'gran gyi mthu ma chung : bh+yo dam can dam la mi gnas ci la gnas: srid pa rlung la mi brten ci la brten: dam la gnas pa'i dam can dgra la bh+yo bdud kyi lto bsgyur mtshon cha 'bar bas bsgyur: khro rgyal gcig dbus thams cad zhi gyur te: cho mes shig choms shig khro rgyal tshogs kyis choms shig cig shig cig khro rgyal tshogs kyisashig bdag ni gzhen te so dkar yan chad nas: rgan pa'i lus po so dmar man chad myi g.ya' ri gangs ri mang po 'grims 'grims nas dben pa'i brag phug mang po 'grims 'grims nas:gnyen mdun spangs nas dam can khyed bsgrubs so: ma g.yel ma g.yel dam la 'du: ma mo nag mo'i tshogs ni mun ltar gtibs mun ltar gtibs kyin da tshur spyon: ma mo smug mo'i tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs sprin ltar gtibs kyin da tshur spyon: ma mo dmar mo'i tshogs ni me ltar 'bar me ltar 'bar kyin da tshur spyon: ma mo ser mo'i tshogs ni ser ltar 'dril: ser ltar 'dril gyin da tshur spyon:ma mo ljang khu'i tshogs ni char ltar 'bab: char ltar 'bab gyin da tshur spyon gnod sbyin ging pho'i tshogs(4ba ji ser ltar 'dril: ser ltar 'dril gyin da tshur spyon: lus srog 'bem du btsugs nas dam can khyed bsgrubs so: sa gang gdan du bting nas dam can khyed bsgrubs so: brag phug zhwa ru gyon nas dam can khyed bsgrubs so: rus pa phur ltar btsugs nas dam can khyed bsgrubs so:zas su sha chan za yin dam can khyed bsgrubs so: sgom du rak+ta btung gin dam can khyed bsgrubs so:gtor ma ri ltar spangs nas dam can khyed bsgrubs so: rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil nas dam can khyed bsgrubs so dga' ba nyams su blangs nas dam can khyed bsgrubs so: mchil ma thul thul ma gcig —481 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonabu 'bod na:phyag gang tsam gyis gting ma ring :khru gang tsam gyis dbangs ma mtho:mda' gang tsam gyis gong ma g.yel:rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgongs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod:྅/stong gsum snang gsal me tog dang :'dzin med dri yis gdug spos dang :gsal stong 'dzin med mar me dang :ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul:snang srid tshogs drug gzhal yas su du ma ro gcig mchod par bshams:chags zhen med pa'i mchod pa 'di ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul:bde stong gnyisamed nyams snang du:'khor 'das dbyer med mchod par bshams stong gsal 'dzin med nyams snang 'di:ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul dug lnga rang grol sgyu lus la:'dzin rtog med pa'i chos dbyings sgrol srid gsum sha khrag mchod par bshams:ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams ldan 'a 'bul:rang shar rang grol blos bkod pa'i 'dzin chags med par mchod par 'bul gsal mdangs chos sku ka dag 'di:ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul:྅/mo sa ri ltar spungs pa 'di ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul:rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil ba 'di ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul skru rus gram ltar bkram pa 'di ma mo chen mo brgyad la 'bul sha khrag gtor ma bshams pa 'di:dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad la 'bul:tshil chen mar me bshams pa 'di mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis la 'bul:gtor ma glud gtor bcas pa 'di shwa na chen mo bzhi la 'bul:ngar glud mar me gtor mar bshams:gos lha chen mo bzhi la 'bul:mdos glud gtor ma bshams pa 'di:re ti ma mo bzhi la 'bul:gtor ma ngar glud mar me zor:sgo ma chen mo bzhi la 'bul ma mo mkha' 'gro mnyes gyur cig de nas glud rabs bya ba ni:྅/sngon ni su dang su yi glud:a shwa ka yi rgyal po'i glud mtshams med sdig pa'i las byas pas ma mo lha srin sdebargyad khros mu ge dus 'khrug yams nad byung :slob dpon ro langs bde ba rdo rje yis sku glud dmar gtor bshams nas ni:snang srid mkha' 'gro'i phyag tu 'bul bsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul:phyogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:'chi mi phod kyi glud du la/la bar du su dang su yi glud rgyal po khri srong lde

nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog sgrigs mi mthun smag rus sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ nang ma 'dabatsan la:ma mo khros pa'i ltas5ba'i nga nas mi dge mi rung sna tshogs byung :slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgyal po'i sku yi tshad du byas:sku glud dmar gtor bshams nas ni:snang srid ma mo'i phyag tu 'bul bsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul:phrogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul:na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul tha ma su dang su yi glud sngar sbyi 'das na bdag rnamasakyi glud:ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs ltas byung :mu ge dus 'khrugs yams nad byung :rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang gong ma yis:sku glud dar zab yungs kyis brgyan dpal gyi gtor ma dmar gyisabargyan:snang srid ma mo'i phyag tu 'bul:bsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul:phrogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul:na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:da lta su dang su yi glud:da lta 'dir 'dus sbyin bdag glud:dril zan ngar mi longs spyod dang :'dod yon dpag med 'di bshams nas snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu 'bul:bsad pa lus glud du 'bul:phyogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul:na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:snang srid lha srin sdobargyad dang :srid par gnas pa'i lha 'dre la:sku glud dmar gtor rgyan dang ldan:snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu 'bul bsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul phrogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul:na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul 'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:de ring su dang su yi glud:rgyu sbyor 6na ji na bdag rnamasakyi glud mtshams med sdig pa'i las byas pas dkar phyogs lha srin thugs khros nas:ri rab nang du zhal gzigs pas nag phyogs lha srin phyi la don:de yi kha rlangs ma rungs pas:mu ge dusazhabrugs na da yams byung :rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag nyid kyi:snang srid ma mo'i tshogs rnamasadang :sde brgyad lha 'dre'i tshogs rnams la:sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'bul bsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul phyogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul snang srid ma mo'i tshogs rnams dang :dregs pa lha 'dre'i tshogs rnams la:zas sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'bul:khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan /mas 'dod sred chags pas ma zhen cig gsad
