brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'bul khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams:'dod sred chags pas ma chen cig:gsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul:phyogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:snang srid ma mo'i tshogs rnams dang :dregs pa lha 'dre'i tsho gos rnams la:chan sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'bul:khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams 'dod sred chags pas ma chen cig gsad pa lusakyi glud du 'bul phyogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul:na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul 'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul snang srid ma mo'i tshogs rnams dang :dregs pa lha 'dre'i tsho gis rnams la gos sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'bul khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams 'dod sred chags pas ma zhen cig:gsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul 7 na ) phyogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul 'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul snang srid ma mo'i //sa rnams dang :dregs pa lha 'dre'i tsho gos rnams

nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog sgrigs mi mas smag tso sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ nang ma rtogel dar gos brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'bul khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams 'dod sred chagasapas ma zhen cig gsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul:phyogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:snang srid ma mo'i tsho gos rnams dang :dregs pa lha 'dre'i tshogs rnams la:gser g.yu la sogs rin cen lnga dpag med brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'bul khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams 'dod sred chags pas ma zhen cig bsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul phyogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul cha mi phod kyi glud du 'bul snang srid ma mo'i tsho gos rnams dang :dregs pa lha 'dre'i tsho gis rnams la:sman sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'bul khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams:'dod sred chags pas ma zhen cig:bsad pa lusakyi glud du 'bul:phrogs pa nor gyi glud du 'bul na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul snang srid ma mo'i tshogs rnams dang :dregs pa lha 'dre'i tsho gos rnams la:glud yas brgyadang rtsa brgyad 'bul khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams 'dod sred chags pas ma zhen cig bsad pa lus kyi glud du 'bul phrogs pa skyabaskor gyi glud du 'bul na mi phod kyi glud du 'bul 'chi mi phod kyi glud du 'bul:snang srid ma mo'i tsho gis rnams dang :dregs pa lha 'dre'i tsho gis rnamasal bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil bar:sha dang rus pa'i glud du 'bul khrag dang chu ser glud du 'bul skra dang ba spu'i glud du 'bul pags pa yan lag glud du 'bul:glo snying mawo pa'i glud du 'bul mkhal ma mchin pa'i glud du 'bul:rgyu ma nang rol glud du 'bul don snying sna lnga'i glud du 'bul lhu wo bcu drug glud du 'bul phyugs dang sgo khyi'i glud du 'bul khang khyim gzhis kyi glud du 'bul gnyen dang bsod nams glud du 'bul dbang po tshogs drug glud du 'bul rnam shes tsho gos brgyad glud du 'bul glud 'di bzhes la gnas su dengs mkha' 'gro gtor mas mnyes gyur cig lha 'dre glud kyi mnyes gyur cig lan chags bu lon khor gyur cig rigs drug lan chags kho/ /ra cig phyi'i bzlog bzlog 〉/mkha' 'gro sde

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lnga khros pa yis dus gzug langs pa'i ltas ga bzlog ma mo bstan ma khros pa yis yams nad blangs pa'i ltas ga bzlog gnod sbyin nor bdag khros pa yis lo nyes mu ge byung ba bzlog ma gshin phur gsum khros pa yis phur kha zug pa'i ltas ga bzlog lha srin sdebargyad khros pa yis ltas8na〉ston sna tshogs langs pa bzlog //'ag rten srid pa'i nad bdag la bsngo ba/bh+yo sngon gyi bskal ba dang po la bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga sa dus mtha'i smon lam bor pa'i mthus da lta dus kyi snyigs ma la sems can log pa'i las byas pas de tshe lha srin thams cad 'khrugs srid pa lasakyi nad bdag mo bdud mo khrag mig ral pa can:gnyan mo kha 'bar zhes bya ba nad kyi bdag mo chen mo zhig rgya mtsho'i gting nas sku bskyod de ri rab zom la brten bcas nas thal mo bar snang khams su rdeb nga ro nam mkha'i mthongs su 'bod nam mkha' nad kyi rlangs pas sgrib sand me ltar 'bar ba dang :gnyan nad nag po rgyug 'gyel dang :rtsa nad ha la cog 'gyel dang :bdud nad thom po mgo yor dang bal nad nag po sum sgril dang 'dre nad 'jum bo ltag skyed dang :'brum nad ltas gnyan ga pa dang :skya 'brum chu ldur lug mig dang :mdze dang shu dang bol dang 'bras dmu chu skya rbab mjing mchus dang :rtsa rgyug mig ser sha ya dang :sad dang ser ba btsa' dang 'bu:dus kyi zhakhrug pa slo bur gtong :sde pa nang 'thab byed pa dang :btsun pa gri ru gsod pa dang :btsun ma lus rgyan nal bu gsod khyod nyid khros pa'i snga ltas yin sngon gyi bskal ba dang po la spre rgyal ha la mañdzu yi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa khyed nyid bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs shab〉kyi:'brum pa'i nad ni mi gtang bar khas blangs chen po ma byas sam:rdo rje gtum po'i spyan snga phus na da gcad par ma byas sam:dur khrod phung lung nag po phu pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga sa dus kyi tha ma shar ba'i chand yams gtsod bar ma byas sam //nga ni rigs 'dzin chos kyi sku nga yi bka' las khyod ma 'da' nga yi bka' las khyod 'das na rdo rje drag po khros pa yis sdang mig gzigasabs brlag par 'gyur srid pa'i ma mo thams ca18 ༷nga :lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa khyod kyi 'khor

nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog sgrigs mi mas smag rus sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ nang ma 6)dang g.yog yin la dal kha bzlog pa'i bka' nan gyis bh+yo/ rin chen ngar gyi mi mo che nag po khrag gi ral pa can srid pa las kyi dal bdag mo bdud mo lha srin bya ba mo bskyed ni 'byung ba lnga las bskyed brdar ni rin cen lnga la brdar dril ni yon bdag lus la dril byas ni mi mo'i gzugs su byas yin ni nad bdag dngos yin te: 'bul ni lha srin yongs la 'bul rje ni skye 'gro srog dang rje gzhags ni sdebargyad yongs la 'debs ngar mo khrag gi ral pa can phyi bltasapas ni ngar mo la nang bltas pas ni rin cen gter: bar du bltas pas dal bdag mo sha med brtse yi sha rus med dung gi rus khrag ni ma mchis mtshal gyi khrag dbugs med rlung gi dbugs sems med nam mkha'i sems mig med lung thang mig so(9na〉da mgron bu'i so:snying med zho sha'i snying : lag med dbang po'i lag rkang pa ma mchis lcags kyi rkang : skye 'gro semasacan thams cad kyi dbang po sgo lnga'i glud du 'bul: lusang ga yid gsum glud du 'bul: kye glud byung dang po gang nas byung : skud byung lha yi yul nas byung : lha rnams kun la tshad nad byung : mtha' bral lha yi bu mo des rgya mtsho'i gling la khrus la phyin: zla bzang klu yi bu yis bzung : mtha' bral lha yi dmag drangs te klu yi gnas nas bkug kyang shor mtha' bral lha yi rgyal bo des: 'bru bdun ngar gyi phye btags te rin cen lnga yi tshul la sbyar dri ngad sel ba'i spos kyis brgyan ro mchog rtsidang sman gyis brgyan gzugs la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: mdzes pa'i kha dog lnga dang ldan lusangag yid gsum blu ba'i glud gdug pa klu yi bu la sbyin: lha yi bu mo bros shing thar: de nas glud byung gang du byung : skud byung za hor yul du byung : za hor rgyal po grags pa gzi bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyis zin 'tsho byed sman pas sman sbyar kyang : rgyal po dngas par ma gyur nas slob dpon bram ze dge ba yis 'bru bdun ngar gyi mi chen la rnam shes brgyad kyi khong gseng gsal sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs rgyal po'i glud du phul ba yi: rgyal po snyan las grol zhing thar: de nas glud byung gang du byung : skyid byung rgya gar yul du byung : rgya (9bskor chos kyi rgyal po la snyun nad tsi tsi dz+wa —487

wa wa 0dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ ()la byung :de la ci phan dris pa las mo dang phya yis mthong mthong zer:de nas mo dang phywa byas bas:lan chags bsnyeg pa'i lha 'dre la glud dang yon rdzongs thod zhig zer slob dpon skye med rdo rje des spyan drangs gdan la bzhugs su gsol:zhal du mthun pa'i skyems kyang drangs:zhu ba'i phyi tshil snyan du phul slob dpon skye med rdo rje yis:'bru sna phye dgu'i dar phye la rgyal po'i sku yi tshad du byas:sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs bden pa'i tshig gi bkrol nas kyang :snang srid lha 'dre glud la dgyes rgyal po snyun las grol bar gyur:de nas glud byung gang du byung :skud byung rgya nag yul du byung :rgyal po kṛ ki 'od bzang gis bya ba log pa sna tshogs byas nyin mo ltas dang brtag pa ga:mtshan mo ltas dang rmi lam ga bgegs chen langs shing gdon chen g.yos:'jam dpal thugs las sprul pa'i sku:kong tsa 'phrul gyi rgyal po des skor mgo sum brgya drug cu las ga pa sto dang glud kyis bcos:nyes pa ma lus gsal zhing bsdus:de nas glud byung gang du byung :bod kyi dam pa chos skyong ba:rgyal po khri srong lde btsan de dpal gyi bsam yas bzhedas pa'i tshe bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rgyal blon 'khor bcas thugs su zhugs 'byung bzhi'i lus la 'du ba 'khrugs slob dpon pad+ma 'byung 10na skonas kyis lha srin 'khor bcas dbang du bsdus rin cen ngar gyi mi mo la:so so'i mthun rdzas bzhed pas bskor ji ltar 'dod pa spungs shing sbyar sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs bden pa'i tshig gis bkrol te btang :rgyal po lus sems bde ba rnyed:de nas glud byung gang du byung :da lta khyim sgo lam srang 'dir rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi nad dang gnod pa bzlog pa dang :chags che nyam nga bsgyur ba dang :mi mthun phyogs kun gsal ba dang :bde legs phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir grogs sa so so'i thun rdzas dang :mi nor phyugs kyi mthun rdzas dang :rang las lor dang g.yin las btsal:las kyis ra dang yid kyis sprul dga' zhing spro ba'i khams kyis ni:tshul dang mthun pa'i tsho gos 'phreng bcad:gusang dang bas 'bul lags na bu lon lan chags bral bar shog / ༷ra gyi pha smos pa gnam la yang nga rtse ngar gyi ma

nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog gas mi mthun smag rum sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ nang ma (pesmos pa sa la dog mo yul gnam sa gnyis la skyes pa'i dar: snying ni zho sha'i snying : yin dran wal la la rus ni dung gi rus dkar mdangs yer re re sha ni brtse yi sha: smug dang khams rtse kham:khrag ni mtshal gyi khrag dmar mdangs brengs rtse breng :drod ni me yi drod: tsha mdangs lamasaselam dbugs ni rlung gi dbugs 'gyu gdangs brengs se breng : mgo ni go lcags mgo: (10ba)gdong bkrag yal la la skra ni sba zer skra mdzes rgyan pur ru phu lag ni dbang po lag g.ya' gangs sil li li mig ni lung thang mig mthong gdangs rgyangs rgyang : sna ni mo bab sna dri zhim phyings phyir so ni mgron bu'i so: ba 'ad gang yal la la lce na la rgan lce smra skad shar ra ra:rkang pa byung mo'i rkang : 'gros stabs lams se lam gos ni ba la tshoni gos: bzang gos lhab ma lhub ming med rang gi ming : cho 'phreng shar ra ra mi bas glud bzang ste dgos 'dod sna dgu tshapami bas gsung snyan te: tshangs pa lha yi gsung : mi bas 'gro mkhas te khyu mchog ma he'i 'gros:bza' bas kha dro ste: ngad mdangs thibs rtse thib mi bas nor che ste: dkor cha sna tsho gos brgyan phung bo rnam lnga tshang : skye mched bstoganyis tshang : khams chen bco brgyad tshang : lusang ga yid gsum tshang : sgang bu mtho mtho nas gsung snyan kyur ru sa yas kyi yas gdong bzlog: gshong bu dma' dma' nas 'gros bzang ldems se ldem mas kyi mas gdon bzlog ca co ldir ldir nas skyes pa dmag la chas pa 'dra pho bdud dal kha bsgyur rgyan rgyan pur pur nas na chung bag mar mas pa 'dra: mo bdud dal kha bsgyur 'di 'dra'i glud mchog ni: 'phangs pa med par btang : spyi bdud dal kha bsgyur srid pa'i lha 'dre yang : mig gi dbang po yis yas dang glud la ltos rna ba'i dbang po yis brjod pa'i (11na)sgra la nyon: dran pa'i dbang po yis bden pa'i don la soms glud dang rdzongs su 'bul bu lon lan chags 'jol dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad bzlog chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol lo skeg zla sgeg thams cad bzlog za sgeg zhag skeg dus sgeg bzlog kye/srid gsum 'di na gang yang rung : tshur gshegs rgyal pa'i bka' la nyon: 'bru mchog ngar glud ya —489—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mtshan can:sngon tshe lha dbang brgya byin glud da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud:glud bdag thams cad glud long zhig:yas kyi bdag po yas long zhig:rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po yi rus pa'i glud 'di rdo la gtong :rdo la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams glud dang lan chags 'di long la:'khor 'dir gnod pa ma mdzad cig sha yi glud 'di sal gtong :sal gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams glud dang lan chags 'di long la:'khor 'dir gnod pa ma mdzad cig khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong :chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams glud dang lan chags 'di long la:'khor 'dir gnod ba ma mdzad cig drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong :me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams glud dang lan chags 'di long la 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma mdzad cig dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la gtong :rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams glud dang lan chags 'di long la 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma mdzad cig yid kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong :mkha' la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams glud dang lan chags 'di long la 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma mdzad cig sngon tshe bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis da lta rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang :rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yi lhag bsam rnam dag bsham pa ni mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di bzhes la:khram la phab na khram kha phyis sho la bab na sho rdo gtor:rgyan la bab na rgyan kha spos rtsis la bab na rtsis kha phyung :bdud kyi zhags pa kha bsgyur cig bya bsaskru dag dga' ba yin bh+yo/rdzas rnams rdzis blug lamadzos bye/gzugs ge lo gyi mgor rdo rje 'jog/khyod ni bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i tshe ma dang bu ru bsten pa'i tshe gang yab gang gi brag phug 6li tsa byi na dri med kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bca' bzhin:ji ltar dam bca' ma g.yel cig rje dang 'bangs su bsten pa'i tshe be do shan gyi brag phug sa su kha gi ni dri med kyi spyan sngar khas blangasadam bca' bzhin:ji ltar dam bcas ma g.yel cig ma dang sring du bsten pa'i tshe mgon po ma hā kā la yi gtsug lag chen po'i khang bzang du spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin:ji ltar dam bca' ma g.yel cig gcen dang gcung du bste/ ༷'i tshe khri rta sngon po'i ri kha sa bo de tshangs pa bla

nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog ra mthun smag rus sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ nang ma 9)med kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin:ji ltar dam bcas ma g.yel cig grogs dang grogs mor bsten pa'i tshe:tsan dang bu ṭa'i mchod rten du slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin:ji ltar dam bcas ma g.yel cig gtso dang 'khor du bsten pa'i tshe dbang phyug gtso mo khyod rang gis dur khrod rol thang nag po phudakar mo 'od kyi bu mo dang dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad dang :kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' dbyings nas sring mo brgya yi mgrin pa dang ma ru rtse yi sgo 'gram du:phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga phu ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhi dam bca' de las ma 'da' zhig:rang srog snying la me 'bar te:lus ni rdul phran tshig par 'gyur nga yi bstan pa mi rung na mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas te:snying yang nges par dum bur 'gyur de bsam mo rang dam ni:rang gis gsos te dam srungs shig //phyir ba tshe gshegs tshe mi khros/sgrubakhagi mdo lpo bde yang lta bu/stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten nas:snang srid ma mo'i tsho gos dang bcas nad bdag ma mo'i tshogs bcas rnams 'di nas dpag tshad brgyad khri nas lho phyogs gshin thang nag po na:gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yis:chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yod:khyed kyi 'byon sa de ru yod 'di ru ma bzhugs de ru byon nad kyi dal kha de ru spos ma mo'i khram sna de ru bsgyur las kyi rde'u de ru khrom mar gyi dru bu de ru skyong :nad kyi rkyal pa de ru phye 'di ru ma 'dug de ru byon khyed kyi zhugs gnas 'di na med:'di ni khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor 12bti:'di ni khyed kyi bzhugasasamed glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la:rang rang gnas su bde bar gshegs gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na dpal chen che mchog khros pa yi:sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tsho gos dang :'jigasabyed khro bcu'i lha tshogs kyis:ma zhi rungs ba na du brlag par byed:rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' la nyon:rnal 'byor bdag la sdob yi:dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod:tshe yi 'du byed gnad nasabaskul mi rabs bdun brgyud rtsad nas cho de:tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor stungs za thang dbang thang stungs la shog:pho rgyud rtsad nas chod ༷ shog mo rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog chu rgyud rtsad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shenas cho de la shog dgra dpung rtsad nas cho de la shog mi rabs rtsad chonas da la shog nor phyugasartsad nas chod la shog lo tog rtsad nas cho de la shog rnam shes tshogos brgyad sdus la shog snying khrag kha ru rdubs la shog khong khrag rkub nas thon la shog dme dang nang 'khrug thong la shog phung shing rgya 'dre lhongs la shog rims nad char ltar phob la shog dmar nad khrag ltar lhongs la shog:gzer nad phur ltar btsugs la shog gag ltog chu ltar bsnyel la shog dam nyams dgra bo'i yul 'khor du steng nas gza' nad thog ltar phob 'og nas klu nad chu ltar phob bar nas btsan nad gzer ltar phob: snang srid ma mo'i tsho gis rnams kyis glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhesal: sngon tshe (13na)pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' la nyen: bcol ba'i 'phrin las khyed kyis sgrubs: rnal 'byor bden pa'i bka' la nyon bh+yo lha srin sde brgyad spyan lam du: ngar mo chos so glud du chos: bdud mo chos so ma bzlog cig: yab bdud rnams kyi spyan lam du: ngar mo chos so ma bzlog cig yab bdud khram nag skyong ba dang : btsan chen rnams kyi spyan lam du ngar mo chos so ma bzlog cig btsan dmar dar thod spyan lam du dmu dang rgyal po ma bdud dang : klu rgyal rnamasakyi spyan lam du ngar mo chos so ma bzlog cig gnyan po sdebazhi'i spyan lam du ngar mo chos sgom bzlog cig: dmu bdud shor ba sbyan lam du ngar mo chos so ma bzlog cig rgyal nad spyo 'bog bzlog tu gsol ma bdud dal 'bebs bzlog tu gsol mdze nad lhog tsos bzlog tu gsol gto nad gdug pa bzlog tu gsol rbod gtong ga pa'i spyan lam du: ngar mo chos so ma bzlog cig ngar mo mdzes ma 'od 'phro ma lha yi gdon tsho gos bzlog tu gsol g.yin gyi mi thub drag shul can: lha min gdon tsho gos bzlog tu gsol gtum pa chen mo stobs bdag mo klu yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol 'bar ba chen mo 'od ldan ma rlung lha'i gdon tsho gis bzlog tu gsol ngar mo sgeg mo mdangs ldan ma nam mkha' lding gi gdon tsho gis bzlog tu gsol: khro gnyer brjid pa'i smreng gshags kyis dri za'i gdon tsho gos bzlog tu gsol: ngar (13ba〉du rin cen rgyan ldan —492

nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi chog sgrigs mi mthun smag rus sel pa'i brgya phrag nyi dngos/ nang ma 9)ma mi yi gdon tsho gis bzlog tu gsol pad+ma lta bu'i 'od mdangs kyis:sto 'phye'i gdon tshogasabazlog tu gsol:ngar mo brtul zhugs che ba yis:gnod sbyin gdon tshogs bzlog cag sol rdo rje lta bu'i sa mkhregs kyis srin po'i gdon tsho gos bzlog tu gsol ngar mo rin cen lus ldan ma yi dwags gdon tsho gos bzlog tu gsol:ngar mo gzugs bzhis che ba yi sha za'i gdon tshogasabazlog tu gsol:ngar mo stobs dang ldan pa yis:'byung po'i gdon tsho gos bzlog tu gsol:sdobargyad yongs kyi dmag dpung bzlog mo ga pra ga thams cad bzlog tu gsol:skye 'gro yongs kyi tshe glud 'di nad bdag chen mo khyed la 'bul:bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol gdams pa stod la mnan pa thag lan chags bu lon khyer te song :mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa gang yang med 'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem rang gi lus la dpe long la:skye 'gro'i lus la gnod ma byed sems can bde zhing yangs par thob sdug sems ldan pa'i 'khor rnams sdus thams cad rang gi gnas su drongs:gal te mi 'gro bar gcod na:bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang :yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang :mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal dang :pho nya rnams kyi brtul zhugs kyi 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje dang :be con dbyug to zhags pa dang :tho ba lcags kyu 'khrigs pa yis gdug pa'i me 'od tsha tsha 'phro://da ni rdo rje drag po rtsal:rdo rje gur gyi ra ba 4na sko:྅ mdzad la sogs khro bo bcu:sgra 'byin ma sogs khro mo bcu:dpa' bo dpa' mo 'jigs pa'i tshogs 'jigs tshul rngams dang stang stabasakyis gang la bya ba'i dgra dang bgegs gso thabs med par brlag par byed song zhig byer zhig nad bdag mo sha za yi dwags 'byung po'i tshogs:gdug cing rgod na brlag par gyis:྅ hūṃ hūṃ/bh+yo/bla ma de nas khror/dkon cog yi dam lha yi tshogs:ma g.yel ma 'da' bdag gi grogasal spyon:chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs:ma g.yel ma 'da' bdag gi grogs la spyon ched du bsten pa'i dam can ma mo'i tshogs ma g.yel ma 'da' rang gi tha tshig long :las kyi chagasapa'i lha 'dre dregs pa can dus la bab kyi da ni 4shur du spyon ma dang sring mo bu mo bran mo'i tshogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa sha dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheslas dang phyi mo bran dang yang bran rnams do nub dus bab ma sring rgya mtsho dus do nub gzu dang dpang mdzod dkon cog gsum do nub snang srid lha 'dres zhal che chod: ma nyes ma yo gzu dang dpang po mdzod da lta mtshan ma'i dngos po 'di la gzigs dus kyi tha ma las kyi mnar ba dag bka' dang gzhung bzhin dam tshig spyad dbang med yar bltas gnam la mar bltas sa la thug pha bos brag la ma bos chu ru 'dug 'di 'dra'i dus na dam can las ma g.yel rang sngags nus pasarang srog bcad ta re dus la bab kyi da ni dam la 'dus bh+yo/ do nub dgra la zor gcig 'phen ma zu ra yi thod pa sa khrag sna gsum gyi smyug chen la spyo byed dug gi spro yang bskyon yungs kar 'bar ba'i mde'u g.yel khro chu 'bar ba'i bcas kyis dkris zor gyi gzhung mchog lams se lam:sngags kyi rgyud sgra chems se chem: dam nyams dgra bo las ga 'di dang po zhe sdang pha yis bskyed bar du 'dod chags ma yi mngal tha ma dri za sto bar 'khor: de nas lnga phung lus su grub lnga phung rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir lha mo nag mo zor 'phongs la mon mos skyogs kyi dpung thul cig bal mos zor gyi kha sgyur cig dam nyams dgra bo lasang na 'di'i 'go ba'i lha la khrag zor ā ming dang gzugs la khrag zor ma srog rtsa dmar la khrag zor yu snying rtsa rgyud la khrag zor lha pho rgyud rtsad cho rtanas da la shog mo rgyud mngal nas skoms la shog chu rgyud rtsad nas da la shog dgra dpung rtsad nas cho de la shog do nub dgra la dmag cig 'dren: ma mo'i khrag sna dgra la sgyur ma mo'i dal yams dgra la thong : ma mo'i bdun stangs dgra la thong : rtsis kyi rde'u dgra la thong : nad kyi dal yams dgra la phob dam nyams dgra bo'i yul 'khor du ma mo'i rta khrom khyil li li dar nag ru mtshon thibs se thib rims nad sna tsho gos char ltar phob: glo bur 'khrug pa'i skyin thang thong :srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis chod: tshe yi 'du byed gnad nas bkum ma mo'i za res dgra la phob nad kyi na bun thul lu lu mtshon gyi char pa shar ra ra ma mo'i g.yab dar (15na〉ngas rtse ling : ma mo lce rgya zhen pa yer re re ltasang na yang sprul mang po thibs4thib mi rkang gling bu skyur ru phu ཿga —494
